window.__IS_ADMIN = false;
// Loaded by both current and legacy boot paths. Install each runtime once.
(function installSecurityRuntimeOnce() {
if (window.__eldoradoSecurityRuntimeLoaded) return;
window.__eldoradoSecurityRuntimeLoaded = true;

// Polyfills for legacy Smart TV browsers (Tizen 2.4-4.0, WebOS 3.x, old WebKit)
if (typeof Object.assign !== 'function') {
    Object.assign = function(target) {
        var to = Object(target);
        for (var i = 1; i < arguments.length; i++) {
            var nextSource = arguments[i];
            if (nextSource != null) {
                for (var key in nextSource) {
                    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(nextSource, key)) {
                        to[key] = nextSource[key];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return to;
    };
}
if (typeof window.fetch !== 'function' && typeof XMLHttpRequest !== 'undefined') {
    window.fetch = function(url, options) {
        options = options || {};
        return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
            try {
                var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                xhr.open(options.method || 'GET', url, true);
                if (options.credentials === 'include' || options.credentials === 'same-origin') {
                    xhr.withCredentials = true;
                }
                var headers = options.headers || {};
                for (var k in headers) {
                    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(headers, k)) {
                        xhr.setRequestHeader(k, headers[k]);
                    }
                }
                xhr.onload = function() {
                    var text = xhr.responseText || '';
                    resolve({
                        ok: xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300,
                        status: xhr.status,
                        text: function() { return Promise.resolve(text); },
                        json: function() {
                            try { return Promise.resolve(JSON.parse(text)); }
                            catch (e) { return Promise.reject(e); }
                        }
                    });
                };
                xhr.onerror = function() { reject(new Error('NETWORK_ERROR')); };
                xhr.ontimeout = function() { reject(new Error('NETWORK_TIMEOUT')); };
                xhr.send(options.body || null);
            } catch (err) {
                reject(err);
            }
        });
    };
}

// Anti-Cheat Script (Silently counters hacks)
(function () {
    if (window.__patch_safe2_loaded) return;
    window.__patch_safe2_loaded = true;

    // Silence keypress & mouseup debug logs in console
    (function silenceKeypressLogs() {
        var origLog = console.log;
        console.log = function() {
            if (arguments.length > 0 && typeof arguments[0] === 'string') {
                if (arguments[0].indexOf('Time since last key press') >= 0 ||
                    arguments[0].indexOf('First key press detected') >= 0 ||
                    arguments[0].indexOf('Time since last onMouseUp') >= 0 ||
                    arguments[0].indexOf('First onMouseUp detected') >= 0) {
                    return;
                }
            }
            return origLog.apply(console, arguments);
        };
    })();

    // Socket.IO is protected by TLS and the authenticated session. Keep the
    // payload structured so the client avoids fixed-key crypto and eval code.
    window.__wsEncrypt = function(data) {
        return data;
    };
    
    window.__wsDecrypt = function(encoded) {
        if (!encoded) return null;
        if (typeof encoded !== 'string') return encoded;
        try { return JSON.parse(encoded); } catch(e) { return null; }
    };

    window.__sg_pack = window.__wsEncrypt;
    window.__sg_unpack = window.__wsDecrypt;

    // Prevent put_error_log spam lag
    var _ServerConnectionCheck = setInterval(function() {
        if (window.ServerConnection) {
            window.ServerConnection.put_error_log = function() {};
            window.ServerConnection.put_black_list_my_id = function() {};
            clearInterval(_ServerConnectionCheck);
        }
    }, 100);

    // Neutralize WSS_DUP — the legacy Korean duplicate-login WebSocket checker.
    // It hardcodes ws://211.253.26.47:50231 which browsers block on HTTPS pages.
    // Eldorado already handles session enforcement via Socket.IO, so stub it out.
    var _wssDupStubTimer = setInterval(function() {
        if (typeof WSS_DUP !== 'undefined') {
            WSS_DUP.init = function() {};
            WSS_DUP.send_msg = function() {};
            WSS_DUP.url = '';
            if (WSS_DUP.obj) {
                try { WSS_DUP.obj.close(); } catch(e) {}
                WSS_DUP.obj = null;
            }
            clearInterval(_wssDupStubTimer);
        } else if (window.WSS_DUP === undefined) {
            // Define it early so the minified code's assignment doesn't re-init
            window.WSS_DUP = { url: '', obj: null, init: function() {}, send_msg: function() {} };
        }
    }, 50);

})();

(function () {

// Gacha results are generated by the authenticated server. Client probability
// tables are display-only and are never rewritten in a polling loop.

// DATA1 uses nine wire slots; the native game keeps an unused slot at index 0.
// Check the exact live snapshot against the DB before constructing any battle.
// The server repeats this check on entry; this gate is the
// cooperative client's recovery path, not a security boundary on its own.
(function installUpgradeEntryGuard() {
    var pendingEntry = null;
    var pendingPurchase = null;
    var transitionSequence = 0;
    var activeCombat = null;
    var invalidCombat = false;

    function normalizeArray(values) {
        if (!Array.isArray(values) || values.length !== 9) return null;
        var result = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            var value = values[i];
            if (typeof value === 'string' && /^\d+$/.test(value)) value = Number(value);
            if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0) return null;
            result.push(value);
        }
        return result;
    }

    window.__eldoradoUpgradeSnapshot = function() {
        var values = window.STORAGE && window.STORAGE.data1 && window.STORAGE.data1.upgrade;
        if (!Array.isArray(values)) return null;
        if (values.length === 10) {
            if (values[0] !== undefined && values[0] !== null && values[0] !== 0) return null;
            values = values.slice(1);
        }
        var normalized = normalizeArray(values);
        return normalized ? normalized.join(':') : null;
    };

    window.__eldoradoApplyUpgradeSnapshot = function(values) {
        var normalized = normalizeArray(values);
        if (!normalized || !window.STORAGE || !window.STORAGE.data1) return false;
        // Background account refreshes must not replace the battle's inputs.
        if (activeCombat) return normalized.join(':') === activeCombat.snapshot;
        window.STORAGE.data1.upgrade = [0].concat(normalized);
        window.MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN = normalized[5];
        // A stale legacy mobile capacity must not leak back into make_data1.
        window.M_OUR_PRODUCT_NUM = 0;
        if (window.DEFINE) {
            window.DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX = normalized[8];
            window.DEFINE.USER_ITEM_PAGE_MAX = Math.ceil(normalized[8] / 12);
            var itemSize = Math.min(1000, window.DEFINE.USER_ITEM_PAGE_MAX * 12) + 2;
            if (Array.isArray(window.STORAGE.item)) {
                while (window.STORAGE.item.length < itemSize) {
                    window.STORAGE.item.push({ item_num: 0, socket_index: 0, add_option: '', add_option_num: 0, add_option_reset_num: 0, lock: 0, is_new: 0 });
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    };

    function releaseCombatSnapshot() {
        var previous = activeCombat;
        activeCombat = null;
        if (!previous) return;
        var descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(previous.owner, 'upgrade');
        if (descriptor && descriptor.configurable) {
            Object.defineProperty(previous.owner, 'upgrade', {
                value: previous.values.slice(), enumerable: true, writable: true, configurable: true
            });
        }
    }

    function isPvpRankingMode(mode) {
        return mode === 2 || mode === 3 || mode === 8 || mode === 10;
    }

    function combatSnapshotMatches() {
        if (!activeCombat || !window.STORAGE || window.STORAGE.data1 !== activeCombat.owner) return false;
        if (window.STORAGE.data1.upgrade !== activeCombat.values) return false;
        if (window.__eldoradoUpgradeSnapshot() !== activeCombat.snapshot) return false;
        var stageMatches = window.S_GAME.stage === activeCombat.stage ||
            (isPvpRankingMode(activeCombat.rankingMode) && window.S_GAME.stage === 290);
        if (!stageMatches) return false;
        var currentRankingMode = Number(window.S_GAME.ranking_mode);
        return currentRankingMode === activeCombat.rankingMode ||
            (activeCombat.targetScene === window.S_DAYDUNGEON && currentRankingMode === 6) ||
            (activeCombat.targetScene === window.S_BOSS && activeCombat.rankingMode === 9 &&
                window.S_BOSS && !window.S_BOSS.guild_boss_ctx);
    }

    function rejectCombat() {
        if (invalidCombat) return false;
        invalidCombat = true;
        window.__eldoradoStageRun = null;
        window.__eldoradoStageRunPromise = Promise.resolve(null);
        if (window.S_GAME) {
            window.S_GAME.end_flag = 1;
            if (typeof window.S_GAME.end === 'function') window.S_GAME.end();
        }
        releaseCombatSnapshot();
        window.gEnableKey = 1;
        if (window.utilNotice) window.utilNotice('Dữ liệu nâng cấp trong trận đã thay đổi hoặc chưa được xác minh. Trận đã dừng; vui lòng vào lại.', 4);
        return false;
    }

    function lockCombatSnapshot(snapshot, stage, rankingMode, targetScene) {
        releaseCombatSnapshot();
        var owner = window.STORAGE && window.STORAGE.data1;
        var values = normalizeArray(String(snapshot).split(':'));
        if (!owner || !values) throw new Error('UPGRADE_SNAPSHOT_INVALID');
        var frozen = Object.freeze([0].concat(values));
        Object.defineProperty(owner, 'upgrade', {
            value: frozen, enumerable: true, writable: false, configurable: true
        });
        activeCombat = {
            owner: owner,
            values: frozen,
            snapshot: snapshot,
            stage: stage,
            rankingMode: rankingMode,
            targetScene: targetScene || null
        };
        invalidCombat = false;
    }

    function installCombatConsumers() {
        // Check again at preload/init: image loading is asynchronous, so checking
        // only when ChangeScene.start is called leaves another mutation window.
        ['preload', 'init', 'interval', 'stage_clear', 'die_your_castle', 'win'].forEach(function(name) {
            var original = window.S_GAME[name];
            if (typeof original !== 'function' || original.__upgrade_consumer_guard) return;
            var guarded = function() {
                if (!combatSnapshotMatches()) return rejectCombat();
                return original.apply(this, arguments);
            };
            guarded.__upgrade_consumer_guard = true;
            window.S_GAME[name] = guarded;
        });
    }

    window.__eldoradoHandleUpgradeRejection = function(response) {
        var code = String(response && (response.CODE || response.code) || '');
        if (!/^UPGRADE_/.test(code)) return false;
        var restored = window.__eldoradoApplyUpgradeSnapshot(response.upgrade_arr);
        window.__eldoradoStageRun = null;
        window.gEnableKey = 1;
        if (typeof window.loading_hide === 'function') window.loading_hide();
        var currentScene = window.g_sceneinfo && window[window.g_sceneinfo.cur_scene];
        if (currentScene && typeof currentScene.addMouseEvent === 'function') currentScene.addMouseEvent();
        if (window.utilNotice) window.utilNotice(restored
            ? 'Nâng cấp chưa khớp dữ liệu máy chủ. Đã đồng bộ lại; vui lòng vào trận lại.'
            : 'Chưa xác minh được dữ liệu nâng cấp. Vui lòng tải lại game.', 3);
        return true;
    };

    // The normal button and Up Max both buy through the same DB-owned path.
    // Never run the native optimistic increment/save or its duplicate PAY save.
    window.__eldoradoPurchaseUpgrade = function() {
        if (pendingPurchase) return pendingPurchase;
        var snapshot = window.__eldoradoUpgradeSnapshot();
        var index = Number(window.S_UPGRADE && window.S_UPGRADE.focus) - 1;
        var token = localStorage.getItem('busidol_auth_token') || '';
        if (!snapshot || !Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0 || index > 8 || !token) return Promise.resolve(false);
        var from = Number(snapshot.split(':')[index]);
        var controller = typeof window.AbortController === 'function' ? new window.AbortController() : null;
        var timer = controller ? setTimeout(function() { controller.abort(); }, 10000) : null;
        if (window.loading_show) window.loading_show('업그레이드', 1);
        var options = {
            method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Session-Token': token },
            body: JSON.stringify({ data_idx: index, from_lv: from, to_lv: from + 1, purchase_mode: 'single' })
        };
        if (controller) options.signal = controller.signal;
        pendingPurchase = window.fetch('/api/castle_upgrade/upgrade', options).then(function(response) {
            return response.json();
        }).then(function(response) {
            if (!response || response.STATE !== 'SUCCESS') {
                if (!window.__eldoradoHandleUpgradeRejection(response) && window.utilNotice) {
                    window.utilNotice(response && response.MSG || 'Không thể nâng cấp. Vui lòng thử lại.', 3);
                }
                return false;
            }
            if (!window.__eldoradoApplyUpgradeSnapshot(response.upgrade_arr)) throw new Error('UPGRADE_RESPONSE_INVALID');
            if (typeof window.applyAuthoritativeResourceSnapshot === 'function') {
                window.applyAuthoritativeResourceSnapshot({ resources: { gold: response.gold, ruby: response.ruby } });
            } else {
                ['gold', 'ruby'].forEach(function(key) {
                    if (window.USER) window.USER[key] = response[key];
                    if (window.STORAGE && window.STORAGE.data1) window.STORAGE.data1[key] = response[key];
                    if (window.gEntrix) window.gEntrix[key] = response[key];
                });
            }
            return true;
        }).catch(function() {
            if (window.utilNotice) window.utilNotice('Chưa nhận được kết quả nâng cấp. Vui lòng đồng bộ lại trước khi thử tiếp.', 3);
            return false;
        }).then(function(success) {
            if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
            pendingPurchase = null;
            if (window.loading_hide) window.loading_hide('업그레이드', 1);
            if (window.S_UPGRADE && typeof window.S_UPGRADE.goto_next_scene === 'function') window.S_UPGRADE.goto_next_scene();
            return success;
        });
        return pendingPurchase;
    };

    window.__eldoradoAttachUpgradeToEntry = function(url, data) {
        if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return data;
        var target = String(url || '');
        var mode = String(data.MODE || data.mode || '').toUpperCase();
        if (/\/update_guild_(?:boss|battle)\.php(?:[?#]|$)/i.test(target) && data.json_obj) {
            var nested = data.json_obj;
            try { if (typeof nested === 'string') nested = JSON.parse(nested); } catch (error) { return data; }
            if (nested && (nested.act === 'enter_battle' || nested.act === 'insert_guild_battle_start')) {
                data.UPGRADE = window.__eldoradoUpgradeSnapshot();
                nested.UPGRADE = data.UPGRADE;
                data.json_obj = typeof data.json_obj === 'string' ? JSON.stringify(nested) : nested;
            }
        }
        if (/\/(?:enter_boss_game|enter_sky_game|enter_pvp_game|enter_pvp_cls_game|stage_start|stage_clear)\.php(?:[?#]|$)/i.test(target) ||
            (/\/update_daydungeon_cur_ticket\.php(?:[?#]|$)/i.test(target) && Number(data.FREE_TICKET_NUM) < 0) ||
            (/cloud_garden/i.test(target) && (mode === 'GAME_TICKET' || mode === 'GAME_RUBY'))) {
            data.UPGRADE = window.__eldoradoUpgradeSnapshot();
        }
        return data;
    };

    function validateSnapshot(snapshot) {
        var token = localStorage.getItem('busidol_auth_token') || '';
        if (!token || typeof window.fetch !== 'function') return Promise.reject(new Error('UPGRADE_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE'));
        return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
            var settled = false;
            var controller = typeof window.AbortController === 'function' ? new window.AbortController() : null;
            var timer = setTimeout(function() {
                if (settled) return;
                settled = true;
                if (controller) controller.abort();
                reject(new Error('UPGRADE_CHECK_TIMEOUT'));
            }, 10000);
            var options = {
                method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Session-Token': token },
                body: JSON.stringify({ UPGRADE: snapshot })
            };
            if (controller) options.signal = controller.signal;
            window.fetch('/api/castle_upgrade/validate', options).then(function(response) {
                return response.json().then(function(body) {
                    if (!response.ok || !body || body.STATE !== 'SUCCESS') {
                        var error = new Error(body && body.CODE || 'UPGRADE_CHECK_FAILED');
                        error.response = body;
                        throw error;
                    }
                    return body;
                });
            }).then(function(body) {
                if (settled) return;
                settled = true;
                clearTimeout(timer);
                resolve(body);
            }, function(error) {
                if (settled) return;
                settled = true;
                clearTimeout(timer);
                reject(error);
            });
        });
    }

    function isBattleTransition(args) {
        return (window.S_GAME && args[2] === window.S_GAME) ||
            (window.gS_GAME !== undefined && args[1] === window.gS_GAME) ||
            (window.S_BOSS && args[2] === window.S_BOSS) ||
            (window.S_DAYDUNGEON && args[2] === window.S_DAYDUNGEON);
    }

    function install() {
        if (!window.ChangeScene || typeof window.ChangeScene.start !== 'function' || !window.S_GAME) return false;
        installCombatConsumers();
        if (window.ChangeScene.start.__upgrade_entry_guard) return true;
        var originalStart = window.ChangeScene.start;
        var guardedStart = function() {
            var args = Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments);
            var receiver = this;
            if (!isBattleTransition(args)) {
                if (activeCombat && !combatSnapshotMatches()) {
                    rejectCombat();
                    if (args[2] === window.S_STAGECLEAR) return;
                }
                releaseCombatSnapshot();
                transitionSequence++;
                pendingEntry = null;
                // The clear scene still needs this run to settle its reward.
                return originalStart.apply(receiver, args);
            }
            if (pendingEntry) return pendingEntry;
            var sequence = ++transitionSequence;
            var snapshot = window.__eldoradoUpgradeSnapshot();
            var stage = window.S_GAME.stage;
            var rankingMode = Number(window.S_GAME.ranking_mode);
            var sourceScene = window.g_sceneinfo && window.g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
            window.gEnableKey = 0;
            window.__eldoradoStageRun = null;
            function isCurrent() {
                return sequence === transitionSequence &&
                    (!window.g_sceneinfo || window.g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === sourceScene) &&
                    window.S_GAME.stage === stage && Number(window.S_GAME.ranking_mode) === rankingMode;
            }
            var entry = validateSnapshot(snapshot).then(function() {
                if (!isCurrent()) return false;
                if (snapshot !== window.__eldoradoUpgradeSnapshot()) throw new Error('UPGRADE_CHANGED_DURING_ENTRY');
                if ((args[2] === window.S_GAME || args[1] === window.gS_GAME) && (rankingMode === 0 || rankingMode === 5)) {
                    if (typeof window.__eldoradoBeginStageRun !== 'function') throw new Error('STAGE_START_UNAVAILABLE');
                    return window.__eldoradoBeginStageRun(stage, rankingMode).then(function(run) {
                        if (!run) {
                            var err = new Error('STAGE_START_FAILED');
                            err.response = window.__lastStageStartError && window.__lastStageStartError.response;
                            throw err;
                        }
                        return true;
                    });
                }
                return true;
            }).then(function(ready) {
                if (!ready || !isCurrent()) return;
                if (snapshot !== window.__eldoradoUpgradeSnapshot()) throw new Error('UPGRADE_CHANGED_DURING_ENTRY');
                lockCombatSnapshot(snapshot, stage, rankingMode, args[2]);
                return originalStart.apply(receiver, args);
            }).catch(function(error) {
                if (!isCurrent()) return;
                releaseCombatSnapshot();
                window.__eldoradoStageRun = null;
                window.gEnableKey = 1;
                var source = window[sourceScene];
                if (source && typeof source.resume === 'function') source.resume();
                if (source && typeof source.addMouseEvent === 'function') source.addMouseEvent();
                var respCode = error && error.response && (error.response.CODE || error.response.code);
                if (!window.__eldoradoHandleUpgradeRejection(error.response) && window.utilNotice) {
                    if (respCode === 'STAGE_LOCKED') {
                        window.utilNotice('Màn này chưa được mở khóa!', 3);
                    } else {
                        window.utilNotice('Chưa xác minh được nâng cấp với máy chủ. Vui lòng thử vào trận lại.', 3);
                    }
                }
            }).then(function(result) {
                if (sequence === transitionSequence) pendingEntry = null;
                return result;
            });
            pendingEntry = entry;
            return entry;
        };
        guardedStart.__upgrade_entry_guard = true;
        // The shipped bundle returns Object.freeze(f). Assigning f.start is a
        // silent no-op, so replace the global facade and retain its closures.
        var facade = Object.assign({}, window.ChangeScene, { start: guardedStart });
        window.ChangeScene = Object.freeze(facade);
        return window.ChangeScene.start === guardedStart;
    }
    window.__eldoradoInstallUpgradeGuard = install;
    if (!install()) {
        var attempts = 0;
        var timer = setInterval(function() {
            if (install() || ++attempts >= 1200) clearInterval(timer);
        }, 50);
    }
})();

// A normal map can be settled only after the authenticated server has created
// a short-lived run nonce. The nonce lives in memory (not localStorage) and is
// attached by patch.js to the one legacy MODE=stageclear save.
(function installStageRunAdapter() {
    var requestSequence = 0;

    function normalizeStage(value) {
        var stage = parseInt(value, 10);
        return isFinite(stage) && stage >= 1 && stage <= 320 ? stage : 0;
    }

    function normalizeMode(value) {
        var mode = parseInt(value, 10);
        return mode === 0 || mode === 5 ? mode : -1;
    }

    function acceptStageRun(response, sequence, stage, rankingMode) {
        if (sequence !== requestSequence || !response) return null;
        var nonce = response.runNonce || response.RUN_NONCE;
        if (!(response.ok === true || response.STATE === 'SUCCESS') ||
            typeof nonce !== 'string' || !/^[a-f0-9]{32,64}$/i.test(nonce)) {
            throw new Error((response && response.code) || (response && response.CODE) || 'STAGE_START_REJECTED');
        }
        window.__eldoradoStageRun = {
            stage: stage,
            rankingMode: rankingMode,
            nonce: nonce,
            expiresAt: Number(response.expiresAt) || 0
        };
        return window.__eldoradoStageRun;
    }

    function beginThroughHttp(stage, rankingMode, upgrade) {
        var token = localStorage.getItem('busidol_auth_token') || '';
        if (!token || typeof window.fetch !== 'function') {
            return Promise.reject(new Error('STAGE_START_HTTP_UNAVAILABLE'));
        }
        return window.fetch('/api/stage/start', {
            method: 'POST',
            credentials: 'same-origin',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'X-Session-Token': token
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ stage: stage, rankingMode: rankingMode, UPGRADE: upgrade })
        }).then(function(response) {
            return response.json().catch(function() { return {}; }).then(function(body) {
                if (!response.ok) {
                    var error = new Error(body.CODE || 'STAGE_START_HTTP_FAILED');
                    error.response = body;
                    throw error;
                }
                return body;
            });
        });
    }

    function beginThroughSocket(stage, rankingMode, upgrade) {
        return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
            var socket = window.__busidol_socket;
            if (!socket || !socket.connected || typeof socket.emit !== 'function') {
                reject(new Error('STAGE_START_SOCKET_UNAVAILABLE'));
                return;
            }
            var finished = false;
            var timer = setTimeout(function() {
                if (finished) return;
                finished = true;
                reject(new Error('STAGE_START_SOCKET_TIMEOUT'));
            }, 4000);
            socket.emit('stage_start', { stage: stage, rankingMode: rankingMode, UPGRADE: upgrade }, function(response) {
                if (finished) return;
                finished = true;
                clearTimeout(timer);
                if (!response || response.ok !== true) {
                    var error = new Error((response && (response.code || response.CODE)) || 'STAGE_START_SOCKET_FAILED');
                    error.response = response;
                    reject(error);
                    return;
                }
                resolve(response);
            });
        });
    }

    window.__eldoradoBeginStageRun = function(stageValue, rankingModeValue) {
        var stage = normalizeStage(stageValue);
        var rankingMode = normalizeMode(rankingModeValue);
        if (!stage || rankingMode < 0) {
            window.__eldoradoStageRun = null;
            return Promise.resolve(null);
        }

        var sequence = ++requestSequence;
        window.__eldoradoStageRun = null;
        var upgrade = typeof window.__eldoradoUpgradeSnapshot === 'function' ? window.__eldoradoUpgradeSnapshot() : null;
        var request = beginThroughSocket(stage, rankingMode, upgrade)
            .catch(function(error) {
                if (error.response) throw error;
                return beginThroughHttp(stage, rankingMode, upgrade);
            })
            .then(function(response) { return acceptStageRun(response, sequence, stage, rankingMode); })
            .catch(function(error) {
                if (sequence === requestSequence) window.__eldoradoStageRun = null;
                window.__lastStageStartError = error;
                if (typeof window.__eldoradoHandleUpgradeRejection === 'function') window.__eldoradoHandleUpgradeRejection(error.response);
                console.warn('[ANTI-CHEAT] Không thể bắt đầu stage an toàn:', error && error.message ? error.message : error);
                return null;
            });
        window.__eldoradoStageRunPromise = request;
        return request;
    };

    window.__eldoradoAttachStageRunNonce = function(data) {
        var run = window.__eldoradoStageRun;
        if (!run || !run.nonce) return data;
        if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
            if (String(data.MODE || '').toLowerCase() !== 'stageclear') return data;
            if (normalizeStage(data.STAGE) !== run.stage) return data;
            data.STAGE_RUN_NONCE = run.nonce;
            return data;
        }
        if (typeof data === 'string' && /(?:^|&)MODE=stageclear(?:&|$)/i.test(data)) {
            var match = data.match(/(?:^|&)STAGE=(\d+)(?:&|$)/i);
            if (match && normalizeStage(match[1]) === run.stage) {
                return data + (data ? '&' : '') + 'STAGE_RUN_NONCE=' + encodeURIComponent(run.nonce);
            }
        }
        return data;
    };

    window.__eldoradoFinishStageRun = function(stageValue) {
        var stage = normalizeStage(stageValue);
        if (window.__eldoradoStageRun && window.__eldoradoStageRun.stage === stage) {
            window.__eldoradoStageRun = null;
        }
    };
})();

// --- 1-SECOND MINIMUM MATCH DURATION & ANTI-SPEEDHACK GUARD ---
(function() {
    var _nativeDateNow = typeof Date !== 'undefined' && typeof Date.now === 'function'
        ? Date.now.bind(Date)
        : function() { return (new Date()).getTime(); };
    var _nativePerfNow = typeof performance !== 'undefined' && typeof performance.now === 'function'
        ? performance.now.bind(performance)
        : null;
    var closureMatchStartWall = 0;
    var closureMatchStartPerf = 0;

    function checkMinDuration() {
        if (window.USER && Number(window.USER.admin) === 1) return false;
        var nowWall = _nativeDateNow();
        var fallbackStart = (window.S_GAME && window.S_GAME.start_time) || (window.S_GAME && window.S_GAME.stage_start_time) || window.__lastMatchStartTime || 0;
        var startTime = closureMatchStartWall > 0 ? closureMatchStartWall : fallbackStart;
        var wallDuration = startTime > 0 ? (nowWall - startTime) : 999999;
        var perfDuration = (_nativePerfNow && closureMatchStartPerf > 0) ? (_nativePerfNow() - closureMatchStartPerf) : wallDuration;
        var effectiveDuration = Math.min(wallDuration, perfDuration);

        var isBoss = window.S_GAME && typeof window.S_GAME.is_boss_mode === 'function' && window.S_GAME.is_boss_mode();
        var isCloud = window.S_GAME && typeof window.S_GAME.is_cloud_garden_mode === 'function' && window.S_GAME.is_cloud_garden_mode();
        var isSky = window.S_GAME && typeof window.S_GAME.is_sky_garden_mode === 'function' && window.S_GAME.is_sky_garden_mode();

        if (!isBoss && !isCloud && !isSky) {
            if (effectiveDuration < 1000) {
                console.warn('[ANTI-CHEAT] Match duration (' + Math.round(effectiveDuration) + 'ms) < 1000ms! Invalidated -> FAIL.');
                return true; // Cheated!
            }
            if (_nativePerfNow && closureMatchStartPerf > 0 && perfDuration < 1500 && (wallDuration - perfDuration) > 2500) {
                console.warn('[ANTI-CHEAT] Clock warp detected during match! Invalidated -> FAIL.');
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    // Record start time on S_GAME.init
    var hookAttempts = 0;
    var minDurationHookTimer = setInterval(function() {
        if (window.S_GAME && typeof window.S_GAME.init === 'function' && !window.S_GAME.__start_time_rec_hooked) {
            window.S_GAME.__start_time_rec_hooked = true;
            var origInit = window.S_GAME.init;
            window.S_GAME.init = function() {
                var nowWall = _nativeDateNow();
                closureMatchStartWall = nowWall;
                closureMatchStartPerf = _nativePerfNow ? _nativePerfNow() : 0;
                window.__lastMatchStartTime = nowWall;
                if (window.S_GAME) window.S_GAME.start_time = nowWall;
                // ChangeScene's entry guard has already awaited DB validation
                // and the stage nonce. Starting another async run here would
                // invalidate that nonce after gameplay has started.
                return origInit.apply(this, arguments);
            };
        }

        // 1. Hook S_GAME.stage_clear
        if (window.S_GAME && typeof window.S_GAME.stage_clear === 'function' && !window.S_GAME.__min_time_hooked) {
            window.S_GAME.__min_time_hooked = true;
            var origStageClear = window.S_GAME.stage_clear;
            window.S_GAME.stage_clear = function() {
                if (checkMinDuration()) {
                    if (window.utilNotice) window.utilNotice('Trận đấu kết thúc quá nhanh (< 1s)! Kết quả không được tính.', 2.5);
                    window.S_GAME.loss && window.S_GAME.loss();
                    window.S_GAME.end && window.S_GAME.end();
                    if (window.ChangeScene && window.g_sceneinfo && window.gS_STAGEFAIL && window.S_STAGEFAIL) {
                        window.ChangeScene.start(window.g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, window.gS_STAGEFAIL, window.S_STAGEFAIL);
                        return;
                    }
                }
                return origStageClear.apply(this, arguments);
            };
        }

        // 2. Hook S_STAGECLEAR.init (Backup check before rendering Stage Clear screen)
        if (window.S_STAGECLEAR && typeof window.S_STAGECLEAR.init === 'function' && !window.S_STAGECLEAR.__min_time_hooked) {
            window.S_STAGECLEAR.__min_time_hooked = true;
            var origStageClearInit = window.S_STAGECLEAR.init;
            window.S_STAGECLEAR.init = function() {
                if (checkMinDuration()) {
                    console.warn('[ANTI-CHEAT] Intercepted S_STAGECLEAR.init due to < 1s duration!');
                    if (window.utilNotice) window.utilNotice('Trận đấu kết thúc quá nhanh (< 1s)! Kết quả không được tính.', 2.5);
                    if (window.ChangeScene && window.g_sceneinfo && window.gS_STAGEFAIL && window.S_STAGEFAIL) {
                        window.ChangeScene.start(window.g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, window.gS_STAGEFAIL, window.S_STAGEFAIL);
                        return;
                    }
                }
                return origStageClearInit.apply(this, arguments);
            };
        }

        // 3. Hook S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.init
        if (window.S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR && typeof window.S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.init === 'function' && !window.S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.__min_time_hooked) {

function add_event_pop() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV ? (window.addEventListener("popstate", add_popstate), utilConsoleLog("== addEventListener : popstate ==")) : utilConsoleLog("Not Web OS")
}

function run_scene_back() {
  var n = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene,
    t = null;
  if (BACK_IGNORE_SCENE[n]) return utilPush(), utilConsoleLog("popstate() back 무시 화면:" + n), !1;
  try {
    if (t = window[n], t) {
      if (typeof t.backKey == "function") return t.backKey(), !0;
      if (typeof t.back == "function") return t.back(), !0
    }
  } catch (i) {
    return utilPush(), ServerConnection.put_error_log("popstate:back error:" + n + ":" + i.message), !1
  }
  return utilPush(), g_back_not_handled_scene != n && (g_back_not_handled_scene = n, ServerConnection.put_error_log("popstate:back key not handled:" + n)), utilConsoleLog("popstate() 미등록 화면:" + n), !1
}

function add_popstate() {
  if (utilConsoleLog("=1=popstate() 실행:" + g_sceneinfo.cur_scene), g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_MAINMENU) {
    if (gHISTORY.pop(), bsdPAY.scene == gS_MARKETSTORE_PAYMENT_PRELOAD) {
      bsdPAY.flag_back = 1;
      utilPush();
      utilConsoleLog("gS_MARKETSTORE_PAYMENT_PRELOAD back!!");
      return
    }
    if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != "KR_INPUT" && gEnableKey == 0) {
      utilPush();
      utilConsoleLog("=2=popstate() 실행:key lock :" + history.length);
      return
    }
  }
  switch (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene) {
    case gS_GACHA_SELECTION:
      utilPush();
      utilConsoleLog("S_GACHA_SELECTION back.....");
      S_GACHA_SELECTION.back();
      break;
    case gS_POPUPYN:
      utilPush();
      utilConsoleLog("gs_POPUPYN back.....");
      S_POPUPYN.back();
      break;
    case gS_LOGO:
      utilConsoleLog("=============4=popstate() 실행:" + history.length);
      break;
    case gS_MAINMENU:
      if (S_MAINMENU.menu_overlay.is_show()) {
        S_MAINMENU.menu_overlay.back();
        return
      }
      if (S_MAINMENU.flag_ani_ing == 1) {
        utilConsoleLog("==3=popstate() 실행:flag_mm_ani :1");
        gHISTORY.pop();
        utilPush();
        return
      }
      utilConsoleLog("Main-back!");
      glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK && history.back();
      break;
    case gS_SETTING:
      if ($("#KR_INPUT_widow_div")[0]) {
        KR_INPUT.back();
        return
      }
      if (S_SETTING.flag_init == 1) {
        location.reload(!0);
        return
      }
      S_SETTING.sub_menu_mode == 1 ? S_SETTING.backKey_sub() : S_SETTING.backKey();
      break;
    case gS_GONGJI:
      S_GONGJI.menuRun();
      break;
    case gS_GACHA:
      S_GACHA.flag_back_lock == 1 ? (utilConsoleLog("ignore back key"), utilPush()) : S_GACHA.hero_popup_open ? (utilPush(), S_GACHA.hero_popup_close()) : S_GACHA.backKey();
      break;
    case gS_CLEVELUP:
      S_GACHA.flag_back_lock == 1 ? (utilConsoleLog("ignore back key"), utilPush()) : S_CLEVELUP.backKey();
      break;
    case gS_MARKETSTORE:
      bsdPAY.scene == gS_MARKETSTORE_PAYMENT_PRELOAD ? (utilConsoleLog("-1-여기 닥 걸렸음"), bsdPAY.flag_back = 1, utilPush()) : bsdPAY.scene == gS_MARKETSTORE_PAYMENT ? utilConsoleLog("-2-이 문장은 실행 되지 않을 듯&&&&&&&&&&&&&&&실행되면 문제임") : (utilConsoleLog("-3-정상 back"), S_MARKETSTORE.backKey());
      break;
    case gS_MARKETSTORE_PAYMENT:
      utilPush();
      bsdPAY.scene == gS_MARKETSTORE_PAYMENT_PRELOAD && (bsdPAY.flag_back = 1);
      break;
    case gS_MARKETSTORE_PAYMENT_PRELOAD:
      utilPush();
      break;
    case gS_SYNOPSIS:
      S_SYNOPSIS.menuRun();
      break;
    case gS_ATTENDANCE:
      S_ATTENDANCE.menuRun();
      break;
    case gS_STAGECLEAR:
      S_STAGECLEAR.focus = 3;
      S_STAGECLEAR.drawFocus();
      S_STAGECLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case gS_ACCOUNT_CHANGE:
      if (S_SETTING.flag_init == 1) {
        location.reload(!0);
        return
      }
      S_ACCOUNT_CHANGE.back();
      break;
    case gS_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE:
      utilPush();
      S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE.back();
      break;
    case "KR_INPUT":
    case "KR_INPUT_div":
      S_SETTING.backKey_krinput();
      utilConsoleLog("KR_INPUT back.....");
      break;
    case gS_GUILD_SHOP:
      S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_open ? (utilPush(), S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_close()) : S_GUILD_SHOP.backKey();
      break;
    default:
      run_scene_back()
  }
}

function run_services() {
  var t = tizen.application.getCurrentApplication().appInfo.packageId,
    n, i;
  S_BRDOPT.service_id = t + ".Service";
  n = new tizen.ApplicationControl("http://tizen.org/appcontrol/operation/pick", null, null, null, [new tizen.ApplicationControlData("caller", ["ForegroundApp"])]);
  i = tizen.application.launchAppControl(n, S_BRDOPT.service_id, function() {
    console.log("service launched", arguments)
  }, function(n) {
    console.log("service launched error", n)
  })
}

function handle_response(n) {
  if (console.log("Service response:", n[0].key, n[0].value), n[0].key == "info") {
    var t = document.querySelector("pre");
    t.innerText = JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(n[0].value), null, 2)
  }
}

function send_message(n) {
  console.log("send message ...", n);
  S_BRDOPT.local_port || (S_BRDOPT.local_port = tizen.messageport.requestLocalMessagePort(S_BRDOPT.message_port_name), console.log("localPort", S_BRDOPT.local_port), S_BRDOPT.local_port.addMessagePortListener(handle_response), S_BRDOPT.remote_port = tizen.messageport.requestRemoteMessagePort(S_BRDOPT.service_id, S_BRDOPT.message_port_name), console.log("remotePort", S_BRDOPT.remote_port));
  S_BRDOPT.remote_port.sendMessage([n], S_BRDOPT.local_port);
  console.log("Message sent")
}

function scheduler() {
  var n = new tizen.AlarmAbsolute(new Date(2024, 2, 20, 11, 55)),
    t = new tizen.ApplicationControl("http://tizen.org/appcontrol/operation/pick", null, null, null, [new tizen.ApplicationControlData("caller", ["ForegroundApp"])]);
  tizen.alarm.add(n, "ZyGIpK1K8v.TizenEldorado", t)
}

function handle_alarm() {
  var n = tizen.application.getCurrentApplication().getRequestedAppControl();
  console.log(n.appControl);
  n.operation == "http://tizen.org/appcontrol/operation/pick" && run_services(!0)
}

  flag: 0,

S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.check = function(n) {
  var i = location.href,
    f = i.slice(i.indexOf("?") + 1, i.length),
    u, r, t;
  if (i.indexOf("?") == -1) {
    S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.flag = 0;
    n && n();
    return
  }
  for (u = f.split("&"), r = 0; r < u.length; r++) {
    t = u[r].split("=");
    switch (t[0]) {
      case "MOBILE_CONNECT":
        if (t.length != 2) {
          utilConsoleLog("파라미터오류 입력형식: index.html?MOBILE_CONNECT=xxxxxx");
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.flag = 0;
          n && n();
          return
        }
        if (t[1] == "OK") {
          if (utilConsoleLog("모바일 연동 data =" + t[1]), t = localStorage.getItem("mobile_connect.eldorado.com.busidol"), t = glo.crypt.decrypt_force(t), t == null) {
            S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.flag = 0;
            n && n();
            return
          }
          localStorage.removeItem("mobile_connect.eldorado.com.busidol");
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.info = JSON.parse(t);
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.flag = 1;
          gEntrix.host_id = S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.info.host_id;
          SERVER_URL = S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.info.server_url;
          n && n();
          return
        }
        utilConsoleLog("파라미터오류 입력형식: index.html?iMOBILE_CONNECT=OK");
        S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.flag = 0;
        n && n();
        return
    }
  }
  n && n()
};

    return
  }
  if (S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.status == 1 && (S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_id = null, S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_pw = null, S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_platform = null, S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_name = null), S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.platformInfo = JSON.parse('[["LG","LG","LG"],["SKB","SKB","SKB"],["SSBR","삼성(22년형 이상)","Samsung(2022+ models)"],["SS","삼성(21년형 이하)","Samsung(2021- models)"],["SSVN","삼성 베트남(21년형 이하)","Samsung VN(2021- models)"],["LGH","LG헬로","LG Hello"],["CJH","HCN","HCN"],["CNM","딜라이브","D\'Live"],["ATV","안드로이드TV","Android TV"]]'), gAPP_RELEASE == "TEST" && (S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.platformInfo = JSON.parse('[["LG","LG","LG"],["SKB","SKB","SKB"],["SSBR","삼성(22년형 이상)","Samsung(2022+ models)"],["SS","삼성(21년형 이하)","Samsung(2021- models)"],["SSVN","삼성 베트남(21년형 이하)","Samsung VN(2021- models)"],["LGH","LG헬로","LG Hello"],["CJH","HCN","HCN"],["CNM","딜라이브","D\'Live"],["ATV","안드로이드TV","Android TV"]]')), utilConsoleLog("S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.init()"), $("#S_MAINMENU_div").empty(), $("#MM_top").css({

    return
  }
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;

  S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.make_screen(S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.status);
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  setTimeout(function() {
    g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO && (gEnableKey = 1)
  }, 300)
};

S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_SETTING.mobile_connect_str == "EMAIL" && S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.focus == 2 && (S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.focus = 1, S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.draw_focus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_SETTING.mobile_connect_str == "EMAIL" && S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.focus == 1 && (S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.focus = 2, S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.draw_focus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.backKey()
  }
};
S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.backKey = function() {
  $("#MM_top").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.end();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU)
};

};

S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.yes = function() {
  loading_show();
  gEnableKey = 0;
  ServerConnection.do_mobile_disconnect_amo(function() {
    loading_hide();
    gEnableKey = 1;
    utilNotice(TXT.complete_mobile_connect_x, 2);
    S_SETTING.mobile_connect_str = "TEMP_PASS";
    S_SETTING.mobile_connect_value = "000000";
    S_SETTING.init_var();
    S_SETTING.make_screen();
    S_SETTING.draw_focus();
    S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.backKey()
  })
};
S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.end = function() {
  S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_id = null;
  S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_pw = null;
  console.log("S_MOBILE_CONNECT_POP_div.end  called ");
  $("#S_MOBILE_CONNECT_POP_div").remove()
};

S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_preview_id = function(n) {
  S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_id = n == null ? "" : String(n);
  n ? util_draw_text_html(n, "MCA_board_id_value", 112, 50, 510, 75, 75, 27, "center", "#ba0c10") : util_draw_text_html(TXT.mobile_connect_amo_input_tvid, "MCA_board_id_value", 112, 50, 510, 75, 75, 27, "center", "#838383")
};
S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_result_id = function(n) {
  if (!Main.use_android_bridge() && (window.KR_INPUT && KR_INPUT.end && KR_INPUT.end(), n == "_CLOSE")) {
    g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO;
    return
  }
  S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_id = n == null ? "" : String(n);
  util_draw_text_html(S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_id || TXT && TXT.mobile_connect_amo_input_tvid || "", "MCA_board_id_value", 112, 50, 510, 75, 75, 27, "center", S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_id ? "#ba0c10" : "#838383");
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO
};
S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_preview_pw = function(n) {
  S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_pw = n == null ? "" : String(n);
  util_draw_text_html(S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_pw, "MCA_board_pw_value", 112, 150, 510, 75, 75, 27, "center", "#333")
};
S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_result_password = function(n) {
  if (!Main.use_android_bridge() && (window.KR_INPUT && typeof KR_INPUT.end == "function" && KR_INPUT.end(), n == "_CLOSE")) {
    g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO;
    return
  }
  S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_pw = n == null ? "" : String(n);
  util_draw_text_html(S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_pw || TXT && TXT.mobile_connect_amo_input_pw || "", "MCA_board_pw_value", 112, 150, 510, 75, 75, 27, "center", S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_pw ? "#ba0c10" : "#838383");
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO
};
S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.on_mouse_move = function() {};
S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.on_mouse_out = function() {
  utilScale_xy_center_classid("button", 1, 1)
};
S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilScale_xy_center_classid("button", 1, 1);
  switch (n.target.id) {
    case "MCA_board_id":
    case "MCA_board_id_value":
      Main.onMouseover_pressed("MCA_board_id", "MCA_board_id_value");
      return;
    case "MCA_board_pw":
    case "MCA_board_pw_value":
      Main.onMouseover_pressed("MCA_board_pw", "MCA_board_pw_value");
      return;
    case "MCA_board_question":
      Main.onMouseover_pressed("MCA_board_question");
      return;
    case "MCA_board_platform_left_arrow":
      Main.onMouseover_pressed("MCA_board_platform_left_arrow");
      return;
    case "MCA_board_platform_right_arrow":
      Main.onMouseover_pressed("MCA_board_platform_right_arrow");
      return;
    case "MCA_board_x":
      Main.onMouseover_pressed("MCA_board_x");
      return
  }
  switch (n.target.parentElement.id) {
    case "MCA_btn1":
      Main.onMouseover_pressed("MCA_btn1");
      return;
    case "MCA_btn2":
      Main.onMouseover_pressed("MCA_btn2");
      return
  }
};
S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.onMouseup = function(n) {
  var t;
  utilScale_xy_center_classid("button", 1, 1);
  switch (S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.status) {
    case 1:
      switch (n.target.id) {
        case "MCA_board_id":
        case "MCA_board_id_value":
          if (gEnableKey = 0, obj = {
              lang: USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? "KOR" : "ENG",
              title: TXT.mobile_connect_amo_input_tvid,
              caution: TXT.mobile_connect_amo_input_tvid_comment,
              mode_id_pw: "ID"
            }, t = S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_id == null ? "" : S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_id, Main.use_android_bridge()) openIdInput();
          else {
            KR_INPUT.init(S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_result_id, t, 20, null, obj);
            try {
              KR_INPUT.set_special_char(!0)
            } catch (n) {
              console.log(n)
            }
            g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = "KR_INPUT"
          }
          gEnableKey = 1;
          return;
        case "MCA_board_pw":
        case "MCA_board_pw_value":
          if (gEnableKey = 0, obj = {
              lang: USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? "KOR" : "ENG",
              title: TXT.mobile_connect_amo_input_pw,
              caution: TXT.mobile_connect_amo_input_pw_comment,
              mode_id_pw: "PASSWORD"
            }, t = S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_pw == null ? "" : S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_pw, Main.use_android_bridge()) openPwInput();
          else {
            KR_INPUT.init(S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_result_password, t, 6, null, obj);
            try {
              KR_INPUT.set_special_char(!0)
            } catch (n) {
              console.log(n)
            }
            g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = "KR_INPUT"
          }
          gEnableKey = 1;
          return;
        case "MCA_board_question":
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.status = 4;
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.make_screen(S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.status);
          return;
        case "MCA_board_platform_left_arrow":
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.change_platform("left");
          return;
        case "MCA_board_platform_right_arrow":
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.change_platform("right");
          return
      }
      switch (n.target.parentElement.id) {
        case "MCA_btn1":
          if (S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_id == null || S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_pw == null) {
            utilNotice(TXT.mobile_connect_amo_input_id_pw_all, 2);
            return
          }
          if (S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_platform == null) {
            utilNotice(TXT.mobile_connect_amo_input_platform, 2);
            return
          }
          gEnableKey = 0;
          ServerConnection.do_mobile_connect_amo(function(n, t, i) {
            loading_show();
            switch (n) {
              default:
              case "ERROR":
                gEnableKey = 1;
                loading_hide();
                return;
              case "OK":
                var r = {
                    platform: S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_platform,
                    host_id: glo.fun.change_host_id_to_upperCase(S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_id),
                    host_id_amo: glo.fun.change_host_id_to_upperCase(gEntrix.host_id),
                    server_url: i,
                    user_name: S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_name
                  },
                  u = JSON.stringify(r);
                S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_platform = t;
                localStorage.setItem("mobile_connect.eldorado.com.busidol", glo.crypt.encrypt_force(u));
                utilNotice(TXT.mobile_connect_amo_success, 2);
                ServerConnection.put_log_mobile_connect_info_amo("모바일 연동시작(최초)");
                setTimeout(function() {
                  loading_hide();
                  gEnableKey = 1;
                  glo.TEST_MODE.INDEX_PC_AMO_HTML ? location.replace("./index_pc_amo.html?MOBILE_CONNECT=OK") : location.replace("./index_amo.html?MOBILE_CONNECT=OK")
                }, 2500);
                return
            }
          });
          return;
        case "MCA_btn2":
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.backKey();
          return
      }
      break;
    case 2:
      switch (n.target.parentElement.id) {
        case "MCA_btn1":
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_id = null;
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_pw = null;
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_platform = null;
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_name = null;
          gEnableKey = 0;
          $("#MCA_board_x").css({
            display: "none"
          });
          ServerConnection.get_mobile_connect_info_amo(function() {
            loading_show();
            S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_id != null ? (utilNotice(TXT.mobile_connect_amo_success, 3), ServerConnection.put_log_mobile_connect_info_amo("모바일 연동시작(두번이상)"), setTimeout(function() {
              loading_hide();
              glo.TEST_MODE.INDEX_PC_AMO_HTML ? location.replace("./index_pc_amo.html?MOBILE_CONNECT=OK") : location.replace("./index_amo.html?MOBILE_CONNECT=OK")
            }, 2500)) : (utilNotice(TXT.mobile_connect_amo_fail, 3), S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.status = 1, S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.make_screen(S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.status))
          });
          return;
        case "MCA_btn2":
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.status = 3;
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.make_screen(S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.status);
          return
      }
      switch (n.target.id) {
        case "MCA_board_x":
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.backKey()
      }
      break;
    case 3:
      switch (n.target.parentElement.id) {
        case "MCA_btn1":
          loading_show();
          gEnableKey = 0;
          ServerConnection.do_mobile_disconnect_amo(function() {
            loading_hide();
            gEnableKey = 1;
            utilNotice(TXT.complete_mobile_connect_x, 2);
            S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.backKey();
            localStorage.removeItem("mobile_connect.eldorado.com.busidol")
          });
          return;
        case "MCA_btn2":
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.status = 2;
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.make_screen(S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.status);
          return
      }
      break;
    case 4:
      switch (n.target.parentElement.id) {
        case "MCA_btn1":
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.status = 1;
          S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.make_screen(S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.status);
          return
      }
  }
};
S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.change_platform = function(n) {
  var t = TXT.platform;
  n == "left" ? S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.platformIndex > 0 ? S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.platformIndex-- : S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.platformIndex = S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.platformInfo.length - 1 : n == "right" && (S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.platformIndex < S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.platformInfo.length - 1 ? S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.platformIndex++ : S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.platformIndex = 0);
  t = USER.lang === LANG.KOREA ? S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.platformInfo[S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.platformIndex][1] : S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.platformInfo[S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.platformIndex][2];
  util_draw_text_html(t, "MCA_board_platform_value", 112, 250, 510, 75, 75, 27, "center", "#000000");
  S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_platform = S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.platformInfo[S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.platformIndex][0]
};
S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.isConnected = function() {
  return S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.flag == 1
};

    r = new Date(EVENT[n].end).getTime(),
    t = (new Date).getTime();

};

DEFINEJS_EVENT.get_month_char_name = function(n) {
  var u = new Date(n),
    f = u.getFullYear(),
    t = u.getMonth() + 1,
    e = f + "/" + (t < 10 ? "0" + t : t),
    i, r;
  return DEFINEJS_EVENT.MONTH_CHAR_OVERRIDE.hasOwnProperty(e) ? (i = DEFINEJS_EVENT.MONTH_CHAR_OVERRIDE[e], i == "none" || !DEFINEJS_EVENT.MONTH_CHAR_STAT.hasOwnProperty(i)) ? "" : i : (r = f * 12 + t - (DEFINEJS_EVENT.MONTH_CHAR_BASE_YEAR * 12 + DEFINEJS_EVENT.MONTH_CHAR_BASE_MONTH), isNaN(r) || r < 0) ? "" : DEFINEJS_EVENT.MONTH_CHAR_ORDER[r % DEFINEJS_EVENT.MONTH_CHAR_ORDER.length]
};
DEFINEJS_EVENT.this_month_char = function() {
  var u, i, t, r, n;
  if (DEFINEJS_EVENT.this_month_char_name = "", DEFINEJS_EVENT.char_event_filename = null, gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.KT) u = (new Date).getTime();
  else {
    if (u = parseInt(g.timestamp_start, 10) + parseInt(g.timestamp_due, 10), u == 0) {
      setTimeout(DEFINEJS_EVENT.this_month_char, 50);
      return
    }
    if (USER.lang == -1) {
      setTimeout(DEFINEJS_EVENT.this_month_char, 50);
      return
    }
  }
  if (i = DEFINEJS_EVENT.get_month_char_name(u), i != "") {
    if (DEFINEJS_EVENT.char_event_filename = i, DEFINEJS_EVENT.this_month_char_name = i, t = DEFINEJS_EVENT.MONTH_CHAR_STAT[i], r = !1, t.move_speed) {
      for (n = 0; n < t.move_speed.length; n++) CHAR_OUR_TEAM[t.move_speed[n]].move_speed = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[t.move_speed[n]].move_speed * 2;
      r = !0
    }
    if (t.attack_len) {
      for (n = 0; n < t.attack_len.length; n++) CHAR_OUR_TEAM[t.attack_len[n]].attack_len = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[t.attack_len[n]].attack_len * 2;
      r = !0
    }
    if (t.attack_speed) {
      for (n = 0; n < t.attack_speed.length; n++) CHAR_OUR_TEAM[t.attack_speed[n]].attack_speed = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[t.attack_speed[n]].attack_speed / 2;
      r = !0
    }
    if (r)
      for (n = 1; n <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; n++) STORAGE.data1.selected_user[n] > 0 && SOCKET.storage_ch_to_socket(n, STORAGE.data1.selected_user[n])
  }
};

Main.time_init = function() {
  get_server_time();
  get_server_timestamp();
  var n = 0,
    t = function() {
      if (window.g.timestamp_flag == 1 || n > 25) Main.timer_stamp = setInterval(function() {
        window.g.timestamp_due += 1e3;
        (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_POPUPYN || g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_EXITPOPUP) && (S_GAME.mukhyang_unit != undefined && (S_GAME.mukhyang_unit.timestamp_popup_our != undefined && (S_GAME.mukhyang_unit.timestamp_popup_our += 1e3), S_GAME.mukhyang_unit.timestamp_popup_your != undefined && (S_GAME.mukhyang_unit.timestamp_popup_your += 1e3)), S_GAME.ogong_unit != undefined && (S_GAME.ogong_unit.timestamp_popup_our != undefined && (S_GAME.ogong_unit.timestamp_popup_our += 1e3), S_GAME.ogong_unit.timestamp_popup_your != undefined && (S_GAME.ogong_unit.timestamp_popup_your += 1e3)));
        var n = window.g.timestamp_start + window.g.timestamp_due;
        if (ENABLE_SERVER_TESTING_PERIOD && SERVER_TESTING_TIME <= n && (SERVER_TESTING = 1), SERVER_TESTING == 1) {
          Main.server_testing();
          clearInterval(Main.timer_stamp);
          return
        }
        window.gAPP_RELEASE = "RELEASE";
        window.glo.fun.init_test_mode()
      }, 1e3);
      else n++, setTimeout(t, 200)
    };
  t()
};

Main.loadData = function() {
  var n, i, t;
  utilConsoleLog(" Main.loadData ");
  switch (gTARGET_PLATFORM) {
    case gPLATFORM.SSBR:
    case gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV:
      gAPP_RELEASE == "TEST" ? STORAGE.load_storage(function() {
        Main.run_exist_host_id_in_server()
      }) : Main.run_exist_host_id_in_server();
      break;
    case gPLATFORM.KT:
      gAPP_RELEASE == "TEST" ? (STORAGE.load_storage(), n = function() {
        switch (S_LOGO.flag1_id) {
          case 0:
            setTimeout(n, 10);
            break;
          case 1:
            Main.run_exist_host_id_in_server();
            break;
          case -1:
            utilConsoleLog("Error in Main.onLoad()")
        }
      }, n()) : Main.run_exist_host_id_in_server();
      break;
    case gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV:
      STORAGE.load_storage();
      n = function() {
        switch (S_LOGO.flag1_id) {
          case 0:
            setTimeout(n, 10);
            break;
          case 1:
            Main.run_exist_host_id_in_server();
            break;
          case -1:
            utilConsoleLog("Error in Main.onLoad()")
        }
      };
      n();
      break;
    case gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM:
    case gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH:
    case gPLATFORM.HCN:
      console.log(" cssApi.isTV:" + cssApi.isTV);
      gAPP_RELEASE == "TEST" ? (window.bsdApp && bsdApp.app_test.check_href_id(), window.bsdApp && bsdApp.app_test.set_platform_LGH_HCN_CNM(), Main.run_exist_host_id_in_server()) : Main.run_exist_host_id_in_server();
      break;
    case gPLATFORM.AMO:
    case gPLATFORM.ATV:
    case gPLATFORM.SKB:
    case gPLATFORM.TOSS:
      Main.run_exist_host_id_in_server()
  }
  if (glo.fun.is_glo_platform() && gAPP_RELEASE == "RELEASE_FACEBOOK_LOGIN")
    for (i = ["103807330255322", "1556419887722383"], t = 0; t < i.length; t++)
      if (gEntrix.host_id == i[t]) {
        utilNotice("You are blocked! If you have any qusetion, please email to apps@busidol.com", 100);
        return
      }
};

    }), n = 1; n <= str_SERVER_TEST.length; n++) $("#txt_" + n).css({

Main.display_realtime_notice = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR ? $("#realtime_notice").css({

    width: "1280px",
    height: "20px",
    background: "black",
    opacity: "0.7",
    "line-height": "20px",
    "font-size": "16rem",
    "text-align": "center",
    color: "yellow",
    position: "absolute"
  }).text(realtime_notice[realtime_notice_p]) : gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT && $("#realtime_notice").css({
    display: "block",
    left: "0px",
    top: "-20px",
    width: "1280px",
    height: "20px",
    background: "black",
    "line-height": "20px",
    "font-size": "16rem",
    "text-align": "center",
    color: "white",
    position: "absolute"
  }).html(realtime_notice[realtime_notice_p]);
  var t = 0,
    r = 2,
    n = -20,
    i = function() {
      n < t ? (n += r, setTimeout(i, 50), $("#realtime_notice").css({
        top: n + "px"
      })) : (n = t, $("#realtime_notice").css({
        top: n + "px"
      }), setTimeout(function() {
        $("#realtime_notice").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        realtime_notice && realtime_notice.length - 1 > realtime_notice_p && (realtime_notice_p++, Main.display_realtime_notice())
      }, 1e4))
    };
  i()
};

    }, function() {}).done(function() {}).fail(function(n) {

    }).always(function() {})
  }
};

  }
  glo.APP_FEATURE.SCREEN_ADJUST_KEY ? Main.toggleSafeZone(1) : Main.displaySafeZone();
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? Main.keyDown = function(n) {

    if (lastKeyTime = u, typeof n != "number" && (n = null, utilConsoleLog("Main.keyDown type not Number")), t = n == null ? event.keyCode : n, r = 0, utilConsoleLog("Main.keyDown pressed: " + t + "    cur_scene:" + g_sceneinfo.cur_scene + "    gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey), utilConsoleLog("Keycode Exit: " + KeyDefine.exit + "           Keycode Back: " + KeyDefine.back), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT && t == window.VK_ESCAPE) {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      util_kt.destroyApplication();
      return
    }
    if ((gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.HCN) && gAPP_RELEASE == "TEST" && t == KeyDefine.EXIT_TEST) {

    }
    if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT && t == KeyDefine.ESCAPE) {
      S_EXITPOPUP.start();
      return
    }
    if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB && (t == 142 || t == 285 || t == 385 || t == 27)) {
      S_LOGO.user_key.is_exist_user_key_box() && (S_LOGO.user_key.exit_popup_from_cancel = !0);
      S_MAINMENU.run_back();
      return
    }
    if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR) {
      if (t == KeyDefine.exit) {
        util_tizen.exitApplication();
        return
      }
      if (t == 9 && (event.stopPropagation(), event.preventDefault()), g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_MARKETSTORE_PAYMENT && t == KeyDefine.back) {

    }

(gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && S_ERROR_NETWORK.keyDown(event, t) : g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === gS_BUSIDOL_PATMENT_SELECT || g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === gS_TV_CODE || g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === gS_B_P_ERROR || g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === gS_B_P_BACK || g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === gS_B_P_COMPLETED || g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === gS_B_P_COMPLETED ? gBUSIDOL_PAY_USE == !0 && window[g_sceneinfo.cur_scene].keyDown(event, t) : g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === gS_MAINMENU ? r = S_MAINMENU.keyDown(event, t) : g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === "KR_INPUT" ? glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE && KR_INPUT.keyDown(event, t) : window[g_sceneinfo.cur_scene].keyDown(event, t)

    flag: !1,
    start_x: 0,
    start_y: 0,
    pressed: 0,
    is_moved: !1,
    target_id: null
  },
  g_last_touch_time = 0,
  GHOST_MOUSE_IGNORE_TIME = 700,
  MOUSE_CLICK_MOVE_PX = 20,
  LG_MRCU_CLICK_MOVE_PX = 80;
Main.get_click_move_px = function(n) {
  return gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && !glo.fun.is_touch_event(n) ? LG_MRCU_CLICK_MOVE_PX : MOUSE_CLICK_MOVE_PX

Main.is_ghost_mouse_event = function(n) {
  var t = (new Date).getTime();
  return glo.fun.is_touch_event(n) ? (g_last_touch_time = t, !1) : g_last_touch_time > 0 && t - g_last_touch_time < GHOST_MOUSE_IGNORE_TIME ? !0 : !1
};
Main.onMouseDown = function(n) {
  if (!Main.is_ghost_mouse_event(n) && (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && !glo.fun.lg_touch_mode && glo.fun.is_touch_event(n) && glo.fun.set_lg_touch_mode("touch"), gEnableKey != 0)) {
    g_mouse_drag.pressed = 1;
    g_mouse_drag.target_id = n.target.id;
    g_mouse_drag.start_x = n.type.toLowerCase() === "mousedown" ? n.pageX : n.touches[0].pageX;
    g_mouse_drag.start_y = n.type.toLowerCase() === "mousedown" ? n.pageY : n.touches[0].pageY;
    try {
      if (!1 && g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === "KR_INPUT") {
        if (glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) KR_INPUT.onMousedown(n)
      } else window[g_sceneinfo.cur_scene].onMousedown(n)
    } catch (t) {
      console.log("%c " + g_sceneinfo.cur_scene + ".onMousedown() is not defined", "background: #222; color: #bada55");
      console.log("%c " + t.message, "background: #222; color: #bada55")
    }
    ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || glo.fun.is_touch_event(n) || n.preventDefault()
  }
};
lastUpTime = null;
Main.onMouseUp = function(n) {
  var i, r, u, f, t;
  if (!Main.is_ghost_mouse_event(n) && (i = (new Date).getTime(), lastUpTime !== null ? (r = i - lastUpTime, console.log("Time since last onMouseUp: " + r + " ms")) : console.log("First onMouseUp detected."), !(r < 100)) && (lastUpTime = i, gEnableKey != 0)) {
    if (g_mouse_drag.pressed == 0) {
      g_mouse_drag.is_moved && (g_mouse_drag.is_moved = !1);
      return
    }
    if (g_mouse_drag.pressed = 0, g_mouse_drag.flag == !1)
      if (g_mouse_drag.is_moved) {
        g_mouse_drag.is_moved = !1;
        Main.onMouseUp_run_not_drag(n)
      } else {
        g_mouse_drag.is_moved = !1;
        Main.onMouseUp_run_not_drag(n)
      }
    else {
      u = n.type.toLowerCase() === "mouseup" ? n.pageX : n.changedTouches[0].pageX;
      f = n.type.toLowerCase() === "mouseup" ? n.pageY : n.changedTouches[0].pageY;
      switch (Main.get_mouse_drag(u, f, n)) {
        case 0:
          if (g_mouse_drag.flag = !1, g_mouse_drag.is_moved) {
            g_mouse_drag.is_moved = !1;
            Main.onMouseUp_run_not_drag(n)
          } else {
            g_mouse_drag.is_moved = !1;
            Main.onMouseUp_run_not_drag(n)
          }
          break;
        case 1:
          switch (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene) {
            case "S_MAKETEAM":
              S_MAKETEAM.mousedrag_left_to_right(n);
              break;
            case "S_CLEVELUP":
              S_CLEVELUP.mousedrag_left_to_right(n);
              break;
            case "S_UPGRADE":
              S_UPGRADE.mousedrag_left_to_right(n);
              break;
            case "S_GACHA":
              S_GACHA.mousedrag_left_to_right(n);
              break;
            case "S_QUEST":
              S_QUEST.mousedrag_left_to_right(n);
              break;
            case "S_QUESTDETAIL":
              S_QUESTDETAIL.mousedrag_left_to_right(n);
              break;
            case "S_SETTING":
              S_SETTING.mousedrag_left_to_right(n);
              break;
            case "S_ITEM_GACHA":
              S_ITEM_GACHA.mousedrag_left_to_right(n);
              break;
            case "S_PACKAGE_STORE":
              S_PACKAGE_STORE.mousedrag_left_to_right(n);
              break;
            case "S_MODE_SELECT":
              S_MODE_SELECT.mousedrag_left_to_right(n);
              break;
            case "S_GUILD_FLAG":
              t = document.elementFromPoint(g_mouse_drag.start_x - window.pageXOffset, g_mouse_drag.start_y - window.pageYOffset);
              glo.fun.has_class(t, "flag_shape_wrap") ? S_GUILD_FLAG.mousedrag("shape", S_GUILD_FLAG.DIR_RIGHT) : glo.fun.has_class(t, "flag_symbol_wrap") && S_GUILD_FLAG.mousedrag("symbol", S_GUILD_FLAG.DIR_RIGHT);
              break;
            case "S_GUILD_BATTLE_DEFENCE":
              S_GUILD_BATTLE_DEFENCE.mousedrag_left_to_right(n);
              break;
            case "S_GUILD_BATTLE_ATTACK":
              S_GUILD_BATTLE_ATTACK.mousedrag_left_to_right(n)
          }
          g_mouse_drag.is_moved = !1;
          break;
        case 2:
          switch (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene) {
            case "S_MAKETEAM":
              S_MAKETEAM.mousedrag_right_to_left(n);
              break;
            case "S_CLEVELUP":
              S_CLEVELUP.mousedrag_right_to_left(n);
              break;
            case "S_UPGRADE":
              S_UPGRADE.mousedrag_right_to_left(n);
              break;
            case "S_GACHA":
              S_GACHA.mousedrag_right_to_left(n);
              break;
            case "S_QUEST":
              S_QUEST.mousedrag_right_to_left(n);
              break;
            case "S_QUESTDETAIL":
              S_QUESTDETAIL.mousedrag_right_to_left(n);
              break;
            case "S_SETTING":
              S_SETTING.mousedrag_right_to_left(n);
              break;
            case "S_ITEM_GACHA":
              S_ITEM_GACHA.mousedrag_right_to_left(n);
              break;
            case "S_PACKAGE_STORE":
              S_PACKAGE_STORE.mousedrag_right_to_left(n);
              break;
            case "S_MODE_SELECT":
              S_MODE_SELECT.mousedrag_right_to_left(n);
              break;
            case "S_GUILD_FLAG":
              t = document.elementFromPoint(g_mouse_drag.start_x - window.pageXOffset, g_mouse_drag.start_y - window.pageYOffset);
              glo.fun.has_class(t, "flag_shape_wrap") ? S_GUILD_FLAG.mousedrag("shape", S_GUILD_FLAG.DIR_LEFT) : glo.fun.has_class(t, "flag_symbol_wrap") && S_GUILD_FLAG.mousedrag("symbol", S_GUILD_FLAG.DIR_LEFT);
              break;
            case "S_GUILD_BATTLE_DEFENCE":
              S_GUILD_BATTLE_DEFENCE.mousedrag_right_to_left(n);
              break;
            case "S_GUILD_BATTLE_ATTACK":
              S_GUILD_BATTLE_ATTACK.mousedrag_right_to_left(n)
          }
          g_mouse_drag.is_moved = !1
      }
      g_mouse_drag.flag = !1
    }
  }
};
Main.onMouseUp_run_not_drag = function(n) {
  try {
    if (!1 && g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === "KR_INPUT") {
      if (glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) KR_INPUT.onMouseup(n)
    } else if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === gS_ERROR_NETWORK) {
      if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) S_ERROR_NETWORK.onMouseup(n)
    } else window[g_sceneinfo.cur_scene].onMouseup(n)
  } catch (t) {
    console.log("%c " + g_sceneinfo.cur_scene + ".onMouseup() is not defined", "background: #222; color: #bada55");
    console.log("%c " + t.message, "background: #222; color: #bada55")
  }
};
Main.onMouseMove = function(n) {
  var t, i;
  if (!Main.is_ghost_mouse_event(n) && gEnableKey != 0 && g_mouse_drag.pressed != 0) {
    g_mouse_drag.is_moved = !0;
    t = n.type.toLowerCase() === "mousemove" ? n.pageX : n.changedTouches[0].pageX;
    i = n.type.toLowerCase() === "mousemove" ? n.pageY : n.changedTouches[0].pageY;
    Main.is_drag_scene(g_mouse_drag.target_id) && (g_mouse_drag.flag = !0);
    var u = Math.abs(g_mouse_drag.start_x - t),
      f = Math.abs(g_mouse_drag.start_y - i),
      r = Main.get_click_move_px(n);
    g_mouse_drag.flag == !1 && (u > r || f > r) && g_sceneinfo.cur_scene !== gS_RANKING_PVP && (utilScale_xy_center_classid("button", 1, 1), g_mouse_drag.pressed = 0);
    ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || glo.fun.is_touch_event(n) || n.preventDefault()
  }
};
Main.is_drag_scene = function(n) {
  if (typeof n != "string") return !1;
  switch (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene) {
    case "S_MAKETEAM":
      return n.substring(0, 9) == "MT_cover_" ? !0 : !1;
    case "S_CLEVELUP":
      return n.substring(0, 9) == "CL_cover_" ? !0 : !1;
    case "S_UPGRADE":
      return n.substring(0, 9) == "UG_cover_" ? !0 : !1;
    case "S_GACHA":
      return n.substring(0, 9) == "GA_cover_" ? !0 : !1;
    case "S_QUEST":
      return n.substring(0, 9) == "QU_cover_" ? !0 : !1;
    case "S_QUESTDETAIL":
      return n.substring(0, 9) == "QD_cover_" ? !0 : !1;
    case "S_ITEM_GACHA":
      return n.substring(0, 9) == "IG_cover_" ? !0 : !1;
    case "S_MODE_SELECT":
      return n.substring(0, 10) == "MOS_cover_" ? !0 : !1;
    case "S_SETTING":
      return n.substring(0, 9) == "ST_cover_" ? !0 : !1;
    case "S_GUILD_FLAG":
      return n.search("flag_shape") >= 0 || n.search("flag_symbol") >= 0 ? !0 : !1;
    case "S_GUILD_BATTLE_DEFENCE":
      return n.search("GU_BA_D_bottom_cover") >= 0 ? !0 : !1;
    case "S_GUILD_BATTLE_ATTACK":
      return n.search("GU_BA_A_bottom_cover") >= 0 ? !0 : !1
  }
  return n.search("hero") >= 0 || n.search("package") >= 0 || n.search("ruby") >= 0 || n.search("gold") >= 0 ? !0 : n.search("MS_ad_") >= 0 ? !0 : !1
};
Main.get_mouse_drag = function(n, t, i) {
  var r = Main.get_click_move_px(i),
    u = Math.abs(g_mouse_drag.start_x - n);
  return u <= r ? 0 : g_mouse_drag.start_x < n ? 1 : 2
};

glo.timestamp = "";
glo.today = "";
glo.crypt = function() {
  var n = {},
    t = "",
    i = "",
    r = "",
    u = "";
  return n.init = function(n) {
    if (typeof n == "string") {
      var u = "" + glo.timestamp + glo.today + STORAGE.make_data2(),
        f = u.slice(0, 16),
        r = u.slice(16, 32);
      r.length < 16 && (r = r + ":");
      console.log("key1:" + f);
      console.log("key2:" + r);
      t = CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(f);
      i = CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(r)
    } else t = CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse("a454dfdb578edfed"), i = CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse("42938ksk2s394030")
  }, n.encrypt = function(n) {
    var r;
    return typeof n != "string" && (n = n.toString()), r = CryptoJS.AES.encrypt(n, t, {
      iv: i
    }), r.toString()
  }, n.decrypt = function(n) {
    var u, r;
    return typeof n != "string" && (n = n.toString()), r = CryptoJS.AES.decrypt(n, t, {
      iv: i
    }), r.toString(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8)
  }, n.encrypt_force = function(n) {
    typeof n != "string" && (n = n.toString());
    var t = CryptoJS.AES.encrypt(n, CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse("a454dfdb578edfed"), {
      iv: CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse("42938ksk2s394030")
    });
    return t.toString()
  }, n.decrypt_force = function(n) {
    typeof n != "string" && (n = n.toString());
    var t = CryptoJS.AES.decrypt(n, CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse("a454dfdb578edfed"), {
      iv: CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse("42938ksk2s394030")
    });
    return t.toString(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8)
  }, n.get_key = function() {
    return "[key1:" + r + "][key2:" + u + "]"
  }, n
}();
glo.fun = {
  is_korea_platform: function(n) {
    return n == "CJH" || n == "CNM" || n == "HCN" || n == "LGH" || n == "SKB" ? !0 : n == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || n == gPLATFORM.HCN || n == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || n == gPLATFORM.SKB ? !0 : !1
  },
  set_mask_user_name: function(n, t, i) {

json_secure = function() {
  function t(n) {
    var t = 0;
    try {
      typeof n == "string" ? obj = JSON.parse(n) : typeof n == "object" && (obj = n);
      obj && obj.guild_gold_bar != null && (t = parseInt(obj.guild_gold_bar, 10) || 0)
    } catch (i) {
      console.log("JSON parse error - json_secure_goldbar", i)
    }
    USER.goldbar = t;
    S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top()
  }

  function i(r, u) {
    if (typeof r == "string") {
      var f = null;
      if (r === "guild_data") try {
        typeof u == "string" ? f = JSON.parse(u) : typeof u == "object" && (f = u);
        f && f.guild_data_mine && (i("guild_data_mine", f.guild_data_mine), t(f.guild_data_mine))
      } catch (e) {} else r === "guild_data_mine" && t(u);
      if (typeof u == "string") {
        n[r] = u;
        return
      }
      if (typeof u == "object") {
        try {
          n[r] = JSON.stringify(u)
        } catch (e) {
          return
        }
        return
      }
    }
  }

  function u(t) {
    if (!n.hasOwnProperty(t)) return null;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(n[t])
    } catch (i) {
      return null
    }
  }

  function f(t) {
    delete n[t]
  }
  var n = {},
    r = {
      set: i,
      get: u,
      clear: f
    };
  return Object.freeze(r), r
}();

    } else if (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) n = function() {
