        display: "none"
      }), $("#Txt_LO_msg").css({
        display: "none"
      }), utilDraw_image_1pixel("Img_LO_background"))
    }, ServerConnection.check_black_list_db(n);
    else if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT) {
      if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_EXITPOPUP) return;
      n = function() {
        utilConsoleLog("[S_LOGO.interval_is_next] check_black_list_loop");
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GONGJI, S_GONGJI);
        $("#Txt_LO_msg").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        utilDraw_image_1pixel("Img_LO_background")
      };
      ServerConnection.check_black_list_db(n);
      utilConsoleLog("[S_LOGO.interval_is_next] check_black_list_db")
    } else if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV) {
      if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_EXITPOPUP) return;
      glo.APP_FEATURE.LANG_SELECT && (S_LANG_SELECT.is_need_lang_select() || STORAGE.data1.chul_num == 0) ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_LANG_SELECT, S_LANG_SELECT) : ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_SYNOPSIS, S_SYNOPSIS);
      $(".loader").css({

S_LOGO.draw_msg = function() {
  $("#Txt_LO_msg").text("Loading...");
  $("#Txt_LO_msg").css({
    display: "block",
    left: "140px",
    top: "320px",
    width: "1000px",
    height: "80px",
    opacity: "0.9",
    "line-height": "80px",
    "font-size": "20rem",
    "text-align": "center",
    "text-shadow": "1px 1px 1px gray",
    color: "white",
    position: "absolute"
  });
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT && $("#Txt_LO_msg").css({
    opacity: "0.9",
    "font-size": "16rem"
  })
};
S_LOGO.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  if (glo.APP_FEATURE.USER_KEY && S_LOGO.user_key.is_popup_showed) {
    var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
    switch (i) {
      case KeyDefine.right:
        S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus == 1 ? (S_LOGO.user_key.focus_1++, S_LOGO.user_key.focus_1 > 2 && (S_LOGO.user_key.focus_1 = 2)) : S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus == 3 && (S_LOGO.user_key.focus_3++, S_LOGO.user_key.focus_3 > 2 && (S_LOGO.user_key.focus_3 = 2));
        S_LOGO.drawFocus();
        break;
      case KeyDefine.down:
        S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus++;
        S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus > 3 && (S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus = 3);
        S_LOGO.drawFocus();
        break;
      case KeyDefine.up:
        S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus--;
        S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus < 1 && (S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus = 1);
        S_LOGO.drawFocus();
        break;
      case KeyDefine.left:
        S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus == 1 ? (S_LOGO.user_key.focus_1--, S_LOGO.user_key.focus_1 < 1 && (S_LOGO.user_key.focus_1 = 1)) : S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus == 3 && (S_LOGO.user_key.focus_3--, S_LOGO.user_key.focus_3 < 1 && (S_LOGO.user_key.focus_3 = 1));
        S_LOGO.drawFocus();
        break;
      case KeyDefine.enter:
        S_LOGO.menuRun();
        break;
      case KeyDefine.esc:
      case KeyDefine.back:
        S_LOGO.user_key.is_exist_user_key_box() && (S_LOGO.user_key.exit_popup_from_cancel = !0, S_MAINMENU.run_back())
    }
  }
};
S_LOGO.drawFocus = function() {
  glo.APP_FEATURE.USER_KEY && S_LOGO.user_key.is_popup_showed && ($(".focus").hide(), S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus == 1 ? S_LOGO.user_key.focus_1 == 1 ? $("#Img_LO_user_key_email_f").show() : $("#Img_LO_user_key_btn1_f").show() : S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus == 2 ? $("#Img_LO_user_key_num_f").show() : S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus == 3 && (S_LOGO.user_key.focus_3 == 1 ? $("#Img_LO_user_key_btn2_f").show() : $("#Img_LO_user_key_btn3_f").show()))
};
S_LOGO.get_focus_btn_id = function() {
  return S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus == 1 ? S_LOGO.user_key.focus_1 == 1 ? "LO_user_key_email" : "LO_user_key_btn1" : S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus == 2 ? "LO_user_key_num" : S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus == 3 ? S_LOGO.user_key.focus_3 == 1 ? "LO_user_key_btn2" : "LO_user_key_btn3" : void 0
};
S_LOGO.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  var n = S_LOGO.get_focus_btn_id();
  if (n == "LO_user_key_email" || n == "LO_user_key_num") {
    S_LOGO.menuRun_Run();
    return
  }
  utilScale_xy_center(S_LOGO.get_focus_btn_id(), gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center(S_LOGO.get_focus_btn_id(), 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_LOGO.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_LOGO.menuRun_Run = function() {
  var n = S_LOGO.get_focus_btn_id();
  if (n == "LO_user_key_email") {
    if (S_LOGO.user_key.email_received_from_server !== "") {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      return
    }
    S_LOGO.user_key.input_type = "email";
    S_LOGO.run_kr_input()
  } else if (n == "LO_user_key_num") {
    if (S_LOGO.user_key.input_email == "" && !(glo.VER_DATE >= "20260804" && S_LOGO.user_key.email_received_from_server != "")) {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      util.notice(TXT.please_input_email, 2);
      return
    }
    S_LOGO.user_key.input_type = "code";
    S_LOGO.run_kr_input()
  } else if (n == "LO_user_key_btn1") {
    if (S_LOGO.user_key.input_email != "" || glo.VER_DATE >= "20260804" && S_LOGO.user_key.email_received_from_server != "") {
      if (S_LOGO.user_key.email_vaild_time > 0) {
        gEnableKey = 1;
        util.notice(TXT.user_check_tip3, 2);
        return
      }
    } else {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      util.notice(TXT.please_input_email, 2);
      return
    }
    S_LOGO.user_key.auth_comment = S_LOGO.user_key.REQUEST_AUTH_NUMBER;
    util.notice(TXT.email_requested, 2);
    loading_show("", 1);
    exist_host_id_in_server()
  } else if (n == "LO_user_key_btn2") {
    if (S_LOGO.user_key.input_email != "" || glo.VER_DATE >= "20260804" && S_LOGO.user_key.email_received_from_server != "") {
      if (S_LOGO.user_key.input_code == "") {
        gEnableKey = 1;
        util.notice(TXT.please_input_code, 2);
        return
      }
    } else {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      util.notice(TXT.please_input_email, 2);
      return
    }
    S_LOGO.user_key.auth_comment = S_LOGO.user_key.VERIFY_AUTH_NUMBER;
    loading_show("", 1);
    exist_host_id_in_server()
  } else n == "LO_user_key_btn3" && (S_LOGO.user_key.verified_user == 1 ? (S_LOGO.user_key.exit_popup_from_cancel = !0, S_MAINMENU.run_back()) : (S_LOGO.user_key.auth_comment = S_LOGO.user_key.CANCEL_AUTH_NUMBER, loading_show("", 1), exist_host_id_in_server()))
};
S_LOGO.end = function() {
  console.log("S_LOGO.end called ");
  S_LOGO.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_LOGO.input_result = function(n) {
  glo.APP_FEATURE.USER_KEY && (KR_INPUT.end(), S_LOGO.drawFocus(), gEnableKey = 1, g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_LOGO, S_LOGO.addMouseEvent(), blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene), $("#KR_INPUT_div").hide(), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? Main.add_keydown_event_listener() : document.body.onkeydown = Main.keyDown, n == "_CLOSE" || (console.log("  KR_INPUT_div:  " + document.getElementById("KR_INPUT_div")), S_LOGO.user_key.input_type == "email" ? (S_LOGO.user_key.set_input_email(n), $("#Txt_LO_user_key_email").html(n).css({
    color: "#012d63"
  })) : (S_LOGO.user_key.input_code = n, $("#Txt_LO_user_key_num").html(n).css({
    color: "#012d63"
  }))))
};
S_LOGO.run_kr_input = function() {
  var r;
  if (glo.APP_FEATURE.USER_KEY) {
    S_LOGO.end();
    gEnableKey = 0;
    var n = TXT.please_input_email,
      t = !0,
      i = S_LOGO.user_key.input_email;
    S_LOGO.user_key.input_type == "code" && (n = TXT.please_input_code, t = !1, i = S_LOGO.user_key.input_code);
    r = {
      lang: "ENG",
      title: n,
      mode_aA: "a",
      email_check: t,
      caution: ""
    };
    g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = "KR_INPUT";
    KR_INPUT.init(S_LOGO.input_result, i, 30, null, r);
    try {
      KR_INPUT.set_special_char(!0)
    } catch (u) {
      console.log(u)
    }
    Main.remove_keydown_event_listener()
  }
};
S_LOGO.test_input_email = function(n) {
  S_LOGO.user_key.set_input_email(n);
  $("#Txt_LO_user_key_email").html(n).css({
    color: "#012d63"
  })
};
S_LOGO.test_input_code = function(n) {
  S_LOGO.user_key.input_code = n;
  $("#Txt_LO_user_key_num").html(n).css({
    color: "#012d63"
  })
};
S_LOGO.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || $(document).mouseover(S_LOGO.onMouseover))
};
S_LOGO.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  (console.log("S_LOGO.removeMouseEvent called "), gMOUSE_USE) && $(document).unbind("mouseover")
};
S_LOGO.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } S_LOGO.menuRun()
  }
};
S_LOGO.onMouseover = function(n) {
  for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
    if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
      t = null;
      return
    } t.id == "LO_user_key_email" ? (S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus = 1, S_LOGO.user_key.focus_1 = 1) : t.id == "LO_user_key_num" ? (S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus = 2, S_LOGO.user_key.focus_2 = 1) : t.id == "LO_user_key_btn1" ? (S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus = 1, S_LOGO.user_key.focus_1 = 2) : t.id == "LO_user_key_btn2" ? (S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus = 3, S_LOGO.user_key.focus_3 = 1) : t.id == "LO_user_key_btn3" && (S_LOGO.user_key.row_focus = 3, S_LOGO.user_key.focus_3 = 2);
  S_LOGO.drawFocus()
};
S_LOGO.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_LOGO.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_LOGO.onMouseover(n)
};
S_LOGO.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_LOGO.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_LOGO.onMouseover(n);
  S_LOGO.onClick(n)
};

PRELOAD_IMG_ARRAY = [];
PRELOAD = {
  TOT_NUM: PRELOAD_IMG_ARRAY.length,
  MEMORY: [],
  cur_num: 0,
  complete: 1
};
PRELOAD.start = function() {
  for (var n = 0; n < PRELOAD.TOT_NUM; n++) PRELOAD.MEMORY[n] = new Image, PRELOAD.MEMORY[n].src = PRELOAD_IMG_ARRAY[n], PRELOAD.MEMORY[n].onload = function() {
    PRELOAD.cur_num++
  };
  PRELOAD.completed_check_interval()
};
PRELOAD.completed_check_interval = function() {
  if (PRELOAD.cur_num == PRELOAD.TOT_NUM) {
    $("#LO_progress_bar_percent").css({
      left: "0px",
      top: "0px",
      width: "100%",
      height: "100%",
      background: "red",
      position: "absolute"
    });
    $("#LO_progress_value").text("100%");
    setTimeout(function() {
      PRELOAD.complete = 1
    }, 500);
    return
  }
  utilConsoleLog("loading=" + PRELOAD.cur_num);
  setTimeout(PRELOAD.completed_check_interval, 1e3);
  var n = Math.round(PRELOAD.cur_num / PRELOAD.TOT_NUM * 100);
  $("#LO_progress_bar_percent").css({
    left: "0px",
    top: "0px",
    width: n + "%",
    height: "100%",
    background: "red",
    border: "1px solid black",
    position: "absolute"
  });
  $("#LO_progress_value").css({
    left: "578px",
    top: "366px",
    width: "124px",
    height: "32px",
    position: "absolute",
    "text-shadow": "black -1px -1px 1px,black 0px -1px 1px,black 1px -1px 1px,black -1px 0px 1px,black 0px 0px 1px,black 1px 0px 1px,black -1px 1px 1px,black 0px 1px 1px,black 1px 1px 1px",
    "line-height": "32px",
    "font-size": "30rem",
    "text-align": "center",
    color: "#ffffff",
    border: "0px solid black"
  }).text(n + "%")
};

S_SYNOPSIS.drawSYNOPSIS = function() {
  var n;
  if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT) $("textarea").html("");
  else
    for ($("#SY_txt_area").css({
        left: S_SYNOPSIS.area.x + "px",

        width: S_SYNOPSIS.area.w + "px",
        height: S_SYNOPSIS.area.h + "px",
        position: "absolute",
        overflow: "hidden"
      }), $("#SY_scroll").css({
        left: "0px",
        top: "0px",
        width: "100%",
        height: "100%",
        position: "absolute"
      }), n = 1; n <= S_SYNOPSIS.num; n++) {
      var t = Math.floor(S_SYNOPSIS.area.fs * 2),
        i = S_SYNOPSIS.area.h + (n - 1) * t,
        r = S_SYNOPSIS.area.w,
        u = TXT["synopsis_" + n];
      $("#SY_line_" + n).text(u);
      $("#SY_line_" + n).css({
        left: "0px",
        top: i + "px",
        width: r + "px",
        height: t + "px",
        "line-height": t + "px",
        "font-size": S_SYNOPSIS.area.fs + "rem",
        "text-align": "left",
        "text-shadow": "1px 1px 1px white",
        color: "#672b0e",
        "font-weight": "bold",
        position: "absolute"
      })
    }
};
S_SYNOPSIS.interval = function() {
  if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT) {
    if (S_SYNOPSIS.lineCount == 7 || S_SYNOPSIS.lineCount == 15) $("textarea").html("");
    else {
      if (S_SYNOPSIS.lineCount > 18) {
        S_SYNOPSIS.menuRun_Run();
        return
      }
      if (S_SYNOPSIS.lineCount < 18) {
        var n = $("textarea").html();
        $("textarea").html(n + S_SYNOPSIS.aText[S_SYNOPSIS.lineCount])
      }
    }
    S_SYNOPSIS.timer = setTimeout(S_SYNOPSIS.interval, 1500);
    S_SYNOPSIS.lineCount++
  } else $("#SY_scroll").css({
    top: S_SYNOPSIS.scroll.cur_y + "px"
  }), S_SYNOPSIS.scroll.cur_y -= S_SYNOPSIS.scroll.gap, S_SYNOPSIS.scroll.cur_y <= S_SYNOPSIS.scroll.goal_y ? S_SYNOPSIS.menuRun_Run() : g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_SYNOPSIS && (S_SYNOPSIS.timer != null && (clearInterval(S_SYNOPSIS.timer), S_SYNOPSIS.timer = null), S_SYNOPSIS.timer = setTimeout(S_SYNOPSIS.interval, 50))
};
S_SYNOPSIS.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  utilScale_xy_center("SY_btn1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("Img_SY_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("SY_btn1", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Img_SY_btn_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_SYNOPSIS.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};

    display: "none"
  });
  S_SYNOPSIS.end();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GONGJI, S_GONGJI)
};

S_GONGJI.init = function() {
  if (utilConsoleLog("S_GONGJI.init()"), S_GONGJI.focus = 1, S_GONGJI.has_checkbox = g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_SYNOPSIS || g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_LOGO, GONGJI.num == 0) {

  var n = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === gS_MAINMENU;
  $("#S_SYNOPSIS_div").empty();

  });
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_GONGJI;
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_GONGJI.make_screen();
  S_GONGJI.viewd_check_and_reward(S_GONGJI.focus);
  S_GONGJI.addMouseEvent();

  S_GONGJI.drawFocus();
  S_GONGJI._came_from_mainmenu = n;

S_GONGJI.viewd_check_and_reward = function(n) {
  if (!S_GONGJI.is_used(GONGJI.content[n].bunho)) {
    GONGJI.content[n].type != "SIMPLE" && S_GONGJI.push(GONGJI.content[n].bunho);
    STORAGE.alldata_to_storage();
    switch (GONGJI.content[n].type) {
      case "GOLD":
      case "RUBY":
      case "BP":
      case "ITEM":
      case "CLOUD":
      case "CEL_ESSN":
      case "CHAR":
        ServerConnection.put_reward_notice(GONGJI.content[n].value, GONGJI.content[n].bunho, GONGJI.content[n].type, STORAGE.make_data1());
        utilNotice(TXT.gongji_reward_mailbox, 1.5);
        break;
      case "URGENT":
      case "SIMPLE":
        update_user_to_server("S_GONGJI:" + GONGJI.content[n].bunho, "gongji")
    }
    utilConsoleLog("공지 읽음:" + GONGJI.content[n].bunho)
  }
};

  t += '<img id="Img_GG_viewed"><div id="GG_btn1" class="button"> <\/div><img id="Img_GG_btn_focus" class="button focus">';

S_GONGJI.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      return;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      return;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_GONGJI.btn_focus == 2 && (S_GONGJI.btn_focus = 1, S_GONGJI.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_GONGJI.btn_focus == 1 && (S_GONGJI.btn_focus = 2, S_GONGJI.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_GONGJI.menuRun()
  }
};

S_GONGJI.drawFocus = function() {
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  $("#Img_GG_btn_focus").hide();
  for (var n = 1; n <= MAX_GONGJI; n++) $("#Img_GG_not_show_checkbox_focus_" + n).hide();
  switch (S_GONGJI.btn_focus) {
    case 1:
      $("#Img_GG_btn_focus").show();
      break;
    case 2:
      $("#Img_GG_not_show_checkbox_focus_" + S_GONGJI.focus).show()
  }
};
S_GONGJI.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  S_GONGJI.btn_focus == 1 ? (utilScale_xy_center("GG_btn1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale), utilScale_xy_center("Img_GG_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)) : S_GONGJI.btn_focus == 2 && (utilScale_xy_center("GG_not_show_checkbox_" + S_GONGJI.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale), utilScale_xy_center("Img_GG_not_show_checkbox_focus_" + S_GONGJI.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale));
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("GG_btn1", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Img_GG_btn_focus", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("GG_not_show_checkbox_" + S_GONGJI.focus, 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Img_GG_not_show_checkbox_focus_" + S_GONGJI.focus, 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_GONGJI.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_GONGJI.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (S_GONGJI.btn_focus == 2) {
    S_GONGJI.set_checkbox();
    return
  }
  if (S_GONGJI.checkbox_bool && STORAGE.save_notice_not_show(GONGJI.content[S_GONGJI.focus].bunho), S_GONGJI.focus < GONGJI.num) {
    S_GONGJI.focus++;
    S_GONGJI.drawGongJi();
    S_GONGJI.viewd_check_and_reward(S_GONGJI.focus);
    return
  }
  $("#S_GONGJI_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_GONGJI.end();
  switch (g_sceneinfo.before_scene) {
    case gS_LOGO:
    case gS_SYNOPSIS:
      S_GONGJI.goto_next_scene();
      break;
    case gS_SETTING:
      S_SETTING.addMouseEvent();
      g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_SETTING;
      $("#Img_ST_card_focus_" + S_SETTING.focus).css({
        display: "block"
      });
      blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
      break;
    case gS_MAINMENU:
    default:
      g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MAINMENU;
      $("#S_MAINMENU_div").css("display", "block");
      S_MAINMENU.resume();
      S_MAINMENU.menu_overlay.focus()
  }
};
S_GONGJI.set_checkbox = function() {
  S_GONGJI.checkbox_bool = S_GONGJI.checkbox_bool ? !1 : !0;
  var n = S_GONGJI.checkbox_bool ? "2" : "";
  $("#GG_not_show_checkbox_" + S_GONGJI.focus).css({
    background: "url(" + glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NOTICE_CHECKBOX") + "image/ui/0_common/notice_checkbox" + n + ".png) no-repeat 0 0",
    "background-position": "0px 0px"
  });
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_GG_not_show_checkbox_focus_" + S_GONGJI.focus, glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NOTICE_CHECKBOX") + "image/ui/0_common/notice_checkbox" + n + "_f.png", -4, -4)
};

S_GONGJI.is_used = function(n) {
  for (var t = 1; t <= MAX_GONGJI; t++)
    if (STORAGE.data1.gongji[t] == n) return !0;
  return !1
};
S_GONGJI.push = function(n) {
  for (var i = !0, t = 1; t <= MAX_GONGJI; t++)
    if (STORAGE.data1.gongji[t] == "0") {
      STORAGE.data1.gongji[t] = n;
      i = !1;
      break
    } if (i) {
    for (t = 1; t <= MAX_GONGJI - 1; t++) STORAGE.data1.gongji[t] = STORAGE.data1.gongji[t + 1];
    STORAGE.data1.gongji[MAX_GONGJI] = n
  }
};
S_GONGJI.end = function() {
  S_GONGJI.removeMouseEvent()
};

S_GONGJI.removeMouseEvent = function() {};
S_GONGJI.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } switch (n.target.id) {
      case "Img_GG_btn_focus":
      case "GG_btn1":
        S_GONGJI.btn_focus = 1;
        break;
      case "GG_not_show_checkbox_" + S_GONGJI.focus:
      case "Img_GG_not_show_checkbox_focus_" + S_GONGJI.focus:
        S_GONGJI.btn_focus = 2
    }
    S_GONGJI.drawFocus();
    S_GONGJI.menuRun()
  }
};
S_GONGJI.onMouseover = function(n) {
  switch (n.target.id) {
    case "Img_GG_btn_focus":
    case "GG_btn1":
      S_GONGJI.btn_focus = 1;
      S_GONGJI.drawFocus();
      S_GONGJI.onMouseover_pressed("GG_btn1", "Img_GG_btn_focus");
      break;
    case "GG_not_show_checkbox_" + S_GONGJI.focus:
    case "Img_GG_not_show_checkbox_focus_" + S_GONGJI.focus:
      S_GONGJI.btn_focus = 2;
      S_GONGJI.drawFocus();
      S_GONGJI.onMouseover_pressed("GG_not_show_checkbox_", "Img_GG_not_show_checkbox_focus_")
  }
};
S_GONGJI.onMouseover_pressed = function(n, t, i, r) {
  Main.onMouseover_pressed(n, t, i, r)
};
S_GONGJI.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GONGJI.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_GONGJI.onMouseover(n);
  return

  utilConsoleLog(" S_GONGJI.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);

S_ATTENDANCE.set_reward_list_from_server = function(n) {
  var r, t, i;
  if (n && n.length) {
    for (r = new Array(ATT_MAX_DAY + 1), t = 1; t <= ATT_MAX_DAY; t++)(i = n[t - 1], i) && (r[t] = {
      type: parseInt(i.TYPE, 10),
      value: parseInt(i.VALUE, 10)
    });
    S_ATTENDANCE.reward_list = r
  }
};
S_ATTENDANCE.get_box_pos = function(n) {
  var t = (n - 1) % 7,
    i = Math.floor((n - 1) / 7);
  return {
    x: ATT_BOX_BASE_X + t * ATT_COL_GAP,
    y: ATT_BOX_BASE_Y + i * ATT_ROW_GAP
  }
};
S_ATTENDANCE.draw_reward = function(n, t, i) {
  var u = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025"),
    r = "";
  switch (i.type) {
    case TY.GOLD:
      utilDrawImage("Img_AD_icon_" + n, u + "image/ui/10_charge/ch_goldicon1.png", t.x + 10, t.y + 29, 86, 62, "absolute");
      r = utilGetNumber_withComma(i.value + "");
      break;
    case TY.RUBY:
      utilDrawImage("Img_AD_icon_" + n, u + "image/ui/10_charge/ch_rubyicon1.png", t.x + 10, t.y + 29, 86, 62, "absolute");
      r = utilGetNumber_withComma(i.value + "");
      break;
    case TY.CHAR:
      utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_AD_icon_" + n, u + "image/ui/14_attendance/at_ran_char" + i.value + ".png", t.x + 14, t.y + 36);
      r = TXT["attendance_random_" + i.value + "star"];
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_ATTENDANCE.draw_reward();:" + i.type)
  }
  var f = "18rem",
    e = "21px",
    o = t.y + 86;
  i.type == TY.CHAR && USER.lang != LANG.KOREA && (f = "13rem");
  i.type == TY.CHAR && (USER.lang == LANG.SPAIN || USER.lang == LANG.RUSSIA || USER.lang == LANG.PORTUGAL) && (f = "13rem", e = "14px", o = t.y + 83);
  $("#Txt_AD_value_" + n).text(r);
  $("#Txt_AD_value_" + n).css({
    left: t.x + "px",
    top: o + "px",
    width: "107px",
    height: "21px",
    "line-height": e,
    "font-size": f,
    "text-align": "center",
    color: "#43485e",
    position: "absolute"
  })
};
S_ATTENDANCE.cur_cycle_day = function(n) {
  if (n <= 0) return 0;
  var t = n % ATT_MAX_DAY;
  return t == 0 ? ATT_MAX_DAY : t
};
S_ATTENDANCE.refresh_stamps = function(n) {
  for (var i, r, u = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025"), t = 1; t <= ATT_MAX_DAY; t++) i = S_ATTENDANCE.get_box_pos(t), r = t <= n, utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_AD_board_" + t, u + "image/ui/14_attendance/" + (r ? "at_box2_1.png" : "at_box1_1.png"), i.x, i.y), $("#Txt_AD_num_" + t).css({
    color: r ? "#ffffff" : "#343743"
  }), r ? ($("#Img_AD_press_" + t).css({
    display: "block"
  }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_AD_press_" + t, u + "image/ui/14_attendance/at_check.png", i.x + 28, i.y + 27)) : $("#Img_AD_press_" + t).css({
    display: "none"
  })
};
S_ATTENDANCE.init = function() {
  if (S_ATTENDANCE.reward_list || (S_ATTENDANCE.reward_list = S_ATTENDANCE.make_default_reward_list()), utilConsoleLog("S_ATTENDANCE.init()"), S_ATTENDANCE.is_double() === 1) {
    S_ATTENDANCE.end();
    add_event_pop();
    ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU);
    return
  }
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_ATTENDANCE;
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_ATTENDANCE.make_screen();
  STORAGE.data1.pvp_num = 10;
  glo.APP_FEATURE.NVN_GAME && (STORAGE.data1.nvn_num = 10);
  S_RANKING_BOSS.tiket = 10;
  ServerConnection.update_boss_tiket_to_server("~오늘 최초 접속 10장 충전~");
  glo.fun.is_glo_platform() && ServerConnection.put_eldorado_score("ATTEND", "출석");
  S_ATTENDANCE.reward();
  setTimeout(S_ATTENDANCE.press1, 700);
  S_ATTENDANCE.addMouseEvent();
  S_ATTENDANCE.focus = 1;
  S_ATTENDANCE.att_done = 0;
  REWARD_AD.is_stale() && REWARD_AD.refresh();
  glo.APP_FEATURE.ATTENDANCE_EVENT && ServerConnection.attendance_event({
    MODE: "ATT"
  });
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)
};
S_ATTENDANCE.pause = function() {
  $("#AD_btn_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_AD_ad_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  })
};
S_ATTENDANCE.resume = function() {
  S_ATTENDANCE.drawFocus();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  gEnableKey = 1
};
S_ATTENDANCE.maketag = function() {
  var i = document.getElementById("S_ATTENDANCE_div"),
    r = document.getElementById("AD_bg"),
    n, t;
  if (!r) {
    for (n = "", n += '<div id="AD_bg"><\/div>', n += '<img id="Img_AD_back">', n += '<div id="AD_title"><\/div>', t = 1; t <= ATT_MAX_DAY; t++) n += '<img id="Img_AD_board_' + t + '">', n += '<img id="Img_AD_icon_' + t + '">', n += '<div id="Txt_AD_num_' + t + '"> <\/div>', n += '<div id="Txt_AD_value_' + t + '"><\/div>', n += '<img id="Img_AD_press_' + t + '">';
    n += '<div id="AD_btn1" class="button"> <\/div>';
    n += '<img id="AD_btn_focus" class="button focus">';
    n += REWARD_AD.html_tag("AD_ad_btn", {
      cls: "button",
      focus_id: "Img_AD_ad_focus"
    });
    i.innerHTML = n
  }
};
S_ATTENDANCE.reward = function() {
  STORAGE.data1.chul_date = S_ATTENDANCE.today;
  STORAGE.data1.chul_num++;
  S_ATTENDANCE.server_chul_num++;
  loading_show("출석", 1);
  STORAGE.save_all_info_to_storage("출석", 0, "att", function(n) {
    loading_hide("출석", 1);
    var t = n;
    if (typeof t == "string") try {
      t = JSON.parse(t)
    } catch (i) {
      t = null
    }
    if (t) {
      if (t.hasOwnProperty("ATT_DAY") && (S_ATTENDANCE.server_att_day = parseInt(t.ATT_DAY)), t.hasOwnProperty("ATT_CHUL_NUM") && (S_ATTENDANCE.server_chul_num = parseInt(t.ATT_CHUL_NUM)), t.hasOwnProperty("ATT_GIVEN") && (S_ATTENDANCE.att_done = 1, REWARD_AD.show("AD_ad_btn"), S_ATTENDANCE.drawFocus()), t.ATT_GIVEN !== !0) {
        STORAGE.data1.chul_num--;
        S_ATTENDANCE.server_chul_num--;
        S_ATTENDANCE.refresh_stamps(S_ATTENDANCE.cur_cycle_day(S_ATTENDANCE.server_chul_num));
        return
      }
      S_ATTENDANCE.refresh_stamps(S_ATTENDANCE.cur_cycle_day(S_ATTENDANCE.server_chul_num));
      utilNotice(TXT.attendance_reward_mailbox, 1.5)
    }
  })
};
S_ATTENDANCE.press1 = function() {
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.CHUL_CONGR);
  STORAGE.data1.chul_date = S_ATTENDANCE.today;
  var i = S_ATTENDANCE.server_chul_num % ATT_MAX_DAY,
    n = i == 0 ? ATT_MAX_DAY : i,
    t = S_ATTENDANCE.get_box_pos(n);
  $("#Txt_AD_num_" + n).css({
    color: "#ffffff"
  });
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_AD_board_" + n, glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/14_attendance/at_box2_1.png", t.x, t.y);
  $("#Img_AD_press_" + n).css({
    display: "block"
  });
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_AD_press_" + n, glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/14_attendance/at_check.png", t.x + 28, t.y + 27)
};
S_ATTENDANCE.is_double = function() {
  return (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.HCN) && (S_ATTENDANCE.today = getDate2()), S_ATTENDANCE.today == S_ATTENDANCE.server_chul_date ? 1 : 0
};
S_ATTENDANCE.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
    case KeyDefine.right:
      REWARD_AD.is_shown("AD_ad_btn") && (S_ATTENDANCE.focus = i == KeyDefine.left ? 1 : 2, S_ATTENDANCE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.back:
      (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && S_ATTENDANCE.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_ATTENDANCE.menuRun()
  }
};

S_ATTENDANCE.drawFocus = function() {
  REWARD_AD.is_shown("AD_ad_btn") || (S_ATTENDANCE.focus = 1);
  S_ATTENDANCE.focus == 2 ? ($("#AD_btn_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_AD_ad_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  })) : ($("#AD_btn_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }), $("#Img_AD_ad_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  }))
};
S_ATTENDANCE.on_reward_ad = function() {
  REWARD_AD.notice(TXT.reward_ad_notice_attend_x2, 3);
  REWARD_AD.refresh_btn("AD_ad_btn");
  S_ATTENDANCE.focus = 1;
  S_ATTENDANCE.drawFocus()
};
S_ATTENDANCE.menuRun = function() {
  if (S_ATTENDANCE.focus == 2) {
    if (!REWARD_AD.is_enabled("AD_ad_btn")) {
      REWARD_AD.notice_state("AD_ad_btn");
      return
    }
    REWARD_AD.play(REWARD_AD.PLACE.ATTEND_X2, "", null, S_ATTENDANCE.on_reward_ad);
    return
  }
  gEnableKey = 0;
  utilScale_xy_center("AD_btn1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("AD_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("AD_btn1", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("AD_btn_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_ATTENDANCE.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_ATTENDANCE.menuRun_Run = function() {
  S_ATTENDANCE.end();
  add_event_pop();
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT && glo.fun.get_value_pay_total_this_month() > 0 ? ($("#S_ATTENDANCE_div").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#S_PAYGUIDE_div").css({
    display: "block"
  }), S_PAYGUIDE.init()) : ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU);
  return
};
S_ATTENDANCE.end = function() {
  S_ATTENDANCE.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_ATTENDANCE.addMouseEvent = function() {
  REWARD_AD.is_supported() && $(".button").click(this.onClick).mouseover(this.onMouseover)
};
S_ATTENDANCE.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  REWARD_AD.is_supported() && $(".button").unbind("click").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_ATTENDANCE.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    if (REWARD_AD.hit(n.target.id, "AD_ad_btn")) {
      S_ATTENDANCE.focus = 2;
      S_ATTENDANCE.drawFocus();
      S_ATTENDANCE.menuRun();
      return
    }
    switch (n.target.id) {
      case "AD_btn1":
      case "AD_btn_focus":
        S_ATTENDANCE.focus = 1;
        S_ATTENDANCE.drawFocus();
        S_ATTENDANCE.menuRun();
        break;
      default:
        utilConsoleLog("Please define this id in S_ATTENDANCE.onClick():" + n.target.id)
    }
  }
};
S_ATTENDANCE.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (REWARD_AD.hit(n.target.id, "AD_ad_btn")) {
    S_ATTENDANCE.focus = 2;
    S_ATTENDANCE.drawFocus();
    return
  }
  switch (n.target.id) {
    case "AD_btn1":
    case "AD_btn_focus":
      S_ATTENDANCE.onMouseover_pressed("AD_btn1", "AD_btn_focus");
      S_ATTENDANCE.focus = 1;
      S_ATTENDANCE.drawFocus();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Please define this id in S_ATTENDANCE.onMouseover():" + n.target.id)
  }
};
S_ATTENDANCE.onMouseover_pressed = function(n, t, i, r) {
  Main.onMouseover_pressed(n, t, i, r)
};
S_ATTENDANCE.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_ATTENDANCE.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_ATTENDANCE.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_ATTENDANCE.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_ATTENDANCE.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_ATTENDANCE.onClick(n);
  return
};

S_MAINMENU.clear_history = function() {
  var n, t, i;
  if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && gHISTORY.length >= 2) {
    for (n = gHISTORY.length, t = 1; t <= n - 1; t++) gHISTORY.pop();
    i = (n - 1) * -1;
    history.go(i)
  }
};

  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV ? gHISTORY.length < 2 && glo.APP_FEATURE.BRIGHT_SDK && (S_BRDOPT.get_status() || S_EVENT.flag_1 != 1 || S_BRDGUIDE.change_scene()) : gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR && glo.APP_FEATURE.BRIGHT_SDK ? S_BRDOPT.get_status() || S_EVENT.flag_1 != 1 || S_BRDGUIDE.change_scene() : glo.APP_FEATURE.HONEYGAIN && S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.honeygain_opt_status != 1 && S_EVENT.flag_1 == 1 && S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.init()
};
S_MAINMENU.check_android_subscription = function() {
  if (glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE && !S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.isConnected()) try {
    if (Main.use_android_bridge()) {
      var n = "eldorado_m_sub_1";
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ATV ? n = "eldorado_atv_sub_1" : gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB && (n = "6603028");
      android_bridge.update_sub(n)
    }
  } catch (t) {}
};
S_MAINMENU.update_guild_act_get_guild_normal = function() {
  ServerConnection.update_guild({
    act: "get_guild_normal"
  }, "guild_inter", function(n) {
    switch (n.result) {
      case "ok":
        switch (n.data) {
          case "no_guild":
            json_secure.set("guild_data", null);
            json_secure.set("season_data", n.season_data);
            break;
          case "진입불가":
            S_MAINMENU.guild_enter = !1;
            break;
          default:
            typeof n.data == "string" && (n.data = JSON.parse(n.data));
            json_secure.set("guild_data", n.data);
            json_secure.set("season_data", n.season_data)
        }
        break;
      default:
        utilNotice("Error - GGN e | " + n.result, 1)
    }
  })
};

S_MAINMENU.check_reward_mailbox = function() {
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_MAINMENU && (S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num() > 0 ? ($("#MM_menu" + S_MAINMENU.MAIL_BTN_NUM + "_new").css({
    display: "block"
  }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("MM_menu" + S_MAINMENU.MAIL_BTN_NUM + "_new", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/1_mainmenu/mm_bigbt_noticeicon.png", 32, -5)) : $("#MM_menu" + S_MAINMENU.MAIL_BTN_NUM + "_new").css({
    display: "none"
  }));
  for (var n = 1; n <= S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num(); n++)
    if (g.REWARD[n].why.includes("PAYMENT SUCCESS") && S_MAILBOX.view_flag == 0) {
      S_MAINMENU.end();
      $("#MM_menu_focus").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $("#MM_menu_focus_gamestart").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAILBOX, S_MAILBOX);
      return
    } loading_hide();
  S_MAILBOX.is_partial_get && (utilNotice(TXT.get_all_part, 3), S_MAILBOX.is_partial_get = !1)
};

S_MAINMENU.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var h = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    o, i, r, u, f, e, c, l, s;
  if (S_MAINMENU.menu_overlay.is_show()) {
    S_MAINMENU.menu_overlay.key_down(h);
    return
  }
  switch (h) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV && gSurvey.onoff == 1) return;
      for (o = S_MAINMENU.get_top_layer_list(), i = -1, r = 0; r < o.length; r++)
        if (o[r] === S_MAINMENU.focus) {
          i = r;
          break
        } if (i >= 0) {
        i > 0 && (S_MAINMENU.focus = o[i - 1]);
        S_MAINMENU.backup_focus_middle = S_MAINMENU.focus;
        S_MAINMENU.drawFocus();
        break
      }(S_MAINMENU.focus >= 2 && S_MAINMENU.focus <= MAINMENU_NUM || S_MAINMENU.focus >= MAINMENU_NUM + 2 && S_MAINMENU.focus <= MAINMENU_NUM + MAINMENU_NUM_TOP) && (S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.focus - 1);
      S_MAINMENU.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV && gSurvey.onoff == 1) return;
      for (u = S_MAINMENU.get_top_layer_list(), f = -1, e = 0; e < u.length; e++)
        if (u[e] === S_MAINMENU.focus) {
          f = e;
          break
        } if (f >= 0) {
        f < u.length - 1 && (S_MAINMENU.focus = u[f + 1]);
        S_MAINMENU.backup_focus_middle = S_MAINMENU.focus;
        S_MAINMENU.drawFocus();
        break
      }(S_MAINMENU.focus < MAINMENU_NUM || S_MAINMENU.focus > MAINMENU_NUM && S_MAINMENU.focus < MAINMENU_NUM + MAINMENU_NUM_TOP) && (S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.focus + 1);
      S_MAINMENU.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV && gSurvey.onoff == 1) {
        S_MAINMENU.survey_focus >= 2 && (S_MAINMENU.survey_focus--, S_MAINMENU.draw_survey_draw_focus());
        return
      }
      S_MAINMENU.focus >= 1 && S_MAINMENU.focus <= MAINMENU_NUM ? (S_MAINMENU.backup_focus = S_MAINMENU.focus, S_MAINMENU.focus == MAINMENU_NUM && glo.APP_FEATURE.MORE_GAMES == 1 && document.getElementById("MM_moregame") ? (S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.MG_BTN_NUM, S_MAINMENU.backup_focus_middle = S_MAINMENU.MG_BTN_NUM) : S_MAINMENU.focus == MAINMENU_NUM && $("#AE_main_icon").html() ? (S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.AE_BTN_NUM, S_MAINMENU.backup_focus_middle = S_MAINMENU.AE_BTN_NUM) : S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.is_valid_top_focus(S_MAINMENU.backup_focus_middle) ? S_MAINMENU.backup_focus_middle : S_MAINMENU.BD_BTN_NUM) : (S_MAINMENU.focus == S_MAINMENU.BD_BTN_NUM || S_MAINMENU.focus == S_MAINMENU.AE_BTN_NUM || S_MAINMENU.focus == S_MAINMENU.MG_BTN_NUM) && (S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.backup_focus_up);
      S_MAINMENU.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV && gSurvey.onoff == 1) {
        S_MAINMENU.survey_focus <= gSurvey.num && (S_MAINMENU.survey_focus++, S_MAINMENU.draw_survey_draw_focus());
        return
      }
      S_MAINMENU.focus >= MAINMENU_NUM + 1 && S_MAINMENU.focus <= MAINMENU_NUM + MAINMENU_NUM_TOP ? (S_MAINMENU.backup_focus_up = S_MAINMENU.focus, S_MAINMENU.focus = $("#AE_main_icon").html() ? S_MAINMENU.backup_focus_middle : S_MAINMENU.BD_BTN_NUM) : (S_MAINMENU.focus == S_MAINMENU.BD_BTN_NUM || S_MAINMENU.focus == S_MAINMENU.AE_BTN_NUM || S_MAINMENU.focus == S_MAINMENU.MG_BTN_NUM) && (S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.backup_focus);
      S_MAINMENU.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV && gSurvey.onoff == 1) {
        S_MAINMENU.menuRun_survey();
        return
      }
      S_MAINMENU.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_MAINMENU.run_back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.CHANNEL_UP:
    case KeyDefine.CHANNEL_DOWN:
      if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT) return -1;
      break;
    case KeyDefine.space:
      if (gAPP_RELEASE != "TEST") return;
    case KeyDefine.RED:
      S_MAINMENU.run_info();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.BLUE:
      if (glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) return;
      if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT) c = "http://appsbusidol.cafe24.com/kt/get_location_url.php", l = {}, $.ajax({
        url: c,
        type: "POST",
        data: l,
        timeout: 5e3,
        success: function(n) {
          window.location = n
        },
        error: function() {
          glo.fun.show_s_error_network()
        }
      });
      else {
        if (glo.APP_FEATURE.BRIGHT_SDK) {
          if (!S_BRDOPT.get_status() && S_EVENT.flag_1 == 1) {
            S_BRDGUIDE.change_scene();
            return
          }
        } else if (glo.APP_FEATURE.HONEYGAIN && S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.honeygain_opt_status != 1 && S_EVENT.flag_1 == 1) {
          S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.init();
          return
        }
        s = function() {
          S_MAINMENU.launch_event_banner_on_right()
        };
        loading_show();
        gEnableKey = 0;
        AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[12] = -1;
        auto_event_system_check(999, s)
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.GREEN:
      return;
    case KeyDefine.PLAY:
      if (gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.KT) return;
      if (glo.APP_FEATURE.BRIGHT_SDK) {
        if (!S_BRDOPT.get_status() && S_EVENT.flag_1 == 1) {
          S_BRDGUIDE.change_scene();
          return
        }
      } else if (glo.APP_FEATURE.HONEYGAIN && S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.honeygain_opt_status != 1 && S_EVENT.flag_1 == 1) {
        S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.init();
        return
      }
      s = function() {
        S_MAINMENU.launch_event_banner_on_right()
      };
      loading_show();
      gEnableKey = 0;
      AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[12] = -1;
      auto_event_system_check(999, s);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      S_MAINMENU.focus = 1;
      S_MAINMENU.drawFocus();
      S_MAINMENU.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      S_MAINMENU.focus = 2;
      S_MAINMENU.drawFocus();
      S_MAINMENU.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
      S_MAINMENU.focus = 3;
      S_MAINMENU.drawFocus();
      S_MAINMENU.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM4:
      S_MAINMENU.focus = 4;
      S_MAINMENU.drawFocus();
      S_MAINMENU.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM5:
      S_MAINMENU.focus = 5;
      S_MAINMENU.drawFocus();
      S_MAINMENU.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM6:
      S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.GUILD_BTN_NUM;
      S_MAINMENU.drawFocus();
      S_MAINMENU.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM7:
      S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.BD_BTN_NUM;
      S_MAINMENU.drawFocus();
      S_MAINMENU.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM8:
      S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.MAIL_BTN_NUM;
      S_MAINMENU.drawFocus();
      S_MAINMENU.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM9:
      S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.OHTER_BTN_NUM;
      S_MAINMENU.drawFocus();
      S_MAINMENU.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM0:
      S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.SETTING_BTN_NUM;
      S_MAINMENU.drawFocus();
      S_MAINMENU.menuRun()
  }
};

S_MAINMENU.run_attendance_event = function() {
  if (glo.APP_FEATURE.BRIGHT_SDK) {
    if (!S_BRDOPT.get_status() && S_EVENT.flag_1 == 1) {
      S_BRDGUIDE.change_scene();
      return
    }
  } else if (glo.APP_FEATURE.HONEYGAIN && S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.honeygain_opt_status != 1 && S_EVENT.flag_1 == 1) {
    S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.init();
    return
  }
  if (glo.APP_FEATURE.ATTENDANCE_EVENT) {
    if (!$("#AE_main_icon").html()) return;
    loading_show();
    ServerConnection.attendance_event({
      MODE: "SHOW"
    }, function(n) {
      loading_hide();
      n.TYPE == "EVENT_END" ? USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice(n.DESCRIPTION, 2) : utilNotice(n.DESCRIPTION_EN, 2) : (S_MAINMENU.end(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_SELECTEVENT, S_SELECTEVENT))
    })
  }
};
S_MAINMENU.run_account_change = function() {
  if (!glo.fun.is_glo_platform() && gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.TOSS) {
    if (glo.APP_FEATURE.BRIGHT_SDK) {
      if (!S_BRDOPT.get_status() && S_EVENT.flag_1 == 1) {
        S_BRDGUIDE.change_scene();
        return
      }
    } else if (glo.APP_FEATURE.HONEYGAIN && S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.honeygain_opt_status != 1 && S_EVENT.flag_1 == 1) {
      S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.init();
      return
    }
    ServerConnection.get_select_id(function() {
      S_ACCOUNT_CHANGE.account_id[2] != "-" ? ServerConnection.get_account_data(function() {
        bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "(계정변경)", "ok");
        utilPush();
        $("#S_ACCOUNT_CHANGE_div").css({
          display: "block"
        });
        S_ACCOUNT_CHANGE.preload();
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1
      }) : (bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "(계정변경)", "ok"), utilPush(), $("#S_ACCOUNT_CHANGE_div").css({
        display: "block"
      }), S_ACCOUNT_CHANGE.preload(), loading_hide(), gEnableKey = 1)
    });
    loading_show();
    gEnableKey = 0
  }
};

S_MAINMENU.unmount_mm_top = function() {
  var t, r, i, n;
  if (!S_MAINMENU.mm_top_is_cleared() && ($("#MM_top").empty(), !1)) {
    if (t = document.getElementById("MM_top"), !t) return;
    for (r = t.querySelectorAll("*"), i = 0; i < r.length; i++) {
      if (n = r[i], typeof jQuery != "undefined") {
        try {
          jQuery(n).off()
        } catch (u) {}
        try {
          jQuery(n).removeData()
        } catch (u) {}
      }
      if (n.tagName === "IMG") try {
        n.removeAttribute("src")
      } catch (u) {}
      try {
        n.style.background = "";
        n.style.backgroundImage = "none";
        n.style.transform = "none";
        n.style.webkitTransform = "none"
      } catch (u) {}
    }
    while (t.firstChild) t.removeChild(t.firstChild)
  }
};

  }

    }).appendTo(t)
  }

  function y() {

      left: "0px"
    });
    i.attr("src", "").css({
      left: t.width() + "px"
    });
    n.active = "A";
    l()
  }

  function h() {
    n.timer && clearTimeout(n.timer);
    n.timer = setTimeout(function() {
      e(n.idx + 1, "next")
    }, a)
  }

  function e(u, f) {
    function y() {
      o || (o = !0, n.idx = u, window.MAIN_BANNER_INDEX = n.idx, n.active = n.active === "A" ? "B" : "A", n.busy = !1, l(), h())
    }
    var o;

      }

        a = n.active === "A" ? r : i,
        s = n.active === "A" ? i : r,

      s.attr("src", c(u)).css({
        left: v + "px",
        top: "0px"
      });
      o = !1;

        left: (f === "prev" ? e : -e) + "px"
      }, 260);
      s.stop(!0, !0).animate({
        left: "0px"
      }, 260, y)
    }
  }

    t.off(".banner");

        }

          }
        }

            this._downY = n.pageY;

            try {
              this.setPointerCapture && this.setPointerCapture(n.pointerId);
              n.pointerType !== "mouse" && n.preventDefault && n.preventDefault()
            } catch (n) {}
          });

          });

        }

          t && n.preventDefault && n.preventDefault();

        });

        });
        t.on("click.banner", ".banner_dot", function() {
          var i = t.find(".banner_dot").index(this),

          i !== n.idx && (r = i > n.idx ? "next" : "prev", e(i, r))
        });
        t.on("mousedown.banner", function(n) {
          this._downX = n.pageX;
          this._downY = n.pageY
        });
        t.on("mouseup.banner", function(n) {
          if (typeof this._downX == "number") {
            var t = n.pageX - this._downX,
              r = n.pageY - this._downY;

            i(t, r, n.target)
          }
        })
      }();

    REWARD_AD.draw("MM_ad_btn", 901, 117, {

S_MAINMENU.open_bgwm = function() {
  var n = S_MAINMENU.BGWM_STORE_URL;
  try {
    if (typeof AndroidBridge != "undefined" && AndroidBridge && AndroidBridge.launchApp) {
      AndroidBridge.launchApp(S_MAINMENU.BGWM_PACKAGE, n);
      return
    }
    if (typeof AndroidBridge != "undefined" && AndroidBridge && AndroidBridge.openUrl) {
      AndroidBridge.openUrl(n);
      return
    }
  } catch (t) {
    utilConsoleLog("S_MAINMENU.open_bgwm: bridge error. " + t)
  }
  try {
    window.open(n, "_blank")
  } catch (i) {
    try {
      location.href = n
    } catch (r) {}
  }
};

  }) : S_MAINMENU.focus === S_MAINMENU.CP_BTN_NUM ? $("#CP_main_f").css({

  }) : S_MAINMENU.focus === S_MAINMENU.BD_BTN_NUM ? $("#BD_main_f").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_MAINMENU.focus === S_MAINMENU.MG_BTN_NUM ? $("#MM_moregame_f").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_MAINMENU.focus === S_MAINMENU.MOBILE_LINK_NUM ? $("#Mobile_Link_main_f").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : (S_MAINMENU.focus === S_MAINMENU.MAIL_BTN_NUM || S_MAINMENU.focus === S_MAINMENU.OHTER_BTN_NUM || S_MAINMENU.focus === S_MAINMENU.SETTING_BTN_NUM) && $("#MM_menu" + S_MAINMENU.focus + "_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  })
};
S_MAINMENU.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  utilScale_xy_center("MM_menu" + S_MAINMENU.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("MM_menu1_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("MM_menu2_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("MM_menu3_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("MM_menu4_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("MM_menu5_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("MM_main_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("MM_menu" + S_MAINMENU.focus, 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("MM_menu1_focus", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("MM_menu2_focus", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("MM_menu3_focus", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("MM_menu4_focus", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("MM_menu5_focus", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("MM_main_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_MAINMENU.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_MAINMENU.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (glo.APP_FEATURE.BRIGHT_SDK) {
    if (!S_BRDOPT.get_status() && S_EVENT.flag_1 == 1 && S_MAINMENU.focus != 9) {
      S_BRDGUIDE.change_scene();
      return
    }
  } else if (glo.APP_FEATURE.HONEYGAIN && S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.honeygain_opt_status != 1 && S_EVENT.flag_1 == 1 && S_MAINMENU.focus != 9) {
    S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.init();
    return
  }
  switch (S_MAINMENU.focus) {
    case S_MAINMENU.TEAM_BTN_NUM:
      bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "maketeam(팀구성)", "ok");
      utilPush();
      S_MAINMENU.end();
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM);
      break;
    case S_MAINMENU.UPGRADE_BTN_NUM:
      loading_show();
      gEnableKey = 0;
      auto_event_system_init();
      auto_event_system_check(999, function() {
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "upgrade(업그레이드)", "ok");
        utilPush();
        S_MAINMENU.end();
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_UPGRADE, S_UPGRADE)
      });
      break;
    case S_MAINMENU.GACHA_BTN_NUM:
      loading_show();
      gEnableKey = 0;
      auto_event_system_init();
      auto_event_system_check(999, function() {
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "gacha(뽑기)", "ok");
        utilPush();
        S_MAINMENU.end();
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GACHA, S_GACHA)
      });
      break;
    case S_MAINMENU.SHOP_BTN_NUM:
      loading_show();
      gEnableKey = 0;
      auto_event_system_init();
      auto_event_system_check(999, function() {
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "market(상점)", "ok");
        utilPush();
        S_MAINMENU.end();
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_PACKAGE_STORE, S_PACKAGE_STORE)
      });
      break;
    case S_MAINMENU.QUEST_BTN_NUM:
      bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "quest(업적)", "ok");
      utilPush();
      S_MAINMENU.end();
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_QUEST, S_QUEST);
      break;
    case S_MAINMENU.GUILD_BTN_NUM:
      if (!S_MAINMENU.guild_enter) {
        utilNotice(TXT.guild_enter_possible, 2);
        return
      }
      ServerConnection.update_guild({
        act: "check_guild_member"
      }, "guild_inter", function(n) {
        switch (n.result) {
          case "no_guild":
            n.exit_remain_time != null && (S_GUILD_ENTER.exit_remain_time = n.exit_remain_time);
            S_GUILD_ENTER.exit_time = n.exit_time;
            json_secure.set("season_data", n.season_data);
            bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "guild(길드)", "ok");
            utilPush();
            S_MAINMENU.end();
            ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_ENTER, S_GUILD_ENTER);
            break;
          case "has_guild":
            n && typeof n.data != "undefined" && n.data !== null ? n.data == "error" ? utilNotice("Error - IGM D e | " + n.comment, 1) : (bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "guild(길드)", "ok"), utilPush(), S_MAINMENU.end(), json_secure.set("guild_data", n.data), json_secure.set("season_data", n.season_data), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_MAIN, S_GUILD_MAIN)) : utilNotice("Error - No guild data | " + n.comment, 1);
            break;
          case "error":
          default:
            utilNotice("Error - IGM-1 e | " + n.comment, 1)
        }
      });
      break;
    case S_MAINMENU.MAIL_BTN_NUM:
      if (S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num() > 0) document.getElementById("S_MAILBOX_div") == null ? $("#S_MAINMENU_div").after('<div id= "S_MAILBOX_div"><\/div>') : $("#S_MAILBOX_div").empty(), bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "mailbox(우편함)", "ok"), utilPush(), S_MAINMENU.end(), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAILBOX, S_MAILBOX) : ($("#S_MAINMENU_div").css({
        display: "none"
      }), $("#S_MAILBOX_div").css({
        display: "block"
      }), S_MAILBOX.init());
      else {
        utilNotice(TXT.mailbox_empty, 3);
        return
      }
      break;
    case S_MAINMENU.OHTER_BTN_NUM:
      S_MAINMENU.menu_overlay.create();
      break;
    case S_MAINMENU.SETTING_BTN_NUM:
      glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? (bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "setting(설정)", "ok"), utilPush(), S_MAINMENU.end(), $("#S_MAINMENU_div").css({
        display: "none"
      }), $("#S_SETTING_div").css({
        display: "block"
      }), S_SETTING.init()) : (loading_show(), gEnableKey = 0, ServerConnection.get_mobile_link_data(function() {
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "setting(설정)", "ok");
        utilPush();
        S_MAINMENU.end();
        gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_SETTING, S_SETTING) : ($("#S_MAINMENU_div").css({
          display: "none"
        }), $("#S_SETTING_div").css({
          display: "block"
        }), S_SETTING.init())
      }));
      break;
    case S_MAINMENU.START_BTN_NUM:
      loading_show();
      gEnableKey = 0;
      auto_event_system_init();
      auto_event_system_check(999, function(n) {
        bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "game start(게임시작)", "ok");
        utilPush();
        S_MAINMENU.end();
        S_MODE_SELECT.cur_boss_hp = n.cur_boss_hp;
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MODE_SELECT, S_MODE_SELECT)
      });
      break;
    case S_MAINMENU.AE_BTN_NUM:
      S_MAINMENU.run_attendance_event();
      break;
    case S_MAINMENU.BD_BTN_NUM:
      glo.APP_FEATURE.BLUE_DRAGON && (bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "four gods(사방신)", "ok"), utilPush(), S_MAINMENU.end(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_FOUR_GODS, S_FOUR_GODS));
      break;
    case S_MAINMENU.MG_BTN_NUM:
      S_MAINMENU.enter_more_games();
      break;
    case S_MAINMENU.CP_BTN_NUM:
      if (!glo.APP_FEATURE.COUPON) return;
      bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "coupon(쿠폰)", "ok");
      utilPush();
      S_MAINMENU.end();
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_COUPON, S_COUPON);
      break;
    case S_MAINMENU.MOBILE_LINK_NUM:
      S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.isConnected() ? (loading_show(), gEnableKey = 0, utilNotice(TXT.mobile_connect_amo_back_to_mobile, 2), S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_platform = S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.info.platform, S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_id = S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.info.uniq_id, ServerConnection.put_log_mobile_connect_info_amo("[모바일연동] 모바일로 돌아감"), setTimeout(function() {
        loading_hide();
        glo.TEST_MODE.INDEX_PC_AMO_HTML ? location.replace("./index_pc_amo.html") : location.replace("./index_amo.html")
      }, 2500)) : (S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_id = null, S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_platform = null, S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.input_name = null, S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.status = 1, ServerConnection.get_mobile_connect_info_amo(function() {
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO, S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO)
      }));
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("error!! in S_MAINMENU.menuRun()")
  }
};

    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)

S_MAINMENU.draw_chat = function() {
  var t, n;
  if (gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV) {
    for ($("#MM_chat_msg_div").css({
        left: "226px",
        top: "156px",
        width: "828px",
        height: "147px",
        position: "absolute"
      }), t = 1; t <= 7; t++) $("#MM_chat_msg_txt" + t + "_name").css({
      left: "0px",
      top: 0 + (t - 1) * 20 + "px",
      width: "120px",
      height: "20px",
      "line-height": "20px",
      "font-size": "17rem",
      "text-align": "left",
      color: "#ffffff",
      "text-shadow": "1px 1px 1px gray",
      position: "absolute"
    }), $("#MM_chat_msg_txt" + t + "_msg").css({
      left: "120px",
      top: 0 + (t - 1) * 20 + "px",
      width: "630px",
      height: "20px",
      "line-height": "20px",
      "font-size": "17rem",
      "text-align": "left",
      color: "#ffffff",
      "padding-left": "2px",
      overflow: "hidden",
      "text-overflow": "ellipsis",
      "white-space": "nowrap",
      "text-shadow": "1px 1px 1px gray",
      position: "absolute"
    }), $("#MM_chat_msg_txt" + t + "_date").css({
      left: "750px",
      top: 0 + (t - 1) * 20 + "px",
      width: "100px",
      height: "20px",
      "line-height": "24.5px",
      "font-size": "13rem",
      "text-align": "left",
      color: "#ffffff",
      "text-shadow": "1px 1px 1px gray",
      position: "absolute"
    });
    for (n = 0; n <= 6; n++)
      if (msg_name = CHAT_MSG[n].NAME, msg_msg = CHAT_MSG[n].MSG, msg_date = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT ? CHAT_MSG[n].DATE.replace(/-/gi, "/") : CHAT_MSG[n].DATE, msg_date != "") {
        var u = new Date(msg_date),
          f = parseInt(window.g.timestamp_start, 10) + parseInt(window.g.timestamp_due, 10),
          e = new Date(f),
          o = e.getTime() - u.getTime(),
          r = Math.floor(o / 6e4),
          i = r;
        i = i <= 0 ? "방금전" : r + "분전";
        CHAT_MSG[n].MSG.length <= 35 ? (document.getElementById("MM_chat_msg_txt" + (n + 1) + "_name").innerHTML = CHAT_MSG[n].NAME, document.getElementById("MM_chat_msg_txt" + (n + 1) + "_msg").innerHTML = " : " + CHAT_MSG[n].MSG + "<font size=-1> ( " + i + " )<\/font>", document.getElementById("MM_chat_msg_txt" + (n + 1) + "_date").innerHTML = "") : (document.getElementById("MM_chat_msg_txt" + (n + 1) + "_name").innerHTML = CHAT_MSG[n].NAME, document.getElementById("MM_chat_msg_txt" + (n + 1) + "_msg").innerHTML = " : " + CHAT_MSG[n].MSG, document.getElementById("MM_chat_msg_txt" + (n + 1) + "_date").innerHTML = " ( " + i + " )")
      } else document.getElementById("MM_chat_msg_txt" + (n + 1) + "_name").innerHTML = "", document.getElementById("MM_chat_msg_txt" + (n + 1) + "_msg").innerHTML = "", document.getElementById("MM_chat_msg_txt" + (n + 1) + "_date").innerHTML = ""
  }
};

  S_MAINMENU.removeMouseEvent();
  S_MAINMENU.clear_all_timers();
  util_fun_img.move_image_up_down.teardown_all();
  S_MAINMENU.focus_none_all();
  gAPP_RELEASE == "RELEASE_FACEBOOK_LOGIN" && $(".fb-like").css({
    display: "none"
  })
};
S_MAINMENU.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || $("#S_MAINMENU_div").mouseover(this.onMouseover))
};
S_MAINMENU.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_MAINMENU_div").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_MAINMENU.onClick = function(n) {
  var t, u, r, i;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (utilConsoleLog(" S_MAINMENU.onClick  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (S_MAINMENU.menu_overlay.is_show()) {
      S_MAINMENU.menu_overlay.onclick(t);
      return
    }
    if (REWARD_AD.hit(n.target.id, "MM_ad_btn")) {
      if (!REWARD_AD.is_enabled("MM_ad_btn")) {
        REWARD_AD.notice_state("MM_ad_btn");
        return
      }
      REWARD_AD.play(REWARD_AD.PLACE.MAINMENU, "", null, S_MAINMENU.on_reward_ad);
      return
    }
    if (t.className.search("run_info") >= 0) {
      S_MAINMENU.run_info();
      return
    }
    if (t.className.search("run_help") >= 0) {
      S_MAINMENU.run_help();
      return
    }
    if (t.className.search("run_exit") >= 0) {
      S_MAINMENU.run_back();
      return
    }
    if (t.className.search("button") >= 0 && t.id.search("AE_main") >= 0) {
      glo.APP_FEATURE.ATTENDANCE_EVENT && S_MAINMENU.run_attendance_event();
      return
    }
    if (t.id.search("Img_MM_account_change") >= 0 || t.id.search("Img_MM_account_change_text") >= 0) {
      S_MAINMENU.run_account_change();
      return
    }
    if (t.id.search("Img_chevent_october") >= 0) {
      loading_show();
      gEnableKey = 0;
      auto_event_system_init();
      auto_event_system_check(999, function() {
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        S_MAINMENU.launch_event_banner_on_right()
      });
      return
    }
    if (gAPP_RELEASE == "RELEASE_FACEBOOK_LOGIN") switch (n.currentTarget.id) {
      case "MM_friend_list":
        u = n.target.id;
        r = u.split("_");
        r.length <= 3 || (i = parseInt(r[3], 10), $("#MM_friend_list_" + i).css({
          background: util_bg_url("url(" + SERVER_IMG_URL + "image/facebook/fb_list_f.png) no-repeat 0 0")
        }), setTimeout(function() {
          if ($("#MM_friend_list_" + i).css({
              background: util_bg_url("url(" + SERVER_IMG_URL + "image/facebook/fb_list.png) no-repeat 0 0")
            }), i > gFriendsGaming.length) {
            var n = gFriendsInvitable[i - 1 - gFriendsGaming.length].id;
            FB.ui({
              method: "apprequests",
              to: n,
              message: TXT.invite_message
            }, function(n) {
              console.log(n);
              n.request != null && (gFriendsInvitedList == null && (gFriendsInvitedList = []), gFriendsInvitedList.push(gFriendsInvitable[i - 1 - gFriendsGaming.length].name), update_quest_invitedlist_to_server(), QUEST.f12_facebook_invite(1), utilNotice("1 request completed", 1.5), S_MAINMENU.facebook_del_a_friend(i))
            })
          } else utilNotice(gFriendsGaming[i - 1].name + " is now playing...", 2)
        }, 300));
        break;
      case "MM_friend_left_arrow":
        S_MAINMENU.facebook_display_arrow(1);
        setTimeout(function() {
          S_MAINMENU.facebook_display_arrow(0);
          S_MAINMENU.facebook.cur_page > 1 && (S_MAINMENU.facebook.cur_page--, S_MAINMENU.facebook_display_page(), S_MAINMENU.facebook.target_x = (S_MAINMENU.facebook.cur_page - 1) * -S_MAINMENU.facebook.page_gap, S_MAINMENU.facebook_friendlist_scroll())
        }, 200);
        break;
      case "MM_friend_right_arrow":
        S_MAINMENU.facebook_display_arrow(2);
        setTimeout(function() {
          S_MAINMENU.facebook_display_arrow(0);
          S_MAINMENU.facebook.cur_page < S_MAINMENU.facebook.tot_page && (S_MAINMENU.facebook.cur_page++, S_MAINMENU.facebook_display_page(), S_MAINMENU.facebook.target_x = (S_MAINMENU.facebook.cur_page - 1) * -S_MAINMENU.facebook.page_gap, S_MAINMENU.facebook_friendlist_scroll())
        }, 200);
        break;
      case "MM_friend_list":
        break;
      case "MM_friend_allinvite":
        S_MAINMENU.facebook_display_allinvite(1);
        setTimeout(function() {
          S_MAINMENU.facebook_display_allinvite(0);
          FB.ui({
            method: "apprequests",
            message: TXT.invite_message
          }, function(n) {
            console.log(n);
            QUEST.f12_facebook_invite(n.to.length);
            utilNotice(n.to.length + " request completed!", 1.5)
          })
        }, 200);
        break;
      default:
        S_MAINMENU.menuRun()
    } else gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV && gSurvey.onoff == 1 ? S_MAINMENU.menuRun_survey() : S_MAINMENU.menuRun()
  }
};
S_MAINMENU.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (S_MAINMENU.menu_overlay.is_show()) {
      S_MAINMENU.menu_overlay.onmouseover(t);
      return
    }
    t.id.search("MM_menu10") >= 0 ? S_MAINMENU.backup_focus_up = S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.SETTING_BTN_NUM : t.id.search("MM_menu1") >= 0 ? S_MAINMENU.backup_focus = S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.TEAM_BTN_NUM : t.id.search("MM_menu2") >= 0 ? S_MAINMENU.backup_focus = S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.UPGRADE_BTN_NUM : t.id.search("MM_menu3") >= 0 ? S_MAINMENU.backup_focus = S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.GACHA_BTN_NUM : t.id.search("MM_menu4") >= 0 ? S_MAINMENU.backup_focus = S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.SHOP_BTN_NUM : t.id.search("MM_menu5") >= 0 ? S_MAINMENU.backup_focus = S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.QUEST_BTN_NUM : t.id.search("MM_menu6") >= 0 ? S_MAINMENU.backup_focus = S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.GUILD_BTN_NUM : t.id.search("MM_menu7") >= 0 ? S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.START_BTN_NUM : t.id.search("MM_menu8") >= 0 ? S_MAINMENU.backup_focus_up = S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.MAIL_BTN_NUM : t.id.search("MM_menu9") >= 0 ? S_MAINMENU.backup_focus_up = S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.OHTER_BTN_NUM : t.id.search("AE_main") >= 0 ? S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.AE_BTN_NUM : t.id.search("BD_main") >= 0 ? S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.BD_BTN_NUM : t.id.search("MM_moregame") >= 0 ? (S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.MG_BTN_NUM, S_MAINMENU.backup_focus_middle = S_MAINMENU.MG_BTN_NUM) : t.id.search("CP_main") >= 0 ? S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.CP_BTN_NUM : t.id.search("MM_top_mobile_link_div") >= 0 && (S_MAINMENU.focus = S_MAINMENU.MOBILE_LINK_NUM);
    S_MAINMENU.drawFocus()
  }
};
S_MAINMENU.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_MAINMENU.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_MAINMENU.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_MAINMENU.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_MAINMENU.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_MAINMENU.onMouseover(n);
  S_MAINMENU.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_MAINMENU.facebook_del_friends = function() {
  var u = 0,
    i, f, r, n, t;

S_USERGUIDE.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_USERGUIDE.focus == 1 && (S_USERGUIDE.right_focus--, S_USERGUIDE.right_focus <= 0 && (S_USERGUIDE.right_focus = 1), S_USERGUIDE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_USERGUIDE.focus == 1 && (S_USERGUIDE.right_focus++, S_USERGUIDE.right_focus > S_USERGUIDE.service_page_max && (S_USERGUIDE.right_focus = S_USERGUIDE.service_page_max), S_USERGUIDE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_USERGUIDE.focus >= 2 && (S_USERGUIDE.focus = S_USERGUIDE.focus - 1, S_USERGUIDE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_USERGUIDE.focus < USERGUIDE_NUM && (S_USERGUIDE.focus = S_USERGUIDE.focus + 1, S_USERGUIDE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_USERGUIDE.backKey()
  }
};

    });
    return
  }

  utilConsoleLog(" onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  switch (n.target.id) {
    case "UP_btn1":
      S_USERPAID.focus != 4 && (S_USERPAID.focus = 1, S_USERPAID.drawFocus());
      break;
    case "UP_btn2":
      S_USERPAID.focus != 4 && (S_USERPAID.focus = 2, S_USERPAID.drawFocus());
      break;
    case "UP_btn3":
      S_USERPAID.has_qr && S_USERPAID.focus != 4 && (S_USERPAID.focus = 3, S_USERPAID.drawFocus());
      break;
    case "adpopup_btn":
      S_USERPAID.focus == 4 && (S_USERPAID.focus = 4, S_USERPAID.drawFocus())
  }
  return
};

S_EVENTPAGE.maketag = function() {
  var n = document.getElementById("S_EVENTPAGE_div");
  $("#S_EVENTPAGE_div").empty();
  n.innerHTML = ' <div id="EP_bg"><\/div> <div id="EP_board"> \t<div id="EP_phone1"><\/div> \t<div id="EP_btn1"><\/div> \t<div id="EP_btn2"><\/div> \t<img id="EP_btn_focus" class="focus"> <\/div>'
};
S_EVENTPAGE.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    r;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_EVENTPAGE.row_focus != 1) {
        S_EVENTPAGE.focus = 2;
        S_EVENTPAGE.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      if (S_EVENTPAGE.row_focus != 1) {
        S_EVENTPAGE.row_focus = 1;
        S_EVENTPAGE.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      if (S_EVENTPAGE.row_focus == 1) {
        S_EVENTPAGE.row_focus = 2;
        S_EVENTPAGE.focus = 1;
        S_EVENTPAGE.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_EVENTPAGE.row_focus == 1 || S_EVENTPAGE.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM0:
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
    case KeyDefine.NUM4:
    case KeyDefine.NUM5:
    case KeyDefine.NUM6:
    case KeyDefine.NUM7:
    case KeyDefine.NUM8:
    case KeyDefine.NUM9:
      r = i - KeyDefine.NUM0 + "";
      switch (S_EVENTPAGE.row_focus) {
        case 1:
          if (S_EVENTPAGE.phone1_count >= 11) {
            utilNotice("11자리 까지만 입력 가능합니다", 2.5);
            return
          }
          S_EVENTPAGE.phone1 += r;
          S_EVENTPAGE.phone1_count++;
          S_EVENTPAGE.display_phone1();
          S_EVENTPAGE.phone1_count >= 11 && (S_EVENTPAGE.row_focus = 2, S_EVENTPAGE.drawFocus());
          break;
        case 2:
          return;
        default:
          utilConsoleLog("Error in S_EVENTPAGE.keyDown()")
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_EVENTPAGE.row_focus == 2) {
        S_EVENTPAGE.focus = 1;
        S_EVENTPAGE.drawFocus();
        return
      }
    case KeyDefine.ERASE:
      switch (S_EVENTPAGE.row_focus) {
        case 1:
          S_EVENTPAGE.phone1_count--;
          S_EVENTPAGE.phone1 = S_EVENTPAGE.phone1.substr(0, S_EVENTPAGE.phone1_count);
          S_EVENTPAGE.display_phone1();
          break;
        case 2:
          return;
        default:
          utilConsoleLog("Error in S_EVENTPAGE.keyDown()")
      }
  }
};
S_EVENTPAGE.display_phone1 = function() {
  var r = document.getElementById("EP_phone1"),
    n = "",
    t, i;
  if (S_EVENTPAGE.phone1_count <= 3) n = S_EVENTPAGE.phone1;
  else if (S_EVENTPAGE.phone1_count <= 7) t = S_EVENTPAGE.phone1.substr(0, 3), i = S_EVENTPAGE.phone1.substr(3, S_EVENTPAGE.phone1_count - 3), n = t + "-" + i;
  else {
    var t = S_EVENTPAGE.phone1.substr(0, 3),
      i = S_EVENTPAGE.phone1.substr(3, 4),
      u = S_EVENTPAGE.phone1.substr(7, S_EVENTPAGE.phone1_count - 7);
    n = t + "-" + i + "-" + u
  }
  r.innerHTML = n
};

S_EVENTPAGE.is_right_phone = function() {
  if (S_EVENTPAGE.phone1_count == 0) {
    utilNotice("휴대폰 번호를 입력해 주세요", 2.5);
    S_EVENTPAGE.row_focus = 1;
    S_EVENTPAGE.drawFocus();
    return
  }
  if (S_EVENTPAGE.phone1_count <= 10) {
    utilNotice("휴대폰 번호를 다시 확인해 주세요", 2.5);
    S_EVENTPAGE.row_focus = 1;
    S_EVENTPAGE.drawFocus();
    return
  }
  if (S_EVENTPAGE.phone1.substr(0, 2) != "01") {
    utilNotice("휴대폰 번호를 다시 확인해 주세요", 2.5);
    S_EVENTPAGE.row_focus = 1;
    S_EVENTPAGE.drawFocus();
    return
  }
  var n = S_EVENTPAGE.phone1.substr(0, 3),
    t = S_EVENTPAGE.phone1.substr(3, 4),
    i = S_EVENTPAGE.phone1.substr(7, S_EVENTPAGE.phone1_count);
  S_EVENTPAGE.phone_completed = n + "-" + t + "-" + i;
  utilNotice(S_EVENTPAGE.phone_completed + "번호로 기프티콘이 발송 될 예정입니다.", 3);
  put_event_result_to_server();
  setTimeout(function() {
    S_EVENTPAGE.back()
  }, 1500)
};

S_EVENTPAGE.is_event_activate = function() {
  if (gEVENT.ACTIVE == !1) return utilConsoleLog("이벤트가 Activate상태가 아닙니다. activate를 위해서는 define.js에 선언된 gEVENT.ACTIVE를 true로 해 주세요"), !1;
  if (S_EVENTPAGE.already == "already") return utilConsoleLog("당신은 벌써 한번 당첨되셨습니다. 초기화 하고 다시 시도 하였기에 이벤트 대상이 아닙니다."), !1;
  var n = new Date;
  return n < gEVENT.start_day || gEVENT.end_day < n ? (utilConsoleLog("이벤트 기간이 아닙니다."), !1) : S_GAME.ranking_mode != 0 ? (utilConsoleLog("일반모드가 아니면 이벤트 대상이 아니다."), !1) : S_GAME.stage != 5 ? (utilConsoleLog("5 stage 클리어 일때만 이벤트 대상입니다. 지금 당신의 스테이지는 :" + S_GAME.stage), !1) : S_STAGECLEAR.oldnew == 0 ? (utilConsoleLog("벌써 깬 5 스테이지는 이벤트 대상이 아닙니다."), !1) : S_EVENTPAGE.first_login_date > gEVENT.end_day ? (utilConsoleLog("이벤트 기간 지나서 가입했다. 그래서 안된다."), !1) : !0
};

S_INPUT_NICKNAME.make_code = function() {
  var t = 10 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 90),
    i = S_INPUT_NICKNAME.getWord(),
    r = 10 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 90),
    n = t + i + r;
  utilConsoleLog("code :" + n);
  S_INPUT_NICKNAME.code = n
};
S_INPUT_NICKNAME.getWord = function() {
  var n = S_INPUT_NICKNAME.word.length - 1,
    t = Math.floor(Math.random() * n);
  return S_INPUT_NICKNAME.word[t]
};
S_INPUT_NICKNAME.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + i + " in S_INPUT_NICKNAME.keyDown()");
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_INPUT_NICKNAME.back()
  }
};

S_INPUT_NICKNAME.drawFocus = function() {
  for (var n = 1; n <= ATTENDANCE.NUM; n++) S_INPUT_NICKNAME.focus != n ? $("#MM_menu" + n).css({
    border: "1px solid black",
    color: "gray"
  }) : $("#MM_menu" + n).css({

    color: "yellow"
  })
};
S_INPUT_NICKNAME.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  utilScale_xy_center("INN_btn1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("INN_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("GG_btn1", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("INN_btn_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_INPUT_NICKNAME.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};

  INNd_event_pop();

    display: "block"
  });
  S_MAINMENU.init()
};

S_INPUT_PAY.back = function() {
  var t, n, i;
  if (S_INPUT_PAY.result_flag = 0, S_INPUT_PAY.result_count = 0, clearInterval(S_INPUT_PAY.result_timer), S_INPUT_PAY.result_timer = null, $("#S_INPUT_PAY_div").css({
      display: "none"
    }), utilPush(), S_INPUT_PAY.end(), g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_USERPAID) {
    S_INPUT_PAY.back_user_paid();
    return
  }
  if (g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_AUTOPLAY_PAID) {
    S_INPUT_PAY.back_auto_play_paid();
    return
  }
  if (g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_PACKAGE_ITEM) S_INPUT_PAY.back_package_item();
  else if (g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE && S_INPUT_PAY.backup_before_scene == gS_GACHA) {
    t = function(n) {
      var u, r, t, f, e, o, i;
      for (loading_hide("", 1), u = n.quest, r = u.split(","), t = 1; t <= QUEST_NUM; t++)
        for (f = (t - 1) * 2, e = (t - 1) * 2 + 1, QUEST[t].status = parseInt(r[f]), o = r[e].split(":"), i = 1; i <= QUEST[t].num; i++) QUEST[t].arrive[i] = parseInt(o[i - 1]);
      g_sceneinfo.before_scene = gS_GACHA;
      g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE;
      S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE.back();
      typeof n.reward_info == "object" && n.reward_info.length > 0 && (S_POPUP_GACHA_RESULT.pending_from_new_gacha = !0, S_POPUP_GACHA_RESULT.goto_scene(n.reward_info));
      glo.package.set_payment_code("")
    };
    loading_show("", 1);
    auto_event_system_init();
    auto_event_system_check(999, t);
    return
  }
  S_EVENT.status == 2 ? S_EVENT.back() : S_EVENT.status == 3 ? (S_INPUT_PAY.one_chance_paid && (n = S_EVENT.one_chance_step == 1 ? 60 : 0, STORAGE.data1.upgrade[1] < n && (STORAGE.data1.upgrade[1] = n), STORAGE.data1.upgrade[2] < n && (STORAGE.data1.upgrade[2] = n), S_EVENT.set_one_chance_count(S_EVENT.one_chance_step, 1)), S_EVENT.back(), S_INPUT_PAY.one_chance_paid && S_EVENT.refresh_mailbox_after_one_chance()) : (i = function(n) {
    var r, i, t, u, f, e;
    for (loading_hide("", 1), S_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_focus == 6 && (S_PACKAGE_STORE.buy_package_item(), S_PACKAGE_STORE.noti_limited_time_goods()), r = n.quest, i = r.split(","), t = 1; t <= QUEST_NUM; t++)
      for (u = (t - 1) * 2, f = (t - 1) * 2 + 1, QUEST[t].status = parseInt(i[u]), e = i[f].split(":"), j = 1; j <= QUEST[t].num; j++) QUEST[t].arrive[j] = parseInt(e[j - 1]);
    S_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_focus == 2 ? S_PACKAGE_STORE.update_box_2_info() : S_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_focus == 3 && (n.is_grow_package == "yes" && (package_index = glo.package.get_package_list_arr_index(6) + 1, $("#Txt_MS_package_price_" + package_index).text(S_PACKAGE_STORE.get_box_3_price_info(package_index)), S_MAINMENU.update_growth_icon()), S_PACKAGE_STORE.update_box_3_info());
    g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_PACKAGE_STORE;
    S_PACKAGE_STORE.resume();
    Main.showSafeZone();
    typeof n.reward_info == "object" && n.reward_info.length > 0 && S_POPUP_GACHA_RESULT.goto_scene(n.reward_info);
    glo.package.set_payment_code("")
  }, loading_show("", 1), auto_event_system_init(), auto_event_system_check(999, i))
};

S_INPUT_PAY.result_check = function() {
  if (S_INPUT_PAY.result_flag == 0) S_INPUT_PAY.result_count++, ServerConnection.get_Xsolla_result_to_code(), S_INPUT_PAY.result_timer != null && (clearInterval(S_INPUT_PAY.result_timer), S_INPUT_PAY.result_timer = null), g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_INPUT_PAY && (S_INPUT_PAY.result_timer = setTimeout(S_INPUT_PAY.result_check, S_INPUT_PAY.again_result_time));
  else if (S_INPUT_PAY.result == "payment_complete") {
    if (USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("결제가 완료되었습니다.", 2) : USER.lang == LANG.VIETNAM ? utilNotice("Tiền đã được thanh toán.", 2) : utilNotice("The payment has been made.", 2), clearInterval(S_INPUT_PAY.result_timer), S_INPUT_PAY.result_timer = null, S_INPUT_PAY.one_chance_paid = !0, S_INPUT_PAY.before_scene == gS_AUTOPLAY_PAID) {
      window.AUTOPLAY || (AUTOPLAY = {});
      var n = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1e3);
      AUTOPLAY.paid = 1;
      AUTOPLAY.on_off = 1;
      (!AUTOPLAY.end_time || Number(AUTOPLAY.end_time) < n) && (AUTOPLAY.end_time = n + 604800);
      ServerConnection.update_autoplay_onoff(1)
    }
    gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_INPUT_PAY.back()
  } else S_INPUT_PAY.result_flag = 0, S_INPUT_PAY.result_count++, ServerConnection.get_Xsolla_result_to_code(), S_INPUT_PAY.result_timer != null && (clearInterval(S_INPUT_PAY.result_timer), S_INPUT_PAY.result_timer = null), g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_INPUT_PAY && (S_INPUT_PAY.result_timer = setTimeout(S_INPUT_PAY.result_check, S_INPUT_PAY.again_result_time))
};
