S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var r = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    i;
  switch (r) {
    case KeyDefine.up:
      if (S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.row_focus == 2) {
        S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.row_focus = 1;
        S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus >= 21 && (S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus = S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus - 20, S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      if (S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.row_focus == 2) return;
      S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus <= 176 ? (S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus = S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus + 20, S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.drawFocus()) : (S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.row_focus = 2, S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.row_focus == 2) {
        S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.btn_focus = 1;
        S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus >= 2 && (S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus--, S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.row_focus == 2) {
        S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.btn_focus = 2;
        S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus < S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.max_country_num && (S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus++, S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      i = document.getElementById("S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING_div");
      $("#Txt_MM_top_gold").text(i);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      i = document.getElementById("div_body");
      $("#Txt_MM_top_gold").text(i);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
      alert(document.body.innerHTML)
  }
};
S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.back = function() {

  Main.showSafeZone()
};

    "-o-transform": "scale(1.0,1.0)",
    "-moz-transform": "scale(1.0,1.0)",
    position: "absolute"
  });
  S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.drawFocus()
};
S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.drawFocus = function() {
  if (g.blink.value = 1, S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.row_focus == 1) {
    $("#PCS_country_text").text(TXT.change_country[S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus]);
    var n = S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus % 20,
      t = Math.floor(S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus / 20);
    n == 0 && (n = 20, t--);
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("PCS_country_focus", glo.img_url + "image/ui/18_popup_country_setting/st_flag_f.png", 29 + (n - 1) * 55, 138 + t * 42);
    $("#PCS_btn1").css({
      color: "white"
    });
    $("#PCS_btn2").css({
      color: "white"
    });
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("PCS_btn_focus", "", 381, 571)
  } else $("#PCS_country_text").text(TXT.change_country[S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.select_focus]), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("PCS_country_focus", "", 0, 0), S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.btn_focus == 1 ? ($("#PCS_btn1").css({
    color: "yellow"
  }), $("#PCS_btn2").css({
    color: "white"
  }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("PCS_btn_focus", glo.img_url + "image/ui/18_popup_country_setting/ga_sbt_focus.png", 381, 571)) : ($("#PCS_btn1").css({
    color: "white"
  }), $("#PCS_btn2").css({
    color: "yellow"
  }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("PCS_btn_focus", glo.img_url + "image/ui/18_popup_country_setting/ga_sbt_focus.png", 586, 571))
};
S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.menuRun = function() {
  if (gEnableKey = 0, sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT), S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.row_focus == 1) S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.menuRun_Run();
  else {
    switch (S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.btn_focus) {
      case 1:
        utilScale_xy_center("PCS_btn1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
        utilScale_xy_center("PCS_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
        break;
      case 2:
        utilScale_xy_center("PCS_btn2", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
        utilScale_xy_center("PCS_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
    }
    setTimeout(function() {
      utilScale_xy_center("PCS_btn1", 1, 1);
      utilScale_xy_center("PCS_btn2", 1, 1);
      utilScale_xy_center("PCS_btn_focus", 1, 1);
      setTimeout(function() {
        S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.menuRun_Run()
      }, gKeyUpTime)
    }, gKeyPressTime)
  }
};
S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (Main.showSafeZone(), S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.row_focus == 1)
    if (gEnableKey = 1, S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.select_focus = S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus, USER.country == S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.country_img_name[S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus]) utilNotice(TXT.country_overlap, 2);
    else {
      S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.select_focus = S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus;
      var n = S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus % 20,
        t = Math.floor(S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus / 20);
      n == 0 && (n = 20, t--);
      utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("PCS_country_select_focus", glo.img_url + "image/ui/18_popup_country_setting/st_flag_select.png", 37 + (n - 1) * 55, 128 + t * 42);
      S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.row_focus = 2;
      S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.btn_focus = 1;
      S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.drawFocus()
    }
  else switch (S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.btn_focus) {
    case 1:
      gEnableKey = 1;
      USER.country == S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.country_img_name[S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.select_focus] ? utilNotice(TXT.country_overlap, 2) : ($("#PCS_btn_focus").css({
        display: "none"
      }), utilPush(), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
        display: "block"
      }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN));
      break;
    case 2:
      gEnableKey = 1;
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : (S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.row_focus = 1, S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.back())
  }
};

  S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.removeMouseEvent()

S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.yes = function() {
  var n, t;
  gEnableKey = 1;
  USER.change_country_check == 1 ? (loading_show("국기변경", 1), n = S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.country_img_name[S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.select_focus], t = "국기변경(" + USER.country + ">" + n + ")|RUBY|0|" + USER.ruby, insert_change_contry(USER.country, n, t, function() {
    loading_hide("국기변경", 1);
    S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.back();
    S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.row_focus = 1
  }), USER.change_country_check = -1, USER.country = STORAGE.data1.country = S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.country_img_name[S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.select_focus], S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top(), utilNotice(TXT.country_change_finish, 2)) : USER.ruby >= S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.need_ruby ? (USER.ruby = USER.ruby - S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.need_ruby, loading_show("국기변경", 1), n = S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.country_img_name[S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.select_focus], t = "국기변경(" + USER.country + ">" + n + ")|RUBY|" + -S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.need_ruby + "|" + USER.ruby, insert_change_contry(USER.country, n, t, function() {
    loading_hide("국기변경", 1);
    S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.back();
    S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.row_focus = 1
  }), save_UserInfo_after_pay_to_server("-" + S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.need_ruby, "국기변경"), USER.change_country_check = -1, USER.country = STORAGE.data1.country = S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.country_img_name[S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.select_focus], S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top(), utilNotice(TXT.country_change_finish, 2)) : ($("#PCS_btn_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }), utilNotice(TXT.ruby_lack, 2))

S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)
};
S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.menuRun()
  }
};
S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.onMouseover = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog("1-onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  for (var t = 1; t <= S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.max_country_num; t++) n.target.id == "PCS_country_img" + t && (S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.row_focus = 1, S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.focus = t, S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.drawFocus(), t = S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.max_country_num);
  switch (n.target.id) {
    case "PCS_btn1":
      S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.row_focus = 2;
      S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.btn_focus = 1;
      S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "PCS_btn2":
      S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.row_focus = 2;
      S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.btn_focus = 2;
      S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "PCS_btn_focus":
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog(" please id check  onMouseover==>1-onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id)
  }
};
S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.onMouseover(n)
};
S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.onMouseover(n);
  S_POPUP_COUNTRY_SETTING.onClick(n)
};

S_BILLING_HISTORY.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.up:
      if (S_BILLING_HISTORY.curPage == 1) return;
      S_BILLING_HISTORY.curPage--;
      S_BILLING_HISTORY.makeTable();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      if (S_BILLING_HISTORY.curPage == S_BILLING_HISTORY.totalPage) return;
      S_BILLING_HISTORY.curPage++;
      S_BILLING_HISTORY.makeTable();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_BILLING_HISTORY.back()
  }
};
S_BILLING_HISTORY.back = function() {
  S_BILLING_HISTORY.cleanup();
  utilConsoleLog("S_BILLING_HISTORY.back ():" + g_sceneinfo.before_scene);
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.HCN ? $("#Img_ST_card_focus_5").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : $("#Img_ST_card_focus_" + S_MAINMENU.focus).css({
    display: "none"
  });
  Main.showSafeZone();
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MAINMENU;
  S_MAINMENU.resume();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)
};

S_BILLING_HISTORY.moveScrollBar = function() {
  var t = S_BILLING_HISTORY.curPage,
    n = S_BILLING_HISTORY.totalPage,
    i = S_BILLING_HISTORY.oScroll.height,
    r = S_BILLING_HISTORY.oScroll.barTop;
  if (n == 1) {
    S_BILLING_HISTORY.hideScroll();
    S_BILLING_HISTORY.$ElArray._page.text(t + " / " + n);
    return
  }
  scrollbarHeight = i / n;
  scrollbarTop = r + scrollbarHeight * (t - 1);
  S_BILLING_HISTORY.$ElArray._scroll_bar.css({
    position: "absolute",
    top: scrollbarTop + "px",
    height: scrollbarHeight + "px"
  });
  utilConsoleLog("moveScrollBar scrollbarHeight: " + scrollbarHeight + "    scrollbarTop:" + scrollbarTop);
  S_BILLING_HISTORY.$ElArray._page.text(t + " / " + n);
  S_BILLING_HISTORY.showScroll()
};
S_BILLING_HISTORY.makeTable = function() {
  var i, t, n, r;
  if (i = gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.HCN ? '<table class="tg" style="undefined;table-layout: fixed; width: 910px" ><tr><th class="tg-bhth">결제일시<\/th><th class="tg-bhth">상품명<\/th><th class="tg-bhth">결제금액(부가세 별도)<\/th><\/tr>' : '<table class="tg" style="undefined;table-layout: fixed; width: 876px" ><tr><th class="tg-bhth">결제일시<\/th><th class="tg-bhth">상품명<\/th><th class="tg-bhth">결제금액<\/th><\/tr>', S_BILLING_HISTORY.aBHistory != null) {
    var u = S_BILLING_HISTORY.aBHistory,
      o = u.length,
      f = "",
      e = 9 * (S_BILLING_HISTORY.curPage - 1),
      s = e + 9;
    for (t = e; t < s; t++) t < o && (n = u[t].split(";"), n[2] && /^[0-9]+$/.test(n[2]) && (n[2] = utilGetNumber_withComma(n[2])), f = '<tr><td class="tg-bhtd">' + n[0] + '<\/td><td class="tg-bhtd">' + n[1] + '<\/td><td class="tg-bhtd">' + n[2] + "<\/td><\/tr>", i += f)
  }
  i += "<\/table>";
  S_BILLING_HISTORY.$ElArray._history_table.html(i);
  r = S_BILLING_HISTORY.$ElArray._history_table;

  else if (n == -99) S_BILLING_HISTORY.$ElArray._tip.text("네트워크 에러가 발생하였습니다");
  else {
    S_BILLING_HISTORY.$ElArray._tip.text("결제내역은 결제한 날부터 90일간 보관됩니다");

    S_BILLING_HISTORY.totalPage = parseInt((S_BILLING_HISTORY.aBHistory.length - 1) / 9 + 1);

      S_BILLING_HISTORY.drawFocus();
      break;
    case S_BILLING_HISTORY.$ElArray._btn2[0].id:
      S_BILLING_HISTORY.focus = 2;

      break;

  }

S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var t = key == null ? n.keyCode : key;
  switch (t) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT.focus--;
      S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT.focus < 1 && (S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT.focus = 1);
      S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT.focus++;
      S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT.focus > S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT.btn_max && (S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT.focus = S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT.btn_max);
      S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT.back()
  }
};
S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT.back = function() {
  Main.showSafeZone();
  S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT.end();
  utilConsoleLog("S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT.back ():" + g_sceneinfo.before_scene);
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = g_sceneinfo.before_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = S_POPUP_DAYDUNGEON_DISCOUNT;
  S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.resume()
};

S_ERROR_NETWORK.back = function() {

  if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT) try {
      util_kt.destroyApplication();
      gEnableKey = 0
    } catch (r) {} else if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR) window[g_sceneinfo.cur_scene].resume(), S_ERROR_NETWORK.cleanup(), utilConsoleLog("S_ERROR_NETWORK.back ():" + g_sceneinfo.before_scene), g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_LOGO || g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_GONGJI || g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_ATTENDANCE || g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_SYNOPSIS ?     else if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV) {
    if (S_ERROR_NETWORK.reload_on_back == 1) {
      S_ERROR_NETWORK.reload_on_back = 0;
      gEnableKey = 0;
      setTimeout(function() {
        location.reload(!0)
      }, 0);
      return
    }
    if (gHISTORY.length >= 2) {
      for (n = gHISTORY.length, t = 1; t <= n - 1; t++) gHISTORY.pop();
      i = (n - 1) * -1;
      utilConsoleLog("------history.go(" + i + ")------in setting");
      S_SETTING.flag_init = 1;
      gEnableKey = 1;
      history.go(i)
    } else history.go(0)
  }

    utilScale_xy_center(S_ERROR_NETWORK.$ElArray._btn_focus.id, 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      if (gEnableKey = 1, glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) try {
        Main.use_android_bridge() && android_bridge.finish()
      } catch (n) {} else ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, g_sceneinfo.before_scene, ChangeScene._oBeforeScene, 1)
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};

S_ERROR_NETWORK.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").click(this.onClick).mouseover(this.onMouseover).mouseout(this.onMouseout)
};
S_ERROR_NETWORK.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("click").unbind("mouseover").unbind("mouseout")
};
S_ERROR_NETWORK.onClick = function() {
  gEnableKey != 0 && (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV ? S_ERROR_NETWORK.back() : S_ERROR_NETWORK.menuRun())
};
S_ERROR_NETWORK.onMouseover = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog("1-onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  switch (n.target.id) {
    case S_ERROR_NETWORK.$ElArray._btn1.id:
      S_ERROR_NETWORK.focus = 1;
      S_ERROR_NETWORK.drawFocus();
      return;
    case S_ERROR_NETWORK.$ElArray._btn_focus.id:
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog(" please id check  onMouseover==>1-onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id)
  }
};
S_ERROR_NETWORK.onMouseout = function() {};
S_ERROR_NETWORK.onMousemove = function() {};
S_ERROR_NETWORK.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_ERROR_NETWORK.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_ERROR_NETWORK.onMouseover(n);
  S_ERROR_NETWORK.onClick(n);
  return
};

    i;
  S_EVENT.flag_1 == 1 && (n = "Click  a Web Indexing in the settings screen to opt-out.", t = "Welcome to El Dorado!\nTo play for free and get 100 rubies(first time once)");
  i = {
    agree_btn: "I_AGREE",
    disagree_btn: "I_DISAGREE",

    app_logo: "icon/icon_130x130.png",
    benefit: t,
    repeat_consent: 3,
    skip_consent: !0,
    on_status_change: S_BRDOPT.on_status_change,
    on_dialog_shown: function() {
      console.log("dialog shown");
      g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
      g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_BRDOPT;
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR && Main.remove_keydown_event_listener()
    },
    on_dialog_closed: function() {
      var n = S_BRDOPT.update_status();
      console.log("dialog closed   status:" + n.consent);
      S_BRDOPT.step = "on_dialog_closed";
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR && Main.add_keydown_event_listener()
    },
    iframe: !1
  };
  try {
    brd_api.init(i, {
      on_failure: function(n) {
        console.log("init failure. Error: ", n)
      },
      on_success: function() {
        console.log("init success")
      }
    })
  } catch (r) {
    console.error(r)
  }
};
S_BRDOPT.on_status_change = function() {
  console.log("status changed");
  var n = S_BRDOPT.update_status();
  n && S_BRDOPT.update_interface(n)
};
S_BRDOPT.step_enable = function() {
  brd_api.show_consent({
    on_failure: function() {
      console.log("show_consent failure")
    },
    on_success: function() {
      console.log("show_consent success")
    }
  })
};
S_BRDOPT.step_disable = function() {
  brd_api.opt_out({
    on_failure: function() {
      console.log("opt_out failure")
    },
    on_success: function() {
      console.log("opt_out success");
      S_BRDOPT.step = "opt_out"
    }
  })
};
S_BRDOPT.update_status = function() {
  if (!brd_api.get_status) {
    console.error("api not initilized");
    return
  }
  var n = brd_api.get_status();
  return console.log("update_status:" + n), n.value || n
};
S_BRDOPT.get_status = function() {
  if (gEntrix.host_id === "ElDorado_2254282") return !0;
  if (!brd_api.get_status) return console.error("api not initilized"), S_EVENT.flag_1 == 1 && utilNotice(TXT.brd_api_error, 3), !1;
  var n = S_BRDOPT.update_status();
  return n.consent == !0 ? !0 : !1
};
S_BRDOPT.update_interface = function(n) {
  n.consent ? (console.log("opt-in 했음"), S_BRDOPT.remote_cb = S_BRDOPT.step_disable) : (console.log("opt-out 했음"), S_BRDOPT.remote_cb = S_BRDOPT.step_enable);
  S_BRDOPT.show_status(n)
};
S_BRDOPT.show_status = function(n) {
  console.log("show_status consent:" + n.consent);
  console.log("show_status ver:" + n.ver);
  console.log("show_status uuid:" + n.uuid);
  console.log("show_status S_BRDOPT.step:" + S_BRDOPT.step);
  S_BRDOPT.step == "on_dialog_closed" ? (S_BRDOPT.back(g_sceneinfo.before_scene), S_BRDOPT.step = "", n.consent && (S_BRDOPT.opt_in_count == 0, S_BRDOPT.opt_in_count++, S_BRDGUIDE.change_scene(1), update_user_to_server("BrightSDK-opt-in", "opt-in"))) : S_BRDOPT.step == "opt_out" && (S_BRDOPT.back(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene), S_BRDOPT.step = "", S_BRDGUIDE.change_scene(1), update_user_to_server("BrightSDK-opt-out", "opt-out"))
};

S_BRDGUIDE.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + i + " in S_BRDGUIDE.keyDown()");
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? S_BRDGUIDE.back() : S_BRDGUIDE.back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_BRDGUIDE.focus >= 2 && (S_BRDGUIDE.focus = 1, S_BRDGUIDE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_BRDGUIDE.focus <= 1 && (S_BRDGUIDE.focus = 2, S_BRDGUIDE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_BRDGUIDE.menuRun()
  }
};

S_BRDGUIDE.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  utilScale_xy_center("BRDGUIDE_btn_" + S_BRDGUIDE.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("BRDGUIDE_btn_" + S_BRDGUIDE.focus, 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      S_BRDGUIDE.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_BRDGUIDE.menuRun_Run = function() {
  console.log(" S_BRDGUIDE.menuRun_Run called focus:" + S_BRDGUIDE.focus);
  console.log(" S_BRDGUIDE.menuRun_Run called result_type:" + S_BRDGUIDE.result_type);
  S_BRDGUIDE.result_type == 1 ? gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? (gEnableKey = 1, S_BRDGUIDE.back()) : S_BRDGUIDE.back() : S_BRDGUIDE.focus == 1 ? };

  return 0

S_EVENT.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_EVENT.focus >= 2 && (S_EVENT.focus = 1, S_EVENT.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_EVENT.focus <= 1 && (S_EVENT.focus = 2, S_EVENT.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_EVENT.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_EVENT.back()
  }
};
S_EVENT.back = function() {
  S_EVENT.end();
  S_EVENT.removeMouseEvent();
  $("#S_EVENT_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  utilConsoleLog("S_EVENT.back ():" + g_sceneinfo.before_scene);
  switch (S_EVENT.backup_scene) {
    case gS_MAINMENU:
      S_MAINMENU.remount_mm_top(S_MAINMENU, TXT.selectmap);
      g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MAINMENU;
      S_MAINMENU.addMouseEvent();
      S_MAINMENU.resume();
      break;
    case gS_MARKETSTORE:
      S_MAINMENU.remount_mm_top(S_MARKETSTORE, TXT.package_store);
      g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MARKETSTORE;
      S_MARKETSTORE.addMouseEvent();
      S_MARKETSTORE.focus = 1;
      S_MARKETSTORE.drawFocus();
      break;
    case gS_PACKAGE_STORE:
      S_MAINMENU.remount_mm_top(S_PACKAGE_STORE, TXT.package_store);
      g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_PACKAGE_STORE;
      S_PACKAGE_STORE.resume()
  }
  gEnableKey = 1;
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && Main.displaySafeZone()
};

  S_EVENT.status == 1 || S_EVENT.status == 2 ? S_EVENT.make_screen_status_1_2() : S_EVENT.status == 3 && S_EVENT.make_screen_status_3();
  S_EVENT.drawFocus()
};

S_EVENT.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  switch (S_EVENT.focus) {
    case 1:
      utilScale_xy_center("EV_btn1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("EV_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 2:
      utilScale_xy_center("EV_btn2", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("EV_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("EV_btn1", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("EV_btn2", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("EV_btn_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      S_EVENT.menuRun_Run()
    }, window.g.keyUPTime)
  }, window.g.keyPressTime)
};
S_EVENT.menuRun_Run = function() {
  switch (S_EVENT.focus) {
    case 1:
      S_EVENT.status == 1 || S_EVENT.status == 2 ? S_EVENT.menuRun_Run_status_1_2() : S_EVENT.status == 3 && S_EVENT.menuRun_Run_status_3();
      break;
    case 2:
      S_EVENT.back()
  }
};
S_EVENT.menuRun_Run_status_1_2 = function() {
  if (glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gEntrix.host_id.substring(0, 5) == "TEMP_") {
    USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("로그인 후 이용할수 있습니다.", 2) : utilNotice("Available after logging in.", 2);
    return
  }
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? (S_PACKAGE_STORE.focus_arr = [0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1], S_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_focus = 4, S_MARKETSTORE.define(), gEnableKey = 1, utilConsoleLog("구매 선택"), S_EVENT.removeMouseEvent(), $("#S_EVENT_div").empty(), S_PACKAGE_STORE.change_scene_input_pay()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.KT ? S_EVENT.status == 1 ? S_MARKETSTORE.focus = 7 : S_EVENT.status == 2 && (S_MARKETSTORE.focus = 8) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && (S_EVENT.status == 1 ? S_MARKETSTORE.focus = 8 : S_EVENT.status == 2 && (S_MARKETSTORE.focus = 10)), S_MARKETSTORE.define(), gEnableKey = 1, utilConsoleLog("구매 선택"), S_PACKAGE_STORE.change_scene_payment_cnm())
};
S_EVENT.menuRun_Run_status_3 = function() {
  var n = S_EVENT.ONE_CHANCE_STEP_INFO[S_EVENT.one_chance_step],
    t;
  if (!n || S_EVENT.one_chance_step > 1 && !S_EVENT.is_one_chance_next_enable()) {
    utilNotice(TXT.one_chance_already_purchased, 2.5);
    gEnableKey = 1;
    return
  }
  if (t = n.p_id, typeof S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO != "undefined" && S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.isConnected() && glo.fun.is_korea_platform(S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.info.platform)) {
    utilNoticeUpper(TXT.payment_fail_mobile_connect, 2);
    gEnableKey = 1;
    return
  }
  if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) S_PACKAGE_STORE.change_scene_payment_cnm();
  else if (glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) try {
    if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB) {
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_PAYMENT_CNM, S_PAYMENT_CNM);
      return
    }
    Main.use_android_bridge() ? (android_bridge.show_progress_dialog(), android_bridge.request_payment(t)) : S_PACKAGE_STORE.payment_cancel("10")
  } catch (i) {
    S_PACKAGE_STORE.payment_cancel("11")
  } else gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? glo.package.toss_purchase_order() : S_PACKAGE_STORE.change_scene_input_pay()
};
S_EVENT.ok_payment = function() {
  var u;
  if (S_EVENT.flag_1 = S_EVENT.flag_2 = 0, gEnableKey = 0, S_EVENT.status == 3) {
    S_EVENT.ok_payment_one_chance();
    return
  }
  var n = 0,
    i = 0,
    r = 0,
    t = "";
  if (S_EVENT.status == 1) n = 100, i = 0, r = 0, t = "첫구매 이벤트";
  else if (S_EVENT.status == 2) n = 150, i = 0, r = 0, t = "재구매 이벤트";
  else {
    utilConsoleLog("Error in S_EVENT.ok_payment():" + S_EVENT.status);
    return
  }
  log_ping_back_to_server(t, MARKET_DESIGN.ROW2[S_MARKETSTORE.focus - 5].won, USER.ruby, USER.ruby + n);
  S_MAINMENU.make_screen_top_add_ruby(n, !0);
  loading_show("이벤트", 1);
  u = "현질성공:루비(" + n + "개):현금(" + MARKET_DESIGN.ROW2[S_MARKETSTORE.focus - 5].won + "원):" + t + "|RUBY|" + n + "|" + USER.ruby;
  STORAGE.save_all_info_to_storage(u, 0, "ruby", function() {
    loading_hide("이벤트", 1);
    blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)
  });
  save_UserInfo_after_pay_to_server(n, "현질(" + t + ")");
  S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top();
  QUEST.f9_charge()
};
S_EVENT.ok_payment_one_chance = function() {
  var t = S_EVENT.one_chance_step,
    i = S_EVENT.ONE_CHANCE_STEP_INFO[t],
    n, r, u;
  i && (t == 1 && (n = 60, STORAGE.data1.upgrade[1] < n && (STORAGE.data1.upgrade[1] = n), STORAGE.data1.upgrade[2] < n && (STORAGE.data1.upgrade[2] = n)), S_EVENT.set_one_chance_count(t, 1), r = "BPA_" + glo.fun.make_uniq_id(), glo.package.set_payment_code(r), u = {
    ORDER_ID: "",
    TOKEN: "",
    SUB_ID: i.sub_id,
    ETC: S_EVENT.get_one_chance_package_name(t),
    CHAR_REWARD: "",
    MODE: i.mode,
    GOODS_ID: "",
    REF_ID: "",
    PAYMENT_CODE: r
  }, ServerConnection.package_shop(u, function(n) {
    utilConsoleLog("one_chance ok_payment package_shop result:" + (n && n.STATE));
    S_EVENT.refresh_mailbox_after_one_chance()
  }), QUEST.f9_charge())
};
S_EVENT.is_first_buy = function() {
  return glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? !1 : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && glo.fun.get_value_pay_total_this_month() > 0 ? !1 : S_EVENT.flag_1 == 1 ? !0 : !1
};
S_EVENT.is_re_buy = function() {
  return glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? !1 : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && glo.fun.get_value_pay_total_this_month() >= window.g.MONTH_MAX_PAYMENT - 1e4 ? !1 : S_EVENT.flag_2 == 1 ? !0 : !1
};
S_EVENT.end = function() {
  S_EVENT.removeMouseEvent();
  $("#S_EVENT_div").empty();
  S_EVENT.status = 0
};
S_EVENT.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").click(this.onClick).mouseover(this.onMouseover)
};
S_EVENT.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("click").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_EVENT.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } S_EVENT.menuRun()
  }
};
S_EVENT.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("btn1") >= 0 ? S_EVENT.focus = 1 : t.id.search("btn2") >= 0 && (S_EVENT.focus = 2);
    S_EVENT.drawFocus()
  }
};

S_SELECTMAP.set_maxfocus = function() {
  S_SELECTMAP.maxfocus = STORAGE.get_maxmap();
  S_SELECTMAP.page = S_SELECTMAP.maxfocus <= 5 ? 1 : S_SELECTMAP.maxfocus <= 10 ? 2 : S_SELECTMAP.stage201_in_check() == !1 ? 2 : 3
};
S_SELECTMAP.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  utilConsoleLog("S_SELECTMAP.keyDown  keyCode:" + i);
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_SELECTMAP.focus >= 2 && S_SELECTMAP.focus <= SELECTMAP_NUM && (S_SELECTMAP.focus = S_SELECTMAP.focus - 1, S_SELECTMAP.focus == 5 ? (S_SELECTMAP.scroll_cur_x = -1280, S_SELECTMAP.scroll_target_x = 0, $("#Img_SM_focus_6").css({
        display: "none"
      }), select_map.draw_left_arrow_f(), gEnableKey = 0, setTimeout(function() {
        (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && (S_SELECTMAP.opacity = 1);
        S_SELECTMAP.scroll_right();
        S_SELECTMAP.page = 1;
        S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus()
      }, 300)) : S_SELECTMAP.focus == 10 ? (S_SELECTMAP.scroll_cur_x = -2560, S_SELECTMAP.scroll_target_x = -1280, $("#Img_SM_focus_11").css({
        display: "none"
      }), select_map.draw_left_arrow_f(), gEnableKey = 0, setTimeout(function() {
        S_SELECTMAP.scroll_right();
        S_SELECTMAP.page = 2;
        S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus()
      }, 300)) : S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus());
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? S_SELECTMAP.focus == S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM && S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus() : S_SELECTMAP.focus == S_SELECTMAP.PREV_BTN_NUM ? S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus() : S_SELECTMAP.focus == S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM && (S_SELECTMAP.focus--, S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_SELECTMAP.focus < S_SELECTMAP.maxfocus) {
        if (S_SELECTMAP.focus == 10 && S_SELECTMAP.stage201_in_check() == !1) return;
        S_SELECTMAP.focus = S_SELECTMAP.focus + 1;
        S_SELECTMAP.focus == 6 ? (S_SELECTMAP.scroll_cur_x = 0, S_SELECTMAP.scroll_target_x = -1280, $("#Img_SM_focus_5").css({
          display: "none"
        }), select_map.draw_right_arrow_f(), gEnableKey = 0, setTimeout(function() {
          (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && (S_SELECTMAP.opacity = 0);
          S_SELECTMAP.scroll_left();
          S_SELECTMAP.page = 2;
          S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus()
        }, 300)) : S_SELECTMAP.focus == 11 ? (S_SELECTMAP.scroll_cur_x = -1280, S_SELECTMAP.scroll_target_x = -2560, $("#Img_SM_focus_10").css({
          display: "none"
        }), select_map.draw_right_arrow_f(), gEnableKey = 0, setTimeout(function() {
          S_SELECTMAP.scroll_left();
          S_SELECTMAP.page = 3;
          S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus()
        }, 300)) : S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus()
      }
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? S_SELECTMAP.focus == S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM && S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus() : S_SELECTMAP.focus == S_SELECTMAP.PREV_BTN_NUM ? (S_SELECTMAP.focus++, S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus()) : S_SELECTMAP.focus == S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM && S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      switch (S_SELECTMAP.focus) {
        case 1:
        case 2:
        case 3:
        case 4:
        case 5:
        case 6:
        case 7:
        case 8:
        case 9:
        case 10:
        case 11:
        case 12:
        case 13:
        case 14:
        case 15:
          S_SELECTMAP.backup_focus = S_SELECTMAP.focus;
          S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus();
          break;
        case S_SELECTMAP.PREV_BTN_NUM:
        case S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM:
          S_SELECTMAP.backup_focus_down = S_SELECTMAP.focus;
          S_SELECTMAP.focus = S_SELECTMAP.backup_focus;
          S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus()
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      switch (S_SELECTMAP.focus) {
        case 1:
        case 2:
        case 3:
        case 4:
        case 5:
        case 6:
        case 7:
        case 8:
        case 9:
        case 10:
        case 11:
        case 12:
        case 13:
        case 14:
        case 15:
          S_SELECTMAP.backup_focus = S_SELECTMAP.focus;
          S_SELECTMAP.focus = S_SELECTMAP.backup_focus_down;
          S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus()
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_SELECTMAP.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_SELECTMAP.run_back()
  }
};

  S_SELECTMAP.page != 3 && (S_SELECTMAP.page == 1 ? $("#Img_SM_background2").css({
    opacity: "0"
  }) : $("#Img_SM_background2").css({
    opacity: "1"
  }))
};

    display: "none"
  }), $("#S_SELECTMAP_HARD_div").length > 0 && $("#S_SELECTMAP_HARD_div").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#S_MODE_SELECT_div").css({
    display: "block"
  }), S_MODE_SELECT.init())
};

  }), select_map.draw_right_arrow()) : $("#Img_SM_rightarrow").css({

  })) : S_SELECTMAP.page == 3 ? ($("#Img_SM_leftarrow").css({

  }), select_map.draw_left_arrow(), $("#Img_SM_rightarrow").css({

  })) : $("#Img_SM_leftarrow").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_SELECTMAP.page == 1 && S_SELECTMAP.maxfocus > 5 ? ($("#Img_SM_rightarrow").css({

  }), select_map.draw_right_arrow()) : S_SELECTMAP.page == 2 && S_SELECTMAP.stage201_in_check() ? MAX_STAGE_NUM > 200 ? ($("#Img_SM_rightarrow").css({
    display: "block"
  }), select_map.draw_right_arrow()) : $("#Img_SM_rightarrow").css({
    display: "none"
  }) : $("#Img_SM_rightarrow").css({
    display: "none"
  })
};
S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus = function() {
  var t, n;
  if (!(S_SELECTMAP.focus <= SELECTMAP_NUM) || !(S_SELECTMAP.maxfocus < S_SELECTMAP.focus)) {
    for (utilConsoleLog("S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus  focus:" + S_SELECTMAP.focus), t = 10, gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? t = 5 : (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && (t = 12), window.g.blink.value = 1, S_SELECTMAP.focus_none_all(), S_SELECTMAP.drawArrow(), n = 1; n <= SELECTMAP_NUM; n++) $("#SM_map_" + n).css({
      "z-index": "0"
    }), S_SELECTMAP.focus == n && ($("#SM_map_" + n).css({
      "z-index": "2"
    }), $("#Img_SM_focus_" + n).css({
      display: "block"
    }), n <= 15 && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_SM_focus_" + n, glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("ANGRY_PLANET") + "image/ui/2_selectmap/sm_map" + n + "_focus.png", SELECTMAP[n].fx, SELECTMAP[n].fy));

      $("#Img_SM_bottom_bt" + S_SELECTMAP.focus + "_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      })
    } catch (i) {
      utilConsoleLog("S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus error:" + i)
    }
    S_SELECTMAP.update_story_package_img()
  }
};

    })
  } catch (t) {

  }
};

  n == "remove" ? ($("#Img_SM_background").remove(), $("#Img_SM_mode_div").remove(), $("#S_ATTENDANCE_div").after('<div id="S_SELECTMAP_div"><\/div>')) : ($("#Img_SM_background").length && $("#Img_SM_background").css({
    display: n
  }), $("#Img_SM_mode_div").length && $("#Img_SM_mode_div").css({
    display: n
  }));
  n == "none" && $("#Img_SM_mode_div").css({
    opacity: 0
  })
};
S_SELECTMAP.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  setTimeout(function() {
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_SELECTMAP.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_SELECTMAP.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_SELECTMAP) {
    utilConsoleLog("마우스가 두번 눌려져서 S_SELECTSTAGE.init()가 두번 불려지는 현상 제거!");
    return
  }
  if (S_SELECTMAP.focus >= 1 && S_SELECTMAP.focus <= 6 && gVALIDATE == 0) {
    var n;
    switch (gAPP_INFO.APP_NAME) {
      case "ELDORADO_LG_TV_RnD":
        n = TXT.validate_over_lgrnd;
        break;
      case "ELDORADO_ENTRIX_test":
        n = TXT.validate_over_entrix;
        break;
      default:
        n = TXT.validate_over
    }
    utilNotice3(n, 5);
    return
  }
  switch (S_SELECTMAP.focus) {
    case 1:
    case 2:
    case 3:
    case 4:
    case 5:
    case 6:
    case 7:
    case 8:
    case 9:
    case 10:
    case 11:
    case 12:
    case 13:
    case 14:
    case 15:
      if (S_SELECTMAP.focus >= 11 && S_SELECTMAP.stage201_in_check_jewel() == !1) {
        USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("보석을 모두 수집하여야 도전가능합니다", 2) : utilNotice("You must collect all the jewels before you can enter.", 2);
        return
      }
      utilPush();
      S_SELECTMAP.removeMouseEvent();
      S_GAME.ranking_mode = 0;
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_SELECTSTAGE, S_SELECTSTAGE) : ($("#S_SELECTMAP_div").css({
        display: "none"
      }), $("#S_SELECTSTAGE_div").css({
        display: "block"
      }), S_SELECTSTAGE.init());
      S_SELECTMAP.set_background_display("none");
      break;
    case S_SELECTMAP.PREV_BTN_NUM:
      S_SELECTMAP.run_back();
      break;
    case S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM:
      utilPush();
      S_SELECTMAP.removeMouseEvent();
      S_SELECTMAP.mode_change("hard");
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("error!! in S_SELECTMAP.menuRun()")
  }
  gEnableKey = 1
};
S_SELECTMAP.boss_start = function(n) {
  console.log("월드보스 S_SELECTMAP.boss_start gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey);
  switch (n) {
    case "play":
      ServerConnection.get_boss_num_to_server(S_SELECTMAP.boss_game_start);
      break;
    case "noplay":
      BOSS_GOIN_FLAG < 0 ? USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("보스전에 입장할수 없습니다.", 2.5) : utilNotice("You can not enter World Boss.", 2.5) : utilNotice(TXT.boss_timelimit, 2.5);
      gEnableKey = 1;
      return
  }
};
S_SELECTMAP.boss_game_start = function(n) {
  console.log("월드보스 S_SELECTMAP.boss_game_start gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey);
  S_BOSS.stage = parseInt(n);
  BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp = -1;
  ServerConnection.boss_cur_hp(S_BOSS.stage);
  var t = function() {
    BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp != -1 ? (console.log("월드보스 S_SELECTMAP.boss_game_start S_RANKING_BOSS 진입  gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey), loading_hide(), utilPush(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_RANKING_BOSS, S_RANKING_BOSS)) : setTimeout(t, 100)
  };
  t()
};
mode_change_flag = !0;
S_SELECTMAP.mode_change = function(n) {
  function r(n, t) {
    var i = $(n);
    i.length && (i.css({
      "will-change": "opacity",
      "pointer-events": "none"
    }), i.css({
      transition: "opacity " + t + "s linear",
      "-webkit-transition": "opacity " + t + "s linear"
    }), i.get(0).offsetWidth, i.css("opacity", 0))
  }

  function l(n, t) {
    var i = 0,
      r = !1;
    return function() {
      if (!r && (i++, i >= n)) {
        r = !0;
        try {
          t()
        } catch (u) {}
      }
    }
  }
  var t, i;
  if (mode_change_flag != !1) {
    mode_change_flag = !1;
    var u = n == "normal" ? "image/ui/25_hardmode/hardmode_stage.jpg" : "image/ui/2_selectmap/sm_bg.jpg",
      f = n == "normal" ? "image/ui/2_selectmap/sm_bg.jpg" : "image/ui/25_hardmode/hardmode_stage.jpg",
      e = n == "normal" ? "image/ui/25_hardmode/sm_hard.png" : "image/ui/2_selectmap/sm_normal.png",
      o = n == "normal" ? "image/ui/2_selectmap/sm_normal.png" : "image/ui/25_hardmode/sm_hard.png",
      s = n == "normal" ? "#00780e" : "#87569b",
      h = n == "normal" ? "#37ac75" : "#9b1c82",
      c = n == "normal" ? 6 : 110;
    t = l(2, function() {
      var t = n == "normal" ? "#SMH_map_section" : "#SM_map_section",
        i = n == "normal" ? "#SMH_bottom_bt_section" : "#SM_bottom_bt_section";
      $(t).css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $(i).css({
        display: "none"
      });
      mode_change_flag = !0;
      n == "normal" ? (S_GAME.ranking_mode = 0, $("#S_SELECTMAP_HARD_div").empty(), glo.APP_FEATURE.SAFE_ZEON && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("SafeZone", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url_only_glo() + "image/ui/0_common/co_border.jpg", 0, 0), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_SELECTMAP, S_SELECTMAP)) : (S_GAME.ranking_mode = 5, $("#S_SELECTMAP_div").empty(), document.getElementById("S_SELECTMAP_HARD_div") == null ? $("#S_SELECTMAP_div").after('<div id="S_SELECTMAP_HARD_div"><\/div>') : $("#S_SELECTMAP_HARD_div").empty(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_SELECTMAP_HARD, S_SELECTMAP_HARD))
    });
    i = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + f;
    util_fun_img.crossfade_bg.prime("Img_SM_background", i, {
      width: 1280,
      height: 720
    }, function() {
      var f = .8;
      r(n == "normal" ? "#SMH_map_section" : "#SM_map_section", f);
      r(n == "normal" ? "#SMH_bottom_bt_section" : "#SM_bottom_bt_section", f);
      util_fun_img.mode_switch.animate_name_colors("Txt_SM_mode_normal", s, "Txt_SM_mode_hard", h, {
        duration: 600
      });
      util_fun_img.mode_switch.animate_button_move("Img_SM_mode_bt", null, c, {
        press_scale: .9,
        t_press: 150,
        t_move: 500,
        onDone: t
      });
      util_fun_img.crossfade_bg.start_instant_once("Img_SM_background", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + u, i, {
        fade: f,
        width: 1280,
        height: 720
      });
      util_fun_img.crossfade_bg.start_instant_once("Img_SM_mode_div", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + e, glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + o, {
        fade: f,
        width: 245,
        height: 41,
        progress_pct: 50,
        on_progress: t
      })
    })
  }
};

S_SELECTMAP.scroll_right = function() {
  S_SELECTMAP.top_icon_none();
  S_SELECTMAP.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_SELECTMAP.scroll_right()!!");
  S_SELECTMAP.scroll_cur_x = S_SELECTMAP.scroll_cur_x - S_SELECTMAP.scroll_speed * (S_SELECTMAP.scroll_cur_x - S_SELECTMAP.scroll_target_x);
  $("#SM_map_section").css({
    left: S_SELECTMAP.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_SELECTMAP.scroll_cur_x + 4 < S_SELECTMAP.scroll_target_x && S_SELECTMAP.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_SELECTMAP.scroll_right, 80) : (S_SELECTMAP.scroll_cur_x = S_SELECTMAP.scroll_target_x, S_SELECTMAP.scroll_flag = 0, (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && S_SELECTMAP.drawBg(1), S_SELECTMAP.drawArrow(), gEnableKey = 1)

S_SELECTMAP.stage201_in_check_jewel = function() {
  for (var i = HARD_MODE_JEWEL.split(","), t = 0, n = 1; n <= HARDMODE_JEWEL_NUM; n++)
    if (i[n - 1] == 0) continue;
    else t++;
  return t == 10 ? !0 : !1
};

  $(".button").unbind("mouseover")

S_SELECTMAP.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (utilConsoleLog(" S_SELECTMAP.onClick  e.target.id: " + n.target.id), n.target.id == "Img_SM_leftarrow") {
      if (S_SELECTMAP.scroll_flag == 1) return;
      if (S_SELECTMAP.page == 1) return;
      switch (S_SELECTMAP.page) {
        case 2:
          S_SELECTMAP.focus = 5;
          S_SELECTMAP.scroll_cur_x = -1280;
          S_SELECTMAP.scroll_target_x = 0;
          $("#Img_SM_focus_6").css({
            display: "none"
          });
          break;
        case 3:
          S_SELECTMAP.focus = 10;
          S_SELECTMAP.scroll_cur_x = -2560;
          S_SELECTMAP.scroll_target_x = -1280;
          $("#Img_SM_focus_11").css({
            display: "none"
          })
      }
      select_map.draw_left_arrow_f();
      gEnableKey = 0;
      setTimeout(function() {
        S_SELECTMAP.scroll_right();
        S_SELECTMAP.page > 1 && S_SELECTMAP.page--;
        gEnableKey = 1;
        S_SELECTMAP.update_story_package_img()
      }, 300);
      return
    }
    if (n.target.id == "Img_SM_rightarrow") {
      if (S_SELECTMAP.scroll_flag == 1) return;
      if (S_SELECTMAP.maxfocus <= 5 && S_SELECTMAP.page == 1) return;
      if (S_SELECTMAP.maxfocus <= 10 && S_SELECTMAP.page == 2) return;
      if (S_SELECTMAP.page == 3) return;
      switch (S_SELECTMAP.page) {
        case 1:
          S_SELECTMAP.focus = 6;
          S_SELECTMAP.scroll_cur_x = 0;
          S_SELECTMAP.scroll_target_x = -1280;
          $("#Img_SM_focus_5").css({
            display: "none"
          });
          break;
        case 2:
          S_SELECTMAP.focus = 11;
          S_SELECTMAP.scroll_cur_x = -1280;
          S_SELECTMAP.scroll_target_x = -2560;
          $("#Img_SM_focus_10").css({
            display: "none"
          })
      }
      select_map.draw_right_arrow_f();
      gEnableKey = 0;
      setTimeout(function() {
        S_SELECTMAP.scroll_left();
        S_SELECTMAP.page < 3 && S_SELECTMAP.page++;
        gEnableKey = 1;
        S_SELECTMAP.update_story_package_img()
      }, 300);
      return
    }
    n.target.className.search("map_button") >= 0 && (S_SELECTMAP.focus = glo.fun.get_only_number_by_text(n.target.id));
    n.target.className.search("prev_button") >= 0 ? S_SELECTMAP.focus = S_SELECTMAP.PREV_BTN_NUM : n.target.className.search("mode_button") >= 0 ? S_SELECTMAP.focus = S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM : n.target.className.search("jewel_button") >= 0 && (S_SELECTMAP.focus = S_SELECTMAP.JEWEL_BTN_NUM);
    S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus();
    S_SELECTMAP.menuRun();
    return
  }
};
S_SELECTMAP.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } utilConsoleLog(" S_SELECTMAP.onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
    n.target.className.search("map_button") >= 0 && (S_SELECTMAP.focus = glo.fun.get_only_number_by_text(n.target.id));
    n.target.className.search("prev_button") >= 0 ? S_SELECTMAP.focus = S_SELECTMAP.PREV_BTN_NUM : n.target.className.search("mode_button") >= 0 ? S_SELECTMAP.focus = S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM : n.target.className.search("jewel_button") >= 0 && (S_SELECTMAP.focus = S_SELECTMAP.JEWEL_BTN_NUM);
    S_SELECTMAP.drawFocus()
  }
};
S_SELECTMAP.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_SELECTMAP.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_SELECTMAP.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_SELECTMAP.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_SELECTMAP.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_SELECTMAP.onMouseover(n);
  S_SELECTMAP.onClick(n);
  return
};

S_SELECTSTAGE.init = function() {
  REWARD_AD.is_stale() && REWARD_AD.refresh();
  gEnableKey = 0;
  utilConsoleLog("S_SELECTSTAGE.init()");
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && S_SELECTSTAGE.maketag();
  S_SELECTSTAGE.define();
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM ? get_stage_time10() : (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && get_stage_time();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_SELECTSTAGE;
  S_MAINMENU.remount_mm_top(this, TXT.selectstage);
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus = 1;
  S_SELECTSTAGE.set_maxfocus();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene != gS_STAGECLEAR ? S_SELECTSTAGE.focus = S_SELECTSTAGE.maxfocus : (S_SELECTSTAGE.focus <= 0 || S_SELECTSTAGE.focus > 20) && (S_SELECTSTAGE.focus = S_SELECTSTAGE.maxfocus);
  S_SELECTSTAGE.make_screen();
  S_SELECTSTAGE.addMouseEvent();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  setTimeout(function() {
    gEnableKey = 1
  }, 700)
};

S_SELECTSTAGE.define = function() {
  for (var t = 5, i = 113, r = 129, u = 0, n = 1; n <= SELECTSTAGE_NUM + 1; n++) SELECTSTAGE[n] = {}, u = 6 <= n && n <= 10 || 16 <= n && n <= 20 ? 64 : 0, SELECTSTAGE[n].title = (S_SELECTMAP.focus - 1) * 20 + n, SELECTSTAGE[n].x = 516 + (i + 15) * ((n - 1) % t) + u, SELECTSTAGE[n].y = 147 + (r + -18) * Math.floor((n - 1) / t) - 20, SELECTSTAGE[n].w = i, SELECTSTAGE[n].h = r
};
S_SELECTSTAGE.set_maxfocus = function() {
  if (S_SELECTMAP.focus < S_SELECTMAP.maxfocus) {
    S_SELECTSTAGE.maxfocus = 20;
    return
  }
  for (var n = 1; n <= MAX_STAGE_NUM; n++)
    if (STORAGE.data3[n] == "T") {
      S_SELECTSTAGE.maxfocus = n % 20 == 0 ? 20 : n % 20;
      return
    } S_SELECTSTAGE.maxfocus = 20;
  S_SELECTSTAGE.stage100 = 1
};
S_SELECTSTAGE.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    r;
  if (utilConsoleLog("S_SELECTSTAGE.keyDown  keyCode:" + i), S_SELECTSTAGE.concept_art.enable) {
    switch (i) {
      case KeyDefine.enter:
        S_SELECTSTAGE.concept_art.show_next()
    }
    return
  }
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus == 2) {
        S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus--;
        $("#SS_map_concept").length && $("#SS_map_concept").css("display") === "block" ? S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus < 0 && (S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus = 0) : S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus < 1 && (S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus = 1);
        S_SELECTSTAGE.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      S_SELECTSTAGE.focus >= 2 && (S_SELECTSTAGE.focus = S_SELECTSTAGE.focus - 1, S_SELECTSTAGE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      if (S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus == 2) {
        S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus = 1;
        S_SELECTSTAGE.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      S_SELECTSTAGE.focus - 5 >= 1 && (S_SELECTSTAGE.focus = S_SELECTSTAGE.focus - 5, S_SELECTSTAGE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus == 2 ? (S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus++, r = REWARD_AD.exists(REWARD_AD.PLACE.STAGESELECT) ? 3 : 2, S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus > r && (S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus = r)) : S_SELECTSTAGE.focus < S_SELECTSTAGE.maxfocus && (S_SELECTSTAGE.focus = S_SELECTSTAGE.focus + 1);
      S_SELECTSTAGE.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      if (S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus == 2) return;
      S_SELECTSTAGE.focus + 5 <= S_SELECTSTAGE.maxfocus ? (S_SELECTSTAGE.focus = S_SELECTSTAGE.focus + 5, S_SELECTSTAGE.drawFocus()) : Math.floor((S_SELECTSTAGE.focus - 1) / 5) < Math.floor((S_SELECTSTAGE.maxfocus - 1) / 5) ? (S_SELECTSTAGE.focus = S_SELECTSTAGE.maxfocus, S_SELECTSTAGE.drawFocus()) : (S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_SELECTSTAGE.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_SELECTSTAGE.run_back()
  }
};
S_SELECTSTAGE.backKey = function() {
  S_SELECTSTAGE.end();
  S_SELECTMAP.set_background_display("block");
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_SELECTMAP, S_SELECTMAP)
};

    switch (t) {
      case "A":

        break;
      case "C":

    }
    $("#SS_menu" + n + "_medal").css({

S_SELECTSTAGE.getMedal = function(n) {
  var i = STORAGE.data3[n],
    t = null;
  switch (i) {
    case "A":
      t = TXT.gold;
      break;
    case "B":
      t = TXT.silver;
      break;
    case "C":
      t = TXT.copper;
      break;
    case "D":
      t = TXT.zero;
      break;
    case "X":
      t = "X";
      break;
    case "T":
      t = "T";
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error! in S_SELECTSTAGE.getMedal():" + i);
      t = "error"
  }
  return t
};

S_SELECTSTAGE.menuRun = function() {
  if (gEnableKey = 0, sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT), S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus == 1) utilScale_xy_center("SS_menu" + S_SELECTSTAGE.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale), utilScale_xy_center("SS_menu" + S_SELECTSTAGE.focus + "_medal", gKeyScale, gKeyScale), utilScale_xy_center("Img_SS_stages_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  else switch (S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus) {
    case 3:
      utilScale_xy_center("SS_ad_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_SS_ad_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 1:
      utilScale_xy_center("SS_back", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Txt_SS_back", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_SS_back_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 2:
      utilScale_xy_center("SS_medal_power", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Txt_SS_medal", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_SS_medal_icon", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_SS_medal_power_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("SS_menu" + S_SELECTSTAGE.focus, 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("SS_menu" + S_SELECTSTAGE.focus + "_medal", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Img_SS_stages_focus", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("SS_back", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Txt_SS_back", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Img_SS_back_focus", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("SS_medal_power", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Txt_SS_medal", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Img_SS_medal_icon", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Img_SS_medal_power_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_SELECTSTAGE.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_SELECTSTAGE.menuRun_Run = function() {
  switch (S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus) {
    case 1:
      var n = (S_SELECTMAP.focus - 1) * 20 + S_SELECTSTAGE.focus;
      if (S_SELECTSTAGE.enter_chaos_planet_requirements(n) === !1) {
        utilNotice(TXT.enter_chaos_planet_requirements, 2);
        return
      }
      n == 281 ? S_SELECTSTAGE.concept_art.show() : S_SELECTSTAGE.run_stage();
      break;
    case 2:
      S_SELECTSTAGE.run_button()
  }
};
S_SELECTSTAGE.run_stage = function() {
  utilPush();
  S_GAME.stage = (S_SELECTMAP.focus - 1) * 20 + S_SELECTSTAGE.focus;
  glo.APP_FEATURE.PASS_TICKET ? S_GAME.stage >= USERPAY_STAGE && USER.userpaid == 0 && STORAGE.data3[S_GAME.stage] == "T" ? (S_SELECTSTAGE.end(), $("#S_SELECTSTAGE_div").css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_SELECTSTAGE.run_stage_no_pass_user()) : S_SELECTSTAGE.run_stage_pass_user() : gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO && S_GAME.stage >= USERPAY_STAGE && STORAGE.data3[S_GAME.stage] == "T" ? S_SELECTSTAGE.run_stage_watched_ad_user() : S_SELECTSTAGE.run_stage_pass_user()
};
S_SELECTSTAGE.run_stage_no_pass_user = function() {
  var i, n, t;
  document.getElementById("S_USERPAID_div") == null ? (i = document.getElementById("div_body"), n = document.createElement("div"), n.id = "S_USERPAID_div", t = document.getElementById("PM_here"), document.getElementById("div_body").insertBefore(n, t)) : $("#S_USERPAID_div").empty();
  $("#S_USERPAID_div").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  S_USERPAID.init()
};
S_SELECTSTAGE.run_stage_watched_ad_user = function() {
  if (!1 && S_EVENT.flag_1 == 1) try {
    Main.use_android_bridge() ? (gEnableKey = 0, android_bridge.show_inter_ad("S_SELECTSTAGE.check_and_start_game")) : gEnableKey = 1
  } catch (n) {
    gEnableKey = 1
  } else S_SELECTSTAGE.check_and_start_game("paid")
};
S_SELECTSTAGE.run_stage_pass_user = function() {
  if (glo.APP_FEATURE.STAGE_SERVER_CALC) {
    ServerConnection.stage_start_then(S_SELECTSTAGE.game_start);
    return
  }
  S_GAME.stage == 245 || S_GAME.stage == 250 || S_GAME.stage == 255 || S_GAME.stage == 260 || S_GAME.stage == 265 || S_GAME.stage == 270 || S_GAME.stage == 275 || S_GAME.stage == 280 || S_GAME.stage == 285 || S_GAME.stage == 290 || S_GAME.stage == 295 || S_GAME.stage == 300 ? (stage_count = S_SELECTSTAGE.count_arr["stage_" + S_GAME.stage].count, stage_count < 5 ? (loading_show(), etc = "스테이지도전:" + S_GAME.stage + "_남은실행수:" + stage_count, update_user_to_server(etc, "stage", function(n) {
    if (loading_hide(), n.STATE == "mysql_error") {
      glo.fun.show_s_error_network(n.DEBUG_MESSAGE);
      return
    }
    if (n.STATE == "ERROR") {
      glo.fun.show_s_error_network(n.DESCRIPTION);
      return
    }

  })) : utilNotice(TXT.map13_count_empty, 2)) : S_SELECTSTAGE.game_start()

};

    r, e, u, i;
  if (f >= 281 && f <= 300) {
    for (r = [], e = STORAGE.data2.length, u = 1; u < e; u++) i = STORAGE.data2[u].ch_num, i > 81 && CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i] && CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].star >= 8 && r.indexOf(i) === -1 && r.push(i);
    return r.length >= 5 ? !0 : !1
  }
  return !0
};
S_SELECTSTAGE.run_button = function() {
  switch (S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus) {
    case 3:
      if (!REWARD_AD.is_enabled("SS_ad_btn")) {
        REWARD_AD.notice_state("SS_ad_btn");
        gEnableKey = 1;
        break
      }
      REWARD_AD.play(REWARD_AD.PLACE.STAGESELECT, "", null, S_SELECTSTAGE.on_reward_ad);
      break;
    case 0:
      S_SELECTSTAGE.show_map_guide();
      break;
    case 1:
      S_SELECTSTAGE.run_back();
      break;
    case 2:
      utilPush();
      S_SELECTSTAGE.end();
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_SELECTSTAGE_div").css({
        display: "none"
      }), $("#S_MEDALPOWER_div").css({
        display: "block"
      }), S_MEDALPOWER.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MEDALPOWER, S_MEDALPOWER)
  }
};

S_SELECTSTAGE.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_SELECTSTAGE.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_SELECTSTAGE.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_SELECTSTAGE.onClick = function(n) {
  var t, i;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.className.search("stage_btn") >= 0 || t.id.search("SS_menu") >= 0 ? (i = glo.fun.get_only_number_by_text(t.id), i == 1 ? (S_SELECTSTAGE.focus = 1, S_SELECTSTAGE.menuRun()) : S_SELECTSTAGE.maxfocus >= i && (S_SELECTSTAGE.focus = i, S_SELECTSTAGE.menuRun())) : REWARD_AD.hit(n.target.id, "SS_ad_btn") ? (S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus = 3, S_SELECTSTAGE.menuRun()) : t.className.search("prev_button") >= 0 ? (S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus = 1, S_SELECTSTAGE.menuRun()) : t.className.search("medal_button") >= 0 ? (S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE.menuRun()) : t.className.search("concept_button") >= 0 ? (S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus = 0, S_SELECTSTAGE.show_map_guide()) : t.id.search("next") >= 0 && S_SELECTSTAGE.concept_art.show_next()
  }
};
S_SELECTSTAGE.onMouseover = function(n) {
  var t, i;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } n.target.id.search("SS_menu") >= 0 ? (i = glo.fun.get_only_number_by_text(n.target.id), i == 1 ? (S_SELECTSTAGE.focus = 1, S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus = 1) : S_SELECTSTAGE.maxfocus >= i && (S_SELECTSTAGE.focus = i, S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus = 1)) : n.target.className.search("prev_button") >= 0 ? (S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus = 1) : n.target.className.search("medal_button") >= 0 ? (S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus = 2) : REWARD_AD.hit(n.target.id, "SS_ad_btn") ? (S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus = 3) : n.target.className.search("concept_button") >= 0 && (S_SELECTSTAGE.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE.btn_focus = 0);
    S_SELECTSTAGE.drawFocus()
  }
};
S_SELECTSTAGE.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_SELECTSTAGE.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_SELECTSTAGE.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_SELECTSTAGE.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_SELECTSTAGE.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_SELECTSTAGE.onMouseover(n);
  S_SELECTSTAGE.onClick(n);
  return
};

S_RANKING.drawRanks = function() {

    platform: u[i].platform,

    team: [],
    score: 0
  };

S_RANKING.define = function() {
  for (var n = 0; n <= RANKING_NUM + 1; n++) RANKING[n] = {};
  RANKING[1].title = TXT.ranking;
  RANKING[1].x = 100;
  RANKING[1].y = 100;
  RANKING[1].w = 600;
  RANKING[1].h = 500;
  RANKING[2].title = TXT.my_ranking;
  RANKING[2].x = 800;
  RANKING[2].y = 100;
  RANKING[2].w = 200;
  RANKING[2].h = 500;
  S_RANKING.ranking_page = 1
};
S_RANKING.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      gPLATFORM.AMO === gTARGET_PLATFORM ? (S_RANKING.focus--, S_RANKING.focus < 2 && (S_RANKING.focus = 2)) : (S_RANKING.focus--, S_RANKING.focus < 1 && (S_RANKING.focus = 1));
      S_RANKING.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      gPLATFORM.AMO === gTARGET_PLATFORM ? S_RANKING.focus++ : S_RANKING.focus++;
      S_RANKING.focus > 4 && (S_RANKING.focus = 4);
      S_RANKING.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_RANKING.ranking_page != 1 && S_RANKING.make_screen_ranking_list("up");
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_RANKING.ranking_page < S_RANKING.max_ranking_page() && S_RANKING.make_screen_ranking_list("down");
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_RANKING.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_RANKING.run_back()
  }
};
S_RANKING.backKey = function() {
  S_RANKING.removeMouseEvent();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MODE_SELECT, S_MODE_SELECT);
  sound_bgm_play(BGM_SOUND.WAIT)
};
S_RANKING.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_RANKING.backKey()
};

  }), $("#Img_RAR_team_focus").css({

  }), $("#Img_RAR_help_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#RAR_scroll_up").css({
    opacity: 0
  }), $("#RAR_scroll_down").css({
    opacity: 0
  }), $("#Img_RAR_back_focus, #Img_RAR_start_focus, #Img_RAR_team_focus").css({
    "pointer-events": "none"
  }), S_RANKING.is_game_matching || gEnableKey == 0) || ($("#Img_RAR_help_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_RANKING.focus == 1 ? $("#Img_RAR_back_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_RANKING.focus == 2 ? $("#Img_RAR_start_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_RANKING.focus == 3 ? $("#Img_RAR_team_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_RANKING.focus == 4 && $("#Img_RAR_help_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }))
};
S_RANKING.menuRun = function() {
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_RANKING.focus) {
    case 1:
      S_RANKING.run_back();
      break;
    case 2:
      if (USER.clear_wave >= MAX_STAGE_NUM) {
        utilNotice(TXT.sky_wave_all_clear, 2);
        return
      }
      S_GAME.stage = 1;
      utilPush();
      S_RANKING.removeMouseEvent();
      USER.clear_wave >= 1 ? gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
        display: "block"
      }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN) : S_RANKING.no();
      break;
    case 3:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM);
      break;
    case 4:
      S_RANKING.run_help()
  }
};

S_RANKING.yes = function() {
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_RANKING;
  var n = USER.clear_wave + 1;
  loading_show("랭킹게임이어서하기", 1);
  ServerConnection.enter_sky_game("ENTRY_RUBY", n, function(n) {
    if (loading_hide("랭킹게임이어서하기", 1), !n || n.STATE === "ERROR") {
      n && n.CODE == "-103" ? (utilNotice(TXT.start1wave, 3), S_RANKING.no()) : n && n.CODE == "-101" ? (utilNotice(TXT.sky_not_entry_time, 3), gEnableKey = 1) : (glo.fun.show_s_error_network(n ? n.ERROR_MESSAGE : "enter_sky_game 서버 응답 없음"), gEnableKey = 1);
      return
    }
    n.STATE === "SUCCESS" && (n.hasOwnProperty("s_add_ruby") && (USER.ruby = parseInt(n.s_add_ruby), glo.APP_FEATURE.RUBY_CRYPT && encoding_add_ruby(-parseInt(n.ENTRY_FEE_RUBY))), S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top(), S_RANKING.flag_connect_game = 1, ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GAME, S_GAME))
  })
};
S_RANKING.no = function() {
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_RANKING;
  loading_show("랭킹게임신규입장", 1);
  S_RANKING.enter_sky_new(function(n) {
    if (loading_hide("랭킹게임신규입장", 1), !n || n.STATE === "ERROR") {
      n && n.CODE == "-101" ? utilNotice(TXT.sky_not_entry_time, 3) : glo.fun.show_s_error_network(n ? n.ERROR_MESSAGE : "enter_sky_game 서버 응답 없음");
      gEnableKey = 1;
      return
    }
    n.STATE === "SUCCESS" && (S_RANKING.flag_connect_game = 0, ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GAME, S_GAME))
  })
};

S_RANKING.wave_design = function(n) {
  var r, t, i, u;
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.wave = n;
  r = n;
  n <= S_RANKING.get_max_open_wave() ? (RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_num = r < 32 ? STAGE.char_num[32] : STAGE.char_num[r], RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_interval = 60) : (RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_num = 10 + Math.floor(n / 3), RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_interval = Math.max(30 - (n - 45) * 5, 5));
  t = r;
  (t > MAX_STAGE_NUM || STAGE_DESIGN[t] == null) && (t = MAX_STAGE_NUM);
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_start = STAGE_DESIGN[t].char_start;
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_end = STAGE_DESIGN[t].char_end;
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_last = STAGE_DESIGN[t].char_last;
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_start === RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_end && S_GAME.is_you_87_90(RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_start) && (RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_num = 3);
  i = S_RANKING.sky_wave_fix[n];
  i && (i.char_num > 0 && (RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_num = i.char_num), RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_interval = i.char_interval, RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_num > 1 && (u = Math.ceil(S_RANKING.SKY_WAVE_MIN_MS / ((RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_num - 1) * TIMER_INTERVAL)), RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_interval < u && (RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_interval = u)));
  console.log("%cwave_design wave=" + n + " stage=" + r + " char_num=" + RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_num + " char_interval=" + RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_interval + " fix=" + (i ? "Y" : "N") + " wave_sec=" + Math.round((RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_num - 1) * RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_interval * TIMER_INTERVAL / 100) / 10 + " char_start=" + RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_start + " char_end=" + RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_end + " char_last=" + RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_last, "color:green");
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.len_from_our_to_your = 1240;
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.bg_filename = "stage2_bg2.png";
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.bg_filename_w = 960;
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.bg_filename_h = 1095;
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.castle_your_filename = "sky_enemyHome";
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.castle_your_x = 652;
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.castle_your_y = 220;
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.castle_your_w = 283;
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.castle_your_h = 279;
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.castle_your_frame_num_beattack = 2;
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.castle_your_frame_num_wait = 1;
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.castle_your_frame_num_destroy = 1;
  RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.castle_your_max_hp = 1e7
};
S_RANKING.before_next_wave = function() {
  for (var t, i, r, u, n = 1; n <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; n++) OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp - Math.floor(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp / 2), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp = Math.max(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp, 1), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = CASTLE_OUR.baseX);
  for (t = 1; t <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; t++) i = document.getElementById("Img_GA_your_unit" + t + "_img"), i != null && (i.style.display = "none");
  for (S_GAME.drawOurTeamNumber(), S_GAME.drawWavetext(), n = 1; n <= USER.socket_available_num; n++) OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].ch_time = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].need_ch_time, S_GAME.bottom_ui.draw_one_char_gage(n);
  r = RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.castle_your_max_hp - CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp;
  u = Math.min(Math.floor(r / 100), 5e3);
  USER.score += u;
  $("#Txt_GA_score").text(RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.wave);
  CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp = RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.castle_your_max_hp;
  S_GAME.$el.txt_your_castle.text(CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp + " / " + CASTLE_YOUR.max_hp)
};

  S_RANKING.removeMouseEvent()

S_RANKING.make_screen_ranking_list = function(n) {
  n == "up" ? (gEnableKey = 0, $("#RAR_scroll_up").css({
    opacity: 1
  }), setTimeout(function() {
    S_RANKING.drawFocus();
    gEnableKey = 1;
    S_RANKING.ranking_page--;
    $("#Txt_RAR_page1").text(S_RANKING.ranking_page);
    S_RANKING.drawRanks()
  }, 500)) : n == "down" && (gEnableKey = 0, $("#RAR_scroll_down").css({
    opacity: 1
  }), setTimeout(function() {
    S_RANKING.drawFocus();
    gEnableKey = 1;
    S_RANKING.ranking_page++;
    $("#Txt_RAR_page2").text(S_RANKING.ranking_page);
    S_RANKING.drawRanks()
  }, 500))
};
S_RANKING.max_ranking_page = function() {
  var n = Math.ceil(S_RANKING.server_rank_num / 10);
  return n > 5 ? n = 5 : n == 0 && (n = 1), n
};
S_RANKING.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_RANKING.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_RANKING.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_RANKING.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (t.className.search("button") >= 0) {
      if (t.id.search("scroll_up") >= 0) {
        S_RANKING.ranking_page != 1 && S_RANKING.make_screen_ranking_list("up");
        return
      }
      if (t.id.search("scroll_down") >= 0) {
        S_RANKING.ranking_page < S_RANKING.max_ranking_page() && S_RANKING.make_screen_ranking_list("down");
        return
      }
    }
    S_RANKING.menuRun()
  }
};
S_RANKING.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && (utilConsoleLog(" onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), gEnableKey != 0)) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("scroll_up") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING.drawFocus(), $("#RAR_scroll_up").css({
      opacity: 1
    })) : t.id.search("scroll_down") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING.drawFocus(), $("#RAR_scroll_down").css({
      opacity: 1
    })) : t.id.search("back") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING.focus = 1, S_RANKING.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("start") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING.focus = 2, S_RANKING.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("team") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING.focus = 3, S_RANKING.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("help") >= 0 && (S_RANKING.focus = 4, S_RANKING.drawFocus())
  }
};
S_RANKING.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_RANKING.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_RANKING.onMouseover(n)
};
S_RANKING.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_RANKING.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_RANKING.onMouseover(n);
  S_RANKING.onClick(n)
};
glo.sky = function() {
  var n = {},
    t = [],
    i = 0,
    r = 0,
    h = "",
    u = 1,
    c = "",
    f, e, o, s;
  return n.RESULT_TYPE = {
    W: "승",
    L: "패",
    D: "무",
    B: "전"
  }, f = 0, e = "", n.set_game_wave = function(n) {
    f = Math.max(0, parseInt(n) || 0)
  }, n.get_game_wave = function() {
    return f
  }, n.set_game_result = function(t) {
    var i = !1;
    for (var r in n.RESULT_TYPE) n.RESULT_TYPE.hasOwnProperty(r) && n.RESULT_TYPE[r] === t && (i = !0);
    if (!i) {
      glo.fun.show_s_error_network("sky 결과 오류");
      return
    }
    e = t
  }, n.get_game_result = function() {
    return e
  }, o = !1, n.set_all_clear = function(n) {
    o = !!n
  }, n.get_all_clear = function() {
    return o
  }, s = "", n.set_game_nonce = function(n) {
    s = n == null ? "" : "" + n
  }, n.get_game_nonce = function() {
    return s
  }, n.get_continue_ruby = function(n) {
    return n = Math.max(0, parseInt(n) || 0), Math.floor(n / 10) + u
  }, n.get_ranking_list = function() {
    return t
  }, n.get_my_ranking = function() {
    return i
  }, n.get_my_clear_wave = function() {
    return r
  }, n.get_my_clear_date = function() {
    return h
  }, n.get_entry_fee_ruby = function() {
    return u
  }, n.get_my_platform = function() {
    return c
  }, n.parse_sky_ranking_info = function(n) {
    var e, f;
    if (n.hasOwnProperty("ranking_list") && n.ranking_list) {
      for (t = [], e = n.ranking_list, f = 0; f < e.length; f++) t[f] = [], t[f].rank = parseInt(e[f].ranking), t[f].user_name = e[f].user_name, t[f].platform = e[f].platform, t[f].level = parseInt(e[f].level), t[f].lang = parseInt(e[f].lang), t[f].team = glo.char.extract_character_numbers(e[f].team), t[f].clear_wave = parseInt(e[f].clear_wave);
      t.unshift("");
      S_RANKING.server_rank_num = e.length
    }
    n.hasOwnProperty("my_ranking") && (i = parseInt(n.my_ranking));
    n.hasOwnProperty("CLEAR_WAVE") && (r = parseInt(n.CLEAR_WAVE));
    n.hasOwnProperty("CLEAR_DATE") && (h = n.CLEAR_DATE);
    n.hasOwnProperty("entry_fee_ruby") && (u = parseInt(n.entry_fee_ruby));
    n.PLATFORM_NAME_COM && (c = n.PLATFORM_NAME_COM);
    USER.ranking = i;
    USER.clear_wave = r
  }, n
}();

S_RANKING_PVP.mask_em_user_id = function(n) {
  var i, t;
  if (typeof n != "string") return n;
  if (i = n.toUpperCase(), t = /^(ATV|EM|BW)(\d+)([A-Z]*)$/i.exec(i), t) {
    var e = t[1],
      r = t[2],
      u = r.length,
      f = Math.min(2, u),
      o = r.slice(0, f),
      s = u - f,
      h = new Array(s + 1).join("*");
    return e + o + h
  }
  return n
};
S_RANKING_PVP.mask_glo_user_id = function(n) {
  return typeof n != "string" ? n : (n = S_SETTING.google_id_hide(n), n.length > 7 ? n.slice(0, 7) : n)
};

S_RANKING_PVP.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  if (!S_RANKING_PVP.is_game_matching || i !== KeyDefine.up && i !== KeyDefine.down && i !== KeyDefine.left && i !== KeyDefine.right && i !== KeyDefine.enter) switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      gPLATFORM.AMO === gTARGET_PLATFORM ? (S_RANKING_PVP.focus--, S_RANKING_PVP.focus < 2 && (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 2)) : (S_RANKING_PVP.focus--, S_RANKING_PVP.focus < 1 && (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 1));
      S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      gPLATFORM.AMO === gTARGET_PLATFORM ? (S_RANKING_PVP.focus++, S_RANKING_PVP.focus > 6 && (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 6)) : (S_RANKING_PVP.focus++, S_RANKING_PVP.focus > 6 && (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 6));
      S_GAME.is_pvp_classic_mode() && S_RANKING_PVP.focus > 4 && (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 4);
      S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_RANKING_PVP.ranking_page != 1 && S_RANKING_PVP.make_screen_ranking_list("up");
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_RANKING_PVP.ranking_page < S_RANKING_PVP.max_ranking_page() && S_RANKING_PVP.make_screen_ranking_list("down");
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_RANKING_PVP.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_RANKING_PVP.run_back()
  }
};
S_RANKING_PVP.backKey = function() {
  S_RANKING_PVP.removeMouseEvent();

  utilNoticeHide();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MODE_SELECT, S_MODE_SELECT);
  sound_bgm_play(BGM_SOUND.WAIT)
};

};
