        color: "#ffffff",
        align: "center",
        text_shadow: S_POPUPTOT.text_shadow_btn
      },
      callbackfn: function() {
        S_POPUPTOT.back();
        S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus()
      }
    }, ]
  };
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPTOT, S_POPUPTOT)
};
S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus = function() {
  if (window.g.blink.value = 1, $("#Img_RV_back_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Img_RV_start_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Img_RV_team_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#RV_reward_info_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Img_RV_season_rank_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#RV_hof_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Img_RV_classic_help_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Img_RV_back_focus, #Img_RV_start_focus, #Img_RV_team_focus, #RV_left_scroll_focus, #RV_reward_info_focus, #Img_RV_season_rank_focus, #RV_hof_focus, #Img_RV_classic_help_focus").css({
      "pointer-events": "none"
    }), !S_RANKING_PVP.is_game_matching && gEnableKey != 0) {
    if (S_GAME.is_pvp_classic_mode()) {
      $("#Img_RV_classic_help_focus").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      S_RANKING_PVP.focus == 1 ? $("#Img_RV_back_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      }) : S_RANKING_PVP.focus == 2 ? $("#Img_RV_start_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      }) : S_RANKING_PVP.focus == 3 ? $("#Img_RV_team_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      }) : S_RANKING_PVP.focus == 4 && $("#Img_RV_classic_help_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      return
    }
    S_RANKING_PVP.focus == 1 ? $("#Img_RV_back_focus").css({
      display: "block"
    }) : S_RANKING_PVP.focus == 2 ? $("#Img_RV_start_focus").css({
      display: "block"
    }) : S_RANKING_PVP.focus == 3 ? $("#Img_RV_team_focus").css({
      display: "block"
    }) : S_RANKING_PVP.focus == 4 ? $("#RV_reward_info_focus").css({
      display: "block"
    }) : S_RANKING_PVP.focus == 5 ? $("#Img_RV_season_rank_focus").css({
      display: "block"
    }) : S_RANKING_PVP.focus == 6 && $("#RV_hof_focus").css({
      display: "block"
    })
  }
};
S_RANKING_PVP.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && sound_play(SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_RANKING_PVP.focus) {
    case 1:
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_RANKING_PVP.run_back();
      break;
    case 2:
      if (S_RANKING_PVP.is_game_matching === !0) return;
      S_RANKING_PVP.run_pvp_game();
      break;
    case 3:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM);
      break;
    case 4:
      if (S_GAME.is_pvp_classic_mode()) {
        S_RANKING_PVP.run_classic_help();
        break
      }
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_RANKING_PVP_REWARD, S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD);
      break;
    case 5:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK, S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK);
      break;
    case 6:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_RANKING_PVP_HOF, S_RANKING_PVP_HOF);
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("error!! in S_RANKING_PVP.menuRun()")
  }
};
S_RANKING_PVP.run_pvp_game = function() {
  if (S_GAME.is_pvp_classic_mode()) {
    S_RANKING_PVP.run_pvp_cls_game();
    return
  }
  glo.pvp.get_ticket() <= 0 ? get_cur_ruby() >= glo.pvp.get_entry_fee_rubies() ? ($("#Img_RV_start_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  }), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
    display: "block"
  }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN)) : (utilNotice(TXT.ruby_lack, 2), gEnableKey = 1) : S_RANKING_PVP.enter_pvp_game("ENTRY_TICKET")
};
S_RANKING_PVP.enter_pvp_game = function(n) {
  loading_show("PVP대전입장", 1);
  ServerConnection.enter_pvp_game(n, function(n) {
    if (loading_hide("PVP대전입장", 1), n.STATE === "ERROR") n.CODE == "-101" ? utilNotice(TXT.pvp_timelimit, 2.5) : n.CODE == "-102" ? utilNotice(TXT.cloud_garden_not_enter, 2.5) : n.CODE == "-103" ? utilNotice(TXT.ruby_lack, 2.5) : n.CODE == "-104" ? utilNotice(TXT.matching_user_error, 2.5) : glo.fun.show_s_error_network(n.ERROR_MESSAGE);
    else if (n.STATE === "SUCCESS") {
      n.hasOwnProperty("add_ticket") && glo.pvp.set_ticket(n.add_ticket);
      n.hasOwnProperty("s_add_ruby") && (USER.ruby = parseInt(n.s_add_ruby), glo.APP_FEATURE.GOLD_CRYPT && encoding_add_ruby(-glo.pvp.get_entry_fee_rubies()));
      glo.pvp.parse_matched_user(n.matched_user);
      var t = glo.fun.set_mask_user_name(USER_NPC.name, USER_NPC.platform);
      if (USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice2_forever(t + TXT.matched) : utilNotice2_forever(TXT.matched + " : " + t), setTimeout(function() {
          $("#message").css({
            display: "none"
          })
        }, 700), (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && (S_GAME.ranking_mode != 2 || g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != "S_RANKING_PVP")) {
        update_user_to_server_acc("[빙고]" + S_GAME.ranking_mode + ":S_RANKING_PVP.game_start():" + g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
        return
      }
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GAME, S_GAME);
      glo.pvp.set_game_result(glo.pvp.RESULT_TYPE.B)
    }
  })
};
S_RANKING_PVP.is_valid_pvp_cls_deck = function() {
  var h = glo.char.get_decks(),
    i, n, r, f, e, u, t, o, s;
  if (!h) return !1;
  for (i = h.split(","), n = 0; n < i.length; n++)
    if (i[n] !== "" && ((r = parseInt(i[n].split(":")[0], 10), !r || !CHAR_OUR_TEAM[r]) || (f = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[r].star, f < 1 || f > 7))) return !1;
  if (e = glo.char.get_deck_items(), e)
    for (u = e.split(","), t = 0; t < u.length; t++)
      if (u[t] !== "" && ((o = parseInt(u[t].split(":")[0], 10), !o) || (s = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade_return_num(o), s < 1 || s > 4))) return !1;
  return !0
};
S_RANKING_PVP.run_pvp_cls_game = function() {
  if (!S_RANKING_PVP.is_valid_pvp_cls_deck()) {
    utilNotice_line2_html(TXT.pvp_classic_deck_limit, 2.5);
    gEnableKey = 1;
    return
  }
  glo.pvp.get_cls_ticket() > 0 ? S_RANKING_PVP.enter_pvp_cls_game("ENTRY_TICKET") : get_cur_gold() >= glo.pvp.get_cls_entry_fee_gold() ? ($("#Img_RV_start_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  }), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
    display: "block"
  }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN)) : (utilNotice(TXT.gold_lack, 2), gEnableKey = 1)
};

loopTimeId = -1;
S_RANKING_PVP.game_start = function() {
  var n, i, t;
  S_RANKING_PVP.is_game_matching = !0;
  n = 0;
  i = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 5);
  setTimeout(function() {
    n = 1
  }, i * 1e3);
  get_user_info_for_pvp();
  t = 0;
  loop_function = function() {
    var i, r;
    if (S_RANKING.server_flag == 1 && n == 1) {
      if ((gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && setTimeout(function() {
          $("#S_RANKING_PVP_div").empty()
        }, 1e3), i = glo.fun.is_glo_platform() ? S_SETTING.google_id_hide(USER_NPC.name) : S_RANKING_PVP.mask_em_user_id(USER_NPC.name), USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice2_forever(i + TXT.matched) : utilNotice2_forever(TXT.matched + " : " + i), setTimeout(function() {
          $("#message").css({
            display: "none"
          })
        }, 700), (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && (S_GAME.ranking_mode != 2 || g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != "S_RANKING_PVP")) {
        update_user_to_server_acc("[빙고]" + S_GAME.ranking_mode + ":S_RANKING_PVP.game_start():" + g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
        return
      }
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GAME, S_GAME)
    } else {
      for (i = "", r = 0; r <= t % 5; r++) i += ". ";
      utilNotice2_forever(TXT.matching + i);
      t++;
      loopTimeId = setTimeout(loop_function, 500)
    }
  };
  loop_function()
};

  if (S_GAME.is_pvp_classic_mode()) {
    S_RANKING_PVP.enter_pvp_cls_game("ENTRY_GOLD");
    return
  }
  S_RANKING_PVP.enter_pvp_game("ENTRY_RUBY");
  return
};
S_RANKING_PVP.end = function() {
  S_RANKING_PVP.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_RANKING_PVP.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (S_RANKING_PVP.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").click(this.onClick).mouseover(this.onMouseover))
};
S_RANKING_PVP.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("click").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_RANKING_PVP.onClick = function(n) {
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_RANKING_PVP && !S_RANKING_PVP.is_game_matching && gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (t.className.search("button") >= 0) {
      if (t.id.search("_red_") >= 0) {
        $("#Img_RV_back_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        $("#Img_RV_start_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        $("#Img_RV_team_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        $("#RV_reward_info_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        $("#Img_RV_season_rank_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        $("#RV_hof_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        S_RANKING_PVP.end();
        utilPush();
        $("#S_POPUP_REWARD_VIEW_div").css({
          display: "block"
        });
        S_POPUP_REWARD_VIEW.init();
        return
      }
      if (t.id.search("scroll_up") >= 0) {
        S_RANKING_PVP.ranking_page != 1 && S_RANKING_PVP.make_screen_ranking_list("up");
        return
      }
      if (t.id.search("scroll_down") >= 0) {
        S_RANKING_PVP.ranking_page < S_RANKING_PVP.max_ranking_page() && S_RANKING_PVP.make_screen_ranking_list("down");
        return
      }
      t.id.search("back") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 1, S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("start") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 2, S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("team") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 3, S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("reward") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 4, S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("season_rank") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 5, S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("hof") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 6, S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("classic_help") >= 0 && (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 4, S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus());
      S_RANKING_PVP.menuRun()
    }
  }
};
S_RANKING_PVP.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_RANKING_PVP && gMOUSE_USE && (utilConsoleLog(" onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), gEnableKey != 0)) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } n.target.className.search("button") >= 0 && (n.target.id.search("back") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 1, S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus()) : n.target.id.search("start") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 2, S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus()) : n.target.id.search("team") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 3, S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus()) : n.target.id.search("reward") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 4, S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus()) : n.target.id.search("season_rank") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 5, S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus()) : n.target.id.search("hof") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 6, S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus()) : n.target.id.search("classic_help") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING_PVP.focus = 4, S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus()) : n.target.id.search("scroll_up") >= 0 ? utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("RV_left_scroll_focus", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/42_cloud_garden/cloud_scrolltop_f.png", 845, 213) : n.target.id.search("scroll_down") >= 0 && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("RV_left_scroll_focus", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/42_cloud_garden/cloud_scrolldown_f.png", 845, 527))
  }
};
S_RANKING_PVP.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_RANKING_PVP.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_RANKING_PVP.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_RANKING_PVP.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_RANKING_PVP.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_RANKING_PVP.onMouseover(n);
  S_RANKING_PVP.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_RANKING_PVP.run_back = function() {
  S_RANKING_PVP.is_game_matching || (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_RANKING_PVP.backKey())
};
glo.pvp = function() {
  function at(t) {
    var i = [];
    for (var r in n.RESULT_TYPE) n.RESULT_TYPE.hasOwnProperty(r) && i.push(n.RESULT_TYPE[r]);
    return i.indexOf(t) === -1
  }

  function vt(n) {
    i = [];
    for (var t = 0; t < n.length; t++) i[t] = {}, i[t].rank = parseInt(n[t].RANKING), i[t].user_name = n[t].NAME, i[t].platform = n[t].PLATFORM, i[t].team = glo.char.extract_character_numbers(n[t].TEAM), i[t].point = parseInt(n[t].TOT_POINT), i[t].season_num = parseInt(n[t].SEASON_NUM)
  }

  function yt(n) {
    if (u = [], n && n.length !== 0)
      for (var t = 0; t < n.length; t++) u[t] = {}, u[t].rank = parseInt(n[t].RANKING), u[t].user_name = n[t].NAME ? n[t].NAME : "", u[t].platform = n[t].PLATFORM ? n[t].PLATFORM : "", u[t].team = glo.char.extract_character_numbers(n[t].TEAM ? n[t].TEAM : ""), u[t].point = parseInt(n[t].TOT_POINT)
  }
  var n = {},
    t = [],
    i = [],
    u = [],
    c = 0,
    l = 0,
    a = [],
    k = 0,
    d = 0,
    g = "",
    nt = "",
    tt = [],
    it = [],
    rt = [],
    ut = 0,
    v = 0,
    o = 0,
    s = 0,
    y = "",
    r = [],
    h = 0,
    p = 0,
    w = 0,
    ft = 0,
    et = 0,
    ot = 1,
    st = 1,
    ht = 1,
    ct = 1,
    lt = 500,
    b = null,
    f, e;
  return n.RESULT_TYPE = {
    W: "승",
    L: "패",
    D: "무",
    B: "전"
  }, f = "", e = 0, n.set_game_score = function() {
    var i, t;

S_RANKING_NVN.define = function() {};
S_RANKING_NVN.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_RANKING_NVN.focus = 1;
      S_RANKING_NVN.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_RANKING_NVN.focus = 2;
      S_RANKING_NVN.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.RED:
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      $("#Img_RN_back_focus").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $("#Img_RN_start_focus").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      utilPush();
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV ? ($("#S_POPUP_REWARD_VIEW_div").css({
        display: "block"
      }), S_POPUP_REWARD_VIEW.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUP_REWARD_VIEW, S_POPUP_REWARD_VIEW);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_RANKING_NVN.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_RANKING_NVN.backKey()
  }
};
S_RANKING_NVN.backKey = function() {
  S_RANKING_NVN.removeMouseEvent();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_SELECTMAP, S_SELECTMAP);
  sound_bgm_play(BGM_SOUND.WAIT)
};

S_RANKING_NVN.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  switch (S_RANKING_NVN.focus) {
    case 1:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? (gEnableKey = 1, history.back()) : (gEnableKey = 1, S_RANKING_NVN.backKey());
      break;
    case 2:
      ServerConnection.is_time_init_nvn_pvp(S_RANKING_NVN.check_init_time);
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("error!! in S_RANKING_NVN.menuRun()")
  }
};
S_RANKING_NVN.check_init_time = function(n) {
  switch (n) {
    case "play":
      if (S_RANKING_NVN.removeMouseEvent(), STORAGE.data1.nvn_num <= 0) {
        USER.gold >= S_RANKING_NVN.need_gold ? ($("#Img_RN_start_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        }), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
          display: "block"
        }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN)) : (utilNotice(TXT.pvp_not_enterance, 2), gEnableKey = 1);
        return
      }
      STORAGE.data1.nvn_num--;
      $("#RN_enterance_num").text(TXT.pvp_free_enterance + " : " + STORAGE.data1.nvn_num);
      STORAGE.save_all_info_to_storage("NvN대전입장:입장권(" + STORAGE.data1.nvn_num + "장 남음)");
      S_RANKING_NVN.game_start();
      break;
    case "noplay":
      utilNotice(TXT.timelimit, 2.5);
      gEnableKey = 1;
      return
  }
};
S_RANKING_NVN.game_start = function() {
  var t = 0,
    i = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 5),
    n;
  setTimeout(function() {
    t = 1
  }, i * 1e3);
  get_user_info_for_nvn();
  n = 0;
  loop_function = function() {
    var i, r;
    if (S_RANKING.server_flag == 1 && t == 1) {
      if (setTimeout(function() {
          $("#S_RANKING_NVN_div").empty()
        }, 1e3), utilNotice2_forever(TXT.nvn_matched), setTimeout(function() {
          $("#message").css({
            display: "none"
          })
        }, 700), S_GAME.ranking_mode != 3 || g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != "S_RANKING_NVN") {
        STORAGE.save_all_info_to_storage("[빙고]" + S_GAME.ranking_mode + ":S_RANKING_NVN.game_start():" + g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
        return
      }
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GAME, S_GAME)
    } else {
      for (i = "", r = 0; r <= n % 5; r++) i += ". ";
      utilNotice2_forever(TXT.matching + i);
      n++;
      setTimeout(loop_function, 500)
    }
  };
  loop_function()
};
S_RANKING_NVN.yes = function() {
  USER.gold = USER.gold - S_RANKING_NVN.need_gold;
  STORAGE.save_all_info_to_storage("NVN게임현금입장:" + S_RANKING_NVN.need_gold + "골드 소모");
  S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top();
  S_RANKING_NVN.game_start()
};
S_RANKING_NVN.end = function() {
  S_RANKING_NVN.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_RANKING_NVN.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").click(this.onClick).mouseover(this.onMouseover).mouseout(this.onMouseout)
};
S_RANKING_NVN.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("click").unbind("mouseover").unbind("mouseout")
};
S_RANKING_NVN.onClick = function() {
  gEnableKey != 0 && S_RANKING_NVN.menuRun()
};
S_RANKING_NVN.onMouseover = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  switch (n.target.id) {
    case "RN_back":
    case "RN_back_icon":
    case "Txt_RN_back":
    case "Img_RN_back_focus":
      S_RANKING_NVN.focus = 1;
      S_RANKING_NVN.drawFocus();
      return;
    case "RN_start_btn":
    case "RN_start":
    case "RN_start_icon":
    case "Img_RN_start_focus":
      S_RANKING_NVN.focus = 2;
      S_RANKING_NVN.drawFocus();
      return;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Please define this id in S_RANKING_NVN.onMouseover():" + n.target.id)
  }
};
S_RANKING_NVN.onMouseout = function() {};
S_RANKING_NVN.onMousemove = function() {};
var MEDALPOWER_NUM = 60,
  MEDALPOWER_NUM_ON_SCREEN = 1,
  S_MEDALPOWER = {
    sceneType: 0,
    focus: 1,
    abs_focus: 1,
    scroll_cur_x: 0,
    scroll_target_x: 0,
    scroll_speed: .3,
    scroll_flag: 0,
    card_w: 856,
    card_h: 411,
    card_y: 177,
    card_gap: 18,
    sub: {
      x: 30,
      y: 199,
      w: 145,
      h: 134,
      gap: 18
    },
    row_focus: 1,
    btn_focus: 1,
    value: new Array(MEDALPOWER_NUM + 1)
  };
for (S_MEDALPOWER.preload = function() {
    var n;
    gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV ? (n = [""], ChangeScene.preloadImage(n)) : (n = ["./image/ui/0_common/co_bg1.jpg", "./image/ui/5_medalview/mv_bt.png", "./image/ui/5_medalview/mv_medalX_bg.png", "./image/ui/5_medalview/mv_medalO_bg.png", "./image/ui/5_medalview/mv_medal1.png", "./image/ui/5_medalview/mv_medal2.png", "./image/ui/5_medalview/mv_medal3.png", "./image/ui/5_medalview/mv_bt_focus.png"], ChangeScene.preloadImage(n));
    S_MEDALPOWER.maketag()
  }, S_MEDALPOWER.init = function() {
    utilConsoleLog("S_MEDALPOWER.init()");
    (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && S_MEDALPOWER.maketag();
    g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MEDALPOWER;
    S_MAINMENU.remount_mm_top(this, TXT.medal);
    send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
    S_MEDALPOWER.define();
    S_MEDALPOWER.make_screen();
    S_MEDALPOWER.addMouseEvent();
    blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)
  }, S_MEDALPOWER.pause = function() {
    utilConsoleLog("S_MEDALPOWER.pause()!!");
    gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && $("#Img_MP_back_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    for (var n = 1; n <= S_MEDALPOWER.card_num; n++) $("#MP_card_" + n + "_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    })
  }, S_MEDALPOWER.resume = function() {
    utilConsoleLog("S_MEDALPOWER.resume()!!");
    S_MEDALPOWER.drawFocus();
    blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)
  }, S_MEDALPOWER.maketag = function() {
    var t = document.getElementById("S_MEDALPOWER_div"),
      i = document.getElementById("Img_MP_background"),
      n;
    if (i) {
      utilConsoleLog("Already ready.");
      return
    }
    n = '<img id="Img_MP_background">\t<div id="s_medalpower_card"> <!-- UPGRADE 카드를 나타낸다. -->\t\t<div id="MP_card_1"> <!-- 요런것을 동적으로 생성해 보자 -->\t\t<div id="MP_card_1_txt"><\/div>\t\t<div id="MP_card_1_sub_1"><\/div> <!-- 요것도 생성한다. -->\t<\/div> <\/div>';
    gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && (n += '<!--  가장 아래 부분의 메뉴 --><div id="MP_back_btn"  class="button">\t<img id="MP_back" class ="button"/>\t<div id="Txt_MP_back" class="button"> <\/div>\t<img id="Img_MP_back_focus" class ="focus"/><\/div>');
    gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO && (n += '<img id="MP_leftarrow_drag" class="button"/><img id="MP_rightarrow_drag" class="button"/>');
    t.innerHTML = n
  }, S_MEDALPOWER.define = function() {
    S_MEDALPOWER.focus = 1;
    S_MEDALPOWER.abs_focus = 1;
    S_MEDALPOWER.focus = S_SELECTMAP.focus * 4 - 3;
    S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x = -(S_MEDALPOWER.card_w + S_MEDALPOWER.card_gap) * (S_MEDALPOWER.focus - 1);
    S_MEDALPOWER.row_focus = 1;
    S_MEDALPOWER.card_num = Math.floor(MAX_STAGE_NUM / 5)
  }, S_MEDALPOWER.keyDown = function(n, t) {
    var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
    switch (i) {
      case KeyDefine.left:
        if (gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && S_MEDALPOWER.row_focus == 2) {
          S_MEDALPOWER.btn_focus = 1;
          S_MEDALPOWER.drawFocus_btnmenu();
          return
        }
        S_MEDALPOWER.check_scroll_and_start_left();
        break;
      case KeyDefine.right:
        if (gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && S_MEDALPOWER.row_focus == 2) return;
        S_MEDALPOWER.check_scroll_and_start_right();
        break;
      case KeyDefine.up:
        gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && S_MEDALPOWER.row_focus == 2 && (S_MEDALPOWER.row_focus = 1, S_MEDALPOWER.drawFocus());
        break;
      case KeyDefine.down:
        gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && S_MEDALPOWER.row_focus == 1 && (S_MEDALPOWER.row_focus = 2, S_MEDALPOWER.drawFocus_btnmenu());
        break;
      case KeyDefine.enter:
        gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && S_MEDALPOWER.row_focus == 2 ? S_MEDALPOWER.menuRun_btnmenu() : S_MEDALPOWER.menuRun();
        break;
      case KeyDefine.esc:
      case KeyDefine.back:
        S_MEDALPOWER.run_back()
    }
  }, S_MEDALPOWER.backKey = function() {
    S_MEDALPOWER.end();
    gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_MEDALPOWER_div").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#S_SELECTSTAGE_div").css({
      display: "block"
    }), S_SELECTSTAGE.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_SELECTSTAGE, S_SELECTSTAGE)
  }, S_MEDALPOWER.check_scroll_and_start_left = function() {
    S_MEDALPOWER.focus >= 2 && (S_MEDALPOWER.focus = S_MEDALPOWER.focus - 1, S_MEDALPOWER.drawFocus(), S_MEDALPOWER.abs_focus >= 2 ? S_MEDALPOWER.abs_focus = S_MEDALPOWER.abs_focus - 1 : (S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x = S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_target_x, S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_flag = 0), S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_target_x = S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x + (S_MEDALPOWER.card_w + S_MEDALPOWER.card_gap), S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_left()))
  }, S_MEDALPOWER.check_scroll_and_start_right = function() {
    S_MEDALPOWER.focus < S_MEDALPOWER.card_num && (S_MEDALPOWER.focus = S_MEDALPOWER.focus + 1, S_MEDALPOWER.drawFocus(), S_MEDALPOWER.abs_focus < MEDALPOWER_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? S_MEDALPOWER.abs_focus = S_MEDALPOWER.abs_focus + 1 : (S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x = S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_target_x, S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_flag = 0), S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_target_x = S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x - (S_MEDALPOWER.card_w + S_MEDALPOWER.card_gap), S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_right()))
  }, S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_right = function() {
    S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_flag = 1;
    S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x = S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x - S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_speed * (S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x - S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_target_x);
    $("#s_medalpower_card").css({
      left: S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x + "px"
    });
    S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x > S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_target_x + 4 && S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_right, 80) : (S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x = S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_target_x, S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_flag = 0)
  }, S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_left = function() {
    S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_flag = 1;
    S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x = S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x + S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_speed * (S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_target_x - S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x);
    $("#s_medalpower_card").css({
      left: S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x + "px"
    });
    S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x < S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_target_x - 4 && S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_left, 80) : (S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x = S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_target_x, S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_flag = 0)
  }, S_MEDALPOWER.make_screen = function() {
    util_draw_div("S_MEDALPOWER_div", 0, 0, 1280, 720);
    utilDrawImage("Img_MP_background", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/0_common/co_bg1.jpg", 0, 0, 1280, 720, "absolute");
    S_MEDALPOWER.make_screen_center();
    S_MEDALPOWER.make_screen_menu();
    S_MEDALPOWER.drawFocus()
  }, S_MEDALPOWER.make_screen_center = function() {
    var i, t, r, u, n;
    for ($("#s_medalpower_card").css({
        left: S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x + "px",
        top: "0px",

      case 3:

    }
    switch (S_MEDALPOWER.btn_focus) {
      case 1:
        S_MEDALPOWER.run_back();

  }, S_MEDALPOWER.how_active = function(n) {
    for (var r, t = 0, u = (n - 1) * 5, i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
      r = u + i;
      switch (STORAGE.data3[r]) {
        case "A":
          t = t + 3;
          break;
        case "B":
          t = t + 2;
          break;
        case "C":
          t = t + 1;
          break;
        default:
          return 0
      }
    }
    return Math.round(100 / 15 * t) / 100
  }, i = 1; i <= MEDALPOWER_NUM; i++) S_MEDALPOWER.value[i] = 0;

  S_MEDALPOWER.removeMouseEvent()

S_MEDALPOWER.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_MEDALPOWER.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_MEDALPOWER.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_MEDALPOWER.onClick = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0 && (S_MEDALPOWER.row_focus == 2 ? S_MEDALPOWER.menuRun_btnmenu() : S_MEDALPOWER.menuRun())
};
S_MEDALPOWER.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    if (utilConsoleLog("S_MEDALPOWER.onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO) {
      if (n.target.id.search("MP_leftarrow_drag") >= 0) {
        S_MEDALPOWER.row_focus = 2;
        S_MEDALPOWER.btn_focus = 3;
        S_MEDALPOWER.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        return
      }
      if (n.target.id.search("MP_rightarrow_drag") >= 0) {
        S_MEDALPOWER.row_focus = 2;
        S_MEDALPOWER.btn_focus = 4;
        S_MEDALPOWER.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        return
      }
    } else if (n.target.id.search("back") >= 0) {
      S_MEDALPOWER.row_focus = 2;
      S_MEDALPOWER.btn_focus = 1;
      S_MEDALPOWER.drawFocus_btnmenu();
      return
    }
    S_MEDALPOWER.row_focus = 1;
    var i = n.target.id.substring(8),
      t = parseInt(i, 10),
      r = Math.floor(S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_target_x * -1 / (S_MEDALPOWER.card_w + S_MEDALPOWER.card_gap)) + 1;
    S_MEDALPOWER.abs_focus = S_MEDALPOWER.abs_focus + (t - S_MEDALPOWER.focus);
    S_MEDALPOWER.focus = t;
    S_MEDALPOWER.drawFocus();
    S_MEDALPOWER.abs_focus == MEDALPOWER_NUM_ON_SCREEN + 1 ? (S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x = S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_target_x, S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_flag = 0), S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_target_x = S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x - (S_MEDALPOWER.card_w + S_MEDALPOWER.card_gap), S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_right(), S_MEDALPOWER.abs_focus = MEDALPOWER_NUM_ON_SCREEN) : S_MEDALPOWER.abs_focus == 0 && (S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x = S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_target_x, S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_flag = 0), S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_target_x = S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_cur_x + (S_MEDALPOWER.card_w + S_MEDALPOWER.card_gap), S_MEDALPOWER.scroll_left(), S_MEDALPOWER.abs_focus = 1)
  }
};
S_MEDALPOWER.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_MEDALPOWER.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_MEDALPOWER.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_MEDALPOWER.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_MEDALPOWER.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_MEDALPOWER.onMouseover(n);
  S_MEDALPOWER.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_MEDALPOWER.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_MEDALPOWER.backKey()
};

S_MAKETEAM.init = function() {
  $("#MM_top").css({
    top: "0px"
  });
  utilConsoleLog("S_MAKETEAM.init()");
  STORAGE.data2_sorting_by_star();
  $("#S_CLEVELUP_div").empty();
  $("#S_CLEVELUP_COMPLETE_div").empty();
  $("#S_EVOLUTION_COMPLETE_div").empty();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MAKETEAM;
  glo.APP_FEATURE.BOSS_2026 ? S_MAINMENU.remount_mm_top(this, TXT.myTeam, {
    show_celestialbar: !0
  }) : S_MAINMENU.remount_mm_top(this, TXT.myTeam);
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  gEnableKey = 0;
  $("#MT_back_btn").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#MT_start_btn").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene != gS_CLEVELUP_COMPLETE && g_sceneinfo.before_scene != gS_EVOLUTION_COMPLETE && g_sceneinfo.before_scene != gS_CLEVELUP && S_MAKETEAM.define();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_EVOLUTION_COMPLETE && S_MAKETEAM.refocus();
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT && util_kt.isLowModel() && (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_speed = 1);
  S_MAKETEAM.make_screen();
  S_MAKETEAM.evolution_ani_flag = 0;
  setTimeout(function() {
    if (S_MAKETEAM.new_flag = 0, !glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING)
      for (var n = 1; n <= DEFINE.USER_STORAGE_MAX; n++) S_MAKETEAM.new_array[n] = 0
  }, 1500);
  glo.event.apply_coupon_code()
};

  }), S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_submenu()) : S_MAKETEAM.row_focus == 2 ? S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_btnmenu() : S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)
};

S_MAKETEAM.define = function() {
  S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num = S_MAKETEAM.get_maketeam_bottom_char_num();
  S_MAKETEAM.top_ch_num = S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num >= 5 ? 5 : S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num;
  S_MAKETEAM.focus = 1;
  S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus = 1;
  S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus = 1;
  S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = 0;
  S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_mode = 0;
  S_MAKETEAM.row_focus = 1;
  S_MAKETEAM.scale.cur = S_MAKETEAM.scale.start
};
S_MAKETEAM.refocus = function() {
  var n, t;
  S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num = S_MAKETEAM.get_maketeam_bottom_char_num();
  S_MAKETEAM.focus > S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num && (S_MAKETEAM.focus = S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num);
  S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus = S_MAKETEAM.focus <= BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? S_MAKETEAM.focus : BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN;
  n = 0;
  S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num > BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN && (n = -(S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_w + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_gap) * (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num - BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN));
  S_MAKETEAM.focus <= BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = 0 : (t = -(S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_w + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_gap) * (S_MAKETEAM.focus - BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN), t < n && (t = n), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = t);
  S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x
};
S_MAKETEAM.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var u = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    r, i;
  switch (u) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_MAKETEAM.row_focus == 2) {
        S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus = S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus <= 1 ? 1 : S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus - 1;
        console.log(S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus);
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        return
      }
      if (S_MAKETEAM.focus >= 2) S_MAKETEAM.focus = S_MAKETEAM.focus - 1, S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus(), S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus >= 2 ? S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus = S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus - 1 : (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag = 0), i = 0, S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num > BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN && (i = -(S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_w + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_gap) * (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num - BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN)), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x + (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_w + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_gap), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x > 0 && (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x = 0), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x < i && (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x = i), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_left());
      else {
        if (glo.APP_FEATURE.DISABLE_DRAG_ROTATE) return;
        S_MAKETEAM.focus = S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus();
        S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num > BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? (S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus = 5, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag = 0), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x = -(S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_w + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_gap) * (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num - BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_right()) : S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus = S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_MAKETEAM.row_focus == 2) {
        r = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? 10 : 11;
        S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus = S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus >= r ? r : S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus + 1;
        console.log(S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus);
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        return
      }
      if (S_MAKETEAM.focus < S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num) S_MAKETEAM.focus = S_MAKETEAM.focus + 1, S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus(), S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus < BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus = S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus + 1 : (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag = 0), i = 0, S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num > BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN && (i = -(S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_w + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_gap) * (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num - BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN)), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x - (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_w + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_gap), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x < i && (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x = i), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x > 0 && (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x = 0), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_right());
      else {
        if (glo.APP_FEATURE.DISABLE_DRAG_ROTATE) return;
        S_MAKETEAM.focus = 1;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus();
        S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus = 1;
        S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag = 0);
        S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x = 0;
        S_MAKETEAM.scroll_left()
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_mode == 1 ? S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus >= 2 ? (S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus--, S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_submenu()) : (S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus = SUBMENU_NUM, S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_submenu()) : S_MAKETEAM.row_focus == 2 && (S_MAKETEAM.row_focus = 1, S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_mode == 1 ? S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus < SUBMENU_NUM ? (S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus++, S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_submenu()) : (S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus = 1, S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_submenu()) : S_MAKETEAM.row_focus == 1 && (S_MAKETEAM.row_focus = 2, S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus = 6, S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_btnmenu());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      if (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag === 1) return;
      S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_mode == 1 ? S_MAKETEAM.menuRun_submenu() : S_MAKETEAM.row_focus == 2 ? S_MAKETEAM.menuRun_btnmenu() : S_MAKETEAM.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_MAKETEAM.run_back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(1);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(2);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
      S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(3);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM4:
      S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(4);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM5:
      S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(5);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM6:
      S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(6);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM7:
      S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(7);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM8:
      S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(8)
  }
};
S_MAKETEAM.backKey = function() {
  S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_mode == 1 ? (S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus = 1, $("#s_maketeam_bottom_submenu").css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_mode = 0) : S_MAKETEAM.run_mainmenu()
};
S_MAKETEAM.run_mainmenu = function() {
  S_MAKETEAM.end();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU)
};
S_MAKETEAM.scroll_right = function() {
  S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_MAKETEAM.scroll_right()!!");
  S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x - S_MAKETEAM.scroll_speed * (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x - S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x);
  $("#s_maketeam_bottom").css({
    left: S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x > S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x + 4 && S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_MAKETEAM.scroll_right, 80) : (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag = 0)
};
S_MAKETEAM.scroll_left = function() {
  S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_MAKETEAM.scroll_left()!!");
  S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x + S_MAKETEAM.scroll_speed * (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x - S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x);
  $("#s_maketeam_bottom").css({
    left: S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x < S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x - 4 && S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_MAKETEAM.scroll_left, 80) : (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag = 0)
};
S_MAKETEAM.make_screen = function() {
  var t, n;
  for (util_draw_div("S_MAKETEAM_div", 0, 0, 1280, 720), t = TXT.myTeam, utilDrawImage("Img_MT_background", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/0_common/co_bg1.jpg", 0, 0, 1280, 720, "absolute"), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_MT_slot", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/7_maketeam/te_slot.png", 130, 144), $("#Img_MT_slot").css({
      "pointer-events": "none"
    }), $("#TXT_MT_subtitle").text(TXT.mycharacters + " : " + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num + "/" + STORAGE.data1.upgrade[8]), $("#TXT_MT_subtitle").css({
      display: "block",
      left: "860px",
      top: "80px",
      width: "386px",
      height: "26px",
      position: "absolute",
      "font-size": "18rem",
      "line-height": "30px",
      "text-align": "right",
      "border-radius": "2px",
      "text-shadow": "1px 1px 1px black",
      color: "white"
    }), $("#s_maketeam_bottom_submenu").css({
      display: "none"
    }), n = 1; n <= 5; n++) $("#MT_top_ch" + n).css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#s_maketeam_bottom").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_MAKETEAM.make_screen_top();
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT ? util_kt.isLowModel() ? ($("#s_maketeam_top").css({
    display: "block"
  }), blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene), gEnableKey = 1) : S_MAKETEAM.make_screen_top_ani() : ($("#s_maketeam_top").css({
    display: "block"
  }), blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene), gEnableKey = 1);
  S_MAKETEAM.make_screen_bottom();
  S_MAKETEAM.make_screen_menu();
  S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus();
  S_MAKETEAM.addMouseEvent()
};
S_MAKETEAM.make_screen_top_ani = function() {
  $("#s_maketeam_top").css({

      color: "white"
    }), n = 1; n <= 8; n++) $("#move_char_" + n + "star_btn_focus").css({

  })
};

S_MAKETEAM.menuRun_Run = function() {

    left: "29px",

  });

    "font-size": "13rem"
  });
  $("#MT_submenu_4").text(TXT.item);

S_MAKETEAM.is_evolution = function() {
  if (S_MAKETEAM.focus <= 0 || S_MAKETEAM.focus == null) return !1;
  var t = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num,
    i = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].max_level,
    r = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].cur_level,
    n = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[t].star,
    u = (n + 1) * 10,
    f = u + 20;
  return i < f ? !1 : r < i ? !1 : n == 8 && (!glo.APP_FEATURE.BOSS_2026 || S_MAKETEAM.EVO_9_STAR_LIST.indexOf(t) === -1) ? !1 : n > 8 ? !1 : !0
};
S_MAKETEAM.get_num_takepartin = function() {
  for (var n = 0, t = 1; t <= S_MAKETEAM.top_ch_num; t++) OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[t].unit_num >= 1 && n++;
  return utilConsoleLog("출전중인 캐릭터 수:" + n), n
};

S_MAKETEAM.menuRun_submenu_Run = function() {
  var n = S_MAKETEAM.focus,
    t;
  switch (S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus) {
    case 1:
      if (0 && (loading_show(), gEnableKey = 0, setTimeout(function() {
          loading_hide();
          gEnableKey = 1
        }, 200)), S_MAKETEAM.get_takepartin(n) == 1) {
        if (S_MAKETEAM.get_num_takepartin() <= 1) {
          utilNotice(TXT.last_one_no_cancel, 1.2);
          return
        }
        SOCKET.del_to_socket(n, !0);
        STORAGE.alldata_to_storage();
        loading_show("출전취소", 1);
        ServerConnection.update_data2_item("출전취소:" + n, "char_appear", function() {
          loading_hide("출전취소", 1);
          S_MAKETEAM.refresh_sub_menu(S_MAKETEAM.focus)
        })
      } else {
        t = SOCKET.add_to_socket(n, !0);
        STORAGE.alldata_to_storage();
        switch (t) {
          case 1:
            loading_show("출전", 1);
            ServerConnection.update_data2_item("출전:" + n, "char_appear", function() {
              loading_hide("출전", 1);
              S_MAKETEAM.refresh_sub_menu(S_MAKETEAM.get_num_takepartin())
            });
            break;
          case 0:
            S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus = 1;
            $("#s_maketeam_bottom_submenu").css({
              display: "none"
            });
            S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_mode = 0;
            utilConsoleLog("Socket Full...");
            utilNotice(TXT.max5, 1.2);
            break;
          case 2:
            S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus = 1;
            $("#s_maketeam_bottom_submenu").css({
              display: "none"
            });
            S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_mode = 0;
            utilNotice(TXT.only_one_sort_takepartin, 1.2);
            utilConsoleLog("Duplication not allowed. only one char slot")
        }
      }
      break;
    case 2:
      S_MAKETEAM.sell_char();
      break;
    case 3:
      if (S_MAKETEAM.is_evolution()) S_MAKETEAM.evolution();
      else {
        if (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num <= 1) {
          utilNotice(TXT.lack_char_for_levelup, 1.2);
          return
        }
        if (window.g.STAR[8].indexOf(STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num) !== -1 && STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].cur_level == 110) {
          utilNotice(TXT.select_levelup_max, 1.5);
          return
        }
        if (window.g.STAR[9].indexOf(STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num) !== -1 && STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].cur_level == 120) {
          utilNotice(TXT.select_levelup_max, 1.5);
          return
        }(gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && utilNotice2(TXT.select_levelup_char, 2.5);
        utilPush();
        S_MAKETEAM.end();
        gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_MAKETEAM_div").css({
          display: "none"
        }), $("#S_CLEVELUP_div").css({
          display: "block"
        }), S_CLEVELUP.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_CLEVELUP, S_CLEVELUP)
      }
      break;
    case 4:
      document.getElementById("S_ITEM_div") == null ? $("#S_MAKETEAM_div").after('<div id= "S_ITEM_div"><\/div>') : $("#S_ITEM_div").empty();
      utilPush();
      S_MAKETEAM.end();
      $("#S_MAKETEAM_div").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $("#S_ITEM_div").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      S_ITEM.init();
      break;
    case 5:
      STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].lock == 0 ? (STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].lock = 1, loading_show("캐릭터 잠금", 1), ServerConnection.update_data2_item("캐릭터 잠금 캐릭터 번호 (" + STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].char_num + ")", "char_lock", function() {
        loading_hide("캐릭터 잠금", 1);
        $("#Img_MT_bottom_lock_icon" + S_MAKETEAM.focus).css({
          display: "block"
        });
        S_MAKETEAM.run_back()
      })) : (STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].lock = 0, loading_show("캐릭터 잠금해체", 1), ServerConnection.update_data2_item("캐릭터 잠금해체 캐릭터 번호 (" + STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].char_num + ")", "char_lock", function() {
        loading_hide("캐릭터 잠금해체", 1);
        $("#Img_MT_bottom_lock_icon" + S_MAKETEAM.focus).css({
          display: "none"
        });
        S_MAKETEAM.run_back()
      }));
      break;
    case 6:
      S_MAKETEAM.run_back();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_MAKETEAM.menuRun_submenu():" + S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus)
  }
};
S_MAKETEAM.refresh_sub_menu = function(n) {
  S_MAKETEAM.make_screen_top();
  S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus = 1;
  $("#s_maketeam_bottom_submenu").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_mode = 0;
  S_MAKETEAM.removeMouseEvent();
  S_MAKETEAM.define();
  S_MAKETEAM.focus = n;
  S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus = n;
  S_MAKETEAM.make_screen_bottom();
  S_MAKETEAM.addMouseEvent();
  $("#MT_bottom_fo" + S_MAKETEAM.focus).css({
    display: "block"
  })
};

      } else S_MAKETEAM.end(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MODE_SELECT, S_MODE_SELECT);
      break;

        S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(6);
        break
      } else {
        S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(5);
        break
      }
    case 9:
      if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO) {
        S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(7);

      } else {
        S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(6);
        break
      }
    case 10:
      if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO) {
        S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(8);
        break
      } else {
        S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(7);
        break
      }
    case 11:
      if (gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO) {
        S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(8);
        break
      }
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_MAKETEAM.menuRun_btnmenu():" + S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus)
  }
};
S_MAKETEAM.get_takepartin = function(n) {
  for (var t = 1; t <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; t++)
    if (n == OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[t].index) return 1;
  return 0
};
S_MAKETEAM.get_maketeam_bottom_char_num = function() {
  for (var t = 0, n = 1; n <= DEFINE.USER_STORAGE_MAX; n++)
    if (STORAGE.data2[n].ch_num >= 1) t++;
    else break;
  return t
};
S_MAKETEAM.evolution = function() {
  var t, i, n;
  if (CAL.char_use_item(S_MAKETEAM.focus) == 1) {
    USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("아이템을 사용중인 캐릭터는 진화 할수 없습니다.", 1.2) : utilNotice("Unable to evolution a character using an item", 1.2);
    return
  }
  for (t = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num, i = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[t].star, S_MAKETEAM.evolution_gold = i * 5e3, S_MAKETEAM.removeMouseEvent(), n = 1; n <= S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num; n++) $("#MT_bottom_fo" + n).css({
    display: "none"
  });
  utilPush();
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
    display: "block"

S_MAKETEAM.evolution_8_star = function() {
  var n, i, t;
  if (!glo.APP_FEATURE.CLOUD_GARDEN) {
    utilNotice("[오류] 캐릭터 8성 진화 오류", 1.5);
    S_MAKETEAM.addMouseEvent();
    gEnableKey = 1;
    return
  }
  if (gEnableKey = 0, n = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num, i = CAL.evolution_result(n), CHAR_OUR_TEAM[n].star != 7) {
    utilNotice("[오류] 캐릭터 7성만 진화 가능", 1.5);
    S_MAKETEAM.addMouseEvent();
    gEnableKey = 1;
    return
  }
  if (USER.cloud_piece < S_CLOUD_GARDEN.cloud_piece_evo_8) {
    utilNotice(TXT.cloud_pieces_lack, 1.5);
    S_MAKETEAM.addMouseEvent();
    gEnableKey = 1;
    return
  }
  loading_show();
  t = {
    MODE: "CHAR_EVO_8",
    ADD_PIECE: S_CLOUD_GARDEN.cloud_piece_evo_8,
    ETC: "캐릭터 " + n + "번 8성 진화로 " + S_CLOUD_GARDEN.cloud_piece_evo_8 + "구름조각 소모"
  };
  ServerConnection.edit_cloud_garden(t, function(n) {
    loading_hide();
    USER.cloud_piece = Number(n.tot_piece);
    S_MAKETEAM.evolution_yes()
  })
};

S_MAKETEAM.evolution_yes = function() {
  var f, e, c, r, l, i, a, v, n, y, t, u, o, s, h;
  if (gEnableKey = 0, utilConsoleLog("진화~~~: yes~"), f = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num, e = S_MAKETEAM.evolution_gold, CHAR_OUR_TEAM[f].star < 7) {
    if (c = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[f].star - 1, e < c * 5e3 && ServerConnection.put_black_list_myid("진화 금액이 다릅니다. unit_num:" + f + " 정상 진화 골드 : " + c * 5e3 + " 유저가 소모한 진화 골드 : " + e), get_cur_gold() < e) {
      utilNotice(TXT.gold_lack, 1.5);
      S_MAKETEAM.addMouseEvent();
      gEnableKey = 1;
      return
    }
    USER.gold = USER.gold - e;
    glo.APP_FEATURE.GOLD_CRYPT && encoding_add_gold(-e)
  }
  if (r = CAL.evolution_result(f), S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top(), r == 0) utilConsoleLog("Error!"), gEnableKey = 1;
  else {
    for (S_MAKETEAM.e_unit_num = r, ally_charbook_list_add_check(S_MAKETEAM.e_unit_num), STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num = r, STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].cur_level = 1, STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].max_level = (CHAR_OUR_TEAM[r].star + 1) * 10, STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].exp = 0, l = 0, n = 1; n <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; n++)
      if (OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].unit_num == r) {
        l = 1;
        break
      } if (S_EVOLUTION_COMPLETE.special_tag = 0, l == 0) {
      for (n = 1; n <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; n++)
        if (OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].index == S_MAKETEAM.focus) {
          OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].unit_num = r;
          SOCKET.storage_ch_to_socket(n, S_MAKETEAM.focus);
          break
        }
    } else
      for (n = 1; n <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; n++)
        if (OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].index == S_MAKETEAM.focus) {
          SOCKET.del_to_socket(S_MAKETEAM.focus, !0);
          S_EVOLUTION_COMPLETE.special_tag = 1;
          break
        } if (S_MAKETEAM.evolution_ani(), S_MAKETEAM.get_takepartin(S_MAKETEAM.focus) == 0)
      for (i = {}, i.ch_num = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num, i.cur_level = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].cur_level, i.max_level = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].max_level, i.exp = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].exp, i.lock = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].lock, glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING && (i.ch_id = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_id), a = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[r].star, v = S_MAKETEAM.get_num_takepartin(), n = v + 1; n <= S_MAKETEAM.focus - 1; n++)
        if (y = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[STORAGE.data2[n].ch_num].star, a > y) {
          for (t = S_MAKETEAM.focus; t > n; t--) STORAGE.data2[t].ch_num = STORAGE.data2[t - 1].ch_num, STORAGE.data2[t].cur_level = STORAGE.data2[t - 1].cur_level, STORAGE.data2[t].max_level = STORAGE.data2[t - 1].max_level, STORAGE.data2[t].exp = STORAGE.data2[t - 1].exp, STORAGE.data2[t].lock = STORAGE.data2[t - 1].lock, glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING && (STORAGE.data2[t].ch_id = STORAGE.data2[t - 1].ch_id);
          STORAGE.data2[n].ch_num = i.ch_num;
          STORAGE.data2[n].cur_level = i.cur_level;
          STORAGE.data2[n].max_level = i.max_level;
          STORAGE.data2[n].exp = i.exp;
          STORAGE.data2[n].lock = i.lock;
          glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING && (STORAGE.data2[n].ch_id = i.ch_id);
          S_MAKETEAM.focus = n;
          break
        } if (AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[8] == 1) {
      u = 0;
      o = "";
      switch (CHAR_OUR_TEAM[S_MAKETEAM.e_unit_num].star) {
        case 2:
          u = 3;
          break;
        case 3:
          u = 5;
          break;
        case 4:
          u = 10;
          break;
        case 5:
          u = 15;
          break;
        case 6:
          u = 20;
          break;
        case 7:
          u = 30;
          break;
        case 8:
          u = 70;
          break;
        case 9:
          u = 100
      }
      USER.lang != LANG.KOREA ? (utilNotice("Character evolution event rewards have been sent to your mailbox.", 3), o = "Evolution Event Reward") : (utilNotice("캐릭터 진화 이벤트 보상은 우편함으로 지급되었습니다.", 3), o = "캐릭터 진화 이벤트");
      glo.VER_DATE < "20260724" && ServerConnection.put_reward_char("RUBY", o, u);
      update_user_to_server_acc(o + "로 루비 :" + u + " 획득(우편함으로지급)")
    }
  }
  STORAGE.alldata_to_storage();
  s = 0;
  loading_show("진화", 1);
  h = 1;
  ServerConnection.update_data2_item("진화(" + f + ">" + r + ")|CHAR|" + f + "|" + r, "char_evo", function() {
    s++;
    s == h && loading_hide("진화", 1)
  });
  CHAR_OUR_TEAM[f].star < 7 && (h = 2, STORAGE.save_all_info_to_storage("진화(" + f + ">" + r + ")로" + e + "골드소모|GOLD|" + -e + "|" + USER.gold, 0, "char_evo_gold", function() {
    s++;
    s == h && loading_hide("진화", 1)
  }))
};

S_MAKETEAM.focus_move = function(n) {
  var i, t;
  if (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag == 1) {
    USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("카드 이동중에는 사용할 수 없습니다.", 2) : utilNotice("Not available while card is moving.", 2);
    return
  }
  for (i = -1, t = 1; t <= STORAGE.data1.upgrade[8]; t++) S_MAKETEAM.get_takepartin(t) == 1 || n == CHAR_OUR_TEAM[STORAGE.data2[t].ch_num].star && (i = t, t = STORAGE.data1.upgrade[8] + 1);
  if (n == 0 && (i = 1), console.log("focus_move type:", n, "move_focus:", i), i == -1) {
    USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("이동 가능한 캐릭터가 없습니다.", 2) : utilNotice("Character does not exist.", 2);
    return
  }
  S_MAKETEAM.row_focus = 1;
  S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_btnmenu();
  S_MAKETEAM.focus = i;
  S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus();
  S_MAKETEAM.refocus();
  $("#s_maketeam_bottom").css({
    left: S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  n == 0 ? USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("출전 캐릭으로 이동하였습니다.", 2) : utilNotice("Move is complete.", 2) : USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice(n + "성 캐릭으로 이동하였습니다.", 2) : utilNotice("Move to " + n + "star is complete.", 2)
};

};

};
S_MAKETEAM.onClick = function(n) {
  var t, r, i, u, f;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (utilConsoleLog("1-onClick  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } switch (n.target.id) {
      case "Img_MT_top_ch1":
      case "Img_MT_top_ch2":
      case "Img_MT_top_ch3":
      case "Img_MT_top_ch4":
      case "Img_MT_top_ch5":
        if (S_MAKETEAM.get_num_takepartin() <= 1) {
          utilNotice(TXT.last_one_no_cancel, 1.2);
          return
        }
        r = parseInt(n.target.id.replace("Img_MT_top_ch", ""));
        i = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[r].index;
        SOCKET.del_to_socket(i, !0);
        STORAGE.alldata_to_storage();
        loading_show("출전취소", 1);
        ServerConnection.update_data2_item("출전취소:" + i, "char_appear", function() {
          loading_hide("출전취소", 1);
          S_MAKETEAM.make_screen_top();
          S_MAKETEAM.make_screen_bottom();
          S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus()
        });
        break;
      case "s_maketeam_bottom_submenu":
      case "MT_submenu_1":
      case "MT_submenu_2":
      case "MT_submenu_3":
      case "MT_submenu_4":
      case "MT_submenu_5":
      case "MT_submenu_6":
        S_MAKETEAM.menuRun_submenu();
        return;
      case "Img_MT_base_btn_focus":
        S_MAKETEAM.menuRun_btnmenu_Run();
        return;
      case "move_char_1star_btn":
      case "move_char_1star_btn_img":
      case "move_char_1star_btn_focus":
      case "move_char_1star_btn_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(1);
        return;
      case "move_char_2star_btn":
      case "move_char_2star_btn_img":
      case "move_char_2star_btn_focus":
      case "move_char_2star_btn_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(2);
        return;
      case "move_char_3star_btn":
      case "move_char_3star_btn_img":
      case "move_char_3star_btn_focus":
      case "move_char_3star_btn_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(3);
        return;
      case "move_char_4star_btn":
      case "move_char_4star_btn_img":
      case "move_char_4star_btn_focus":
      case "move_char_4star_btn_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(4);
        return;
      case "move_char_5star_btn":
      case "move_char_5star_btn_img":
      case "move_char_5star_btn_focus":
      case "move_char_5star_btn_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(5);
        return;
      case "move_char_6star_btn":
      case "move_char_6star_btn_img":
      case "move_char_6star_btn_focus":
      case "move_char_6star_btn_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(6);
        return;
      case "move_char_7star_btn":
      case "move_char_7star_btn_img":
      case "move_char_7star_btn_focus":
      case "move_char_7star_btn_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(7);
        return;
      case "move_char_8star_btn":
      case "move_char_8star_btn_img":
      case "move_char_8star_btn_focus":
      case "move_char_8star_btn_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.focus_move(8);
        return;
      case "back_button":
      case "Img_MT_back_bg":
      case "Txt_MT_back_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.run_mainmenu();
        return;
      case "draw_button":
      case "Img_MT_draw_bg":
      case "Img_MT_draw_card":
      case "Txt_MT_draw_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.end();
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GACHA, S_GACHA);
        return;
      case "start_button":
      case "Img_MT_start_bg":
      case "Txt_MT_start_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.end();
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MODE_SELECT, S_MODE_SELECT)
    }
    n.target.id.substring(0, 9) == "MT_cover_" && (u = n.target.id.substring(9), f = parseInt(u, 10), S_MAKETEAM.menuRun())
  }
};
S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover = function(n) {
  var i, t, r;
  if (console.log("onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), gMOUSE_USE) {
    switch (n.target.id) {
      case "s_maketeam_bottom_submenu":
        return;
      case "MT_submenu_1":
        S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus = 1;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_submenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("MT_submenu_1");
        return;
      case "MT_submenu_2":
        S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus = 2;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_submenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("MT_submenu_2");
        return;
      case "MT_submenu_3":
        S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus = 3;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_submenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("MT_submenu_3");
        return;
      case "MT_submenu_4":
        S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus = 4;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_submenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("MT_submenu_4");
        return;
      case "MT_submenu_5":
        S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus = 5;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_submenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("MT_submenu_5");
        return;
      case "MT_submenu_6":
        S_MAKETEAM.sub_menu_focus = 6;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_submenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("MT_submenu_6");
        return;
      case "move_char_1star_btn":
      case "move_char_1star_btn_img":
      case "move_char_1star_btn_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.row_focus = 2;
        S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus = 1;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("move_char_1star_btn");
        return;
      case "move_char_2star_btn":
      case "move_char_2star_btn_img":
      case "move_char_2star_btn_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.row_focus = 2;
        S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus = 2;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("move_char_2star_btn");
        return;
      case "move_char_3star_btn":
      case "move_char_3star_btn_img":
      case "move_char_3star_btn_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.row_focus = 2;
        S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus = 3;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("move_char_3star_btn");
        return;
      case "move_char_4star_btn":
      case "move_char_4star_btn_img":
      case "move_char_4star_btn_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.row_focus = 2;
        S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus = 4;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("move_char_4star_btn");
        return;
      case "back_button":
      case "Img_MT_back_bg":
      case "Txt_MT_back_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.row_focus = 2;
        S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus = 5;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("back_button");
        return;
      case "draw_button":
      case "Img_MT_draw_bg":
      case "Img_MT_draw_card":
      case "Txt_MT_draw_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.row_focus = 2;
        S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? 5 : 6;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("draw_button");
        return;
      case "start_button":
      case "Img_MT_start_bg":
      case "Txt_MT_start_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.row_focus = 2;
        S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? 6 : 7;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("start_button");
        return;
      case "move_char_5star_btn":
      case "move_char_5star_btn_img":
      case "move_char_5star_btn_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.row_focus = 2;
        S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? 7 : 8;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("move_char_5star_btn");
        return;
      case "move_char_6star_btn":
      case "move_char_6star_btn_img":
      case "move_char_6star_btn_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.row_focus = 2;
        S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? 8 : 9;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("move_char_6star_btn");
        return;
      case "move_char_7star_btn":
      case "move_char_7star_btn_img":
      case "move_char_7star_btn_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.row_focus = 2;
        S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? 9 : 10;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("move_char_7star_btn");
        return;
      case "move_char_8star_btn":
      case "move_char_8star_btn_img":
      case "move_char_8star_btn_text":
        S_MAKETEAM.row_focus = 2;
        S_MAKETEAM.btn_focus = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? 10 : 11;
        S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("move_char_8star_btn");
        return
    }
    if (n.target.id.substring(0, 9) != "MT_cover_") {
      utilConsoleLog("해당 id는 무시:" + n.target.id);
      return
    }
    if (S_MAKETEAM.row_focus = 1, i = n.target.id.substring(9), t = parseInt(i, 10), isNaN(t)) {
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover() : focus is NaN");
      return
    }
    r = Math.floor(S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x * -1 / (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_w + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_gap)) + 1;
    S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus = S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus + (t - S_MAKETEAM.focus);
    S_MAKETEAM.focus = t;
    S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus();
    S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover_pressed("MT_bottom_ch" + t)
  }
};

  utilConsoleLog(" S_MAKETEAM.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);

  return
};
S_MAKETEAM.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_MAKETEAM.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_MAKETEAM.onMouseover(n);
  S_MAKETEAM.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_MAKETEAM.mousedrag_right_to_left = function() {
  if ((utilConsoleLog("S_MAKETEAM.mousedrag_right_to_left()#############################"), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag != 1) && !(S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num <= BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN)) {
    var t = (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_w + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_gap) * (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num - BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1,
      i = (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_w + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_gap) * (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num - BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1 - S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x,
      r = Math.abs(Math.floor(i / (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_w + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_gap))),
      n = BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN - 1,
      u = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x - (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_w + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_gap) * n;
    if (u < t && (n = r), S_MAKETEAM.focus < S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num) {
      if (S_MAKETEAM.focus = S_MAKETEAM.focus + n, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag = 0), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x - (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_w + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_gap) * n, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_right(), gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.CRAZY_GAME && gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.AMO) {
        if (glo.APP_FEATURE.DISABLE_DRAG_ROTATE) return;
        S_MAKETEAM.before_scroll_target_x == t && S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x == t ? (S_MAKETEAM.focus = 1, S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus(), S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus = 1, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag = 0), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x = 0, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_left()) : (S_MAKETEAM.before_scroll_target_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_right())
      }
    } else if (gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.CRAZY_GAME && gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.AMO) {
      if (glo.APP_FEATURE.DISABLE_DRAG_ROTATE) return;
      S_MAKETEAM.focus = 1;
      S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus();
      S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus = 1;
      S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag = 0);
      S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x = 0;
      S_MAKETEAM.before_scroll_target_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x;
      S_MAKETEAM.scroll_left()
    }
  }
};
S_MAKETEAM.mousedrag_left_to_right = function() {
  if ((utilConsoleLog("S_MAKETEAM.mousedrag_left_to_right()#############################"), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag != 1) && !(S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num <= BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN)) {
    var n = S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_w + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_gap,
      i = n * (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num - BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1,
      r = 0 - S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x,
      u = Math.abs(Math.floor(r / n)),
      t = BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN - 1,
      f = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x + n * t;
    if (f > 0 && (t = u), S_MAKETEAM.focus > 1) {
      if (S_MAKETEAM.focus = S_MAKETEAM.focus - t, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag = 0), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x + n * t, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_left(), gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.CRAZY_GAME && gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.AMO) {
        if (glo.APP_FEATURE.DISABLE_DRAG_ROTATE) return;
        S_MAKETEAM.before_scroll_target_x == 0 && S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x == 0 ? (S_MAKETEAM.focus = S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num, S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus(), S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus = S_MAKETEAM.focus, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag = 0), S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x = i, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_right()) : (S_MAKETEAM.before_scroll_target_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_left())
      }
    } else if (gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.CRAZY_GAME && gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.AMO) {
      if (glo.APP_FEATURE.DISABLE_DRAG_ROTATE) return;
      S_MAKETEAM.focus = S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num;
      S_MAKETEAM.drawFocus();
      S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus = S_MAKETEAM.focus;
      S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag = 0);
      S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x = i;
      S_MAKETEAM.before_scroll_target_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_target_x;
      S_MAKETEAM.scroll_right()
    }
  }
};
S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_start = function(n, t) {
  var r, u, i;
  S_MAKETEAM.scroll_flag != 1 && S_MAKETEAM.get_takepartin(t) != 1 && (r = n.touches ? n.touches[0] : n, S_MAKETEAM.drag_start_x = r.clientX, S_MAKETEAM.drag_start_y = r.clientY, S_MAKETEAM.drag_char_index = t, document.addEventListener("mousemove", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_move_handler, {
    passive: !1
  }), document.addEventListener("mouseup", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_end_handler, {
    passive: !1
  }), document.addEventListener("touchmove", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_move_handler, {
    passive: !1
  }), document.addEventListener("touchend", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_end_handler, {
    passive: !1
  }), document.addEventListener("contextmenu", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_contextmenu, !0), console.log("on_drag_start 진입!", "char_index : ", t, "mouse or touch :", n.type, "gMOUSE_USE : ", gMOUSE_USE, "gEnableKey : ", gEnableKey), u = document.getElementById("MT_bottom_ch" + t), u ? (i = u.getBoundingClientRect(), S_MAKETEAM.drag_card_left = i.left, S_MAKETEAM.drag_card_top = i.top, S_MAKETEAM.drag_card_right = i.right, S_MAKETEAM.drag_card_bottom = i.bottom) : (S_MAKETEAM.drag_card_left = S_MAKETEAM.drag_start_x, S_MAKETEAM.drag_card_top = S_MAKETEAM.drag_start_y, S_MAKETEAM.drag_card_right = S_MAKETEAM.drag_start_x + 100, S_MAKETEAM.drag_card_bottom = S_MAKETEAM.drag_start_y + 100), S_MAKETEAM.drag_press_time = setTimeout(function() {
    var r, i, n;
    console.log("0.3초 경과 - 클론 생성");
    S_MAKETEAM.drag_is_dragging = !0;
    r = "Img_MT_bottom_icon" + t;
    i = document.getElementById(r);
    i && (n = i.cloneNode(!0), n.id = "MT_drag_clone", $(n).css({
      position: "fixed",
      opacity: .7,
      left: "0px",
      top: "0px",
      transform: "translate(" + (S_MAKETEAM.drag_start_x - 80) + "px, " + (S_MAKETEAM.drag_start_y - 50) + "px)",
      "pointer-events": "none"
    }), document.body.appendChild(n), S_MAKETEAM.drag_element = n, S_MAKETEAM.drag_started = !0)
  }, 300))
};
S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_move = function(n) {
  console.log("on_drag_move", n.type);
  var r = n.touches ? n.touches[0] : n,
    t = r.clientX,
    i = r.clientY;
  if (!S_MAKETEAM.drag_is_dragging) {
    if (t < S_MAKETEAM.drag_card_left || t > S_MAKETEAM.drag_card_right || i < S_MAKETEAM.drag_card_top || i > S_MAKETEAM.drag_card_bottom) {
      console.log("카드 영역 밖으로 나감 - 타이머 취소");
      S_MAKETEAM.drag_press_time && (clearTimeout(S_MAKETEAM.drag_press_time), S_MAKETEAM.drag_press_time = null);
      document.removeEventListener("mousemove", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_move_handler, {
        passive: !1
      });
      document.removeEventListener("mouseup", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_end_handler, {
        passive: !1
      });
      document.removeEventListener("touchmove", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_move_handler, {
        passive: !1
      });
      document.removeEventListener("touchend", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_end_handler, {
        passive: !1
      });
      document.removeEventListener("contextmenu", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_contextmenu, !0);
      S_MAKETEAM.drag_char_index = -1;
      S_MAKETEAM.drag_started = !1;
      return
    }
    return
  }
  S_MAKETEAM.drag_element && $(S_MAKETEAM.drag_element).css({
    transform: "translate(" + (t - 80) + "px, " + (i - 50) + "px)"
  })
};
S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_end = function(n) {
  var h, i, r, t, u;
  if (console.log("on_drag_end", n.type), S_MAKETEAM.drag_element && (document.body.removeChild(S_MAKETEAM.drag_element), S_MAKETEAM.drag_element = null), S_MAKETEAM.drag_press_time && (clearTimeout(S_MAKETEAM.drag_press_time), S_MAKETEAM.drag_press_time = null), !S_MAKETEAM.drag_is_dragging) {
    S_MAKETEAM.drag_char_index = -1;
    S_MAKETEAM.drag_started = !1;
    return
  }
  if (S_MAKETEAM.drag_is_dragging) {
    var f = n.changedTouches ? n.changedTouches[0] : n,
      e = f.clientX,
      o = f.clientY,
      s = !1;
    if (S_MAKETEAM.drag_started) {
      for (t = 1; t <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; t++)
        if (h = document.getElementById("MT_top_ch" + t), i = h.getBoundingClientRect(), e >= i.left && e <= i.right && o >= i.top && o <= i.bottom) {
          for (is_dropped_on_socket = !0, r = !1, t = 1; t <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; t++)
            if (OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[t].unit_num < 1) {
              r = !0;
              break
            } if (!r) {
            utilNotice(TXT.max5, 1.2);
            utilConsoleLog("Socket Full... (드래그 출전: 빈 소켓 없음)");
            S_MAKETEAM.drag_is_dragging = !1;
            S_MAKETEAM.drag_char_index = -1;
            S_MAKETEAM.drag_started = !1;
            return
          }
          if (u = S_MAKETEAM.add_char_to_socket(S_MAKETEAM.drag_char_index), u === 1) break;
          if (u === 2) {
            s = !0;
            break
          }
        } s == !0 && (utilNotice(TXT.only_one_sort_takepartin, 1.2), utilConsoleLog("Duplication not allowed. only one char slot"))
    }
    document.removeEventListener("mousemove", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_move_handler, {
      passive: !1
    });
    document.removeEventListener("mouseup", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_end_handler, {
      passive: !1
    });
    document.removeEventListener("touchmove", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_move_handler, {
      passive: !1
    });
    document.removeEventListener("touchend", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_end_handler, {
      passive: !1
    });
    document.removeEventListener("contextmenu", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_contextmenu, !0);
    S_MAKETEAM.drag_is_dragging = !1;
    S_MAKETEAM.drag_char_index = -1;
    S_MAKETEAM.drag_started = !1
  }

S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_contextmenu = function(n) {
  if (n.preventDefault(), S_MAKETEAM.drag_element) {
    try {
      document.body.removeChild(S_MAKETEAM.drag_element)
    } catch (n) {}
    S_MAKETEAM.drag_element = null
  }
  S_MAKETEAM.drag_is_dragging = !1;
  S_MAKETEAM.drag_char_index = -1;
  S_MAKETEAM.drag_started = !1;
  document.removeEventListener("mousemove", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_move_handler, {
    passive: !1
  });
  document.removeEventListener("mouseup", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_end_handler, {
    passive: !1
  });
  document.removeEventListener("touchmove", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_move_handler, {
    passive: !1
  });
  document.removeEventListener("touchend", S_MAKETEAM.on_drag_end_handler, {
    passive: !1
  });
  S_MAKETEAM.drag_press_time && (clearTimeout(S_MAKETEAM.drag_press_time), S_MAKETEAM.drag_press_time = null)
};
