glo.char = function() {
  function u(n) {
    var t = STORAGE.data2[n];
    return t.ch_num + ":" + t.cur_level + ":" + t.max_level + ":" + t.exp + ":" + t.lock + ":" + t.ch_id
  }
  var n = {},
    i = 200,
    t = [],
    r = function() {
      t = [];
      for (var n = i; n >= 1; n--) t.push(n)
    },
    f = function() {
      for (var t, r = {}, u = STORAGE.data2.length, n = 1; n < u; n++) STORAGE.data2[n] && STORAGE.data2[n].ch_id > 0 && (r[STORAGE.data2[n].ch_id] = 1);
      for (t = 1; t <= i; t++)
        if (!r[t]) return t;
      return i
    };
  return n.rebuild_pool = function() {
    for (var r, u = {}, f = STORAGE.data2.length, n = 1; n < f; n++) STORAGE.data2[n] && STORAGE.data2[n].ch_id > 0 && (u[STORAGE.data2[n].ch_id] = 1);
    for (t = [], r = i; r >= 1; r--) u[r] || t.push(r)
  }, n.init = function() {
    r()
  }, n.get_index_by_value = function(n) {
    for (var i = 0; i < t.length; i++)
      if (parseInt(n) === t[i]) return i;
    return -1
  }, n.mapping_char_id = function(i, r) {
    if (parseInt(i) === 0) {
      r && (r.ch_id = 0);
      return
    }
    var u = n.get_index_by_value(i);
    u === -1 ? (console.error("[DEV_LOG] glo.char.mapping_char_id() ch_id(" + i + ") is not find"), r.ch_id = 0) : r && (t.splice(u, 1), r.ch_id = parseInt(i))
  }, n.mapping_pop = function(n) {
    if (n.ch_num > 0) {
      var i = t.pop();
      typeof i == "undefined" && (i = f(), console.error("[DEV_LOG] glo.char.mapping_pop() char_ids pool empty -> recover ch_id:" + i));
      n.ch_id = i
    } else console.error("glo.char.mapping_pop() char_one.ch_num(" + n.ch_num + ") is 0")
  }, n.push = function(r) {
    var u = parseInt(r),
      f;
    if (isNaN(u) || u < 1 || u > i) {
      console.error("[DEV_LOG] glo.char.push() invalid ch_id(" + r + ") ignored");
      return
    }
    f = n.get_index_by_value(u);
    f === -1 ? t.push(u) : console.error("glo.char.push() ch_id(" + r + ") is duplicated")
  }, n.find_char_index = function(n) {
    for (var i = -1, r = STORAGE.data2.length, n = parseInt(n), t = 1; t < r; t++)
      if (STORAGE.data2[t].ch_id === n) {
        i = t;
        break
      } return i
  }, n.find_char_id = function(n) {
    var t = STORAGE.data2.length;
    return n > 0 && n < t ? STORAGE.data2[n].ch_id : (console.error("glo.char.find_char_id() ch_index(" + n + ") is over char_length(" + t + ")"), 0)
  }, n.reset_item = function() {
    for (var t, i, n = 1; n <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX; n++) STORAGE.item[n].add_option_reset_num > 0 ? (t = glo.char.find_char_index(STORAGE.item[n].add_option_reset_num), t < 0 ? (STORAGE.item[n].socket_index = 0, STORAGE.item[n].add_option_reset_num = 0) : STORAGE.item[n].socket_index = t) : STORAGE.item[n].socket_index > 0 && (i = glo.char.find_char_id(STORAGE.item[n].socket_index), STORAGE.item[n].add_option_reset_num = i)
  }, n.is_new_char = function(n) {
    var t = 0;
    return t = STORAGE.data2[n].is_new, STORAGE.data2[n].is_new = 0, t
  }, n.equip_item_to_char = function(n, t) {
    n = parseInt(n);
    t = parseInt(t);
    var i = STORAGE.data2.length,
      r = STORAGE.item.length;
    t > 0 && t < i && n > 0 && n < r ? (STORAGE.item[n].socket_index = t, STORAGE.item[n].add_option_reset_num = STORAGE.data2[t].ch_id) : console.error("glo.char.equip_item_to_char() item_index(" + n + ") <= 0 or over item_length(" + r + "),  ch_index(" + t + ") <= 0 or over char_length(" + i + ")")
  }, n.unequip_item_from_char = function(n) {
    n = parseInt(n);
    var t = STORAGE.item.length;
    n > 0 && n < t ? (STORAGE.item[n].socket_index = 0, STORAGE.item[n].add_option_reset_num = 0) : console.error("glo.char.equip_item_to_char() item_index(" + n + ") <= 0 or over item_length(" + t + ")")
  }, n.get_decks = function() {
    var r = [],
      i = n.get_deck_count(),
      t, f;
    if (i === 1) return u(i);
    for (t = 1; t <= i; t++) f = u(t), r.push(f);
    return r.join(",")
  }, n.get_deck_items = function() {
    for (var i, u, r = [], f = n.get_deck_count(), t = 1; t <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX; t++) i = STORAGE.item[t].socket_index, i >= 1 && i <= f && (u = STORAGE.make_item_index(t), r.push(u));
    return r.join(",")
  }, n.get_deck_count = function() {
    for (var n = STORAGE.data1.selected_user, t = 0; t < n.length; t++)(n[t] === "" || n[t] === null || typeof n[t] == "undefined") && (n[t] = 0);
    return Math.max.apply(null, n)
  }, n.extract_character_numbers = function(n) {
    for (var i, r = [], u = n.split(","), t = 0; t < u.length; t++) i = u[t].split(":"), i.length > 0 && r.push(i[0]);
    return r
  }, r(), n
}();

S_CLEVELUP.define = function() {
  S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num = S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num - 1;
  S_CLEVELUP.top_ch_num = 3;
  S_CLEVELUP.focus = 1;
  S_CLEVELUP.abs_focus = 1;
  S_CLEVELUP.sub_menu_focus = 1;
  S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x = 0;
  S_CLEVELUP.sub_menu_mode = 0;
  S_CLEVELUP.row_focus = 1;
  S_CLEVELUP.select_char_array = [-1, 0, 0, 0, 0]
};
BTN_ORDER = [3, 4, 5, 6, 1, 2, 7, 8, 9, 10];
S_CLEVELUP.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var u = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    r, i;
  switch (u) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_CLEVELUP.sub_menu_mode == 1) return;
      if (S_CLEVELUP.row_focus == 2) {
        for (i = -1, r = 0; r < BTN_ORDER.length; r++)
          if (BTN_ORDER[r] === S_CLEVELUP.btn_focus) {
            i = r;
            break
          } i < 0 ? i = 0 : i > 0 && (i = i - 1);
        S_CLEVELUP.btn_focus = BTN_ORDER[i];
        S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        return
      }
      S_CLEVELUP.focus >= 2 ? (S_CLEVELUP.focus = S_CLEVELUP.focus - 1, S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus(), S_CLEVELUP.abs_focus >= 2 ? S_CLEVELUP.abs_focus = S_CLEVELUP.abs_focus - 1 : (S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag = 0), S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x + (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_w + S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_gap), S_CLEVELUP.scroll_left())) : (S_CLEVELUP.focus = S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num, S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus(), S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num > S_CLEVELUP.BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? (S_CLEVELUP.abs_focus = 5, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag = 0), S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x = -(S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_w + S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_gap) * (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num - S_CLEVELUP.BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN), S_CLEVELUP.scroll_right()) : S_CLEVELUP.abs_focus = S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_CLEVELUP.sub_menu_mode == 1) return;
      if (S_CLEVELUP.row_focus == 2) {
        for (i = -1, r = 0; r < BTN_ORDER.length; r++)
          if (BTN_ORDER[r] === S_CLEVELUP.btn_focus) {
            i = r;
            break
          } i < 0 ? i = 0 : i < BTN_ORDER.length - 1 && (i = i + 1);
        S_CLEVELUP.btn_focus = BTN_ORDER[i];
        S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        return
      }
      S_CLEVELUP.focus < S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num ? (S_CLEVELUP.focus = S_CLEVELUP.focus + 1, S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus(), S_CLEVELUP.abs_focus < S_CLEVELUP.BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? S_CLEVELUP.abs_focus = S_CLEVELUP.abs_focus + 1 : (S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag = 0), S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x - (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_w + S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_gap), S_CLEVELUP.scroll_right())) : (S_CLEVELUP.focus = 1, S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus(), S_CLEVELUP.abs_focus = 1, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag = 0), S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x = 0, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_left());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_CLEVELUP.sub_menu_mode == 1 ? S_CLEVELUP.sub_menu_focus >= 2 && (S_CLEVELUP.sub_menu_focus--, S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus_submenu()) : S_CLEVELUP.row_focus == 2 && (S_CLEVELUP.row_focus = 1, S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_CLEVELUP.sub_menu_mode == 1 ? S_CLEVELUP.sub_menu_focus < S_CLEVELUP.SUBMENU_NUM && (S_CLEVELUP.sub_menu_focus++, S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus_submenu()) : S_CLEVELUP.row_focus == 1 && (S_CLEVELUP.row_focus = 2, S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus_btnmenu());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_CLEVELUP.row_focus == 2 ? S_CLEVELUP.menuRun_btnmenu() : S_CLEVELUP.select_char();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_CLEVELUP.run_back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      S_CLEVELUP.focus_move(1);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      S_CLEVELUP.focus_move(2);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
      S_CLEVELUP.focus_move(3);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM4:
      S_CLEVELUP.focus_move(4);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM5:
      S_CLEVELUP.focus_move(5);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM6:
      S_CLEVELUP.focus_move(6);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM7:
      S_CLEVELUP.focus_move(7);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM8:
      S_CLEVELUP.focus_move(8)
  }
};
S_CLEVELUP.star_based_max_level = function(n) {
  switch (n) {
    case 1:
      return 40;
    case 2:
      return 50;
    case 3:
      return 60;
    case 4:
      return 70;
    case 5:
      return 80;
    case 6:
      return 90;
    case 7:
      return 100;
    case 8:
      return 110;
    case 9:
      return 120
  }
};
S_CLEVELUP.select_char = function() {
  for (var i, h, s, a, y, p, c, l, v, w, n, b, f, e = 1; e <= 4; e++)
    if (S_CLEVELUP.select_char_array[e] == S_CLEVELUP.focus) {
      for (i = e; i <= 4; i++) S_CLEVELUP.select_char_array[i] = i == 4 ? 0 : S_CLEVELUP.select_char_array[i + 1];
      $("#Img_CL_bottom_checkbox_select" + S_CLEVELUP.focus).css({
        display: "none"
      });
      S_CLEVELUP.make_screen_top();
      return
    } var r = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].cur_level,
    t = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].max_level,
    u = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num,
    k = parseInt(STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].exp),
    o = S_CLEVELUP.focus >= S_MAKETEAM.focus ? S_CLEVELUP.focus + 1 : S_CLEVELUP.focus;
  if (S_MAKETEAM.get_takepartin(o) == 1) {
    USER.lang == LANG.RUSSIA ? utilNotice(TXT.not_moreup_for_takepartin, 1.2, 15) : utilNotice(TXT.not_moreup_for_takepartin, 1.2);
    return
  }
  if (r == t && u != STORAGE.data2[o].ch_num) {
    utilNotice(TXT.not_levelup, 1.2);
    return
  }
  if (STORAGE.data2[o].lock == 1) {
    utilNotice(TXT.not_moreup_for_lock, 1.2);
    return
  }
  if (CAL.char_use_item(o) == 1) {
    utilNotice(TXT.item_no_char_moreup, 1.2);
    return
  }
  for (h = 0, s = 1; s <= 4; s++) S_CLEVELUP.select_char_array[s] > 0 && (n = S_CLEVELUP.select_char_array[s], a = S_MAKETEAM.focus <= n ? n + 1 : n, h = h + S_CLEVELUP.get_moreup_exp(a), u == STORAGE.data2[a].ch_num && (y = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[u].star, p = (y + 3) * 10, t <= p - 5 && (t = t + 5)));
  for (c = h + k, l = r; l < t; l++)
    if (v = CAL.get_need_char_exp_for_levelup(l), c >= v) c = c - v, r++;
    else break;
  if (w = S_CLEVELUP.star_based_max_level(CHAR_OUR_TEAM[u].star), w == r) {
    utilNotice(TXT.char_max_lv, 1.5);
    return
  }
  if (r == t && u != STORAGE.data2[o].ch_num) {
    utilNotice(TXT.not_levelup, 1.2);
    return
  }
  for (n = S_MAKETEAM.focus <= S_CLEVELUP.focus ? S_CLEVELUP.focus + 1 : S_CLEVELUP.focus, b = STORAGE.data2[n].ch_num, CHAR_OUR_TEAM[u].star < CHAR_OUR_TEAM[b].star ? USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("등급이 높은 캐릭터가 강화 재료로 선택되었습니다.", 2) : utilNotice("Character with a higher rating has been selected as a material.", 2) : (r < STORAGE.data2[n].cur_level || t < STORAGE.data2[n].max_level) && (USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("레벨이 높은 캐릭터가 강화 재료로 선택되었습니다.", 2) : utilNotice("character with a higher level has been selected as a material.", 2)), f = 1; f <= 4; f++) {
    if (S_CLEVELUP.select_char_array[f] == 0) {
      S_CLEVELUP.select_char_array[f] = S_CLEVELUP.focus;
      $("#Img_CL_bottom_checkbox_select" + S_CLEVELUP.focus).css({
        display: "block"
      });
      S_CLEVELUP.make_screen_top();
      return
    }
    f == 4 && utilNotice(TXT.char_not_select_max, 2)
  }
};
S_CLEVELUP.material_num = function() {
  for (var t = 0, n = 1; n <= 4; n++) S_CLEVELUP.select_char_array[n] > 0 && t++;
  return t
};
S_CLEVELUP.backKey = function() {
  S_CLEVELUP.sub_menu_mode == 1 ? (S_CLEVELUP.sub_menu_focus = 1, $("#s_clevelup_bottom_submenu").css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_CLEVELUP.sub_menu_mode = 0) : (0 && glo.fun.is_glo_platform() && (S_CLEVELUP.before_scroll_target_x = 0, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x = 0), S_CLEVELUP.end(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM))
};
S_CLEVELUP.scroll_right = function() {
  S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_CLEVELUP.scroll_right()!!");
  S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x - S_CLEVELUP.scroll_speed * (S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x - S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x);
  $("#s_clevelup_bottom").css({
    left: S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x > S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x + 4 && S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_CLEVELUP.scroll_right, 80) : (S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag = 0)
};
S_CLEVELUP.scroll_left = function() {
  S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_CLEVELUP.scroll_right()!!");
  S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x + S_CLEVELUP.scroll_speed * (S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x - S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x);
  $("#s_clevelup_bottom").css({
    left: S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x < S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x - 4 && S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_CLEVELUP.scroll_left, 80) : (S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag = 0)
};

      });

      $(".focus").css({
        display: "none"
      })
  }
};

S_CLEVELUP.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  utilScale_xy_center("CL_bottom_ch" + S_CLEVELUP.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("CL_bottom_ch" + S_CLEVELUP.focus, 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_CLEVELUP.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_CLEVELUP.menuRun_Run = function() {
  S_CLEVELUP.moreup()
};

S_CLEVELUP.menuRun_btnmenu = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_CLEVELUP.btn_focus) {
    case 1:
      utilScale_xy_center("CL_back", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("CL_back_icon", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Txt_CL_back", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_CL_back_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 2:
      utilScale_xy_center("CL_start", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_CL_draw_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("CL_back", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("CL_back_icon", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Txt_CL_back", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Img_CL_back_btn_focus", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("CL_start", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Img_CL_draw_btn_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_CLEVELUP.menuRun_btnmenu_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_CLEVELUP.menuRun_btnmenu_Run = function() {
  switch (S_CLEVELUP.btn_focus) {
    case 1:
      S_CLEVELUP.run_back();
      break;
    case 2:
      if (S_CLEVELUP.material_num() == 0) {
        utilNotice(TXT.char_lv_not_material, 2);
        return
      }
      S_CLEVELUP.moreup();
      break;
    case 3:
    case 4:
    case 5:
    case 6:
    case 7:
    case 8:
    case 9:
    case 10:
      S_CLEVELUP.focus_move(S_CLEVELUP.btn_focus - 2);
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_CLEVELUP.menuRun_btnmenu():" + S_CLEVELUP.btn_focus)
  }
};
S_CLEVELUP.moreup = function() {
  var n = S_CLEVELUP.need_gold;
  if (get_cur_gold() < n) {
    utilNotice(TXT.gold_lack, 1.2);
    return
  }
  S_UPGRADE.removeMouseEvent();
  $("#Img_CL_draw_btn_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  utilPush();
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
    display: "block"
  }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN)
};
S_CLEVELUP.is_levelup = function() {
  var n = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num,
    f = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[n].star,
    r = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].cur_level,
    u = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].max_level,
    t, i;
  return r != u ? !0 : (t = S_CLEVELUP.focus >= S_MAKETEAM.focus ? S_CLEVELUP.focus + 1 : S_CLEVELUP.focus, i = STORAGE.data2[t].ch_num, i == n ? !0 : !1)
};
S_CLEVELUP.yes = function() {
  var c, f, e, o, i, s, r, n, t, l;
  bga("send", "event", "levelup", "Char:" + STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num, "complete");
  USER.gold = USER.gold - S_CLEVELUP.need_gold;
  glo.APP_FEATURE.GOLD_CRYPT && encoding_add_gold(-S_CLEVELUP.need_gold);
  S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top();
  S_CLEVELUP.flag_back_lock = 1;
  gEnableKey = 0;
  S_CLEVELUP.effectRun();
  var h = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].cur_level,
    a = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].max_level,
    u = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num;
  for (S_CLEVELUP_COMPLETE.before.mi = CAL.get_char_nm(u, h, a, S_MAKETEAM.focus), S_CLEVELUP_COMPLETE.before.ap = CAL.get_char_ap(u, h, S_MAKETEAM.focus), S_CLEVELUP_COMPLETE.before.hp = CAL.get_char_hp(u, h, S_MAKETEAM.focus), c = 0, f = 1; f <= 4; f++)
    if (S_CLEVELUP.select_char_array[f] > 0 && (c++, n = S_CLEVELUP.select_char_array[f], t = S_MAKETEAM.focus <= n ? n + 1 : n, STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num == STORAGE.data2[t].ch_num)) {
      var v = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num,
        y = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[v].star,
        p = (y + 3) * 10,
        w = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].max_level;
      w <= p - 5 && (STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].max_level += 5)
    } for (e = 0, o = 1; o <= 4; o++) S_CLEVELUP.select_char_array[o] > 0 && (n = S_CLEVELUP.select_char_array[o], t = S_MAKETEAM.focus <= n ? n + 1 : n, e = e + S_CLEVELUP.get_moreup_exp(t));
  for (utilConsoleLog("lv add exp = " + e), S_CLEVELUP.cal_moreup_exp(S_MAKETEAM.focus, e), i = 1; i <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; i++)
    if (OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[i].index == S_MAKETEAM.focus) {
      OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[i].unit_num = u;
      SOCKET.storage_ch_to_socket(i, S_MAKETEAM.focus);
      break
    } for (STORAGE.save_quest_to_server(), s = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(S_CLEVELUP.select_char_array)), s.sort(function(n, t) {
      return n < t ? 1 : n === t ? 0 : n > t ? -1 : void 0
    }), r = 0; r < 4; r++) s[r] > 0 && (n = s[r], t = S_MAKETEAM.focus <= n ? n + 1 : n, utilConsoleLog("~~~삭제되는 캐릭터  = " + t), STORAGE.del_char(t, !0), S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num--, S_MAKETEAM.focus > s[r] && (S_MAKETEAM.focus--, S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus == 1 ? S_MAKETEAM.focus >= 5 ? (S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus = 5, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x + 5 * (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_w + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_gap)) : (S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus = S_MAKETEAM.focus, S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x = S_MAKETEAM.scroll_cur_x + S_MAKETEAM.focus * (S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_w + S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_gap)) : S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus = S_MAKETEAM.abs_focus - 1));
  S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num = S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num - 1;
  S_CLEVELUP.focus > S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num && (S_CLEVELUP.focus = S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num);
  loading_show("캐릭터레벨업", 1);
  l = "캐릭터레벨업|" + u + "|" + -c + "|GOLD|" + -S_CLEVELUP.need_gold + "|" + USER.gold;
  ServerConnection.update_data2_item(l, "clevelup", function() {
    loading_hide("캐릭터레벨업");
    S_CLEVELUP.effect.cur_loop > S_CLEVELUP.effect.max_loop && (gEnableKey = 1)
  })
};

  }, 0)) : (S_CLEVELUP.effect.cur_frame++, S_CLEVELUP.effect.timer = setTimeout(S_CLEVELUP.drawEffect, EFFECT_INTERVAL));
  S_CLEVELUP.effect.cur_loop == S_CLEVELUP.effect.max_loop && S_CLEVELUP.effect.cur_frame > 10 && (S_CLEVELUP.scale.start += S_CLEVELUP.scale.gap, S_CLEVELUP.scale.start > S_CLEVELUP.scale.end && utilScale_xy_center("s_clevelup_top", S_CLEVELUP.scale.start, S_CLEVELUP.scale.start))
};
S_CLEVELUP.cal_moreup_exp = function(n, t) {
  for (var s = parseInt(STORAGE.data2[n].ch_num), c = parseInt(CHAR_OUR_TEAM[s].star), l = parseInt(STORAGE.data2[n].cur_level), h = parseInt(STORAGE.data2[n].exp), i = t + h, e, u, o, f = STORAGE.data2[n].cur_level, r = STORAGE.data2[n].cur_level; r < STORAGE.data2[n].max_level; r++)
    if (u = CAL.get_need_char_exp_for_levelup(r), i >= u) i = i - u, STORAGE.data2[n].cur_level++;
    else break;
  e = STORAGE.data2[n].cur_level;
  o = e - f;
  QUEST.f2_char_levelup(o);
  STORAGE.data2[n].cur_level == STORAGE.data2[n].max_level ? (STORAGE.data2[n].exp = 0, utilConsoleLog("MAX_LEVEL도달하여 Exp를 강제 0 처리 함. ")) : STORAGE.data2[n].exp = i
};
S_CLEVELUP.get_lv_exp = function(n) {
  var u, i, f, s, h, o, c, r, e, t;
  for (n.after_max_level = n.before_max_level, u = 0, i = 1; i <= 4; i++)
    if (S_CLEVELUP.select_char_array[i] > 0 && (f = S_CLEVELUP.select_char_array[i], s = S_MAKETEAM.focus <= f ? f + 1 : f, STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num == STORAGE.data2[s].ch_num)) {
      var l = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num,
        a = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[l].star,
        v = (a + 3) * 10,
        y = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].max_level;
      y <= v + u * 5 - 5 && u++
    } for (n.after_max_level = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].max_level + u * 5, h = STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.focus].ch_num, o = S_CLEVELUP.star_based_max_level(CHAR_OUR_TEAM[h].star), o < n.after_max_level && (n.after_max_level = o), c = parseInt(STORAGE.data2[n.storage_index].exp), n.after_cur_level = n.before_cur_level, r = n.exp + c, e = n.before_cur_level; e < n.after_max_level; e++)
    if (t = CAL.get_need_char_exp_for_levelup(e), r >= t) r = r - t, n.after_cur_level++;
    else break;
  n.after_exp = r;
  n.after_cur_level == n.after_max_level ? (n.after_exp = 0, n.after_exp_p = 0) : (t = CAL.get_need_char_exp_for_levelup(n.after_cur_level), t <= n.after_exp && (utilConsoleLog("Error in S_CLEVELUP.get_lv_exp():이건 사고다. exp계산했는데 값이 요상하다." + n.after_exp_p), n.after_exp = t - 1), n.after_exp_p = Math.floor(n.after_exp / t * 100))
};
S_CLEVELUP.get_moreup_exp = function(n) {
  var u = [{}, {
      min: 1e3,
      max: 7e3
    }, {
      min: 4e3,
      max: 18e3
    }, {
      min: 9e3,
      max: 33e3
    }, {
      min: 16e3,
      max: 54e3
    }, {
      min: 25e3,
      max: 8e4
    }, {
      min: 36e3,
      max: 11e4
    }, {
      min: 49e3,
      max: 15e4
    }, {
      min: 64e3,
      max: 2e5
    }, {
      min: 81e3,
      max: 25e4
    }],
    e = STORAGE.data2[n].ch_num,
    i = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[e].star,
    f = STORAGE.data2[n].cur_level,
    r = u[i].min,
    o = u[i].max,
    t = r;
  return f == 1 ? (utilConsoleLog("EXP =" + t), t) : (t = Math.floor(r + (o - r) / ((i + 1) * 10) * f), utilConsoleLog("EXP =" + t), t)
};

S_CLEVELUP.draw_item = function(n) {

    i, s;

    if (STORAGE.item[i].socket_index == n) {

      switch (o) {

          break;
        case 2:

          break;
        case 3:
          utilDrawImage("Img_CL_bottom_item_armor" + t, r ? u : glo.img_url + "image/item/3_armor/itembox_" + f + "_armor.png", 19, 140, 28, 28, "absolute");
          break;

          utilDrawImage("Img_CL_bottom_item_shoes" + t, r ? u : glo.img_url + "image/item/4_shoes/itembox_" + f + "_shoes.png", 159, 140, 28, 28, "absolute")
      }
    }
};
S_CLEVELUP.focus_move = function(n) {
  var i, r, t, u;
  if (S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag == 1) {
    USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("카드 이동중에는 사용할 수 없습니다.", 2) : utilNotice("Not available while card is moving.", 2);
    return
  }
  for (i = -1, t = 1; t < STORAGE.data1.upgrade[8]; t++) r = t >= S_MAKETEAM.focus ? t + 1 : t, S_MAKETEAM.get_takepartin(r) == 1 || n == CHAR_OUR_TEAM[STORAGE.data2[r].ch_num].star && (i = t, t = STORAGE.data1.upgrade[8] + 1);
  if (n == 0)
    if (S_MAKETEAM.get_num_takepartin() != 1) i = 1;
    else {
      for (t = 1; t <= S_MAKETEAM.top_ch_num; t++)
        if (OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[t].index == S_MAKETEAM.focus) {
          USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("출전중인 캐릭터가 레벨업 진행중입니다.", 2) : utilNotice("The character in the game is in the level-up process.", 2);
          return
        } i = 1
    } if (i == -1) {
    USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("이동 가능한 캐릭터가 없습니다.", 2) : utilNotice("Character does not exist.", 2);
    return
  }
  S_CLEVELUP.row_focus = 1;
  S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus_btnmenu();
  S_CLEVELUP.focus = i;
  S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num < S_CLEVELUP.focus && (S_CLEVELUP.focus = S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num);
  S_CLEVELUP.abs_focus = S_CLEVELUP.focus <= 4 ? S_CLEVELUP.focus : 5;
  u = S_CLEVELUP.focus <= 5 ? 0 : S_CLEVELUP.focus - 5;
  S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x = u * (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_w + S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_gap) * -1;
  S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus();
  $("#s_clevelup_bottom").css({
    left: S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  n == 0 ? USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("출전 캐릭으로 이동하였습니다.", 2) : utilNotice("Move is complete.", 2) : USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice(n + "성 캐릭으로 이동하였습니다.", 2) : utilNotice("Move to " + n + "star is complete.", 2)
};
S_CLEVELUP.end = function() {
  S_CLEVELUP.removeMouseEvent();
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && $("#s_clevelup_bottom").empty();
  util_key_number.clear_all()
};
S_CLEVELUP.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_CLEVELUP.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_CLEVELUP.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_CLEVELUP.onClick = function(n) {
  var t, i, r;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } S_CLEVELUP.sub_menu_mode == 1 ? S_CLEVELUP.menuRun_submenu() : S_CLEVELUP.row_focus == 2 && S_CLEVELUP.menuRun_btnmenu();
    n.target.id.substring(0, 9) == "CL_cover_" && (i = n.target.id.substring(9), r = parseInt(i, 10), S_CLEVELUP.select_char())
  }
};
S_CLEVELUP.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    utilConsoleLog("1-onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
    switch (n.target.id) {
      case "CL_back_btn":
      case "Img_CL_back_btn_icon":
      case "Img_CL_back_btn_focus":
      case "CL_back_btn_text":
        S_CLEVELUP.row_focus = 2;
        S_CLEVELUP.btn_focus = 1;
        S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_CLEVELUP.onMouseover_pressed("CL_back_btn", "Img_CL_back_btn_icon", "CL_back_btn_text");
        return;
      case "CL_draw_btn":
      case "Img_CL_draw_btn_icon":
      case "Img_CL_draw_btn_focus":
      case "CL_draw_btn_text":
        S_CLEVELUP.row_focus = 2;
        S_CLEVELUP.btn_focus = 2;
        S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_CLEVELUP.onMouseover_pressed("CL_draw_btn", "Img_CL_draw_btn_icon", "CL_draw_btn_text");
        return;
      case "CL_move_char_1star_btn":
      case "CL_move_char_1star_btn_text":
      case "Img_CL_move_char_1star_focus":
        S_CLEVELUP.row_focus = 2;
        S_CLEVELUP.btn_focus = 3;
        S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_CLEVELUP.onMouseover_pressed("CL_move_char_1star_btn", "CL_move_char_1star_btn_text");
        return;
      case "CL_move_char_2star_btn":
      case "CL_move_char_2star_btn_text":
      case "Img_CL_move_char_2star_focus":
        S_CLEVELUP.row_focus = 2;
        S_CLEVELUP.btn_focus = 4;
        S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_CLEVELUP.onMouseover_pressed("CL_move_char_2star_btn", "CL_move_char_2star_btn_text");
        return;
      case "CL_move_char_3star_btn":
      case "CL_move_char_3star_btn_text":
      case "Img_CL_move_char_3star_focus":
        S_CLEVELUP.row_focus = 2;
        S_CLEVELUP.btn_focus = 5;
        S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_CLEVELUP.onMouseover_pressed("CL_move_char_3star_btn", "CL_move_char_3star_btn_text");
        return;
      case "CL_move_char_4star_btn":
      case "CL_move_char_4star_btn_text":
      case "Img_CL_move_char_4star_focus":
        S_CLEVELUP.row_focus = 2;
        S_CLEVELUP.btn_focus = 6;
        S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_CLEVELUP.onMouseover_pressed("CL_move_char_4star_btn", "CL_move_char_4star_btn_text");
        return;
      case "CL_move_char_5star_btn":
      case "CL_move_char_5star_btn_text":
      case "Img_CL_move_char_5star_focus":
        S_CLEVELUP.row_focus = 2;
        S_CLEVELUP.btn_focus = 7;
        S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_CLEVELUP.onMouseover_pressed("CL_move_char_5star_btn", "CL_move_char_5star_btn_text");
        return;
      case "CL_move_char_6star_btn":
      case "CL_move_char_6star_btn_text":
      case "Img_CL_move_char_6star_focus":
        S_CLEVELUP.row_focus = 2;
        S_CLEVELUP.btn_focus = 8;
        S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_CLEVELUP.onMouseover_pressed("CL_move_char_6star_btn", "CL_move_char_6star_btn_text");
        return;
      case "CL_move_char_7star_btn":
      case "CL_move_char_7star_btn_text":
      case "Img_CL_move_char_7star_focus":
        S_CLEVELUP.row_focus = 2;

        S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_CLEVELUP.onMouseover_pressed("CL_move_char_7star_btn", "CL_move_char_7star_btn_text");

      case "CL_move_char_8star_btn":

        S_CLEVELUP.onMouseover_pressed("CL_move_char_8star_btn", "CL_move_char_8star_btn_text");

      utilConsoleLog("해당 id는 무시:" + n.target.id);
      return
    }
    S_CLEVELUP.row_focus = 1;

  }

S_CLEVELUP.mousedrag_right_to_left = function() {
  if ((utilConsoleLog("S_CLEVELUP.mousedrag_right_to_left()#############################"), S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag != 1) && !(S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num <= BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN)) {
    var t = (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_w + S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_gap) * (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num - BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1,
      i = (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_w + S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_gap) * (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num - BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1 - S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x,
      r = Math.abs(Math.floor(i / (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_w + S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_gap))),
      n = BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN - 1,
      u = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x - (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_w + S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_gap) * n;
    u < t && (n = r);
    S_CLEVELUP.focus < S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num ? (S_CLEVELUP.focus = S_CLEVELUP.focus + n, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag = 0), S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x - (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_w + S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_gap) * n, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_right(), gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.CRAZY_GAME && gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.AMO && (S_CLEVELUP.before_scroll_target_x == t && S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x == t ? (S_CLEVELUP.focus = 1, S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus(), S_CLEVELUP.abs_focus = 1, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag = 0), S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x = 0, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_left()) : (S_CLEVELUP.before_scroll_target_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_right()))) : gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.CRAZY_GAME && gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.AMO && (S_CLEVELUP.focus = 1, S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus(), S_CLEVELUP.abs_focus = 1, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag = 0), S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x = 0, S_CLEVELUP.before_scroll_target_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_left())
  }
};
S_CLEVELUP.mousedrag_left_to_right = function() {
  var i = 0,
    n = 4,
    t = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x + (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_w + S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_gap) * n;
  t > i && (n = 3, t = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x + (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_w + S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 2, t = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x + (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_w + S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 1, t = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x + (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_w + S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 0))));
  S_CLEVELUP.focus = S_CLEVELUP.focus - n;
  S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag = 0);
  S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x + (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_w + S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_gap) * n;
  gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.CRAZY_GAME && gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.AMO ? S_CLEVELUP.before_scroll_target_x == 0 && S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x == 0 ? (S_CLEVELUP.focus = S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num, S_CLEVELUP.drawFocus(), S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num > BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? (S_CLEVELUP.abs_focus = 5, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_CLEVELUP.scroll_cur_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_flag = 0), S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x = -(S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_w + S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_gap) * (S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num - BOTTOM_NUM_ON_SCREEN), S_CLEVELUP.scroll_right()) : S_CLEVELUP.abs_focus = S_CLEVELUP.bottom_ch_num) : (S_CLEVELUP.before_scroll_target_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_left()) : (S_CLEVELUP.before_scroll_target_x = S_CLEVELUP.scroll_target_x, S_CLEVELUP.scroll_left())

};

  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  utilScale_xy_center("EC_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("Img_EC_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("EC_btn", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Img_EC_btn_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_EVOLUTION_COMPLETE.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};

};

S_UPGRADE.define = function() {
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_MAINMENU && (S_UPGRADE.focus = 1, S_UPGRADE.abs_focus = 1, S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x = 0);
  S_UPGRADE.row_focus = 1;
  S_UPGRADE.card_num = UPGRADE_NUM;
  glo.APP_FEATURE.PACKAGE_STORE && (S_UPGRADE.lang_suffix = "", S_UPGRADE.img_path = SERVER_IMG_URL, gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT && (S_UPGRADE.img_path = "./"), USER.lang !== LANG.KOREA && (S_UPGRADE.lang_suffix = "_eng"))
};
S_UPGRADE.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_UPGRADE.row_focus == 2) {
        if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO) {
          S_UPGRADE.btn_focus == 3 && (S_UPGRADE.btn_focus = 2, S_UPGRADE.drawFocus_btnmenu());
          return
        }
        S_UPGRADE.btn_focus == 3 ? (S_UPGRADE.btn_focus = 2, S_UPGRADE.drawFocus_btnmenu()) : S_UPGRADE.btn_focus == 2 && (S_UPGRADE.btn_focus = 1, S_UPGRADE.drawFocus_btnmenu());
        return
      }
      S_UPGRADE.focus >= 2 && (S_UPGRADE.focus = S_UPGRADE.focus - 1, S_UPGRADE.drawFocus(), S_UPGRADE.abs_focus >= 2 ? S_UPGRADE.abs_focus = S_UPGRADE.abs_focus - 1 : (S_UPGRADE.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x = S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x, S_UPGRADE.scroll_flag = 0), S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x = S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x + (S_UPGRADE.card_w + S_UPGRADE.card_gap), S_UPGRADE.scroll_left()));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_UPGRADE.row_focus == 2) {
        S_UPGRADE.btn_focus == 1 ? (S_UPGRADE.btn_focus = 2, S_UPGRADE.drawFocus_btnmenu()) : S_UPGRADE.btn_focus == 2 && (S_UPGRADE.btn_focus = 3, S_UPGRADE.drawFocus_btnmenu());
        return
      }
      S_UPGRADE.focus < S_UPGRADE.card_num && (S_UPGRADE.focus = S_UPGRADE.focus + 1, S_UPGRADE.drawFocus(), S_UPGRADE.abs_focus < UPGRADE_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? S_UPGRADE.abs_focus = S_UPGRADE.abs_focus + 1 : (S_UPGRADE.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x = S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x, S_UPGRADE.scroll_flag = 0), S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x = S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x - (S_UPGRADE.card_w + S_UPGRADE.card_gap), S_UPGRADE.scroll_right()));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_UPGRADE.row_focus == 2 && (S_UPGRADE.row_focus = 1, S_UPGRADE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_UPGRADE.row_focus == 1 && (S_UPGRADE.row_focus = 2, S_UPGRADE.btn_focus = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? 2 : 1, S_UPGRADE.drawFocus_btnmenu());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_UPGRADE.row_focus == 2 ? S_UPGRADE.menuRun_btnmenu() : S_UPGRADE.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_UPGRADE.run_back()
  }
};
S_UPGRADE.backKey = function() {
  S_UPGRADE.end();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU)
};
S_UPGRADE.scroll_right = function() {
  S_UPGRADE.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_UPGRADE.scroll_right()!!");
  S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x = S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x - S_UPGRADE.scroll_speed * (S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x - S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x);
  $("#s_upgrade_card").css({
    left: S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x > S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x + 4 && S_UPGRADE.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_UPGRADE.scroll_right, 80) : (S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x = S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x, S_UPGRADE.scroll_flag = 0)
};
S_UPGRADE.scroll_left = function() {
  S_UPGRADE.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_UPGRADE.scroll_right()!!");
  S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x = S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x + S_UPGRADE.scroll_speed * (S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x - S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x);
  $("#s_upgrade_card").css({
    left: S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x < S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x - 4 && S_UPGRADE.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_UPGRADE.scroll_left, 80) : (S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x = S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x, S_UPGRADE.scroll_flag = 0)
};

S_UPGRADE.get_growth_reward = function(n) {
  if (!glo.APP_FEATURE.PACKAGE_STORE) return n;
  console.log(" get_growth_reward start value:" + n);
  console.log(" get_growth_reward get_is_growth:" + glo.package.get_is_growth());
  var t = 1;
  return glo.package.get_is_growth() == "yes" && USER.level <= glo.package.get_growth_max_level() && (t = glo.package.get_growth_upgrade_cost()), n = Math.floor(n * t), console.log(" get_growth_reward cost:" + t), console.log(" get_growth_reward end value:" + n), n
};
S_UPGRADE.batch = {
  from_level: 0,
  target_level: 0,
  applied_count: 1
};
S_UPGRADE.batch.is_on = function() {
  return glo.APP_FEATURE.UPGRADE_SERVER_CALC ? glo.APP_FEATURE.UPGRADE_BATCH ? S_UPGRADE.can_tower_be_awakened() ? !1 : !0 : !1 : !1
};
S_UPGRADE.batch.is_ruby = function(n) {
  return n == 7 || n == 8
};
S_UPGRADE.batch.get_max_level = function(n) {
  return n == 3 ? DEFINE.MISSILE_RECHARGE_MAX : n == 6 ? UPGRADE_OUR_PRODUCT_MAX : n == 8 ? DEFINE.USER_STORAGE_MAX : n == 9 ? DEFINE.ITEM_STORAGE_MAX : DEFINE.UPGRADE_MAX
};
S_UPGRADE.batch.get_growth_mul = function() {
  return glo.APP_FEATURE.PACKAGE_STORE ? glo.package.get_is_growth() == "yes" && USER.level <= glo.package.get_growth_max_level() ? glo.package.get_growth_upgrade_cost() : 1 : 1
};
S_UPGRADE.batch.get_one_cost = function(n, t, i) {
  var r = 0;
  return n >= 1 && n <= 5 ? r = (t + 1) * 1e3 : n == 6 ? r = t * 1e4 : n == 7 ? r = t + 1 : n == 8 ? r = t - 25 : n == 9 && (r = 1e5 * Math.pow(2, t - 60), r > 1e8 && (r = 1e8)), r < 0 && (r = 0), AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[1] == 1 && (r = Math.floor(r / 2)), Math.floor(r * i)
};
S_UPGRADE.batch.get_total_cost = function(n, t, i) {
  for (var u = 0, f = S_UPGRADE.batch.get_growth_mul(), r = 0, r = t; r < i; r++) u += S_UPGRADE.batch.get_one_cost(n, r, f);
  return u
};
S_UPGRADE.batch.get_max_target_level = function(n, t) {
  for (var u = S_UPGRADE.batch.get_max_level(n), f = S_UPGRADE.batch.is_ruby(n) ? get_cur_ruby() : get_cur_gold(), e = S_UPGRADE.batch.get_growth_mul(), r = 0, i = 0, i = t; i < u; i++)
    if (r += S_UPGRADE.batch.get_one_cost(n, i, e), r > f) break;
  return i
};
S_UPGRADE.batch.init = function() {
  var n = S_UPGRADE.focus;
  S_UPGRADE.batch.from_level = STORAGE.data1.upgrade[n];
  S_UPGRADE.batch.target_level = S_UPGRADE.batch.from_level + 1;

S_UPGRADE.drawFocus = function() {
  var n;

    display: "block"
  }) : $("#Img_UG_card_focus_" + n).css({
    display: "none"
  });
  for ($("#Img_UG_back_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Img_UG_store_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Img_UG_start_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), n = 1; n <= S_UPGRADE.card_num; n++) S_UPGRADE.focus != n ? ($("#Txt_1_UG_card_" + n).css({
    color: "#131a37"
  }), $("#Txt_2_UG_card_" + n).css({
    color: "#ffffff"
  }), $("#Txt_3_UG_card_" + n).css({
    color: "#e57100"
  })) : ($("#Txt_1_UG_card_" + n), $("#Txt_2_UG_card_" + n), $("#Txt_3_UG_card_" + n));
  glo.APP_FEATURE.TOWER_AWAKENING && S_UPGRADE.is_upgraded_max(5) && ($("#Txt_1_UG_card_5").css({
    color: "#5e1900"
  }), $("#Txt_2_UG_card_5").css({
    color: "#fff600"
  }), $("#Txt_3_UG_card_5").css({
    color: "#5e1900"
  }))
};

S_UPGRADE.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  utilScale_xy_center("UG_card_" + S_UPGRADE.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("UG_card_" + S_UPGRADE.focus, 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_UPGRADE.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_UPGRADE.menuRun_Run = function() {
  S_UPGRADE.focus >= 1 && S_UPGRADE.focus <= 9 && S_UPGRADE.levelup(S_UPGRADE.focus)
};
S_UPGRADE.menuRun_btnmenu = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_UPGRADE.btn_focus) {
    case 1:
      utilScale_xy_center("UG_back", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Txt_UG_back", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_UG_back_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 2:
      utilScale_xy_center("UG_store_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("UG_store", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_UG_store_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("UG_store_icon", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 3:
      utilScale_xy_center("UG_start_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("UG_start", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_UG_start_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("UG_back", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Txt_UG_back", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Img_UG_back_focus", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("UG_store_btn", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("UG_store", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("UG_store_icon", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Img_UG_store_focus", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("UG_start_btn", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("UG_start", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Img_UG_start_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_UPGRADE.menuRun_btnmenu_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_UPGRADE.menuRun_btnmenu_Run = function() {
  switch (S_UPGRADE.btn_focus) {
    case 1:
      S_UPGRADE.run_back();
      break;
    case 2:
      S_UPGRADE.end();
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_PACKAGE_STORE, S_PACKAGE_STORE);
      break;
    case 3:
      S_UPGRADE.end();
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MODE_SELECT, S_MODE_SELECT);
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_UPGRADE.menuRun_btnmenu():" + S_UPGRADE.btn_focus)
  }
};
S_UPGRADE.is_upgraded_max = function(n) {
  var t = !1;
  return n == 3 && STORAGE.data1.upgrade[n] == DEFINE.MISSILE_RECHARGE_MAX || n == 6 && STORAGE.data1.upgrade[n] == UPGRADE_OUR_PRODUCT_MAX || n == 8 && STORAGE.data1.upgrade[n] == DEFINE.USER_STORAGE_MAX || n == 9 && STORAGE.data1.upgrade[n] == DEFINE.ITEM_STORAGE_MAX ? t = !0 : n === 5 && STORAGE.data1.upgrade[n] == DEFINE.UPGRADE_MAX ? glo.APP_FEATURE.TOWER_AWAKENING && USER.tower_awakening > 0 ? t = !0 : glo.APP_FEATURE.TOWER_AWAKENING || (t = !0) : STORAGE.data1.upgrade[n] == DEFINE.UPGRADE_MAX && (t = !0), t
};
S_UPGRADE.can_tower_be_awakened = function() {
  var n = !1;
  return S_UPGRADE.focus == 5 && glo.APP_FEATURE.TOWER_AWAKENING && STORAGE.data1.upgrade[5] == DEFINE.UPGRADE_MAX && USER.tower_awakening === 0 && (n = !0), n
};
S_UPGRADE.levelup = function(n) {
  var u = STORAGE.data1.upgrade[n],
    i, t, r;
  if (S_UPGRADE.focus == 5 && glo.APP_FEATURE.TOWER_AWAKENING && u == DEFINE.UPGRADE_MAX && USER.tower_awakening === 0) {
    if (i = 1500, get_cur_ruby() >= i) {
      for (utilPush(), S_UPGRADE.need_ruby = i, S_UPGRADE.removeMouseEvent(), r = 1; r <= S_UPGRADE.card_num; r++) $("#Img_UG_card_focus_" + r).css({
        display: "none"
      });

S_UPGRADE.yes_by_server = function() {
  var i = S_UPGRADE.focus,
    r = STORAGE.data1.upgrade[i],
    n = S_UPGRADE.can_tower_be_awakened(),
    o = n ? "TOWER_AWAKENING" : "UPGRADE",
    t = r + 1,
    u, e, f;
  if (n ? t = r : S_UPGRADE.batch.is_on() && (t = S_UPGRADE.batch.target_level), u = n ? 1 : t - r, u < 1) {
    utilNotice(TXT.your_update_is_max, 1.2);
    S_UPGRADE.back_from_yes(!1);
    return
  }
  e = DEFINE.USER_ITEM_PAGE_MAX;
  f = n ? "타워각성" : "업그레이드";
  loading_show(f, 1);
  ServerConnection.do_upgrade(o, i, t, u, function(t) {
    loading_hide(f, 1);
    S_UPGRADE.apply_upgrade_result(t, i, n, e)
  })
};
S_UPGRADE.apply_upgrade_result = function(n, t, i, r) {
  var u = n.STATE,
    s, f, o, e;
  if (u !== "SUCCESS" && u !== "PARTIAL") {
    u === "NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD" ? utilNotice(TXT.gold_lack, 1.2) : u === "NOT_ENOUGH_RUBY" ? utilNotice(TXT.ruby_lack, 1.2) : u === "MAX_LEVEL" ? utilNotice(TXT.your_update_is_max, 1.2) : u === "ALREADY_AWAKENED" ? (USER.tower_awakening = 1, utilNotice(TXT.your_update_is_max, 1.2)) : utilNotice(TXT.upgrade_batch_fail, 1.2);
    s = !1;
    f = parseInt(n.UP_LEVEL, 10);
    !isNaN(f) && f > 0 && f !== STORAGE.data1.upgrade[t] && (STORAGE.data1.upgrade[t] = f, S_UPGRADE.apply_after_upgrade(t, r), s = !0);
    S_UPGRADE.back_from_yes(s);
    return
  }
  o = parseInt(n.UP_LEVEL, 10);
  !isNaN(o) && o > 0 && (STORAGE.data1.upgrade[t] = o);
  e = parseInt(n.UP_COUNT, 10);
  (isNaN(e) || e < 1) && (e = 1);
  S_UPGRADE.batch.applied_count = i ? 1 : e;
  i && (USER.tower_awakening = 1);
  S_UPGRADE.apply_after_upgrade(t, r);
  u === "PARTIAL" && utilNotice(LANG.replace_value(TXT.upgrade_batch_partial, [STORAGE.data1.upgrade[t]]), 2);
  S_UPGRADE.goto_next_scene()
};
S_UPGRADE.apply_after_upgrade = function(n, t) {
  n == 9 && (DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX = STORAGE.data1.upgrade[n], DEFINE.USER_ITEM_PAGE_MAX = Math.ceil(STORAGE.data1.upgrade[n] / 12), t < DEFINE.USER_ITEM_PAGE_MAX && (loading_show(), S_LOGO.flag4_item = 0, STORAGE.init_item_arr(), ServerConnection.get_item()));
  S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top();
  switch (n) {
    case 5:
      S_GAME.stageCastle_init();
      break;
    case 6:
      MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN = STORAGE.data1.upgrade[6]
  }
};
S_UPGRADE.back_from_yes = function(n) {
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_UPGRADE;
  n ? (S_UPGRADE.make_screen_bottom(), S_UPGRADE.addMouseEvent(), S_UPGRADE.drawFocus()) : (S_UPGRADE.addMouseEvent(), $("#Img_UG_card_focus_" + S_UPGRADE.focus).css({
    display: "block"
  }));
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  gEnableKey = 1
};
S_UPGRADE.goto_next_scene = function() {
  S_UPGRADE.end();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_UPGRADE_COMPLETE, S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE)
};
S_UPGRADE.end = function() {
  S_UPGRADE.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_UPGRADE.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_UPGRADE.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover).mouseout(this.onMouseout)))
};
S_UPGRADE.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover").unbind("mouseout")
};
S_UPGRADE.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } S_UPGRADE.row_focus == 2 ? S_UPGRADE.menuRun_btnmenu() : S_UPGRADE.menuRun()
  }
};
S_UPGRADE.onMouseover = function(n) {
  var i, t, r;
  switch (n.target.id) {
    case "UG_back":
    case "Txt_UG_back":
    case "Txt_UG_back":
      gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && (S_UPGRADE.row_focus = 2, S_UPGRADE.btn_focus = 1, S_UPGRADE.drawFocus_btnmenu());
      return;
    case "UG_store_btn":
    case "UG_store":
    case "UG_store_icon":
    case "Img_UG_store_focus":
      S_UPGRADE.row_focus = 2;
      S_UPGRADE.btn_focus = 2;
      S_UPGRADE.drawFocus_btnmenu();
      return;
    case "UG_start_btn":
    case "UG_start":
    case "Img_UG_start_focus":
      S_UPGRADE.row_focus = 2;
      S_UPGRADE.btn_focus = 3;
      S_UPGRADE.drawFocus_btnmenu();
      return
  }
  if (n.target.id.substring(0, 9) != "UG_cover_") {
    utilConsoleLog("해당 id는 무시:" + n.target.id);
    return
  }
  S_UPGRADE.row_focus = 1;
  i = n.target.id.substring(9);
  t = parseInt(i, 10);
  isNaN(t) && utilConsoleLog("Error in S_UPGRADE.onMouseover() : focus is NaN");
  r = Math.floor(S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x * -1 / (S_UPGRADE.card_w + S_UPGRADE.card_gap)) + 1;
  S_UPGRADE.abs_focus = S_UPGRADE.abs_focus + (t - S_UPGRADE.focus);
  S_UPGRADE.focus = t;
  S_UPGRADE.drawFocus()
};
S_UPGRADE.onMouseover_pressed = function(n, t, i, r) {
  Main.onMouseover_pressed(n, t, i, r)
};
S_UPGRADE.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_UPGRADE.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_UPGRADE.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_UPGRADE.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_UPGRADE.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_UPGRADE.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_UPGRADE.mousedrag_right_to_left = function() {
  if (S_UPGRADE.scroll_flag != 1) {
    var t = (S_UPGRADE.card_w + S_UPGRADE.card_gap) * (S_UPGRADE.card_num - UPGRADE_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1,
      i = (S_UPGRADE.card_w + S_UPGRADE.card_gap) * (S_UPGRADE.card_num - UPGRADE_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1 - S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x,
      r = Math.abs(Math.floor(i / (S_UPGRADE.card_w + S_UPGRADE.card_gap))),
      n = UPGRADE_NUM_ON_SCREEN - 1,
      u = S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x - (S_UPGRADE.card_w + S_UPGRADE.card_gap) * n;
    u < t && (n = r);
    S_UPGRADE.focus < S_UPGRADE.card_num && (S_UPGRADE.focus = S_UPGRADE.focus + n, S_UPGRADE.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x = S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x, S_UPGRADE.scroll_flag = 0), S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x = S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x - (S_UPGRADE.card_w + S_UPGRADE.card_gap) * n, S_UPGRADE.scroll_right())
  }
};
S_UPGRADE.mousedrag_left_to_right = function() {
  var i = 0,
    n = 3,
    t = S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x + (S_UPGRADE.card_w + S_UPGRADE.card_gap) * n;
  t > i && (n = 2, t = S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x + (S_UPGRADE.card_w + S_UPGRADE.card_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 1, t = S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x + (S_UPGRADE.card_w + S_UPGRADE.card_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 0)));
  S_UPGRADE.focus = S_UPGRADE.focus - n;
  S_UPGRADE.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x = S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x, S_UPGRADE.scroll_flag = 0);
  S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x = S_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x + (S_UPGRADE.card_w + S_UPGRADE.card_gap) * n;
  utilConsoleLog(" S_UPGRADE.mousedrag_left_to_right  S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x: " + S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x);
  S_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x = 0;
  S_UPGRADE.scroll_left()
};

S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.resume = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.resume()!!");
  $("#Img_UC_btn_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.drawEffect();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)
};
S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.maketag = function() {
  var n = document.getElementById("S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE_div"),
    t = document.getElementById("Img_UC_background");
  if (t) {
    utilConsoleLog("Already ready.");
    return
  }
  n.innerHTML = '\t<img id="Img_UC_background">\t<img id="UC_effect">\t<div id="UC_center">\t\t<img id="Img_UC_board">\t\t<div id="Txt_UC_subtitle"><\/div>\t\t<img id="UC_board_icon">\t\t<div id="Txt_UC_level1"><\/div> <div id="Txt_UC_level2"><\/div>\t<\/div>\t<div id="UC_btn" class="button">\t\t<div id="Txt_UC_btn"><\/div>\t<\/div>\t<img id="Img_UC_btn_focus" class="button focus">'
};
S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.back = function() {
  var n = function(n) {
    for (var t = 0; t < n.event_arr.length; t++) AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[n.event_arr[t]] = 1;
    auto_event_value();
    loading_hide();
    gEnableKey = 1;
    $("#S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE_div").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.end();
    ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_UPGRADE, S_UPGRADE)
  };
  loading_show();
  gEnableKey = 0;
  auto_event_system_init();
  auto_event_system_check(999, n)
};
S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.drawEffect = function() {
  var n = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url_only_glo() + "image/ui/98_effect/ef_twinkle2.png";
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("UC_effect", n, 282, 67);
  utilRotate5050("UC_effect", S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.effect.cur_degree);
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_UPGRADE_COMPLETE && (S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.effect.cur_degree < 360 - S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.effect.gap ? S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.effect.cur_degree += S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.effect.gap : S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.effect.cur_degree = 0, S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.effect.timer = setTimeout(S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.drawEffect, EFFECT_INTERVAL))
};
S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_LOGO.flag4_item == 1 ? S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.menuRun() : USER.lang != LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("Saving item information.", 1.5) : utilNotice("아이템 정보를 저장중입니다.", 1.5);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.run_back()
  }
};

S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.drawCenterScale = function() {
  utilScale_xy_center("UC_center", S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.scale.start, S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.scale.start);
  $("#UC_center").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.scale.start >= S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.scale.end - .05 ? (utilConsoleLog("---complete scale--- gEnbaleKey ---> 1"), gEnableKey = 1, S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.addMouseEvent(), blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)) : (S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.scale.start = S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.scale.start + S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.scale.speed * (S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.scale.end - S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.scale.start), setTimeout(S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.drawCenterScale, EFFECT_INTERVAL))
};
S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.drawFocus = function() {};
S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  utilScale_xy_center("UC_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("Img_UC_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("UC_btn", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Img_UC_btn_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.menuRun_Run = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.back()
};
S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.end = function() {
  S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.removeMouseEvent();
  S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.effect.timer != null && (clearInterval(S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.effect.timer), S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.effect.timer = null)
};
S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").click(this.onClick).mouseover(this.onMouseover).mouseout(this.onMouseout)
};
S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("click").unbind("mouseover").unbind("mouseout")
};
S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.onClick = function() {
  gEnableKey != 0 && S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.menuRun()
};
S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.onMouseover = function() {
  return
};
S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.onMouseout = function() {};
S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.onMousemove = function() {};
S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.back()
};
S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.back()
};

S_GACHA.init = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  utilConsoleLog("S_GACHA.init()");
  utilPush();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_GACHA;
  S_MAINMENU.remount_mm_top(this, TXT.gacha);
  gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV && gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.KT && gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.SSBR && (S_GACHA.preload(), S_GACHA.maketag());
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_GACHA.effect.cur_frame = S_GACHA.effect.cur_loop = 1;
  S_GACHA.scale.start = 1;
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT && util_kt.isLowModel() && (S_GACHA.scroll_speed = 1);
  var n = g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_GACHA_COMPLETE;
  n || (S_GACHA.tab_focus = S_GACHA.entry_tab > 0 ? S_GACHA.entry_tab : 1, S_GACHA.entry_tab = 0, S_GACHA.define());
  loading_show();
  auto_event_system_init();
  auto_event_system_check(999, function() {
    loading_hide();
    var t = S_GACHA.focus,
      i = S_GACHA.abs_focus,
      r = S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x;
    S_GACHA.define();
    n && t >= 1 && t <= S_GACHA.card_num && (S_GACHA.focus = t, S_GACHA.abs_focus = i, S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = r);
    S_GACHA.make_screen();
    S_GACHA.addMouseEvent();
    blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1
    }, DEFINE.KEYLOCKTIME);
    glo.event.apply_coupon_code()
  })
};
S_GACHA.pause = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_GACHA.pause()!!");
  $("#Img_GC_back_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_GC_start_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_GC_maketeam_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  for (var n = 1; n <= S_GACHA.card_num; n++) $("#GC_card_focus_" + n).css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_GACHA.flag_back_lock == 1 && (clearInterval(S_GACHA.effect.timer), S_GACHA.effect.timer = null)
};
S_GACHA.resume = function() {
  if (utilConsoleLog("S_GACHA.resume()!!"), S_PACKAGE_STORE.POPUP.flag == 1) $("#SafeZone").css({
    display: "none"
  }), blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  else {
    if (blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene), S_GACHA.flag_back_lock == 1) {
      S_GACHA.drawEffect();
      return
    }
    S_GACHA.make_screen_tab();
    S_GACHA.row_focus == 1 ? S_GACHA.drawFocus() : S_GACHA.drawFocus_btnmenu()
  }
};
S_GACHA.maketag = function() {
  var n = document.getElementById("S_GACHA_div"),
    t = document.getElementById("Img_GC_background");
  if (t) {
    utilConsoleLog("Already ready.");

S_GACHA.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  if (S_GACHA.POPUP.flag == 1) {
    (i == KeyDefine.enter || i == KeyDefine.back) && (gEnableKey = 0, utilScale_xy_center("MS_popup_btn1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale), utilScale_xy_center("MS_popup_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale), setTimeout(function() {
      utilScale_xy_center("MS_popup_btn1", 1, 1);
      utilScale_xy_center("MS_popup_focus", 1, 1);
      setTimeout(function() {
        gEnableKey = 1;
        $("#MS_popup_div").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        $("#MS_popup_div").empty();
        $("#MM_top").css({
          display: "block"
        });
        S_GACHA.POPUP.flag = 0;
        S_GACHA.drawFocus();
        Main.showSafeZone()
      }, gKeyUpTime)
    }, gKeyPressTime));
    return
  }
  if (S_GACHA.hero_popup_open) {
    S_GACHA.hero_popup_keyDown(i);
    return
  }
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_GACHA.on_tab) {
        S_GACHA.tab_focus--;
        S_GACHA.tab_focus < 1 && (S_GACHA.tab_focus = 1);
        S_GACHA.switch_tab(S_GACHA.tab_focus);
        S_GACHA.on_tab = !0;
        S_GACHA.drawFocus_tab();
        return
      }
      if (S_GACHA.row_focus == 2) {
        S_GACHA.btn_focus > 1 && (S_GACHA.btn_focus--, S_GACHA.drawFocus_btnmenu());
        return
      }
      S_GACHA.focus >= 2 && (S_GACHA.focus = S_GACHA.focus - 1, S_GACHA.drawFocus(), S_GACHA.abs_focus >= 2 ? S_GACHA.abs_focus = S_GACHA.abs_focus - 1 : (S_GACHA.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = S_GACHA.scroll_target_x, S_GACHA.scroll_flag = 0), S_GACHA.scroll_target_x = S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x + (S_GACHA.card_w + S_GACHA.card_gap), S_GACHA.scroll_left()));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_GACHA.on_tab) {
        S_GACHA.tab_focus++;
        S_GACHA.tab_focus > S_GACHA.tab_tot && (S_GACHA.tab_focus = S_GACHA.tab_tot);
        S_GACHA.switch_tab(S_GACHA.tab_focus);
        S_GACHA.on_tab = !0;
        S_GACHA.drawFocus_tab();
        return
      }
      if (S_GACHA.row_focus == 2) {
        S_GACHA.btn_focus < 2 && (S_GACHA.btn_focus++, S_GACHA.drawFocus_btnmenu());
        return
      }
      S_GACHA.focus < S_GACHA.card_num && (S_GACHA.focus = S_GACHA.focus + 1, S_GACHA.drawFocus(), S_GACHA.abs_focus < GACHA_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? S_GACHA.abs_focus = S_GACHA.abs_focus + 1 : (S_GACHA.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = S_GACHA.scroll_target_x, S_GACHA.scroll_flag = 0), S_GACHA.scroll_target_x = S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x - (S_GACHA.card_w + S_GACHA.card_gap), S_GACHA.scroll_right()));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_GACHA.row_focus == 2 ? (S_GACHA.row_focus = 1, S_GACHA.drawFocus()) : S_GACHA.row_focus != 1 || S_GACHA.on_tab || (S_GACHA.on_tab = !0, S_GACHA.drawFocus_tab());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_GACHA.on_tab ? (S_GACHA.on_tab = !1, S_GACHA.make_screen_tab(), S_GACHA.row_focus = 1, S_GACHA.drawFocus()) : S_GACHA.row_focus == 1 && (S_GACHA.row_focus = 2, S_GACHA.btn_focus = glo.APP_FEATURE.TOUCH_PLATFORM ? 2 : 1, S_GACHA.drawFocus_btnmenu());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      if (S_GACHA.on_tab) {
        S_GACHA.switch_tab(S_GACHA.tab_focus);
        return
      }
      S_GACHA.row_focus == 2 ? S_GACHA.menuRun_btnmenu() : S_GACHA.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_GACHA.run_back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.space:
      if (gAPP_RELEASE != "TEST") return;
    case KeyDefine.RED:
      S_GACHA.run_percentage_show()
  }
};
S_GACHA.backKey = function() {
  S_GACHA.tab_focus = 1;
  S_GACHA.end();
  $("#S_GACHA_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU)
};
S_GACHA.scroll_right = function() {
  S_GACHA.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_GACHA.scroll_right()!!");
  S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x - S_GACHA.scroll_speed * (S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x - S_GACHA.scroll_target_x);
  $("#s_gacha_card").css({
    left: S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x > S_GACHA.scroll_target_x + 4 && S_GACHA.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_GACHA.scroll_right, 80) : (S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = S_GACHA.scroll_target_x, S_GACHA.scroll_flag = 0)
};
S_GACHA.scroll_left = function() {
  S_GACHA.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_GACHA.scroll_left()!!");
  S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x + S_GACHA.scroll_speed * (S_GACHA.scroll_target_x - S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x);
  $("#s_gacha_card").css({
    left: S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x < S_GACHA.scroll_target_x - 4 && S_GACHA.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_GACHA.scroll_left, 80) : (S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = S_GACHA.scroll_target_x, S_GACHA.scroll_flag = 0)
};

S_GACHA.getRemainTime = function() {
  var u = window.g.REWARD_TIME_MS,
    t, n, i, r;
  return gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN ? (t = new Date, n = t.getTime()) : n = parseInt(window.g.timestamp_start, 10) + parseInt(window.g.timestamp_due, 10), i = n - STORAGE.data1.gacha_time, r = u - i, r
};
S_GACHA.drawRemainTime = function() {
  var r, n;
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === gS_GACHA && S_GACHA.tab_focus === 1) {
    if (n = S_GACHA.getRemainTime(), n <= 0) r = TXT.remain_time_zero, $("#Txt_3_GC_card_1").text(r), $("#Txt_3_GC_card_1").css({
      left: "110px",
      top: "346px",
      width: "126px",
      height: "35px",
      color: "white",
      "line-height": USER.lang == LANG.ENGLISH || USER.lang == LANG.VIETNAM || USER.lang == LANG.RUSSIA ? "18px" : "35px",
      "font-size": USER.lang == LANG.ENGLISH || USER.lang == LANG.VIETNAM || USER.lang == LANG.SPAIN || USER.lang == LANG.RUSSIA ? "17rem" : "24rem",
      "text-align": "center",
      "text-shadow": "1px 1px 1px black",
      position: "absolute"
    });
    else {
      var t = Math.floor(n / 36e5),
        i = Math.floor((n - t * 36e5) / 6e4),
        u = Math.floor((n - t * 36e5 - i * 6e4) / 1e3),
        f = t > 9 ? t : t == 0 ? "00" : "0" + t,
        e = i > 9 ? i : i == 0 ? "00" : "0" + i,
        o = u > 9 ? u : u == 0 ? "00" : "0" + u;
      r = f + ":" + e + ":" + o;
      $("#Txt_3_GC_card_1").text(r);
      $("#Txt_3_GC_card_1").css({
        left: "110px",
        top: "346px",
        width: "126px",
        height: "35px",
        color: "white",
        "line-height": "35px",
        "font-size": "24rem",
        "text-align": "center",
        "text-shadow": "1px 1px 1px black",
        position: "absolute"
      })
    }(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_GACHA && S_GACHA.tab_focus === 1 || n > 0) && setTimeout(S_GACHA.drawRemainTime, 1e3)
  }
};

S_GACHA.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  utilScale_xy_center("GC_card_" + S_GACHA.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("GC_card_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("GC_card_" + S_GACHA.focus, 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("GC_card_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_GACHA.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};

    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};

};
S_GACHA.check_BP = function(n) {
  var t = 0;
  switch (n) {
    case "BONUS_POINT_5":
      USER.bonus_point >= NEED_BONUS_POINT5 && (t = 1);
      break;
    case "BONUS_POINT_6":
      USER.bonus_point >= NEED_BONUS_POINT && (t = 1);
      break;
    case "BONUS_POINT_7":
      USER.bonus_point >= NEED_BONUS_POINT7 && (t = 1)
  }
  return t
};
S_GACHA.check_user_pay_total_this_month = function(n) {
  console.log("%c S_GACHA.check_user_pay_total_this_month called ", "color: red;");
  S_PACKAGE_STORE.flag_get_user_pay_total_this_month = 0;
  S_PACKAGE_STORE.value_get_user_pay_total_this_month = 0;
  gEnableKey = 0;
  loading_show();
  get_user_pay_total_this_month(function() {
    loading_hide();
    var t = S_PACKAGE_STORE.value_get_user_pay_total_this_month,
      i = 5e3,
      r = t + parseInt(i);
    console.log("이번달 결제 금액:" + t);
    console.log("지  금 결제 금액:" + i);
    console.log("hap = " + r);
    r <= window.g.MONTH_MAX_PAYMENT ? (gEnableKey = 1, n && n.call(this, !1)) : (console.log("이번달 결제 한도액 초과 입니다. 다음달에 진행 바랍니다."), S_GACHA.POPUP.init(), S_GACHA.addMouseEvent(), blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene), gEnableKey = 1)
  })
};
S_GACHA.gacha_run = function() {
  if (S_GACHA.ad_reroll_run = 0, S_GACHA.ad_reroll_ticket = "", gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT) {
    if (S_GACHA.tab_focus === 2) {
      S_GACHA.check_user_pay_total_this_month(function(n) {
        if (!n && S_GACHA.tab_focus === 2) {
          S_GACHA.gacha_run_hero();
          return
        }
      });
      return
    }
    if (S_GACHA.tab_focus === 3) {
      if (S_GACHA.abs_focus === 1) {
        S_GACHA.check_user_pay_total_this_month(function(n) {
          if (!n && S_GACHA.tab_focus === 3) {
            S_GACHA.gacha_run_item();
            return
          }
        });
        return
      }
      if (S_GACHA.tab_focus === 3) {
        S_GACHA.gacha_run_item();
        return
      }
    }
  } else {
    if (S_GACHA.tab_focus === 2) {
      S_GACHA.gacha_run_hero();
      return
    }
    if (S_GACHA.tab_focus === 3) {
      S_GACHA.gacha_run_item();
      return
    }
  }
  loading_hide();
  gEnableKey = 1;
  var n = S_GACHA.data[S_GACHA.focus].type,
    t;
  if (n !== "LUCKY_CHANCE" && (t = S_GACHA.data[S_GACHA.focus].need_ruby), n === "SPECIAL") {
    if (S_GACHA.getRemainTime() > 0) {
      utilNotice(TXT.time_remain, 1.5);
      utilConsoleLog(TXT.time_remain);
      return
    }
  } else {
    if (n === "BONUS_POINT_5" || n === "BONUS_POINT_6" || n === "BONUS_POINT_7") {
      if (S_GACHA.check_BP(n)) {
        if (S_GACHA.need_ruby = t, S_GACHA.need_bonus_point = n === "BONUS_POINT_5" ? NEED_BONUS_POINT5 : n === "BONUS_POINT_6" ? NEED_BONUS_POINT : NEED_BONUS_POINT7, !S_GACHA.is_char_storage_space_available("BP")) return;
        S_GACHA.removeMouseEvent();
        $("#GC_card_focus_" + S_GACHA.focus).css({
          display: "none"
        });
        gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN) : ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
          display: "block"
        }), S_POPUPYN.init());
        return
      }
      utilNotice(TXT.bonus_point_lack, 1.4);
      return
    }
    if (n === "LUCKY_CHANCE") {
      if (LUCK_EVENT_FLAG == 0) {
        utilNotice(TXT.luck_event_not_time, 2);
        utilConsoleLog("행운이벤트 기간이 아닙니다.");
        return
      }
      if (S_GACHA.luck_event_num > 6) {
        utilNotice(TXT.luck_event_all_Participate, 2);
        utilConsoleLog("행운이벤트를 모두참여하였습니다.");
        return
      }
      if (USER.ruby >= LUCK_EVENT_NEED_RUBY[S_GACHA.luck_event_num]) {
        utilPush();
        S_GACHA.removeMouseEvent();
        $("#GC_card_focus_" + S_GACHA.focus).css({
          display: "none"
        });
        gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN) : ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
          display: "block"
        }), S_POPUPYN.init());
        return
      }
      utilNotice(TXT.ruby_lack, 1.2);
      utilConsoleLog("ruby 가 부족합니다. 구매 하시겠습니까?");
      return
    }
  }
  if (n === "SPECIAL" || USER.ruby >= t) {
    if (S_GACHA.need_ruby = t, !S_GACHA.is_char_storage_space_available("RUBY")) return;
    utilPush();
    S_GACHA.removeMouseEvent();
    $("#GC_card_focus_" + S_GACHA.focus).css({
      display: "none"
    });
    n === "SELECTION" || n === "SELECTION_PLUS" ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GACHA_SELECTION, S_GACHA_SELECTION) : gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN) : ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
      display: "block"
    }), S_POPUPYN.init());
    return
  }
  utilNotice(TXT.ruby_lack, 1.2);
  utilConsoleLog("ruby 가 부족합니다. 구매 하시겠습니까?");
  return
};
S_GACHA.is_char_storage_space_available = function(n) {
  var r = STORAGE.get_my_char_tot_num(),
    i, t;
  return (n === "RUBY" ? (i = S_GACHA.data[S_GACHA.focus].type, t = i === "PREMIUM_PLUS" || i === "SELECTION_PLUS" ? 6 : 1, AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[9] == 1 && (t = i === "PREMIUM_PLUS" ? 12 : 2, i === "SELECTION_PLUS" ? t = 6 : i === "SELECTION" && (t = 1)), AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[27] == 1 && (i === "SELECTION_PLUS" ? t = 12 : i === "SELECTION" && (t = 2))) : n === "BP" ? (i = S_GACHA.data[S_GACHA.focus].type, t = 1, AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[9] == 1 && (t = 2, i === "BONUS_POINT_7" && (t = 1))) : n == "FOUR_GODS" && (t = 1), r + t > STORAGE.data1.upgrade[8]) ? (utilNotice_line2_html(TXT.space_lack_2, 1.2), 0) : 1
};

S_GACHA.drawEffect = function() {
  var t, n;
  if (gEnableKey = 0, t = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url_only_glo() + "image/ui/98_effect/ef_levelup" + S_GACHA.effect.cur_frame + ".png", $("#GC_effect").css({
      display: "block",
      zIndex: "2"
    }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("GC_effect", t, 427, 200), S_GACHA.effect.cur_frame >= S_GACHA.effect.max_frame ? (S_GACHA.effect.cur_frame = 1, S_GACHA.effect.cur_loop++, S_GACHA.effect.cur_loop <= S_GACHA.effect.max_loop ? S_GACHA.effect.timer = setTimeout(S_GACHA.drawEffect, EFFECT_INTERVAL) : S_GACHA.effect_complete = 1) : (S_GACHA.effect.cur_frame++, S_GACHA.effect.timer = setTimeout(S_GACHA.drawEffect, EFFECT_INTERVAL)), S_GACHA.effect.cur_loop == S_GACHA.effect.max_loop && S_GACHA.effect.cur_frame > 10) {
    for (n = 1; n <= S_GACHA.card_num; n++) n == S_GACHA.focus ? $("#GC_card_" + n).css({
      display: "block"
    }) : $("#GC_card_" + n).css({
      display: "none"
    });
    S_GACHA.scale.start += S_GACHA.scale.gap;
    S_GACHA.scale.start >= S_GACHA.scale.end && utilScale_xy_center("GC_card_" + S_GACHA.focus, S_GACHA.scale.start, S_GACHA.scale.start)
  }
};
S_GACHA.checkCardAniEffect = function() {
  var i, r;
  if (S_GACHA.card_ani_complete_count >= 6 && S_GACHA.effect_complete == 1) {
    loading_show();
    gEnableKey = 0;
    auto_event_system_init();
    var u = {
        cur_ruby: USER.ruby,
        need_ruby: S_GACHA.need_ruby,
        cur_bp: USER.bonus_point,
        need_bp: S_GACHA.need_bonus_point,
        card_type: S_GACHA.data[S_GACHA.focus].type
      },
      n = S_GACHA.data[S_GACHA.focus].type,
      t = 1;
    S_GACHA.server_draw = null;
    i = function() {
      (t--, t > 0) || S_GACHA.networkCheck()
    };
    glo.APP_FEATURE.GACHA_SERVER_DRAW && n !== "LUCKY_CHANCE" && (t++, r = 0, (n === "SELECTION" || n === "SELECTION_PLUS") && (r = S_GACHA_SELECTION.checkbox_focus), ServerConnection.draw_char(n, r, S_GACHA.ad_reroll_run, function(n, t) {
      if (S_GACHA.server_draw = n, !n && !t) {
        glo.fun.show_s_error_network("Error in draw_char");
        return
      }
      i()
    }));
    auto_event_system_check(999, function() {
      i()
    }, JSON.stringify(u))
  } else setTimeout(S_GACHA.checkCardAniEffect, 100)
};

};
