  });
  S_GACHA.card10_ani.cur_x > S_GACHA.card_ani_target + 4 ? setTimeout(S_GACHA.card10_scroll_right, 100) : (S_GACHA.card10_ani.cur_x = S_GACHA.card_ani_target, $("#GC_card_10").css({
    left: S_GACHA.card10_ani.cur_x + "px"
  }), S_GACHA.card_ani_complete_count++)
};
S_GACHA.card11_scroll_right = function() {
  S_GACHA.card11_ani.cur_x = S_GACHA.card11_ani.cur_x - S_GACHA.card11_ani.speed * (S_GACHA.card11_ani.cur_x - S_GACHA.card_ani_target);
  $("#GC_card_11").css({
    left: S_GACHA.card11_ani.cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_GACHA.card11_ani.cur_x > S_GACHA.card_ani_target + 4 ? setTimeout(S_GACHA.card11_scroll_right, 100) : (S_GACHA.card11_ani.cur_x = S_GACHA.card_ani_target, $("#GC_card_11").css({
    left: S_GACHA.card11_ani.cur_x + "px"
  }), S_GACHA.card_ani_complete_count++)
};
S_GACHA.end = function() {
  S_GACHA.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_GACHA.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_GACHA.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_GACHA.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_GACHA.onClick = function(n) {
  var t, r, i, u, e, f, o, s;
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (S_GACHA.hero_popup_open) {
      for (r = n.target.id, i = n.target; i && i.id && i.id.substring(0, 17) !== "GC_hero_pop_hero_";)
        if (i = i.parentNode, !i || i.nodeName === "BODY") {
          i = null;
          break
        } if (i && i.id && i.id.substring(0, 17) === "GC_hero_pop_hero_") {
        u = parseInt(i.id.substring(17), 10);
        e = S_GUILD_SHOP.POPUP_HEROES ? S_GUILD_SHOP.POPUP_HEROES.length : 0;
        !isNaN(u) && u >= 1 && u <= e && (S_GACHA.hero_popup_focus = u, S_GACHA.hero_popup_row_focus = 1, S_GACHA.hero_popup_select(u), S_GACHA.hero_popup_drawFocus());
        return
      }
      if (r === "GC_hero_pop_btn_ok" || r === "GC_hero_pop_btn_ok_img" || r === "GC_hero_pop_btn_ok_focus" || r === "GC_hero_pop_btn_ok_txt") {
        S_GACHA.hero_popup_confirm();
        return
      }
      if (r === "GC_hero_pop_btn_cancel" || r === "GC_hero_pop_btn_cancel_img" || r === "GC_hero_pop_btn_cancel_focus" || r === "GC_hero_pop_btn_cancel_txt") {
        S_GACHA.hero_popup_close();
        return
      }
      return
    }
    n.target.id.search("percentage") >= 0 ? S_GACHA.run_percentage_show() : t && t.id && t.id.substring(0, 7) === "GC_tab_" ? (f = parseInt(t.id.substring(7), 10), !isNaN(f) && f >= 1 && f <= 4 && S_GACHA.switch_tab(f)) : S_GACHA.row_focus == 2 ? S_GACHA.menuRun_btnmenu() : n.target.id.substring(0, 9) == "GA_cover_" && (o = n.target.id.substring(9), s = parseInt(o, 10), S_GACHA.menuRun())
  }
};
S_GACHA.onMouseover = function(n) {
  var i, u, e, t, r, o, f, s;
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    if (S_GACHA.hero_popup_open) {
      for (t = n.target.id, i = n.target; i && i.id && i.id.substring(0, 17) !== "GC_hero_pop_hero_";)
        if (i = i.parentNode, !i || i.nodeName === "BODY") {
          i = null;
          break
        } if (i && i.id && i.id.substring(0, 17) === "GC_hero_pop_hero_") {
        u = parseInt(i.id.substring(17), 10);
        e = S_GUILD_SHOP.POPUP_HEROES ? S_GUILD_SHOP.POPUP_HEROES.length : 0;
        !isNaN(u) && u >= 1 && u <= e && (S_GACHA.hero_popup_focus = u, S_GACHA.hero_popup_row_focus = 1, S_GACHA.hero_popup_drawFocus());
        return
      }
      if (t === "GC_hero_pop_btn_ok" || t === "GC_hero_pop_btn_ok_img" || t === "GC_hero_pop_btn_ok_focus" || t === "GC_hero_pop_btn_ok_txt") {
        S_GACHA.hero_popup_row_focus = 2;
        S_GACHA.hero_popup_btn_focus = 1;
        S_GACHA.hero_popup_drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (t === "GC_hero_pop_btn_cancel" || t === "GC_hero_pop_btn_cancel_img" || t === "GC_hero_pop_btn_cancel_focus" || t === "GC_hero_pop_btn_cancel_txt") {
        S_GACHA.hero_popup_row_focus = 2;
        S_GACHA.hero_popup_btn_focus = 2;
        S_GACHA.hero_popup_drawFocus();
        return
      }
      return
    }
    if (!(n.target.id.search("percentage") >= 0)) {
      if (t = n.target.id, r = 0, t === "GC_tab_1" || t === "GC_tab_2" || t === "GC_tab_3" || t === "GC_tab_4" ? r = parseInt(t.charAt(t.length - 1), 10) : (t.substring(0, 12) === "GC_tab_text_" || t.substring(0, 13) === "GC_tab_focus_") && (r = parseInt(t.charAt(t.length - 1), 10)), r >= 1 && r <= 4) {
        r !== S_GACHA.cur_tab && S_GACHA.switch_tab(r);
        S_GACHA.on_tab = !0;
        S_GACHA.drawFocus_tab();
        return
      }
      S_GACHA.on_tab && (S_GACHA.on_tab = !1, S_GACHA.make_screen_tab());
      switch (n.target.id) {
        case "GC_back":
        case "GC_back_icon":
        case "Txt_GC_back":
        case "Img_GC_back_focus":
          if (!glo.APP_FEATURE.TOUCH_PLATFORM) {
            S_GACHA.row_focus = 2;
            S_GACHA.btn_focus = 1;
            S_GACHA.drawFocus_btnmenu();
            S_GACHA.onMouseover_pressed("GC_back_icon", "Txt_GC_back")
          }
          return;
        case "GC_maketeam_btn":
        case "GC_maketeam_bg":
        case "Txt_GC_maketeam":
        case "Img_GC_maketeam_icon":
        case "Img_GC_maketeam_focus":
          S_GACHA.row_focus = 2;
          S_GACHA.btn_focus = 2;
          S_GACHA.drawFocus_btnmenu();
          return
      }
      if (n.target.id.substring(0, 9) != "GA_cover_") {
        utilConsoleLog("해당 id는 무시:" + n.target.id);
        return
      }
      if (S_GACHA.row_focus = 1, o = n.target.id.substring(9), f = parseInt(o, 10), isNaN(f)) {
        utilConsoleLog("Error in S_GACHA.onMouseover() : focus is NaN");
        return
      }
      s = Math.floor(S_GACHA.scroll_target_x * -1 / (S_GACHA.card_w + S_GACHA.card_gap)) + 1;
      S_GACHA.abs_focus = S_GACHA.abs_focus + (f - S_GACHA.focus);
      S_GACHA.focus = f;
      S_GACHA.drawFocus()
    }
  }
};
S_GACHA.get_card_left = function(n) {
  return S_GACHA.card_align === S_GACHA.CARD_ALIGN_LEFT ? 41 : n <= 1 ? 640 - S_GACHA.card_w / 2 : n <= GACHA_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? 640 - S_GACHA.card_w / 2 - (S_GACHA.card_w / 2 + S_GACHA.card_gap / 2) * (n - 1) : 640 - S_GACHA.card_w / 2 - (S_GACHA.card_w / 2 + S_GACHA.card_gap / 2) * (GACHA_NUM_ON_SCREEN - 1)
};

  }), $("#Txt_3_GC_card_" + n).css({
    color: "white"
  });

    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_GC_start_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });

  })

  S_GACHA.define();

  S_GACHA.addMouseEvent()
};

S_GACHA.hero_popup_draw = function() {
  for (var t = S_GUILD_SHOP.img_url_profile, i = S_GUILD_SHOP.POPUP_HEROES, n = 1; n <= 10; n++) {
    var r = n - 1,
      u = r < i.length,
      f = u ? t + "profile_icon_" + i[r].char_num + ".png" : t + "profile_icon_blank.png";
    $("#GC_hero_pop_icon_" + n).attr("src", f);
    u && n === S_GACHA.hero_popup_selected ? $("#GC_hero_pop_check_" + n).show() : $("#GC_hero_pop_check_" + n).hide()
  }
};
S_GACHA.hero_popup_drawFocus = function() {
  for (var n = 1; n <= 10; n++) $("#GC_hero_pop_focus_" + n).hide();
  $("#GC_hero_pop_btn_ok_focus").hide();
  $("#GC_hero_pop_btn_cancel_focus").hide();
  S_GACHA.hero_popup_row_focus === 1 ? S_GACHA.hero_popup_focus >= 1 && S_GACHA.hero_popup_focus <= 10 && $("#GC_hero_pop_focus_" + S_GACHA.hero_popup_focus).show() : S_GACHA.hero_popup_btn_focus === 1 ? $("#GC_hero_pop_btn_ok_focus").show() : $("#GC_hero_pop_btn_cancel_focus").show()
};
S_GACHA.hero_popup_select = function(n) {
  var t = S_GUILD_SHOP.POPUP_HEROES;
  n < 1 || n > t.length || (S_GACHA.hero_popup_selected = S_GACHA.hero_popup_selected === n ? 0 : n, S_GACHA.hero_popup_draw())
};
S_GACHA.hero_popup_confirm = function() {
  if (S_GACHA.hero_popup_selected === 0) {
    utilNotice(TXT.selecet_a_character, 1.5);
    return
  }
  var t = S_GACHA.hero_popup_selected - 1,
    i = S_GUILD_SHOP.POPUP_HEROES,
    n = i[t],
    r = S_GACHA.hero_popup_times >= 10 ? n.type_num_10 : n.type_num_1;
  S_GACHA.hero_popup_open = !1;
  $("#GC_hero_pop_dim").hide();
  $("#GC_hero_pop_bg").hide();
  S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_max = 2;
  S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE.type_num = r;
  S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE.from_gacha = !0;
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE, S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE)
};
S_GACHA.hero_popup_close = function() {
  S_GACHA.hero_popup_open = !1;
  $("#GC_hero_pop_dim").hide();
  $("#GC_hero_pop_bg").hide();
  S_GACHA.drawFocus()
};
S_GACHA.hero_popup_keyDown = function(n) {
  var t = 5,
    f = S_GUILD_SHOP.POPUP_HEROES,
    e = f ? f.length : 0,
    i = S_GACHA.hero_popup_focus,
    r, u;
  switch (n) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_GACHA.hero_popup_row_focus === 1 ? (r = (i - 1) % t, r > 0 && S_GACHA.hero_popup_focus--) : S_GACHA.hero_popup_btn_focus > 1 && S_GACHA.hero_popup_btn_focus--;
      S_GACHA.hero_popup_drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_GACHA.hero_popup_row_focus === 1 ? (r = (i - 1) % t, r < t - 1 && i + 1 <= e && S_GACHA.hero_popup_focus++) : S_GACHA.hero_popup_btn_focus < 2 && S_GACHA.hero_popup_btn_focus++;
      S_GACHA.hero_popup_drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_GACHA.hero_popup_row_focus === 1 ? i > t && (S_GACHA.hero_popup_focus -= t) : S_GACHA.hero_popup_row_focus = 1;
      S_GACHA.hero_popup_drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_GACHA.hero_popup_row_focus === 1 && (u = i + t, i <= t && u <= e ? S_GACHA.hero_popup_focus = u : S_GACHA.hero_popup_row_focus = 2);
      S_GACHA.hero_popup_drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_GACHA.hero_popup_row_focus === 1 ? S_GACHA.hero_popup_select(S_GACHA.hero_popup_focus) : S_GACHA.hero_popup_btn_focus === 1 ? S_GACHA.hero_popup_confirm() : S_GACHA.hero_popup_close();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_GACHA.hero_popup_close()
  }
};
S_GACHA.gacha_run_item = function() {
  var t = S_GACHA.focus,
    r = S_GACHA.is_hide_x10_pkg() ? 1 : 2,
    i, n, u;
  if (t <= r) {
    if (i = S_GACHA.tab_item_pkg_data[t], !i) return;
    S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_max = 2;
    S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE.type_num = i.type_num;
    S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE.from_gacha = !0;
    ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE, S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE);
    return
  }
  n = t - r;
  u = function(t) {
    for (var r, u, i = 0; i < t.event_arr.length; i++) AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[t.event_arr[i]] = 1;
    if (auto_event_value(), loading_hide(), gEnableKey = 1, !S_ITEM_GACHA.data || !S_ITEM_GACHA.data[n]) {
      utilConsoleLog("gacha_run_item: S_ITEM_GACHA.data 없음");
      return
    }
    if (r = S_ITEM_GACHA.data[n].need_ruby, !(get_cur_ruby() > 0 && get_cur_ruby() >= r)) {
      utilNotice(TXT.ruby_lack, 1.2);
      return
    }
    if (u = n <= 3 ? 1 : 6, AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[23] == 1 && (u = n <= 3 ? 2 : 12), STORAGE.get_my_item_tot_num() + u > DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX) {
      utilNotice(TXT.item_space_lack, 1.2);
      return
    }
    S_ITEM_GACHA.focus = n;
    S_ITEM_GACHA.need_ruby = r;
    S_ITEM_GACHA.is_error = 0;
    S_GACHA.item_gacha_mode = !0;
    S_GACHA.item_gacha_focus = n;
    S_GACHA.item_gacha_need_ruby = r;
    utilPush();
    S_GACHA.removeMouseEvent();
    gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN) : ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
      display: "block"
    }), S_POPUPYN.init())
  };
  loading_show();
  gEnableKey = 0;
  auto_event_system_init();
  auto_event_system_check(999, u)
};
S_GACHA.gacha_item_yes = function() {
  if (!glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_GACHA_PHP_REFACTORING) {
    utilConsoleLog("gacha_item_yes: ITEM_GACHA_PHP_REFACTORING 꺼져 있음");
    return
  }
  gEnableKey = 0;
  S_ITEM_GACHA.flag_back_lock = 1;
  S_GACHA.item_ad_reroll_done = S_GACHA.item_ad_reroll_run ? 1 : 0;
  var n = null;
  S_GACHA.item_ad_reroll_run && (S_ITEM_GACHA.need_ruby = 0, S_GACHA.item_gacha_need_ruby = 0, n = {
    AD_REROLL: 1
  });
  S_GACHA.item_ad_reroll_run = 0;
  $("#S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_MAINMENU.remount_mm_top(S_GACHA, TXT.gacha);
  $("#S_GACHA_div").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  S_ITEM_GACHA.call_num_by_gacha = 0;
  S_ITEM_GACHA.is_error = 0;
  S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.init_ITEM_GACHARESULT();
  S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.calculate();
  S_ITEM_GACHA.gacha_etc = S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha_etc();
  S_GACHA.aniRun();
  loading_show("ITEM_GACHA", 1);
  ServerConnection.update_item_to_server(S_ITEM_GACHA.gacha_etc, function(n) {
    loading_hide("ITEM_GACHA", 1);
    var t = n;
    if (t.STATUS == "ERROR") {
      S_ITEM_GACHA.is_error = 1;
      t.ERROR_CODE == "BLACK_LIST" || t.ERROR_CODE == "ITEM_USE_OVER" ? ((gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.SSBR) && (S_ERROR_NETWORK.black_list_check = 1), glo.fun.show_s_error_network("아이템 뽑기에서 실패:BLACK_LIST")) : t.ERROR_CODE == "RUN_COUNT_ERROR" || t.ERROR_CODE == "HOST_ID_NONE" ? glo.fun.show_s_error_network("아이템 뽑기에서 실패:" + t.ERROR_CODE) : glo.fun.show_s_error_network("아이템 뽑기에서 실패:" + t.ERROR_CODE);
      S_GACHA.item_gacha_error_lg_unlock();
      return
    }
    if (t.STATUS && t.STATUS.search("mysql_error") >= 0) {
      S_ITEM_GACHA.is_error = 1;
      glo.fun.show_s_error_network("아이템 뽑기에서 실패:mysql_error:" + t.ERROR_MESSAGE);
      S_GACHA.item_gacha_error_lg_unlock();
      return
    }
    USER.ruby = Number(t.after_ruby);
    glo.APP_FEATURE.GOLD_CRYPT && (USER.ruby_encoding = number_encoding(t.after_ruby));
    S_ITEM_GACHA.is_error = 0;
    S_ITEM_GACHA.callback_update_item_to_server()
  }, "ITEM_GACHA", S_ITEM_GACHA.need_ruby * -1, n)
};

};

S_GACHA.mousedrag_right_to_left = function() {
  if (S_GACHA.scroll_flag != 1) {
    var t = (S_GACHA.card_w + S_GACHA.card_gap) * (S_GACHA.card_num - GACHA_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1,
      i = (S_GACHA.card_w + S_GACHA.card_gap) * (S_GACHA.card_num - GACHA_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1 - S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x,
      r = Math.abs(Math.floor(i / (S_GACHA.card_w + S_GACHA.card_gap))),
      n = GACHA_NUM_ON_SCREEN - 1,
      u = S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x - (S_GACHA.card_w + S_GACHA.card_gap) * n;
    u < t && (n = r);
    S_GACHA.focus < S_GACHA.card_num && (S_GACHA.focus = S_GACHA.focus + n, S_GACHA.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = S_GACHA.scroll_target_x, S_GACHA.scroll_flag = 0), S_GACHA.scroll_target_x = S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x - (S_GACHA.card_w + S_GACHA.card_gap) * n, S_GACHA.scroll_right())
  }
};
S_GACHA.mousedrag_left_to_right = function() {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    var i = 0,
      n = 3,
      t = S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x + (S_GACHA.card_w + S_GACHA.card_gap) * n;
    t > i && (n = 2, t = S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x + (S_GACHA.card_w + S_GACHA.card_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 1, t = S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x + (S_GACHA.card_w + S_GACHA.card_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 0)));
    S_GACHA.focus = S_GACHA.focus - n;
    S_GACHA.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = S_GACHA.scroll_target_x, S_GACHA.scroll_flag = 0);
    S_GACHA.scroll_target_x = S_GACHA.scroll_cur_x + (S_GACHA.card_w + S_GACHA.card_gap) * n;
    S_GACHA.scroll_left()
  }
};

S_GACHA_COMPLETE.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var r = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    i;
  if (S_GACHA_COMPLETE.is_make_screen_btnmenu === 1) switch (r) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_GACHA.data[S_GACHA.focus].type === "LUCKY_CHANCE") return;
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus >= 2 && (S_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus--, S_GACHA_COMPLETE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_GACHA.data[S_GACHA.focus].type === "LUCKY_CHANCE") return;
      i = REWARD_AD.exists(REWARD_AD.PLACE.GACHA_COMPLETE) && !S_GACHA_COMPLETE.ad_redraw_used ? 4 : 3;
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus < i && (S_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus++, S_GACHA_COMPLETE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.run_back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.menuRun()
  }
};

S_GACHA_COMPLETE.menuRun = function() {
  console.log(" S_GACHA_COMPLETE.menuRun gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey);
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus) {
    case 1:
      utilScale_xy_center("GCO_redraw", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_GCO_redraw_icon", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_GCO_redraw_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 2:
      utilScale_xy_center("GCO_ok", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_GCO_ok_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 3:
      utilScale_xy_center("GCO_maketeam", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_GCO_maketeam_icon", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_GCO_maketeam_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    switch (S_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus) {
      case 1:
        utilScale_xy_center("GCO_redraw", 1, 1);
        utilScale_xy_center("Img_GCO_redraw_icon", 1, 1);
        utilScale_xy_center("Img_GCO_redraw_focus", 1, 1);
        break;
      case 2:
        utilScale_xy_center("GCO_ok", 1, 1);
        utilScale_xy_center("Img_GCO_ok_focus", 1, 1);
        break;
      case 3:
        utilScale_xy_center("GCO_maketeam", 1, 1);
        utilScale_xy_center("Img_GCO_maketeam_icon", 1, 1);
        utilScale_xy_center("Img_GCO_maketeam_focus", 1, 1)
    }
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_GACHA_COMPLETE.menuRun_Run = function() {
  var n, t, i;
  console.log(" S_GACHA_COMPLETE.menuRun_Run gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey);
  switch (S_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus) {
    case 4:
      if (!REWARD_AD.is_enabled("GCO_ad_btn")) {
        REWARD_AD.notice_state("GCO_ad_btn");
        gEnableKey = 1;
        break
      }
      REWARD_AD.play(REWARD_AD.PLACE.GACHA_COMPLETE, "", null, S_GACHA_COMPLETE.on_reward_ad);
      break;
    case 1:
      if (S_GACHA.ad_reroll_run = 0, S_GACHA.ad_reroll_ticket = "", n = S_GACHA.data[S_GACHA.focus].type, t = S_GACHA.data[S_GACHA.focus].need_ruby, S_GACHA.data[S_GACHA.focus].type === "SPECIAL") {
        if (S_GACHA.getRemainTime() > 0) {
          utilNotice(TXT.time_remain, 1.5);
          utilConsoleLog(TXT.time_remain);
          return
        }
      } else if (n === "BONUS_POINT_5" || n === "BONUS_POINT_6" || n === "BONUS_POINT_7") {
        if (S_GACHA_COMPLETE.check_BP_for_one_more(n)) {
          if (S_GACHA.need_ruby = t, S_GACHA.need_bonus_point = n === "BONUS_POINT_5" ? Math.ceil(NEED_BONUS_POINT5 * .9) : n === "BONUS_POINT_6" ? Math.ceil(NEED_BONUS_POINT * .9) : Math.ceil(NEED_BONUS_POINT7 * .9), !S_GACHA.is_char_storage_space_available("BP")) return;
          S_GACHA.removeMouseEvent();
          $("#GC_card_focus_" + S_GACHA.focus).css({
            display: "none"
          });
          gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN) : ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
            display: "block"
          }), S_POPUPYN.init());
          return
        }
        utilNotice(TXT.bonus_point_lack, 1.4);
        return
      }
      if (i = Math.floor(t * .9), (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && EVENT.is_active(2) && (i = Math.floor(t * (100 - EVENT[2].value) / 100)), get_cur_ruby() >= i) {
        if (S_GACHA.need_ruby = i, !S_GACHA.is_char_storage_space_available("RUBY")) return;
        utilPush();
        gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV ? (S_GACHA.removeMouseEvent(), $("#GC_card_focus_" + S_GACHA.focus).css({
          display: "none"
        }), $("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
          display: "block"
        }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? (S_GACHA_COMPLETE.removeMouseEvent(), $("#GCO_btn1_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        }), $("#GCO_btn2_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        }), $("#GCO_btn3_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        }), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN)) : gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT ? (S_GACHA_COMPLETE.end(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN)) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && (S_GACHA_COMPLETE.removeMouseEvent(), $("#GCO_btn1_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        }), $("#GCO_btn2_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        }), $("#GCO_btn3_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        }), $("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
          display: "block"
        }), S_POPUPYN.init());
        return
      }
      utilNotice(TXT.ruby_lack, 1.2);
      utilConsoleLog("ruby 가 부족합니다. 구매 하시겠습니까?");
      return;
    case 2:
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.run_back();
      break;
    case 3:
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.end();
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM);
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_GACHA_COMPLETE.menuRun_Run():" + S_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus)
  }
};
S_GACHA_COMPLETE.check_BP_for_one_more = function(n) {
  var t = 0;
  switch (n) {
    case "BONUS_POINT_5":
      USER.bonus_point >= NEED_BONUS_POINT5 * .9 && (t = 1);
      break;
    case "BONUS_POINT_6":
      USER.bonus_point >= NEED_BONUS_POINT * .9 && (t = 1);
      break;
    case "BONUS_POINT_7":
      USER.bonus_point >= NEED_BONUS_POINT7 * .9 && (t = 1)
  }
  return t
};
S_GACHA_COMPLETE.back = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  S_GACHA_COMPLETE.end();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GACHA, S_GACHA)
};
S_GACHA_COMPLETE.apply_server_draw = function() {
  var n = typeof S_GACHA != "undefined" ? S_GACHA.server_draw : null,
    t;
  if (!n) return !1;
  var r = S_GACHA.data[S_GACHA.focus].type,
    u = r === "SELECTION_PLUS" || r === "PREMIUM_PLUS" ? 6 : 1,
    i = "";
  for (n.CH_NUM && n.CH_NUM.length !== 0 ? n.CH_NUM.length !== u && (i = "마리수가 " + n.CH_NUM.length + " 로 기대(" + u + ")와 다르다") : i = "캐릭터 목록이 비었다", t = 1; !i && t <= n.CH_NUM.length; t++) parseInt(n.CH_NUM[t - 1], 10) || (i = t + "번째 캐릭터 번호가 비었다");
  if (i) return utilConsoleLog("apply_server_draw: " + i + ". 뽑기를 진행하지 않는다."), S_GACHA.server_draw = null, glo.fun.show_s_error_network("Error in draw_char result"), !0;
  for (t = 1; t <= n.CH_NUM.length; t++) GACHARESULT[t].star = parseInt(n.STAR[t - 1], 10), GACHARESULT[t].ch_num = parseInt(n.CH_NUM[t - 1], 10);
  return utilConsoleLog("서버 발급 결과 사용 : " + n.CH_NUM.join(",") + " (1+1:" + n.IS_1P1 + ")"), S_GACHA_COMPLETE.add_char(), !0
};
S_GACHA_COMPLETE.calculate = function() {
  if (S_GACHA_COMPLETE.quest_counted = 0, !S_GACHA_COMPLETE.apply_server_draw()) switch (S_GACHA.data[S_GACHA.focus].type) {
    case "SPECIAL":
    case "NORMAL":
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha1();
      break;
    case "NORMAL_PLUS":
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha2();
      break;
    case "PREMIUM":
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha3();
      break;
    case "PREMIUM_PLUS":
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha4();
      break;
    case "BONUS_POINT_5":
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha6();
      break;
    case "BONUS_POINT_6":
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha7();
      break;
    case "LUCKY_CHANCE":
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha8();
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.show_screen();
      break;
    case "BONUS_POINT_7":
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha_bp7();
      break;
    case "SELECTION":
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha_selection();
      break;
    case "SELECTION_PLUS":
      S_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha_selection_plus()
  }
};
S_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha1 = function() {
  var n = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 1),
    r, t, i, u;
  for (utilConsoleLog("get_gacha1  rnd:" + n), GACHARESULT[1].star = n <= GACHA_PROBABILITY.gacha1[1] ? 5 : n <= GACHA_PROBABILITY.gacha1[1] + GACHA_PROBABILITY.gacha1[2] ? 4 : n <= GACHA_PROBABILITY.gacha1[1] + GACHA_PROBABILITY.gacha1[2] + GACHA_PROBABILITY.gacha1[3] ? 3 : n <= GACHA_PROBABILITY.gacha1[1] + GACHA_PROBABILITY.gacha1[2] + GACHA_PROBABILITY.gacha1[3] + GACHA_PROBABILITY.gacha1[4] ? 2 : 1, r = [], t = 0, i = 1; i <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM; i++) GACHARESULT[1].star == CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].star && (t++, r[t] = i);
  utilConsoleLog("Count =" + t);
  u = Math.floor(Math.random() * t + 1);
  GACHARESULT[1].ch_num = r[u];
  S_GACHA_COMPLETE.add_char()
};

S_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha4 = function() {
  var i = new Array(GACHA_HOW_MANY + 1),
    t, u, n, e, f, r, o;
  for (utilConsoleLog("get_gacha4  rnd:" + i), t = 0, u = 0, n = 1; n <= GACHA_HOW_MANY; n++) {
    for (i[n] = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 1), i[n] <= GACHA_PROBABILITY.gacha4[1] ?   }
};
S_GACHA_COMPLETE.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    utilConsoleLog(" onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
    switch (n.target.id) {
      case "GCO_redraw_btn":
      case "GCO_redraw":
      case "Txt_GCO_redraw":
      case "Img_GCO_redraw_icon":
      case "Img_GCO_redraw_focus":
        S_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus = 1;
        break;
      case "GCO_ok_btn":
      case "GCO_ok":
      case "Txt_GCO_ok":
      case "Img_GCO_ok_focus":
        S_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus = 2;
        break;
      case "GCO_maketeam_btn":
      case "GCO_maketeam":
      case "Txt_GCO_maketeam":
      case "Img_GCO_maketeam_icon":
      case "Img_GCO_maketeam_focus":
        S_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus = 3;
        break;
      case "GCO_ad_btn":
      case "Txt_GCO_ad_btn_label":
      case "Txt_GCO_ad_btn_sub":
      case "Img_GCO_ad_btn_dim":
      case "Img_GCO_ad_focus":
        S_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus = 4
    }
    S_GACHA_COMPLETE.drawFocus()
  }
};

S_MARKETSTORE.define = function() {
  for (var i, r, t, n = 0; n <= MARKETSTORE_NUM + 1; n++) MARKETSTORE[n] = {};
  for (i = 5, r = 206, n = 1; n <= 5; n++) MARKETSTORE[n].x = 115 + r * (n - 1) + i * (n - 1), MARKETSTORE[n].y = 149, MARKETSTORE[n].w = 206, MARKETSTORE[n].h = 205, t = n + 5, MARKETSTORE[t].x = 115 + r * (n - 1) + i * (n - 1), MARKETSTORE[t].y = 378, MARKETSTORE[t].w = 206, MARKETSTORE[t].h = 205;
  for (n = 1; n <= BUY_SORT_NUM; n++) BUY_GOLD[n] = {}, BUY_RUBY[n] = {};
  BUY_GOLD[1].gold = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW1[1].gold;
  BUY_GOLD[1].need_ruby = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW1[1].ruby;
  BUY_GOLD[2].gold = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW1[2].gold;
  BUY_GOLD[2].need_ruby = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW1[2].ruby;
  BUY_GOLD[3].gold = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW1[3].gold;
  BUY_GOLD[3].need_ruby = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW1[3].ruby;
  BUY_GOLD[4].gold = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW1[4].gold;
  BUY_GOLD[4].need_ruby = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW1[4].ruby;
  BUY_GOLD[5].gold = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW1[5].gold;
  BUY_GOLD[5].need_ruby = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW1[5].ruby;
  BUY_RUBY[1].ruby = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW2[1].ruby;
  BUY_RUBY[1].need_won = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW2[1].won;
  BUY_RUBY[2].ruby = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW2[2].ruby;
  BUY_RUBY[2].need_won = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW2[2].won;
  BUY_RUBY[3].ruby = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW2[3].ruby;
  BUY_RUBY[3].need_won = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW2[3].won;
  BUY_RUBY[4].ruby = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW2[4].ruby;

S_MARKETSTORE.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  if ((gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR) && !stopYoutube) {
    console.log(" S_MARKETSTORE.keyDown  openPaymentWindow  " + getPlayerState());
    $("#player1").css({
      left: "830px",
      height: "300px",
      width: "450px"
    });
    $("#player1_notmouse").css({
      left: "830px",
      height: "300px",
      width: "450px"
    });
    $("#player1_next_btn").hide();
    S_MARKETSTORE.openPaymentWindow();
    return
  }
  if (S_MARKETSTORE.POPUP.flag == 1) {
    (i == KeyDefine.enter || i == KeyDefine.back) && (gEnableKey = 0, utilScale_xy_center("MS_popup_btn1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale), utilScale_xy_center("MS_popup_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale), setTimeout(function() {
      utilScale_xy_center("MS_popup_btn1", 1, 1);
      utilScale_xy_center("MS_popup_focus", 1, 1);
      setTimeout(function() {
        gEnableKey = 1;
        $("#MS_popup_div").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        $("#MS_popup_div").empty();
        $("#MM_top").css({
          display: "block"
        });
        S_MARKETSTORE.POPUP.flag = 0;
        S_MARKETSTORE.drawFocus();
        Main.displaySafeZone()
      }, gKeyUpTime)
    }, gKeyPressTime));
    return
  }
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.up:
      if (S_MARKETSTORE.row_focus == 2) {
        S_MARKETSTORE.row_focus = 1;
        S_MARKETSTORE.drawFocus();
        PACKAGE_OPEN == 1 && S_MARKETSTORE.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        return
      }
      S_MARKETSTORE.focus >= 6 && (S_MARKETSTORE.focus = S_MARKETSTORE.focus - 5, S_MARKETSTORE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      if (S_MARKETSTORE.row_focus == 2) return;
      S_MARKETSTORE.focus <= 5 ? (S_MARKETSTORE.focus = S_MARKETSTORE.focus + 5, S_MARKETSTORE.drawFocus()) : (S_MARKETSTORE.row_focus = 2, S_MARKETSTORE.drawFocus_btnmenu());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_MARKETSTORE.row_focus == 2) {
        PACKAGE_OPEN == 1 ? S_MARKETSTORE.btn_focus > 1 && S_MARKETSTORE.btn_focus-- : S_MARKETSTORE.btn_focus = 1;
        S_MARKETSTORE.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        return
      }
      S_MARKETSTORE.focus >= 2 && (S_MARKETSTORE.focus--, S_MARKETSTORE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_MARKETSTORE.row_focus == 2) {
        PACKAGE_OPEN == 1 ? S_MARKETSTORE.btn_focus < 3 && S_MARKETSTORE.btn_focus++ : S_MARKETSTORE.btn_focus = 2;
        S_MARKETSTORE.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        return
      }
      S_MARKETSTORE.focus < MARKETSTORE_NUM && (S_MARKETSTORE.focus++, S_MARKETSTORE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_MARKETSTORE.backKey();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_MARKETSTORE.menuRun()
  }
};
S_MARKETSTORE.backKey = function() {
  S_MARKETSTORE.removeMouseEvent();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU)
};

S_MARKETSTORE.drawFocus = function() {
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  PACKAGE_OPEN != 1 ? ($("#Img_MS_back_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_MS_start_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Txt_MS_back").css({
    color: "white"
  }), $("#MS_start").css({
    color: "white"
  })) : gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM && gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH && gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.HCN && S_MARKETSTORE.drawFocus_btnmenu();
  for (var n = 1; n <= MARKETSTORE_NUM; n++) S_MARKETSTORE.focus != n ? ($("#Txt1_MS_m" + n).css({
    color: "white"
  }), $("#Txt2_MS_m" + n).css({
    color: "white"
  }), n > 5 && $("#Txt2_MS_m" + n + "_bp").css({
    color: "white"
  })) : ($("#Txt1_MS_m" + n).css({
    color: "yellow"
  }), $("#Txt2_MS_m" + n).css({
    color: "yellow"
  }), n > 5 && $("#Txt2_MS_m" + n + "_bp").css({
    color: "yellow"
  }), $("#MS_menu_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("MS_menu_focus", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url_only_glo() + "image/ui/10_charge/ch_bt_focus.png", MARKETSTORE[n].x, MARKETSTORE[n].y))
};

S_MARKETSTORE.menuRun = function() {
  if (gEnableKey = 0, sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT), S_MARKETSTORE.row_focus == 2) {
    if (gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM && gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH && gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.HCN) switch (S_MARKETSTORE.btn_focus) {
      case 1:
        utilScale_xy_center("MS_back", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
        utilScale_xy_center("MS_back_icon", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
        utilScale_xy_center("Txt_MS_back", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
        utilScale_xy_center("Img_MS_back_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
        break;
      case 2:
        utilScale_xy_center("MS_start", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
        utilScale_xy_center("MS_start_icon", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
        utilScale_xy_center("Img_MS_start_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
    }
  } else utilScale_xy_center("MS_menu" + S_MARKETSTORE.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale), utilScale_xy_center("MS_menu_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM && gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH && gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.HCN && (utilScale_xy_center("MS_back", 1, 1), utilScale_xy_center("MS_back_icon", 1, 1), utilScale_xy_center("Txt_MS_back", 1, 1), utilScale_xy_center("Img_MS_back_focus", 1, 1), utilScale_xy_center("MS_start", 1, 1), utilScale_xy_center("MS_start_icon", 1, 1), utilScale_xy_center("Img_MS_start_focus", 1, 1));
    utilScale_xy_center("MS_menu" + S_MARKETSTORE.focus, 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("MS_menu_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      S_MARKETSTORE.menuRun_Run();
      (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && (gEnableKey = 1)
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_MARKETSTORE.menuRun_Run = function() {
  var n;
  if (S_MARKETSTORE.row_focus == 2) {
    switch (S_MARKETSTORE.btn_focus) {
      case 1:
        bga("send", "event", "market", "select", "back");
        gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : (S_MARKETSTORE.removeMouseEvent(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU));
        break;
      case 2:
        PACKAGE_OPEN == 1 ? (bga("send", "event", "market", "select", "package"), S_MARKETSTORE.removeMouseEvent(), $("#S_MARKETSTORE_div").css({
          display: "none"
        }), document.getElementById("S_PACKAGE_ITEM_div") == null ? $("#S_MARKETSTORE_div").after('<div id= "S_PACKAGE_ITEM_div"><\/div>') : $("#S_PACKAGE_ITEM_div").empty(), ServerConnection.get_package_event_time(S_PACKAGE_ITEM.buy_package_item), loading_show(), gEnableKey = 0) : (bga("send", "event", "market", "select", "gamestart"), S_MARKETSTORE.removeMouseEvent(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_SELECTMAP, S_SELECTMAP));
        break;
      case 3:
        PACKAGE_OPEN == 1 && (bga("send", "event", "market", "select", "gamestart"), S_MARKETSTORE.removeMouseEvent(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_SELECTMAP, S_SELECTMAP))
    }
    return
  }
  switch (S_MARKETSTORE.focus) {
    case 1:
    case 2:
    case 3:
    case 4:
    case 5:
      bga("send", "event", "market", "select", "gold:" + S_MARKETSTORE.focus);
      var t = S_MARKETSTORE.focus,
        i = S_MARKETSTORE.need_ruby = BUY_GOLD[t].need_ruby,
        r = BUY_GOLD[t].gold;
      if (get_cur_ruby() >= i) {
        utilPush();
        S_MARKETSTORE.removeMouseEvent();
        $("#MS_menu_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
          display: "block"
        }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN);
        return
      }
      gEnableKey = 1;
      utilNotice(TXT.ruby_lack, 1.3);
      return;
    case 6:
    case 7:
    case 8:
    case 9:
    case 10:
      if ((gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && (n = function() {
          if (S_MARKETSTORE.flag_get_user_pay_total_this_month == 0) {
            setTimeout(n, 10);
            return
          }
          loading_hide();
          var t = S_MARKETSTORE.value_get_user_pay_total_this_month,
            i = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW2[S_MARKETSTORE.focus - 5].won,
            r = t + parseInt(uncomma(i));
          if (utilConsoleLog("이번달 결제 금액:" + t), utilConsoleLog("지  금 결제 금액:" + i), utilConsoleLog("hap = " + r), r <= window.g.MONTH_MAX_PAYMENT) {
            gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_PAYMENT_CNM, S_PAYMENT_CNM) : ($("#S_PAYMENT_CNM_div").css({
              display: "block"
            }), S_PAYMENT_CNM.init());
            return
          }
          utilConsoleLog("이번달 결제 한도액 초과 입니다. 다음달에 진행 바랍니다.");
          S_MARKETSTORE.POPUP.init();
          S_MARKETSTORE.addMouseEvent();
          blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
          gEnableKey = 1;
          return
        }), bga("send", "event", "market", "select", "ruby:" + (S_MARKETSTORE.focus - 5)), S_MARKETSTORE.removeMouseEvent(), $("#MS_menu_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        }), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT) {
        S_MARKETSTORE.flag_get_user_pay_total_this_month = 0;
        S_MARKETSTORE.value_get_user_pay_total_this_month = 0;
        gEnableKey = 0;
        loading_show();
        get_user_pay_total_this_month();
        n();
        return
      }
      if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) {
        ServerConnection.payment_count("XSOLLA");
        gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_INPUT_PAY_div").css({
          display: "block"
        }), S_INPUT_PAY.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_INPUT_PAY, S_INPUT_PAY);
        return
      }
      if (glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) {
        if (S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.isConnected() && glo.fun.is_korea_platform(S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.info.platform)) {
          utilNoticeUpper(TXT.payment_fail_mobile_connect, 2);
          return
        }
        try {
          if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB) {
            ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_PAYMENT_CNM, S_PAYMENT_CNM);
            return
          }
          Main.use_android_bridge() ? (android_bridge.show_progress_dialog(), android_bridge.request_payment(MARKETSTORE.ROW2[S_MARKETSTORE.focus - 5].pid)) : S_PACKAGE_STORE.payment_cancel("5")
        } catch (u) {
          S_PACKAGE_STORE.payment_cancel("6")
        }
      }
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN);
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("error!! in S_MARKETSTORE.menuRun()")
  }
};
S_MARKETSTORE.yes = function() {
  if (gEnableKey = 0, S_MARKETSTORE.focus <= 5) {
    if (utilConsoleLog("S_MARKETSTORE.yes  골드전환"), glo.APP_FEATURE.BUY_GOLD_SERVER_CALC) {
      loading_show("골드환전", 1);
      ServerConnection.buy_gold(S_MARKETSTORE.focus, function(n) {
        loading_hide("골드환전", 1);
        S_PACKAGE_STORE.apply_buy_gold_result(n);
        S_MARKETSTORE.addMouseEvent();
        $("#MS_menu_focus").css({
          display: "block"
        });
        blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)
      });
      return
    }
    USER.ruby = USER.ruby - S_MARKETSTORE.need_ruby;
    glo.APP_FEATURE.RUBY_CRYPT && encoding_add_ruby(-S_MARKETSTORE.need_ruby);
    S_MAINMENU.make_screen_top_add_gold(BUY_GOLD[S_MARKETSTORE.focus].gold);
    utilNotice(TXT.buy_gold_ok, 1.3);
    STORAGE.save_all_info_to_storage("골드전환:" + S_MARKETSTORE.need_ruby + "루비 ->" + BUY_GOLD[S_MARKETSTORE.focus].gold + "골드");
    save_UserInfo_after_pay_to_server("-" + S_MARKETSTORE.need_ruby, "골드전환");
    S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top();
    S_MARKETSTORE.addMouseEvent();
    loading_show();
    setTimeout(function() {
      loading_hide();
      $("#MS_menu_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
      gEnableKey = 1
    }, 700)
  } else if (gBUSIDOL_PAY_USE == !0) ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_BUSIDOL_PATMENT_SELECT, S_BUSIDOL_PATMENT_SELECT);
  else if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV) gLOCAL_SET == "ED_VIET" ? initYoutubePlayer() : S_MARKETSTORE.openPaymentWindow();
  else if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR) S_MARKETSTORE.openPaymentWindow();
  else if (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) {
    var n = S_MARKETSTORE.focus - 5,
      t = BUY_RUBY[n].need_won,

S_MARKETSTORE.facebook_payment_result = function(n) {
  if (n.status != null && n.status == "completed") {
    utilNotice(TXT.buy_ruby_ok, 1.5);
    S_MARKETSTORE.ok_payment();
    S_MARKETSTORE.resume();
    S_MARKETSTORE.addMouseEvent();
    var t = n.purchase_token;
    FB.api("/" + t + "/consume", "post", {
      access_token: gAccessToken
    }, function() {})
  } else {
    put_callback_fail(n);
    S_MARKETSTORE.resume();
    S_MARKETSTORE.addMouseEvent();
    return
  }
};

g_pay_time = 0;
S_MARKETSTORE.ok_payment = function() {
  var r, t;
  if (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) {
    if (S_MARKETSTORE.ok_payment_calltime == window.g.timestamp_due) return;
    S_MARKETSTORE.ok_payment_calltime = window.g.timestamp_due
  } else if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR) {
    if (r = parseInt(window.g.timestamp_start, 10) + parseInt(window.g.timestamp_due, 10), g_pay_time != 0 && r - g_pay_time <= 1e3) {
      utilConsoleLog("연속결제오류 방지!!" + r);
      g_pay_time = r;
      var u = S_MARKETSTORE.focus - 5,
        i = BUY_RUBY[u].need_won,
        n = BUY_RUBY[u].ruby;
      save_UserInfo_after_pay_to_server(n, "현질(연속결제오류방지)");
      return
    }
    g_pay_time = r
  }
  var u = S_MARKETSTORE.focus - 5,
    i = BUY_RUBY[u].need_won,
    n = BUY_RUBY[u].ruby;
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR) && S_EVENT.status == 2 ? (n = 150, log_ping_back_to_server("재구매이벤트(루비150+50BP)", i, USER.ruby, USER.ruby + n), S_MAINMENU.make_screen_top_add_ruby(n), save_UserInfo_after_pay_to_server(n, "현질"), t = 50, ServerConnection.add_bonus_point(t, i + "($,원)소모 재구매이벤트 (" + t + "포인트 획득)"), USER.bonus_point += t, STORAGE.save_all_info_to_storage("ok_payment():결제완료"), S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top(), S_EVENT.status = 0, g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU.addMouseEvent(), S_MAINMENU.drawFocus(), blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)) : (log_ping_back_to_server("루비 " + n + "개", i, USER.ruby, USER.ruby + n), S_MAINMENU.make_screen_top_add_ruby(n), save_UserInfo_after_pay_to_server(n, "현질"), t = MARKET_DESIGN.get_bonus_point(i), ServerConnection.add_bonus_point(t, i + "($,원)소모 루비구매 (" + t + "포인트 획득)"), USER.bonus_point += t, STORAGE.save_all_info_to_storage("현질:" + i + "원($) : Ruby(" + n + ")"), S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top());
  QUEST.f9_charge()
};

S_MARKETSTORE.addMouseEvent = function() {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    if (S_MARKETSTORE.mouse_event == 1) {
      utilConsoleLog("!!! 중복호출 제거 !!!");
      return
    }
    S_MARKETSTORE.mouse_event = 1;
    $(".button").click(this.onClick).mouseover(this.onMouseover)
  }
};
S_MARKETSTORE.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (S_MARKETSTORE.mouse_event = 0, $(".button").unbind("click").unbind("mouseover"))
};

S_GAME.pause = function() {
  var n, t;
  if (utilConsoleLog("S_GAME.pause()!!"), gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM)
    if (CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp <= 0) S_GAME.ourCastle_destroyAni();
    else if (CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp <= 0) S_GAME.yourCastle_destroyAni();
  else {
    if (sound_bgm_play(BGM_SOUND.INGAME), S_GAME.addMouseEvent(), S_GAME.notice_flag == 1) {
      $("#GA_board").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_GAME.notice_flag = 1;
      return
    }
    S_GAME.interval();
    S_GAME.start_render();
    n = S_GAME.your_team_stop_time - S_GAME.your_team_start_time;
    S_GAME.timer_autoYourTeamManager != null && (clearInterval(S_GAME.timer_autoYourTeamManager), S_GAME.timer_autoYourTeamManager = null);
    S_GAME.your_team_remain_time = S_GAME.your_team_remain_time - n;
    S_GAME.your_team_remain_time < 0 && (S_GAME.your_team_remain_time = 0);
    S_GAME.timer_autoYourTeamManager = setTimeout(S_GAME.autoYourTeamManager_timeout, S_GAME.your_team_remain_time);
    t = new Date;
    S_GAME.your_team_start_time = t.getTime()
  } else S_GAME.notice_flag == 1 && (clearInterval(S_GAME.notice_timer), S_GAME.notice_timer = null), S_GAME.end()
};
S_GAME.resume = function() {
  var n, t;
  if (utilConsoleLog("S_GAME.resume()!!"), CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp <= 0) S_GAME.ourCastle_destroyAni();
  else if (CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp <= 0) S_GAME.yourCastle_destroyAni();
  else {
    if (sound_bgm_play(BGM_SOUND.INGAME), S_GAME.addMouseEvent(), S_GAME.notice_flag == 1) {
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN ? ($("#GA_board").css({
        display: "block"
      }), gEnableKey = 1, S_GAME.notice_flag = 1) : ($("#GA_board").css({
        display: "none"
      }), gEnableKey = 1, S_GAME.notice_flag = 0);
      return
    }
    S_GAME.interval();
    S_GAME.start_render();
    n = S_GAME.your_team_stop_time - S_GAME.your_team_start_time;
    S_GAME.timer_autoYourTeamManager != null && (clearInterval(S_GAME.timer_autoYourTeamManager), S_GAME.timer_autoYourTeamManager = null);
    S_GAME.your_team_remain_time = S_GAME.your_team_remain_time - n;
    S_GAME.your_team_remain_time < 0 && (S_GAME.your_team_remain_time = 0);
    S_GAME.timer_autoYourTeamManager = setTimeout(S_GAME.autoYourTeamManager_timeout, S_GAME.your_team_remain_time);
    t = new Date;
    S_GAME.your_team_start_time = t.getTime()
  }
};
S_GAME.create_stone = function() {
  S_GAME.stage >= 221 && 225 >= S_GAME.stage ? S_GAME.addYourUnit(77) : S_GAME.stage >= 226 && 230 >= S_GAME.stage ? S_GAME.addYourUnit(78) : S_GAME.stage >= 231 && 235 >= S_GAME.stage ? S_GAME.addYourUnit(79) : S_GAME.stage >= 236 && 240 >= S_GAME.stage ? S_GAME.addYourUnit(80) : S_GAME.stage == 300 && S_GAME.addYourUnit(105);
  switch (S_GAME.stage) {
    case 225:
      S_GAME.addYourUnit(77);
      break;
    case 230:
      S_GAME.addYourUnit(78);
      break;
    case 235:
      S_GAME.addYourUnit(79);
      break;
    case 240:
      S_GAME.addYourUnit(80)
  }
};

S_GAME.mineral_level_init = function() {
  for (var t = CAL.get_user_mineral_maxlimt(), n = 1; n <= MINERAL_LEVEL_MAX; n++) MINERAL_LEVEL_ARRAY[n] = {}, MINERAL_LEVEL_ARRAY[n].max = Math.floor(t * (1 + (n - 1) / 10)), MINERAL_LEVEL_ARRAY[n].need_mineral = Math.floor(t * .1 * n)
};
S_GAME.levelUp = function() {
  var n;
  if (S_GAME.stage == MAX_LEVEL) {
    document.getElementById("temp_text").innerHTML = "니 끝판까지 깻다. 수고했다.";
    $("#temp_text").css({
      display: "block"
    });
    return
  }
  for (S_GAME.stage++, S_GAME.my_mineral = S_GAME.max_mineral = S_GAME.max_mineral + 50, CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp = CASTLE_OUR.max_hp, CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp = CASTLE_YOUR.max_hp = STAGE_DESIGN[S_GAME.stage].castle_your_max_hp, S_GAME.init(), S_GAME.acc_your_num = 0, n = 1; n <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; n++) S_GAME.ourunit_display_none(n);
  for (n = 1; n <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) S_GAME.yourunit_display_none(n)
};

S_GAME.end = function() {
  S_GAME.removeMouseEvent();
  var n = new Date;
  S_GAME.your_team_stop_time = n.getTime();
  clearInterval(S_GAME.timer_interval);
  S_GAME.timer_interval = null;
  S_GAME.stop_render();
  clearInterval(S_GAME.timer_autoYourTeamManager);
  S_GAME.timer_autoYourTeamManager = null;
  clearInterval(timer_nextwave);
  timer_nextwave = null;
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && sound_bgm_stop()
};
S_GAME.end_memory_free = function() {
  for (var u, n = 1; n <= USER.socket_available_num; n++) LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[n] && (LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[n].MOVE = null, LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[n].WAIT = null, LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[n].ATTACK = null, LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[n].BEATTACK = null, LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[n].FIRE = null, LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[n].VALKYRIE = null, LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[n].SHIELD = null, LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[n].SHIELD_102 = null, LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[n].REFLECT = null, LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[n].HEAL = null, LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[n].FEVER = null, LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[n].ATTACK_2 = null);
  GOLD_ELEPHANT_BURN_ANI = null;
  SNAKE_BIND_ANI = null;
  LOIMG_ETC_OUR.free_memory();
  var i = "GA",
    r = "S_GAME",
    t = 1;
  if (S_GAME.is_sky_garden_mode()) t = RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_end - RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.char_start + 1;
  else if (S_GAME.is_pvp_mode())
    for (t = USER_NPC.num, USER_NPC.char = [], u = 1; u <= 5; u++) USER_NPC.char[u] = {
      unit_num: 0
    };
  else S_GAME.is_stage_mode() ? (t = STAGE_DESIGN[S_GAME.stage].char_end - STAGE_DESIGN[S_GAME.stage].char_start + 1, S_GAME.is_nazegul_create(S_GAME.stage) && t++, S_GAME.is_secret_create(S_GAME.stage) && t++, S_GAME.is_stone_create(S_GAME.stage) && t++) : S_GAME.is_boss_mode() ? (i = "BOSS", r = "S_BOSS", t = S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() ? 1 : BOSS_STAGE_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].boss_max_num) : S_GAME.is_daydungeon_mode() ? (i = "DD", r = "S_DAYDUNGEON", t = DAYDUNGEON_STAGE_DESIGN[DD_stage_design_index()].dd_enemy.length - 1) : S_GAME.is_cloud_garden_mode() && (i = "CLOUD_GARDEN", r = "S_CLOUD_GARDEN", t = CLOUD_GARDEN_STAGE_DESIGN[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage].cloud_garden_max_num, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.char_up_arr = null, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.char_down_arr = null, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.BOSS_AP_INFO = null, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.CHAR_AP_INFO = null);
  for (n = 1; n <= t; n++) LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[n] && (LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[n].MOVE = null, LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[n].WAIT = null, LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[n].ATTACK = null, LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[n].BEATTACK = null, LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[n].FIRE = null, LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[n].VALKYRIE = null, LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[n].SHIELD = null, LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[n].SHIELD_102 = null, LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[n].REFLECT = null, LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[n].HEAL = null, LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[n].FEVER = null);
  $("#Img_" + i + "_bg").css({
    background: null
  });
  $("#Img_" + i + "_center_bg").css({
    background: null
  });
  $("#Img_" + i + "_bottom_bg").css({

  });
  window[r].$el = null
};

S_GAME.modeChange_m = function() {
  if (S_GAME.is_sky_garden_mode()) {
    if (RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.len_from_our_to_your <= 1280) return;
    S_GAME.view_mode = 1280 / RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.len_from_our_to_your
  } else {
    if (STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_GAME.stage] <= 1280) return;
    S_GAME.view_mode = 1280 / STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_GAME.stage]
  }
  $("#s_game_center").css({
    left: CASTLE_OUR.x + "px",
    top: GAME_BASE_Y - GAME_BASE_Y * S_GAME.view_mode + "px",
    width: "1280px",
    height: "720px",
    position: "absolute"
  });
  utilScale_xy("s_game_center", S_GAME.view_mode, S_GAME.view_mode)
};
S_GAME.focusRun_board = function() {
  var u = 73,
    t, r, n, i;
  switch (S_GAME.board.focus) {
    case 1:
    case 2:
    case 3:
      if (S_GAME.board.ad_free == 1) break;
      if (n = S_GAME.board.focus, S_GAME.board.menu[n].check == 0) {
        if (get_cur_ruby() < S_GAME.board.need_ruby_tot + S_GAME.board.menu[n].need_ruby) {
          utilNotice(TXT.ruby_lack, 1.5);
          return
        }
        S_GAME.board.menu[n].check = 1;
        S_GAME.board.need_ruby_tot += S_GAME.board.menu[n].need_ruby;
        $("#GA_board_btn" + n + "_check").css({
          display: "block"
        });
        $("#Txt_MM_top_ruby").text(utilGetNumber_withComma(USER.ruby - S_GAME.board.need_ruby_tot + ""));
        S_GAME.board.focus == 1 && (t = 333 + u, $("#Img_GA_attackup").css({
          display: "block"
        }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_GA_attackup", glo.img_url + "image/ui/4_game/ga_attackupicon.png", t, 16), S_GAME.board.menu[2].check == 1 && (t += 80, utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_GA_shieldup", glo.img_url + "image/ui/4_game/ga_shieldupicon.png", t, 16)));
        S_GAME.board.focus == 2 && (t = 489 + u - 80, S_GAME.board.menu[1].check == 0 && (t -= 80), $("#Img_GA_shieldup").css({
          display: "block"
        }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_GA_shieldup", glo.img_url + "image/ui/4_game/ga_shieldupicon.png", t, 16));
        S_GAME.board.focus == 3 && S_GAME.top_ui.update_metor_num(S_GAME.metor_num + S_GAME.board.menu[3].upgrade)
      } else S_GAME.board.menu[n].check = 0, S_GAME.board.need_ruby_tot -= S_GAME.board.menu[n].need_ruby, $("#GA_board_btn" + n + "_check").css({
        display: "none"

S_GAME.apply_stage_burn_damage = function() {
  var t, f, n;
  if (S_GAME.burn_damage_time > 0 && S_GAME.ranking_mode == 0 && S_GAME.stage >= 261 && S_GAME.stage <= 280) {
    var o = new Date,
      r = o.getTime(),
      u = r - S_GAME.burn_damage_time;
    if (u < 1e3) return;
    for (console.log("스테이지 화상 데미지 S_GAME.total_burn_damage:" + S_GAME.total_burn_damage), S_GAME.burn_damage_time = r - u % 1e3, S_GAME.total_burn_damage > S_GAME.MAX_BURN_DAMAGE_LIMIT && (S_GAME.total_burn_damage = S_GAME.MAX_BURN_DAMAGE_LIMIT), t = 1, S_GAME.is_ice_queen_rucy_alive_ally86() && (t = .5, console.log("스테이지 화상 데미지 - 얼음여왕 루시 출전시에는 데미지 50% 감소 적용")), f = Math.floor(CASTLE_OUR.max_hp * (S_GAME.total_burn_damage / 100) * t), S_GAME.attack_damage.attack_tower("burn", "your", f), n = 1; n <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; n++)
      if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1) {
        var e = Math.floor(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].full_hp * (S_GAME.total_burn_damage / 100) * t),
          s = Math.floor(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].full_hp * .5),
          h = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp,
          i = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num;
        if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].cheering_time > 0 || OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].shield_102_time > 0) {
          console.log("유니콘 루비 (89)의 응원으로 스테이지 화상 데미지 면역");
          continue
        } else if (S_GAME.has_innate_ability("our", i, INNATE_ABILITY.ANGRY_BURN_IMM)) {
          console.log("[홍염] 환염 - 앵그리 행성 화상 데미지 면역 unit_num:" + i);
          continue
        } else console.log("스테이지 화상 데미지 OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp:" + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp + "  base_damage:" + e), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp - e;
        S_GAME.run_half_hp_and_die_of_our(n, 0, h, s, i, !1)
      }
  }
};

S_GAME.get_max_damage_on_enemy = function(n, t, i, r) {
  var f = t,
    u, e, a, o, h, s, c, l;
  if (i) {
    if (!YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n]) return 0;
    u = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num;
    e = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].full_hp
  } else {
    if (!OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n]) return 0;
    u = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num;
    e = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].full_hp
  }
  if (r == "ILLUSION" && (a = i ? "your" : "our", S_GAME.check_stealth_dodge(a, n))) return 0;
  if (i) {
    if (S_GAME.is_pvp_mode()) {
      if (S_GAME.is_koo_char(u)) return 0;
      if (!check_ability_stage()) return t;
      if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].cheering_time > 0) return 0;
      u == 82 || u == 85 || u == 89 || u == 90 || u == 116 || u == 117 ? (o = Math.floor(e * .3), f = o > t ? t : o) : u == 92 && r == "ILLUSION" ? (h = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 1), f = h <= 80 ? 0 : t) : S_GAME.is_four_guardians_char(u) || S_GAME.has_special_ability("your", u, SPECIAL_ABILITY.FORTITUDE) ? (s = Math.floor(e * S_GAME.get_damage_buff_of_four_gods("your", u)), f = Math.min(s, t), console.log(" PVP 사방신의 강인함 full_hp:" + e + "  blue_buff:" + s + "  enemy_power:" + t + " res:" + f + " 현재 hp:  " + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp)) : f = t
    } else f = t;
    return S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() && f > 0 && S_GAME.ogong_unit.is_live_your && (c = i ? "your" : "our", l = S_GAME.special_ability.get_index_value(S_GAME.ogong_unit.unit_num, S_GAME.ogong_unit.socket_index_your, c, "pvp_team_damage_reduction_per"), f = Math.floor(f * (100 - l) / 100), f < 1 && (f = 1)), f
  }
  if (S_GAME.is_koo_char(u)) return 0;
  if (!check_ability_stage()) return t;
  if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].cheering_time > 0) return 0;
  if (u == 82 || u == 85 || u == 89 || u == 90 || u == 116 || u == 117) o = Math.floor(e * .3), f = o > t ? t : o;
  else if (u == 92 && r == "ILLUSION") h = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 1), f = h <= 80 ? 0 : t;
  else if (S_GAME.is_four_guardians_char(u) || S_GAME.has_special_ability("our", u, SPECIAL_ABILITY.FORTITUDE)) {
    if (CHAR_OUR_TEAM[u].fortitude_per !== undefined) var v = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].socket_index,
      y = S_GAME.special_ability.get_index_value(u, v, "our", "fortitude_per"),
      s = Math.floor(e * (y / 100));
    else s = Math.floor(e * S_GAME.get_damage_buff_of_four_gods("our", u));
    f = Math.min(s, t)
  } else f = t;
  return S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() && f > 0 && S_GAME.ogong_unit.is_live_our && (c = i ? "your" : "our", l = S_GAME.special_ability.get_index_value(S_GAME.ogong_unit.unit_num, S_GAME.ogong_unit.socket_index_our, c, "pvp_team_damage_reduction_per"), f = Math.floor(f * (100 - l) / 100), f < 1 && (f = 1)), f
};
S_GAME.check_stealth_dodge = function(n, t) {
  var u, i, r;
  return check_ability_stage() ? (u = n == "our" ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY : YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY, i = u[t], !i || i.alive != 1) ? !1 : S_GAME.has_special_ability(n, i.unit_num, SPECIAL_ABILITY.STEALTH) ? i.stealth_roll_tick === window.g.timestamp_due ? i.stealth_dodged : (r = S_GAME.special_ability.get_index_value(i.unit_num, i.socket_index, n, "stealth_per"), i.stealth_dodged = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 1) <= r, i.stealth_roll_tick = window.g.timestamp_due, i.stealth_dodged && console.log("[현오 은신] 회피 성공! (팀:" + n + " idx:" + t + " unit_num:" + i.unit_num + " 확률:" + r + "%)"), i.stealth_dodged) : !1 : !1
};

      }
    } return i

S_GAME.drawCastle_our = function() {
  var n = null,
    t, i, r;
  CASTLE_OUR.mode_before = CASTLE_OUR.mode;
  switch (CASTLE_OUR.mode) {
    case MODE.DESTROY:
      n = "_destroy";
      break;
    case MODE.WAIT:
      n = "_wait";
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:
      t = CAL.get_our_castle_level();
      i = t <= 3 ? 4 : 6;
      n = "_attack_" + CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_attack;
      CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_attack >= i ? (CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_attack = 1, S_GAME.fireRaser(), CASTLE_OUR.mode = MODE.WAIT) : CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_attack++;
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED:
      switch (CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_beattack) {
        case 1:
          n = "_beattack_1";
          CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_beattack = 2;
          break;
        case 2:
          n = "_beattack_2";
          CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_beattack = 1;
          CASTLE_OUR.mode = MODE.WAIT
      }
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_GAME.drawCastle_our()");
      return
  }
  r = S_GAME.is_sky_garden_mode() ? RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.castle_our_filename + n + ".png" : STAGE_DESIGN[S_GAME.stage].castle_our_filename + n + ".png";
  utilDrawImage_no_wh$(S_GAME.$el.our_castle, r, CASTLE_OUR.x, CASTLE_OUR.y, "absolute");
  S_GAME.show_easter_eggs()
};

S_GAME.startUnit = function(n) {
  var i, t, o, r, u, f, h, s, e;
  if ((n <= 0 || n > 8) && utilConsoleLog("Error! in S_GAME.startUnit()"), i = "GA", t = "S_GAME", S_GAME.is_stage_mode()) {
    if ((S_SELECTSTAGE.is_forced_debuff_stage() || S_SELECTSTAGE.is_enhanced_sealing_debuff_stage()) && S_GAME.socket_not_available["seal" + n] == 1) return
  } else if (S_GAME.is_boss_mode()) i = "BOSS", t = "S_BOSS";
  else if (S_GAME.is_cloud_garden_mode()) i = "CLOUD_GARDEN", t = "S_CLOUD_GARDEN";
  else if (S_GAME.is_daydungeon_mode()) i = "DD", t = "S_DAYDUNGEON";
  else if (S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() && OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].seal !== undefined && OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].seal == !0) return;
  for (o = !1, r = 1; r <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; r++)
    if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[r].alive == 0) {
      o = !0;
      break
    } if (o) {
    if (glo.APP_FEATURE.BLUE_DRAGON && (u = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].unit_num, S_GAME.is_four_guardians_char(u) || S_GAME.has_deploy_type("our", u, DEPLOY_TYPE.ONE))) {
      for (f = S_GAME.get_num_live_our_char(), h = {}, e = 0; e < DEPLOY_TYPE_ONE.length; e++) s = DEPLOY_TYPE_ONE[e], h[s] = f.live_map[s] === 1 ? 1 : 0;
      if (f.live_map && f.live_map[u] === 1) {
        S_GAME.bottom_ui.draw_char_dim(n, "show");
        return
      }
      if (USER.mineral_cur < OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].need_mineral) {
        utilNotice(TXT.mineral_lack, 1.2);
        return
      }
      OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].ch_time >= OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].need_ch_time && S_GAME.bottom_ui.draw_char_dim(n, "show")
    }
    OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].ch_time >= OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].need_ch_time ? window[t].addOurUnit(n) : is_autoplay_stop() == !1 && utilNotice(TXT.time_lack, 1.2)
  }
};

        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_speed_base = l;
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_speed_item_per = u + f;
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_speed_bensi_mul = w;
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].moonlight_leap_per = b;
        r = S_GAME.wolmyo_unit.get_move_speed_with_char_effect(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t], 1);
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_speed = r;
        S_GAME.is_normal_stage_mode() && S_SELECTSTAGE.is_sloth_debuff_level1() ? (console.log(" 252 스테이지 - 나태 - 이동속도 저하 (캐릭터 이동속도 -50% 적용) "), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_speed = Math.floor(r * .5), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_speed_base = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_speed_base * .5) : S_GAME.is_normal_stage_mode() && S_SELECTSTAGE.is_sloth_debuff_level2() && (console.log(" 혼돈 행성 스테이지 - 나태 - 이동속도 저하 (캐릭터 이동속도 -75% 적용) "), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_speed = Math.floor(r * .25), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_speed_base = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_speed_base * .25);

        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].excitingly_time = 0;
        (i == 87 || i == 94 || i == 109 || i == 110) && S_GAME.apply_special_ability("EXCITINGLY");
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].dignity_time = 0;
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_stop_count = 0;
        i == 90 && S_GAME.apply_special_ability("DIGNITY", "YOUR");
        i == 116 && S_GAME.apply_horus_move_stop(t, "our", 3);
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].freezing_time = 0;
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].ori_move_speed = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_speed;
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].ori_attack_speed = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].attack_speed;
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].cold_slow_time = 0;
        S_GAME.apply_cold_aura_on_spawn(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY, t, "our", "your");
        S_GAME.apply_summon_heal_on_spawn(t, "our");
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].cheering_time = 0;
        i == 89 && S_GAME.apply_special_ability("CHEERING");
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].shield_102_time = 0
      }
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode = MODE.MOVE;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_frame_cur = 1;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].attack_frame_cur = 1;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].beattack_frame_cur = 1;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].fire_frame_cur = 1;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].wait_frame_cur = 1;
      S_GAME.apply_heal_to_castle(i, n, "our");
      i == 84 && check_ability_stage() && (S_GAME.is_stage_mode() && (S_GAME.stage == 245 || S_GAME.stage == 250 || S_GAME.stage == 255 || S_GAME.stage == 260) ? console.log(" 거인 나오는 스테이지에서는 8성 특수 능력 메테오 사용하면 안됨") : S_GAME.run_metor(!0));

    } a == 0 && is_autoplay_stop() == !1 && utilNotice(TXT.fullongame, 1.2)

S_GAME.addYourUnit = function(n) {

          break;

          break;
        case 67:
        case 68:
        case 69:
        case 70:
          YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x = CASTLE_YOUR.x - 300;
          break;
        case 71:
        case 72:
        case 73:
        case 74:

        case 76:
          YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x = CASTLE_YOUR.x - CHAR_YOUR_TEAM[n].beattack_margine;

S_GAME.is_move_blocked = function(n, t) {
  if (!check_ability_stage()) return !1;
  var i = n == "your" ? YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY : OUR_TEAM_ARRAY;
  return !i[t] || i[t].alive != 1 ? !1 : i[t].move_stop_count > 0
};
S_GAME.apply_special_ability = function(n, t) {
  var r, s, o, v, c, e, h, i, a;
  if (check_ability_stage()) {
    for (t === "YOUR" ? (r = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY, s = MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN, o = S_GAME.get_num_live_your_char()) : (r = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY, s = MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX, o = S_GAME.get_num_live_our_char()), v = o.four_count, c = o.live_map, e = {}, i = 0; i < DEPLOY_TYPE_ONE.length; i++) h = DEPLOY_TYPE_ONE[i], e[h] = c[h] === 1 ? 1 : 0;
    if (n == "VALOR_BUGLE" && e[107] == 0) {
      r = null;
      return
    }
    for (i = 1; i <= s; i++)
      if (r[i].alive == 1) {
        console.log("캐릭번호:" + r[i].unit_num + "  check_type:" + n + "  add_type:" + t);
        var l = S_GAME.get_hp_bar_xy(i, t),
          u = l.x,
          f = l.y;
        if (n == "VALOR" || n == "VALOR_2" || n == "VALOR_3") {
          if (e[95] == 1) {
            r = null;
            return
          }
          a = n == "VALOR_3" ? 1.4 : n == "VALOR_2" ? 1.35 : 1.3;

          console.log("캐릭번호:" + r[i].unit_num + "  용맹함 적용 후 AP:" + r[i].attack_power)
        } else if (n == "EXCITINGLY") {

            return
          }
          console.log("캐릭번호:" + r[i].unit_num + "  신나게 적용 전 AP:" + r[i].move_speed);
          r[i].move_speed = Math.floor(S_GAME.wolmyo_unit.get_move_speed_with_char_effect(r[i], 2));

S_GAME.AutoPlay_auto = function() {
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_GAME) {
    switch (S_GAME.autoplay_count) {
      case 1:
        S_GAME.focus = 1;
        break;
      case 2:
        S_GAME.focus = 2;
        break;
      case 3:
        3 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_GAME.focus = 3);
        break;
      case 4:
        4 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_GAME.focus = 4);
        break;
      case 5:
        5 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_GAME.focus = 5);
        break;
      case 6:
        6 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_GAME.focus = 6);
        break;
      case 7:
        6 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_GAME.focus = 7)
    }
    S_GAME.focusRun();
    S_GAME.autoplay_count == 7 ? S_GAME.autoplay_count = 1 : S_GAME.autoplay_count++;
    S_GAME.autoplay_timer != null && (clearInterval(S_GAME.autoplay_timer), S_GAME.autoplay_timer = null);
    S_GAME.autoplay_timer = setTimeout(S_GAME.AutoPlay_auto, 100)
  } else S_GAME.autoplay_count = 1, clearInterval(S_GAME.autoplay_timer), S_GAME.autoplay_timer = null
};

  if (S_GAME.stage < 181 || S_GAME.stage > 200) {
    $("#GA_ability_time_div").css({

    });
    return
  }
  $("#GA_ability_time_div").css({

  });
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("GA_ability_time_bg", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/4_game/ga_specialbox_0.png", 0, 28);

    width: "604px",
    height: "35px",
    "line-height": "35px",
    "font-size": "19rem",
    "text-align": "center",
    color: "#fffc00",
    position: "absolute"
  });
  USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? ($("#GA_ability_time_bg_text").text("아군의 모든 특수능력이 " + stage_ability_limit_time() + "초간 통하지 않는 스테이지입니다!"), S_GAME.stage > 197 && $("#GA_ability_time_bg_text").text("아군의 모든 특수능력이 통하지 않는 스테이지입니다!")) : ($("#GA_ability_time_bg_text").text("stage where all your special ability don't last for " + stage_ability_limit_time() + " seconds!"), S_GAME.stage > 197 && $("#GA_ability_time_bg_text").text("stage where all your special ability don't!"));

    top: "-4px",
    width: "43px",
    height: "44px",
    "line-height": "44px",
    "font-size": "25rem",
    "text-align": "center",
    color: "#ff0000",
    position: "absolute"
  });
  var n = function() {
    if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_GAME && g_sceneinfo.before_scene != gS_GAME && g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_POPUPYN) {
      $("#GA_ability_time_div").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      return
    }
    if (S_GAME.stage_ability_time_pause_start > 0) {
      utilConsoleLog("~~##~~특수능력 사용불가 시간에 일시 정지 중입니다. ");
      setTimeout(n, 200);
      return
    }
    if (check_ability_stage()) $("#GA_ability_time_div").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    else {
      $("#GA_ability_time_div").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      var i = stage_ability_limit_time(),
        r = stage_progress_time(),
        t = i - r;
      t >= 0 ? $("#GA_ability_time_text").text(t) : $("#GA_ability_time_text").text("");
      t % 2 == 0 ? (utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("GA_ability_time_img", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/4_game/ga_specialtime1.png", 264, -24), $("#GA_ability_time_text").css({
        color: "#ff0000"
      })) : (utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("GA_ability_time_img", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/4_game/ga_specialtime2.png", 264, -24), $("#GA_ability_time_text").css({
        color: "#fffc00"
      }));
      S_GAME.stage >= 198 && $("#GA_ability_time_text").text("∞");
      setTimeout(n, 200)
    }
  };
  n()
};

      }

S_GAME.apply_fever_tower_damage_daydungeon = function(n, t) {
  if (n === "our") {
    if (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day == 2 || S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day === 7) return;
    if (CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp = Math.floor(CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp - t), CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp <= 0) {
      CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp = 0;
      document.getElementById("Txt_DD_your_castle").innerHTML = Math.floor(CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp) + " / " + CASTLE_YOUR.max_hp;
      CASTLE_YOUR.mode = MODE.DESTROY;
      S_DAYDUNGEON.drawCastle_your();
      S_DAYDUNGEON.yourCastle_destroyAni();
      return
    }
    CASTLE_YOUR.mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED;
    document.getElementById("Txt_DD_your_castle").innerHTML = Math.floor(CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp) + " / " + CASTLE_YOUR.max_hp
  } else {
    if (CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp = Math.floor(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp - t), CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp <= 0) {
      CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp = 0;
      document.getElementById("Txt_DD_our_castle").innerHTML = Math.floor(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp) + " / " + CASTLE_OUR.max_hp;
      S_DAYDUNGEON.ourCastle_destroyAni();
      return
    }
    document.getElementById("Txt_DD_our_castle").innerHTML = Math.floor(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp) + " / " + CASTLE_OUR.max_hp
  }
};

S_GAME.get_num_live_generic = function(n) {
  var h = typeof DEPLOY_TYPE_ONE != "undefined" && DEPLOY_TYPE_ONE && typeof DEPLOY_TYPE_ONE.length == "number" ? DEPLOY_TYPE_ONE : [],
    k = n === "our",
    o, s, e, i, t;
  k ? (o = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY, s = MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX, e = !1, i = !1) : (o = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY, s = MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN, e = !0, i = !0);
  for (var c = 0, l = 0, a = [], f = {}, r = 0; r < h.length; r++) f[h[r]] = 0;
  for (r = 1; r <= s; r++)
    if (t = o[r], t)
      if (t.alive === 1 && (e ? t.hp > 0 : !0)) {
        var u = t.unit_num,
          v = !1,
          y = !1;
        if (c++, v = S_GAME.is_four_guardians_char(u), y = S_GAME.has_deploy_type(n, u, DEPLOY_TYPE.ONE), (v || y) && (!i || i && S_GAME.is_pvp_mode())) {
          l++;
          f[u] = 1;
          continue
        }
        f.hasOwnProperty(u) && (f[u] = 1)
      } else if (e && t.alive === 1 && t.hp <= 0) {

S_GAME.interval_set_your_div = function(n) {

  h = S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() ? glo.fun.get_img_url_ally(t) + "image/char/" + e[t].dirname + "/" : glo.fun.get_img_url_enemy(t) + "image/char/" + e[t].dirname + "/";
  g = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w + "px";
  nt = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].h + "px";
  u = null;
  switch (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode) {
    case MODE.WAIT:
      u = "wait_" + (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur + 10);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur++;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur > e[t].wait_frame_num && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur = 1);
      break;
    case MODE.MOVE:
      u = "move_" + (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur + 10);
      S_GAME.is_move_blocked("your", n) || (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur++, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur > e[t].move_frame_num && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur = 1));
      S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() || CHAR_YOUR_TEAM[t].unit_type !== UNIT_TYPE.GIANT || YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur == 12 && (S_GAME.isCanYouattack_87_90(n), console.log(" 이동 공격  screen_index: " + t));
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:

        for (c = 0, f = 1; f <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; f++) OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[f].alive == 1 && (S_GAME.is_koo_char(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[f].unit_num) || (v = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[f].unit_num, o = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x - (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[f].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[f].w) - CHAR_OUR_TEAM[v].beattack_margine, o <= YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[f].x, c = 1)));
        y = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x - CASTLE_OUR.baseX;
        y <= YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len && c == 0 && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = CASTLE_OUR.baseX)
      }
      if (S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur == YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_fire_frame) switch (t) {
        case 27:
        case 28:
          var tt = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + 10,

            rt = tt - 73,

      }
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED:
      if (u = "beattack_" + (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur + 10), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur++, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur > e[t].beattack_frame_num && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1), !S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() && CHAR_YOUR_TEAM[t].unit_type !== UNIT_TYPE.TOWER && !S_GAME.is_move_blocked("your", n)) switch (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur) {

CHECK_AREA = new Array(MAX_OUR_TEAM_UNIT + 1);
CHECK_AREA_count = 0;
S_GAME.init_check_area = function() {
  CHECK_AREA_count = 0;
  for (var n = 1; n <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_UNIT; n++) CHECK_AREA[n] = {}, CHECK_AREA[n].x1 = CHECK_AREA[n].x2 = 0
};
S_GAME.add_check_area = function(n, t) {
  if (CHECK_AREA_count + 1 > MAX_OUR_TEAM_UNIT) {
    utilConsoleLog("Error in S_GAME.add_check_area():" + CHECK_AREA_count + 1 + "--이게 full찰리가 없는데..");
    return
  }
  CHECK_AREA[CHECK_AREA_count + 1].x1 = n;
  CHECK_AREA[CHECK_AREA_count + 1].x2 = t;
  CHECK_AREA_count++
};
S_GAME.del_check_area = function() {
  if (CHECK_AREA_count <= 0) {
    utilConsoleLog("S_GAME.del_check_area() : 여기서 0 이 될리가 없는데..." + CHECK_AREA_count);
    return
  }
  for (var n = 1; n <= CHECK_AREA_count - 1; n++) CHECK_AREA[n].x1 = CHECK_AREA[n + 1].x1, CHECK_AREA[n].x2 = CHECK_AREA[n + 1].x2;
  CHECK_AREA[CHECK_AREA_count].x1 = CHECK_AREA[CHECK_AREA_count].x2 = 0;
  CHECK_AREA_count--;
  return
};
S_GAME.del_check_area_our_char = function(n) {
  if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 40) {
    var t = S_GAME.$el.our_unit[n].fire_pung_img.css("display");
    t == "block" && S_GAME.del_check_area()
  }
};
S_GAME.is_check_area = function(n) {
  if (check_ability_stage()) {
    for (var t = 1; t <= CHECK_AREA_count; t++)
      if (CHECK_AREA[t].x1 <= n && n <= CHECK_AREA[t].x2) return !0;
    return !1
  }
  return !1
};

      case 60:

        S_GAME.bottom_ui.draw_char_bensi_buff(n, "show");
        break;
      case 61:
        OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].move_speed = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].unit_num].move_speed * 3;
        S_GAME.bottom_ui.draw_char_bensi_buff(n, "show");
        break;
      case 62:
        OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].move_speed = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].unit_num].move_speed * 4;
        S_GAME.bottom_ui.draw_char_bensi_buff(n, "show");
        break;
      case 92:
        OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].move_speed = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].unit_num].move_speed * 5;
        S_GAME.bottom_ui.draw_char_bensi_buff(n, "show");
        break;
      default:
        OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].move_speed = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].unit_num].move_speed;
        S_GAME.bottom_ui.draw_char_bensi_buff(n, "hide")
    } else
      for (n = 1; n <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; n++) OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].move_speed = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].unit_num].move_speed, S_GAME.bottom_ui.draw_char_bensi_buff(n, "hide")

          break;
        case 60:
          t < 60 && (t = 60)
      }
  }
  return t
