        r = 260;
        break;
      case 18:
        r = 350;
        break;
      case 19:
        r = 210;
        break;
      case 20:
        r = 110;
        break;
      case 21:
        r = 70;
        break;
      case 22:
        r = 50;
        break;
      case 23:
        r = 0
    }
  return r
};
S_GAME.animate_cheering_effect = function(n, t, i) {
  var r, u, f;
  i == "our" ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].cheering_time > 0 && (r = LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[t].SHIELD, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 85 || OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 88 ? context.drawImage(r, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w / 3, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y + 150, 214, 338) : OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 95 ? context.drawImage(r, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w / 5, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y + 50, 214, 338) : CHAR_OUR_TEAM[OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num].center_y > 0 ? (u = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + CHAR_OUR_TEAM[OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num].center_x - 80, f = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y + CHAR_OUR_TEAM[OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num].center_y - 1014 / 5, context.drawImage(r, u, f, 214, 338)) : context.drawImage(r, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w / 3, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y, 214, 338)) : i == "your" && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].cheering_time > 0 && S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() && (r = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].SHIELD, context.save(), context.scale(-1, 1), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 85 || YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 88 ? (context.translate(-YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x - YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w / 2, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].h / 4), context.drawImage(r, 0, 0, 214, 338, 214 / -3, 0, 214, 338)) : YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 95 ? (context.translate(-YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x - YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w / 4, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].h / 2 + 40), context.drawImage(r, 0, 0, 214, 338, 214 / -3, -169, 214, 338)) : CHAR_OUR_TEAM[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num].center_y > 0 ? (u = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + CHAR_OUR_TEAM[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num].center_x, f = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y + CHAR_OUR_TEAM[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num].center_y, context.translate(-u, f), context.drawImage(r, 0, 0, 214, 338, 214 / -3, -169, 214, 338)) : (context.translate(-YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x - YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w / 2, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].h / 2), context.drawImage(r, 0, 0, 214, 338, 214 / -3, -169, 214, 338)), context.restore())
};
S_GAME.get_socket_index_of_loing_char = function(n, t) {
  var u = 1,
    r = LOIMG_CHAR_OUR,
    i;
  for (t == "your" && (r = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR), i = 1; i < r.length; i++)
    if (r[i].unit_num == n) {
      u = i;
      break
    } return u
};
SCROLL = {
  old_x: 0,
  target_x: 0,
  cur_x: 0,
  flag: 0,
  timer: null,
  part_tot_num: 0,
  part_cur_num: 0,
  part_x: Array(10),
  part12_start: 0,
  part12_end: 0,
  part23_start: 0,
  part23_end: 0
};
S_GAME.scroll_define = function() {
  var t, n;
  t = S_GAME.is_sky_garden_mode() ? RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.len_from_our_to_your : S_GAME.ranking_mode == 4 ? BOSS_STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_BOSS.stage] : g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_DAYDUNGEON ? DAYDUNGEON_STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day][S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus] : STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_GAME.stage];
  SCROLL.part_tot_num = t - 1280 <= 0 ? 1 : Math.floor((t - 1281) / 640) + 2;
  SCROLL.part_cur_num = 1;
  switch (SCROLL.part_tot_num) {
    case 1:
      return;
    case 2:
      SCROLL.part_x[1] = 0;
      SCROLL.part_x[2] = t - 1280;
      n = (1280 - SCROLL.part_x[2]) / 3;
      SCROLL.part12_start = SCROLL.part_x[2] + n;
      SCROLL.part12_end = SCROLL.part_x[2] + n * 2;
      break;
    case 3:
      SCROLL.part_x[1] = 0;
      SCROLL.part_x[3] = t - 1280;
      SCROLL.part_x[2] = (SCROLL.part_x[1] + SCROLL.part_x[3]) / 2;
      n = (1280 - SCROLL.part_x[2]) / 3;
      SCROLL.part12_start = SCROLL.part_x[2] + n;
      SCROLL.part12_end = SCROLL.part_x[2] + n * 2;
      n = (SCROLL.part_x[2] + 1280 - SCROLL.part_x[3]) / 3;
      SCROLL.part23_start = SCROLL.part_x[3] + n;
      SCROLL.part23_end = SCROLL.part_x[3] + n * 2;
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error!! len_from_our_to_your value is over 1280*2")
  }
};
S_GAME.where_scroll = function() {
  var t = 0,
    i = 1e4,
    r, n;
  if (S_GAME.ranking_mode == 4) {
    if (S_BOSS.view_mode != 1) return 0
  } else if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_DAYDUNGEON) {
    if (S_DAYDUNGEON.view_mode != 1) return 0
  } else if (S_GAME.view_mode != 1) return 0;
  if (SCROLL.part_tot_num == 1) return 0;
  for (n = 1; n <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; n++) OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && t < OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x && (t = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x);
  if (t != 0) switch (SCROLL.part_cur_num) {
    case 0:
      utilConsoleLog("Error!! in S_GAME.is_scroll()");
      break;
    case 1:
      if (t >= SCROLL.part12_start) return 2;
      break;
    case 2:
      if (SCROLL.part_tot_num > 2 && t >= SCROLL.part23_start) return 3;
      if (t <= SCROLL.part_x[2]) return 1;
      break;
    case 3:
      if (t < SCROLL.part23_start) return 2;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_GAME.is_scroll:" + SCROLL.part_cur_num)
  } else if (t == 0) {
    for (r = S_GAME.ranking_mode == 4 ? MAX_BOSS_NUM_ON_SCREEN : MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN, n = 1; n <= r; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && i > YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x && (i = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x);
    if (i != 1e4) switch (SCROLL.part_cur_num) {
      case 0:
        utilConsoleLog("Error!! in S_GAME.is_scroll()-init");
        break;
      case 1:
        break;
      case 2:
        if (i <= SCROLL.part12_end) return 1;
        break;
      case 3:
        if (i <= SCROLL.part23_end) return 2;
        break;
      default:
        utilConsoleLog("Error in S_GAME.is_scroll----")
    } else utilConsoleLog("~~~~~~~~~~Woops~~~~~~ SAME~~~SAME~~~무승부~~~~~")
  } return 0
};
S_GAME.scroll_part = function(n) {
  if (SCROLL.flag == 1 && (clearInterval(SCROLL.timer), SCROLL.timer = null), SCROLL.flag = 1, SCROLL.part_cur_num == n) {
    utilConsoleLog("Error in S_GAME.scroll_part(); ");
    return
  }
  SCROLL.part_cur_num = n;
  var t = $("#s_game_center").css("left");
  S_GAME.ranking_mode == 4 && (t = $("#S_BOSS_center").css("left"));
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_DAYDUNGEON && (t = $("#S_daydungeon_center").css("left"));
  SCROLL.cur_x = SCROLL.old_x = Math.floor(parseInt(t, 10)) * -1;
  SCROLL.target_x = SCROLL.part_x[n];
  S_GAME.scroll_part_interval()
};
S_GAME.scroll_part_interval = function() {
  var t = .2,
    n;
  SCROLL.old_x < SCROLL.target_x ? (SCROLL.cur_x = SCROLL.cur_x + t * (SCROLL.target_x - SCROLL.cur_x), SCROLL.cur_x >= SCROLL.target_x - 1 && (SCROLL.flag = 0, SCROLL.cur_x = SCROLL.target_x)) : (SCROLL.cur_x = SCROLL.cur_x - t * (SCROLL.cur_x - SCROLL.target_x), SCROLL.cur_x <= SCROLL.target_x + 1 && (SCROLL.flag = 0, SCROLL.cur_x = SCROLL.target_x));
  n = "";
  n = S_GAME.ranking_mode == 4 ? "S_BOSS_center" : "s_game_center";
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_DAYDUNGEON && (n = "S_daydungeon_center");
  $("#" + n).css({
    left: "-" + SCROLL.cur_x + "px",
    position: "absolute"
  });
  SCROLL.flag != 0 && (SCROLL.timer = setTimeout(S_GAME.scroll_part_interval, TIMER_SCROLL))
};
S_GAME.stop_autoplay = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog("~~~~~ 자동 플레이 중에 키 입력이 들어왔습니다 ~~~~~");
  n === gS_GAME ? ($("#GA_autoplay_div").css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_GAME.autoplay_count = 1, clearInterval(S_GAME.autoplay_timer), S_GAME.autoplay_timer = null) : n === gS_STAGECLEAR ? ($("#SC_autoplay_div").css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_STAGECLEAR.autoplay_start_count = 5, clearInterval(S_STAGECLEAR.autoplay_timer), S_STAGECLEAR.autoplay_timer = null) : n === gS_STAGEFAIL && ($("#SF_autoplay_div").css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_STAGEFAIL.autoplay_start_count = 5, clearInterval(S_STAGEFAIL.autoplay_timer), S_STAGEFAIL.autoplay_timer = null);
  utilNotice(TXT.autoplayend, 2);
  AUTOPLAY.stop_flag = 0;
  n === gS_GAME && S_GAME.drawFocus();
  AUTOPLAY.acc_end_time = window.g.timestamp_due;
  ServerConnection.insert_autoplay_acc("");
  update_user_to_server_acc("자동 플레이 종료")
};
S_GAME.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  if (is_autoplay_stop()) {
    if ((gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && i != KeyDefine.enter) return;
    S_GAME.stop_autoplay(gS_GAME);
    return
  }
  if (S_GAME.board.flag == 1) switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_GAME.board.focus >= 2 && (S_GAME.board.focus--, S_GAME.drawFocus_board());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_GAME.board.focus == S_GAME.board.num && REWARD_AD.is_shown("GA_ad_btn") ? (S_GAME.board.focus = 5, S_GAME.drawFocus_board()) : S_GAME.board.focus < S_GAME.board.num - 1 && (S_GAME.board.focus++, S_GAME.drawFocus_board());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_GAME.board.focus == 5 ? (S_GAME.board.focus = 2, S_GAME.drawFocus_board()) : S_GAME.board.focus == S_GAME.board.num && (S_GAME.board.focus = 2, S_GAME.drawFocus_board());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_GAME.board.focus < S_GAME.board.num && (S_GAME.board.focus = 4, S_GAME.drawFocus_board());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_GAME.stage_start_time = window.g.timestamp_due;
      S_GAME.focusRun_board()
  } else switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_GAME.run_zoom();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_GAME.top_ui.is_meteor_available() && S_GAME.run_metor();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.back:
    case KeyDefine.esc:
      S_GAME.run_back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_GAME.focus == S_GAME.bottom_ui.get_max_btn() ? (S_GAME.focus--, S_GAME.drawFocus()) : S_GAME.focus >= 2 && (S_GAME.focus--, S_GAME.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_GAME.focusRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_GAME.focus < USER.socket_available_num + 2 ? (S_GAME.focus++, S_GAME.drawFocus()) : S_GAME.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      3 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_GAME.focus = 3, S_GAME.drawFocus(), S_GAME.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      4 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_GAME.focus = 4, S_GAME.drawFocus(), S_GAME.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
      5 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_GAME.focus = 5, S_GAME.drawFocus(), S_GAME.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM4:
      6 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_GAME.focus = 6, S_GAME.drawFocus(), S_GAME.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM5:
      7 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_GAME.focus = 7, S_GAME.drawFocus(), S_GAME.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.RED:
    case KeyDefine.A:
      S_GAME.focus = 1;
      S_GAME.drawFocus();
      S_GAME.focusRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.BLUE:
      (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB) && (S_GAME.focus = 2, S_GAME.drawFocus(), S_GAME.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.GREEN:
    case KeyDefine.S:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.KT && (S_GAME.focus = 2, S_GAME.drawFocus(), S_GAME.focusRun())
  }
};
S_GAME.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_GAME.backKey()
};
S_GAME.backKey = function() {
  S_GAME.end();
  utilPush();
  S_POPUPYN.focus = 2;
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
    display: "block"
  }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN)
};
S_GAME.run_metor = function(n) {
  S_GAME.metor_num > 0 || n == !0 ? (gEnableKey = 0, sound_play(EFF_SOUND.METOR), S_GAME.effect_meteor(n), n || S_GAME.metor_num--, S_GAME.top_ui.update_metor_num(S_GAME.metor_num)) : utilNotice(TXT.metor_only_one, 1.5)
};
S_GAME.run_zoom = function() {
  if (S_GAME.is_sky_garden_mode()) {
    if (RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.len_from_our_to_your <= 1280) return
  } else if (STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_GAME.stage] <= 1280) return;
  if (S_GAME.zoom_flag == 0) {
    if (utilNotice(TXT.zoomout, 1.2), SCROLL.flag == 1) return;
    if (S_GAME.view_mode != 1) return;
    S_GAME.modeChange_m();
    S_GAME.top_ui.show_zoom_out();
    setTimeout(function() {
      S_GAME.zoom_flag = 1
    }, 1e3)
  } else utilNotice(TXT.zoomin, 1.2), S_GAME.top_ui.show_zoom_in(), S_GAME.view_mode = 1, $("#s_game_center").css({
    left: "0px",
    top: "0px",
    width: "1280px",
    height: "720px",
    position: "absolute"
  }), utilConsoleLog("View mode 작동=====> " + S_GAME.view_mode), utilScale_xy("s_game_center", S_GAME.view_mode, S_GAME.view_mode), SCROLL.part_cur_num = 1, setTimeout(function() {
    S_GAME.zoom_flag = 0
  }, 1e3)
};
S_GAME.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_GAME.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_GAME.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_GAME.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    if (is_autoplay_stop()) {
      S_GAME.stop_autoplay(gS_GAME);
      return
    }
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } S_GAME.board.flag == 0 ? t.id.search("metor") >= 0 ? S_GAME.top_ui.is_meteor_available() && S_GAME.run_metor() : t.id.search("zoom") >= 0 ? S_GAME.run_zoom() : t.id.search("back") >= 0 ? S_GAME.run_back() : S_GAME.focusRun() : S_GAME.focusRun_board()
  }
};
S_GAME.onMouseover = function(n) {
  var t, i;
  for (utilConsoleLog(" --onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
    if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
      t = null;
      return
    } S_GAME.board.flag == 0 ? t.id.search(S_GAME.bottom_ui.get_missile_id()) >= 0 ? (S_GAME.focus = 1, S_GAME.drawFocus()) : t.id.search(S_GAME.bottom_ui.get_mineral_id()) >= 0 ? (S_GAME.focus = 2, S_GAME.drawFocus()) : t.id.search(S_GAME.bottom_ui.get_char_id()) >= 0 && (i = glo.fun.get_only_number_by_text(t.id), USER.socket_available_num >= i && (S_GAME.focus = i + 2), S_GAME.drawFocus()) : (REWARD_AD.hit(t.id, "GA_ad_btn") ? S_GAME.board.focus = 5 : t.id.search("btn1") >= 0 ? S_GAME.board.focus = 1 : t.id.search("btn2") >= 0 ? S_GAME.board.focus = 2 : t.id.search("btn3") >= 0 ? S_GAME.board.focus = 3 : t.id.search("btn4") >= 0 && (S_GAME.board.focus = 4), S_GAME.drawFocus_board())
};
S_GAME.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GAME.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_GAME.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_GAME.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GAME.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_GAME.onMouseover(n);
  S_GAME.onClick(n);
  return
};

USER.get_missile_power = function() {
  var t = 100,
    i = t + (500 - t) / 100 * STORAGE.data1.upgrade[4],
    n;
  return STORAGE.data1.upgrade[4] == 1 && (i = t), n = 0, S_MEDALPOWER.value[4] > 0 && (n = n + S_MEDALPOWER.value[4] * .5), S_MEDALPOWER.value[15] > 0 && (n = n + S_MEDALPOWER.value[15]), S_MEDALPOWER.value[24] > 0 && (n = n + S_MEDALPOWER.value[24]), S_MEDALPOWER.value[33] > 0 && (n = n + S_MEDALPOWER.value[33]), S_MEDALPOWER.value[43] > 0 && (n = n + S_MEDALPOWER.value[43] / 2), i * (1 + n)
};

USER.get_missile_power_stage = function() {
  var n = 5e3 + 150 * (S_GAME.stage - 140);
  return S_GAME.stage <= 180 ? S_GAME.ranking_mode == 5 ? n * HARD_MODE_UP_NUM : n : S_GAME.ranking_mode == 5 ? n * 2 * HARD_MODE_UP_NUM : S_GAME.stage == 245 || S_GAME.stage == 250 || S_GAME.stage == 255 || S_GAME.stage == 260 ? n * 6 : n * 2
};
USER.get_missile_power_daydungeon = function() {
  var t, n = 0,
    i, r;
  switch (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day) {
    case 1:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 1 ? n = 10 : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 2 ? n = 30 : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 3 && (n = 100);
      break;
    case 2:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 1 ? n = 30 : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 2 ? n = 100 : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 3 && (n = 220);
      break;
    case 3:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 1 ? n = 30 : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 2 ? n = 100 : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 3 && (n = 200);
      break;
    case 4:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 1 ? n = 30 : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 2 ? n = 70 : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 3 && (n = 150);
      break;
    case 5:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 1 ? n = 30 : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 2 ? n = 100 : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 3 && (n = 220);
      break;
    case 6:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 1 ? n = 30 : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 2 ? n = 100 : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 3 && (n = 180);
      break;
    case 7:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 1 ? n = 30 : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 2 ? n = 100 : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 3 && (n = 180)
  }
  return i = 5e3, r = 150, t = i + r * (n - 10), n <= 30 ? t = 100 : n >= 11 && n <= 30 ? t = 300 : n >= 31 && n <= 100 && (t = 15e3), utilConsoleLog("~~ 요일던전 적군 미사일 데미지 ~~ : " + t), t
};
USER.get_our_castle_max_hp = function() {
  var i = STORAGE.data1.upgrade[5],
    t = i * i * 15 + 60,
    n = 0;
  return S_MEDALPOWER.value[5] > 0 && (n = n + S_MEDALPOWER.value[5] * .5), S_MEDALPOWER.value[16] > 0 && (n = n + S_MEDALPOWER.value[16]), S_MEDALPOWER.value[25] > 0 && (n = n + S_MEDALPOWER.value[25]), S_MEDALPOWER.value[34] > 0 && (n = n + S_MEDALPOWER.value[34]), S_MEDALPOWER.value[41] > 0 && (n = n + S_MEDALPOWER.value[41] / 2), S_MEDALPOWER.value[49] > 0 && (n = n + S_MEDALPOWER.value[49] / 5), S_MEDALPOWER.value[50] > 0 && (n = n + S_MEDALPOWER.value[50] / 5), S_MEDALPOWER.value[51] > 0 && (n = n + S_MEDALPOWER.value[51] / 5), S_MEDALPOWER.value[52] > 0 && (n = n + S_MEDALPOWER.value[52] / 5), t = t * (1 + n), glo.APP_FEATURE.TOWER_AWAKENING && USER.tower_awakening > 0 && (t = 5e6), Math.floor(t)
};

USER.get_missile_full_tick = function() {
  var i = 500,

};

    case "A":
    case "B":
    case "C":
    case "D":
      n++
  }
  return utilConsoleLog("~~ 현재 사용자가 월드 보스에 진입할수 있는지 여부를 확인하는 함수 ~~ clear_stage : " + n), n >= 50 ? !0 : !1
};

S_GAME.get_missile_level = function() {
  if (S_UPGRADE.is_upgraded_max(5)) return 7;
  if (STORAGE.get_maxstage() >= 201) return 6;
  var n = STORAGE.data1.upgrade[4];
  return n < 10 ? 1 : n < 30 ? 2 : n < 50 ? 3 : n < 70 ? 4 : 5
};

};
your_raser_beattacked = [];
S_GAME.fireRaser = function() {
  var t, r, u, i, f, n, e, o;
  if (RASER.flag == 1) {
    utilConsoleLog("Can not fire because firing....");
    return
  }
  for (sound_play(EFF_SOUND.RASER_FIRE), S_GAME.is_sky_garden_mode() ? (RASER.baseX = CASTLE_OUR.x + RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.nose_x, RASER.baseY = CASTLE_OUR.y + RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.nose_y, RASER.target_start_x = RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.castle_our_w, RASER.target_end_x = Math.min(USER.missile_len, RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.len_from_our_to_your), RASER.old_x = CASTLE_OUR.x) : (RASER.baseX = CASTLE_OUR.x + STAGE_DESIGN[S_GAME.stage].nose_x, RASER.baseY = CASTLE_OUR.y + STAGE_DESIGN[S_GAME.stage].nose_y, RASER.target_start_x = STAGE_DESIGN[S_GAME.stage].castle_our_w, RASER.target_end_x = Math.min(USER.missile_len, STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_GAME.stage]), RASER.old_x = CASTLE_OUR.x), RASER.w = $("#Img_GA_missile").width(), RASER.h = $("#Img_GA_missile").height(), t = CASTLE_YOUR.baseX, n = 1; n <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++)
    if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1)
      if (r = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num, S_GAME.is_pvp_mode())
        if (S_GAME.is_koo_char(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num)) continue;
        else t = Math.min(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x - CHAR_OUR_TEAM[r].beattack_margine, t);
  else t = CHAR_YOUR_TEAM[r].unit_type === UNIT_TYPE.GIANT ? Math.min(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + 300, t) : r >= 97 && r <= 106 ? Math.min(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + CHAR_YOUR_TEAM[r].center_x, t) : Math.min(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x - 10, t);
  for (u = 0, n = 1; n <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) S_GAME.is_missile_absorb(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num) && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && (u = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x - 10, n = MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN);
  for (u != 0 && (t = u), i = t - CASTLE_OUR.baseX, i <= 60 ? (i = 60, RASER.HEIGHT = Math.floor(15 * 1.5)) : RASER.HEIGHT = Math.floor(i / 10 * 1.5), console.log("len=" + i + ", RASER.HEIGHT=" + RASER.HEIGHT), f = 25, i >= 1200 && (f = 31), n = 0; n <= RASER_DELTA_X + 2; n++) RASER.x[n] = Math.round(RASER.baseX - RASER.w / 2 + i / (RASER_DELTA_X + 2) * n), RASER.y[n] = RASER.baseY - Math.round(-1 * RASER.HEIGHT / f * (n - 5) * (n - 5) + RASER.HEIGHT) - RASER.h;
  for (n = 0; n <= RASER_DELTA_X + 1; n++) e = RASER.x[n + 1] - RASER.x[n], o = RASER.y[n] - RASER.y[n + 1], RASER.deg[n] = 90 - Math.round(Math.atan2(o, e) * 360 / 6.283185);
  RASER.deg[RASER_DELTA_X + 2] = RASER.deg[RASER_DELTA_X + 1];
  RASER.flag = 1
};
S_GAME.fireRaser_interval = function() {
  var p, w, n, r, e, nt;
  if (RASER.flag != 0) {
    if (RASER.dx++, $("#Img_GA_missile").css({
        display: "block",
        left: RASER.x[RASER.dx] + "px",
        top: RASER.y[RASER.dx] + "px",
        "-webkit-transform-origin": "50% 100%",
        "-webkit-transform": "rotate(" + RASER.deg[RASER.dx] + "deg)",
        position: "absolute"
      }), RASER.pole_x = RASER.x[RASER.dx] + RASER.w / 2 + RASER.h * Math.sin(RASER.deg[RASER.dx] * Math.PI / 180), RASER.pole_y = RASER.y[RASER.dx] + RASER.h - RASER.h * Math.cos(RASER.deg[RASER.dx] * Math.PI / 180), S_GAME.is_pvp_mode())
      for (n = 1; n <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++)
        if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && S_GAME.is_koo_char(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num)) {
          var o = RASER.pole_x,
            s = RASER.pole_x + RASER.w,
            t = 0;
          switch (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num) {
            case 76:
              t = 62;
              break;
            case 77:
              t = 40;
              break;
            case 78:
              t = 100;
              break;
            case 79:
              t = 254;
              break;
            case 80:
              t = 213;
              break;
            case 81:
              t = 166;
              break;
            case 94:
              t = 200
          }
          var h = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + t,
            c = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w,
            l = RASER.pole_y - RASER.h,
            a = RASER.pole_y + RASER.h,
            v = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y,
            y = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].h;
          if ((o <= h && h <= s || o <= c && c <= s) && (l <= v && v <= a || l <= y && y <= a) && (p = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e3) + 1, w = 1e3 - DEFINE.RASER_DESTROY_PERCENT["COW" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num], p <= w)) {
            RASER.dx = -1;
            RASER.flag = 0;
            QUEST.f6_missile();
            S_GAME.fireRaser_you_cow(n, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y);
            return
          }
        } if (RASER.dx >= RASER_DELTA_X + 2 || RASER.pole_y >= GAME_BASE_Y - 30) {
      RASER.dx = -1;
      RASER.flag = 0;
      QUEST.f6_missile();
      var b = 0,
        k = RASER.x[RASER_DELTA_X + 2],
        tt = k - RASER.damage_range,
        it = k + RASER.damage_range,
        d = 0,
        i = 0,
        g = 0;
      for (n = 1; n <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++)
        if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1)
          if (r = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num, e = S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() ? YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + CHAR_OUR_TEAM[r].beattack_margine : YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + CHAR_YOUR_TEAM[r].beattack_margine, S_GAME.ranking_mode == 0 || S_GAME.is_sky_garden_mode() || S_GAME.ranking_mode == 5) {
            if (S_GAME.is_missile_absorb(r) && (d = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y), tt <= e && e <= it && S_GAME.is_missile_absorb(r)) {
              b = 1;
              break
            }
          } else if (S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 49 || YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 93 || YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 109)) {
        i = n;
        g = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y;
        break
      }
      if (b == 1) $("#Img_GA_missile").css({
        display: "none"
      }), S_GAME.fireRaser_attack_nazegul(d);
      else if (i >= 1) {
        var rt = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].socket_index,
          u = USER_NPC.char[rt].cur_level,
          f = 0;
        f = u <= 80 ? DEFINE.RUSY.C49_PROP.LEVEL80 : u <= 85 ? DEFINE.RUSY.C49_PROP.LEVEL85 : u <= 90 ? DEFINE.RUSY.C49_PROP.LEVEL90 : u <= 95 ? DEFINE.RUSY.C49_PROP.LEVEL95 : DEFINE.RUSY.C49_PROP.LEVEL100;
        YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].unit_num == 93 && (f = DEFINE.RUSY.C49_PROP.LEVEL100);
        YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].unit_num == 109 && (f = DEFINE.RUSY.C49_PROP.LEVEL100);
        nt = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100) + 1;
        nt <= f ? ($("#Img_GA_missile").css({
          display: "none"
        }), S_GAME.fireRaser_attack_nazegul(g + 150)) : ($("#Img_GA_missile").css({
          display: "none"
        }), S_GAME.fireRaser_attack())
      } else $("#Img_GA_missile").css({
        display: "none"
      }), S_GAME.fireRaser_attack();
      return
    }
  }
};
S_GAME.fireRaser_attack = function() {
  var e = RASER.x[RASER_DELTA_X],
    i = e - RASER.damage_range,
    r = e + RASER.damage_range,
    t = 1,
    o, u, n, f;
  o = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT ? 4 : gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN ? 10 : 7;
  u = RASER.pole_x;
  n = RASER.pole_y;
  $("#Img_GA_raser_pung_effect").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  f = function() {
    var l, a, v, e, s, h, y, c;
    if (t <= o ? (l = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url_only_glo() + "image/ui/98_effect/missileEffect_" + t + ".png", a = u - 206, console.log(" PVP 모드 backup_pole_x :" + u + "  RASER.pole_x:" + RASER.pole_x + " backup_pole_y :" + n), v = S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() && n >= 450 ? n - 200 : n - 161, utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_GA_raser_pung_effect", l, a, v), setTimeout(f, TIMER_INTERVAL), t++) : setTimeout(function() {
        utilDraw_image_1pixel("Img_GA_raser_pung_effect");
        $("#Img_GA_raser_pung_effect").css({
          display: "none"
        })
      }, 50), t == 5) {
      for (e = 1; e <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; e++)
        if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].alive == 1 && (s = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].unit_num, h = S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() ? YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].x - CHAR_OUR_TEAM[s].beattack_margine : s >= 97 && s <= 106 ? YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].x + CHAR_YOUR_TEAM[s].center_x : YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].x - CHAR_YOUR_TEAM[s].beattack_margine, S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() || CHAR_YOUR_TEAM[s].unit_type !== UNIT_TYPE.GIANT || (h += 300), console.log("  아군미사일 발사 left_x: " + i + " right_x:" + r + " enemy_x:" + h), i <= h && h <= r)) {
          if (console.log("  아군미사일 발사 폭탄 맞음"), S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() && S_GAME.is_koo_char(s)) continue;
          (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].cheering_time == 0 || YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].shield_102_time == 0) && (S_GAME.has_special_ability("your", s, SPECIAL_ABILITY.ARMOR) ? YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].hp = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].hp - 1 : S_GAME.has_innate_ability("your", s, INNATE_ABILITY.ARMOR) ? YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].hp = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].hp - 1 : (y = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].hp, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].hp = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].hp - S_GAME.get_max_damage_on_enemy(e, USER.missile_power, !0), console.log("  아군미사일 적군 번호: " + s + " 남은 hp:" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].hp + " 아군미사일공격력:" + USER.missile_power)));
          S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() || CHAR_YOUR_TEAM[s].unit_type !== UNIT_TYPE.STONE ? S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() || CHAR_YOUR_TEAM[s].unit_type !== UNIT_TYPE.TOWER && CHAR_YOUR_TEAM[s].unit_type !== UNIT_TYPE.GIANT ? YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED : console.log(" 아군 미사일 -  거인, 타워 종류는 MODE.BE_ATTACKED 안함") : (c = 0, STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_GAME.stage] == 800 ? c = 600 : STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_GAME.stage] == 1200 ? c = 800 : STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_GAME.stage] == 1800 && (c = 1350));
          YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[e].hp <= 0 && S_GAME.die_by_our_attack(e)
        } S_GAME.gullveig_unit.is_stage() || RASER.damage_enemy_tower(i, r)
    }
  };
  f()
};

S_GAME.fireRaser_attack_nazegul = function(n) {
  var r = RASER.x[RASER_DELTA_X],
    e = r - RASER.damage_range,
    o = r + RASER.damage_range,
    t = 1,
    u = 10,
    f = RASER.pole_x,
    s = RASER.pole_y,
    i;
  $("#Img_GA_raser_pung_effect").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  i = function() {
    if (t <= u) {
      var r = glo.ser_img_url + "image/ui/98_effect/spark_" + t + ".png",
        e = f - 107 / 2 - 80,
        o = n;
      utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_GA_raser_pung_effect", r, e, o);
      setTimeout(i, TIMER_INTERVAL);
      t++
    } else setTimeout(function() {
      utilNotice(TXT.missile_absorbed, 2);
      utilDraw_image_1pixel("Img_GA_raser_pung_effect");
      $("#Img_GA_raser_pung_effect").css({
        display: "none"
      })
    }, 50)
  };
  i()
};

S_GAME.fireRaser_pvp = function() {
  var i, r, t, n, u, f;
  for (sound_play(EFF_SOUND.RASER_FIRE), RASER_PVP.baseX = CASTLE_YOUR.x + CASTLE_YOUR.w / 5, RASER_PVP.baseY = CASTLE_YOUR.y + 105, RASER_PVP.w = $("#Img_GA_missile_pvp").width(), RASER_PVP.h = $("#Img_GA_missile_pvp").height(), i = CASTLE_OUR.baseX + CASTLE_YOUR.w / 2, n = 1; n <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; n++)
    if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1)
      if (r = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num, S_GAME.is_koo_char(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num)) continue;
      else OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 49 || OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 93 || OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 109 ? (i = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w / 2, n = MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX) : i = Math.max(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w + CHAR_OUR_TEAM[r].beattack_margine, i);
  for (t = CASTLE_YOUR.baseX + CASTLE_YOUR.w / 2 - i, S_GAME.get_missile_level_pvp() >= 6 && (t = t + 60), t <= 60 ? (t = 60, RASER_PVP.HEIGHT = Math.floor(15 * 1.5)) : RASER_PVP.HEIGHT = Math.floor(t / 10 * 1.5), n = 0; n <= RASER_PVP_DELTA_X + 2; n++) RASER_PVP.x[n] = Math.round(RASER_PVP.baseX + RASER_PVP.w / 2 - t / (RASER_PVP_DELTA_X + 2) * n), RASER_PVP.y[n] = RASER_PVP.baseY - Math.round(RASER_PVP.HEIGHT / -25 * (n - 5) * (n - 5) + RASER_PVP.HEIGHT) - RASER_PVP.h;
  for (n = 0; n <= RASER_PVP_DELTA_X + 1; n++) u = RASER_PVP.x[n + 1] - RASER_PVP.x[n], f = RASER_PVP.y[n] - RASER_PVP.y[n + 1], RASER_PVP.deg[n] = 90 - Math.round(Math.atan2(f, u) * 360 / 6.283185);
  RASER_PVP.deg[RASER_PVP_DELTA_X + 2] = RASER_PVP.deg[RASER_PVP_DELTA_X + 1];
  RASER_PVP.flag = 1
};
S_GAME.fireRaser_interval_pvp = function() {
  var o, s, v, y, n, w;
  if (RASER_PVP.flag != 0) {
    for (RASER_PVP.dx++, $("#Img_GA_missile_pvp").css({
        display: "block",
        left: RASER_PVP.x[RASER_PVP.dx] + "px",
        top: RASER_PVP.y[RASER_PVP.dx] + "px",
        "-webkit-transform-origin": "50% 100%",
        "-webkit-transform": "rotate(" + RASER_PVP.deg[RASER_PVP.dx] + "deg)",
        position: "absolute"
      }), RASER_PVP.pole_x = RASER_PVP.x[RASER_PVP.dx] - RASER_PVP.w / 2 - RASER_PVP.h * Math.sin(RASER_PVP.deg[RASER_PVP.dx] * Math.PI / 180), RASER_PVP.pole_y = RASER_PVP.y[RASER_PVP.dx] + RASER_PVP.h - RASER_PVP.h * Math.cos(RASER_PVP.deg[RASER_PVP.dx] * Math.PI / 180), n = 1; n <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; n++)
      if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && S_GAME.is_koo_char(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num)) {
        var h = RASER_PVP.pole_x,
          c = RASER_PVP.pole_x + RASER_PVP.w,
          t = 0;
        switch (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num) {
          case 76:
            t = 62;
            break;
          case 77:
            t = 40;
            break;
          case 78:
            t = 100;
            break;
          case 79:
            t = 254;
            break;
          case 80:
            t = 213;
            break;
          case 81:
            t = 166;
            break;
          case 94:
            t = 166
        }
        var l = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x - t,
          a = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w + t / 3,
          f = RASER_PVP.pole_y - RASER_PVP.h,
          e = RASER_PVP.pole_x + RASER_PVP.h;
        if (console.log(" PVP raser_top_y : " + f + "   raser_bottom_y :" + e), o = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y, s = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].h, (h <= l && l <= c || h <= a && a <= c) && (f <= o && o <= e || f <= s && s <= e) && (v = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e3) + 1, y = 1e3 - DEFINE.RASER_DESTROY_PERCENT["COW" + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num], v <= y)) {
          RASER_PVP.dx = -1;
          RASER_PVP.flag = 0;
          S_GAME.fireRaser_i_cow(n, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y);
          return
        }
      } if (RASER_PVP.dx >= RASER_PVP_DELTA_X + 2 || RASER_PVP.pole_y >= GAME_BASE_Y - 30) {
      RASER_PVP.dx = -1;
      RASER_PVP.flag = 0;
      $("#Img_GA_missile_pvp").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      var i = 0,
        p = 0;
      for (n = 1; n <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; n++) OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 49 || OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 93 || OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 109) && (i = n, p = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y, n = MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX);
      if (i >= 1) {
        var b = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].socket_index,
          r = STORAGE.data2[b].cur_level,
          u = 0;
        u = r <= 80 ? DEFINE.RUSY.C49_PROP.LEVEL80 : r <= 85 ? DEFINE.RUSY.C49_PROP.LEVEL85 : r <= 90 ? DEFINE.RUSY.C49_PROP.LEVEL90 : r <= 95 ? DEFINE.RUSY.C49_PROP.LEVEL95 : DEFINE.RUSY.C49_PROP.LEVEL100;
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].unit_num == 93 && (u = DEFINE.RUSY.C49_PROP.LEVEL100);
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].unit_num == 109 && (u = DEFINE.RUSY.C49_PROP.LEVEL100);
        w = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100) + 1;
        w <= u ? S_GAME.fireRaser_attack_stage_rusy49(p) : S_GAME.fireRaser_attack_pvp()
      } else S_GAME.fireRaser_attack_pvp();
      return
    }
  }
};
S_GAME.fireRaser_attack_pvp = function() {
  var t = RASER_PVP.x[RASER_PVP_DELTA_X],
    f, e, o, i;
  S_GAME.ranking_mode == 8 && (t = RASER_PVP.x[RASER_PVP_DELTA_X + 1]);
  var r = t - RASER_PVP.damage_range,
    u = t + RASER_PVP.damage_range,
    n = 1;
  f = gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.KT ? 4 : gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN ? 10 : 7;
  e = RASER_PVP.pole_x;
  o = RASER_PVP.pole_y;
  $("#Img_GA_raser_pung_effect_pvp").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  i = function() {
    var t, s, h, y, c;
    if (n <= f) {
      var l = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url_only_glo() + "image/ui/98_effect/missileEffect_" + n + ".png",
        a = e - 300,
        v = o - 200;
      $("#Img_GA_raser_pung_effect_pvp").css({
        "-webkit-transform": "rotateY(180deg)",
        "-webkittransform-origin": "50% 50%",
        transform: "scaleX(1.0) scaleY(1.0) rotateY(180deg)",
        "transform-origin": "50% 50%"
      });
      utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_GA_raser_pung_effect_pvp", l, a, v);
      setTimeout(i, TIMER_INTERVAL);
      n++
    } else setTimeout(function() {
      utilDraw_image_1pixel("Img_GA_raser_pung_effect_pvp");
      $("#Img_GA_raser_pung_effect_pvp").css({
        display: "none"
      })
    }, 50);
    if (n == 5) {
      for (t = 1; t <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; t++)
        if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1 && (s = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num, h = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].w + CHAR_OUR_TEAM[s].beattack_margine, r <= h && h <= u)) {
          if (S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() && S_GAME.is_koo_char(s)) continue;
          if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED, S_GAME.is_pvp_mode() && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].cheering_time > 0 || OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].shield_102_time > 0)) continue;
          S_GAME.has_special_ability("your", s, SPECIAL_ABILITY.ARMOR) ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - 1 : S_GAME.has_innate_ability("your", s, INNATE_ABILITY.ARMOR) ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - 1 : (y = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - S_GAME.get_max_damage_on_enemy(t, USER.get_missile_power_pvp(), !1));
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp <= 0 && S_GAME.die_by_your_attack(t)
        } r <= CASTLE_OUR.baseX && CASTLE_OUR.baseX <= u && (c = USER.get_missile_power_pvp(), S_GAME.attack_damage.attack_tower("missile", "your", c))
    }
  };
  i()
};

    } else setTimeout(function() {
      utilNotice(TXT.missile_absorbed, 2);
      utilDraw_image_1pixel("Img_GA_raser_pung_effect_stage");
      $("#Img_GA_raser_pung_effect_stage").css({
        display: "none"
      })
    }, 50)
  };
  u()
};

SOCKET = {};
SOCKET.init = function() {
  for (var n = 1; n <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; n++) OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n] = {}, OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].index = 0, OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].alive = 0, OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].ch_time = 0, OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].unit_num = 0
};
SOCKET.clear_socket = function(n) {
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].index = 0;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].alive = 0;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].ch_time = 0;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].unit_num = 0
};
SOCKET.add_to_socket = function(n, t) {
  for (var u, f, r, i = 1; i <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; i++)
    if (OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[i].unit_num == STORAGE.data2[n].ch_num) return 2;
  for (i = 1; i <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; i++)
    if (OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[i].index == 0)
      for (i = 1; i <= STORAGE.data1.upgrade[8]; i++)
        if (S_MAKETEAM.get_takepartin(i) == 0) {
          for (u = {}, u.ch_num = STORAGE.data2[n].ch_num, u.cur_level = STORAGE.data2[n].cur_level, u.max_level = STORAGE.data2[n].max_level, u.exp = STORAGE.data2[n].exp, u.lock = STORAGE.data2[n].lock, glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING && (u.ch_id = STORAGE.data2[n].ch_id), f = 1; f <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX + 1; f++) STORAGE.item[f].socket_index == Number(n) && (STORAGE.item[f].socket_index = -11);
          for (r = n; r > i; r--) STORAGE.data2[r].ch_num = STORAGE.data2[r - 1].ch_num, STORAGE.data2[r].cur_level = STORAGE.data2[r - 1].cur_level, STORAGE.data2[r].max_level = STORAGE.data2[r - 1].max_level, STORAGE.data2[r].exp = STORAGE.data2[r - 1].exp, STORAGE.data2[r].lock = STORAGE.data2[r - 1].lock, glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING && (STORAGE.data2[r].ch_id = STORAGE.data2[r - 1].ch_id), STORAGE.item_index_change(r - 1, r);
          return STORAGE.data2[i].ch_num = u.ch_num, STORAGE.data2[i].cur_level = u.cur_level, STORAGE.data2[i].max_level = u.max_level, STORAGE.data2[i].exp = u.exp, STORAGE.data2[i].lock = u.lock, glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING && (STORAGE.data2[i].ch_id = u.ch_id), STORAGE.item_index_change(-11, i), n = i, SOCKET.storage_ch_to_socket(i, n), utilConsoleLog("Add to socket FOCUS:" + n), STORAGE.data2_sorting(t), 1
        } return utilConsoleLog("Socket Full... Something error!!"), 0
};
SOCKET.del_to_socket = function(n, t) {
  for (var r, e, o, i, s, f = 0, u = 1; u <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; u++) OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[u].index > 0 && f++;
  for (u = 1; u <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; u++)
    if (OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[u].index == n) {
      for (r = {}, r.ch_num = STORAGE.data2[n].ch_num, r.cur_level = STORAGE.data2[n].cur_level, r.max_level = STORAGE.data2[n].max_level, r.exp = STORAGE.data2[n].exp, r.lock = STORAGE.data2[n].lock, glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING && (r.ch_id = STORAGE.data2[n].ch_id), e = 1; e <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX + 1; e++) STORAGE.item[e].socket_index == Number(n) && (STORAGE.item[e].socket_index = -11);
      for (i = n; i < f; i++) S_MAKETEAM.get_takepartin(i) == 1 && (STORAGE.data2[i].ch_num = STORAGE.data2[i + 1].ch_num, STORAGE.data2[i].cur_level = STORAGE.data2[i + 1].cur_level, STORAGE.data2[i].max_level = STORAGE.data2[i + 1].max_level, STORAGE.data2[i].exp = STORAGE.data2[i + 1].exp, STORAGE.data2[i].lock = STORAGE.data2[i + 1].lock, glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING && (STORAGE.data2[i].ch_id = STORAGE.data2[i + 1].ch_id), SOCKET.storage_ch_to_socket(i, OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[i + 1].index), OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[i].index = i, STORAGE.item_index_change(i + 1, i));
      for (OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[f].index = 0, OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[f].unit_num = 0, o = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[r.ch_num].star, i = f; i < S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num; i++) {
        if (STORAGE.data2[i + 1].ch_num == 0) return;
        if (s = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[STORAGE.data2[i + 1].ch_num].star, s >= o) STORAGE.data2[i].ch_num = STORAGE.data2[i + 1].ch_num, STORAGE.data2[i].cur_level = STORAGE.data2[i + 1].cur_level, STORAGE.data2[i].max_level = STORAGE.data2[i + 1].max_level, STORAGE.data2[i].exp = STORAGE.data2[i + 1].exp, STORAGE.data2[i].lock = STORAGE.data2[i + 1].lock, glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING && (STORAGE.data2[i].ch_id = STORAGE.data2[i + 1].ch_id), STORAGE.item_index_change(i + 1, i);
        else return STORAGE.data2[i].ch_num = r.ch_num, STORAGE.data2[i].cur_level = r.cur_level, STORAGE.data2[i].max_level = r.max_level, STORAGE.data2[i].exp = r.exp, STORAGE.data2[i].lock = r.lock, glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING && (STORAGE.data2[i].ch_id = r.ch_id), STORAGE.item_index_change(-11, i), utilConsoleLog("===== 무조건 이 라인 실행 되어야 함 ====="), STORAGE.data2_sorting(t), 1
      }
      return STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num].ch_num = r.ch_num, STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num].cur_level = r.cur_level, STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num].max_level = r.max_level, STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num].exp = r.exp, STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num].lock = r.lock, glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING && (STORAGE.data2[S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num].ch_id = r.ch_id), STORAGE.item_index_change(-11, S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num), STORAGE.data2_sorting(t), 1
    } return utilConsoleLog("Socket Full... Something error!!"), 0
};
SOCKET.storage_ch_to_socket = function(n, t) {
  if (!STORAGE.data2[t] || STORAGE.data2[t].ch_num <= 0) {
    SOCKET.clear_socket(n);
    return
  }
  var i = STORAGE.data2[t].ch_num,
    r = STORAGE.data2[t].cur_level,
    u = STORAGE.data2[t].max_level;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].index = t;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].unit_num = i;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].name = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].name;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].filename = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].filename;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].feature = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].feature;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].star = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].star;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].need_ch_time = CAL.get_charge_time_tick(t);
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].ch_time = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].need_ch_time;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].need_mineral = CAL.get_char_nm(i, r, u, t);
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].attack_power = CAL.get_char_ap(i, r, t);
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].hp = CAL.get_char_hp(i, r, t);
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].attack_len = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_len;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].attack_speed = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_speed;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].move_speed = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].move_speed;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].w = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].w;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].h = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].h;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].move_frame_num = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].move_frame_num;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].attack_fire_frame = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_fire_frame;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].fire_frame_num = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].fire_frame_num;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].max_level = STORAGE.data2[t].max_level;
  OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].lock = STORAGE.data2[t].lock
};
SOCKET.get_socket_all_ap = function() {
  for (var t = 0, n = 1; n <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; n++) OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].index > 0 && (t += OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].attack_power);
  return t
};
S_GAME.socket_getAvailable_num = function() {
  for (var t = 0, n = 1; n <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; n++) OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].index > 0 && t++;
  return t
};
S_GAME.get_your_socket_index = function(n) {
  for (var t = 1; t <= LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR.length - 1; t++)
    if (LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].unit_num == n) return t;
  return utilConsoleLog("Error in S_GAME.get_your_socket_index():" + n), 0
};
S_GAME.get_index_using_unit_num = function(n) {
  for (var t = 1; t <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; t++)
    if (OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[t].unit_num == n) return t;
  return utilConsoleLog("Error in S_GAME.get_index_using_unit_num():" + n), -1
};
var MAX_EFFECT = 3,
  EFFECT_COUNT = 1,
  EFFECT_ARRAY = new Array(MAX_EFFECT + 1);
S_GAME.effect_init = function() {
  for (var n = 1; n <= MAX_EFFECT; n++) EFFECT_ARRAY[n] = {}, EFFECT_ARRAY[n].live = 0, EFFECT_ARRAY[n].id = null, EFFECT_ARRAY[n].count = 1
};
var effect_adding = 0,
  effect_deleting = 0,
  backup_id_add = 0,
  backup_id_del = 0;
S_GAME.effect_add = function(n) {
  var t;
  for ((effect_adding == 1 || effect_deleting == 1) && (backup_id_add = n, setTimeout(function() {
      S_GAME.effect_add(backup_id_add)
    }, 30)), effect_adding = 1, t = 1; t <= MAX_EFFECT; t++)
    if (EFFECT_ARRAY[t].live == 1 && EFFECT_ARRAY[t].id == n) return effect_adding = 0, 0;
  for (t = 1; t <= MAX_EFFECT; t++)
    if (EFFECT_ARRAY[t].live == 0) return EFFECT_ARRAY[t].live = 1, EFFECT_ARRAY[t].id = n, EFFECT_ARRAY[t].count = EFFECT_COUNT, effect_adding = 0, 1;
  return utilConsoleLog("EFFECT_ARRAY full...."), effect_adding = 0, 0
};
S_GAME.effect_del = function(n) {
  (effect_adding == 1 || effect_deleting == 1) && (backup_id_del = n, setTimeout(function() {
    S_GAME.effect_del(backup_id_del)
  }, 30));
  effect_deleting = 1;
  for (var t = 1; t <= MAX_EFFECT; t++)
    if (EFFECT_ARRAY[t].live == 1 && EFFECT_ARRAY[t].id == n) return EFFECT_ARRAY[t].live = 0, EFFECT_ARRAY[t].id = null, EFFECT_ARRAY[t].count = 0, $("#" + n).css({
      "-webkit-box-shadow": "0px 0px 0px 0px rgba(5,240,146,1)"
    }), effect_deleting = 0, 1;
  return utilConsoleLog("Can not find id:" + n + "___effect_del_fail"), effect_deleting = 0, 0
};
S_GAME.bottom_effect_interval = function() {
  for (var n = 1; n <= MAX_EFFECT; n++)
    if (EFFECT_ARRAY[n].live == 1) switch (EFFECT_ARRAY[n].id) {
      case "game_ui_mineral":
        S_GAME.bottom_ui.reder_mineral_bg(EFFECT_ARRAY[n].count);
        EFFECT_ARRAY[n].count = EFFECT_ARRAY[n].count == 1 ? 2 : 1;
        break;
      case "game_ui_missile":
        S_GAME.bottom_ui.reder_missile_bg(EFFECT_ARRAY[n].count);
        EFFECT_ARRAY[n].count = EFFECT_ARRAY[n].count == 1 ? 2 : 1
    }
};

  } else setTimeout(function() {
    switch (n) {
      case 1:
        S_GAME.our_char_pung_1(t, i - 30);
        break;
      case 2:
        S_GAME.our_char_pung_2(t, i - 30);

        break;

      case 10:
      default:
        S_GAME.our_char_pung_10(t, i - 30)
    }
  }, 0)
};

EFFECT1 = {
  ccanvas: null,
  context: null,
  image: {
    star: null,
    twinkle: null
  },
  load: {
    cur: 0,
    max: 2
  },
  twinkle: {
    num: 15,
    repeat: 5,
    count: 0,
    w: 45,
    h: 44
  },
  twinkles: []
};
EFFECT1.init = function(n, t, i, r, u) {
  $("#effect_div").css({
    display: "block",
    left: t + "px",
    top: i + "px",
    position: "absolute"
  });
  EFFECT1.canvas = document.getElementById(n);
  EFFECT1.context = EFFECT1.canvas.getContext("2d");
  EFFECT1.canvas.width = r;
  EFFECT1.canvas.height = u;
  EFFECT1.load.cur = 0;
  EFFECT1.image.star = new Image;
  EFFECT1.image.star.src = IMG_RES.resolve(glo.fun.get_ser_img_url_only_glo() + "image/ui/98_effect/ef_star.png");
  EFFECT1.image.star.onload = function() {
    EFFECT1.load.cur++
  };
  EFFECT1.image.twinkle = new Image;
  EFFECT1.image.twinkle.src = IMG_RES.resolve(glo.fun.get_ser_img_url_only_glo() + "image/ui/98_effect/ef_twinkle.png");
  EFFECT1.image.twinkle.onload = function() {
    EFFECT1.load.cur++
  };
  for (var f = 1; f <= EFFECT1.twinkle.num; f++) EFFECT1.twinkles[f] = {}, EFFECT1.twinkles[f].x = 10 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 500), EFFECT1.twinkles[f].y = 10 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 500), EFFECT1.twinkles[f].scale = Math.random() * 1.5, EFFECT1.twinkles[f].opacity = 1
};
EFFECT1.draw_effect_twinkle = function(n, t) {
  var i;
  if (EFFECT1.load.cur != EFFECT1.load.max) {
    setTimeout(function() {
      EFFECT1.draw_effect_twinkle(n, t)
    }, 50);
    return
  }
  for (i = 1; i <= EFFECT1.twinkle.num; i++) EFFECT1.twinkles[i] = {}, EFFECT1.twinkles[i].x = Math.floor(Math.random() * n), EFFECT1.twinkles[i].y = Math.floor(Math.random() * t), EFFECT1.twinkles[i].scale = Math.random() * 1.5, EFFECT1.twinkles[i].opacity = 1;
  for (EFFECT1.context.clearRect(0, 0, EFFECT1.canvas.width, EFFECT1.canvas.height), i = 1; i <= EFFECT1.twinkle.num; i++) EFFECT1.context.drawImage(EFFECT1.image.twinkle, EFFECT1.twinkles[i].x, EFFECT1.twinkles[i].y, EFFECT1.twinkle.w * EFFECT1.twinkles[i].scale, EFFECT1.twinkle.h * EFFECT1.twinkles[i].scale);
  EFFECT1.twinkle.count < EFFECT1.twinkle.repeat && (EFFECT1.twinkle.count++, setTimeout(function() {
    EFFECT1.draw_effect_twinkle(n, t)
  }, 150))
};
EFFECT1.draw_line_test = function() {
  EFFECT1.context.clearRect(0, 0, EFFECT1.canvas.width, EFFECT1.canvas.height);
  EFFECT1.context.beginPath();
  EFFECT1.context.moveTo(8, 8);
  EFFECT1.context.lineTo(100, 100);
  EFFECT1.context.lineWidth = 2;
  EFFECT1.context.lineCap = "round";
  EFFECT1.context.strokeStyle = "#ffff00";
  EFFECT1.context.stroke()
};

EFFECT2.draw_effect_twinkle = function(n, t) {
  var i, r, u;
  if (EFFECT2.load.cur != EFFECT2.load.max) {
    setTimeout(function() {
      EFFECT2.draw_effect_twinkle(n, t)
    }, 50);
    return
  }
  for (EFFECT2.context.clearRect(0, 0, EFFECT2.canvas.width, EFFECT2.canvas.height), i = 1; i <= EFFECT2.twinkle.num; i++) EFFECT2.twinkles[i].order == 1 ? (EFFECT2.twinkles[i].cur_s += EFFECT2.twinkles[i].gap, EFFECT2.twinkles[i].cur_s >= EFFECT2.twinkles[i].max_s && (EFFECT2.twinkles[i].order = 0)) : (EFFECT2.twinkles[i].cur_s -= EFFECT2.twinkles[i].gap, EFFECT2.twinkles[i].cur_s <= EFFECT2.twinkles[i].min_s && (EFFECT2.twinkles[i].order = 1)), r = EFFECT2.twinkle.w * EFFECT2.twinkles[i].cur_s, u = EFFECT2.twinkle.h * EFFECT2.twinkles[i].cur_s, EFFECT2.context.drawImage(EFFECT2.image.twinkle, EFFECT2.twinkles[i].x - (r - EFFECT2.twinkle.w) / 2, EFFECT2.twinkles[i].y - (u - EFFECT2.twinkle.h) / 2, EFFECT2.twinkle.w * EFFECT2.twinkles[i].cur_s, EFFECT2.twinkle.h * EFFECT2.twinkles[i].cur_s);
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_STAGECLEAR ? setTimeout(function() {
    EFFECT2.draw_effect_twinkle(n, t)
  }, EFFECT2.interval) : $("#effect_div").css({
    display: "none"
  })
};

S_POPUPYN.ub.is_on = function() {
  return g_sceneinfo.before_scene !== gS_UPGRADE ? !1 : typeof S_UPGRADE == "undefined" || !S_UPGRADE.batch ? !1 : S_UPGRADE.batch.is_on()
};
S_POPUPYN.ub.get_col_by_id = function(n) {
  switch (n) {
    case "PYN_UB_bt_min":
      return 1;
    case "PYN_UB_bt_minus":
      return 2;
    case "PYN_UB_bt_plus":
      return 3;
    case "PYN_UB_bt_max":
      return 4;
    case "PYN_UB_ic_minus":
      return 2;
    case "PYN_UB_ic_plus":
      return 3;
    case "PYN_UB_bt_focus":
      return S_POPUPYN.ub.col
  }
  return 0
};
S_POPUPYN.ub.draw_level = function() {
  var n = S_UPGRADE.focus,
    t = S_UPGRADE.batch.target_level,
    i = "Lv." + t;
  n == 6 ? i = t + TXT.person_unit : (n == 8 || n == 9) && (i = t + TXT.object_unit);
  $("#PYN_UB_level").text(i)
};
S_POPUPYN.ub.draw_cost = function() {
  $("#PYN_Txt_3").text(utilGetNumber_withComma(S_UPGRADE.batch.get_cur_cost() + ""))
};
S_POPUPYN.ub.draw_focus = function() {
  var n = S_POPUPYN.ub.BTN_X[S_POPUPYN.ub.col] - S_POPUPYN.ub.FOCUS_GAP,
    t = S_POPUPYN.ub.BTN_Y - S_POPUPYN.ub.FOCUS_GAP;
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("PYN_UB_bt_focus", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/9_upgrade/up_popbt_f.png", n, t);
  $("#PYN_UB_bt_focus").show()
};
S_POPUPYN.ub.run = function(n) {
  var f = S_UPGRADE.focus,
    i = S_UPGRADE.batch.from_level,
    u = S_UPGRADE.batch.target_level,
    r = S_UPGRADE.batch.get_max_target_level(f, i),
    t = u;
  r < i + 1 && (r = i + 1);
  switch (n) {
    case 1:
      t = i + 1;
      break;
    case 2:
      t = u - 1;
      break;
    case 3:
      t = u + 1;
      break;
    case 4:
      t = r
  }(t < i + 1 && (t = i + 1), t > r && (t = r, r >= S_UPGRADE.batch.get_max_level(f) ? utilNotice(TXT.your_update_is_max, 1.2) : utilNotice(TXT.upgrade_batch_asset_limit, 1.2)), t !== u) && (S_UPGRADE.batch.target_level = t, S_POPUPYN.ub.draw_level(), S_POPUPYN.ub.draw_cost())
};
S_POPUPYN.preload = function() {
  var n = ["./image/ui/99_popup/po_goldbar.png", "./image/ui/99_popup/po_rubybar.png", "./image/ui/99_popup/po_bg.png", "./image/ui/1_mainmenu/mm_mainbt.png", "./image/ui/1_mainmenu/mm_mainbt_focus.png", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/99_popup/po_celestialbar.png"];
  ChangeScene.preloadImage(n);
  S_POPUPYN.maketag()
};
S_POPUPYN.init = function() {
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && $("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
    left: "0px",
    top: "0px",
    position: "absolute"
  });
  Main.showSafeZone();
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && S_POPUPYN.maketag();
  gEnableKey = 0;
  utilConsoleLog("S_POPUPYN.init()");
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_POPUPYN;
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_POPUPYN.define();
  S_POPUPYN.make_screen();
  S_POPUPYN.addMouseEvent();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  setTimeout(function() {
    gEnableKey = 1
  }, DEFINE.KEYLOCKTIME)
};
S_POPUPYN.pause = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_POPUPYN.pause()!!")
};
S_POPUPYN.resume = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_POPUPYN.resume()!!");
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)
};
S_POPUPYN.maketag = function() {
  var n = document.getElementById("S_POPUPYN_div"),
    t = document.getElementById("Img_PYN_bg");
  if (t) {
    utilConsoleLog("Already ready.");
    return
  }
  n.innerHTML = '\t<div id="Img_PYN_bg"> <\/div>\t<img id="Img_PYN_board">\t<div id="PYN_Txt_Img">\t<\/div>\t<div id="PYN_btn1"\t\tclass="button"> <\/div>\t<div id="PYN_btn2"\t\tclass="button"> <\/div>\t<img id="PYN_btn_focus"\tclass="button  focus">';
  glo.APP_FEATURE.PACKAGE_STORE && (n.innerHTML = n.innerHTML + '<img id="Img_PYN_growth_icon">');
  n.innerHTML = n.innerHTML + '\t<div id="PYN_UB_bt_min"\t\tclass="button"> <\/div>\t<div id="PYN_UB_bt_minus"\tclass="button"> <\/div>\t<div id="PYN_UB_bt_plus"\tclass="button"> <\/div>\t<div id="PYN_UB_bt_max"\t\tclass="button"> <\/div>\t<img id="PYN_UB_ic_minus"\tclass="button">\t<img id="PYN_UB_ic_plus"\tclass="button">\t<img id="PYN_UB_bt_focus"\tclass="button  focus">\t<div id="PYN_UB_level"> <\/div>';
  n.style.top = "0px"
};

S_POPUPYN.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var r = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    i = S_POPUPYN.ub.is_on();
  switch (r) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (i && S_POPUPYN.ub.row === 1) {
        S_POPUPYN.ub.col > 1 && (S_POPUPYN.ub.col--, S_POPUPYN.drawFocus());
        break
      }
      S_POPUPYN.focus >= 2 && (S_POPUPYN.focus = 1, S_POPUPYN.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (i && S_POPUPYN.ub.row === 1) {
        S_POPUPYN.ub.col < 4 && (S_POPUPYN.ub.col++, S_POPUPYN.drawFocus());
        break
      }
      S_POPUPYN.focus <= 1 && (S_POPUPYN.focus = 2, S_POPUPYN.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      i && S_POPUPYN.ub.row === 2 && (S_POPUPYN.ub.row = 1, S_POPUPYN.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      i && S_POPUPYN.ub.row === 1 && (S_POPUPYN.ub.row = 2, S_POPUPYN.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      if (i && S_POPUPYN.ub.row === 1) {
        sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
        S_POPUPYN.ub.run(S_POPUPYN.ub.col);
        break
      }
      S_POPUPYN.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_POPUPYN.back()
  }
};
S_POPUPYN.back_game = function() {
  var n, t;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_GAME;
  sound_bgm_play(BGM_SOUND.INGAME);
  S_GAME.addMouseEvent();
  S_GAME.interval();
  S_GAME.start_render();
  n = S_GAME.your_team_stop_time - S_GAME.your_team_start_time;
  S_GAME.timer_autoYourTeamManager != null && (clearInterval(S_GAME.timer_autoYourTeamManager), S_GAME.timer_autoYourTeamManager = null);
  S_GAME.your_team_remain_time = S_GAME.your_team_remain_time - n;
  S_GAME.your_team_remain_time < 0 && (S_GAME.your_team_remain_time = 0);
  S_GAME.timer_autoYourTeamManager = setTimeout(S_GAME.autoYourTeamManager_timeout, S_GAME.your_team_remain_time);
  t = new Date;
  S_GAME.your_team_start_time = t.getTime();
  (S_GAME.ranking_mode == 0 || S_GAME.ranking_mode == 5) && (S_GAME.stage_ability_time_pause_end = window.g.timestamp_due);
  S_GAME.stage_ability_time_pause_flag = 1;
  S_GAME.timer_ui.set_timer_pause_end(gS_GAME);
  S_GAME.timer_ui.start()
};

S_POPUPYN.drawFocus = function() {
  var n, t;
  if (window.g.blink.value = 1, n = S_POPUPYN.ub.is_on(), n && S_POPUPYN.ub.row === 1) {
    $("#PYN_btn_focus").hide();

  }
  n && $("#PYN_UB_bt_focus").hide();
  t = n ? 461 : 413;
  $("#PYN_btn_focus").show();
  S_POPUPYN.focus == 1 ? utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("PYN_btn_focus", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/1_mainmenu/mm_mainbt_focus.png", 421, t) : utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("PYN_btn_focus", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/1_mainmenu/mm_mainbt_focus.png", 643, t)

S_POPUPYN.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_POPUPYN.focus) {
    case 1:
      utilScale_xy_center("PYN_btn1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("PYN_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 2:
      utilScale_xy_center("PYN_btn2", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("PYN_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("PYN_btn1", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("PYN_btn2", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("PYN_btn_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      S_POPUPYN.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};

S_POPUPYN.end = function() {
  S_POPUPYN.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_POPUPYN.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_POPUPYN.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_POPUPYN.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_POPUPYN.onClick = function(n) {
  var t, i;
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (utilConsoleLog("S_POPUPYN.onClick  elm.id: " + t.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id + "    gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey), S_POPUPYN.ub.is_on() && S_POPUPYN.ub.row === 1 && (i = S_POPUPYN.ub.get_col_by_id(n.target.id), i > 0)) {
      sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
      S_POPUPYN.ub.run(i);
      return
    }(n.target.id == "PYN_btn1" || n.target.id == "PYN_btn2" || n.target.id == "PYN_btn_focus") && S_POPUPYN.menuRun()
  }
};
S_POPUPYN.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (utilConsoleLog("S_POPUPYN.onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id + "    gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey), S_POPUPYN.ub.is_on()) {
    var t = S_POPUPYN.ub.get_col_by_id(n.target.id);
    if (t > 0 && n.target.id !== "PYN_UB_bt_focus") {
      S_POPUPYN.ub.row = 1;
      S_POPUPYN.ub.col = t;
      S_POPUPYN.drawFocus();
      return
    }(n.target.id === "PYN_btn1" || n.target.id === "PYN_btn2") && (S_POPUPYN.ub.row = 2)
  }
  switch (n.target.id) {
    case "PYN_btn1":
      S_POPUPYN.focus = 1;
      S_POPUPYN.drawFocus();
      return;
    case "PYN_btn2":
      S_POPUPYN.focus = 2;
      S_POPUPYN.drawFocus();
      return
  }
};
S_POPUPYN.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_POPUPYN.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_POPUPYN.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_POPUPYN.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_POPUPYN.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_POPUPYN.onMouseover(n);
  S_POPUPYN.onClick(n);
  return
};

S_STAGECLEAR.apply_server_result = function(n) {
  var r, l, t, f, i, h, s, b, u, e, o, v, y, p, c, w, a;
  if (S_STAGECLEAR.oldnew = parseInt(n.IS_FIRST_CLEAR, 10) === 1 ? 1 : 0, S_STAGECLEAR.oldnew_medal = parseInt(n.IS_UPDATE_MEDAL, 10) === 1 ? 1 : 0, S_STAGECLEAR.medal = typeof n.MEDAL == "string" ? n.MEDAL : "", S_STAGECLEAR.rad_exp_x2 = parseInt(n.RAD_EXP_MUL, 10) > 1, S_GAME.is_normal_stage_mode() && typeof n.UP_DATA3 == "string" && n.UP_DATA3 !== "") {
    for (h = n.UP_DATA3.split(","), r = 0; r < h.length; r++) h[r] !== "" && h[r] != null && (STORAGE.data3[r + 1] = h[r]);
    S_MEDALPOWER.cal_power();
    S_STAGECLEAR.oldnew === 1 && S_GAME.stage == 300 && ServerConnection.add_sub_stage(S_GAME.stage, "신규스테이지통과(" + S_GAME.stage + "stage)")
  }
  for (S_GAME.is_hard_stage_mode() && (n.hasOwnProperty("HARD_STAGE_DATA") && (CUR_HARD_STAGE_NUM = parseInt(n.HARD_STAGE_DATA, 10)), n.hasOwnProperty("HARD_JEWEL_DATA") && typeof n.HARD_JEWEL_DATA == "string" && (HARD_MODE_JEWEL = n.HARD_JEWEL_DATA)), s = parseInt(n.ADD_GOLD, 10), (isNaN(s) || s < 0) && (s = 0), S_STAGECLEAR.wingold = s, b = S_GAME.is_hard_stage_mode() ? "하드모드 " + S_GAME.stage + "스테이지 클리어" : S_GAME.stage + "스테이지클리어", S_MAINMENU.make_screen_top_add_gold(s, b, !0), u = parseInt(n.USER_LEVEL_BEFORE, 10), e = parseInt(n.USER_LEVEL, 10), isNaN(u) && (u = USER.level), isNaN(e) && (e = u), S_STAGECLEAR.old.level = u, S_STAGECLEAR.old.exp = parseFloat(n.USER_EXP_BEFORE), isNaN(S_STAGECLEAR.old.exp) && (S_STAGECLEAR.old.exp = USER.exp), USER.level = e, USER.exp = parseFloat(n.USER_EXP), isNaN(USER.exp) && (USER.exp = 0), r = u; r < e; r++) QUEST.f1_player_levelup();
  for (u < e && (utilConsoleLog(TXT.congratulate_levelup + ":" + u + "==>" + e), setTimeout(function() {
      u < 10 && e >= 10 ? utilNotice(TXT.pvpranking_ok, 4) : u < 80 && e >= 80 && utilNotice(TXT.ournum_upgrade_ok, 4)
    }, 4e3)), o = parseInt(n.ADD_RUBY, 10), (isNaN(o) || o < 0) && (o = 0), S_STAGECLEAR.levelup_ruby = o, o > 0 && (USER.ruby += o, glo.APP_FEATURE.RUBY_CRYPT && encoding_add_ruby(o)), t = 1; t <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; t++) S_STAGECLEAR.char_level[t] && (i = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[t].index, v = i > 0 && STORAGE.data2[i] ? STORAGE.data2[i].cur_level : 0, S_STAGECLEAR.char_level[t].before = v, S_STAGECLEAR.char_level[t].after = v);
  for (y = n.CHARS && n.CHARS.length ? n.CHARS : [], l = 0; l < y.length; l++)
    if (f = y[l], i = parseInt(f.INDEX, 10), i > 0 && STORAGE.data2[i]) {
      if (parseInt(STORAGE.data2[i].ch_num, 10) !== parseInt(f.CH_NUM, 10)) {
        for (p = 0, t = 1; t <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; t++)
          if (c = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[t].index, c > 0 && STORAGE.data2[c] && parseInt(STORAGE.data2[c].ch_num, 10) === parseInt(f.CH_NUM, 10)) {
            i = c;
            p = 1;
            break
          } if (!p) {
          utilConsoleLog("stage_clear CHARS index mismatch:" + f.INDEX + ":" + f.CH_NUM);
          continue
        }
      }
      for (w = parseInt(f.BEFORE_LEVEL, 10), a = parseInt(f.AFTER_LEVEL, 10), STORAGE.data2[i].cur_level = a, STORAGE.data2[i].exp = parseInt(f.EXP, 10), QUEST.f2_char_levelup(a - w), t = 1; t <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; t++) OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[t].index == i && S_STAGECLEAR.char_level[t] && (S_STAGECLEAR.char_level[t].before = w, S_STAGECLEAR.char_level[t].after = a)
    } S_GAME.is_normal_stage_mode() && S_STAGECLEAR.oldnew == 1 && QUEST.f4_stageclear();
  STORAGE.save_quest_to_server();
  STORAGE.alldata_to_storage();
  S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top()
};

S_STAGECLEAR.draw_server_rewards = function(n) {
  for (var t, i, f = n.REWARDS && n.REWARDS.length ? n.REWARDS : [], r = 0, u = 0; u < f.length; u++)(t = f[u], i = parseInt(t.VALUE, 10), i > 0) && (t.TYPE === "CHAR" ? (S_STAGECLEAR.draw_bonus_char(i), r = 1) : t.TYPE === "ITEM" && (S_STAGECLEAR.draw_bonus_item(i), r = 1));
  r && utilNotice(TXT.reward_mailbox_check, 2);
  S_GAME.is_hard_stage_mode() && parseInt(n.JEWEL_STATE, 10) === 1 && S_STAGECLEAR.hardmode_get_jewel_draw();
  $("#SC_btn1_new").css({
    display: "none"
  })
};

  var l = null,
    r = 0,

    c, t;
  S_STAGECLEAR.rad_exp_x2 = h > 1;
  var n = 0,
    u = "",

S_STAGECLEAR.win_cal_npc = function() {
  var i = 20,
    r = CAL.get_pvp_bonus1_time(),
    u = CAL.get_pvp_bonus2_kill(),
    f = CAL.get_pvp_bonus3_levelgap(),
    t, n;
  for (score = glo.pvp.get_game_result() === glo.pvp.RESULT_TYPE.W || S_RANKING_NVN.game_result == 1 ? i + 50 + r + u + f : i, t = 0, n = 1; n < OUR_TEAM_SOCKET.length; n++) S_GAME.has_special_ability("our", OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].unit_num, SPECIAL_ABILITY.PVP_SCORE_UP) && (t = t + S_GAME.special_ability.get_index_value(OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].unit_num, n, "our", "pvp_score_up_per") / 100);
  return score = score * (1 + t), Math.round(score)
};
S_STAGECLEAR.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var r = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    i;
  if (S_STAGECLEAR.lv_overlay_on) {
    if (!S_STAGECLEAR.lvup_can_close) return;
    typeof S_STAGECLEAR.hide_user_levelup_overlay == "function" ? S_STAGECLEAR.hide_user_levelup_overlay() : ($("#Img_SC_levelup_bg").hide(), S_STAGECLEAR.lv_overlay_on = 0, S_STAGECLEAR.lvup_can_close = 0, gEnableKey = 1);
    return
  }
  if (is_autoplay_stop()) {
    if ((gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && r != KeyDefine.enter) return;
    S_GAME.stop_autoplay(gS_STAGECLEAR);
    return
  }
  if (!S_STAGECLEAR.handle_event_cutscene() && S_STAGECLEAR.is_make_screen_btnmenu === 1) switch (r) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_STAGECLEAR.focus >= 2) {
        S_STAGECLEAR.focus--;
        S_STAGECLEAR.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (glo.APP_FEATURE.MACRO_PREVENTION_PVP && S_GAME.ranking_mode == 0 && S_STAGECLEAR.focus == 1) {
        S_STAGECLEAR.focus = 4;
        S_STAGECLEAR.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (i = 5, REWARD_AD.exists(REWARD_AD.PLACE.STAGECLEAR) && S_GAME.is_stage_mode() && (i = 6), S_GAME.ranking_mode == 8 && (i = 3), S_STAGECLEAR.focus < i) {
        S_STAGECLEAR.focus++;
        S_STAGECLEAR.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (glo.APP_FEATURE.MACRO_PREVENTION_PVP && S_GAME.ranking_mode == 0 && S_STAGECLEAR.focus == 4) {
        S_STAGECLEAR.focus = 1;
        S_STAGECLEAR.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_STAGECLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      S_STAGECLEAR.focus = 1;
      S_STAGECLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      S_STAGECLEAR.focus = 2;
      S_STAGECLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
      S_STAGECLEAR.focus = 3;
      S_STAGECLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM4:
      if (S_GAME.ranking_mode == 8) return;
      S_STAGECLEAR.focus = 4;
      S_STAGECLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM5:
      if (S_GAME.ranking_mode == 8) return;
      S_STAGECLEAR.focus = 5;
      S_STAGECLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.back:
      (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && (S_STAGECLEAR.focus = 5, S_STAGECLEAR.menuRun_Run())
  }
};

S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni_f = function() {
  var n, u, t, r, i;
  if (S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni.curY += S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni.gap, S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni.curY >= 148 && (S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni.count++, S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni.curY = 0), S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni.curY >= S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni.goalY) {
    if (S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni.count < S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni.repeat) {
      $("#SC_medal_value").css({
        "background-position": "0px -" + S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni.curY + "px"
      });
      setTimeout(S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni_f, 50);
      return
    }
    if (S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni.curY = S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni.goalY, $("#SC_medal_value").css({
        "background-position": "0px -" + S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni.curY + "px"
      }), (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && S_EVENTPAGE.is_event_activate()) {
      utilNotice("축하 합니다. 이벤트에 담청되셨습니다.", 1.5);
      setTimeout(function() {
        $("#S_EVENTPAGE_div").css({
          display: "block"
        });
        S_EVENTPAGE.init()
      }, 500);
      return
    }
    if (n = S_GAME.stage, u = n === 100 || n === 200 || n === 241 || n === 260 || n === 300, u) {
      if (S_STAGECLEAR.lv_overlay_on || S_STAGECLEAR.defer_cutscene) {
        S_STAGECLEAR.defer_cutscene = 1;
        S_STAGECLEAR.deferred_stage_for_cutscene = n === 100 ? 100 : 200;
        return
      }
      n === 100 ? S_STAGECLEAR.show_100stage_clear() : (gEnableKey = 0, S_STAGECLEAR.message_200_focus = 1, S_STAGECLEAR.show_200stage_clear());
      return
    }
    for (t = Math.floor((S_GAME.stage - 1) / 5) + 1, r = 1, i = t * 5 - 4; i <= t * 5; i++)
      if (STORAGE.data3[i] == "T" || STORAGE.data3[i] == "D") {
        r = 0;
        break
      } if ((S_STAGECLEAR.oldnew == 1 || S_STAGECLEAR.oldnew_medal == 1) && r == 1) {
      var f = TXT["medalpower" + t],
        e = S_MEDALPOWER.value[t] * 100,
        o = t + ". " + f + "(" + e + "% " + TXT.baldong + ")";
      utilNotice(o, 3.5)
    }
    S_STAGECLEAR.make_screen_btnmenu()
  } else $("#SC_medal_value").css({
    "background-position": "0px -" + S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni.curY + "px"
  }), setTimeout(S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni_f, 75)
};

S_STAGECLEAR.display_levelupani = function() {
  if (S_GAME.ranking_mode != 8) {
    var n = S_STAGECLEAR.old.level,
      t = S_STAGECLEAR.old.exp;
    n == USER.level ? (S_STAGECLEAR.exp.start = Math.floor(S_STAGECLEAR.old.exp / CAL.get_need_user_exp_for_levelup(n) * 1e3) / 10, S_STAGECLEAR.exp.end = Math.floor(USER.exp / CAL.get_need_user_exp_for_levelup(USER.level) * 1e3) / 10, S_STAGECLEAR.exp.cur = S_STAGECLEAR.exp.start, S_STAGECLEAR.exp.gap = (S_STAGECLEAR.exp.end - S_STAGECLEAR.exp.start) / 10, S_STAGECLEAR.level.cur = S_STAGECLEAR.old.level, S_STAGECLEAR.levelupani_exp()) : (S_STAGECLEAR.exp.start = Math.floor(S_STAGECLEAR.old.exp / CAL.get_need_user_exp_for_levelup(n) * 1e3) / 10, S_STAGECLEAR.exp.end = 100, S_STAGECLEAR.exp.cur = S_STAGECLEAR.exp.start, S_STAGECLEAR.exp.gap = (S_STAGECLEAR.exp.end - S_STAGECLEAR.exp.start) / 10, S_STAGECLEAR.level.cur = S_STAGECLEAR.old.level, S_STAGECLEAR.levelupani_exp())
  }
};
S_STAGECLEAR.levelupani_exp = function() {
  var n = Math.floor(S_STAGECLEAR.exp.cur * 10) / 10;
  if ($("#SC_level_progress").css({
      width: n + "%"
    }), USER.level == DEFINE.USER_LEVEL_MAX ? $("#Txt_SC_level_percent").text("MAX") : $("#Txt_SC_level_percent").text(n + "%"), S_STAGECLEAR.exp.cur += S_STAGECLEAR.exp.gap, S_STAGECLEAR.exp.cur >= S_STAGECLEAR.exp.end) {
    if ($("#SC_level_progress").css({
        width: S_STAGECLEAR.exp.end + "%"
      }), $("#Txt_SC_level_percent").text(S_STAGECLEAR.exp.end + "%"), S_GAME.ranking_mode == 0 && S_STAGECLEAR.medalAni_f(), S_STAGECLEAR.level.cur < USER.level) {
      S_STAGECLEAR.level.cur++;
      $("#Txt_SC_level_title").text("" + S_STAGECLEAR.level.cur);
      S_STAGECLEAR.exp.start = 0;
      S_STAGECLEAR.exp.end = S_STAGECLEAR.level.cur == USER.level ? Math.floor(USER.exp / CAL.get_need_user_exp_for_levelup(USER.level) * 100) : 100;
      S_STAGECLEAR.exp.cur = S_STAGECLEAR.exp.start;
      S_STAGECLEAR.exp.gap = (S_STAGECLEAR.exp.end - S_STAGECLEAR.exp.start) / 10;
      S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top();
      setTimeout(S_STAGECLEAR.levelupani_exp, S_STAGECLEAR.interval * 2);
      return
    }
    S_GAME.is_hard_stage_mode() ? (S_STAGECLEAR.make_screen_btnmenu(), $("#SC_medal_value").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Txt_SC_medal_title").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#SC_medal_value").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Txt_SC_gold_title").css({
      top: "200px"
    }), USER.lang == LANG.RUSSIA && $("#Txt_SC_gold_title").css({
      top: "191px"
    }), $("#Txt_SC_gold_value").css({
      top: "200px"
    }), $("#Txt_SC_medal_title").text("")) : ($("#SC_medal_value").css({
      display: "block"
    }), $("#Txt_SC_medal_title").css({
      display: "block"
    }), $("#SC_medal_value").css({

S_STAGECLEAR.set_char_bar_pct = function(n, t) {
  var i = 64,
    r = Math.max(0, Math.min(i, Math.round(i * (t / 100))));
  $("#SC_ch" + n + "_levelup_bar").css({
    width: r + "px"
  })
};
S_STAGECLEAR.set_char_level_label = function(n, t, i) {
  var r = $("#Txt_SC_ch" + n + "_level");
  i != null && t >= i ? r.text("MAX") : r.text("Lv." + t)
};
S_STAGECLEAR.prepare_char_exp_ani = function() {
  var n, t, i, u, s, h, f, e, r, c, l, o;
  if (S_GAME.ranking_mode != 8 && !S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.running) {
    for (S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.running = 1, n = 1; n <= S_STAGECLEAR.ch_num; n++) {
      if (t = S_STAGECLEAR.char_level && S_STAGECLEAR.char_level[n] ? S_STAGECLEAR.char_level[n].before : null, i = S_STAGECLEAR.char_level && S_STAGECLEAR.char_level[n] ? S_STAGECLEAR.char_level[n].after : null, u = S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp_pct_before && S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp_pct_before[n] != null ? S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp_pct_before[n] : 0, s = S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp_pct_after && S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp_pct_after[n] != null ? S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp_pct_after[n] : t != null && i != null && i > t ? 0 : 30, e = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n] && OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].index ? OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].index : 0, r = e > 0 && STORAGE.data2[e] ? STORAGE.data2[e].max_level : null, h = t != null && i != null && i > t, c = r != null && t != null && t >= r, l = r != null && i != null && i >= r && !c, c) {
        S_STAGECLEAR.set_char_bar_pct(n, 100);
        S_STAGECLEAR.set_char_level_label(n, t, r);
        S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.slots[n] = {
          done: 1
        };
        continue
      }
      f = h ? 100 : s;
      f < u && (f = u);
      S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.slots[n] = {
        cur: u,
        start: u,
        end: f,
        last_end: l ? 100 : s,
        level_cur: t != null ? t : 0,
        level_end: i != null ? i : t != null ? t : 0,
        leveled: h ? 1 : 0,
        max_level: r,
        gap: (f - u) / S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.step_count,
        done: 0
      };
      S_STAGECLEAR.set_char_level_label(n, S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.slots[n].level_cur, r);
      S_STAGECLEAR.set_char_bar_pct(n, u)
    }
    for (o = 1; o <= S_STAGECLEAR.ch_num; o++)(function(n) {
      setTimeout(function() {
        S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp_tick(n)
      }, S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.interval)
    })(o)
  }
};
S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp_tick = function(n) {
  var t = S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.slots[n],
    s, h, e, r, i, u, o, f;
  if (t && !t.done) {
    if (t.cur += t.gap, s = t.gap >= 0 ? Math.min(t.cur, t.end) : Math.max(t.cur, t.end), S_STAGECLEAR.set_char_bar_pct(n, s), h = t.gap >= 0 && t.cur >= t.end || t.gap < 0 && t.cur <= t.end, h) {
      if (S_STAGECLEAR.set_char_bar_pct(n, t.end), t.leveled && t.level_cur < t.level_end) {
        if (t.level_cur += 1, t.max_level != null && t.level_cur >= t.max_level) {
          for (S_STAGECLEAR.set_char_bar_pct(n, 100), S_STAGECLEAR.set_char_level_label(n, t.level_cur, t.max_level), t.done = 1, e = 1, r = 1; r <= S_STAGECLEAR.ch_num; r++)
            if (S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.slots[r] && !S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.slots[r].done) {
              e = 0;
              break
            } e && (S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.running = 0);
          return
        }
        S_STAGECLEAR.set_char_level_label(n, t.level_cur, t.max_level);
        i = 0;
        u = t.level_cur === t.level_end ? t.last_end : 100;
        u < i && (u = i);
        t.start = i;
        t.end = u;
        t.cur = i;
        t.gap = (u - i) / S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.step_count;
        setTimeout(function() {
          S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp_tick(n)
        }, S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.interval);
        return
      }
      for (S_STAGECLEAR.set_char_level_label(n, t.level_cur, t.max_level), t.done = 1, o = 1, f = 1; f <= S_STAGECLEAR.ch_num; f++)
        if (S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.slots[f] && !S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.slots[f].done) {
          o = 0;
          break
        } o && (S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.running = 0);
      return
    }
    setTimeout(function() {
      S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp_tick(n)
    }, S_STAGECLEAR.char_exp.interval)
  }
};
S_STAGECLEAR.display_uparrow = function() {
  if (S_GAME.ranking_mode == 2 || S_GAME.ranking_mode == 8 || S_GAME.ranking_mode == 10) {
    S_STAGECLEAR.make_screen_btnmenu();
    return
  }
  S_GAME.ranking_mode == 3 && S_STAGECLEAR.make_screen_btnmenu();
  for (var n = 1; n <= S_STAGECLEAR.ch_num; n++) STORAGE.data2[n].cur_level == STORAGE.data2[n].max_level ? $("#SC_ch" + n + "_expup").css({
    display: "none"
  }) : utilScale_xy_bottom("SC_ch" + n + "_expup", 1, S_STAGECLEAR.scale.cur);
  S_STAGECLEAR.scale.cur < S_STAGECLEAR.scale.end ? (S_STAGECLEAR.scale.cur += S_STAGECLEAR.scale.gap, setTimeout(S_STAGECLEAR.display_uparrow, S_STAGECLEAR.interval)) : (S_STAGECLEAR.char_levelup_display(), (S_GAME.is_sky_garden_mode() || S_GAME.is_pvp_mode()) && S_STAGECLEAR.make_screen_btnmenu())
};
