S_GUILD_JOIN.insert_search_box = function() {
  if (Main.use_android_bridge() && glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_KEYBOARD) S_NATIVE_KEYBOARD.open(S_GUILD_JOIN.input_search_str || "", function(n) {
    S_GUILD_JOIN.input_search_str = n == null ? "" : String(n);
    n ? util_draw_text_html(n, "GU_J_text_insert_search_box", 0, 0, 323, 44, 44, 25, "center", "#000000") : util_draw_text_html(TXT.guild_insert_search_box_hint, "GU_J_text_insert_search_box", 0, 0, 323, 44, 44, 25, "center", "#9e9590")
  }, function(n) {
    window.KR_INPUT && KR_INPUT.end && KR_INPUT.end();
    S_GUILD_JOIN.input_search_str = n == null ? "" : String(n);
    util_draw_text_html(S_GUILD_JOIN.input_search_str || TXT && TXT.guild_insert_search_box_hint || "", "GU_J_text_insert_search_box", 0, 0, 323, 44, 44, 25, "center", "#000000")
  });
  else {
    gEnableKey = 0;
    var t = S_GUILD_JOIN.input_result,
      n = {};
    n.lang = USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? "KOR" : "ENG";
    n.title = TXT.guild_insert_search_box_hint;
    g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = "KR_INPUT";
    KR_INPUT.init(t, null, 12, null, n);
    try {
      KR_INPUT.set_check_str(!1);
      KR_INPUT.set_special_char(!1)
    } catch (i) {
      console.log(i)
    }
    Main.remove_keydown_event_listener()
  }
};
S_GUILD_JOIN.input_result = function(n) {
  n != "_CLOSE" && (S_GUILD_JOIN.input_search_str = n, util_draw_text_html(S_GUILD_JOIN.input_search_str, "GU_J_text_insert_search_box", 0, 0, 323, 44, 44, 25, "center", "#000000"));
  KR_INPUT.end();
  $("#Img_GU_J_search_btn").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_GUILD_JOIN;
  setTimeout(function() {
    gEnableKey = 1
  }, 200);
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? (blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene), S_GUILD_JOIN.addMouseEvent(), $("#KR_INPUT_div").hide(), Main.add_keydown_event_listener()) : (document.body.onkeydown = Main.keyDown, (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene));
  S_GUILD_JOIN.search_guild()
};
S_GUILD_JOIN.search_guild = function(n) {
  typeof n == "undefined" && (n = null);
  var n = {
    search_str: S_GUILD_JOIN.input_search_str,
    sort_type: S_GUILD_SORT_LIST[S_GUILD_JOIN.sort_search_index],
    act: "get_guild_list"
  };
  ServerConnection.update_guild(n, "guild_inter", function(n) {
    switch (n.result) {
      case "ok":
        n && typeof n.data != "undefined" && n.data !== null ? (json_secure.set("guild_list", n.data), S_GUILD_JOIN.make_scroll_item()) : utilNotice("Error - No guild list data | " + n.comment, 1);
        break;
      case "error":
      default:
        utilNotice("Error - GLD e | " + n.comment, 1)
    }
  })
};
S_GUILD_JOIN.run_sort_cut = function(n) {
  S_GUILD_JOIN.sort_search_index = n;
  S_GUILD_JOIN.search_guild()
};
S_GUILD_JOIN.focus_none_all = function() {
  for (var t, n = 0; n < S_GUILD_JOIN_SHORT_CUT.length; n++) $("#GU_J_short_cut_focus_" + S_GUILD_JOIN_SHORT_CUT[n]).hide();
  if ($("#Img_GU_J_insert_search_box_focus").hide(), $("#Img_GU_J_search_btn_focus").hide(), $("#Img_GU_J_search_init_btn_focus").hide(), $("#GU_J_back_focus").hide(), $("#Img_GU_J_scroll_left_focus").hide(), $("#Img_GU_J_scroll_right_focus").hide(), t = json_secure.get("guild_list"), t)
    for (n = 0; n < t.length; n++) $("#GU_J_scroll_item_focus_" + n).hide()
};
S_GUILD_JOIN.drawFocus = function() {
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  S_GUILD_JOIN.focus_none_all();
  switch (S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn) {
    case "insert_search_box":
      $("#Img_GU_J_insert_search_box_focus").show();
      break;
    case "search_button":
      $("#Img_GU_J_search_btn_focus").show();
      break;
    case "search_init_button":
      $("#Img_GU_J_search_init_btn_focus").show();
      break;
    case "scroll_left_button":
      $("#Img_GU_J_scroll_left_focus").show();
      break;
    case "scroll_right_button":
      $("#Img_GU_J_scroll_right_focus").show();
      break;
    case "back_button":
      $("#GU_J_back_focus").show();
      break;
    case "join_button":
      $("#GU_J_scroll_item_focus_" + S_GUILD_JOIN.list_index).show();
      break;
    default:
      for (var n = 0; n < S_GUILD_JOIN_SHORT_CUT.length; n++)
        if (S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn == S_GUILD_JOIN_SHORT_CUT[n]) {
          $("#GU_J_short_cut_focus_" + S_GUILD_JOIN_SHORT_CUT[n]).show();
          break
        }
  }
};
S_GUILD_JOIN.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn) {
    case "insert_search_box":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_J_insert_search_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "search_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_GU_J_search_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "search_init_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_GU_J_search_init_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "back_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_J_back_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "scroll_left_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_J_scroll_left", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "scroll_right_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_J_scroll_right", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "sort_random":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_J_sort_random_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "sort_latest":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_J_short_cut_btn_sort_latest", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "sort_member_desc":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_J_short_cut_btn_sort_member_desc", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "sort_member_asc":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_J_short_cut_btn_sort_member_asc", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "sort_guild_free":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_J_short_cut_btn_sort_guild_free", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "sort_guild_approve":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_J_short_cut_btn_sort_guild_approve", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "join_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_J_scroll_item_join_btn_" + S_GUILD_JOIN.list_index, gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center_classid("button", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_GUILD_JOIN.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_GUILD_JOIN.menuRun_Run = function() {
  var i, n, t;
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_EXITPOPUP) {
    utilPush();
    S_GUILD_JOIN.end();
    switch (S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn) {
      case "insert_search_box":
        S_GUILD_JOIN.insert_search_box();
        break;
      case "search_button":
        S_GUILD_JOIN.search_guild();
        break;
      case "search_init_button":
        S_GUILD_JOIN.input_search_str = "";
        util_draw_text_html(TXT.guild_insert_search_box_hint, "GU_J_text_insert_search_box", 0, 0, 323, 44, 44, 25, "center", "#9e9590");
        S_GUILD_JOIN.search_guild();
        break;
      case "back_button":
        S_GUILD_JOIN.run_back();
        break;
      case "scroll_left_button":
        S_GUILD_JOIN.move_page(-1);
        break;
      case "scroll_right_button":
        S_GUILD_JOIN.move_page(1);
        break;
      case "sort_random":
      case "sort_latest":
      case "sort_member_desc":
      case "sort_member_asc":
      case "sort_guild_free":
      case "sort_guild_approve":
        i = {
          sort_random: 0,
          sort_latest: 1,
          sort_member_desc: 2,
          sort_member_asc: 3,
          sort_guild_free: 4,
          sort_guild_approve: 5
        };
        S_GUILD_JOIN.run_sort_cut(i[S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn]);
        break;
      case "join_button":
        n = json_secure.get("guild_list")[S_GUILD_JOIN.list_index];
        n = typeof n == "string" ? JSON.parse(n) : n;
        n.guild_type = n.guild_type == 1 ? "free" : "approve";
        S_GUILD_JOIN.focus_none_all();
        t = {
          popup_type: "join",
          popup_title: TXT.guild_name + " : " + n.guild_name,
          popup_des: n.guild_type == "free" ? TXT.guild_join_free_des : TXT.guild_join_apprve_des,
          guild_type: n.guild_type,
          guild_name: n.guild_name,
          bar_bool: !1,
          one_btn: !1
        };
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP, S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP, null, null, t)
    }
    S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn == "join_button" ? (n = json_secure.get("guild_list")[S_GUILD_JOIN.list_index], n = typeof n == "string" ? JSON.parse(n) : n, n.guild_type = n.guild_type == 1 ? "free" : "approve", S_GUILD_JOIN.focus_none_all(), t = {
      popup_type: "join",
      popup_title: TXT.guild_name + " : " + n.guild_name,
      popup_des: n.guild_type == "free" ? TXT.guild_join_free_des : TXT.guild_join_apprve_des,
      guild_type: n.guild_type,
      guild_name: n.guild_name,
      bar_bool: !1,
      one_btn: !1
    }, ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP, S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP, null, null, t)) : S_GUILD_JOIN.row_focus == 1 ? S_GUILD_JOIN.btn_focus == 1 || S_GUILD_JOIN.btn_focus == 2 : S_GUILD_JOIN.row_focus == 2 ? S_GUILD_JOIN.btn_focus == 1 : S_GUILD_JOIN.row_focus == 3 ? S_GUILD_JOIN.btn_focus == 1 && S_GUILD_JOIN.move_page(1) : S_GUILD_JOIN.row_focus == 4 && (S_GUILD_JOIN.btn_focus == 1 || S_GUILD_JOIN.btn_focus >= 2 && S_GUILD_JOIN.btn_focus <= 1 + S_GUILD_SORT_LIST.length)
  }
};
S_GUILD_JOIN.end = function() {
  S_GUILD_JOIN.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_GUILD_JOIN.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_GUILD_JOIN.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover).mouseout(this.onMouseout)))
};
S_GUILD_JOIN.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover").unbind("mouseout")
};
S_GUILD_JOIN.onClick = function(n) {
  var t, i, r;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (t = n.changedTouches && n.changedTouches.length > 0 ? n.changedTouches[0].target : n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } switch (!0) {
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "insert_search_box"):
        S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn = "insert_search_box";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "insert_search"):
        S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn = "search_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "init_search"):
        S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn = "search_init_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "scroll_left"):
        S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn = "scroll_left_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "scroll_right"):
        S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn = "scroll_right_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "back_button"):
        S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn = "back_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "join_button"):
        for (S_GUILD_JOIN.is_list_item_focus = !0, S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn = "join_button", t = n.target; t;) {
          if (t.id && t.id.indexOf("GU_J_scroll_item_join_btn_") === 0) break;
          t = t.parentNode
        }
        if (!t || !t.id) break;
        if (i = t.id.substring(t.id.lastIndexOf("_") + 1), i = parseInt(i, 10), isNaN(i)) break;
        S_GUILD_JOIN.list_index = i;
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "short_cut_button"):
        for (r = 0; r < S_GUILD_JOIN_SHORT_CUT.length; r++)
          if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, S_GUILD_JOIN_SHORT_CUT[r])) {
            S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn = S_GUILD_JOIN_SHORT_CUT[r];
            break
          }
    }
    S_GUILD_JOIN.menuRun()
  }
};
S_GUILD_JOIN.onMouseover = function(n) {
  var t, i, r;
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    utilConsoleLog("1-onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
    switch (!0) {
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "insert_search_box"):
        S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn = "insert_search_box";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "insert_search"):
        S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn = "search_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "init_search"):
        S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn = "search_init_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "scroll_left"):
        S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn = "scroll_left_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "scroll_right"):
        S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn = "scroll_right_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "back_button"):
        S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn = "back_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "join_button"):
        for (S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn = "join_button", t = n.target; t;) {
          if (t.id && t.id.indexOf("GU_J_scroll_item_join_btn_") === 0) break;
          t = t.parentNode
        }
        if (!t || !t.id) break;
        if (i = t.id.substring(t.id.lastIndexOf("_") + 1), i = parseInt(i, 10), isNaN(i)) break;
        S_GUILD_JOIN.list_index = i;
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "short_cut_button"):
        for (r = 0; r < S_GUILD_JOIN_SHORT_CUT.length; r++)
          if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, S_GUILD_JOIN_SHORT_CUT[r])) {
            S_GUILD_JOIN.cur_btn = S_GUILD_JOIN_SHORT_CUT[r];
            break
          }
    }
    S_GUILD_JOIN.drawFocus()
  }
};
S_GUILD_JOIN.onMouseover_pressed = function(n, t, i, r) {
  Main.onMouseover_pressed(n, t, i, r)
};
S_GUILD_JOIN.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GUILD_JOIN.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_GUILD_JOIN.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_GUILD_JOIN.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GUILD_JOIN.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_GUILD_JOIN.onMouseover(n);
  S_GUILD_JOIN.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_GUILD_JOIN.run_back = function(n) {
  typeof n != "boolean" && (n = !0);
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_GUILD_JOIN.backKey(n)
};

S_GUILD_CREATE.define = function() {
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene !== gS_GUILD_FLAG && (S_GUILD_CREATE.guild_type = "free", S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str = "");
  S_GUILD_CREATE.guild_name_final_str = "";
  S_GUILD_CREATE.is_guild_name_check = !1;
  S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "insert_name_button"
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      switch (S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn) {
        case "confirm_button":
          S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "insert_name_button";
          break;
        case "type_free_button":
          S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "flag_change_button";
          break;
        case "type_approve_button":
          S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "type_free_button";
          break;
        case "create_button":
          S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "back_button"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      switch (S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn) {
        case "insert_name_button":
          S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "confirm_button";
          break;
        case "flag_change_button":
          S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "type_free_button";
          break;
        case "type_free_button":
          S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "type_approve_button";
          break;
        case "back_button":
          S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "create_button"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      switch (S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn) {
        case "flag_change_button":
        case "type_free_button":
        case "type_approve_button":
          S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "insert_name_button";
          break;
        case "back_button":
        case "create_button":
          S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "type_free_button"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      switch (S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn) {
        case "insert_name_button":
        case "confirm_button":
          S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "type_free_button";
          break;
        case "flag_change_button":
        case "type_free_button":
        case "type_approve_button":
          S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "create_button"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_GUILD_CREATE.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_GUILD_CREATE.run_back()
  }
  S_GUILD_CREATE.drawFocus()
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.interval_check_init = function() {
  var n, i, r, t;
  n = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? new Date(parseInt(window.g.timestamp_start, 0) + parseInt(window.g.timestamp_due, 0)) : new Date;
  i = n.getDay();
  i == 1 && (r = n.getHours(), t = n.getMinutes(), parseInt(r) == 5 && 0 <= parseInt(t, 10) && parseInt(t, 10) <= 3 && (STORAGE.quest_init(), utilNotice(TXT.quest_init, 1.5), g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_QUESTDETAIL ? S_QUESTDETAIL.init() : g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_QUEST && S_GUILD_CREATE.init(), glo.pvp.init_my_ranking_score()));
  setTimeout(S_GUILD_CREATE.interval_check_init, 6e4)
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.backKey = function(n) {

  $("#S_GUILD_CREATE_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  n && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_ENTER, S_GUILD_ENTER)
};

S_GUILD_CREATE.set_flag_define = function() {
  if (S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color == "") {
    var n = "red",
      t = 1,
      i = 1;
    S_GUILD_CREATE.flag_data.flagImg = "flag_" + n + t + ".png";
    S_GUILD_CREATE.flag_data.symbolImg = "flagsymbol" + i + ".png";
    S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color = n;
    S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape = t;
    S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol = i;
    S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color_focus = n;
    S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape_focus = t;
    S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol_focus = i
  }
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.set_guild_type = function(n) {
  (n == "free" || n == "approve") && (S_GUILD_CREATE.guild_type = n, n == "free" ? ($("#Img_GU_C_guild_type_check_free").css({
    display: "block"
  }), $("#Img_GU_C_guild_type_check_approve").css({
    display: "none"
  })) : n == "approve" && ($("#Img_GU_C_guild_type_check_free").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_GU_C_guild_type_check_approve").css({
    display: "block"
  })))
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.insert_search_box = function() {
  if (Main.use_android_bridge() && glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_KEYBOARD) S_NATIVE_KEYBOARD.open(S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str || "", function(n) {
    S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str = n == null ? "" : String(n);
    S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str = S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str.replace(/\s+/g, "");
    n ? util_draw_text_html(n, "GU_C_text_insert_guild_name", 0, 0, 323, 44, 44, 25, "center", "#000000") : util_draw_text_html(TXT.guild_insert_search_box_hint, "GU_C_text_insert_guild_name", 0, 0, 323, 44, 44, 25, "center", "#af9180")
  }, function(n) {
    window.KR_INPUT && KR_INPUT.end && KR_INPUT.end();
    S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str = n == null ? "" : String(n);
    S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str = S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str.replace(/\s+/g, "");
    util_draw_text_html(S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str || TXT && TXT.guild_insert_search_box_hint || "", "GU_C_text_insert_guild_name", 0, 0, 323, 44, 44, 25, "center", "#000000")
  });
  else {
    gEnableKey = 0;
    var t = S_GUILD_CREATE.input_result,
      i = S_GUILD_CREATE.guild_name_min_length,
      n = {};
    n.lang = USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? "KOR" : "ENG";
    n.title = TXT.guild_insert_name_hint;
    g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = "KR_INPUT";
    KR_INPUT.init(t, null, 10, null, n, i);
    try {
      KR_INPUT.set_special_char(!1)
    } catch (r) {
      console.log(r)
    }
    Main.remove_keydown_event_listener()
  }
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.input_result = function(n) {
  n == "_INIT" ? (S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str = "", util_draw_text_html(TXT.guild_insert_name_hint, "GU_C_text_insert_guild_name", 0, 0, 323, 44, 44, 25, "center", "#af9180")) : n != "_CLOSE" && (S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str = n, S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str = S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str.replace(/\s+/g, ""), util_draw_text_html(S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str, "GU_C_text_insert_guild_name", 0, 0, 323, 44, 44, 25, "center", "#000000"));
  KR_INPUT.end();
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_GUILD_CREATE;
  setTimeout(function() {
    gEnableKey = 1
  }, 200);
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? (blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene), S_GUILD_CREATE.addMouseEvent(), $("#KR_INPUT_div").hide(), Main.add_keydown_event_listener()) : (document.body.onkeydown = Main.keyDown, (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene))
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.run_confirm_guild_name = function() {
  if (S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str.length < S_GUILD_CREATE.guild_name_min_length) {
    utilNotice(TXT.guild_name_min_length.replace("^0", S_GUILD_CREATE.guild_name_min_length), 2);
    return
  }
  var n = {
    guild_name: String(S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str || "").replace(/\s+/g, ""),
    act: "check_guild_name"
  };
  ServerConnection.update_guild(n, "guild_inter", function(n) {
    switch (n.result) {
      case "ok":
        S_GUILD_CREATE.is_guild_name_check = !0;
        S_GUILD_CREATE.guild_name_final_str = S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str;
        utilNotice(TXT.guild_name_check_ok, 2);
        break;
      case "duplication":
        n && typeof n.data != "undefined" && n.data !== null ? n.data == "error" ? utilNotice("Error - CGN e | " + n.comment, 1) : utilNotice(TXT.guild_name_duplication, 2) : utilNotice(TXT.guild_name_duplication, 2);
        break;
      case "str_not_allowed":
        utilNotice(TXT.str_not_allowed, 2);
        break;
      case "long":
        utilNotice(TXT.input_text_over, 2);
        break;
      case "error":
      default:
        utilNotice("Error - CGN e | " + n.comment, 1)
    }
  })
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.focus_none_all = function() {
  $("#Img_GU_C_insert_guild_name_focus").hide();
  $("#GU_C_confirm_focus").hide();
  $("#GU_C_flag_change_focus").hide();
  $("#Img_GU_C_guild_type_check_free_focus").hide();
  $("#Img_GU_C_guild_type_check_approve_focus").hide();
  $("#GU_C_back_focus").hide();
  $("#GU_C_create_focus").hide()
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.drawFocus = function() {
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  S_GUILD_CREATE.focus_none_all();
  switch (S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn) {
    case "insert_name_button":
      $("#Img_GU_C_insert_guild_name_focus").show();
      break;
    case "confirm_button":
      $("#GU_C_confirm_focus").show();
      break;
    case "flag_change_button":
      $("#GU_C_flag_change_focus").show();
      break;
    case "type_free_button":
      $("#Img_GU_C_guild_type_check_free_focus").show();
      break;
    case "type_approve_button":
      $("#Img_GU_C_guild_type_check_approve_focus").show();
      break;
    case "back_button":
      $("#GU_C_back_focus").show();
      break;
    case "create_button":
      $("#GU_C_create_focus").show()
  }
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn) {
    case "insert_name_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_C_insert_guild_name", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "confirm_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_C_confirm", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "flag_change_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_C_flag_change", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "type_free_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_C_guild_type_free", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "type_approve_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_C_guild_type_free", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "back_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_C_back_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "create_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_C_create_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center_classid("button", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_GUILD_CREATE.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_EXITPOPUP) {
    utilPush();
    S_GUILD_CREATE.end();
    switch (S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn) {
      case "insert_name_button":
        S_GUILD_CREATE.insert_search_box();
        break;
      case "confirm_button":
        S_GUILD_CREATE.run_confirm_guild_name();
        break;
      case "flag_change_button":
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_FLAG, S_GUILD_FLAG);
        break;
      case "type_free_button":
        S_GUILD_CREATE.set_guild_type("free");
        break;
      case "type_approve_button":
        S_GUILD_CREATE.set_guild_type("approve");
        break;
      case "back_button":
        S_GUILD_CREATE.input_guild_name_str = "";
        S_GUILD_CREATE.run_back();
        break;
      case "create_button":
        if (!S_GUILD_CREATE.is_guild_name_check) {
          utilNotice(TXT.guild_need_name_check, 2);
          return
        }
        if (S_GUILD_CREATE.guild_name_final_str == "") {
          utilNotice(TXT.guild_need_name_check, 2);
          return
        }
        S_GUILD_CREATE.focus_none_all();
        var n = {
          popup_type: "create",
          popup_title: TXT.guild_create_title,
          popup_des: TXT.guild_create_popup_des.replace("^0", utilGetNumber_withComma(S_GUILD_CREATE.CREATE_RUBY_COST)),
          guild_type: S_GUILD_CREATE.guild_type,
          guild_name: S_GUILD_CREATE.guild_name_final_str,
          bar_bool: !0,
          one_btn: !1
        };
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP, S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP, null, null, n)
    }
  }
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.end = function() {
  S_GUILD_CREATE.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_GUILD_CREATE.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover).mouseout(this.onMouseout)))
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover").unbind("mouseout")
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.changedTouches && n.changedTouches.length > 0 ? n.changedTouches[0].target : n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } switch (!0) {
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "insert_name"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "insert_name_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "confirm"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "confirm_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "flag_change"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "flag_change_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "free_type"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "type_free_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "approve_type"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "type_approve_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "back_button"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "back_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "create_button"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "create_button"
    }
    S_GUILD_CREATE.menuRun()
  }
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    utilConsoleLog("1-onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
    switch (!0) {
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "insert_name"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "insert_name_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "confirm"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "confirm_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "flag_change"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "flag_change_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "free_type"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "type_free_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "approve_type"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "type_approve_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "back_button"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "back_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "create_button"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE.cur_btn = "create_button"
    }
    S_GUILD_CREATE.drawFocus()
  }
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.onMouseover_pressed = function(n, t, i, r) {
  Main.onMouseover_pressed(n, t, i, r)
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GUILD_CREATE.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_GUILD_CREATE.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_GUILD_CREATE.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GUILD_CREATE.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_GUILD_CREATE.onMouseover(n);
  S_GUILD_CREATE.onClick(n);
  return
};

  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_GUILD_CREATE.backKey(n)
};

S_GUILD_FLAG.define = function() {
  S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color_focus = S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color;
  S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape_focus = S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape;
  S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol_focus = S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var l = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    u;
  switch (l) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      switch (S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn) {
        case "color_session":
          u = glo.fun.get_index_by_value(S_GUILD_FLAG_COLOR, S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color_focus);
          u > 0 && (S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color_focus = S_GUILD_FLAG_COLOR[u - 1]);
          break;
        case "shape_session":
          if (S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape_focus > 1) {
            S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape_focus--;
            var i = S_GUILD_FLAG._get_ctx("shape"),
              f = i.width + i.gap,
              e = S_GUILD_FLAG[i.cur_x],
              o = Math.floor(Math.abs(e) / f) + 1;
            S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape_focus < o && S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_one_step("shape", S_GUILD_FLAG.DIR_RIGHT)
          }
          break;
        case "symbol_session":
          if (S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol_focus > 1) {
            S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol_focus--;
            var r = S_GUILD_FLAG._get_ctx("symbol"),
              s = r.width + r.gap,
              h = S_GUILD_FLAG[r.cur_x],
              c = Math.floor(Math.abs(h) / s) + 1;
            S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol_focus < c && S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_one_step("symbol", S_GUILD_FLAG.DIR_RIGHT)
          }
          break;
        case "change_button":
          S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "back_button"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      switch (S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn) {
        case "color_session":
          u = glo.fun.get_index_by_value(S_GUILD_FLAG_COLOR, S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color_focus);
          u < S_GUILD_FLAG_COLOR.length - 1 && (S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color_focus = S_GUILD_FLAG_COLOR[u + 1]);
          break;
        case "shape_session":
          if (S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape_focus < S_GUILD_FLAG_SHAPE) {
            S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape_focus++;
            var i = S_GUILD_FLAG._get_ctx("shape"),
              f = i.width + i.gap,
              e = S_GUILD_FLAG[i.cur_x],
              o = Math.floor(Math.abs(e) / f) + 1,
              a = o + i.onScreen - 1;
            S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape_focus > a && S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_one_step("shape", S_GUILD_FLAG.DIR_LEFT)
          }
          break;
        case "symbol_session":
          if (S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol_focus < S_GUILD_FLAG_SYMBOL) {
            S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol_focus++;
            var r = S_GUILD_FLAG._get_ctx("symbol"),
              s = r.width + r.gap,
              h = S_GUILD_FLAG[r.cur_x],
              c = Math.floor(Math.abs(h) / s) + 1,
              v = c + r.onScreen - 1;
            S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol_focus > v && S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_one_step("symbol", S_GUILD_FLAG.DIR_LEFT)
          }
          break;
        case "back_button":
          S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "change_button"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      switch (S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn) {
        case "shape_session":
          S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "color_session";
          break;
        case "symbol_session":
          S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "shape_session";
          break;
        case "back_button":
        case "change_button":
          S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "symbol_session"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      switch (S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn) {
        case "color_session":
          S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "shape_session";
          break;
        case "shape_session":
          S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "symbol_session";
          break;
        case "symbol_session":
          S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "back_button"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_GUILD_FLAG.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_GUILD_FLAG.run_back()
  }
  S_GUILD_FLAG.drawFocus()
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.interval_check_init = function() {
  var n, i, r, t;
  n = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? new Date(parseInt(window.g.timestamp_start, 0) + parseInt(window.g.timestamp_due, 0)) : new Date;
  i = n.getDay();
  i == 1 && (r = n.getHours(), t = n.getMinutes(), parseInt(r) == 5 && 0 <= parseInt(t, 10) && parseInt(t, 10) <= 3 && (STORAGE.quest_init(), utilNotice(TXT.quest_init, 1.5), g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_QUESTDETAIL ? S_QUESTDETAIL.init() : g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_QUEST && S_GUILD_FLAG.init(), glo.pvp.init_my_ranking_score()));
  setTimeout(S_GUILD_FLAG.interval_check_init, 6e4)
};

S_GUILD_FLAG.show_hide_sub_rewrard_ticket = function() {

};
S_GUILD_FLAG.get_all_reward = function() {
  for (var r, f, n = 0, t = 0, u = 1, i = 1; i <= QUEST_NUM; i++)
    for (r = 1; r <= QUEST[i].num; r++) QUEST[i].arrive[r] == 1 && (n += QUEST[i].r_ruby[r], t += QUEST[i].r_gold[r], QUEST[i].arrive[r] = 2);
  if (glo.APP_FEATURE.PACKAGE_STORE && glo.package.get_is_subscribe() == "yes" && (u = glo.package.get_sub_mul(), n = n * u, t = t * u), utilConsoleLog("tot_ruby = " + n), utilConsoleLog("tot_gold = " + t), n == 0 && t == 0) {
    utilNotice(TXT.quest_not_all_reward, 2);
    return
  }
  utilNotice(TXT.quest_all_reward_noti + "(" + TXT.ruby + " : " + n + TXT.quest_count + " " + TXT.quest_reward_gold + " : " + utilGetNumber_withComma(t + "") + ")", 2);
  n > 0 && (S_MAINMENU.make_screen_top_add_ruby(n, !0), save_UserInfo_after_pay_to_server(n, "업적보상모두받기(루비)"));
  t > 0 && S_MAINMENU.make_screen_top_add_gold(t, "업적보상모두받기(골드)", !0);
  loading_show("업적모두받기", 1);
  f = "업적모두받기(" + n + "루비," + t + "골드)|RUBY|" + n + "|" + USER.ruby + "|GOLD|" + t + "|" + USER.gold;
  update_quest_to_server(STORAGE.get_saved_quest_data(), f, function() {
    loading_hide("업적모두받기", 1);
    $("#S_QUEST_div").empty();
    S_GUILD_FLAG.init()
  })
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.focus_none_all = function() {
  for (var n = 0; n < S_GUILD_FLAG_COLOR.length; n++) $("#GU_F_flag_color_" + S_GUILD_FLAG_COLOR[n] + "_focus").hide();
  for (n = 1; n <= S_GUILD_FLAG_SHAPE; n++) $("#GU_F_flag_shape_" + n + "_focus").hide();
  for (n = 1; n <= S_GUILD_FLAG_SYMBOL; n++) $("#GU_F_flag_symbol_" + n + "_focus").hide();
  $("#GU_F_back_focus").hide();
  $("#GU_F_change_focus").hide()
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.drawFocus = function() {
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  S_GUILD_FLAG.focus_none_all();
  switch (S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn) {
    case "color_session":
      $("#GU_F_flag_color_" + S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color_focus + "_focus").show();
      break;
    case "shape_session":
      $("#GU_F_flag_shape_" + S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape_focus + "_focus").show();
      break;
    case "symbol_session":
      $("#GU_F_flag_symbol_" + S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol_focus + "_focus").show();
      break;
    case "back_button":
      $("#GU_F_back_focus").show();
      break;
    case "change_button":
      $("#GU_F_change_focus").show()
  }
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.drawFocus_btnmenu = function() {
  for (var n = 1; n <= S_GUILD_FLAG.card_num; n++) $("#QU_card_focus_" + n).css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_GUILD_FLAG.btn_focus == 1 ? ($("#Img_QU_back_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }), $("#Img_QU_get_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  })) : ($("#Img_QU_back_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_QU_get_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }))
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_GUILD_FLAG.btn_focus) {
    case 1:
      utilScale_xy_center("GE_menu1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 2:
      utilScale_xy_center("GE_menu2", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 3:
      utilScale_xy_center("GE_back_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 4:
      utilScale_xy_center("GE_ranking_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("GE_menu1", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("GE_menu2", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("GE_back_btn", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("GE_ranking_btn", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_GUILD_FLAG.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_EXITPOPUP) {
    utilPush();
    S_GUILD_FLAG.end();
    switch (S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn) {
      case "color_session":
      case "shape_session":
      case "symbol_session":
        S_GUILD_FLAG.refresh_flag();
        break;
      case "back_button":
        S_GUILD_FLAG.run_back();
        break;
      case "change_button":
        S_GUILD_FLAG.set_flag();
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_CREATE, S_GUILD_CREATE)
    }
  }
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.set_flag = function() {
  S_GUILD_CREATE.flag_data.flagImg = "flag_" + S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color + S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape + ".png";
  S_GUILD_CREATE.flag_data.symbolImg = "flagsymbol" + S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol + ".png"
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.refresh_flag = function() {
  for (var n = 1; n <= S_GUILD_FLAG_SHAPE; n++) utilDrawImage("GU_F_flag_shape_" + n, S_GUILD_FLAG.img_url + "flag_" + S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color_focus + n + ".png", 11, 20, 77, 80, "absolute");
  if (utilDrawImage("GU_F_flag_shape", S_GUILD_FLAG.img_url + "flag_" + S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color_focus + S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape_focus + ".png", 0, 0, 225, 234, "absolute"), utilDrawImage("GU_F_flag_symbol", S_GUILD_FLAG.img_url + "flagsymbol" + S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol_focus + ".png", 57, 37, 112, 118, "absolute"), S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn == "color_session") {
    for (n = 0; n < S_GUILD_FLAG_COLOR.length; n++) $("#GU_F_flag_color_" + S_GUILD_FLAG_COLOR[n] + "_check").hide();
    $("#GU_F_flag_color_" + S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color_focus + "_check").show();
    S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color = S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color_focus
  } else if (S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn == "shape_session") {
    for (n = 1; n <= S_GUILD_FLAG_SHAPE; n++) $("#GU_F_flag_shape_" + n + "_check").hide();
    $("#GU_F_flag_shape_" + S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape_focus + "_check").show();
    S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape = S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape_focus
  } else if (S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn == "symbol_session") {
    for (n = 1; n <= S_GUILD_FLAG_SYMBOL; n++) $("#GU_F_flag_symbol_" + n + "_check").hide();
    $("#GU_F_flag_symbol_" + S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol_focus + "_check").show();
    S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol = S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol_focus
  }
};
S_GUILD_FLAG._get_ctx = function(n) {
  return n === "shape" ? {
    cur_x: "scroll_shape_cur_x",
    target_x: "scroll_shape_target_x",
    num: S_GUILD_FLAG_SHAPE,
    onScreen: 8,
    domId: "#GU_F_flag_shape_wrap",
    width: 99,
    height: 118,
    gap: 13,
    pad_x: 6,
    pad_y: 6
  } : n === "symbol" ? {
    cur_x: "scroll_symbol_cur_x",
    target_x: "scroll_symbol_target_x",
    num: S_GUILD_FLAG_SYMBOL,
    onScreen: 8,
    domId: "#GU_F_flag_symbol_wrap",
    width: 99,
    height: 94,
    gap: 13,
    pad_x: 6,
    pad_y: 6
  } : null
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.init_scroll_by_value = function(n, t) {
  var i = S_GUILD_FLAG._get_ctx(n),
    f, u, e, r;
  i && (i.num <= i.onScreen || (f = i.width + i.gap, u = i.num - i.onScreen, e = t - 1 <= u ? t - 1 : u, r = -f * e, r = Math.round(r), S_GUILD_FLAG[i.cur_x] = r, S_GUILD_FLAG[i.target_x] = r, $(i.domId).css({
    left: r + i.pad_x + "px"
  })))
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.mousedrag = function(n, t) {
  var i = S_GUILD_FLAG._get_ctx(n),
    r;
  i && (S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_flag = 0, S_GUILD_FLAG[i.cur_x] = S_GUILD_FLAG[i.target_x]), r = S_GUILD_FLAG.drag_move(n, t), r) && (S_GUILD_FLAG[i.target_x] = r.target_x, S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_move(n, t))
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.drag_move = function(n, t) {
  var r = S_GUILD_FLAG._get_ctx(n),
    u, f;
  if (!r || S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_flag == 1 || r.num <= r.onScreen || (u = r.width + r.gap, f = S_GUILD_FLAG[r.cur_x], typeof f != "number")) return null;
  var o = 0,
    s = -u * (r.num - r.onScreen),
    i = r.onScreen - 1,
    e = f + u * i * t;
  return (e > o ? (i = Math.floor((o - f) / u), i < 0 && (i = 0), e = f + u * i * t) : e < s && (i = Math.floor((f - s) / u), i < 0 && (i = 0), e = f + u * i * t), i <= 0) ? null : {
    move: i,
    target_x: e
  }
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_move = function(n, t) {
  var i = S_GUILD_FLAG._get_ctx(n),
    e;
  if (i) {
    S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_flag = 1;
    gEnableKey = 0;
    var f = i.width + i.gap,
      r = S_GUILD_FLAG[i.cur_x],
      u = S_GUILD_FLAG[i.target_x];
    r += S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_speed * (u - r);
    r = Math.round(r);
    S_GUILD_FLAG[i.cur_x] = r;
    $(i.domId).css({
      left: r + "px"
    });
    e = Math.abs(r - u) <= 1;
    e ? (u = Math.round(u / f) * f, S_GUILD_FLAG[i.cur_x] = u, $(i.domId).css({
      left: u + "px"
    }), S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_flag = 0, gEnableKey = 1) : setTimeout(function() {
      S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_move(n, t)
    }, 16)
  }
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_one_step = function(n, t) {
  var i = S_GUILD_FLAG._get_ctx(n);
  if (i) {
    var u = i.width + i.gap,
      o = S_GUILD_FLAG[i.cur_x],
      f = -u * (i.num - i.onScreen),
      e = 0,
      r = o + u * t;
    r > e && (r = e);
    r < f && (r = f);
    S_GUILD_FLAG[i.target_x] = r;
    S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_move(n, t)
  }
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.end = function() {
  S_GUILD_FLAG.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_GUILD_FLAG.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover).mouseout(this.onMouseout)))
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover").unbind("mouseout")
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.onClick = function(n) {
  var t, i, r, u;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (t = n.changedTouches && n.changedTouches.length > 0 ? n.changedTouches[0].target : n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } switch (!0) {
      case glo.fun.has_class(t, "flag_color"):
        i = glo.fun.get_index_by_class(t, S_GUILD_FLAG_COLOR, "color_");
        i !== -1 && (S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color_focus = S_GUILD_FLAG_COLOR[i], S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "color_session");
        S_GUILD_FLAG.refresh_flag();
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(t, "flag_shape"):
        r = glo.fun.get_index_by_class(t, S_GUILD_FLAG_SHAPE, "shape_");
        r !== -1 && (S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape_focus = r, S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "shape_session");
        S_GUILD_FLAG.refresh_flag();
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(t, "flag_symbol"):
        u = glo.fun.get_index_by_class(t, S_GUILD_FLAG_SYMBOL, "symbol_");
        u !== -1 && (S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol_focus = u, S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "symbol_session");
        S_GUILD_FLAG.refresh_flag();
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(t, "back_button"):
        S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "back_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(t, "change_button"):
        S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "change_button"
    }
    S_GUILD_FLAG.menuRun()
  }
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.onMouseover = function(n) {
  var t, i, r, u;
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    utilConsoleLog("1-onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
    t = n.target;
    switch (!0) {
      case glo.fun.has_class(t, "flag_color"):
        i = glo.fun.get_index_by_class(t, S_GUILD_FLAG_COLOR, "color_");
        i !== -1 && (S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_color_focus = S_GUILD_FLAG_COLOR[i], S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "color_session");
        S_GUILD_FLAG.refresh_flag();
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(t, "flag_shape"):
        r = glo.fun.get_index_by_class(t, S_GUILD_FLAG_SHAPE, "shape_");
        r !== -1 && (S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_shape_focus = r, S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "shape_session");
        S_GUILD_FLAG.refresh_flag();
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(t, "flag_symbol"):
        u = glo.fun.get_index_by_class(t, S_GUILD_FLAG_SYMBOL, "symbol_");
        u !== -1 && (S_GUILD_FLAG.flag_symbol_focus = u, S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "symbol_session");
        S_GUILD_FLAG.refresh_flag();
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(t, "back_button"):
        S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "back_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(t, "change_button"):
        S_GUILD_FLAG.cur_btn = "change_button"
    }
    S_GUILD_FLAG.drawFocus()
  }
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.onMouseover_pressed = function(n, t, i, r) {
  Main.onMouseover_pressed(n, t, i, r)
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GUILD_FLAG.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_GUILD_FLAG.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GUILD_FLAG.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_GUILD_FLAG.onMouseover(n);
  S_GUILD_FLAG.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.mousedrag_right_to_left = function() {
  if (S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_flag != 1) {
    var t = (S_GUILD_FLAG.card_w + S_GUILD_FLAG.card_gap) * (S_GUILD_FLAG.card_num - QUEST_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1,
      i = (S_GUILD_FLAG.card_w + S_GUILD_FLAG.card_gap) * (S_GUILD_FLAG.card_num - QUEST_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1 - S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_cur_x,
      r = Math.abs(Math.floor(i / (S_GUILD_FLAG.card_w + S_GUILD_FLAG.card_gap))),
      n = QUEST_NUM_ON_SCREEN - 1,
      u = S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_cur_x - (S_GUILD_FLAG.card_w + S_GUILD_FLAG.card_gap) * n;
    u < t && (n = r);
    S_GUILD_FLAG.focus < S_GUILD_FLAG.card_num && (S_GUILD_FLAG.focus = S_GUILD_FLAG.focus + n, S_GUILD_FLAG.drawFocus(), S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_cur_x = S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_target_x, S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_flag = 0), S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_target_x = S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_cur_x - (S_GUILD_FLAG.card_w + S_GUILD_FLAG.card_gap) * n, S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_right())
  }
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.mousedrag_left_to_right = function() {
  if (S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_flag != 1) {
    var i = 0,
      n = 4,
      t = S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_cur_x + (S_GUILD_FLAG.card_w + S_GUILD_FLAG.card_gap) * n;
    t > i && (n = 3, t = S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_cur_x + (S_GUILD_FLAG.card_w + S_GUILD_FLAG.card_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 2, t = S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_cur_x + (S_GUILD_FLAG.card_w + S_GUILD_FLAG.card_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 1, t = S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_cur_x + (S_GUILD_FLAG.card_w + S_GUILD_FLAG.card_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 0))));
    S_GUILD_FLAG.focus = S_GUILD_FLAG.focus - n;
    S_GUILD_FLAG.drawFocus();
    S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_cur_x = S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_target_x, S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_flag = 0);
    S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_target_x = S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_cur_x + (S_GUILD_FLAG.card_w + S_GUILD_FLAG.card_gap) * n;
    S_GUILD_FLAG.scroll_left()
  }
};
S_GUILD_FLAG.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_GUILD_FLAG.backKey()
};

  S_GUILD_FLAG.img_url = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("GUILD") + "image/ui/49_guild/"
};
glo.fun.add_img_url_initor(S_GUILD_FLAG.init_img_url);

S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.define = function() {
  S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.type = "";
  S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.popup_type = "";
  S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.guild_name = "";
  S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.cur_btn = "no_button";
  S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.tran_data = null
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      switch (S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.cur_btn) {
        case "no_button":
          S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.cur_btn = "ok_button"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      switch (S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.cur_btn) {
        case "ok_button":
          S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.cur_btn = "no_button"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_back()
  }
  S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.drawFocus()
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.back = function() {
  gEnableKey = 1;
  S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.end();
  switch (g_sceneinfo.before_scene) {
    case gS_GUILD_CREATE:
      S_GUILD_CREATE.drawFocus();
      break;
    case gS_GUILD_JOIN:
      S_GUILD_JOIN.drawFocus();
      break;
    case gS_GUILD_MAIN:
      if (S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.type == "type_change") {
        S_GUILD_MAIN.drawFocus();
        break
      }
      switch (S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.cur_btn) {
        case "no_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.drawFocus()
      }
      break;
    case gS_GUILD_DONATE:
      S_GUILD_DONATE.drawFocus()
  }
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP && (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = g_sceneinfo.before_scene);
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)
};

S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_buff_upgrade = function() {
  var n = json_secure.get("guild_data"),
    t;
  if (n != null) {
    if (n.guild_money < n.guild_buff_next_price) {
      utilNotice(TXT.guild_buff_not_enough_money, 2);
      return
    }
    t = {
      guild_name: n.guild_name,
      guild_money: n.guild_money,
      guild_buff_next_price: n.guild_buff_next_price,
      guild_buff_value: n.guild_buff_value,
      guild_buff_level: n.guild_buff_level,
      act: "update_guild_buff"
    };
    ServerConnection.update_guild(t, "guild_main", function(n) {
      if (n.result == "ok") {
        json_secure.set("guild_data", n.data);
        S_GUILD_MAIN.make_guild_info_screen();
        S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.end();
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_BUFF_LEVELUP_COMPLETE, S_GUILD_BUFF_LEVELUP_COMPLETE);
        return
      }
      utilNotice("Error - UGB e | " + n.result, 1)
    });
    S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_back()
  }
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_type_change = function() {
  var n = json_secure.get("guild_data"),
    t;
  n != null && glo.fun.set_ruby_gold("ruby", n.guild_type_change_ruby_value, "길드 속성 변경", !1) && (t = {
    guild_name: n.guild_name,
    cur_guild_type: n.guild_type,
    ruby_value: n.guild_type_change_ruby_value,
    act_detail: "change_guild_type",
    act: "update_guild_member"
  }, ServerConnection.update_guild(t, "guild_main", function(t) {
    var i, r;
    switch (t.result) {
      case "ok":
        glo.fun.set_ruby_gold("ruby", n.guild_type_change_ruby_value, "길드 속성 변경", !0);
        json_secure.set("guild_data", t.guild_data);
        t.member_data && json_secure.set("member_list", t.member_data);
        S_GUILD_MAIN.make_guild_info_screen();
        utilNotice(TXT.guild_type_change_done, 2);
        break;
      case "not_yet":
        t.guild_data && json_secure.set("guild_data", t.guild_data);
        S_GUILD_MAIN.make_guild_info_screen();
        i = Math.ceil((S_GUILD_MAIN.type_change_until - (new Date).getTime()) / 1e3);
        i > 0 ? utilNotice(TXT.guild_type_change_not_yet.replace("^0", S_GUILD_MAIN.get_type_change_remain_str(i)), 2) : utilNotice("Error - UGCT | " + t.result, 1);
        break;
      case "type_mismatch":
      case "disabled":
        t.guild_data && json_secure.set("guild_data", t.guild_data);
        S_GUILD_MAIN.make_guild_info_screen();
        break;
      case "price_changed":
        t.guild_data && json_secure.set("guild_data", t.guild_data);
        S_GUILD_MAIN.make_guild_info_screen();
        r = json_secure.get("guild_data");
        utilNotice(TXT.guild_type_change_price_changed.replace("^0", utilGetNumber_withComma(r != null ? r.guild_type_change_ruby_value : "")), 2);
        break;
      case "not_enough_ruby":
        utilNotice(TXT.goods_not_enough.replace("^0", USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? "루비" : "Ruby"), 2);
        break;
      default:
        utilNotice("Error - UGCT e | " + t.result, 1)
    }
  }), S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_back())
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_donate = function() {
  var n = json_secure.get("guild_data"),
    t = json_secure.get("guild_data_mine"),
    i = {
      guild_name: n.guild_name,
      cur_season_score: t.guild_season_score,
      plus_season_score: S_GUILD_DONATE_CONTRIBUTE_VALUE[S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.popup_type],
      cur_goldbar: USER.goldbar,
      plus_goldbar: S_GUILD_DONATE_GOLDBAR_VALUE[S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.popup_type],
      act_detail: S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.popup_type,
      act_value: S_GUILD_DONATE_VALUE[S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.popup_type],
      act: "update_member_donate"
    };
  ServerConnection.update_guild(i, "guild_main", function(n) {
    switch (n.result) {
      case "ok":
        json_secure.set("guild_data_mine", n.guild_data_mine);
        var t = S_GUILD_DONATE_VALUE[S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.popup_type],
          i = "";
        switch (S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.popup_type) {
          case "CLOUD":
            USER.cloud_piece = USER.cloud_piece - t;
            i = TXT.guild_donate_success.replace("^0", TXT.cloud_pieces);
            break;
          case "RUBY":
            USER.ruby = USER.ruby - t;
            glo.APP_FEATURE.RUBY_CRYPT && encoding_add_ruby(-t);
            i = TXT.guild_donate_success.replace("^0", TXT.ruby);
            break;
          case "GOLD":
            USER.gold = USER.gold - t;
            glo.APP_FEATURE.GOLD_CRYPT && encoding_add_gold(-t);
            i = TXT.guild_donate_success.replace("^0", TXT.gold2)
        }
        STORAGE.alldata_to_storage();
        S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.popup_type == "RUBY" && save_UserInfo_after_pay_to_server("-" + t, "길드기부 비용 지불", "길드기부:" + t + " 사용");
        utilNotice(i, 2);
        S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top();
        S_GUILD_DONATE.make_screen();
        S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_back();
        break;
      case "already":
        utilNotice(TXT.guild_donate_already_donate, 2);
        break;
      default:
        utilNotice("Error - DUG e | " + n.result, 1)
    }
    S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_back()
  })
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_create_guild = function() {
  if (glo.fun.set_ruby_gold("ruby", S_GUILD_CREATE.CREATE_RUBY_COST, "길드 창설 비용 지불", !1)) {
    var n = {
      guild_name: String(S_GUILD_CREATE.guild_name_final_str || "").replace(/\s+/g, ""),
      guild_type: S_GUILD_CREATE.guild_type,
      guild_flag: S_GUILD_CREATE.flag_data,
      act: "insert_new_guild"
    };
    ServerConnection.update_guild(n, "guild_inter", function(n) {
      switch (n.result) {
        case "ok":
          if (!glo.fun.set_ruby_gold("ruby", S_GUILD_CREATE.CREATE_RUBY_COST, "길드 창설 비용 지불", !0)) return;
          $("#S_GUILD_CREATE_div").remove();
          json_secure.set("guild_data", n.data);
          ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_MAIN, S_GUILD_MAIN);
          break;
        case "not_enough_ruby":
          utilNotice(TXT.goods_not_enough.replace("^0", USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? "루비" : "Ruby"), 2);
          break;
        case "no_user_name":
          utilNotice(TXT.guild_no_user_name, 2);
          break;
        case "str_not_allowed":
          utilNotice(TXT.str_not_allowed, 2);
          break;
        case "long":
          utilNotice(TXT.input_text_over, 2);
          break;
        case "already":
          utilNotice(TXT.guild_already_join_other_guild, 2);
          S_GUILD_CREATE.run_back(!1);
          S_GUILD_ENTER.run_back();
          break;
        default:
          utilNotice("Error - ING e | " + n.result, 1)
      }
      S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_back()
    })
  }
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_join_guild = function() {
  if (S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.guild_name == "") {
    utilNotice("Error", 2);
    return
  }
  var n = S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.popup_type == "free" ? "join_open_guild" : "join_approve_guild",
    t = {
      guild_name: S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.guild_name,
      act: n
    };
  ServerConnection.update_guild(t, "guild_inter", function(n) {
    if (S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.popup_type == "approve") {
      n.my_approve_cnt && S_GUILD_JOIN.set_my_approve_cnt(n.my_approve_cnt, !0);
      switch (n.result) {
        case "ok":
          utilNotice(TXT.guild_join_approve_success, 2);
          S_GUILD_JOIN.set_my_approve_cnt(n.my_approve_cnt, !0);
          break;
        case "already":
          utilNotice(TXT.guild_join_already_approve, 2);
          break;
        case "no_user_name":
          utilNotice(TXT.guild_no_user_name, 2);
          break;
        case "over":
          utilNotice(TXT.guild_approve_over, 2);
          break;
        case "full":
          utilNotice(TXT.guild_member_full, 2);
          break;
        case "duplication":
          utilNotice(TXT.guild_already_join_other_guild, 2);
          S_GUILD_JOIN.run_back(!1);
          S_GUILD_ENTER.run_back();
          break;
        default:
          utilNotice("Error - JAG e | " + n.result, 1)
      }
    } else if (S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.popup_type == "free") switch (n.result) {
      case "ok":
        $("#S_GUILD_JOIN_div").remove();
        json_secure.set("guild_data", n.data);
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_MAIN, S_GUILD_MAIN);
        break;
      case "full":
        utilNotice(TXT.guild_member_full, 2);
        break;
      case "duplication":
        utilNotice(TXT.guild_already_join_other_guild, 2);
        S_GUILD_JOIN.run_back(!1);
        S_GUILD_ENTER.run_back();
        break;
      case "no_user_name":
        utilNotice(TXT.guild_no_user_name, 2);
        break;
      case "not_yet":
        utilNotice(TXT.guild_kick, 2);
        S_GUILD_JOIN.run_back(!1);
        S_GUILD_ENTER.run_back();
        break;
      default:
        utilNotice("Error - JOG e | " + n.result, 1)
    }
    S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_back()
  })
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.focus_none_all = function() {
  $("#GU_CP_ok_focus").hide();
  $("#GU_CP_no_focus").hide()
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.drawFocus = function() {
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.focus_none_all();
  switch (S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.cur_btn) {
    case "ok_button":
      $("#GU_CP_ok_focus").show();
      break;
    case "no_button":
      $("#GU_CP_no_focus").show()
  }
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.cur_btn) {
    case "ok_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_CP_ok_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "no_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_CP_no_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center_classid("button", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.menuRun_Run = function() {
  Main.showSafeZone();
  switch (S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.cur_btn) {
    case "ok_button":
      switch (S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.type) {
        case "buff_upgrade":
          S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_buff_upgrade();
          break;
        case "donate":
          S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_donate();
          break;
        case "create":
          S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_create_guild();
          break;
        case "join":
          S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_join_guild();
          break;
        case "type_change":
          S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_type_change()
      }
      break;
    case "no_button":
      S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_back()
  }
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.end = function() {
  $("#S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP_div").remove();
  S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } switch (!0) {
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "ok_button"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.cur_btn = "ok_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "no_button"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.cur_btn = "no_button"
    }
    S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.menuRun()
  }
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    utilConsoleLog("S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id + "    gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey);
    switch (!0) {
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "ok_button"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.cur_btn = "ok_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "no_button"):
        S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.cur_btn = "no_button"
    }
    S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.drawFocus()
  }
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.onMouseover(n);
  S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP.back()
};

};

S_GUILD_MAIN.init = function() {
  var n, t;
  utilPush();
  n = {
    show_goldbar: !0
  };
  S_MAINMENU.remount_mm_top(this, TXT.guild, n);
  gEnableKey = 0;
  utilConsoleLog("S_GUILD_MAIN.init()");
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_GUILD_MAIN;
  $("#S_GUILD_CREATE_div").remove();
  $("#S_GUILD_ENTER_div").remove();
  S_GUILD_MAIN.define();
  S_GUILD_MAIN.maketag();
  S_GUILD_MAIN.make_screen();
  clearTimeout(S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_poll_timer);
  S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_poll_timer = setTimeout(S_GUILD_MAIN.load_chat_poll, 5e3);
  S_GUILD_MAIN.addMouseEvent();
  S_GUILD_MAIN.drawFocus();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  setTimeout(function() {
    gEnableKey = 1
  }, DEFINE.KEYLOCKTIME);
  S_GUILD_MAIN.is_guild_master && (t = {
    guild_name: json_secure.get("guild_data").guild_name,
    order_by: "NO",
    act: "get_approve_list"
  }, ServerConnection.update_guild(t, "guild_main", function(n) {
    switch (n.result) {
      case "ok":
        json_secure.set("approve_list", n.data);
        S_GUILD_MAIN.set_approve_alert(n.data);
        break;
      default:
        utilNotice("Error - GMAL e | " + n.comment, 1)
    }
  }))
};

S_GUILD_MAIN.define = function() {
  var n = json_secure.get("guild_data");
  n != null && (S_GUILD_MAIN.is_guild_master = n.guild_position == "MASTER" ? !0 : !1, S_GUILD_MAIN.prev_btn != "type_button" || S_GUILD_MAIN.is_type_change_focusable() || (S_GUILD_MAIN.prev_btn = "start_button"), S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = S_GUILD_MAIN.prev_btn)
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.is_type_change_on = function() {
  var n = json_secure.get("guild_data");
  return n == null ? !1 : glo.APP_FEATURE.GUILD_TYPE_CHANGE == 1 && n.guild_type_change_enable == 1
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.is_type_change_focusable = function() {
  return S_GUILD_MAIN.is_type_change_on() && S_GUILD_MAIN.is_guild_master
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_GUILD_MAIN.menu_type == "chat") {
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "chat_back_btn";
        break
      }
      if (S_GUILD_MAIN.menu_type != "help") switch (S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn) {
        case "right_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "left_button";
          break;
        case "chat_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "donate_button";
          break;
        case "donate_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "shop_button";
          break;
        case "shop_button":
          if (!glo.APP_FEATURE.TOUCH_PLATFORM) {
            S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "back_button";
            break
          }
          break;
        case "start_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "chat_button";
          break;
        case "buff_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "start_button";
          break;
        case "ranking_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = S_GUILD_MAIN.is_guild_master ? "buff_button" : "start_button";
          break;
        case "help_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "ranking_button";
          break;
        case "setting_menu_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "help_button"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_GUILD_MAIN.menu_type == "chat") {
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "chat_input_btn";
        break
      }
      if (S_GUILD_MAIN.menu_type != "help") switch (S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn) {
        case "left_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "right_button";
          break;
        case "buff_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "ranking_button";
          break;
        case "donate_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "chat_button";
          break;
        case "chat_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "start_button";
          break;
        case "back_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "shop_button";
          break;
        case "shop_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "donate_button";
          break;
        case "start_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = S_GUILD_MAIN.is_guild_master ? "buff_button" : "ranking_button";
          break;
        case "ranking_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "help_button";
          break;
        case "help_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "setting_menu_button"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      if (S_GUILD_MAIN.menu_type == "chat") {
        S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_scroll(-1);
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_MAIN.menu_type != "help") switch (S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn) {
        case "buff_button":
        case "donate_button":
        case "chat_button":
        case "back_button":
        case "shop_button":
        case "start_button":
        case "ranking_button":
        case "help_button":
        case "setting_menu_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = S_GUILD_MAIN.is_type_change_focusable() ? "type_button" : "left_button";
          break;
        case "type_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "left_button"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      if (S_GUILD_MAIN.menu_type == "chat") {
        S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_scroll(1);
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_MAIN.menu_type != "help") switch (S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn) {
        case "left_button":
        case "right_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = S_GUILD_MAIN.is_type_change_focusable() ? "type_button" : "start_button";
          break;
        case "type_button":
          S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "start_button"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_GUILD_MAIN.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_GUILD_MAIN.menu_type == "chat" ? S_GUILD_MAIN.show_chat_screen(!1) : S_GUILD_MAIN.menu_type == "help" ? S_GUILD_MAIN.show_help_screen(!1) : S_GUILD_MAIN.run_back()
  }
  S_GUILD_MAIN.drawFocus()
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.backKey = function() {
  if (S_GUILD_MAIN.menu_type === "chat") {
    S_GUILD_MAIN.show_chat_screen(!1);
    utilPush();
    return
  }
  clearTimeout(S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_poll_timer);
  S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_poll_timer = null;
  S_GUILD_MAIN.end();
  $("#S_GUILD_MAIN_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU)
};

S_GUILD_MAIN.parse_system_msg = function(n) {
  var t;
  try {
    t = typeof n == "string" ? JSON.parse(n) : n
  } catch (e) {
    return n
  }
  var i = USER.lang === LANG.KOREA,
    r = t.rank || "",
    u = t.score ? t.score.toLocaleString() : "",
    f = t.max_stage || "0";
  switch (t.type) {
    case "weekly_reward":
      return i ? "[길드전장] 이번 주 " + u + "점으로 " + r + "등! 보상 일괄 지급되었습니다." : "[Guild Battle] Ranked " + r + " with " + u + "pts this week! Reward distributed.";
    case "season_reward":
      return i ? "[길드시즌] 이번 시즌 " + u + "점으로 " + r + "위! 보상 일괄 지급되었습니다." : "[Guild Season] Ranked " + r + " with " + u + "pts this season! Reward distributed.";
    case "buff_upgrade":
      return i ? "[길드버프] Lv." + t.new_level + " 업그레이드 완료!" : "[Guild Buff] Upgrade to Lv." + t.new_level + "!";
    case "guild_boss_reward":
      return i ? "[길드보스] 이번 주 " + f + "단계까지 클리어! 보상 일괄 지급되었습니다." : "[Guild Boss] Cleared up to " + f + " stage! Reward distributed.";
    default:
      return n
  }
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.append_chat_line = function(n) {
  var t = $("#GU_M_chat_list_area").children().length,
    u, f, i;
  if ($("#GU_M_chat_list_area").append('<div id="GU_M_chatline_' + t + '"><\/div>'), $("#GU_M_chatline_" + t).css({
      position: "relative",
      left: "0px",
      width: "683px",
      "min-height": "30px",
      "font-size": "18rem",
      "line-height": "28px",
      padding: "1px 0px",
      "word-break": "break-all"
    }), n.type === "date") $("#GU_M_chatline_" + t).css({
    "text-align": "center",
    color: "#fef2df",
    position: "relative"
  }), $("#GU_M_chatline_" + t).html('<img id="Img_GU_M_chatline_' + t + '"><span style="position:relative;">' + n.text + "<\/span>"), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_GU_M_chatline_" + t, glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/49_guild/guild_chatline.png", 0, 0);
  else if (n.type === "system") u = S_GUILD_MAIN.parse_system_msg(n.etc), $("#GU_M_chatline_" + t).css({
    color: "#ff6060"
  }), $("#GU_M_chatline_" + t).text(u);
  else {
    var e = n.host_id == glo.fun.get_uniq_id(),
      o = glo.fun.set_mask_user_name(n.name, parse_platform_name_string(n.platform)),
      r = $("#GU_M_chatline_" + t);
    r.css({
      color: e ? "#ffe56d" : "#fef2df"
    });
    f = document.createTextNode(o + " › " + n.text + " ");
    i = document.createElement("span");
    i.style.fontSize = "13rem";
    i.textContent = "(" + n.time + ")";
    r[0].appendChild(f);
    r[0].appendChild(i)
  }
};

};
S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_scroll = function(n) {
  var t = document.getElementById("GU_M_chat_list_area");
  t && (t.scrollTop += n * 60, S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_scroll_offset = t.scrollTop, S_GUILD_MAIN.apply_chat_scroll(!1))
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.send_chat = function() {
  var n = S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str,
    t, i, r;
  if (!n) {
    utilNotice(TXT.guild_chat_send_error_empty, 2);
    return
  }
  if (n.length > 70) {
    utilNotice(TXT.guild_chat_send_error_long, 2);
    return
  }(t = json_secure.get("guild_data"), t != null) && (i = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.HCN, r = {
    guild_name: t.guild_name,
    user_name: gEntrix.user_name,
    message: i ? n.replace(/&/g, "%26").replace(/=/g, "%3D").replace(/\+/g, "%2B") : n,
    act: "send_guild_chat"
  }, ServerConnection.update_guild(r, "guild_main", function(n) {
    n != null && (n.result === "ok" ? (S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str = "", util_draw_text_html(TXT.guild_chat_placeholder, "GU_M_chat_input_text", 20, 0, 592, 53, 53, 16, "left", "#9e9e9e"), S_GUILD_MAIN.load_chat(!0)) : utilNotice("Error - SC e | " + n.comment, 1))
  }))
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.load_chat = function(n) {
  var t = json_secure.get("guild_data"),
    i;
  t != null && (i = {
    guild_name: t.guild_name,
    act: "get_guild_chat"
  }, ServerConnection.update_guild(i, "guild_main", function(t) {
    var h, e;
    if (t != null && t.result === "ok") {
      var u = t.data,
        r = 506,
        f = document.getElementById("GU_M_chat_list_area"),
        c = f ? f.scrollHeight : r,
        l = f ? f.scrollTop : 0,
        v = Math.max(0, c - r),
        y = n || c <= r || l >= v - 10;
      if ($("#GU_M_chat_list_area").html(""), S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_scroll_offset = 0, u && u.length > 0)
        for (h = "", e = 0; e < u.length; e++) {
          var i = u[e],
            o = i.update_time ? i.update_time.substring(0, 10) : "",
            s = i.update_time ? i.update_time.substring(11, 19) : "",
            p = s ? parseInt(s.substring(0, 2)) : 0,
            w = s ? (p < 12 ? "AM " : "PM ") + s : "";
          o && o !== h && (S_GUILD_MAIN.append_chat_line({
            type: "date",
            text: o
          }), h = o);
          i.host_id === "SYSTEM" ? S_GUILD_MAIN.append_chat_line({
            type: "system",
            etc: i.etc
          }) : S_GUILD_MAIN.append_chat_line({
            type: "chat",
            host_id: i.host_id,
            name: i.user_name,
            platform: i.platform,
            text: i.chat,
            time: w
          })
        } else $("#GU_M_chat_list_area").html('<div id="GU_M_chat_empty_msg"><\/div>'), $("#GU_M_chat_empty_msg").css({
          position: "absolute",
          left: "0px",
          top: "225px",
          width: "693px",
          height: "50px",
          "text-align": "center",
          color: "#a19d99",
          "font-size": "20rem",
          "line-height": "36px"
        }), $("#GU_M_chat_empty_msg").html(TXT.guild_chat_empty.replace(/\n/g, "<br>"));
      if (y) S_GUILD_MAIN.apply_chat_scroll(!0);
      else {
        var a = document.getElementById("GU_M_chat_list_area"),
          b = a ? a.scrollHeight : r,
          k = Math.max(0, b - r);
        S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_scroll_offset = Math.min(l, k);
        S_GUILD_MAIN.apply_chat_scroll(!1)
      }
    }
  }))
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.update_guild_mission = function(n, t) {
  var i = json_secure.get("guild_data"),
    r;
  i != null && (r = {
    guild_name: i.guild_name,
    guild_money: i.guild_money,
    guild_mission_act: S_GUILD_MAIN_MISSION[n],
    guild_act_value: t,
    guild_mission_index: n,
    guild_mission_value: S_GUILD_MAIN_MISSION_VALUE[n],
    act: "update_guild_mission"
  }, ServerConnection.update_guild(r, "guild_main", function(n) {
    switch (n.result) {
      case "ok":
      case "already":
        typeof n.data == "string" && (n.data = JSON.parse(n.data));
        json_secure.set("guild_data", n.data.guild_data);
        json_secure.set("guild_mission_data", n.data.mission_data);
        g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_GUILD_MAIN && S_GUILD_MAIN.make_guild_info_screen();
        break;
      default:
        utilNotice("Error - UGM e | " + n.result, 1)
    }
  }))
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.set_guild_info = function(n) {
  var t, i;
  (n != null && S_GUILD_MAIN.update_guild_mission(n), t = json_secure.get("guild_data"), t != null) && (i = {
    guild_name: t.guild_name,
    order_by: "SEASON_SCORE",
    act: "get_member_list"
  }, ServerConnection.update_guild(i, "guild_main", function(n) {
    switch (n.result) {
      case "ok":
        json_secure.set("member_list", n.data);
        S_GUILD_MAIN.make_member_list(n.data)
    }
  }))
};

S_GUILD_MAIN.get_total_page = function() {
  var n = json_secure.get("member_list");
  return n ? Math.ceil(n.length / S_GUILD_MAIN.page_item_max) : 0
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.move_page = function(n) {
  var i = S_GUILD_MAIN.get_total_page(),
    t = S_GUILD_MAIN.list_cur_page + n;
  t < 1 || t > i || (S_GUILD_MAIN.list_cur_page = t, S_GUILD_MAIN.update_member_page())
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.update_member_page = function(n) {
  var i, t;
  if (n && (S_GUILD_MAIN.list_cur_page = 1), i = json_secure.get("member_list"), i) {
    var r = S_GUILD_MAIN.page_item_max,
      u = (S_GUILD_MAIN.list_cur_page - 1) * r,
      f = u + r;
    for (t = 0; t < i.length; t++) $("#GU_M_member_data" + t).css({
      display: t >= u && t < f ? "block" : "none",
      top: 77 * (t % r) + "px"
    });
    $("#GU_M_text_member_ranking_page_num").text(S_GUILD_MAIN.list_cur_page + "/" + S_GUILD_MAIN.get_total_page())
  }
};
