    S_GUILD_MAIN.load_chat(!0);
    clearTimeout(S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_poll_timer);
    S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_poll_timer = null;
    S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_poll_timer = setTimeout(S_GUILD_MAIN.load_chat_poll, 5e3)
  } else $("#GU_M_background_chat_area").css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_GUILD_MAIN.menu_type = "main", S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "chat_button";
  S_GUILD_MAIN.drawFocus()
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.open_chat_input = function() {
  if (S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str = "", Main.use_android_bridge() && glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_KEYBOARD) S_NATIVE_KEYBOARD.open("", function(n) {
    if (n != null && n !== "") {
      if (n.length > S_GUILD_CHAT_KEYBOARD.MAX_CHAR && (n = n.slice(0, S_GUILD_CHAT_KEYBOARD.MAX_CHAR), utilNotice(USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? S_GUILD_CHAT_KEYBOARD.MAX_CHAR + "자가 초과되어 " + S_GUILD_CHAT_KEYBOARD.MAX_CHAR + "자까지 입력됩니다." : "Exceeds " + S_GUILD_CHAT_KEYBOARD.MAX_CHAR + " characters. Input will be limited to " + S_GUILD_CHAT_KEYBOARD.MAX_CHAR + ".", 4)), S_GUILD_CHAT_KEYBOARD.check_not_allowed(n)) {
        utilNotice(USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? "해당 문자는 사용할 수 없습니다." : "These characters are not allowed.", 2);
        return
      }
      S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str = String(n);
      S_GUILD_MAIN.send_chat()
    }
  }, function(n) {
    S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str = n == null ? "" : String(n);
    S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str.length > S_GUILD_CHAT_KEYBOARD.MAX_CHAR && (S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str = S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str.slice(0, S_GUILD_CHAT_KEYBOARD.MAX_CHAR), utilNotice(USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? S_GUILD_CHAT_KEYBOARD.MAX_CHAR + "자가 초과되어 " + S_GUILD_CHAT_KEYBOARD.MAX_CHAR + "자까지 입력됩니다." : "Exceeds " + S_GUILD_CHAT_KEYBOARD.MAX_CHAR + " characters. Input will be limited to " + S_GUILD_CHAT_KEYBOARD.MAX_CHAR + ".", 4));
    util_draw_text_html(S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str || TXT.guild_chat_placeholder, "GU_M_chat_input_text", 20, 0, 592, 53, 53, 16, "left", S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str ? "#18130e" : "#9e9e9e")
  });
  else {
    var n = USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? "KOR" : "ENG";
    S_GUILD_CHAT_KEYBOARD.init(function(n) {
      n && n != "_CLOSE" && (S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str = String(n), util_draw_text_html(S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str, "GU_M_chat_input_text", 20, 0, 592, 53, 53, 16, "left", "#18130e"), S_GUILD_MAIN.send_chat())
    }, n)
  }
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_result = function(n) {
  n == "_INIT" ? (S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str = "", util_draw_text_html(TXT.guild_chat_placeholder, "GU_M_chat_input_text", 20, 0, 592, 53, 53, 16, "left", "#9e9e9e")) : n != "_CLOSE" && (S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str = String(n), util_draw_text_html(S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str || TXT.guild_chat_placeholder, "GU_M_chat_input_text", 20, 0, 592, 53, 53, 16, "left", S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str ? "#18130e" : "#9e9e9e"));
  KR_INPUT.end();
  n != "_CLOSE" && n != "_INIT" && S_GUILD_MAIN.chat_input_str && S_GUILD_MAIN.send_chat()
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.run_buff = function() {
  var n = json_secure.get("guild_data"),
    t;
  if (n != null) {
    if (n.guild_position != "MASTER") {
      utilNotice(TXT.guild_not_master, 2);
      return
    }
    if (n.guild_buff_level >= 5) {
      utilNotice(TXT.guild_buff_max_level, 2);
      return
    }
    S_GUILD_MAIN.focus_none_all();
    t = {
      popup_type: "buff_upgrade",
      popup_title: TXT.guild_buff_title + " " + TXT.levelup,
      popup_des: TXT.guild_buff_des_no_percent,
      guild_type: n.guild_type,
      guild_name: n.guild_name,
      bar_bool: !1,
      one_btn: !1
    };
    ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP, S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP, null, null, t)
  }
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.get_type_change_remain_str = function(n) {
  var t = Math.ceil(n / 60),
    i = Math.floor(t / 60),
    r = t % 60;
  return TXT.guild_type_change_remain_time.replace("^0", i).replace("^1", r)
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.set_type_change_until = function(n) {
  var t = n != null ? parseInt(n.guild_type_change_remain_sec, 10) : 0;
  (isNaN(t) || t < 0) && (t = 0);
  S_GUILD_MAIN.type_change_until = (new Date).getTime() + t * 1e3
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.run_type_change = function() {
  var n = json_secure.get("guild_data"),
    t, i;
  if (n != null && S_GUILD_MAIN.is_type_change_on()) {
    if (n.guild_position != "MASTER") {
      utilNotice(TXT.guild_not_master, 2);
      return
    }
    if (t = Math.ceil((S_GUILD_MAIN.type_change_until - (new Date).getTime()) / 1e3), t > 0) {
      utilNotice(TXT.guild_type_change_not_yet.replace("^0", S_GUILD_MAIN.get_type_change_remain_str(t)), 2);
      return
    }
    S_GUILD_MAIN.focus_none_all();
    i = {
      popup_type: "type_change",
      popup_title: TXT.guild_type_change_title,
      popup_des: TXT.guild_type_change_des,
      guild_type: n.guild_type == 1 ? "free" : "approve",
      guild_name: n.guild_name,
      bar_bool: !1,
      one_btn: !1
    };
    ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP, S_GUILD_CREATE_POPUP, null, null, i)
  }
};

  $("#GU_M_buff_focus").hide();
  $("#GU_M_ranking_focus").hide();

  $("#GU_M_chat_back_focus").hide();
  $("#GU_M_chat_input_focus").hide();
  $("#GU_M_type_focus").hide()
};

  }

S_GUILD_MAIN.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn) {
    case "left_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_GU_M_member_ranking_scroll_left", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_GU_M_member_ranking_scroll_left_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "right_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_GU_M_member_ranking_scroll_right", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_GU_M_member_ranking_scroll_right_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "chat_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_M_chat_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "chat_input_btn":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_M_chat_input_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "chat_back_btn":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_M_chat_back_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "donate_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_M_donate_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "back_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_M_back_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "shop_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_M_shop_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "start_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_M_start_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "buff_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_M_buff_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "ranking_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_M_ranking_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "help_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_M_help_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "setting_menu_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_M_setting_menu_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case "type_button":
      utilScale_xy_center("GU_M_type_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center_classid("button", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_GUILD_MAIN.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_EXITPOPUP)
    if (S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn !== "chat_button" && S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn !== "chat_input_btn" && S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn !== "chat_back_btn" && utilPush(), S_GUILD_MAIN.end(), S_GUILD_MAIN.menu_type == "help") S_GUILD_MAIN.show_help_screen(!1);
    else switch (S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn) {
      case "left_button":
        S_GUILD_MAIN.move_page(-1);
        break;
      case "right_button":
        S_GUILD_MAIN.move_page(1);
        break;
      case "chat_button":
        S_GUILD_MAIN.prev_btn = "chat_button";
        S_GUILD_MAIN.show_chat_screen(!0);
        break;
      case "chat_input_btn":
        S_GUILD_MAIN.open_chat_input();
        break;
      case "chat_back_btn":
        S_GUILD_MAIN.show_chat_screen(!1);
        break;
      case "donate_button":
        S_GUILD_MAIN.prev_btn = "donate_button";
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_DONATE, S_GUILD_DONATE);
        break;
      case "back_button":
        S_GUILD_MAIN.prev_btn = "start_button";
        S_GUILD_MAIN.run_back();
        break;
      case "shop_button":
        S_GUILD_MAIN.prev_btn = "shop_button";
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_SHOP, S_GUILD_SHOP);
        break;
      case "start_button":
        S_GUILD_MAIN.prev_btn = "start_button";
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_GAME_SELECT, S_GUILD_GAME_SELECT);
        break;
      case "buff_button":
        S_GUILD_MAIN.prev_btn = "buff_button";
        S_GUILD_MAIN.run_buff();
        break;
      case "ranking_button":
        S_GUILD_MAIN.prev_btn = "ranking_button";
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING, S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING);
        break;
      case "help_button":
        S_GUILD_MAIN.prev_btn = "help_button";
        S_GUILD_MAIN.show_help_screen(!0);
        break;
      case "setting_menu_button":
        S_GUILD_MAIN.prev_btn = "setting_menu_button";
        S_GUILD_MAIN.show_approve_alert && (S_GUILD_MAIN.show_approve_alert = !1);
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_SETTING_MENU, S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU);
        break;
      case "type_button":
        S_GUILD_MAIN.prev_btn = "type_button";
        S_GUILD_MAIN.run_type_change()
    }
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.end = function() {
  S_GUILD_MAIN.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_GUILD_MAIN.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover).mouseout(this.onMouseout)))
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover").unbind("mouseout")
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    if (S_GUILD_MAIN.menu_type == "chat") {
      glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "chat_back_btn") ? S_GUILD_MAIN.show_chat_screen(!1) : glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "chat_input_btn") && S_GUILD_MAIN.open_chat_input();
      return
    }
    for (var t = n.changedTouches && n.changedTouches.length > 0 ? n.changedTouches[0].target : n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } switch (!0) {
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "left_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "left_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "right_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "right_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "chat_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "chat_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "donate_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "donate_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "back_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "back_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "shop_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "shop_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "start_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "start_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "buff_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "buff_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "ranking_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "ranking_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "help_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "help_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "setting_menu_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "setting_menu_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "type_button"):
        if (!S_GUILD_MAIN.is_type_change_focusable()) {
          S_GUILD_MAIN.is_type_change_on() && utilNotice(TXT.guild_not_master, 2);
          return
        }
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "type_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "chat_back_btn"):
        if (S_GUILD_MAIN.menu_type == "chat") {
          S_GUILD_MAIN.show_chat_screen(!1);
          return
        }
    }
    S_GUILD_MAIN.menuRun()
  }
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    utilConsoleLog("1-onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
    switch (!0) {
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "left_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "left_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "right_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "right_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "chat_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "chat_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "donate_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "donate_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "back_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "back_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "shop_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "shop_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "start_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "start_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "buff_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "buff_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "ranking_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "ranking_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "help_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "help_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "setting_menu_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "setting_menu_button";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "type_button"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.is_type_change_focusable() && (S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "type_button");
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "chat_back_btn"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "chat_back_btn";
        break;
      case glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "chat_input_btn"):
        S_GUILD_MAIN.cur_btn = "chat_input_btn"
    }
    S_GUILD_MAIN.drawFocus()
  }
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.onMouseover_pressed = function(n, t, i, r) {
  Main.onMouseover_pressed(n, t, i, r)
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GUILD_MAIN.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_GUILD_MAIN.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_GUILD_MAIN.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GUILD_MAIN.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_GUILD_MAIN.onMouseover(n);
  S_GUILD_MAIN.onClick(n);
  return
};

  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_GUILD_MAIN.backKey()
};

  cur_btn: "card",
  is_guild_master: !0
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.POPUP_HEROES = [];
S_GUILD_SHOP.refresh_popup_heroes = function() {
  var u, n, f, t, r, e, i;
  if (typeof glo != "undefined" && glo.package && glo.package.get_hero_list && (u = glo.package.get_hero_list(), u)) {
    for (n = {}, f = 0; f < u.length; f++)(t = u[f], t && t.char_num) && (r = t.char_num, n[r] || (n[r] = {
      char_num: r,
      type_num_1: 0,
      type_num_10: 0
    }), t.times == 10 ? n[r].type_num_10 = t.num : t.times == 1 && (n[r].type_num_1 = t.num));
    e = [];
    for (i in n) n[i].type_num_1 > 0 && n[i].type_num_10 == 0 && (n[i].type_num_10 = n[i].type_num_1 + 1), (n[i].type_num_1 > 0 || n[i].type_num_10 > 0) && e.push(n[i]);
    e.sort(function(n, t) {
      return t.char_num - n.char_num
    });
    S_GUILD_SHOP.POPUP_HEROES = e
  }
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.preload = function() {
  var r;
  S_GUILD_SHOP.refresh_popup_heroes();
  var i = S_GUILD_SHOP.img_url,
    t = S_GUILD_SHOP.img_url_shop,
    n = S_GUILD_SHOP.img_url_pkg,
    u = S_GUILD_SHOP.img_url_setting,

  });

S_GUILD_SHOP.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_open ? S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_close() : S_GUILD_SHOP.run_back();
      return
  }
  S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_open ? S_GUILD_SHOP.keyDown_popup(i) : S_GUILD_SHOP.keyDown_main(i)
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.keyDown_main = function(n) {
  switch (n) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus === 1 ? (S_GUILD_SHOP.tab_focus--, S_GUILD_SHOP.tab_focus < 1 && (S_GUILD_SHOP.tab_focus = 1)) : (S_GUILD_SHOP.card_focus--, S_GUILD_SHOP.card_focus < 1 && (S_GUILD_SHOP.card_focus = 1));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus === 1 ? (S_GUILD_SHOP.tab_focus++, S_GUILD_SHOP.tab_focus > S_GUILD_SHOP.tab_tot && (S_GUILD_SHOP.tab_focus = S_GUILD_SHOP.tab_tot)) : (S_GUILD_SHOP.card_focus++, S_GUILD_SHOP.card_focus > S_GUILD_SHOP.card_tot && (S_GUILD_SHOP.card_focus = S_GUILD_SHOP.card_tot));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus === 2 ? S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus = 1 : S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus === 3 && (S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus = 2);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus === 1 ? S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus = 2 : S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus === 2 && (S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus = 3);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_GUILD_SHOP.menuRun();
      return
  }
  S_GUILD_SHOP.drawFocus()
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.keyDown_popup = function(n) {
  var r = S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_heroes_per_page,
    u = S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_page,
    e = S_GUILD_SHOP.POPUP_HEROES.length,
    i = Math.min(r, e - (u - 1) * r),
    t = 5,
    p = u > 1,
    w = u < S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_page_max,
    o = e > r,
    s, h, c, l, a, v, y, f;
  switch (n) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_row_focus === 2 ? (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_btn_focus--, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_btn_focus < 1 && (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_btn_focus = 1)) : S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus === 2 ? (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus = 0, s = Math.floor((S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus - 1) / t), S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus = Math.min(i, (s + 1) * t)) : S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus !== 1 && (h = (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus - 1) % t, h === 0 && o && p ? S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus = 1 : (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus--, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus < 1 && (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus = 1)));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_row_focus === 2 ? (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_btn_focus++, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_btn_focus > 2 && (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_btn_focus = 2)) : S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus === 1 ? (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus = 0, c = Math.floor((S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus - 1) / t), S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus = c * t + 1) : S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus !== 2 && (l = (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus - 1) % t, l === t - 1 && o && w ? S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus = 2 : (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus++, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus > i && (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus = i)));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_row_focus === 2 ? (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_row_focus = 1, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus = 0) : S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus === 0 && (a = Math.floor((S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus - 1) / t), a > 0 && (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus -= t));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_row_focus === 1 && S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus === 0 ? (v = Math.floor((S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus - 1) / t), y = Math.ceil(i / t), v < y - 1 ? (f = S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus + t, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus = f <= i ? f : i) : (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_row_focus = 2, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_btn_focus = 1)) : S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus > 0 && (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_row_focus = 2, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus = 0, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_btn_focus = 1);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_menuRun();
      return
  }
  S_GUILD_SHOP.drawFocus_popup()
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.focus_none_all = function() {
  var i, n, r, t;
  for ($("#GU_S_back_focus").hide(), i = S_GUILD_SHOP.TABS, n = 0; n < i.length; n++) $("#GU_S_tab_focus_" + (n + 1)).hide();
  for (r = S_GUILD_SHOP.CARDS, t = 0; t < r.length; t++) $("#GU_S_card_focus_" + (t + 1)).hide()
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.drawFocus = function() {
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  S_GUILD_SHOP.focus_none_all();
  S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus === 3 ? $("#GU_S_back_focus").show() : S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus === 1 ? $("#GU_S_tab_focus_" + S_GUILD_SHOP.tab_focus).show() : $("#GU_S_card_focus_" + S_GUILD_SHOP.card_focus).show()
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.drawFocus_popup = function() {
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  $("#GU_S_pop_arrow_left_focus").hide();
  $("#GU_S_pop_arrow_right_focus").hide();
  $("#GU_S_pop_btn_select_focus").hide();
  $("#GU_S_pop_btn_cancel_focus").hide();
  for (var n = 1; n <= S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_heroes_per_page; n++) $("#GU_S_pop_hero_focus_" + n).hide();
  S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_row_focus === 2 ? S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_btn_focus === 1 ? $("#GU_S_pop_btn_select_focus").show() : $("#GU_S_pop_btn_cancel_focus").show() : S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus === 1 ? $("#GU_S_pop_arrow_left_focus").show() : S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus === 2 ? $("#GU_S_pop_arrow_right_focus").show() : $("#GU_S_pop_hero_focus_" + S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus).show()
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_open_hero = function(n) {
  S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_open = !0;
  S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_gacha_times = n;
  S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_page = 1;
  S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_row_focus = 1;
  S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus = 1;
  S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus = 0;
  S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_btn_focus = 1;
  S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_selected_hero = 0;
  S_GUILD_SHOP.focus_none_all();
  $("#GU_S_pop_dim").show();
  $("#GU_S_pop_bg").show();
  S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_draw_heroes();
  S_GUILD_SHOP.drawFocus_popup();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_close = function() {
  S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_open = !1;
  $("#GU_S_pop_dim").hide();
  $("#GU_S_pop_bg").hide();
  S_GUILD_SHOP.drawFocus()
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_draw_heroes = function() {
  for (var f, t = S_GUILD_SHOP.POPUP_HEROES, i = S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_heroes_per_page, r = S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_page, e = S_GUILD_SHOP.img_url_profile, s = S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_selected_hero, h = (r - 1) * i, n = 1; n <= i; n++) {
    var u = h + (n - 1),
      c = u + 1,
      o = u < t.length,
      l = o ? e + "profile_icon_" + t[u].char_num + ".png" : e + "profile_icon_blank.png";
    $("#GU_S_pop_hero_icon_" + n).attr("src", l);
    $("#GU_S_pop_hero_" + n).css({
      display: "block"
    });
    o && c === s ? $("#GU_S_pop_hero_check_" + n).show() : $("#GU_S_pop_hero_check_" + n).hide()
  }
  f = t.length > i;
  $("#GU_S_pop_arrow_left").css({
    display: f && r > 1 ? "block" : "none"
  });
  $("#GU_S_pop_arrow_right").css({
    display: f && r < S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_page_max ? "block" : "none"
  })
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_select_hero = function(n) {
  var r = S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_heroes_per_page,
    i = (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_page - 1) * r + (n - 1),
    t;
  i >= S_GUILD_SHOP.POPUP_HEROES.length || (t = i + 1, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_selected_hero = S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_selected_hero === t ? 0 : t, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_draw_heroes(), S_GUILD_SHOP.drawFocus_popup())
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_do_gacha = function() {
  if (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_selected_hero === 0) {
    utilNotice(TXT.selecet_a_character, 1.5);
    return
  }
  S_GUILD_SHOP.gacha_open_confirm()
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.gacha_open_confirm = function() {
  var t = S_GUILD_SHOP.CARDS[S_GUILD_SHOP.card_focus - 1],
    i = S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_selected_hero - 1,
    n = S_GUILD_SHOP.POPUP_HEROES[i],
    r = S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_gacha_times,
    u = r >= 10 ? n.type_num_10 : n.type_num_1;
  S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE._from_guild_shop = !0;
  S_GUILD_SHOP._gacha_hero = n;
  S_GUILD_SHOP._gacha_card = t;
  $("#GU_S_pop_dim").hide();
  $("#GU_S_pop_bg").hide();
  S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_max = 2;
  S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE.type_num = u;
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE, S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE);
  $("#Txt_PPS_package_1").css({
    color: "#e95436"
  }).text(utilGetNumber_withComma(t.price))
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.item_gacha_open_confirm = function(n) {
  S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE._from_guild_shop = !0;
  S_GUILD_SHOP._gacha_hero = null;
  S_GUILD_SHOP._gacha_card = n;
  S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_gacha_times = n.times;
  S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_max = 2;
  S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE.type_num = n.type_num;
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE, S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE);
  $("#Txt_PPS_package_1").css({
    color: "#e95436"
  }).text(utilGetNumber_withComma(n.price))
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus === 2 && utilScale_xy_center("GU_S_card_" + S_GUILD_SHOP.card_focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center_classid("button", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_GUILD_SHOP.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene !== gS_EXITPOPUP)
    if (utilPush(), S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus === 3) S_GUILD_SHOP.backKey();
    else if (S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus === 1) S_GUILD_SHOP.drawFocus();
  else {
    var n = S_GUILD_SHOP.CARDS[S_GUILD_SHOP.card_focus - 1];
    n.type === "item" ? S_GUILD_SHOP.item_gacha_open_confirm(n) : S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_open_hero(n.times)
  }
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_menuRun = function() {
  S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_row_focus === 2 ? S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_btn_focus === 1 ? S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_do_gacha() : S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_close() : S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus === 1 ? (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_page--, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_page < 1 && (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_page = 1), S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_selected_hero = 0, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus = 1, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus = 0, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_draw_heroes(), S_GUILD_SHOP.drawFocus_popup()) : S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus === 2 ? (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_page++, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_page > S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_page_max && (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_page = S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_page_max), S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_selected_hero = 0, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus = 1, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus = 0, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_draw_heroes(), S_GUILD_SHOP.drawFocus_popup()) : S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_select_hero(S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus)
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.end = function() {
  S_GUILD_SHOP.removeMouseEvent();
  S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE._from_guild_shop = !1
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.backKey = function() {
  S_GUILD_SHOP.end();
  $("#S_GUILD_SHOP_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_MAIN, S_GUILD_MAIN)
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.run_back = function() {
  S_GUILD_SHOP.end();
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_GUILD_SHOP.backKey()
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.interval_check_init = function() {
  var n, i, r, t;
  n = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? new Date(parseInt(window.g.timestamp_start, 0) + parseInt(window.g.timestamp_due, 0)) : new Date;
  i = n.getDay();
  i == 1 && (r = n.getHours(), t = n.getMinutes(), parseInt(r) == 5 && 0 <= parseInt(t, 10) && parseInt(t, 10) <= 3 && (STORAGE.quest_init(), utilNotice(TXT.quest_init, 1.5), g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_QUESTDETAIL ? S_QUESTDETAIL.init() : g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_QUEST && S_GUILD_SHOP.init(), glo.pvp.init_my_ranking_score()));
  setTimeout(S_GUILD_SHOP.interval_check_init, 6e4)
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_GUILD_SHOP.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(S_GUILD_SHOP.onMouseover)))
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.changedTouches && n.changedTouches.length > 0 ? n.changedTouches[0].target : n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") return;
    if (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_open) S_GUILD_SHOP.onClick_popup(t);
    else S_GUILD_SHOP.onClick_main(t)
  }
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.onClick_main = function(n) {
  var t, i;
  if (glo.fun.has_class(n, "back_button")) {
    S_GUILD_SHOP.run_back();
    return
  }
  if (glo.fun.has_class(n, "gs_tab")) {
    t = parseInt(n.id.replace("GU_S_tab_", ""), 10);
    S_GUILD_SHOP.tab_focus = t;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus = 1;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.menuRun();
    return
  }
  if (glo.fun.has_class(n, "gs_card")) {
    i = parseInt(n.id.replace("GU_S_card_", ""), 10);
    S_GUILD_SHOP.card_focus = i;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus = 2;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.menuRun();
    return
  }
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.onClick_popup = function(n) {
  if (glo.fun.has_class(n, "gs_hero")) {
    var t = parseInt(n.id.replace("GU_S_pop_hero_", ""), 10);
    S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_row_focus = 1;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus = t;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus = 0;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_select_hero(t);
    return
  }
  if (glo.fun.has_class(n, "gs_arrow")) {
    n.id === "GU_S_pop_arrow_left" && (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus = 1);
    n.id === "GU_S_pop_arrow_right" && (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus = 2);
    S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_menuRun();
    return
  }
  if (glo.fun.has_class(n, "gs_popbtn")) {
    S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_row_focus = 2;
    n.id === "GU_S_pop_btn_select" ? (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_btn_focus = 1, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_do_gacha()) : (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_btn_focus = 2, S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_close());
    return
  }
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") return;
    if (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_open) S_GUILD_SHOP.onMouseover_popup(t);
    else S_GUILD_SHOP.onMouseover_main(t)
  }
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.onMouseover_main = function(n) {
  if (glo.fun.has_class(n, "back_button")) {
    S_GUILD_SHOP.focus_none_all();
    $("#GU_S_back_focus").show();
    return
  }
  if (glo.fun.has_class(n, "gs_tab")) {
    S_GUILD_SHOP.tab_focus = parseInt(n.id.replace("GU_S_tab_", ""), 10);
    S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus = 1;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.drawFocus();
    return
  }
  if (glo.fun.has_class(n, "gs_card")) {
    S_GUILD_SHOP.card_focus = parseInt(n.id.replace("GU_S_card_", ""), 10);
    S_GUILD_SHOP.row_focus = 2;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.drawFocus();
    return
  }
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.onMouseover_popup = function(n) {
  if (glo.fun.has_class(n, "gs_hero")) {
    var t = parseInt(n.id.replace("GU_S_pop_hero_", ""), 10),
      i = (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_page - 1) * S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_heroes_per_page + (t - 1);
    if (i >= S_GUILD_SHOP.POPUP_HEROES.length) return;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_focus = t;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_row_focus = 1;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus = 0;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.drawFocus_popup();
    return
  }
  if (glo.fun.has_class(n, "gs_arrow")) {
    n.id === "GU_S_pop_arrow_left" && (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus = 1);
    n.id === "GU_S_pop_arrow_right" && (S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus = 2);
    S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_row_focus = 1;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.drawFocus_popup();
    return
  }
  if (glo.fun.has_class(n, "gs_popbtn")) {
    S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_row_focus = 2;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_arrow_focus = 0;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.popup_btn_focus = n.id === "GU_S_pop_btn_select" ? 1 : 2;
    S_GUILD_SHOP.drawFocus_popup();
    return
  }
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.onMouseover_pressed = function(n, t, i, r) {
  Main.onMouseover_pressed(n, t, i, r)
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog("S_GUILD_SHOP.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_GUILD_SHOP.onMouseover(n)
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog("S_GUILD_SHOP.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_GUILD_SHOP.onMouseover(n);
  S_GUILD_SHOP.onClick(n)
};
S_GUILD_SHOP.init_img_url = function() {
  S_GUILD_SHOP.img_url = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("GUILD") + "image/ui/49_guild/";
  S_GUILD_SHOP.img_url_pkg = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_GACHA") + "image/ui/40_package_store/";
  S_GUILD_SHOP.img_url_shop = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_GACHA") + "image/ui/49_guild_shop/";
  S_GUILD_SHOP.img_url_setting = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/11_setting/";
  S_GUILD_SHOP.img_url_common = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/0_common/";
  S_GUILD_SHOP.img_url_profile = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_GACHA") + "image/ui/52_profile/"
};
glo.fun.add_img_url_initor(S_GUILD_SHOP.init_img_url);

  S_MAINMENU.unmount_mm_top();

  n != null && (n.guild_position != "MASTER" && glo.fun.remove_array_key(S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU_LIST, "join_request", "notice_management"), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.maketag(), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.make_screen(), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.addMouseEvent(), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus(), blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene), setTimeout(function() {
    gEnableKey = 1
  }, DEFINE.KEYLOCKTIME))
};

};

S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.define = function() {
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.row_focus = 1;
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.btn_focus = 2;
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button";
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index = 0;
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type = "member_management";
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_master = !1;
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_cur_page = 1;
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.input_notice_str = "";
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU_LIST = ["member_management", "join_request", "notice_management", "guild_leave"]
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var h = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    r, o, u, f, i, e, s;
  if (gEnableKey != 0) switch (h) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (!S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_master) {
        if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "close_button") {
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button";
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
          return
        }
        if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_right_button") {
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "scroll_left_button";
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
          return
        }
        if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_left_button") {
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button";
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
          return
        }
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "close_button") {
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_center_list && S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_center_list() ? "add_button" : "menu_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "add_button") {
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "menu_button") return;
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_left_button") {
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_right_button") {
        if (i = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_list_data(), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "join_request" && (e = i.length, e > 0)) {
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "list_button";
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
          return
        }
        if (r = i.length, u = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_page_end(r), i[S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index].is_mine == "yes") {
          if (r <= 1) {
            S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "scroll_left_button";
            S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
            return
          }
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index < u ? S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index++ : S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index--
        }
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "list_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "list_button") {
        if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "join_request" && (typeof S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index == "undefined" && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index = 0), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index == 1)) {
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index = 0;
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
          return
        }
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "scroll_left_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "center_button") {
        f = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_center_button_count();
        (f <= 1 || S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index == 0) && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button", S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus());
        return
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (!S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_master && S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_left_button") {
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "scroll_right_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "add_button") {
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "close_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "menu_button") {
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_center_list && S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_center_list() ? S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "join_request" && S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_list_data().length <= 0 ? "add_button" : "scroll_left_button" : "center_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_left_button") {
        if (i = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_list_data(), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "join_request" && (e = i.length, e > 0)) {
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "list_button";
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
          return
        }
        if (r = i.length, r <= 0) return;
        if (u = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_page_end(r), i[S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index].is_mine == "yes") {
          if (r <= 1) {
            S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "scroll_right_button";
            S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
            return
          }
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index < u ? S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index++ : S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index--
        }
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "list_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_right_button") return;
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "list_button") {
        if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "join_request" && (typeof S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index == "undefined" && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index = 0), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index == 0)) {
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index = 1;
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
          return
        }
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "scroll_right_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "center_button") {
        f = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_center_button_count();
        f >= 2 && S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index == 0 && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index = 1, S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus());
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "close_button") return;
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      if (!S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_master) {
        if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "center_button") {
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "close_button";
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
          return
        }
        if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_left_button" || S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_right_button") {
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "close_button";
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
          return
        }
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "close_button") return;
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "add_button") {
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "close_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "menu_button") {
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index > 0 && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index--, S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus());
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_left_button" || S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_right_button") {
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "add_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "list_button") {
        if (i = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_list_data(), r = i.length, r <= 0) return;
        if (o = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_page_start(), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index > 0 && i[S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index - 1].is_mine == "yes" && S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index--, S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index <= o) {
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "add_button";
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
          return
        }
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index--;
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "center_button") {
        if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type === "guild_leave") {
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "add_button";
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
          return
        }
        if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_center_list && !S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_center_list()) {
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "close_button";
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
          return
        }
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      if (!S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_master && S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "close_button") {
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_center_list && S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_center_list() ? "scroll_right_button" : "center_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "close_button") {
        if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_center_list && S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_center_list()) S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "add_button";
        else {
          if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type === "guild_leave") {
            S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "add_button";
            S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
            return
          }
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "center_button"
        }
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "add_button") {
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.enter_center_default();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "menu_button") {
        s = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU_LIST || [];
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index < s.length - 1 && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index++, S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus());
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_left_button") return;
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_right_button") return;
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "list_button") {
        if (i = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_list_data(), r = i.length, r <= 0) return;
        if (u = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_page_end(r), i[S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index + 1].is_mine == "yes") {
          if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index + 1 >= u) return;
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index++
        }
        if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index >= u) return;
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index++;
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "center_button") return;
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.run_back()
  }
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.interval_check_init = function() {
  var n, i, r, t;
  n = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? new Date(parseInt(window.g.timestamp_start, 0) + parseInt(window.g.timestamp_due, 0)) : new Date;
  i = n.getDay();
  i == 1 && (r = n.getHours(), t = n.getMinutes(), parseInt(r) == 5 && 0 <= parseInt(t, 10) && parseInt(t, 10) <= 3 && (STORAGE.quest_init(), utilNotice(TXT.quest_init, 1.5), g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_QUESTDETAIL ? S_QUESTDETAIL.init() : g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_QUEST && S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.init(), glo.pvp.init_my_ranking_score()));
  setTimeout(S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.interval_check_init, 6e4)
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.backKey = function(n) {
  typeof n != "boolean" && (n = !0);
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.end();
  n && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_MAIN, S_GUILD_MAIN)
};

S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_list = function(n) {
  var i = json_secure.get("guild_data"),
    t, r;
  if (i != null) {
    S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_master = i.guild_position == "MASTER" ? !0 : !1;
    t = "";
    switch (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type) {
      case "member_management":
        t = "get_member_list";
        break;
      case "join_request":
        t = "get_approve_list";
        break;
      case "notice_management":
        t = "none";
        break;
      case "guild_leave":
        t = i.guild_position == "MASTER" ? "get_member_list" : "none"
    }
    t != "" && (t != "none" ? (r = {
      guild_name: i.guild_name,
      order_by: "NO",
      act: t
    }, ServerConnection.update_guild(r, "guild_main", function(i) {
      switch (i.result) {
        case "ok":
          t == "get_member_list" ? json_secure.set("member_list", i.data) : t == "get_approve_list" && json_secure.set("approve_list", i.data);
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.update_inner_info(i);
          S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.make_center_tag(i.data);
          n != null && n && n(S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_list_data());
          break;
        default:
          utilNotice("Error - GLS e | " + i.comment, 1)
      }
    })) : (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.update_inner_info("none"), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.make_center_tag("none")))
  }
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.make_center_tag = function(n) {
  var r = document.getElementById("GU_ME_center_area"),
    i, t;
  if (!r) {
    utilConsoleLog("GU_ME_center_area not found.");
    return
  }
  if ($("#GU_ME_center_area").empty(), $("#GU_ME_center_area").css({
      left: "380px",
      top: "105px",
      width: "704px",
      height: "498px",
      position: "absolute"
    }), i = "", S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "member_management")

};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.update_inner_info = function(n) {
  var i = 1,
    t, r, u;
  switch (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type) {
    case "member_management":
      i = 1;
      break;
    case "join_request":
      i = 2;
      break;
    case "notice_management":
      i = 3;
      break;
    case "guild_leave":
      i = 4
  }
  for (utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_GU_ME_menu_icon", S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.img_url + "guild_leader_icon" + i + ".png", 389, 45), $("#GU_ME_text_menu_title").text(TXT["guild_setting_menu_" + S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type]), n == "none" ? $("#GU_ME_menu_member_box").hide() : n != null && ($("#GU_ME_menu_member_box").show(), $("#GU_ME_text_menu_member_num").text(n.cur_member + "/" + n.max_member)), t = 0; t < S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU_LIST.length; t++) r = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU_LIST[t], u = r ? "guild_button6" : "guild_button7", $("#GU_ME_menu_" + S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU_LIST[t] + "_btn").css("background", util_bg_url("url(" + S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.img_url + u + ".png) no-repeat 0 0")), $("#GU_ME_text_menu_" + S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU_LIST[t] + "_btn").css("color", r ? "#ffffff" : "#646464")
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.set_approve_alert = function(n, t) {
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.show_approve_alert && t && t.length > 0 ? $("#" + n).show() : $("#" + n).hide()
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.show_scroll_page = function(n, t) {
  t ? ($("#GU_ME_left_scroll_btn").show(), $("#GU_ME_right_scroll_btn").show(), $("#GU_ME_text_scroll_page_num").show(), $("#GU_ME_text_scroll_page_num").text(S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_cur_page + "/" + S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_total_page(n)), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.update_member_page(!0)) : ($("#GU_ME_left_scroll_btn").hide(), $("#GU_ME_right_scroll_btn").hide(), $("#GU_ME_text_scroll_page_num").hide())
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_total_page = function(n) {
  var t = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "join_request" ? "approve_list" : "member_list",
    n = json_secure.get(t);
  return n ? Math.ceil(n.length / S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.page_item_max) : 0
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.move_page = function(n) {
  var i = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_total_page(),
    t = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_cur_page + n;
  t < 1 || t > i || (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_cur_page = t, S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.update_member_page(), $("#GU_ME_text_scroll_page_num").text(S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_cur_page + "/" + i))
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.update_member_page = function(n) {
  var u, i, t;
  if (n && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_cur_page = 1), u = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "join_request" ? "approve_list" : "member_list", i = json_secure.get(u), i) {
    var r = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.page_item_max,
      f = (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_cur_page - 1) * r,
      e = f + r;
    for (t = 0; t < i.length; t++) $("#GU_ME_list_item" + t).css({
      display: t >= f && t < e ? "block" : "none",
      top: 83 * (t % r) + "px"
    })
  }
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.setting_popup_ok_act = function() {
  var n;
  switch (S_GUILD_SETTING_POPUP.popup_type) {
    case "leave":
      n = json_secure.get("guild_data");
      utilNotice(TXT.guild_leave_ok.replace("^0", n.guild_name), 1);
      json_secure.set("guild_data", null);
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.run_back(!1);
      S_GUILD_MAIN.run_back();
      break;
    case "delete":
      n = json_secure.get("guild_data");
      utilNotice(TXT.guild_delete_ok.replace("^0", n.guild_name), 1);
      json_secure.set("guild_data", null);
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.run_back(!1);
      S_GUILD_MAIN.run_back();
      break;
    case "kick":
      utilNotice(TXT.guild_kick_ok.replace("[^0]", ""), 1);
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_list(function(n) {
        n != null && n.length <= 1 && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button", S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus())
      });
      break;
    case "delegate":
      utilNotice(TXT.guild_delegate_ok.replace("[^0]", ""), 1);
      break;
    case "add_member":
      n = json_secure.get("guild_data");
      utilNotice(TXT.guild_add_member_ok.replace("^0", n.guild_max_member), 1)
  }
  S_GUILD_SETTING_POPUP.popup_type == "delegate" ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_MAIN, S_GUILD_MAIN) : S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_list()
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.update_notice = function(n) {
  var t = json_secure.get("guild_data"),
    i;
  t != null && (i = {
    guild_name: t.guild_name,
    notice_str: n,
    act_detail: "change_notice",
    act: "update_guild_member"
  }, ServerConnection.update_guild(i, "guild_main", function(t) {
    switch (t.result) {
      case "ok":
        utilNotice(TXT.guild_notice_change_ok, 1);
        $("#GU_ME_text_guild_cur_notice").html(n);
        $("#GU_ME_text_guild_cur_notice").css({
          left: "0px",
          top: "0px",
          width: "583px",
          height: "122px",
          "font-size": "20rem",
          color: "#312a23",
          "line-height": "30px",
          "align-items": "center",
          "justify-content": "center",
          "text-align": "center",
          position: "absolute",
          display: "flex",
          "word-break": "keep-all",
          "word-break": "break-word",
          "overflow-wrap": "break-word"
        });
        break;
      case "long":
        utilNotice(TXT.guild_notice_error_long_notice.replace("^0", S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.notice_max_length), 1);
        break;
      case "str_not_allowed":
        utilNotice(TXT.str_not_allowed, 1);
        break;
      default:
        utilNotice("Error | " + S_GUILD_SETTING_POPUP.popup_type + " | " + t.result, 1)
    }
  }))
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.insert_notice_box = function() {
  if (Main.use_android_bridge() && glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_KEYBOARD) S_NATIVE_KEYBOARD.open(S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.input_notice_str || "", function(n) {
    S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.input_notice_str = n == null ? "" : String(n);
    n || (n = "-");
    S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.update_notice(n)
  }, function(n) {
    window.KR_INPUT && KR_INPUT.end && KR_INPUT.end();
    S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.input_notice_str = n == null ? "" : String(n);
    util_draw_text_html(S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.input_notice_str || TXT && TXT.guild_insert_search_box_hint || "", "GU_ME_text_guild_cur_notice", 0, 0, 323, 44, 44, 25, "center", "#000000")
  });
  else {
    gEnableKey = 0;
    var t = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.input_result,
      n = {};
    n.lang = USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? "KOR" : "ENG";
    n.title = TXT.guild_notice_insert_hint;
    n.caution = TXT.caution_abnormal_name;
    g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = "KR_INPUT";
    KR_INPUT.init(t, null, 70, null, n, 1);
    try {
      KR_INPUT.set_special_char(!0);
      KR_INPUT.set_use_initial_char(!0)
    } catch (i) {
      console.log(i)
    }
    Main.remove_keydown_event_listener()
  }
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.input_result = function(n) {
  n != "_CLOSE" && S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.update_notice(n);
  KR_INPUT.end();
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_GUILD_SETTING_MENU;
  setTimeout(function() {
    gEnableKey = 1
  }, 200);
  $("#Img_GU_ME_guild_notice_change_btn_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? (blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.addMouseEvent(), $("#KR_INPUT_div").hide(), Main.add_keydown_event_listener()) : (document.body.onkeydown = Main.keyDown, (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene))
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_center_list = function() {
  if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "member_management" || S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "join_request") return !0;
  if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "guild_leave" && S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_master) {
    var n = json_secure.get("member_list") || [];
    if (n.length > 1) return !0
  }
  return !1
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_list_data = function() {
  return S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "join_request" ? json_secure.get("approve_list") || [] : json_secure.get("member_list") || []
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_page_start = function() {
  return (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_cur_page - 1) * S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.page_item_max
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_page_end = function(n) {
  var t = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_page_start() + S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.page_item_max - 1;
  return t >= n && (t = n - 1), t < 0 && (t = 0), t
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_center_button_count = function() {
  return 1
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.enter_center_default = function() {
  if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_center_list()) {
    var i = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_list_data(),
      n = i.length,
      t = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_page_start();
    if (n <= 0) {
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "join_request") return;
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "center_button";
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
      return
    }
    if (t >= n && (t = 0), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index = t, n <= 1 && S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type != "join_request") {
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "scroll_left_button";
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
      return
    }
    S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index < n && i[S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index].is_mine == "yes" && S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index++;
    S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "list_button";
    S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus();
    return
  }
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index = 0;
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "center_button";
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus()
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.select_menu = function(n) {
  n && S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type != n && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type = n, S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_list())
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_press_target_id = function() {
  var n, t;
  return S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "close_button" ? "GU_ME_menu_close_btn" : S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "add_button" ? "GU_ME_menu_member_add_btn" : S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "menu_button" ? (n = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU_LIST || [], n.length <= 0) ? "" : (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index < 0 && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index = 0), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index >= n.length && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index = n.length - 1), t = n[S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index], !t) ? "" : "GU_ME_menu_" + t + "_btn" : S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_left_button" ? "GU_ME_left_scroll_btn" : S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_right_button" ? "GU_ME_right_scroll_btn" : S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "list_button" ? S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "member_management" ? "GU_ME_list_item_kick_btn" + S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index : S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "join_request" ? (typeof S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index == "undefined" && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index = 0), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index == 1) ? "GU_ME_list_item_reject_btn" + S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index : "GU_ME_list_item_accept_btn" + S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index : S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "guild_leave" ? "GU_ME_list_item_delegate_btn" + S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index : "" : S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "center_button" ? S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "notice_management" ? "GU_ME_guild_notice_change_btn" : S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "guild_leave" ? S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_master ? "GU_ME_guild_delete_ok_btn" : "GU_ME_guild_leave_ok_btn" : "" : ""
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.focus_none_all = function() {
  $(".focus").css({
    display: "none"
  })
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus = function() {
  var n;
  if (window.g.blink.value = 1, S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.focus_none_all(), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "close_button") {
    $("#Img_GU_ME_menu_close_focus").css({
      display: "block"
    });
    return
  }
  if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "add_button") {
    $("#Img_GU_ME_menu_member_add_focus").css({
      display: "block"
    });
    return
  }
  if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "menu_button") {
    n = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU_LIST || [];
    S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index < 0 && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index = 0);
    S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index >= n.length && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index = n.length - 1);
    n.length > 0 && $("#Img_GU_ME_menu_" + n[S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index] + "_focus").css({
      display: "block"
    });
    return
  }
  if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_left_button") {
    $("#GU_ME_left_scroll_btn_focus").css({
      display: "block"
    });
    return
  }
  if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_right_button") {
    $("#GU_ME_right_scroll_btn_focus").css({
      display: "block"
    });
    return
  }
  if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "list_button") {
    if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "member_management") {
      $("#Img_GU_ME_list_item_kick_btn_focus" + S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index).css({
        display: "block"
      });
      return
    }
    if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "join_request") {
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "join_request") {
        typeof S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index == "undefined" && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index = 0);
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index == 1 ? $("#Img_GU_ME_list_item_reject_btn_focus" + S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index).css({
          display: "block"
        }) : $("#Img_GU_ME_list_item_accept_btn_focus" + S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index).css({
          display: "block"
        });
        return
      }
      return
    }
    if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "guild_leave") {
      $("#Img_GU_ME_list_item_delegate_btn_focus" + S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index).css({
        display: "block"
      });
      return
    }
    return
  }
  if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "center_button") {
    if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "notice_management") {
      $("#Img_GU_ME_guild_notice_change_btn_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      return
    }
    if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "guild_leave") {
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_master ? $("#Img_GU_ME_guild_delete_ok_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      }) : $("#Img_GU_ME_guild_leave_ok_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      return
    }
    return
  }
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menuRun = function() {
  var n;
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  n = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_press_target_id();
  n != "" && utilScale_xy_center(n, gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    n != "" && utilScale_xy_center(n, 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menuRun_Run = function() {
  var r, u, n, o, i, s, f, h, c, e, l, t;
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_EXITPOPUP) {
    if (utilPush(), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "close_button") {
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.run_back();
      return
    }
    if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "add_button") {
      if (i = json_secure.get("guild_data"), i == null) return;
      if (i.guild_max_member >= i.guild_next_max_member) {
        utilNotice(TXT.guild_member_max_to_add, 2);
        return
      }
      t = {
        popup_type: "add_member",
        data: null
      };
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_SETTING_POPUP, S_GUILD_SETTING_POPUP, null, null, t);
      return
    }
    if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "menu_button") {
      if (r = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU_LIST || [], r.length <= 0) return;
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index < 0 && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index = 0), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index >= r.length && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index = r.length - 1), u = r[S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index], !u) return;
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == u) return;
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index = 0;
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_cur_page = 1;
      typeof S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index != "undefined" && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index = 0);
      $("#GU_ME_text_scroll_page_num").text("1/" + S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_total_page());
      u == "join_request" && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.show_approve_alert = !1, S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.set_approve_alert("Img_GU_ME_menu_join_request_alert_icon", json_secure.get("approve_list")));
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type = u;
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_list();
      return
    }
    if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_left_button") {
      h = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.page_item_max;
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.move_page(-1);
      s = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_list_data();
      f = s.length;
      f > 0 && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index - h, S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index < 0 && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index = 0), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index > f - 1 && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index = f - 1));
      return
    }
    if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "scroll_right_button") {
      l = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.page_item_max;
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.move_page(1);
      c = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_list_data();
      e = c.length;
      e > 0 && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index + l, S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index < 0 && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index = 0), S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index > e - 1 && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index = e - 1));
      return
    }
    if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "list_button") {
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "member_management") {
        n = json_secure.get("member_list")[S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index];
        n = typeof n == "string" ? JSON.parse(n) : n;
        t = {
          popup_type: "kick",
          data: n
        };
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_SETTING_POPUP, S_GUILD_SETTING_POPUP, null, null, t);
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "join_request") {
        if (i = json_secure.get("guild_data"), i == null) return;
        if (n = json_secure.get("approve_list")[S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index], n = typeof n == "string" ? JSON.parse(n) : n, n == null) return;
        typeof S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index == "undefined" && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index = 0);
        o = {
          guild_name: i.guild_name,
          member_name: n.user_name,
          member_no: n.member_no,
          act_detail: "approve_member",
          approve_reject: S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index == 1 ? "REJECT" : "APPROVE",
          act: "update_guild_member"
        };
        ServerConnection.update_guild(o, "guild_main", function(n) {
          switch (n.result) {
            case "ok":
              S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.get_list(function(n) {
                S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index == 1 ? (utilNotice(TXT.guild_reject_ok.replace("[^0]", ""), 1), n != null && n.length <= 0 && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button", S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus())) : (utilNotice(TXT.guild_approve_ok.replace("[^0]", ""), 1), n != null && n.length <= 0 && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button", S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus()))
              });
              break;
            case "already_other_guild":
              utilNotice(TXT.guild_already_join_other_guild, 2);
              break;
            case "full":
              utilNotice(TXT.guild_member_full, 2);
              break;
            default:
              utilNotice("Error | " + n.result, 1)
          }
        });
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "guild_leave") {
        n = json_secure.get("member_list")[S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index];
        n = typeof n == "string" ? JSON.parse(n) : n;
        t = {
          popup_type: "delegate",
          data: n
        };
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_SETTING_POPUP, S_GUILD_SETTING_POPUP, null, null, t);
        return
      }
      return
    }
    if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn == "center_button") {
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "guild_leave" && S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_master) {
        t = {
          popup_type: "delete",
          data: null
        };
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_SETTING_POPUP, S_GUILD_SETTING_POPUP, null, null, t);
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "guild_leave" && !S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.is_master) {
        t = {
          popup_type: "leave",
          data: null
        };
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_SETTING_POPUP, S_GUILD_SETTING_POPUP, null, null, t);
        return
      }
      if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_type == "notice_management") {
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.insert_notice_box();
        return
      }
      return
    }
  }
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.end = function() {
  $("#S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU_div").remove();
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover).mouseout(this.onMouseout)))
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover").unbind("mouseout")
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.onClick = function(n) {
  var t, i, o, s, r, u, f, e;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (t = n.changedTouches && n.changedTouches.length > 0 ? n.changedTouches[0].target : n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "", typeof S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index == "undefined" && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index = 0), typeof S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index == "undefined" && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index = 0), glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "kick_button") || glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "accept_button") || glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "reject_button") || glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "delegate_button")) {
      for (i = n.target; i;) {
        if (i.id && i.id.indexOf("GU_ME_list_item") === 0) break;
        i = i.parentNode
      }
      if (!i || !i.id) return;
      if (o = i.id.match(/\d+$/), !o) return;
      s = parseInt(o[0], 10);
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index = s;
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index = glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "reject_button") ? 1 : 0;
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "list_button";
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menuRun();
      return
    }
    if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "delete_button")) {
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "center_button";
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menuRun();
      return
    }
    if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "leave_button")) {
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "center_button";
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menuRun();
      return
    }
    if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "notice_change_button")) {
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "center_button";
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menuRun();
      return
    }
    if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "add_button")) {
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "add_button";
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menuRun();
      return
    }
    if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "close_button")) {
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "close_button";
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menuRun();
      return
    }
    if (r = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU_LIST || [], r.length > 0) {
      if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "member_management")) {
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index = 0;
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menuRun();
        return
      }
      if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "join_request")) {
        for (u = 0; u < r.length; u++)
          if (r[u] == "join_request") {
            S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index = u;
            break
          } S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menuRun();
        return
      }
      if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "notice_management")) {
        for (f = 0; f < r.length; f++)
          if (r[f] == "notice_management") {
            S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index = f;
            break
          } S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menuRun();
        return
      }
      if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "guild_leave")) {
        for (e = 0; e < r.length; e++)
          if (r[e] == "guild_leave") {
            S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index = e;
            break
          } S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button";
        S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menuRun();
        return
      }
    }
    if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "left_button")) {
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "scroll_left_button";
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menuRun();
      return
    }
    if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "right_button")) {
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "scroll_right_button";
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menuRun();
      return
    }
  }
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.onMouseover = function(n) {
  var t, e, o, i, r, u, f;
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    if (utilConsoleLog("1-onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "kick_button") || glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "accept_button") || glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "reject_button") || glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "delegate_button")) {
      for (t = n.target; t;) {
        if (t.id && t.id.indexOf("GU_ME_list_item") === 0) break;
        t = t.parentNode
      }
      if (!t || !t.id) return;
      if (e = t.id.match(/\d+$/), !e) return;
      o = parseInt(e[0], 10);
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.list_index = o;
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.center_index = glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "reject_button") ? 1 : 0;
      S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "list_button"
    }
    if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "delete_button") && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "center_button"), glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "leave_button") && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "center_button"), glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "notice_change_button") && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "center_button"), glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "add_button") && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "add_button"), glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "close_button") && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "close_button"), i = S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU_LIST || [], i.length > 0) {
      if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "member_management") && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index = 0, S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button"), glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "join_request")) {
        for (r = 0; r < i.length; r++)
          if (i[r] == "join_request") {
            S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index = r;
            break
          } S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button"
      }
      if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "notice_management")) {
        for (u = 0; u < i.length; u++)
          if (i[u] == "notice_management") {
            S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index = u;
            break
          } S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button"
      }
      if (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "guild_leave")) {
        for (f = 0; f < i.length; f++)
          if (i[f] == "guild_leave") {
            S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.menu_index = f;
            break
          } S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "menu_button"
      }
    }
    glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "left_button") && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "scroll_left_button");
    glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "right_button") && (S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.cur_btn = "scroll_right_button");
    S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.drawFocus()
  }
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.onMouseover_pressed = function(n, t, i, r) {
  Main.onMouseover_pressed(n, t, i, r)
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.onMouseover(n);
  S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.run_back = function(n) {
  typeof n != "boolean" && (n = !0);
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_GUILD_SETTING_MENU.backKey(n)
};

};

S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.menu_type != "help") switch (S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.cur_btn) {
        case "left_button":
          S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.cur_btn = "help_button";
          break;
        case "right_button":
          S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.cur_btn = "left_button";
          break;
        case "help_button":
          glo.APP_FEATURE.TOUCH_PLATFORM || (S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.cur_btn = "back_button")
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.menu_type != "help") switch (S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.cur_btn) {
        case "left_button":
          S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.cur_btn = "right_button";
          break;
        case "back_button":
          glo.APP_FEATURE.TOUCH_PLATFORM || (S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.cur_btn = "help_button");
          break;
        case "help_button":
          S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.cur_btn = "left_button"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      if (S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.menu_type != "help") switch (S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.cur_btn) {
        case "back_button":
        case "help_button":
          S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.cur_btn = "left_button"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      if (S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.menu_type != "help") switch (S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.cur_btn) {
        case "left_button":
        case "right_button":
          S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.cur_btn = "help_button"
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.menu_type == "help" ? S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.show_help_screen(!1) : S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.run_back()
  }
  S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.drawFocus()
};
S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.interval_check_init = function() {
  var n, i, r, t;
  n = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? new Date(parseInt(window.g.timestamp_start, 0) + parseInt(window.g.timestamp_due, 0)) : new Date;
  i = n.getDay();
  i == 1 && (r = n.getHours(), t = n.getMinutes(), parseInt(r) == 5 && 0 <= parseInt(t, 10) && parseInt(t, 10) <= 3 && (STORAGE.quest_init(), utilNotice(TXT.quest_init, 1.5), g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_QUESTDETAIL ? S_QUESTDETAIL.init() : g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_QUEST && S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.init(), glo.pvp.init_my_ranking_score()));
  setTimeout(S_GUILD_SEASON_RANKING.interval_check_init, 6e4)
};

ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_ENTER, S_GUILD_ENTER) : ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU)
};
