S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.pre_define = function(n) {
  S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.list_1 = n.week_rank;
  S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.list_2 = n.attack_success;
  S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.list_3 = n.defence_fail
};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.define = function() {
  var n = 1,
    t = this.get_list(n),
    i = t.length - 1;
  this.tot_page[n] = Math.floor((i - 1) / 10) + 1;
  this.cur_page[n] = 1;
  var n = 2,
    t = this.get_list(n),
    i = t.length - 1;
  this.tot_page[n] = Math.floor((i - 1) / 10) + 1;
  this.cur_page[n] = 1;
  var n = 3,
    t = this.get_list(n),
    i = t.length - 1;
  this.tot_page[n] = Math.floor((i - 1) / 10) + 1;
  this.cur_page[n] = 1;
  this.cur_tab = 1
};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.get_list = function(n) {
  switch (n) {
    case 1:
      return this.list_1;
    case 2:
      return this.list_2;
    case 3:
      return this.list_3
  }
};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var r = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    i = !glo.APP_FEATURE.TOUCH_PLATFORM;
  switch (r) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      switch (this.focus) {
        case 2:
        case 3:
        case 5:
          this.focus--;
          break;
        case 7:
          i && this.focus--
      }
      this.focus <= 3 && (this.cur_tab = this.focus);
      this.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      switch (this.focus) {
        case 1:
        case 2:
        case 4:
        case 6:
          this.focus++;
          this.focus <= 3 && (this.cur_tab = this.focus);
          this.drawFocus()
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      switch (this.focus) {
        case 4:
          this.focus = 1;
          break;
        case 5:
          this.focus = 3;
          break;
        case 6:
          this.focus = 4;
          break;
        case 7:
          this.focus = 5
      }
      this.focus <= 3 && (this.cur_tab = this.focus);
      this.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      switch (this.focus) {
        case 1:
        case 2:
          this.focus = 4;
          break;
        case 3:
          this.focus = 5;
          break;
        case 4:
          this.focus = i ? 6 : 7;
          break;
        case 5:
          this.focus = 7
      }
      this.focus <= 3 && (this.cur_tab = this.focus);
      this.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.run_back()
  }
};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.backKey = function() {
  S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.end();
  $("#S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_BATTLE, S_GUILD_BATTLE);
  S_GUILD_BATTLE.drawFocus()
};

    f = t.length - 1,
    n, i, e, r, u, o;
  for ($("#GU_WR_list").css({
      left: "290px",
      top: "138px",
      width: "701px",
      height: "503px",
      position: "absolute"
    }), $("#GU_WR_list_frame").css({
      left: "35px",
      top: "0px",
      width: "631px",
      height: 51 * f + "px",
      position: "absolute"
    }), n = 1; n <= f; n++) i = "GU_WR_list" + n, $("#" + i).css({
    left: "0px",
    top: (n - 1) * 51 + "px",
    width: "631px",
    height: "44px",
    position: "absolute"
  }), t[n].TOT == 0 ? utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos(i + "_bg", S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.img_url + "guild_mhistory_list2.png", 0, 0) : utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos(i + "_bg", S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.img_url + "guild_mhistory_list1.png", 0, 0), e = t[n].platform.replace("ELDORADO_", ""), util_draw_text_html(e, i + "_platform", 6, 17, 52, 12, 12, 12, "center", "#1a1a1a"), r = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("PROFILE"), t[n].char >= 107 && (r = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("LUCY_9STAR")), u = r + "image/ui/52_profile/profile_icon_" + t[n].char + ".png", t[n].char == 0 && (u = S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.img_url + "onepixel.png"), utilDrawImage(i + "_char", u, 63, 4, 37, 36, "absolute"), util_draw_text_html(t[n].name, i + "_name", 111, 9, 198, 26, 26, 16, "center", "#1a1a1a"), o = t[n].TOT + TXT.short_tot + t[n].WIN + TXT.short_win + t[n].DRAW + TXT.short_draw + t[n].LOSE + TXT.short_lose, util_draw_text_html(o, i + "_history", 326, 9, 274, 26, 26, 16, "center", "#1a1a1a"), t[n].me_flag == 1 && (utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos(i + "_bg", S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.img_url + "guild_mhistory_list3.png", 0, 0), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos(i + "_highlight", S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.img_url + "guild_mhistory_list_me.png", -35, -3))
};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.scroll_frame = function() {
  var n = "GU_WR_list" + this.cur_tab + "_frame",
    t = (this.cur_page[this.cur_tab] - 1) * -490;
  $("#" + n).css("top", t)
};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.make_screen_btn = function() {
  var n = !glo.APP_FEATURE.TOUCH_PLATFORM;
  n && ($("#GU_WR_back_btn").css({
    left: "11px",
    top: "619px",

    height: "89px",

  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("GU_WR_help_btn_focus", S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.img_url + "button_back_focus.png", 1, -1)
};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.drawFocus = function() {
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  $(".focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $(".highlight").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $(".highlight_bg").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $(".unlight").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  var n = S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.focus;
  switch (n) {
    case 1:
      $("#GU_WR_tab1_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      $("#GU_WR_tab1_title").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $("#GU_WR_list1_frame").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      $("#GU_WR_list2_frame").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $("#GU_WR_list3_frame").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      this.cur_tab = n;
      this.cur_page[n] = 1;
      S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.make_screen_tab1();
      S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.make_screen_page();
      break;
    case 2:
      $("#GU_WR_tab2_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      $("#GU_WR_tab2_title").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $("#GU_WR_list1_frame").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $("#GU_WR_list2_frame").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      $("#GU_WR_list3_frame").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      this.cur_tab = n;
      this.cur_page[n] = 1;
      S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.make_screen_tab2();
      S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.make_screen_page();
      break;
    case 3:
      $("#GU_WR_tab3_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      $("#GU_WR_tab3_title").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $("#GU_WR_list1_frame").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $("#GU_WR_list2_frame").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $("#GU_WR_list3_frame").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      this.cur_tab = n;
      this.cur_page[n] = 1;
      S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.make_screen_tab3();
      S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.make_screen_page();
      break;
    case 4:
      $("#GU_WR_arrow_left_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      break;
    case 5:
      $("#GU_WR_arrow_right_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      break;
    case 6:
      $("#GU_WR_back_btn_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      break;
    case 7:
      $("#GU_WR_help_btn_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      })
  }
  $("#GU_WR_tab" + this.cur_tab + "_focus_bg").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  $("#GU_WR_tab" + this.cur_tab + "_title_highlight").css({
    display: "block"
  })
};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  var n = null;
  switch (this.focus) {
    case 4:
      n = "GU_WR_arrow_left";
      break;
    case 5:
      n = "GU_WR_arrow_right";
      break;
    case 6:
      n = "GU_WR_back_btn";
      break;
    case 7:
      n = "GU_WR_help_btn"
  }
  utilScale_xy_center(n, gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center(n, 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.menuRun_Run = function() {
  var n = S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.focus;
  switch (n) {
    case 4:
      this.cur_page[this.cur_tab] > 1 && (this.cur_page[this.cur_tab]--, this.update_page());
      break;
    case 5:
      this.cur_page[this.cur_tab] < this.tot_page[this.cur_tab] && (this.cur_page[this.cur_tab]++, this.update_page());
      break;
    case 6:
      S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.run_back();
      break;
    case 7:
      S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.popup_HELP()
  }
};

S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.end = function() {
  S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.addMouseEvent = function() {};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.removeMouseEvent = function() {};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) switch (n.target.parentElement.id) {
    case "GU_WR_tab1":
    case "GU_WR_tab2":
    case "GU_WR_tab3":
    case "GU_WR_arrow_left":
    case "GU_WR_arrow_right":
    case "GU_WR_back_btn":
    case "GU_WR_help_btn":
      S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.menuRun_Run()
  }
};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    utilConsoleLog("1-onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   e.target.parentElement.id:" + n.target.parentElement.id);
    switch (n.target.parentElement.id) {
      case "GU_WR_tab1":
        this.focus = 1;
        this.drawFocus();
        break;
      case "GU_WR_tab2":
        this.focus = 2;
        this.drawFocus();
        break;
      case "GU_WR_tab3":
        this.focus = 3;
        this.drawFocus();
        break;
      case "GU_WR_arrow_left":
        this.focus = 4;
        this.drawFocus();
        break;
      case "GU_WR_arrow_right":
        this.focus = 5;
        this.drawFocus();
        break;
      case "GU_WR_back_btn":
        this.focus = 6;
        this.drawFocus();
        break;
      case "GU_WR_help_btn":
        this.focus = 7;
        this.drawFocus()
    }
  }
};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.onMouseover_pressed = function(n, t, i, r) {
  Main.onMouseover_pressed(n, t, i, r)
};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  switch (n.target.parentElement.id) {
    case "GU_WR_tab1":
    case "GU_WR_tab2":
    case "GU_WR_tab3":
    case "GU_WR_arrow_left":
    case "GU_WR_arrow_right":
    case "GU_WR_back_btn":
    case "GU_WR_help_btn":
      S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.onMouseover_pressed(n.target.parentElement.id)
  }
  S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilScale_xy_center_classid("button", 1, 1);
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.backKey()
};
S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.init_img_url = function() {
  S_GUILD_BATTLE_WEEK_RANK.img_url = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("GUILD") + "image/ui/49_guild/"
};

  img_url_gb: "",
  img_url_guild: "",
  img_url_ui2025: "",
  sceneType: 0,
  btn_focus: "enter",
  period_timer: null,
  cur_assets: null,

S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.get_boss_assets = function(n) {
  var t = parseInt(n, 10);
  return t == 5 ? {
    bg: "boss_bg5.jpg",
    bgbox: "boss_bgbox_50_5.png",
    img: "boss_img5.png",
    scroll_color: "#945700"
  } : t == 6 ? {
    bg: "boss_bg6.jpg",
    bgbox: "boss_bgbox_50_6.png",
    img: "boss_img6.png",
    scroll_color: "#073d22"
  } : {
    bg: "boss_bg7.jpg",
    bgbox: "boss_bgbox_50_7.png",
    img: "boss_img7.png",
    scroll_color: "#b35d00"
  }
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.preload = function() {
  var t = S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.img_url_gb,
    n = S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.img_url_guild,
    u = S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.img_url_ui2025,
    i = json_secure.get("guild_boss_lobby"),
    f = i && i.boss_no ? parseInt(i.boss_no, 10) : 7,
    r = S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.get_boss_assets(f),

S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.run_dev_action = function(n) {
  if (typeof gAPP_RELEASE != "undefined" && gAPP_RELEASE === "TEST") {
    var t = json_secure.get("guild_data");
    t != null && (gEnableKey = 0, ServerConnection.update_guild({
      guild_name: t.guild_name,
      act: n
    }, "guild_boss", function(t) {
      if (t == null || t.result !== "ok") {
        utilNotice("DEV " + n + " 실패: " + (t ? t.result : "null"), 2);
        gEnableKey = 1;
        return
      }
      n === "dev_change_boss" ? utilNotice(TXT.guild_boss_dev_toast_boss + t.boss_no + "번", 1.2) : utilNotice(TXT.guild_boss_dev_toast_stage + t.next_stage + "단계", 1.2);
      t.lobby && json_secure.set("guild_boss_lobby", t.lobby);
      S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.run_back()
    }))
  }
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.draw_dynamic = function() {
  var n = json_secure.get("guild_boss_lobby"),
    c, e, u, k, d, o, s, g, l, rt, f, a, v, ut, p, w, t, b, i, et, r, h, ot, it;
  if (n == null || n.result !== "ok") {
    utilNotice("Error - GBL d", 1);
    return
  }
  if (c = parseInt(n.boss_no, 10), e = S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.get_boss_assets(c), S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.cur_assets = e, $("#Img_GU_BOSS_background").attr("src", S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.img_url_gb + e.bg), $("#Img_GU_BOSS_bgbox").attr("src", S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.img_url_gb + e.bgbox), $("#Img_GU_BOSS_image").attr("src", S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.img_url_gb + e.img), u = "#940000", c === 5 ? u = "#945700" : c === 6 && (u = "#073d22"), $("#GU_BOSS_my_dmg_label").css({
      color: u
    }), $("#GU_BOSS_my_damage").css({
      color: u
    }), $("#GU_BOSS_my_rank_label").css({
      color: u
    }), $("#GU_BOSS_my_rank").css({
      color: u
    }), n.active_stage <= 0) {
    if (d = 7, n.stages && n.stages.length > 0) {
      for (o = 0, s = 0; s < n.stages.length; s++) g = parseInt(n.stages[s].stage, 10), n.stages[s].cleared && g > o && (o = g);
      o > 0 && (d = o)
    }
    k = d + TXT.guild_boss_stage_cleared
  } else k = parseInt(n.active_stage, 10) + TXT.guild_boss_stage_progress;
  if ($("#GU_BOSS_stage_text").text(k), n.active_stage <= 0) l = TXT.guild_boss_defeated;
  else if (l = "0.0000%", n.stages)
    for (rt = parseInt(n.active_stage, 10), f = 0; f < n.stages.length; f++)
      if (parseInt(n.stages[f].stage, 10) === rt) {
        a = parseInt(n.stages[f].current_hp, 10);
        v = parseInt(n.stages[f].max_hp, 10);
        !isNaN(v) && v > 0 && !isNaN(a) && a >= 0 && (l = (a / v * 100).toFixed(4) + "%");
        break
      } $("#GU_BOSS_stage_state").text(l);
  $("#GU_BOSS_my_damage").text(utilGetNumber_withComma(parseInt(n.my_total_damage, 10)));
  parseInt(n.my_rank, 10) > 0 ? $("#GU_BOSS_my_rank").text(String(n.my_rank) + TXT.rank) : $("#GU_BOSS_my_rank").text("-");
  ut = USER.lang === LANG.KOREA ? TXT.times_suffix : "";
  $("#GU_BOSS_free_text").text(TXT.guild_boss_free_remain + " : " + parseInt(n.free_remain, 10) + ut);
  var ft = n.ranking || [],
    nt = S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.page_size,
    y = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(ft.length / nt));
  for (S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.total_pages = y, S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.cur_page < 1 && (S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.cur_page = 1), S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.cur_page > y && (S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.cur_page = y), p = S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.cur_page, w = 1; w <= 5; w++) $("#GU_BOSS_rank_flag_" + w).css({
    display: p === 1 ? "" : "none"
  });
  for (t = 1; t <= 30; t++)
    if (b = t >= 1 && t <= nt ? (p - 1) * nt + (t - 1) : -1, i = b >= 0 ? ft[b] : null, i) {
      $("#GU_BOSS_rank_row_" + t).css({
        display: "block",
        position: "relative",
        width: "1185px",
        height: "35px"
      });
      var tt = b + 1,
        st = tt <= 5 ? "#ffffff" : "#533525",
        ht = tt <= 5 ? "#bf0202" : "#533525",
        ct = tt <= 5 ? "#bf0202" : "#533525";
      for ($("#GU_BOSS_rank_no_" + t).text(i.rank), $("#GU_BOSS_rank_no_" + t).css({
          left: "59px",
          top: "0px",
          width: "29px",
          height: "31px",
          "line-height": "31px",
          "font-size": "18rem",
          "text-align": "center",
          color: st,
          position: "absolute"
        }), $("#GU_BOSS_rank_char_" + t).css({
          left: "151px",
          top: "5px",
          width: "200px",
          height: "22px",
          position: "absolute"
        }), et = i.user_chars && typeof i.user_chars == "string" ? i.user_chars.split("||") : [], r = 0; r < 5; r++) h = parseInt(et[r], 10), isNaN(h) || h <= 0 ? utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("GU_BOSS_rank_char_" + t + "_" + (r + 1), "", 9999, 9999) : (ot = glo.fun.get_img_url_ally(h) + "image/ui/4_game/char/ga_ally_" + h + ".jpg", utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("GU_BOSS_rank_char_" + t + "_" + (r + 1), ot, r * 38, 0)), utilScale_xy("GU_BOSS_rank_char_" + t + "_" + (r + 1), .3, .3);
      it = parse_platform_name_string(i.platform);
      $("#GU_BOSS_rank_name_" + t).text(String(glo.fun.set_mask_user_name(i.user_name, it)) + "(" + String(it) + ")");
      $("#GU_BOSS_rank_name_" + t).css({
        left: "368px",
        top: "0px",

        height: "31px",
        overflow: "hidden",

        "font-size": "18rem",

      });
      $("#GU_BOSS_rank_score_" + t).text(utilGetNumber_withComma(parseInt(i.total_damage, 10)));
      $("#GU_BOSS_rank_score_" + t).css({
        left: "597px",

        height: "31px",
        "line-height": "31px",
        "font-size": "18rem",
        "text-align": "center",
        color: ct,
        position: "absolute"
      })
    } else $("#GU_BOSS_rank_row_" + t).css({
      display: "none"
    });
  $("#GU_BOSS_left_scroll_text1").text(p);
  $("#GU_BOSS_left_scroll_text2").text(y)
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.make_screen_ranking_list = function(n) {
  n == "up" ? (gEnableKey = 0, utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("GU_BOSS_left_scroll_focus", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/42_cloud_garden/cloud_scrolltop_f.png", 779, 230), setTimeout(function() {
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("GU_BOSS_left_scroll_focus", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url_only_glo() + "image/ui/0_common/onepixel.png", 779, 230);
    gEnableKey = 1;
    S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.cur_page--;
    S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.draw_dynamic()
  }, 500)) : n == "down" && (gEnableKey = 0, utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("GU_BOSS_left_scroll_focus", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/42_cloud_garden/cloud_scrolldown_f.png", 779, 333), setTimeout(function() {
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("GU_BOSS_left_scroll_focus", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url_only_glo() + "image/ui/0_common/onepixel.png", 779, 230);
    gEnableKey = 1;
    S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.cur_page++;
    S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.draw_dynamic()
  }, 500))
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.btn_focus === "enter" ? S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.btn_focus = "back" : S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.btn_focus === "help" && (S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.btn_focus = "enter");
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.btn_focus === "back" ? S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.btn_focus = "enter" : S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.btn_focus === "enter" && (S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.btn_focus = "help");
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.cur_page > 1 && S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.make_screen_ranking_list("up");
      return;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.cur_page < S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.total_pages && S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.make_screen_ranking_list("down");
      return;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.menu_run();
      return;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.run_back();
      return
  }
  if (i == 66) {
    S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.run_dev_action("dev_change_boss");
    return
  }
  if (i == 83) {
    S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.run_dev_action("dev_next_stage");
    return
  }
  S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.drawFocus()
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.menu_run = function() {
  switch (S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.btn_focus) {
    case "back":
      S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.run_back();
      break;
    case "enter":
      S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.run_enter();
      break;
    case "help":
      S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.run_help()
  }
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.backKey()
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.backKey = function() {
  S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.end();
  $("#S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_GAME_SELECT, S_GUILD_GAME_SELECT)
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.run_enter = function() {
  var n = json_secure.get("guild_data"),
    t;
  n != null && (gEnableKey = 0, t = {
    guild_name: n.guild_name,
    act: "check_can_enter"
  }, ServerConnection.update_guild(t, "guild_boss", function(n) {
    if (gEnableKey = 1, n == null) {
      utilNotice("Error - GBC n", 1);
      return
    }
    utilConsoleLog("[run_enter check_can_enter] result=" + n.result + " free_remain=" + n.free_remain);
    switch (n.result) {
      case "ok":
        var t = parseInt(n.free_remain, 10);
        t > 0 ? S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.do_enter() : (S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.need_gold = parseInt(n.paid_entry_gold, 10) || 1e4, S_POPUPYN.focus = 1, S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.focus_none_all(), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN) : ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
          display: "block"
        }), S_POPUPYN.init()));
        break;
      case "gb-cap-reached":
        utilNotice(TXT.guild_boss_cap_reached, 1.5);
        break;
      case "gb-all-cleared":
      case "gb-day-cleared":
        utilNotice(TXT.guild_boss_all_cleared, 1.5);
        break;
      case "error-gb-settle-period":
        utilNotice(TXT.guild_boss_settle_period, 1.5);
        break;
      default:
        utilNotice("Error - GBC e | " + n.result, 1)
    }
  }))
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.do_enter = function() {
  var t = json_secure.get("guild_data");
  if (t != null) {
    gEnableKey = 0;
    var i = {
        guild_name: t.guild_name,
        act: "enter_battle",
        client_gold: parseInt(USER.gold, 10),
        client_ruby: parseInt(USER.ruby, 10),
        client_cloud: parseInt(USER.cloud_piece, 10)
      },
      n = !1,
      r = function(t) {
        if (!n) {
          if (n = !0, t == null) {
            utilNotice("Error - GBE n", 1);
            gEnableKey = 1;
            return
          }
          switch (t.result) {
            case "ok":
              S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.start_battle(t);
              break;
            case "gb-all-cleared":
              utilNotice(TXT.guild_boss_all_cleared, 1.5);
              gEnableKey = 1;
              break;
            case "gb-day-cleared":
              utilNotice(TXT.guild_boss_all_cleared, 1.5);
              gEnableKey = 1;
              break;
            case "gb-cap-reached":
              utilNotice(TXT.guild_boss_cap_reached, 1.5);
              gEnableKey = 1;
              break;
            case "gb-not-enough-gold":
              utilNotice(TXT.guild_boss_not_enough_gold, 1.5);
              gEnableKey = 1;
              break;
            case "error-gb-settle-period":
              utilNotice(TXT.guild_boss_settle_period, 1.5);
              gEnableKey = 1;
              break;
            default:
              utilNotice("Error - GBE e | " + t.result, 1);
              gEnableKey = 1
          }
        }
      };
    ServerConnection.update_guild(i, "guild_boss", r);
    setTimeout(function() {
      n || (n = !0, utilConsoleLog("[GB] do_enter TIMEOUT 5000ms — callback NOT received, key restored"), gEnableKey = 1)
    }, 5e3)
  }
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.start_battle = function(n) {
  var t = json_secure.get("guild_boss_lobby"),
    e = parseInt(n.stage, 10),
    i = -1,
    r = -1,
    u, f;
  if (t && t.stages)
    for (u = 0; u < t.stages.length; u++)
      if (parseInt(t.stages[u].stage, 10) === e) {
        i = parseInt(t.stages[u].max_hp, 10);
        r = parseInt(t.stages[u].current_hp, 10);
        break
      }(i <= 0 || isNaN(i)) && typeof n.stage_max_hp != "undefined" && (i = parseInt(n.stage_max_hp, 10));
  (r < 0 || isNaN(r)) && typeof n.stage_current_hp != "undefined" && (r = parseInt(n.stage_current_hp, 10));
  utilConsoleLog("[GB start_battle] enter_res.stage_current_hp=" + n.stage_current_hp + " enter_res.stage_max_hp=" + n.stage_max_hp + " → ctx.cur_hp=" + r + " ctx.max_hp=" + i);
  f = {
    week_id: parseInt(n.week_id, 10),
    boss_no: parseInt(n.boss_no, 10),
    stage: e,
    max_hp: i,
    cur_hp: r,
    used_type: n.used_type,
    battle_token: n.battle_token ? String(n.battle_token) : "",
    cap_pct: parseInt(n.cap_pct, 10) || 0,
    my_cap_remain_raw: typeof n.my_cap_remain_raw != "undefined" ? parseInt(n.my_cap_remain_raw, 10) : -1,
    my_cur_raw: typeof n.my_cur_raw != "undefined" ? parseInt(n.my_cur_raw, 10) : 0
  };
  json_secure.set("guild_boss_battle_ctx", f);
  S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.end();
  typeof S_GAME != "undefined" && S_GAME != null && (S_GAME.ranking_mode_prev_for_guild_boss = S_GAME.ranking_mode, S_GAME.ranking_mode = 9);
  typeof S_BOSS != "undefined" && S_BOSS != null && (S_BOSS.guild_boss_ctx = f, S_BOSS.stage = parseInt(f.boss_no, 10));
  document.getElementById("S_BOSS_div") == null && document.getElementById("MM_top") && $("#MM_top").after('<div id="S_BOSS_div"><\/div>');
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_BOSS, S_BOSS)
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.run_help = function() {
  S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.end();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_BOSS_HELP, S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP)

S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.drawFocus = function() {
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === gS_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY) {
    window.g.blink.value = 1;
    S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.focus_none_all();
    switch (S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.btn_focus) {
      case "back":
        $("#GU_BOSS_back_focus_img").css({

        break;
      case "enter":

S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.removeMouseEvent(), $("#S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY_div .button").mouseover(this.onMouseover).mouseout(this.onMouseout)))
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY_div .button").unbind("mouseover").unbind("mouseout")
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.changedTouches && n.changedTouches.length > 0 ? n.changedTouches[0].target : n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") return;
    if (glo.fun.has_class(t, "scroll_up_button")) {
      S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.cur_page > 1 && S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.make_screen_ranking_list("up");
      return
    }
    if (glo.fun.has_class(t, "scroll_down_button")) {
      S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.cur_page < S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.total_pages && S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.make_screen_ranking_list("down");
      return
    }
    if (glo.fun.has_class(t, "back_button")) S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.btn_focus = "back";
    else if (glo.fun.has_class(t, "enter_button")) S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.btn_focus = "enter";
    else if (glo.fun.has_class(t, "help_button")) S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.btn_focus = "help";
    else return;
    S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.drawFocus();
    S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.menu_run()
  }
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.onMouseover = function(n) {
  gMOUSE_USE && (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "back_button") ? S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.btn_focus = "back" : glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "enter_button") ? S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.btn_focus = "enter" : glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "help_button") && (S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.btn_focus = "help"), S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.drawFocus())
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.onMousedown = function(n) {
  S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.onMouseover(n)
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.onMouseup = function(n) {
  S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.onMouseover(n);
  S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY.onClick(n)
};

};

S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.drawFocus = function() {
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === gS_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP && (window.g.blink.value = 1, S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.focus_none_all(), S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.btn_focus === "yes" ? $("#GBEP_yes_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : $("#GBEP_no_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }))
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.removeMouseEvent(), $("#S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP_div .button").mouseover(this.onMouseover).mouseout(this.onMouseout)))
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP_div .button").unbind("mouseover").unbind("mouseout")
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.changedTouches && n.changedTouches.length > 0 ? n.changedTouches[0].target : n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") return;
    if (glo.fun.has_class(t, "yes_button")) S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.btn_focus = "yes";
    else if (glo.fun.has_class(t, "no_button")) S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.btn_focus = "no";
    else return;
    S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.drawFocus();
    S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.menu_run()
  }
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.onMouseover = function(n) {
  gMOUSE_USE && (glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "yes_button") ? S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.btn_focus = "yes" : glo.fun.has_class(n.target, "no_button") && (S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.btn_focus = "no"), S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.drawFocus())
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.onMousedown = function(n) {
  S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.onMouseover(n)
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.onMouseup = function(n) {
  S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.onMouseover(n);
  S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.onClick(n)
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.init_img_url = function() {
  S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.img_url_ui2025 = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025")
};
glo.fun.add_img_url_initor(S_GUILD_BOSS_ENTRY_POPUP.init_img_url);

S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.draw_page = function(n) {
  var h, o, c, f, i, l, s, a, t, u;
  if (S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.cur_page = n, n == 1) {
    if ($("#Img_GBHELP_bg_help").attr("src", S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.img_url_gb + "guildboss_help_bg1.png"), $("#GBHELP_p1_container").css({
        display: "block"
      }), $("#GBHELP_p2_container").css({
        display: "none"
      }), $("#GBHELP_page_num").text("1/2"), $("#GBHELP_p1_desc").html("- " + TXT.guild_boss_rule_1 + "<br>- " + TXT.guild_boss_rule_2 + "<br>- " + TXT.guild_boss_rule_3 + "<br>- " + TXT.guild_boss_rule_4 + "<br>- " + TXT.guild_boss_rule_5 + "<br>- " + TXT.guild_boss_rule_6), i = json_secure.get("guild_boss_help"), h = {
        3: 50,
        4: 40,
        5: 30,
        6: 20,
        7: 10
      }, i && i.data)
      for (t = 0; t < i.data.length; t++) o = parseInt(i.data[t].stage, 10), c = parseInt(i.data[t].cap_pct, 10), c > 0 && (h[o] = c);
    for (f = 3; f <= 7; f++) $("#GBHELP_p1_stage_" + f).text(f + TXT.guild_boss_stage_unit), $("#GBHELP_p1_pct_" + f).text(h[f] + "%")
  } else {
    if ($("#Img_GBHELP_bg_help").attr("src", S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.img_url_gb + "guildboss_help_bg2.png"), $("#GBHELP_p1_container").css({
        display: "none"
      }), $("#GBHELP_p2_container").css({
        display: "block"
      }), $("#GBHELP_page_num").text("2/2"), i = json_secure.get("guild_boss_help"), i == null || !i.data) return;
    for (l = !1, t = 0; t < i.data.length; t++)
      if (s = i.data[t].reward, s && s.cel_essn && parseInt(s.cel_essn, 10) > 0) {
        l = !0;
        break
      } for (l && $("#Img_GBHELP_bg_help").attr("src", S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.img_url_gb + "guildboss_help_bg2_v2.png"), a = [TXT.daydungeon_day1, TXT.daydungeon_day2, TXT.daydungeon_day3, TXT.daydungeon_day4, TXT.daydungeon_day5, TXT.daydungeon_day6, TXT.daydungeon_day7], t = 0; t < i.data.length && t < 7; t++) {
      var o = i.data[t],
        e = parseInt(o.stage, 10),
        r = e;
      $("#GBHELP_p2_stage_" + r).text(e);
      $("#GBHELP_p2_day_" + r).text(a[e - 1]);
      e === 1 ? $("#GBHELP_p2_cond_" + r).text("-") : $("#GBHELP_p2_cond_" + r).text(e - 1 + TXT.guild_boss_cond_after_clear);
      u = o.reward;
      $("#GBHELP_p2_v_gold_" + r).text(parseInt(u.gold_bar, 10));
      u.cel_essn && parseInt(u.cel_essn, 10) > 0 ? $("#GBHELP_p2_v_cloud_" + r).text(parseInt(u.cel_essn, 10)) : $("#GBHELP_p2_v_cloud_" + r).text(parseInt(u.cloud, 10));
      $("#GBHELP_p2_v_ruby_" + r).text(parseInt(u.ruby, 10));
      $("#GBHELP_p2_v_score_" + r).text(utilGetNumber_withComma(parseInt(u.contribution, 10)))
    }
    $("#GBHELP_p2_settle_desc").html(TXT.guild_boss_help_settle_1 + "<br>" + TXT.guild_boss_help_settle_2 + "<br>" + TXT.guild_boss_help_settle_3 + "<br>" + TXT.guild_boss_help_settle_4)
  }
  n == 1 ? ($("#GBHELP_prev_btn").css({
    opacity: .3
  }), $("#GBHELP_next_btn").css({
    opacity: 1
  })) : ($("#GBHELP_prev_btn").css({
    opacity: 1
  }), $("#GBHELP_next_btn").css({
    opacity: .3
  }))
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.cur_page > 1 && S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.draw_page(S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.cur_page - 1);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.cur_page < 2 && S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.draw_page(S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.cur_page + 1);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.run_back();
      return
  }
  S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.drawFocus()
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.backKey()
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.backKey = function() {
  S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.end();
  $("#S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY, S_GUILD_BOSS_LOBBY)
};

  }))

  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.removeMouseEvent())
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  !gMOUSE_USE
};
S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.changedTouches && n.changedTouches.length > 0 ? n.changedTouches[0].target : n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") return;
    glo.fun.has_class(t, "close_button") ? S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.run_back() : glo.fun.has_class(t, "prev_button") ? S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.cur_page > 1 && S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.draw_page(S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.cur_page - 1) : glo.fun.has_class(t, "next_button") && S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.cur_page < 2 && S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.draw_page(S_GUILD_BOSS_HELP.cur_page + 1)
  }
};

S_POPUPTOT.init = function() {
  if (util.log("S_POPUPTOT.init()"), S_POPUPTOT.focus = 1, S_POPUPTOT.define == null) {
    console.error("S_POPUPTOT.define is null, 호출되기전에 define을 정의한후 호출해야 함.!!");
    return
  }
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_POPUPTOT) {
    util.log("Error in S_POPUPTOT.init()!: 아마도 연속키에 의한 POPUP이 따블 호출때문임. 근본 해결책을 찾아야 함. 우선 예외처리");
    return
  }
  utilPush();
  S_POPUPTOT.define.txt_num = S_POPUPTOT.define.txt.length - 1;
  S_POPUPTOT.define.img_num = S_POPUPTOT.define.img.length - 1;
  S_POPUPTOT.define.btn_num = S_POPUPTOT.define.btn.length - 1;
  S_POPUPTOT.maketag();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_POPUPTOT;
  S_POPUPTOT.define.btn_move == null && (S_POPUPTOT.define.btn_move = "좌우키");
  S_POPUPTOT.define.base_focus == null && (S_POPUPTOT.define.base_focus = 1);
  S_POPUPTOT.focus = S_POPUPTOT.define.base_focus;
  S_POPUPTOT.make_screen();
  util.blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  setTimeout(function() {
    g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_POPUPTOT && (glo.enable_key = 1)
  }, 300);
  S_POPUPTOT.addMouseEvent()
};

S_POPUPTOT.maketag = function() {
  var t, i, r, u, n;
  for ($("#S_POPUPTOT_div").empty(), t = document.getElementById("S_POPUPTOT_div"), t == null && $("#S_POPUPYN_div").before('<div id="S_POPUPTOT_div"><\/div>'), t = document.getElementById("S_POPUPTOT_div"), i = "", n = 1; n <= S_POPUPTOT.define.img_num; n++) i += '<img id="PUT_img' + n + '">';
  for (r = "", n = 1; n <= S_POPUPTOT.define.txt_num; n++) r += '<div id="PUT_txt' + n + '"><\/div>';
  for (u = "", n = 1; n <= S_POPUPTOT.define.btn_num; n++) u += '<div id="PUT_btn' + n + '" class="button">\t<img id="PUT_btn' + n + '_bg">\t<img id="PUT_btn' + n + '_focus" class="focus">\t<div id="PUT_btn' + n + '_txt"><\/div><\/div>';
  t.innerHTML = '<div id="Img_PUT_bg"> <\/div><div id="PUT_board">\t\t<img id="PUT_board_bg">' + i + r + u + "<\/div>"
};
S_POPUPTOT.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_POPUPTOT.define.btn_move == "좌우키" && S_POPUPTOT.focus >= 2 && (S_POPUPTOT.focus--, S_POPUPTOT.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_POPUPTOT.define.btn_move == "좌우키" && S_POPUPTOT.focus < S_POPUPTOT.define.btn_num && (S_POPUPTOT.focus++, S_POPUPTOT.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_POPUPTOT.define.btn_move == "상하키" && S_POPUPTOT.focus >= 2 && (S_POPUPTOT.focus--, S_POPUPTOT.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_POPUPTOT.define.btn_move == "상하키" && S_POPUPTOT.focus < S_POPUPTOT.define.btn_num && (S_POPUPTOT.focus++, S_POPUPTOT.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_POPUPTOT.menu_run();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_POPUPTOT.back();
      try {
        eval(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene + ".draw_focus();")
      } catch (r) {
        util.log(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene + ".draw_focus()가 정의되지 않아 무시함.")
      }
  }
};
S_POPUPTOT.back = function() {
  S_POPUPTOT.end();
  $("#S_POPUPTOT_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = g_sceneinfo.before_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = gS_POPUPTOT;
  util.blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  switch (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene) {
    case gS_GUILD_BATTLE:
      S_GUILD_BATTLE.drawFocus();
      break;
    case gS_RANKING_BOSS:
      S_RANKING_BOSS.drawFocus();
      break;
    case gS_RANKING_PVP:
      S_RANKING_PVP.drawFocus();
      break;
    case gS_RANKING:
      S_RANKING.drawFocus()
  }
};
S_POPUPTOT.make_screen = function() {
  var t, n, i;
  for ($("#Img_PUT_bg").css({

    }), $("#PUT_board").css({

    }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("PUT_board_bg", S_POPUPTOT.define.board.fname, 0, 0), i = 1; i <= S_POPUPTOT.define.img_num; i++) t = "PUT_img" + i, n = S_POPUPTOT.define.img[i], utilDrawImage(t, n.fname, n.x, n.y, n.w, n.h, "absolute");
  for (i = 1; i <= S_POPUPTOT.define.txt_num; i++) t = "PUT_txt" + i, n = S_POPUPTOT.define.txt[i], document.getElementById(t).innerHTML = n.title, $("#" + t).css({

    "text-shadow": n.text_shadow,
    position: "absolute"
  }), n.bg && $("#" + t).css({
    "background-color": n.bg
  }), n.border && $("#" + t).css({
    border: n.border,
    "box-sizing": "border-box"
  }), g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_GONGJI && glo.flag.first_tutorial == !0 && $("#" + t).css({
    "font-family": "sans-serif"
  });
  for (i = 1; i <= S_POPUPTOT.define.btn_num; i++) t = "PUT_btn" + i, n = S_POPUPTOT.define.btn[i], $("#" + t).css({
    left: n.x,

    "line-height": n.txt.lineheight + "px",

  })), g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_GONGJI && glo.flag.first_tutorial == !0 && $("#" + t + "_txt").css({
    "font-family": "sans-serif"
  }), util.draw_image_no_wh_pos(t + "_focus", n.focusname, n.fx, n.fy), $("#" + t + "_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  S_POPUPTOT.drawFocus()
};
S_POPUPTOT.drawFocus = function() {
  ($(".focus").css({
    display: "none"
  }), gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.IOS) && $("#PUT_btn" + S_POPUPTOT.focus + "_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  })
};
S_POPUPTOT.menu_run = function() {
  var n = glo.enable_key;
  glo.enable_key = 0;
  utilScale_xy_center("PUT_btn" + S_POPUPTOT.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("PUT_btn" + S_POPUPTOT.focus, 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      glo.enable_key = n;
      S_POPUPTOT.menu_run_run()
    }, glo.KeyUpTime)
  }, glo.KeyPressTime)
};
S_POPUPTOT.menu_run_run = function() {
  if (S_POPUPTOT.define.btn != null) {
    var n = S_POPUPTOT.define.btn[S_POPUPTOT.focus].callbackfn;
    n()
  }
};
S_POPUPTOT.end = function() {
  S_POPUPTOT.define = null;
  S_POPUPTOT.removeMouseEvent()
};

S_POPUPTOT.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_POPUPTOT_div").unbind("mouseover")
};

    case "PUT_btn1":
    case "PUT_btn2":
    case "PUT_btn3":
    case "PUT_btn4":
    case "PUT_btn5":
    case "PUT_btn6":
    case "PUT_btn7":
    case "PUT_btn8":
      Main.onMouseover_pressed(n.target.parentElement.id);
      S_POPUPTOT.onMouseover(n)
  }
};
S_POPUPTOT.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilScale_xy_center_classid("button", 1, 1);
  switch (n.target.parentElement.id) {
    case "PUT_btn1":
    case "PUT_btn2":
    case "PUT_btn3":
    case "PUT_btn4":
    case "PUT_btn5":
    case "PUT_btn6":
    case "PUT_btn7":
    case "PUT_btn8":
      S_POPUPTOT.menu_run_run()
  }
};
S_POPUPTOT.onMouseover = function(n) {
  switch (n.target.parentElement.id) {
    case "PUT_btn1":
      S_POPUPTOT.focus = 1;
      S_POPUPTOT.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "PUT_btn2":
      S_POPUPTOT.focus = 2;
      S_POPUPTOT.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "PUT_btn3":
      S_POPUPTOT.focus = 3;
      S_POPUPTOT.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "PUT_btn4":
      S_POPUPTOT.focus = 4;
      S_POPUPTOT.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "PUT_btn5":
      S_POPUPTOT.focus = 5;
      S_POPUPTOT.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "PUT_btn6":
      S_POPUPTOT.focus = 6;
      S_POPUPTOT.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "PUT_btn7":
      S_POPUPTOT.focus = 7;
      S_POPUPTOT.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "PUT_btn8":
      S_POPUPTOT.focus = 8;
      S_POPUPTOT.drawFocus()
  }
};

S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.get_set_status = function(n, t) {
  try {
    Main.use_android_bridge() && (S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.honeygain_opt_status = android_bridge.honeygain_opted(n, t))
  } catch (i) {}
};
S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.drawFocus = function() {
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  $("#PYH_btn_focus").show();
  var n = parseInt($("#PYH_btn1").css("left"), 10),
    t = parseInt($("#PYH_btn1").css("top"), 10),
    i = parseInt($("#PYH_btn2").css("left"), 10),
    r = parseInt($("#PYH_btn2").css("top"), 10);
  S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.focus == 1 ? utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("PYH_btn_focus", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/1_mainmenu/mm_mainbt_focus.png", n, t) : utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("PYH_btn_focus", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/1_mainmenu/mm_mainbt_focus.png", i, r)
};
S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.focus) {
    case 1:
      utilScale_xy_center("PYH_btn1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("PYH_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 2:
      utilScale_xy_center("PYH_btn2", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("PYH_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("PYH_btn1", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("PYH_btn2", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("PYH_btn_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.menuRun_Run = function() {
  Main.showSafeZone();
  switch (S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.focus) {
    case 1:
      switch (S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.popup_type) {
        case 1:
          S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.define.text_num = 2;
          S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.popup_type = 2;
          S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.make_screen();
          break;
        case 2:
          S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.get_set_status("opt_on_off", "on");
          S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.opt_in_count++;
          S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.define.text_num = 3;
          S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.popup_type = 3;
          S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.make_screen();
          break;
        case 3:
          S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.back();
          break;
        case 4:
          S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.get_set_status("opt_on_off", "off");
          S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.define.text_num = 3;
          S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.popup_type = 3;
          S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.make_screen()
      }
      break;
    case 2:
      S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.back()
  }
};
S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.end = function() {
  $("#S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN_div").remove();
  S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } utilConsoleLog("S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.onClick  elm.id: " + t.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id + "    gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey);
    (n.target.id == "PYH_btn1" || n.target.id == "PYH_btn2" || n.target.id == "PYH_btn_focus") && S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.menuRun()
  }
};
S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.onMouseover = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog("S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id + "    gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey);
  switch (n.target.id) {
    case "PYH_btn1":
      S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.focus = 1;
      S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.drawFocus();
      return;
    case "PYH_btn2":
      S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.focus = 2;
      S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.drawFocus();
      return
  }
};
S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.onMouseover(n);
  S_POPUP_HONEYGAIN.onClick(n);
  return
};

S_EXITPOPUP.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  if ((gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && (S_EXITPOPUP.type == 1 || S_EXITPOPUP.type == 2 || S_EXITPOPUP.type == 3 || S_EXITPOPUP.type == 4)) switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_EXITPOPUP.menuRun()
  } else switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_EXITPOPUP.focus >= 2 && (S_EXITPOPUP.focus = 1, S_EXITPOPUP.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_EXITPOPUP.focus <= 1 && (S_EXITPOPUP.focus = 2, S_EXITPOPUP.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_EXITPOPUP.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_EXITPOPUP.back()
  }
};
S_EXITPOPUP.start = function(n, t) {
  if (typeof t == "string" && (S_EXITPOPUP.msg = t), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT && n == 1) {
    S_ERROR_NETWORK.forceSceneChange();
    return
  }
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_EXITPOPUP) {
    utilConsoleLog("S_EXITPOPUP 나왔는데 또 나오라고 하는 거는 심한거 아이가?");
    return
  }
  if (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) {
    switch (n) {
      case 1:
        S_EXITPOPUP.type = 1;
        utilKeyDefine();
        break;
      case 2:
        S_EXITPOPUP.type = 2;
        utilKeyDefine();
        break;
      case 3:
        S_EXITPOPUP.type = 3;
        utilKeyDefine();
        break;
      case 4:
        glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? S_EXITPOPUP.type = 0 : (S_EXITPOPUP.type = 4, utilKeyDefine());
        break;
      case 0:
      default:
        S_EXITPOPUP.type = 0
    }
    utilConsoleLog("cur_scene=" + g_sceneinfo.cur_scene + "   type :" + S_EXITPOPUP.type)
  }
  S_EXITPOPUP.backup_before_scene = g_sceneinfo.before_scene;
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && is_autoplay_stop() == !1 && window[g_sceneinfo.cur_scene].pause();
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_EXITPOPUP_div").css({
    display: "block"
  }), S_EXITPOPUP.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_EXITPOPUP, S_EXITPOPUP)
};
S_EXITPOPUP.back = function() {
  S_EXITPOPUP.back_cloud_garden();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene === gS_GAME && S_POPUPYN.back_game();
  Main.showSafeZone();
  S_EXITPOPUP.end();
  $("#S_EXITPOPUP_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = g_sceneinfo.before_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = S_EXITPOPUP.backup_before_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_CLOUD_GARDEN || g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === gS_GAME || window[g_sceneinfo.cur_scene].resume()
};

S_EXITPOPUP.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_EXITPOPUP.focus) {
    case 1:
      utilScale_xy_center("EPU_btn1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("EPU_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 2:
      utilScale_xy_center("EPU_btn2", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("EPU_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("EPU_btn1", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("EPU_btn2", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("EPU_btn_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_EXITPOPUP.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_EXITPOPUP.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (S_EXITPOPUP.focus == 1) {
    if ((gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && (S_EXITPOPUP.type == 1 || S_EXITPOPUP.type == 2 || S_EXITPOPUP.type == 3 || S_EXITPOPUP.type == 4)) util_CNM_exit();
    else if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR) util_tizen.exitApplication();
    else if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) util_CNM_exit();
    else if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT) util_kt.destroyApplication();
    else if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV) {
      var n = history.length;
      history.go(-n);
      window.close()
    } else if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) util_toss.close();
    else if (glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) try {
      Main.use_android_bridge() && android_bridge.finish()
    } catch (t) {} else if (glo.fun.is_glo_platform()) {
      location.reload(!0);
      return
    }
  } else S_EXITPOPUP.back()
};
S_EXITPOPUP.end = function() {
  S_EXITPOPUP.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_EXITPOPUP.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_EXITPOPUP.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_EXITPOPUP.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_EXITPOPUP.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } S_EXITPOPUP.menuRun()
  }
};
S_EXITPOPUP.onMouseover = function(n) {
  switch (n.target.id) {
    case "EPU_btn1":
      S_EXITPOPUP.focus = 1;
      S_EXITPOPUP.drawFocus();
      return;
    case "EPU_btn2":
      S_EXITPOPUP.focus = 2;
      S_EXITPOPUP.drawFocus();
      return;
    case "EPU_btn_focus":
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog(" please id check  onMouseover==>1-onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id)
  }
};
S_EXITPOPUP.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_EXITPOPUP.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_EXITPOPUP.onMouseover(n)
};
S_EXITPOPUP.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_EXITPOPUP.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_EXITPOPUP.onMouseover(n);
  S_EXITPOPUP.onClick(n)
};

S_PAYMENT_CNM.init_after = function() {
  var n, t, i, r, u;
  if (S_EVENT.status > 0) {
    S_PAYMENT_CNM.init_after_event();
    return
  }
  if (S_PACKAGE_ITEM.status == 1) {
    S_PAYMENT_CNM.init_after_package();
    return
  }
  if (S_PAYMENT_CNM.status = 1, S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus = 1, S_PAYMENT_CNM.password = "", S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count = 0, gEntrix.pw_check_result = 0, (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB) && S_PAYMENT_CNM.maketag(), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB && g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_AUTOPLAY_PAID) {
    S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.id = "auto_play";
    S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.won = "2,200원";
    S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.name = "자동 플레이";
    S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.pid = "6603128";
    S_PAYMENT_CNM.make_screen();
    blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
    return
  }
  if (glo.VER_DATE >= "20260518" && S_GACHA.tab_focus == 2 || S_GACHA.tab_focus == 3) {
    u = S_GACHA.tab_focus == 3 ? glo.package.get_one_gacha_item(S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE.type_num) : glo.package.get_one_hero(S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE.type_num);
    i = parseInt(u.num);
    r = parseInt(u.id);
    S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.id = r;
    gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB ? (S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.won = u.displayPrice + "", S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.pid = r) : S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.won = u.costNoVat + "";
    S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.name = u.name;
    S_PAYMENT_CNM.make_screen();
    blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
    return
  }
  if (n = S_PACKAGE_STORE.focus_arr[S_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_focus], S_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_focus == 4) S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.id = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW2[n].ruby, S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.won = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW2[n].won, S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.name = "루비 " + MARKET_DESIGN.ROW2[n].ruby + "개", gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB && (S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.pid = MARKET_DESIGN.ROW2[n].pid);
  else if (S_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_focus == 3) t = glo.package.get_package_list(USER.lang), i = parseInt(t[n - 1].num), r = parseInt(t[n - 1].id), S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.id = 2e3 + i, S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.won = r == "2001" && glo.package.is_show_month_sub_price() ? "월" + glo.package.get_diaplsy_price_package(i) : gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN ? utilGetNumber_withComma(glo.package.get_price_package(i)) + "원" : glo.package.get_diaplsy_price_package(i), S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.name = glo.package.get_package_name(i), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB && (S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.pid = t[n - 1].id);
  else if (S_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_focus == 2) glo.VER_DATE >= "20260518" ? (t = glo.package.get_monthly_package_list(USER.lang), i = parseInt(t[n - 1].num), r = parseInt(t[n - 1].id), S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.won = glo.package.get_diaplsy_price_package(i), S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.name = glo.package.get_package_name(i), S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.pid = r, S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.id = r) : (t = glo.package.get_hero_list(), i = parseInt(t[n - 1].num), r = parseInt(t[n - 1].id), S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.id = 2e3 + i, gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB ? (S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.won = t[n - 1].displayPrice + "", S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.pid = t[n - 1].id) : S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.won = t[n - 1].costNoVat + "", S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.name = t[n - 1].name);
  else {
    if (S_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_focus == 6) {
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.init_after_package();
      return
    }
    utilConsoleLog("Error in S_PAYMENT_CNM.init();");

  }
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.make_screen();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)
};
S_PAYMENT_CNM.init_after_event = function() {
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.status = 1;
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus = 1;
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.password = "";
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count = 0;
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.adult_display = 0;
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.monthly_display = 0;
  gEntrix.pw_check_result = 0;
  switch (S_EVENT.status) {
    case 1:
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.id = "goods_2";
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.won = gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN ? "3,000원" : "3,300원";
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.gold = "0골드";
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.ruby = "100개";
      break;
    case 2:
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.id = "goods_3";
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.won = gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN ? "5,000원" : "5,500원";
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.gold = "0골드";
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.ruby = "150개";
      break;
    case 3:
      var n = S_EVENT.ONE_CHANCE_STEP_INFO[S_EVENT.one_chance_step];
      n || (utilConsoleLog("Error in S_PAYMENT_CNM.init_after_event(): one_chance_step=" + S_EVENT.one_chance_step), n = S_EVENT.ONE_CHANCE_STEP_INFO[1]);
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.id = n.sub_id;
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB ? (S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.won = n.won_skb, S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.pid = n.skb_id) : S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.won = n.won;
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.name = S_EVENT.get_one_chance_package_name(S_EVENT.one_chance_step);
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.gold = "0골드";
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.ruby = "0개";
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error inS_PAYMENT_CNM.init_after_event();");
      utilNotice("Payment Error!", 1)
  }
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.maketag();
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.make_screen();
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.addMouseEvent();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)
};
S_PAYMENT_CNM.init_after_package = function() {
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.status = 1;
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus = 1;
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.password = "";
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count = 0;
  gEntrix.pw_check_result = 0;
  var n = S_PACKAGE_ITEM.focus;
  glo.APP_FEATURE.PACKAGE_STORE && (n = S_PACKAGE_STORE.focus_arr[S_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_focus]);
  switch (n) {
    case 1:
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.id = "goods_3";

      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.pid = PACKAGE_DESIGN.ROW1[n].pid != undefined ? PACKAGE_DESIGN.ROW1[n].pid : "";
      break;
    case 2:
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.id = "goods_5";
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.won = PACKAGE_DESIGN.ROW1[n].won;
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.name = "골드 " + utilGetNumber_withComma(PACKAGE_DESIGN.ROW1[n].gold + "") + "개";
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.pid = PACKAGE_DESIGN.ROW1[n].pid != undefined ? PACKAGE_DESIGN.ROW1[n].pid : "";
      break;
    case 3:
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.id = "goods_3";
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.won = PACKAGE_DESIGN.ROW1[n].won;
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.name = "루비 " + PACKAGE_DESIGN.ROW1[n].ruby + "개";
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.pid = PACKAGE_DESIGN.ROW1[n].pid != undefined ? PACKAGE_DESIGN.ROW1[n].pid : "";
      break;
    case 4:
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.id = "goods_5";

      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.name = "루비 " + PACKAGE_DESIGN.ROW1[n].ruby + "개";
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.pid = PACKAGE_DESIGN.ROW1[n].pid != undefined ? PACKAGE_DESIGN.ROW1[n].pid : ""
  }
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.maketag();
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.make_screen();
  S_PAYMENT_CNM.addMouseEvent();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)
};

S_PAYMENT_CNM.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    r;
  switch (this.status) {
    case 1:
      switch (i) {
        case 8:
          if (!S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_table_tv()) return;
        case KeyDefine.left:
          S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus == 3 && (S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus = 2, S_PAYMENT_CNM.drawFocus());
          (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus == 1 && S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count >= 1 && (utilConsoleLog("before:" + S_PAYMENT_CNM.password), S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count--, S_PAYMENT_CNM.password = S_PAYMENT_CNM.password.substr(0, S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count), utilConsoleLog("after:" + S_PAYMENT_CNM.password), S_PAYMENT_CNM.display_password(), S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_table_tv() && (document.getElementById("pininput").value = S_PAYMENT_CNM.password));
          break;
        case KeyDefine.right:
          S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus == 2 && (S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus = 3, S_PAYMENT_CNM.drawFocus());
          break;
        case KeyDefine.up:
          (S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus == 2 || S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus == 3) && (S_PAYMENT_CNM.password = "", S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count = 0, document.getElementById("PC_pw_input").innerHTML = "", S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus = 1, S_PAYMENT_CNM.drawFocus(), S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_table_tv() && S_PAYMENT_CNM.show_osk());
          break;
        case KeyDefine.down:
          S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus == 1 && (S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_table_tv() && S_PAYMENT_CNM.hide_osk(), S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus = 2, S_PAYMENT_CNM.drawFocus());
          break;
        case KeyDefine.enter:
          if (S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus == 3) {
            S_PAYMENT_CNM.back();
            return
          }
          if (S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus == 1 && S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count <= 3)
            if (S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_table_tv()) S_PAYMENT_CNM.hide_osk(), S_PAYMENT_CNM.password = "", S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count = 0, S_PAYMENT_CNM.display_password(), utilNotice("4자리 비밀번호를 입력해 주세요.", 1), S_PAYMENT_CNM.show_osk();
            else return;
          S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count == 4 ? (S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_table_tv() && S_PAYMENT_CNM.hide_osk(), S_PAYMENT_CNM.menuRun()) : (utilNotice("4자리 비밀번호를 입력해 주세요.", 1), S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus = 1, S_PAYMENT_CNM.password = "", S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count = 0, document.getElementById("PC_pw_input").innerHTML = "", S_PAYMENT_CNM.drawFocus(), S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_table_tv() && S_PAYMENT_CNM.show_osk());
          break;
        case KeyDefine.esc:
        case KeyDefine.back:
          S_PAYMENT_CNM.back();
          break;
        case KeyDefine.NUM0:
        case KeyDefine.NUM1:
        case KeyDefine.NUM2:
        case KeyDefine.NUM3:
        case KeyDefine.NUM4:
        case KeyDefine.NUM5:
        case KeyDefine.NUM6:
        case KeyDefine.NUM7:
        case KeyDefine.NUM8:
        case KeyDefine.NUM9:
          if (S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus != 1) return;
          r = i - KeyDefine.NUM0 + "";
          S_PAYMENT_CNM.password += r;
          S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count++;
          S_PAYMENT_CNM.display_password();
          S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count >= 4 && (S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus = 2, S_PAYMENT_CNM.drawFocus());
          break;
        case KeyDefine.ERASE:
          if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) {
            if (S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus != 1) return;
            S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count >= 1 && (utilConsoleLog("before:" + S_PAYMENT_CNM.password), S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count--, S_PAYMENT_CNM.password = S_PAYMENT_CNM.password.substr(0, S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count), utilConsoleLog("after:" + S_PAYMENT_CNM.password), S_PAYMENT_CNM.display_password())
          }
      }
      break;
    case 2:
    case 3:
    case 4:
    case 5:
      if (this.status == 5 && gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT) switch (i) {
        case KeyDefine.left:
          S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus == 2 && (S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus = 1, S_PAYMENT_CNM.drawFocus());
          break;
        case KeyDefine.right:
          S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus == 1 && (S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus = 2, S_PAYMENT_CNM.drawFocus());
          break;
        case KeyDefine.enter:
          S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus == 2 ? S_PAYMENT_CNM.back() : S_PAYMENT_CNM.menuRun()
      } else S_PAYMENT_CNM.menuRun();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_PAYMENT_CNM.maketag():" + this.status)
  }
};
S_PAYMENT_CNM.display_password = function() {
  var r = document.getElementById("PC_pw_input"),
    i = "O",
    n, t;
  for ((gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB) && (i = "*"), n = "", t = 1; t <= S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count; t++) n += i;
  r.innerHTML = n
};
S_PAYMENT_CNM.back = function() {
  if ($("#S_PAYMENT_CNM_div").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#S_PAYMENT_CNM_div").empty(), S_PAYMENT_CNM.status = 1, S_PACKAGE_ITEM.status == 1) {
    S_PACKAGE_ITEM.buy_package_item();
    return
  }
  if (S_EVENT.status > 0) {
    if (S_EVENT.status == 3) {
      S_EVENT.back();
      return
    }
    g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_EVENT;
    S_EVENT.resume()
  } else if (glo.APP_FEATURE.PACKAGE_STORE) {
    if (S_POPUP_PACKAGE_STORE.appen_node == "S_MAINMENU_div" || g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_AUTOPLAY_PAID) g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MAINMENU, gEnableKey = 1, S_MAINMENU.resume(), ServerConnection.get_reward2_mailbox(S_MAINMENU.check_reward_mailbox);
    else {
      if (glo.VER_DATE >= "20260518" && (S_GACHA.tab_focus == 2 || S_GACHA.tab_focus == 3)) {
        g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_GACHA;
        gEnableKey = 1;
        S_GACHA.resume();
        Main.showSafeZone();
        return
      }
      S_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_focus == 5 && S_PACKAGE_STORE.buy_package_item();
      g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_PACKAGE_STORE;
      S_PACKAGE_STORE.resume()
    }
    Main.showSafeZone()
  } else S_PACKAGE_ITEM.status == 1 && (S_PACKAGE_ITEM.end(), $("#S_PACKAGE_ITEM_div").css({
    display: "none"
  })), S_MARKETSTORE.addMouseEvent(), g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MARKETSTORE, blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene), $("#MS_menu_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }), Main.showSafeZone()
};

  });
  switch (this.status) {
    case 1:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT ? (this.make_screen_1_kt(), S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_table_tv() && (document.getElementById("pininput").style.display = "block", document.getElementById("pininput").focus(), document.getElementById("pininput").oninput = function() {

        n.length > 4 ? (S_PAYMENT_CNM.hide_osk(), S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus = 2, S_PAYMENT_CNM.drawFocus()) : n.length < 4 ? (S_PAYMENT_CNM.password = n, S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count = n.length, S_PAYMENT_CNM.display_password()) : (S_PAYMENT_CNM.password = n, S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count = n.length, S_PAYMENT_CNM.display_password(), S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus = 2, S_PAYMENT_CNM.drawFocus(), S_PAYMENT_CNM.hide_osk())
      })) : this.make_screen_1();
      break;
    case 2:

        this.make_screen_3_kt();
        break
      }
    case 5:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT ? this.make_screen_5_kt() : this.make_screen_2345();
      break;
    case 4:
      this.make_screen_2345();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_PAYMENT_CNM.maketag():" + this.status)
  }

};

S_PAYMENT_CNM.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (this.status) {
    case 1:
      switch (S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus) {
        case 2:
          utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
          utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
          break;
        case 3:
          utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn2", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
          utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
      }
      setTimeout(function() {
        utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn1", 1, 1);
        utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn2", 1, 1);
        utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn_focus", 1, 1);
        setTimeout(function() {
          gEnableKey = 1;
          S_PAYMENT_CNM.menuRun_Run()
        }, gKeyUpTime)
      }, gKeyPressTime);
      break;
    case 2:
    case 3:
    case 4:
    case 5:
      if (this.status == 5 && gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT) {
        switch (S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus) {
          case 1:
            utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
            utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
            break;
          case 2:
            utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn2", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
            utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
        }
        setTimeout(function() {
          utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn1", 1, 1);
          utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn2", 1, 1);
          utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn_focus", 1, 1);
          setTimeout(function() {
            gEnableKey = 1;
            S_PAYMENT_CNM.menuRun_Run()
          }, gKeyUpTime)
        }, gKeyPressTime)
      } else utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale), utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale), setTimeout(function() {
        utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn1", 1, 1);
        utilScale_xy_center("PC_btn_focus", 1, 1);
        setTimeout(function() {
          gEnableKey = 1;
          S_PAYMENT_CNM.menuRun_Run()
        }, gKeyUpTime)
      }, gKeyPressTime);
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_PAYMENT_CNM.maketag():" + this.status)
  }
};
S_PAYMENT_CNM.menuRun_Run = function() {
  var n;
  switch (this.status) {
    case 1:
      switch (S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus) {
        case 1:
          utilNotice("4자리수 입력 바랍니다.", 2);
          S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_table_tv() && (S_PAYMENT_CNM.hide_osk(), S_PAYMENT_CNM.password = "", S_PAYMENT_CNM.pw_count = 0, S_PAYMENT_CNM.display_password(), utilNotice("4자리 비밀번호를 입력해 주세요.", 1), S_PAYMENT_CNM.show_osk());
          break;
        case 2:
          if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB) {
            Main.use_android_bridge() && (S_PAYMENT_CNM.old_ruby = USER.ruby, android_bridge.request_payment(S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.pid, S_PAYMENT_CNM.password));
            return
          }
          if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN)
            if (glo.APP_FEATURE.PACKAGE_STORE) S_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_focus == 5 ? (n = parseInt(window.g.timestamp_start, 10) + parseInt(window.g.timestamp_due, 10), S_PACKAGE_STORE.start_time <= n && n <= S_PACKAGE_STORE.end_time ? gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.KT ? S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_right_password_kt() : S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_right_password() : (utilNotice(TXT.not_buy_period, 1.5), S_PAYMENT_CNM.end(), $("#S_PAYMENT_CNM_div").css({
              display: "none"
            }), $("#S_PAYMENT_CNM_div").empty(), S_PACKAGE_STORE.buy_package_item())) : gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.KT ? S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_right_password_kt() : S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_right_password();
            else {
              if (S_PACKAGE_ITEM.status == 1) {
                n = parseInt(window.g.timestamp_start, 10) + parseInt(window.g.timestamp_due, 10);
                S_PACKAGE_ITEM.start_time <= n && n <= S_PACKAGE_ITEM.end_time ? gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.KT ? S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_right_password_kt() : S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_right_password() : (utilNotice(TXT.not_buy_period, 1.5), S_PAYMENT_CNM.end(), $("#S_PAYMENT_CNM_div").css({
                  display: "none"
                }), $("#S_PAYMENT_CNM_div").empty(), S_PACKAGE_ITEM.buy_package_item());
                return
              }
              gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.KT ? S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_right_password_kt() : S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_right_password()
            }
          else S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_right_password();
          break;
        case 3:
          S_PAYMENT_CNM.back()
      }
      break;
    case 2:
    case 5:
      this.status == 5 && gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT ? (S_PAYMENT_CNM.status = 1, S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus = 1, S_PAYMENT_CNM.maketag(), S_PAYMENT_CNM.init()) : S_PAYMENT_CNM.back();
      break;
    case 3:
      S_PAYMENT_CNM.init();
      break;
    case 4:
      if (S_PACKAGE_ITEM.status == 1) {
        S_PAYMENT_CNM.end();
        $("#S_PAYMENT_CNM_div").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        $("#S_PAYMENT_CNM_div").empty();
        S_PACKAGE_ITEM.buy_package_item();
        return
      }
      S_EVENT.status > 0 ? (S_PAYMENT_CNM.end(), $("#S_PAYMENT_CNM_div").css({
        display: "none"
      }), $("#S_PAYMENT_CNM_div").empty(), S_EVENT.back()) : (S_PAYMENT_CNM.end(), S_PAYMENT_CNM.back(), S_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_focus == 5 && (S_PACKAGE_STORE.buy_package_item(), S_PACKAGE_STORE.noti_limited_time_goods()));
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_PAYMENT_CNM.maketag():" + this.status)
  }
};
S_PAYMENT_CNM.is_right_password_kt = function() {
  var i, n, t;
  if (loading_show(), gEnableKey = 0, glo.APP_FEATURE.PACKAGE_STORE) {
    if (n = {
        pin: gEntrix.pin_number,
        pwd: S_PAYMENT_CNM.password,
        price: util_fun.dbl.getPriceNum(S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.won),
        ruby: S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.id
      }, S_EVENT.status == 0 && (i = S_PACKAGE_STORE.focus_arr[S_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_focus], S_PACKAGE_STORE.btn_focus == 5)) switch (i) {
      case 1:
        n.ruby = 1001;
        break;
      case 2:
        n.ruby = 1002;
        break;
      case 3:
        n.ruby = 1003;
        break;
      case 4:
        n.ruby = 1004
    }
    console.log(" oPay:" + JSON.stringify(n))
  } else if (n = {
      pin: gEntrix.pin_number,
      pwd: S_PAYMENT_CNM.password,
      price: util_fun.dbl.getPriceNum(S_PAYMENT_CNM.goods.won),
      ruby: MARKET_DESIGN.ROW2[S_MARKETSTORE.focus - 5].ruby
    }, S_PACKAGE_ITEM.status == 1) switch (S_PACKAGE_ITEM.focus) {
    case 1:
      n.ruby = 1001;
      break;
    case 2:
      n.ruby = 1002;
      break;
    case 3:
      n.ruby = 1003;
      break;
    case 4:
      n.ruby = 1004
  }
  util_kt.checkPaymentPwd(n, function(n, t) {
    utilConsoleLog("is_right_password_kt()  pwCheckResult:" + n);
    gEntrix.pw_check_result = Number(n);

  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    utilConsoleLog("1-onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
    switch (n.target.id) {
      case "PC_btn1":
        S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus = 1;
        S_PAYMENT_CNM.drawFocus();
        return;
      case "PC_btn2":
        S_PAYMENT_CNM.focus = 2;
        S_PAYMENT_CNM.drawFocus();
        return;
      case "PC_btn_focus":
        break;
      default:
        utilConsoleLog(" please id check  onMouseover==>1-onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id)
    }
  }
};

S_QUEST.define = function() {
  S_QUEST.focus = 1;
  S_QUEST.abs_focus = 1;
  S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x = 0;
  S_QUEST.row_focus = 1;
  S_QUEST.card_num = QUEST_NUM
};
S_QUEST.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_QUEST.row_focus == 2) {
        S_QUEST.btn_focus >= 2 && (S_QUEST.btn_focus--, S_QUEST.drawFocus_btnmenu());
        return
      }
      S_QUEST.focus >= 2 && (S_QUEST.focus = S_QUEST.focus - 1, S_QUEST.drawFocus(), S_QUEST.abs_focus >= 2 ? S_QUEST.abs_focus = S_QUEST.abs_focus - 1 : (S_QUEST.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x = S_QUEST.scroll_target_x, S_QUEST.scroll_flag = 0), S_QUEST.scroll_target_x = S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x + (S_QUEST.card_w + S_QUEST.card_gap), S_QUEST.scroll_left()));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_QUEST.row_focus == 2) {
        S_QUEST.btn_focus < 2 && (S_QUEST.btn_focus++, S_QUEST.drawFocus_btnmenu());
        return
      }
      S_QUEST.focus < S_QUEST.card_num && (S_QUEST.focus = S_QUEST.focus + 1, S_QUEST.drawFocus(), S_QUEST.abs_focus < QUEST_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? S_QUEST.abs_focus = S_QUEST.abs_focus + 1 : (S_QUEST.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x = S_QUEST.scroll_target_x, S_QUEST.scroll_flag = 0), S_QUEST.scroll_target_x = S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x - (S_QUEST.card_w + S_QUEST.card_gap), S_QUEST.scroll_right()));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_QUEST.row_focus == 2 && (S_QUEST.row_focus = 1, S_QUEST.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_QUEST.row_focus == 1 && (S_QUEST.row_focus = 2, S_QUEST.drawFocus_btnmenu());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_QUEST.row_focus == 2 ? S_QUEST.menuRun_btnmenu() : S_QUEST.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_QUEST.run_back()
  }
};
S_QUEST.interval_check_init = function() {
  var n;
  if (0) {
    n = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? new Date(parseInt(window.g.timestamp_start, 0) + parseInt(window.g.timestamp_due, 0)) : new Date;
    var r = n.getDay(),
      u = n.getHours(),
      i = n.getMinutes()
  } else var t = util_time.get_korea_time_info(),
    r = t.day_index,
    u = t.hour,
    i = t.minutes;
  r == 1 && parseInt(u) == 5 && 0 <= parseInt(i, 10) && parseInt(i, 10) <= 3 && (STORAGE.quest_init(), utilNotice(TXT.quest_init, 1.5), g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_QUESTDETAIL ? S_QUESTDETAIL.init() : g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_QUEST && S_QUEST.init(), glo.pvp.init_my_ranking_score());
  setTimeout(S_QUEST.interval_check_init, 6e4)
};
