S_QUEST.scroll_right = function() {
  S_QUEST.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_QUEST.scroll_right()!!");
  S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x = S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x - S_QUEST.scroll_speed * (S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x - S_QUEST.scroll_target_x);
  $("#s_QUEST_card").css({
    left: S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x > S_QUEST.scroll_target_x + 4 && S_QUEST.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_QUEST.scroll_right, 80) : (S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x = S_QUEST.scroll_target_x, S_QUEST.scroll_flag = 0)
};
S_QUEST.scroll_left = function() {
  S_QUEST.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_QUEST.scroll_right()!!");
  S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x = S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x + S_QUEST.scroll_speed * (S_QUEST.scroll_target_x - S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x);
  $("#s_QUEST_card").css({
    left: S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x < S_QUEST.scroll_target_x - 4 && S_QUEST.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_QUEST.scroll_left, 80) : (S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x = S_QUEST.scroll_target_x, S_QUEST.scroll_flag = 0)
};

  if (glo.APP_FEATURE.PACKAGE_STORE && (glo.package.get_is_subscribe() == "yes" ?     utilNotice(TXT.quest_not_all_reward, 2);
    return
  }
  utilNotice(TXT.quest_all_reward_noti + "(" + TXT.ruby + " : " + n + TXT.quest_count + " " + TXT.quest_reward_gold + " : " + utilGetNumber_withComma(t + "") + ")", 2);

  h = s + "|RUBY|" + n + "|" + USER.ruby + "|GOLD|" + t + "|" + USER.gold + "|" + e;

S_QUEST.drawFocus = function() {
  var t, n;
  for (window.g.blink.value = 1, $("#Img_QU_back_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Img_QU_get_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), t = S_QUEST.card_num == 1 ? 640 - S_QUEST.card_w / 2 : S_QUEST.card_num <= QUEST_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? 640 - S_QUEST.card_w / 2 - (S_QUEST.card_w / 2 + S_QUEST.card_gap / 2) * (S_QUEST.card_num - 1) : 640 - S_QUEST.card_w / 2 - (S_QUEST.card_w / 2 + S_QUEST.card_gap / 2) * (QUEST_NUM_ON_SCREEN - 1), n = 1; n <= S_QUEST.card_num; n++) S_QUEST.focus != n ? $("#QU_card_focus_" + n).css({
    display: "none"
  }) : $("#QU_card_focus_" + n).css({
    display: "block"
  })
};
S_QUEST.drawFocus_btnmenu = function() {
  for (var n = 1; n <= S_QUEST.card_num; n++) $("#QU_card_focus_" + n).css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_QUEST.btn_focus == 1 ? ($("#Img_QU_back_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }), $("#Img_QU_get_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  })) : ($("#Img_QU_back_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_QU_get_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }))
};
S_QUEST.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  utilScale_xy_center("QU_card_" + S_QUEST.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("QU_card_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("QU_card_" + S_QUEST.focus, 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("QU_card_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_QUEST.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_QUEST.menuRun_Run = function() {
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_EXITPOPUP && (utilPush(), S_QUEST.end(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_QUESTDETAIL, S_QUESTDETAIL))
};
S_QUEST.menuRun_btnmenu = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_QUEST.btn_focus) {
    case 1:
      utilScale_xy_center("QU_back", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Txt_QU_back", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_QU_back_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 2:
      utilScale_xy_center("QU_get", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Txt_QU_get", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_QU_get_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("QU_back", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Txt_QU_back", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Img_QU_back_focus", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("QU_get", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Txt_QU_get", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("Img_QU_get_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_QUEST.menuRun_btnmenu_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_QUEST.menuRun_btnmenu_Run = function() {
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_EXITPOPUP) switch (S_QUEST.btn_focus) {
    case 1:
      S_QUEST.run_back();
      break;
    case 2:
      S_QUEST.get_all_reward();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_QUEST.menuRun_btnmenu():" + S_QUEST.btn_focus)
  }
};
S_QUEST.is_new = function() {
  for (var t, n = 1; n <= QUEST_NUM; n++)
    for (t = 1; t <= QUEST[n].num; t++)
      if (QUEST[n].arrive[t] == 1) return !0;
  return !1
};
S_QUEST.end = function() {
  S_QUEST.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_QUEST.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_QUEST.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover).mouseout(this.onMouseout)))
};
S_QUEST.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover").unbind("mouseout")
};
S_QUEST.onClick = function(n) {
  var t, i, r;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (n.target.className.search("button") >= 0 && n.target.id.search("QU_softkey_txt") >= 0) {
      S_QUEST.get_all_reward();
      return
    }
    S_QUEST.row_focus == 2 && S_QUEST.menuRun_btnmenu();
    n.target.id.substring(0, 9) == "QU_cover_" && (i = n.target.id.substring(9), r = parseInt(i, 10), S_QUEST.menuRun())
  }
};
S_QUEST.onMouseover = function(n) {
  var i, t, r;
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    if (utilConsoleLog("1-onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), n.target.id.search("back") >= 0 ? (S_QUEST.row_focus = 2, S_QUEST.btn_focus = 1, S_QUEST.drawFocus_btnmenu()) : n.target.id.search("get") >= 0 && (S_QUEST.row_focus = 2, S_QUEST.btn_focus = 2, S_QUEST.drawFocus_btnmenu()), n.target.id.substring(0, 9) != "QU_cover_") {
      utilConsoleLog("해당 id는 무시:" + n.target.id);
      return
    }
    if (S_QUEST.row_focus = 1, i = n.target.id.substring(9), t = parseInt(i, 10), isNaN(t)) {
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_QUEST.onMouseover() : focus is NaN");
      return
    }
    r = Math.floor(S_QUEST.scroll_target_x * -1 / (S_QUEST.card_w + S_QUEST.card_gap)) + 1;
    S_QUEST.abs_focus = S_QUEST.abs_focus + (t - S_QUEST.focus);
    S_QUEST.focus = t;
    S_QUEST.drawFocus()
  }
};
S_QUEST.onMouseover_pressed = function(n, t, i, r) {
  Main.onMouseover_pressed(n, t, i, r)
};
S_QUEST.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_QUEST.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_QUEST.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_QUEST.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_QUEST.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_QUEST.onMouseover(n);
  S_QUEST.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_QUEST.mousedrag_right_to_left = function() {
  if (S_QUEST.scroll_flag != 1) {
    var t = (S_QUEST.card_w + S_QUEST.card_gap) * (S_QUEST.card_num - QUEST_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1,
      i = (S_QUEST.card_w + S_QUEST.card_gap) * (S_QUEST.card_num - QUEST_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1 - S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x,
      r = Math.abs(Math.floor(i / (S_QUEST.card_w + S_QUEST.card_gap))),
      n = QUEST_NUM_ON_SCREEN - 1,
      u = S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x - (S_QUEST.card_w + S_QUEST.card_gap) * n;
    u < t && (n = r);
    S_QUEST.focus < S_QUEST.card_num && (S_QUEST.focus = S_QUEST.focus + n, S_QUEST.drawFocus(), S_QUEST.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x = S_QUEST.scroll_target_x, S_QUEST.scroll_flag = 0), S_QUEST.scroll_target_x = S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x - (S_QUEST.card_w + S_QUEST.card_gap) * n, S_QUEST.scroll_right())
  }
};
S_QUEST.mousedrag_left_to_right = function() {
  if (S_QUEST.scroll_flag != 1) {
    var i = 0,
      n = 4,
      t = S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x + (S_QUEST.card_w + S_QUEST.card_gap) * n;
    t > i && (n = 3, t = S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x + (S_QUEST.card_w + S_QUEST.card_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 2, t = S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x + (S_QUEST.card_w + S_QUEST.card_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 1, t = S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x + (S_QUEST.card_w + S_QUEST.card_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 0))));
    S_QUEST.focus = S_QUEST.focus - n;
    S_QUEST.drawFocus();
    S_QUEST.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x = S_QUEST.scroll_target_x, S_QUEST.scroll_flag = 0);
    S_QUEST.scroll_target_x = S_QUEST.scroll_cur_x + (S_QUEST.card_w + S_QUEST.card_gap) * n;
    S_QUEST.scroll_left()
  }
};
S_QUEST.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_QUEST.backKey()
};

QUEST.init = function() {
  for (var t, n = 1; n <= QUEST_NUM; n++) {
    for (t = 1; t <= QUEST[n].num; t++) QUEST[n].arrive[t] = 0;
    QUEST[n].status = 0
  }
};
QUEST.cal_score = function() {
  for (var t, n = 1; n <= QUEST_NUM; n++)
    for (QUEST_SORT_ARR[n].index = n, QUEST_SORT_ARR[n].score = 0, t = 1; t <= QUEST[n].num; t++) QUEST[n].arrive[t] == 1 && QUEST_SORT_ARR[n].score++
};
QUEST.sorting = function() {
  var n, t;
  for (QUEST.cal_score(), n = 1; n <= QUEST_NUM - 1; n++)
    for (t = n + 1; t <= QUEST_NUM; t++) QUEST_SORT_ARR[n].score < QUEST_SORT_ARR[t].score && (QUEST_SORT_ARR[0] = QUEST_SORT_ARR[n], QUEST_SORT_ARR[n] = QUEST_SORT_ARR[t], QUEST_SORT_ARR[t] = QUEST_SORT_ARR[0])
};
QUEST.f1_player_levelup = function() {
  var n = 1,
    t;
  for (QUEST[n].status++, t = 1; t <= QUEST[n].num; t++) QUEST[n].status >= QUEST[n].time[t] && QUEST[n].arrive[t] == 0 && (QUEST[n].arrive[t] = 1)
};
QUEST.f2_char_levelup = function(n) {
  var t = 2,
    i;
  for (QUEST[t].status = Number(QUEST[t].status) + Number(n), i = 1; i <= QUEST[t].num; i++) QUEST[t].status >= QUEST[t].time[i] && QUEST[t].arrive[i] == 0 && (QUEST[t].arrive[i] = 1)
};

S_QUESTDETAIL.define = function() {
  S_QUESTDETAIL.focus = 1;
  S_QUESTDETAIL.abs_focus = 1;
  S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x = 0;
  S_QUESTDETAIL.row_focus = 1;
  S_QUESTDETAIL.card_num = QUEST[QUEST_SORT_ARR[S_QUEST.focus].index].num;
  for (var n = 1; n <= QUEST[QUEST_SORT_ARR[S_QUEST.focus].index].num; n++)
    if (QUEST[QUEST_SORT_ARR[S_QUEST.focus].index].arrive[n] == 1) {
      S_QUESTDETAIL.focus = n;
      break
    } S_QUESTDETAIL.focus - QUESTDETAIL_NUM_ON_SCREEN > 0 ? (S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_target_x = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x - (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w + S_QUESTDETAIL.card_gap) * (S_QUESTDETAIL.focus - QUESTDETAIL_NUM_ON_SCREEN), S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_right(), S_QUESTDETAIL.abs_focus = QUESTDETAIL_NUM_ON_SCREEN) : S_QUESTDETAIL.abs_focus = S_QUESTDETAIL.focus;
  S_QUESTDETAIL.sub_mul = 1;
  S_QUESTDETAIL.cloud_mul = 1;
  glo.APP_FEATURE.PACKAGE_STORE && (glo.package.get_is_subscribe() == "yes" ? S_QUESTDETAIL.sub_mul = glo.package.get_sub_mul() : glo.package.get_month_cloud_package_buy_status() == 1 && (S_QUESTDETAIL.cloud_mul = glo.package.get_cloud_mul()), S_QUESTDETAIL.lang_suffix = "", S_QUESTDETAIL.img_path = SERVER_IMG_URL, gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT && (S_QUESTDETAIL.img_path = "./"), USER.lang !== LANG.KOREA && (S_QUESTDETAIL.lang_suffix = "_eng"))
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_QUESTDETAIL.row_focus == 2) {
        S_QUESTDETAIL.btn_focus >= 2 && (S_QUESTDETAIL.btn_focus--, S_QUESTDETAIL.drawFocus_btnmenu());
        return
      }
      S_QUESTDETAIL.focus >= 2 && (S_QUESTDETAIL.focus = S_QUESTDETAIL.focus - 1, S_QUESTDETAIL.drawFocus(), S_QUESTDETAIL.abs_focus >= 2 ? S_QUESTDETAIL.abs_focus = S_QUESTDETAIL.abs_focus - 1 : (S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_target_x, S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_flag = 0), S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_target_x = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x + (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w + S_QUESTDETAIL.card_gap), S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_left()));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_QUESTDETAIL.row_focus == 2) {
        S_QUESTDETAIL.btn_focus < 2 && (S_QUESTDETAIL.btn_focus++, S_QUESTDETAIL.drawFocus_btnmenu());
        return
      }
      S_QUESTDETAIL.focus < S_QUESTDETAIL.card_num && (S_QUESTDETAIL.focus = S_QUESTDETAIL.focus + 1, S_QUESTDETAIL.drawFocus(), S_QUESTDETAIL.abs_focus < QUESTDETAIL_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? S_QUESTDETAIL.abs_focus = S_QUESTDETAIL.abs_focus + 1 : (S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_target_x, S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_flag = 0), S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_target_x = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x - (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w + S_QUESTDETAIL.card_gap), S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_right()));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_QUESTDETAIL.row_focus == 2 && (S_QUESTDETAIL.row_focus = 1, S_QUESTDETAIL.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_QUESTDETAIL.row_focus == 1 && (S_QUESTDETAIL.row_focus = 2, S_QUESTDETAIL.drawFocus_btnmenu());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_QUESTDETAIL.row_focus == 2 ? S_QUESTDETAIL.menuRun_btnmenu() : S_QUESTDETAIL.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_QUESTDETAIL.run_back()
  }
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.backKey = function() {
  S_QUESTDETAIL.end();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_QUEST, S_QUEST)
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_right = function() {
  S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_right()!!");
  S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x - S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_speed * (S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x - S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_target_x);
  $("#s_QUESTDETAIL_card").css({
    left: S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x > S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_target_x + 4 && S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_right, 80) : (S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_target_x, S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_flag = 0)
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_left = function() {
  S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_right()!!");
  S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x + S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_speed * (S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_target_x - S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x);
  $("#s_QUESTDETAIL_card").css({
    left: S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x < S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_target_x - 4 && S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_left, 80) : (S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_target_x, S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_flag = 0)
};

    }), $("#Img_QD_get_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), t = S_QUESTDETAIL.card_num == 1 ? 640 - S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w / 2 : S_QUESTDETAIL.card_num <= QUESTDETAIL_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? 640 - S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w / 2 - (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w / 2 + S_QUESTDETAIL.card_gap / 2) * (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_num - 1) : 640 - S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w / 2 - (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w / 2 + S_QUESTDETAIL.card_gap / 2) * (QUESTDETAIL_NUM_ON_SCREEN - 1), n = 1; n <= S_QUESTDETAIL.card_num; n++) S_QUESTDETAIL.focus != n ? $("#QD_card_focus_" + n).css({
    display: "none"
  }) : $("#QD_card_focus_" + n).css({
    display: "block"
  })

S_QUESTDETAIL.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  utilScale_xy_center("QD_card_" + S_QUESTDETAIL.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("QD_card_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("QD_card_" + S_QUESTDETAIL.focus, 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("QD_card_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_QUESTDETAIL.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.menuRun_Run = function() {
  var u = QUEST[QUEST_SORT_ARR[S_QUEST.focus].index].arrive[S_QUESTDETAIL.focus],
    t, n, i, r, f, e, o;
  switch (u) {
    case 0:
      utilNotice(TXT.quest_not_yet_notice, 1.8);
      break;
    case 1:
      glo.package.get_is_subscribe() == "yes" ? (t = QUEST[QUEST_SORT_ARR[S_QUEST.focus].index].r_gold[S_QUESTDETAIL.focus] * S_QUESTDETAIL.sub_mul, n = QUEST[QUEST_SORT_ARR[S_QUEST.focus].index].r_ruby[S_QUESTDETAIL.focus] * S_QUESTDETAIL.sub_mul) : glo.package.get_month_cloud_package_buy_status() == 1 ? (t = QUEST[QUEST_SORT_ARR[S_QUEST.focus].index].r_gold[S_QUESTDETAIL.focus] * S_QUESTDETAIL.cloud_mul, n = QUEST[QUEST_SORT_ARR[S_QUEST.focus].index].r_ruby[S_QUESTDETAIL.focus] * S_QUESTDETAIL.cloud_mul) : (t = QUEST[QUEST_SORT_ARR[S_QUEST.focus].index].r_gold[S_QUESTDETAIL.focus], n = QUEST[QUEST_SORT_ARR[S_QUEST.focus].index].r_ruby[S_QUESTDETAIL.focus]);
      i = "";
      t > 0 && (i = (USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? TXT.gold2 : TXT.gold) + " " + t);
      n > 0 && (i = i + TXT.ruby + " " + n);
      USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice(i + "개를 보상 받습니다.", 1.5) : utilNotice(TXT.quest_you_receive + " " + i + "(s)", 1.5);
      r = S_QUESTDETAIL.sub_mul > 1 || S_QUESTDETAIL.cloud_mul > 1 ? 1 : 0;
      f = r ? "업적보상(2배)" : "업적보상";
      n > 0 && (S_MAINMENU.make_screen_top_add_ruby(n, !0), save_UserInfo_after_pay_to_server(n, f));
      t > 0 && S_MAINMENU.make_screen_top_add_gold(t, "업적보상", !0);
      QUEST[QUEST_SORT_ARR[S_QUEST.focus].index].arrive[S_QUESTDETAIL.focus] = 2;
      S_QUESTDETAIL.arrive_display(S_QUESTDETAIL.focus);
      loading_show("업적보상받기", 1);
      e = r ? "업적보상받기(2배지급됨 루비)" : "업적보상받기(루비)";
      o = e + QUEST[QUEST_SORT_ARR[S_QUEST.focus].index].m_title + "(" + n + "루비," + t + "골드)|RUBY|" + n + "|" + USER.ruby + "|GOLD|" + t + "|" + USER.gold + "|" + r;
      update_quest_to_server(STORAGE.get_saved_quest_data(), o, function() {
        loading_hide("업적보상받기", 1);
        $("#S_QUESTDETAIL_div").empty();
        S_QUESTDETAIL.init()
      });
      break;
    case 2:
      utilNotice(TXT.quest_already_reward, 1.5);
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_QUESTDETAIL.menuRun_Run():" + u)
  }
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.menuRun_btnmenu = function() {
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_EXITPOPUP) {
    gEnableKey = 0;
    sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
    switch (S_QUESTDETAIL.btn_focus) {
      case 1:
        utilScale_xy_center("QD_back", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
        utilScale_xy_center("QD_back_icon", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
        utilScale_xy_center("Txt_QD_back", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
        utilScale_xy_center("Img_QD_back_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
        break;
      case 2:
        utilScale_xy_center("QD_get", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
        utilScale_xy_center("Txt_QD_get", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
        utilScale_xy_center("Img_QD_get_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
    }
    setTimeout(function() {
      utilScale_xy_center("QD_back", 1, 1);
      utilScale_xy_center("Txt_QD_back", 1, 1);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_QD_back_focus", 1, 1);
      utilScale_xy_center("QD_get", 1, 1);
      utilScale_xy_center("Txt_QD_get", 1, 1);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_QD_get_focus", 1, 1);
      setTimeout(function() {
        gEnableKey = 1;
        S_QUESTDETAIL.menuRun_btnmenu_Run()
      }, gKeyUpTime)
    }, gKeyPressTime)
  }
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.menuRun_btnmenu_Run = function() {
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_EXITPOPUP) switch (S_QUESTDETAIL.btn_focus) {
    case 1:
      S_QUESTDETAIL.run_back();
      break;
    case 2:
      S_QUESTDETAIL.get_all_reward();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_QUESTDETAIL.menuRun_btnmenu():" + S_QUESTDETAIL.btn_focus)
  }
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.get_all_reward = function() {
  var t = 0,
    i = 0,
    u = 1,
    f = 1,
    n = null,
    r, e, o, s, h;
  if (typeof S_QUESTDETAIL.quest_index != "undefined" ? n = S_QUESTDETAIL.quest_index : typeof S_QUESTDETAIL.quest_i != "undefined" ? n = S_QUESTDETAIL.quest_i : typeof S_QUESTDETAIL.cur_quest_i != "undefined" ? n = S_QUESTDETAIL.cur_quest_i : typeof S_QUEST != "undefined" && S_QUEST && typeof S_QUEST.focus != "undefined" && typeof QUEST_SORT_ARR != "undefined" && QUEST_SORT_ARR[S_QUEST.focus] && (n = QUEST_SORT_ARR[S_QUEST.focus].index), n == null || typeof QUEST == "undefined" || !QUEST[n]) {
    utilConsoleLog("Error in S_QUESTDETAIL.get_all_reward(): invalid quest index");
    utilNotice(TXT.quest_not_all_reward, 2);
    return
  }
  for (r = 1; r <= QUEST[n].num; r++) QUEST[n].arrive[r] == 1 && (t += QUEST[n].r_ruby[r], i += QUEST[n].r_gold[r], QUEST[n].arrive[r] = 2);
  if (glo.APP_FEATURE.PACKAGE_STORE && (glo.package.get_is_subscribe() == "yes" ? (u = glo.package.get_sub_mul(), t = t * u, i = i * u) : glo.package.get_month_cloud_package_buy_status() == 1 && (f = glo.package.get_cloud_mul(), t = t * f, i = i * f)), utilConsoleLog("detail quest_i = " + n), utilConsoleLog("tot_ruby = " + t), utilConsoleLog("tot_gold = " + i), t == 0 && i == 0) {
    utilNotice(TXT.quest_not_all_reward, 2);
    return
  }
  utilNotice(TXT.quest_all_reward_noti + "(" + TXT.ruby + " : " + t + TXT.quest_count + " " + TXT.quest_reward_gold + " : " + utilGetNumber_withComma(i + "") + ")", 2);
  e = u > 1 || f > 1 ? 1 : 0;
  o = e ? "업적보상모두받기(2배지급됨 루비)" : "업적보상모두받기(루비)";
  t > 0 && (S_MAINMENU.make_screen_top_add_ruby(t, !0), save_UserInfo_after_pay_to_server(t, o));
  i > 0 && S_MAINMENU.make_screen_top_add_gold(i, "업적모두받기(골드-상세)", !0);
  loading_show("업적모두받기_상세", 1);
  s = e ? "업적보상모두받기(2배지급됨,상세," : "업적보상모두받기(상세,";
  h = s + n + ")|RUBY|" + t + "|" + USER.ruby + "|GOLD|" + i + "|" + USER.gold + "|" + e;
  update_quest_to_server(STORAGE.get_saved_quest_data(), h, function() {
    loading_hide("업적모두받기_상세", 1);
    $("#S_QUESTDETAIL_div").empty();
    S_QUESTDETAIL.init()
  })
};

  utilConsoleLog("S_QUESTDETAIL.QUESTDETAIL_run() - ");
  S_QUESTDETAIL.end();
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_QUESTDETAILROULETTE, S_QUESTDETAILROULETTE) : ($("#S_QUESTDETAIL_div").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#S_QUESTDETAILROULETTE_div").css({
    display: "block"
  }), S_QUESTDETAILROULETTE.init());
  return
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.end = function() {
  S_QUESTDETAIL.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_QUESTDETAIL.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover).mouseout(this.onMouseout)))
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover").unbind("mouseout")
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.onClick = function(n) {
  var t, i, r;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } S_QUESTDETAIL.row_focus == 2 && S_QUESTDETAIL.menuRun_btnmenu();
    n.target.id.substring(0, 9) == "QD_cover_" && (i = n.target.id.substring(9), r = parseInt(i, 10), S_QUESTDETAIL.menuRun())
  }
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.onMouseover = function(n) {
  var i, t, r;
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    if (n.target.id.search("back") >= 0) {
      S_QUESTDETAIL.row_focus = 2;
      S_QUESTDETAIL.btn_focus = 1;
      S_QUESTDETAIL.drawFocus_btnmenu();
      S_QUESTDETAIL.onMouseover_pressed("QD_back", "Txt_QD_back", "Img_QD_back_focus")
    } else if (n.target.id.search("get") >= 0) {
      S_QUESTDETAIL.row_focus = 2;
      S_QUESTDETAIL.btn_focus = 2;
      S_QUESTDETAIL.drawFocus_btnmenu();
      S_QUESTDETAIL.onMouseover_pressed("QD_get", "Txt_QD_get", "Img_QD_get_focus")
    }
    if (n.target.id.substring(0, 9) != "QD_cover_") {
      utilConsoleLog("해당 id는 무시:" + n.target.id);
      return
    }
    if (S_QUESTDETAIL.row_focus = 1, i = n.target.id.substring(9), t = parseInt(i, 10), isNaN(t)) {
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_QUESTDETAIL.onMouseover() : focus is NaN");
      return
    }
    r = Math.floor(S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_target_x * -1 / (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w + S_QUESTDETAIL.card_gap)) + 1;
    S_QUESTDETAIL.abs_focus = S_QUESTDETAIL.abs_focus + (t - S_QUESTDETAIL.focus);
    S_QUESTDETAIL.focus = t;
    S_QUESTDETAIL.drawFocus()
  }
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.onMouseover_pressed = function(n, t, i, r) {
  Main.onMouseover_pressed(n, t, i, r)
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_QUESTDETAIL.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_QUESTDETAIL.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_QUESTDETAIL.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_QUESTDETAIL.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.mousedrag_right_to_left = function() {
  if (S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_flag != 1 && !(S_QUESTDETAIL.card_num <= QUESTDETAIL_NUM_ON_SCREEN)) {
    var t = (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w + S_QUESTDETAIL.card_gap) * (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_num - QUESTDETAIL_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1,
      i = (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w + S_QUESTDETAIL.card_gap) * (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_num - QUESTDETAIL_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1 - S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x,
      r = Math.abs(Math.floor(i / (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w + S_QUESTDETAIL.card_gap))),
      n = QUESTDETAIL_NUM_ON_SCREEN - 1,
      u = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x - (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w + S_QUESTDETAIL.card_gap) * n;
    u < t && (n = r);
    S_QUESTDETAIL.focus < S_QUESTDETAIL.card_num && (S_QUESTDETAIL.focus = S_QUESTDETAIL.focus + n, S_QUESTDETAIL.drawFocus(), S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_target_x, S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_flag = 0), S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_target_x = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x - (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w + S_QUESTDETAIL.card_gap) * n, S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_right())
  }
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.mousedrag_left_to_right = function() {
  var i = 0,
    n = 4,
    t = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x + (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w + S_QUESTDETAIL.card_gap) * n;
  t > i && (n = 3, t = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x + (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w + S_QUESTDETAIL.card_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 2, t = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x + (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w + S_QUESTDETAIL.card_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 1, t = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x + (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w + S_QUESTDETAIL.card_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 0))));
  S_QUESTDETAIL.focus = S_QUESTDETAIL.focus - n;
  S_QUESTDETAIL.drawFocus();
  S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_target_x, S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_flag = 0);
  S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_target_x = S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_cur_x + (S_QUESTDETAIL.card_w + S_QUESTDETAIL.card_gap) * n;
  S_QUESTDETAIL.scroll_left()
};
S_QUESTDETAIL.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_QUESTDETAIL.backKey()
};

S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.preload = function() {
  var n, t, u, i, r;
  if (utilConsoleLog("S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.preload() called!"), gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) {
    if (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.maketag(), n = USER.charbook_ally_list.split(","), USER.charbook_ally_list == "" || USER.charbook_ally_list == null) return;
    for (m = 0; m < n.length; m++)
      for (t = ally_get_decx_num(n[m]), s = 1; s <= window.g.CHAR_NUM[t].length; s++) n[m] == window.g.CHAR_NUM[t][s] && (u = s, s = window.g.CHAR_NUM[t].length + 1);
    i = setInterval(function() {
      var r = 0,
        t, u, f;
      for (m = 0; m < n.length; m++) {
        for (t = ally_get_decx_num(n[m]), s = 1; s <= window.g.CHAR_NUM[t].length; s++) n[m] == window.g.CHAR_NUM[t][s] && (u = s, s = window.g.CHAR_NUM[t].length + 1);
        f = parseInt($("#CBA_big_char" + t + "_img" + u).width(), 10);
        f >= 2 && r++
      }
      r == n.length && clearInterval(i)
    }, 100)
  } else gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT ? (r = ["./image/ui/19_charbook/cb_bg.jpg"], ChangeScene.preloadImage(r)) : S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.maketag()
};

  });

    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.row_focus != 1 && (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.row_focus--, r = parseInt($("#CBA_big_char" + S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus + "_scroll_in_screen").css("left"), 0), r < 0 && S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus <= 2 && $("#CBA_big_char" + S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus + "_scroll_in_screen").css({

S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_right = function() {
  S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_right()!!");
  S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_cur_x = S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_cur_x - S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_speed * (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_cur_x - S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_target_x);
  $("#CBA_big_card_div").css({
    left: S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_cur_x > S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_target_x + 4 && S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_right, 80) : (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_cur_x = S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_target_x, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_flag = 0, $("#CBA_big_card_div").css({
    left: S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  }))
};

S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.make_screen_arrow = function(n) {
  var i = window.g.CHAR_NUM[n].length - 1,
    r = parseInt($("#CBA_big_char" + n + "_scroll_in_screen").css("left"), 0),
    t = Math.abs(r) / 200;
  if (t > 0 ? $("#CBA_big_char" + n + "_arrow_left").css({
      display: "block"
    }) : $("#CBA_big_char" + n + "_arrow_left").css({
      display: "none"
    }), t + 6 < i ? $("#CBA_big_char" + n + "_arrow_right").css({
      display: "block"
    }) : $("#CBA_big_char" + n + "_arrow_right").css({
      display: "none"
    }), n !== S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus) {
    $("#CBA_big_char" + n + "_arrow_left_f").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    $("#CBA_big_char" + n + "_arrow_right_f").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    return
  }
  S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.arrow_focus === 1 && t > 0 ? $("#CBA_big_char" + n + "_arrow_left_f").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : $("#CBA_big_char" + n + "_arrow_left_f").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.arrow_focus === 2 && t + 6 < i ? $("#CBA_big_char" + n + "_arrow_right_f").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : $("#CBA_big_char" + n + "_arrow_right_f").css({
    display: "none"
  })
};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus = function() {
  var n, t, i;
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  $("#CBA_small_card_text").css({
    left: S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_sx + (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus - 1) * S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_x_gap - 5 + "px",
    top: "582px",
    width: glo.APP_FEATURE.THRUE_CHAR ? "90px" : "105px",
    height: "32px",
    color: "#672b0e",
    "line-height": "18px",
    "font-size": "15rem",
    "text-align": "center",
    position: "absolute"
  });
  n = S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus;
  t = parseInt($("#CBA_big_char" + S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus + "_scroll_in_screen").css("left"), 0);
  t % -200 == 0 && t <= -200 && t >= -1200 && (n = n + t / 200);
  n > CHARBOOK_CHAR_MAX_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? n = CHARBOOK_CHAR_MAX_NUM_ON_SCREEN : n < 1 && (n = 1);
  $("#CBA_card" + S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus + "_reward_btn_focus").hide();
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("CBA_big_card_focus", "", i, 49);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("CBA_small_card_focus", "", S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_sx + (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus - 1) * S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_x_gap, 513);
  $("#CBA_small_card_text").text("");
  S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.back_button.blur();
  switch (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.row_focus) {
    case 1:
      $("#CBA_card" + S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus + "_reward_btn_focus").show();
      break;
    case 2:
      i = 10 + (n - 1) * 200 + (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus - 1) * 1222;
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.arrow_focus === 0 ? utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("CBA_big_card_focus", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/19_charbook/cb_allycard_line.png", i, 49) : utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("CBA_big_card_focus", "", i, 49);
      utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("CBA_small_card_focus", "", S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_sx + (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus - 1) * S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_x_gap, 513);
      break;
    case 3:
      utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("CBA_small_card_focus", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_PVP") + "image/ui/19_charbook/cb_smallbt_line_1.png", S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_sx + (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus - 1) * S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_x_gap, 513);
      window.g.CHAR_NUM[S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus][1] == 43 ? $("#CBA_small_card_text").text(TXT.goldman) : window.g.CHAR_NUM[S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus][1] == 96 ? $("#CBA_small_card_text").text(TXT.transfer_ally_thrue) : window.g.CHAR_NUM[S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus][1] == 95 ? $("#CBA_small_card_text").text(TXT.hero_str) : $("#CBA_small_card_text").text(TXT["char_name_" + window.g.CHAR_NUM[S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus][1]]);
      break;
    case 4:
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.back_button.focus()
  }
};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus_btnmenu = function() {};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.menuRun = function() {
  switch (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.row_focus) {
    case 1:
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.menuRun_btnmenu();
      break;
    case 2:
      utilPush();
      utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("CBA_big_card_focus", "", 0, 0);
      utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("CBA_small_card_focus", "", 0, 0);
      $("#CBA_small_card_text").text("");
      $("#Img_CBA_back_focus").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $("#Img_CBA_start_focus").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $("#Txt_CBA_back").css({
        color: "white"
      });
      $("#CBA_start").css({
        color: "white"
      });
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.removeMouseEvent();
      $("#S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP_div").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.init();
      break;
    case 3:
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.row_focus = 2;
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus = 1;
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus();
      break;
    case 4:
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.menuRun_btnmenu()
  }
};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.yes = function() {};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.menuRun_btnmenu = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  this.row_focus == 1 && utilScale_xy_center("CBA_card" + this.abs_focus + "_reward_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  this.row_focus == 4 && this.back_button.scale(gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.back_button.scale(1);
    utilScale_xy_center("CBA_card" + S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus + "_reward_btn", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.menuRun_btnmenu_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.menuRun_btnmenu_Run = function() {
  this.row_focus == 1 && this.reward_charbook_check();
  this.row_focus == 4 && this.run_back()
};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.end = function() {
  $("#S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_div").empty();
  S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.reward_charbook_check = function() {
  if (ally_get_decx_char_number(S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus) != window.g.CHAR_NUM[S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus].length - 1) {
    utilNotice(TXT.quest_not_yet_notice, 3);
    return
  }
  if (ally_get_decx_reward(S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus) == 1) {
    var n = "A" + S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus;
    USER.charbook_ally_reward = USER.charbook_ally_reward == null || USER.charbook_ally_reward == "" ? n + "" : USER.charbook_ally_reward + "," + n;
    S_MAINMENU.make_screen_top_add_ruby(2, !0);
    utilNotice(TXT.char_book_reward_text, 3);
    add_ally_reward(n);
    loading_show("아군 캐릭도감 완성", 1);
    STORAGE.save_all_info_to_storage("아군캐릭도감보상|RUBY|2|" + USER.ruby, 0, "ruby", function() {
      loading_hide("아군 캐릭도감 완성", 1)
    });
    save_UserInfo_after_pay_to_server(2, "아군 캐릭도감 완성 : " + n);
    S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top();
    S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.toggle_reward_button(S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus, !1)
  } else utilNotice(TXT.quest_already_reward, 3)
};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover))
};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.onClick = function(n) {
  var t, u, r, i, e;
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    for (t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (t.id.search("back") >= 0) S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.menuRun_btnmenu();
    else if (t.id.search("reward_btn") >= 0) S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.reward_charbook_check();
    else if (t.id.search("_cover") >= 0) S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.menuRun();
    else if (t.id.search("CBA_small_card") >= 0) u = glo.fun.get_only_number_by_text(t.id), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.row_focus = 3, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus = 1, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus = u, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus = u, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus(), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.make_screen_small_card(), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.make_screen_big_card();
    else if (n.target.id.search("_arrow_left") >= 0) r = parseInt($("#CBA_big_char" + S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus + "_scroll_in_screen").css("left"), 0), r < 0 && (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.row_focus = 2, i = r + 200, $("#CBA_big_char" + S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus + "_scroll_in_screen").css({
      left: i + "px"
    }), i >= 0 ? (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.arrow_focus = 0, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus = 1) : S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.arrow_focus = 1, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus(), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.make_screen_arrow(S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus));
    else if (n.target.id.search("_arrow_right") >= 0) {
      var f = window.g.CHAR_NUM[S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus].length - 1,
        r = parseInt($("#CBA_big_char" + S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus + "_scroll_in_screen").css("left"), 0),
        o = Math.abs(r) / 200;
      o + 6 < f && (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.row_focus = 2, i = r - 200, $("#CBA_big_char" + S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus + "_scroll_in_screen").css({
        left: i + "px"
      }), e = Math.abs(i) / 200, e + 6 >= f ? (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.arrow_focus = 0, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus = f) : (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.arrow_focus = 2, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus = e + 1), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus(), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.make_screen_arrow(S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus))
    }
  }
};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.onMouseover = function(n) {
  var r, i;
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } utilConsoleLog("S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.onMouseover  elm.id: " + t.id);
    t.id.search("_cover") >= 0 ? (r = n.target.id.split("_cover"), i = parseInt(r[1]), i > 0 && (console.log(" S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.onMouseover focus:" + i), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.row_focus = 2, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus = i, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.arrow_focus = 0, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.make_screen_arrow(S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus())) : t.id.search("back") >= 0 ? (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.row_focus = 4, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.btn_focus = 1, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.arrow_focus = 0, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.make_screen_arrow(S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("reward_btn") >= 0 ? (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.row_focus = 1, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.btn_focus = 1, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.arrow_focus = 0, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.make_screen_arrow(S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("_arrow_left") >= 0 ? (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.arrow_focus = 1, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.make_screen_arrow(S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("_arrow_right") >= 0 ? (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.arrow_focus = 2, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.make_screen_arrow(S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus()) : (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.arrow_focus = 0, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.make_screen_arrow(S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus())
  }
};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.onMouseover(n)
};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.onMouseover(n);
  S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.onClick(n)
};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.backKey()
};

  S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.maketag();

  utilConsoleLog("S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.init()");

  S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.make_screen();

  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  setTimeout(function() {
    gEnableKey = 1
  }, 700)
};

  })

};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.maketag = function() {
  var n = document.getElementById("S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP_div"),
    t = document.getElementById("Img_CBAP_background");
  if (t) {
    utilConsoleLog("Already ready.");

S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.backKey()
};
S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.backKey = function() {
  S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.end();
  $("#S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_div").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.init("back");
  for (var n = 1; n <= CHARBOOK_CHAR_MAX_NUM; n++) $("#CBA_big_char" + n + "_arrow_left").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#CBA_big_char" + n + "_arrow_right").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#CBA_big_char" + n + "_arrow_left_f").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#CBA_big_char" + n + "_arrow_right_f").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.make_screen_arrow(S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus);
  S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus()
};

S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.ok_button = function() {

    n = "ok_btn",
    i = "";
  return t.create = function(t) {
    var r;
    $("#" + t).after('<div id="' + n + '" class="button"><\/div>');
    i += '<img id="' + n + '_bg">';
    i += '<div id="' + n + '_txt"><\/div>';
    i += '<img id="' + n + '_focus" class="focus">';
    $("#" + n).append(i);
    util_draw_div(n, 567, 579, 146, 66);
    r = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/0_common/co_bt3.png";
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos(n + "_bg", r, 0, 0);
    util_draw_text_html(TXT.ok, n + "_txt", 5, 4, 136, 54, 54, 24, "center", "#ffffff");
    r = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/0_common/co_bt_f.png";
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos(n + "_focus", r, -8, -9)
  }, t.blur = function() {
    $("#" + n + "_focus").hide()
  }, t.focus = function() {
    $("#" + n + "_focus").show()
  }, t.scale = function(t) {
    utilScale_xy_center(n, t, t)
  }, t
}();

S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE)
    if (n.target.id.search("ok_btn") >= 0) S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.backKey();
    else if (n.target.id == "Img_CBAP_arrow_right_cover")
    if (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus == window.g.CHAR_NUM[S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus].length - 1) S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus < CHARBOOK_CHAR_MAX_NUM && (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus = 1, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus++, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus++, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.char_num = window.g.CHAR_NUM[S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus][S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus], S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.arrow_blink_right(), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_target_x = S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_cur_x - (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.card_w + S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.card_gap), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_cur_x = S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_target_x, $("#CBA_big_card_div").css({
      left: S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_target_x + "px"
    }), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus(), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.make_screen_small_card());
    else {
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus++;
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.char_num = window.g.CHAR_NUM[S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus][S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus];
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.arrow_blink_right();
      var t = parseInt($("#CBA_big_char" + S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus + "_scroll_in_screen").css("left"), 0);
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus == 7 && t == 0 ? $("#CBA_big_char" + S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus + "_scroll_in_screen").css({
        left: "-200px"
      }) : S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus == 8 && t == -200 && $("#CBA_big_char" + S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus + "_scroll_in_screen").css({
        left: "-400px"
      });
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus();
      S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.make_screen_small_card()
    }
  else n.target.id == "Img_CBAP_arrow_left_cover" && (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus == 1 ? S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus > 1 && (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus--, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus--, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus = window.g.CHAR_NUM[S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.abs_focus].length - 1, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.char_num = window.g.CHAR_NUM[S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus][S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus], S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.arrow_blink_left(), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_target_x = S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_cur_x + (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.card_w + S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.card_gap), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_cur_x = S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_target_x, $("#CBA_big_card_div").css({
    left: S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.scroll_target_x + "px"
  }), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus(), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.make_screen_small_card()) : (S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus--, S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.char_num = window.g.CHAR_NUM[S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.small_focus][S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.focus], S_CHARBOOK_ALLY_POPUP.arrow_blink_left(), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.drawFocus(), S_CHARBOOK_ALLY.make_screen_small_card()))
};

S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.preload = function() {
  var n, t;
  if (utilConsoleLog("S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.preload() called!"), !1 && (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN)) {
    if (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.maketag(), n = USER.charbook_enemy_list.split(","), USER.charbook_enemy_list == "" || USER.charbook_enemy_list == null) return;
    t = setInterval(function() {
      var r = 0,
        u, i, f;
      for (m = 0; m < n.length; m++) u = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.get_decx_num(n[m]), i = n[m] % 6, i == 0 && (i = 6), n[m] >= 67 && 70 >= n[m] ? (i = (n[m] - 66) % 4, i == 0 && (i = 4)) : n[m] >= 71 && 76 >= n[m] ? (i = (n[m] - 70) % 6, i == 0 && (i = 6)) : n[m] >= 77 && 80 >= n[m] && (i = (n[m] - 76) % 4, i == 0 && (i = 4)), f = parseInt($("#CBE_card" + u + "_img" + i).width(), 10), f >= 2 && r++;
      r == n.length && clearInterval(t)
    }, 100)
  } else {
    if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT) return;
    glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS
  }
};
S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.init = function() {
  this.max_row_btn = this.back_button.get_max_row_btn();
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.MAX_NUM = MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM;
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.MAX_NUM_ON_SCREEN = 6;
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.MAX_NUM_PAGE = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.get_max_page();
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.maketag();
  gEnableKey = 0;
  utilConsoleLog("S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.init()");
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_CHARBOOK_ENEMY;
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_MAINMENU.remount_mm_top(this, TXT.setting2);
  $("#S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY_card").css({
    left: "0px",
    top: "0px",
    position: "absolute"
  });
  $("#ST_message").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.char_book_arrar = USER.charbook_enemy_list.split(",");
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.focus = 1;
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.row_focus = 2;
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.make_screen();
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.addMouseEvent();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  setTimeout(function() {
    gEnableKey = 1
  }, 700);
  glo.event.apply_coupon_code()
};

  $("#CBE_card" + n + "_reward_btn_focus").hide();

    display: "none"
  })
};

S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.maketag = function() {
  var lt = document.getElementById("S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY_div"),
    at = document.getElementById("Img_CBE_background"),
    c, f, e, n, l, i, a, o, v, y, r, p, w, b, s, t, k, d, g, u, nt, tt, it, rt, ut, ft, et, ot, st, ht, ct, h;
  if (at) {
    utilConsoleLog("Already ready.");
    return

S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.row_focus == 2 && S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.focus != 1 && (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.focus--, S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_target_x, S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_flag = 0), S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_target_x = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x + (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.card_w + S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.card_gap), S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_left(), S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.row_focus == 2 && S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.focus != S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.MAX_NUM_PAGE && (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.focus++, S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_target_x, S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_flag = 0), S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_target_x = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x - (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.card_w + S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.card_gap), S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_right(), S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.row_focus--;
      S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.row_focus < 1 && (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.row_focus = 1);
      S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.row_focus++;
      S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.row_focus > this.max_row_btn && (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.row_focus = this.max_row_btn);
      S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      this.run_back()
  }
};
S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.backKey = function() {
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.end();
  $("#S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MAINMENU;
  S_MAINMENU.resume();
  S_MAINMENU.menu_overlay.show()
};
S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_right = function() {
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_flag = 1;
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x - S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_speed * (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x - S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_target_x);
  $("#CBE_card_div").css({
    left: S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x > S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_target_x + 4 && S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_right, 80) : (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_target_x, S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_flag = 0, $("#CBE_card_div").css({
    left: S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  }))
};
S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_left = function() {
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_flag = 1;
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x + S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_speed * (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_target_x - S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x);
  $("#CBE_card_div").css({
    left: S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x < S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_target_x - 4 && S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_left, 80) : (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_target_x, S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_flag = 0, $("#CBE_card_div").css({
    left: S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  }))
};

S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.menuRun_btnmenu = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  this.row_focus == 1 && utilScale_xy_center("CBE_card" + this.focus + "_reward_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  this.row_focus == 3 && this.back_button.scale(gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.back_button.scale(1);
    utilScale_xy_center("CBE_card" + S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.focus + "_reward_btn", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.menuRun_btnmenu_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};

S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.list_add_check = function(n) {
  for (var i = USER.charbook_enemy_list.split(","), t = 0; t <= i.length; t++) {
    if (i[t] == n) return;
    t == i.length && (utilConsoleLog("~~~새로 수집한 적군 캐릭번호 : " + n), USER.charbook_enemy_list = USER.charbook_enemy_list == null || USER.charbook_enemy_list == "" ? n + "" : USER.charbook_enemy_list + "," + n, utilConsoleLog("~~~새로 수집한 적군 캐릭배열 : " + USER.charbook_enemy_list), add_enemy_list(n), S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.reward_add_check() == 1 && utilNotice(TXT.enemy_reward, 3))
  }
};
S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.reward_add_check = function() {
  for (var t, i = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.get_max_page(), n = 1; n <= i; n++)
    if (t = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.get_decx_char_number(n), t == S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.get_page_max_char(n) && S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.get_decx_reward(n) == 1) return 1;
  return 0
};
S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.get_decx_num = function(n) {
  if (n >= 67 && 70 >= n) return 12;
  if (n >= 71 && 76 >= n) return 13;
  if (n >= 77 && 80 >= n) return 14;
  var t = n % 6;
  return t == 0 ? Math.floor(n / 6) : Math.floor(n / 6) + 1
};
S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.get_decx_char_number = function(n) {
  for (var r, i, o, f = USER.charbook_enemy_list.split(","), e = 0, t = n * 6, u = 0; u < S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.MAX_NUM_ON_SCREEN; u++)
    for (i = 0; i < f.length; i++) o = t - u, f[i] == o && (e++, i = f.length);
  if (n >= 12) {
    e = 0;
    r = 0;
    switch (n) {
      case 12:
        t = 70;
        r = 4;
        break;
      case 13:
        t = 76;
        r = 6;
        break;
      case 14:
        t = 80;
        r = 4;
        break;
      case 15:
        t = 86;
        r = 6;
        break;
      case 16:
        t = 90;
        r = 4;
        break;
      case 17:
        t = 96;
        r = 6;
        break;
      case 18:
        t = 102;
        r = 6;
        break;
      case 19:
        t = 106;
        r = 4
    }
    for (u = 0; u < r; u++)
      for (i = 0; i < f.length; i++) o = t - u, f[i] == o && (e++, i = f.length)
  }
  return e
};
S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.get_decx_reward = function(n) {
  var i = USER.charbook_enemy_reward.split(","),
    r = 1,
    t, u;
  if (USER.charbook_enemy_reward == null || USER.charbook_enemy_reward == "") return 1;
  for (t = 0; t < i.length; t++) u = "E" + n, i[t] == u ? (t = i.length, r = 0) : t == i.length - 1 && (r = 1);
  return r
};
S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.is_new = function() {
  for (var t, i = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.get_max_page(), n = 1; n <= i; n++)
    if (t = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.get_decx_char_number(n), t == S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.get_page_max_char(n) && S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.get_decx_reward(n) == 1) return 1;
  return 0
};
S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("back") >= 0 ? S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.menuRun() : t.id.search("reward_btn") >= 0 ? S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.reward_charbook_check() : t.id.search("EnemyButtonLeft") >= 0 ? S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.focus != 1 && (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.focus--, S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_target_x, S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_flag = 0), S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_target_x = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x + (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.card_w + S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.card_gap), S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_left(), S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.drawFocus()) : n.target.id == "EnemyButtonRight" && S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.focus != S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.MAX_NUM_PAGE && (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.focus++, S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_target_x, S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_flag = 0), S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_target_x = S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_cur_x - (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.card_w + S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.card_gap), S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.scroll_right(), S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.drawFocus())
  }
};
S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.onMouseover = function(n) {
  var t, i;
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    for (utilConsoleLog("1-onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (t.id.search("enemyCover") >= 0) {
      if (i = glo.fun.get_only_number_by_text(t.id), S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.focus !== i) return;
      S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.row_focus = 2;
      S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.focus = i;
      S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.drawFocus()
    } else t.id.search("back") >= 0 ? (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.row_focus = 3, S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.btn_focus = 1, S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("reward_btn") >= 0 && (S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.row_focus = 1, S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.btn_focus = 1, S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.drawFocus())
  }
};
S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.onMouseover(n)
};
S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.onMouseover(n);
  S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.onClick(n)
};
S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_CHARBOOK_ENEMY.backKey()
};

  f = new Date;
  S_BOSS.start_timestamp = f.getTime();
  S_BOSS.notice_timer = setTimeout(function() {
    $("#BOSS_board").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    $("#BOSS_board_bg").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    gEnableKey = 1;
    S_BOSS.notice_flag = 0;
    S_BOSS.board.flag = 0;
    g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_BOSS ? (unblink(), S_BOSS.drawFocus(), S_BOSS.interval(), S_BOSS.start_render(), S_BOSS.autoYourTeamManager_timeout()) : (clearInterval(S_BOSS.notice_timer), S_BOSS.notice_timer = null)
  }, 3e3);
  S_GAME.init_all_unit()
};
S_BOSS.pause = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_BOSS.pause()!!");
  S_BOSS.notice_flag == 1 && (clearInterval(S_BOSS.notice_timer), S_BOSS.notice_timer = null);
  S_BOSS.end()
};
S_BOSS.resume = function() {
  var n, t;
  if (utilConsoleLog("S_MEDALPOWER.resume()!!"), CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp <= 0) S_BOSS.ourCastle_destroyAni();
  else {
    if (sound_bgm_play(BGM_SOUND.INGAME), S_BOSS.addMouseEvent(), S_BOSS.notice_flag == 1) {
      $("#BOSS_board").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_BOSS.notice_flag = 0;
      return
    }
    S_BOSS.interval();
    S_BOSS.start_render();
    n = S_BOSS.your_team_stop_time - S_BOSS.your_team_start_time;
    S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager != null && (clearInterval(S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager), S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager = null);
    S_BOSS.your_team_remain_time = S_BOSS.your_team_remain_time - n;
    S_BOSS.your_team_remain_time < 0 && (S_BOSS.your_team_remain_time = 0);
    S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager = setTimeout(S_BOSS.autoYourTeamManager_timeout, S_BOSS.your_team_remain_time);
    t = new Date;
    S_BOSS.your_team_start_time = t.getTime()
  }
};

S_BOSS.focusRun = function() {
  switch (S_BOSS.focus) {
    case 1:
      USER.missile_cur_tick >= USER.missile_full_tick && (S_GAME.effect_del("game_ui_missile"), USER.missile_cur_tick = 0, CASTLE_OUR.mode = MODE.ATTACK, S_GAME.bottom_ui.reder_missile_gage());
      break;
    case 2:
      if (USER.mineral_cur_level >= MINERAL_LEVEL_MAX) {
        utilConsoleLog("Your Mineral Level ... MAX...");
        return
      }
      USER.mineral_cur >= MINERAL_LEVEL_ARRAY[USER.mineral_cur_level].need_mineral ? ((gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && sound_play(EFF_SOUND.CHAR_CREATE), S_GAME.mineral_effect_f(), USER.mineral_cur = Math.round(USER.mineral_cur) - MINERAL_LEVEL_ARRAY[USER.mineral_cur_level].need_mineral, USER.mineral_cur_level++, S_GAME.bottom_ui.update_mineral_level(), S_GAME.bottom_ui.update_mineral_count(), S_GAME.effect_del("game_ui_mineral")) : utilConsoleLog("need more mineral.. please wait..");
      break;
    case 3:
    case 4:
    case 5:
    case 6:
    case 7:
      S_BOSS.startUnit(S_BOSS.focus - 2)
  }
};

S_BOSS.autoYourTeamManager_timeout = function() {
  var n, t, i;
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_BOSS) {
    utilConsoleLog("by pass----------");
    return
  }
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene + "- BOSS : " + S_BOSS.stage);
  n = new Date;
  S_BOSS.your_team_start_time = n.getTime();
  t = S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() ? 1 : BOSS_STAGE_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].boss_max_num;
  S_BOSS.acc_your_num >= t ? (S_BOSS.acc_your_num = 0, S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager != null && (clearInterval(S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager), S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager = null), S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager = setTimeout(function() {
    g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_BOSS ? (S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager != null && (clearInterval(S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager), S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager = null), S_BOSS.autoYourTeamManager_timeout()) : utilConsoleLog("Wave ended!--")
  }, BOSS_STAGE.char_interval[S_BOSS.stage] * BOSS_TIMER_INTERVAL * 1.5), S_BOSS.your_team_remain_time = BOSS_STAGE.char_interval[S_BOSS.stage] * BOSS_TIMER_INTERVAL * 1.5) : (i = S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() ? S_BOSS.stage : BOSS_STAGE_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].boss_num[S_BOSS.acc_your_num + 1], S_BOSS.addYourUnit(i), S_BOSS.acc_your_num++, g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_BOSS ? (S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager != null && (clearInterval(S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager), S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager = null), S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager = setTimeout(S_BOSS.autoYourTeamManager_timeout, BOSS_STAGE.char_interval[S_BOSS.stage] * BOSS_TIMER_INTERVAL), S_BOSS.your_team_remain_time = BOSS_STAGE.char_interval[S_BOSS.stage] * BOSS_TIMER_INTERVAL) : utilConsoleLog("Wave endded~"))
};
timer_nextwave = null;
S_BOSS.nextWaveGo = function() {
  var t, n, i;
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_BOSS) {
    for (t = 0, n = 1; n <= MAX_BOSS_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && t++;
    t == 0 ? (USER.score = USER.score + RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.wave * RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.wave * 20, $("#Txt_BOSS_score").text(USER.score), put_scorewave_to_server(RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.wave, USER.score), USER.clear_wave < RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.wave ? (USER.clear_wave = RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.wave, USER.clear_wavescore = USER.score) : USER.clear_wavescore < USER.score && (USER.clear_wavescore = USER.score), RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.wave++, S_RANKING.before_next_wave(), S_RANKING.wave_design(RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.wave), flag_LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR = 0, loading_your_boss(), i = function() {
      flag_LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR == 1 ? (S_BOSS.acc_your_num = 0, S_BOSS.nextwavego_flag = 0, S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager != null && (clearInterval(S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager), S_BOSS.timer_autoYourTeamManager = null), S_BOSS.autoYourTeamManager_timeout()) : setTimeout(i, 1e3)
    }, S_BOSS.nextwavego_flag = 1, i(), utilNotice2("Wave " + RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.wave, 1.5)) : (timer_nextwave != null && (clearInterval(timer_nextwave), timer_nextwave = null), timer_nextwave = setTimeout(function() {

  }
};

S_BOSS.interval = function() {
  var r = (new Date).getTime(),
    t, n, i;
  if (S_BOSS.end_flag == 1) {
    utilConsoleLog("S_BOSS.end_flag가 1이라서 S_BOSS.interval() 건너뜀.");
    return
  }
  for (++S_BOSS.count >= 1e6 && (S_BOSS.count = 1), context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, 570), t = 1; t <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; t++) OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1 && S_BOSS.interval_set_our_div(t);
  for (n = 1; n <= MAX_BOSS_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && S_BOSS.count % 3 == 0 && S_BOSS.interval_set_your_div(n);
  for (n = 1; n <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; n++) OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACK && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACKEND && (S_BOSS.isCanIattack(n) == !1 ? (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].before_x = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + CAL.p_get_move_speed_your(n), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.MOVE, S_BOSS.$el.our_unit[n].fire_pung.css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_BOSS.$el.our_unit[n].fire_img.css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_BOSS.del_check_area_our_char(n), S_BOSS.$el.our_unit[n].fire_pung_img.css({
    display: "none"

S_BOSS.isCanIattack = function(n) {
  var u = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num,
    f = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power,
    t = S_BOSS.getYou_firt_one(),
    e, o, s, c, h, i, r;
  if (t != 0 && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1 && (e = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num, o = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x + BOSS_DESIGN[e].beattack_margine - (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w), o <= OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len)) {
    if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_num = t, S_BOSS.isCanIattack_fireAni(n, t), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur == OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_num && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACK && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACKEND && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.DESTROY)
      if (s = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp, c = CHAR_YOUR_TEAM[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num].hp / 2, CHAR_OUR_TEAM[u].attack_type == ATTACK_TYPE.WIDE || CHAR_OUR_TEAM[u].attack_type == ATTACK_TYPE.HIT_WIDE || CHAR_OUR_TEAM[u].attack_type == ATTACK_TYPE.FULL_WIDE) S_BOSS.featureWideOur(n);
      else if (i = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num == 3 ? Math.floor(f * .1) : f, glo.APP_FEATURE.BOSS_2026 && (h = S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() && typeof gAPP_RELEASE != "undefined" && gAPP_RELEASE == "TEST" ? 10 : .001, i = Math.floor(f * h)), S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].guild_boss_shield === !0 && (i = 0), S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() && (i = S_BOSS.guild_boss_apply_damage_cap(i)), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - i, console.error("isCanIattack attack!  old hp:" + s + " new hp:" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp + " damage:" + i), S_BOSS.draw_damage(t, i), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode == MODE.WAIT && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_BOSS_your_unit" + t + "_img", (S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() ? glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("GUILD_BOSS") : glo.img_url) + "image/char/" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].filename + "/" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].filename + "_beattack_11.png", YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].y), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp <= 0)
      for (S_BOSS.die_by_our_attack(t, n), r = 1; r <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; r++) OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[r].attack_num == t && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[r].attack_num = 0, S_BOSS.$el.our_unit[r].fire_pung.css({
        display: "none"
      }), S_BOSS.$el.our_unit[r].fire_img.css({
        display: "none"
      }), S_BOSS.del_check_area_our_char(t), S_BOSS.$el.our_unit[r].fire_pung_img.css({
        display: "none"
      }));
    return !0
  }
  return !1
};
S_BOSS.featureWideOur = function(n) {
  for (var y, e, p, i, w, o, s, u, d = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 1), r = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num, h = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power, t = 1; t <= MAX_BOSS_NUM_ON_SCREEN; t++)
    if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1) {
      var b = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x - (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w),
        k = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp,
        f = !1;
      if (CHAR_OUR_TEAM[r].attack_type == ATTACK_TYPE.HIT_WIDE) {
        var c = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_center_x,
          l = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[r].attack_half_width,
          a = c - l,
          v = c + l;
        r == 102 || r == 99 ? (y = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num, e = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x + BOSS_DESIGN[y].beattack_margine, e >= a && e <= v && (f = !0)) : YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x >= a && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x <= v && (f = !0)
      } else CHAR_OUR_TEAM[r].attack_type == ATTACK_TYPE.FULL_WIDE ? f = !0 : b <= OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len + 100 && (f = !0);
      if (f) {
        if (i = h, glo.APP_FEATURE.BOSS_2026 && (p = S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() && typeof gAPP_RELEASE != "undefined" && gAPP_RELEASE == "TEST" ? 10 : .001, i = Math.floor(h * p)), S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].guild_boss_shield === !0 && (i = 0), S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() && (i = S_BOSS.guild_boss_apply_damage_cap(i)), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - i, console.log("%cfeatureWideOur attack!  old hp:" + k + " new hp:" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp + " damage:" + i, "color: yellow"), S_BOSS.draw_damage(t, i), S_GAME.has_innate_ability("our", r, INNATE_ABILITY.MULTI_HIT) && (w = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].socket_index, o = S_GAME.special_ability.get_index_value(r, w, "our", "multi_hit_count"), o > 1))
          for (s = 1; s < o; s++) {
            if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive != 1 || YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp <= 0) break;
            u = S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].guild_boss_shield === !0 ? 0 : i;
            S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() && u > 0 && (u = S_BOSS.guild_boss_apply_damage_cap(u));
            YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - u;
            S_BOSS.draw_damage(t, u)
          }
        YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode == MODE.WAIT && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_BOSS_your_unit" + t + "_img", (S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() ? glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("GUILD_BOSS") : glo.img_url) + "image/char/" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].filename + "/" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].filename + "_beattack_11.png", YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].y);
        YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp <= 0 && S_BOSS.die_by_our_attack(t, n)
      }
    }
};
S_BOSS.die_by_our_attack = function(n, t) {
  USER_NPC.bekilled++;
  YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp < 0 && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp = 0);
  typeof S_BOSS.hp_bar_update_your == "function" && S_BOSS.hp_bar_update_your(n);
  YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.DESTROY;
  S_BOSS.yourunit_display_none(n);
  t > 0 && (S_BOSS.$el.our_unit[t].fire_pung.css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_BOSS.$el.our_unit[t].fire_img.css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_BOSS.$el.our_unit[t].fire_pung_img.css({
    display: "none"
  }))
};
S_BOSS.die_by_your_attack = function(n, t) {
  USER.bekilled++;
  S_BOSS.del_check_area_our_char(n);
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && sound_play(EFF_SOUND.CHAR_DIE);
  OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED;
  OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].shield_102_time = 0;
  S_BOSS.ourunit_display_none(n);
  t > 0 && (S_BOSS.$el.your_unit[t].fire.css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_BOSS.$el.your_unit[t].fire_pung.css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_BOSS.$el.your_unit[t].fire_img.css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_BOSS.$el.your_unit[t].fire_pung_img.css({
    display: "none"
  }));
  S_BOSS.drawOurTeamNumber()
};
S_BOSS.getYou_firt_one = function() {
  for (var t = 0, i = 2e3, n = 1; n <= MAX_BOSS_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && i > YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x && (i = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, t = n);
  return t
};
S_BOSS.featureWideYour = function(n) {
  for (var i, r, h = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 1), t = 1; t <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; t++)
    if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1) {
      var f = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x - (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].w),
        e = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp,
        o = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].socket_index,
        s = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[o].hp,
        u = s / 2;
      if (f <= YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len + 100) {
        if (i = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num, S_GAME.is_koo_char(i)) continue;
        S_GAME.has_special_ability("our", i, SPECIAL_ABILITY.ARMOR) ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].shield_102_time == 0 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - 1) : S_GAME.has_innate_ability("our", i, INNATE_ABILITY.ARMOR) ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].shield_102_time == 0 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - 1) : (r = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].shield_102_time == 0 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - r));
        S_GAME.apply_reflection_buff(t, n, r, "your");
        console.log(" 월드보스 아군데미지: " + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power + "  남은 HP:" + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp);
        e >= u && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp < u && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].flag_hp_half = 1);
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp <= 0 && S_BOSS.die_by_your_attack(t, n)
      }
    } if (CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp = Math.floor(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp - YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power * .2), CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp <= 0) {
    CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp = 0;
    S_BOSS.$el.txt_our_castle.text(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp + " / " + CASTLE_OUR.max_hp);
    S_BOSS.ourCastle_destroyAni();
    return
  }
  CASTLE_OUR.mode == MODE.ATTACK ? utilConsoleLog("==미사일 계속 발사하게 내 버려 두라~~") : CASTLE_OUR.mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED;
  S_BOSS.$el.txt_our_castle.text(Math.floor(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp) + " / " + CASTLE_OUR.max_hp)
};

S_BOSS.isCanBossattack = function(n) {
  for (var e, i, r, u, f, t = 1; t <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; t++)
    if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1) {
      if (e = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_num = t, S_BOSS.isCanYouattack_fireAni(n), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur == S_BOSS.get_boss_fire_hit_frame(n) && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACK && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACKEND)
        for (i = 1, S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() && BOSS_DESIGN[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num] && BOSS_DESIGN[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num].hit_count && (i = BOSS_DESIGN[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num].hit_count), r = 0; r < i; r++) S_BOSS.featureWideYour(n);
      return YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur == S_BOSS.get_boss_fire_hit_frame(n) && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1 && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].flag_hp_half == 1 ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].flag_hp_half = 0 : $("#Img_BOSS_our_unit" + t).css({
        opacity: "1.0",
        "-webkit-transform": "rotate(0deg) scale(1.0,1.0)"
      }), !0
    } if (S_BOSS.isCanYouattack_fireAni(n), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur == S_BOSS.get_boss_fire_hit_frame(n)) {
    for (u = 1, S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n] && BOSS_DESIGN[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num] && BOSS_DESIGN[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num].hit_count && (u = BOSS_DESIGN[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num].hit_count), f = 0; f < u; f++) CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp = Math.floor(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp - YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power * .2);
    if (CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp <= 0) {
      CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp = 0;
      S_BOSS.$el.txt_our_castle.text(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp + " / " + CASTLE_OUR.max_hp);
      S_BOSS.ourCastle_destroyAni();
      return
    }
    return CASTLE_OUR.mode == MODE.ATTACK ? utilConsoleLog("==미사일 계속 발사하게 내 버려 두라~~") : CASTLE_OUR.mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED, S_BOSS.$el.txt_our_castle.text(Math.floor(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp) + " / " + CASTLE_OUR.max_hp), !0
  }
  return !0
};
S_BOSS.drawCastle_our = function() {
  var n = null,
    t, i, r;
  CASTLE_OUR.mode_before = CASTLE_OUR.mode;
  switch (CASTLE_OUR.mode) {
    case MODE.DESTROY:
      n = "_destroy";
      break;
    case MODE.WAIT:
      n = "_wait";
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:
      t = CAL.get_our_castle_level();
      i = t <= 3 ? 4 : 6;
      n = "_attack_" + CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_attack;
      CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_attack >= i ? (CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_attack = 1, S_BOSS.fireRaser(), CASTLE_OUR.mode = MODE.WAIT) : CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_attack++;
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED:
      switch (CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_beattack) {
        case 1:
          n = "_beattack_1";
          CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_beattack = 2;
          break;
        case 2:
          n = "_beattack_2";
          CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_beattack = 1;
          CASTLE_OUR.mode = MODE.WAIT
      }
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_BOSS.drawCastle_our()");
      return
  }
  r = STAGE_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].castle_our_filename + n + ".png";
  utilDrawImage_no_wh$(S_BOSS.$el.our_castle, r, CASTLE_OUR.x, CASTLE_OUR.y, "absolute")
};

  S_GAME.startUnit(n)
};

S_BOSS.addYourUnit = function(n) {
  for (var i = 0, t = 1; t <= MAX_BOSS_NUM_ON_SCREEN; t++)
    if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 0) {
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num = n;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].index = t;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive = 1;
      utilConsoleLog("S_BOSS.addYourUnit---->unit_num=" + n);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].socket_index = S_GAME.get_your_socket_index(n);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x = BOSS_STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_BOSS.stage] < 1280 ? 1280 - BOSS_DESIGN[n].w + BOSS_DESIGN[n].center_gap_x : BOSS_STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_BOSS.stage] - BOSS_DESIGN[n].w + BOSS_DESIGN[n].center_gap_x;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].y = GAME_BASE_Y - BOSS_DESIGN[n].h + BOSS_DESIGN[n].center_gap_y;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].name = BOSS_DESIGN[n].name;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].filename = BOSS_DESIGN[n].filename;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].feature = BOSS_DESIGN[n].feature;
