S_BOSS.interval_set_our_div = function(n) {
  var i = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num,
    f, e, o, u, r, t;
  switch (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode) {
    case MODE.WAIT:
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur++;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur > CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].wait_frame_num && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur = 1);
      break;
    case MODE.MOVE:
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur++;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur > CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].move_frame_num && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur = 1);
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:
      if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur++, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur > CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_frame_num && (S_GAME.is_koo_char(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num) ? (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_frame_num, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x += DEFINE.COW_MOVE_SPEED, console.log(" 쿠 캐릭터 사라짐  unit_num:" + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num)) : (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.WAIT, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1)), S_GAME.set_normal_attcak_count_of_four_gods(i, n, "our"), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur == OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_fire_frame) switch (i) {
        case 27:
        case 28:
        case 43:
        case 44:
        case 45:
        case 46:
          var s = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w - 10,
            h = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].h / 2,
            c = s - 52,
            l = h - 52;
          S_GAME.our_char_pung(n, c, l)
      }
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED:
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur++;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur > CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].beattack_frame_num && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1);
      switch (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur) {
        case 1:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 10;
          break;
        case 2:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 10;
          break;
        case 3:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 8;
          break;
        case 4:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 8;
          break;
        case 5:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 3;
          break;
        case 6:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 1
      }
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 114 ? (f = CASTLE_OUR.baseX + CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].game_gap_x, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x < f && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = f)) : OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x < CASTLE_OUR.baseX && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].game_gap_x !== undefined ? CASTLE_OUR.baseX + CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].game_gap_x : CASTLE_OUR.baseX);
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACK:
      if (S_GAME.ranking_mode != 2 || S_GAME.ranking_mode != 3) {
        utilConsoleLog("Error in S_BOSS.interval_set_our_div()  case MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACK");
        return
      }
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur++;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur > CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].beattack_frame_num && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.WAIT);
      switch (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur) {
        case 1:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 48;
          break;
        case 2:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 42;
          break;
        case 3:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 36;
          break;
        case 4:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 15;
          break;
        case 5:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 12;
          break;
        case 6:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 3
      }
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x < CASTLE_OUR.baseX && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = CASTLE_OUR.baseX);
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACKEND:
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur++;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur > 15 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.WAIT, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1);
      e = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x - CASTLE_OUR.baseX;
      o = .1;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= e * o;

S_BOSS.interval_set_your_div = function(n) {
  var a, v, f = null,
    i = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num,
    t, c, s, e, r, l, u, h, o;
  f = (S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() ? glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("GUILD_BOSS") : glo.img_url) + "image/char/" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].filename + "/";
  a = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w + "px";
  v = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].h + "px";
  t = null;
  switch (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode) {
    case MODE.WAIT:
      t = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].filename + "_wait_" + (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur + 10);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur++;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur > BOSS_DESIGN[i].wait_frame_num && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur = 1);
      break;
    case MODE.MOVE:
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.WAIT;
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur == 1 && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].current_attack_special = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].special_mode === !0);
      c = "_attack_";
      s = BOSS_DESIGN[i].attack_frame_num;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 7 && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].current_attack_special === !0 && (c = "_attack2_", s = BOSS_DESIGN[i].attack2_frame_num || BOSS_DESIGN[i].attack_frame_num);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur > s && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur < 1 && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1);
      t = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].filename + c + (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur + 10);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur++;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur > s && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_done_pending_wait === !0 && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.WAIT, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_done_pending_wait = !1));
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED:
      t = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].filename + "_beattack_" + (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur + 10);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur++;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur > BOSS_DESIGN[i].beattack_frame_num && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1);
    case MODE.DESTROY:
      t = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].filename + "_destroy_" + (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].destroy_frame_cur + 10);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].destroy_frame_cur++;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].destroy_frame_cur > BOSS_DESIGN[i].destroy_frame_num && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].destroy_frame_cur = 1)
  }
  r = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].socket_index;
  switch (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode) {
    case MODE.MOVE:
      l = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur;
      e = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[r].MOVE[l];
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error! in S_BOSS.interval_set_your_div() 08990348 :" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode);
    case MODE.WAIT:
      e = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[r].WAIT[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur];
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:
      e = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[r].ATTACK[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur];
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED:
      e = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[r].BEATTACK[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur];
      break;
    case MODE.DESTROY:
      e = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[r].DESTROY[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].destroy_frame_cur]
  }
  if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode == MODE.ATTACK) {
    for (u = 0, h = 0, o = 1; o <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; o++) OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[o].alive == 1 && (h = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[o].x - YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w / 2, u < h && (u = h), u < 0 && (u = 0));
    YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 1 ? YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur >= 5 ? utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_BOSS_your_unit" + n + "_img", f + t + ".png", u, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y) : utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_BOSS_your_unit" + n + "_img", f + t + ".png", YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y) : utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_BOSS_your_unit" + n + "_img", f + t + ".png", YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y);
    S_BOSS.stage == 1 && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur % 2 != 0 ? $("#S_BOSS_center_shake_div").css({
      top: "-20px"
    }) : $("#S_BOSS_center_shake_div").css({
      top: "0px"
    }));
    YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur == BOSS_DESIGN[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num].attack_frame_num && (S_BOSS.boss_attack_count_power(n), S_BOSS.boss_attack_count_attackspeed(n))
  } else $("#S_BOSS_center_shake_div").css({
    top: "0px",
    position: "absolute"
  }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_BOSS_your_unit" + n + "_img", f + t + ".png", YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y);
  switch (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num) {
    case 1:
      utilScale_xy_bottom("Img_BOSS_your_unit" + n + "_img", 1.8, 1.8);
      break;
    case 2:
      utilScale_xy_bottom("Img_BOSS_your_unit" + n + "_img", 1, 1);
      break;
    case 3:
      utilScale_xy_bottom("Img_BOSS_your_unit" + n + "_img", 1.5, 1.5);
      break;
    case 5:
    case 6:
    case 7:
      break;
    default:
      utilScale_xy_bottom("Img_BOSS_your_unit" + n + "_img", 1.8, 1.8)
  }
  YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode == MODE.DESTROY && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].destroy_frame_cur == 1 && (S_BOSS.$el.your_unit[n].fire.css({
    display: "none"
  }), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp <= 0 && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive = 0, S_BOSS.$el.your_unit[n].fire.css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_BOSS.$el.your_unit[n].fire_pung.css({
    display: "none"
  }), gEnableKey = 1, S_BOSS.end_boss_hp = 0, S_BOSS.end_flag = 1, BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp = -1, S_BOSS.clear_boss()));
  YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp >= 0 && S_BOSS.hp_bar_update_your(n)
};
S_BOSS.clear_boss = function() {
  if (S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode()) {
    S_BOSS.guild_boss_report_damage("승");
    return
  }
  if (glo.APP_FEATURE.BOSS_2026) ServerConnection.update_boss_result("승", function(n) {
    S_RANKING_BOSS.parse_ranking_info(n);
    S_BOSSCLEAR.reward_ruby = 0;
    BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp = parseInt(n.boss_cur_hp);
    ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_BOSSCLEAR, S_BOSSCLEAR)
  });
  else {
    ServerConnection.boss_cur_hp(S_BOSS.stage);
    var n = function() {
      BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp != -1 ? (BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp > 0 ? (S_BOSSCLEAR.reward_ruby = BOSS_DIE_RUBY, BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp = 0) : S_BOSSCLEAR.reward_ruby = 0, ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_BOSSCLEAR, S_BOSSCLEAR)) : setTimeout(n, 100)
    };
    n()
  }
};

CHECK_AREA = new Array(MAX_OUR_TEAM_UNIT + 1);
CHECK_AREA_count = 0;
S_BOSS.init_check_area = function() {
  CHECK_AREA_count = 0;
  for (var n = 1; n <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_UNIT; n++) CHECK_AREA[n] = {}, CHECK_AREA[n].x1 = CHECK_AREA[n].x2 = 0
};
S_BOSS.add_check_area = function(n, t) {
  if (CHECK_AREA_count + 1 > MAX_OUR_TEAM_UNIT) {
    utilConsoleLog("Error in S_BOSS.add_check_area():" + CHECK_AREA_count + 1 + "--이게 full찰리가 없는데..");
    return
  }
  CHECK_AREA[CHECK_AREA_count + 1].x1 = n;
  CHECK_AREA[CHECK_AREA_count + 1].x2 = t;
  CHECK_AREA_count++
};
S_BOSS.del_check_area = function() {
  if (CHECK_AREA_count <= 0) {
    utilConsoleLog("S_BOSS.del_check_area() : 여기서 0 이 될리가 없는데..." + CHECK_AREA_count);
    return
  }
  for (var n = 1; n <= CHECK_AREA_count - 1; n++) CHECK_AREA[n].x1 = CHECK_AREA[n + 1].x1, CHECK_AREA[n].x2 = CHECK_AREA[n + 1].x2;
  CHECK_AREA[CHECK_AREA_count].x1 = CHECK_AREA[CHECK_AREA_count].x2 = 0;
  CHECK_AREA_count--;
  return
};
S_BOSS.del_check_area_our_char = function(n) {
  if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 40) {
    var t = S_BOSS.$el.our_unit[n].fire_pung_img.css("display");
    t == "block" && S_BOSS.del_check_area()
  }
};
S_BOSS.is_check_area = function(n) {
  for (var t = 1; t <= CHECK_AREA_count; t++)
    if (CHECK_AREA[t].x1 <= n && n <= CHECK_AREA[t].x2) return !0;
  return !1
};
S_BOSS.boss_attack_count_power = function(n) {
  S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() || CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp != CASTLE_OUR.max_hp && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power = glo.APP_FEATURE.BOSS_2026 ? Math.floor(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power * 2.5) : Math.floor(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power * 10))
};
S_BOSS.boss_attack_count_attackspeed = function(n) {

S_BOSS.fireRaser = function() {
  var i, t, n, r, u;
  if (RASER.flag == 1) {
    utilConsoleLog("Can not fire because firing....");
    return
  }
  for ((gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && sound_play(EFF_SOUND.RASER_FIRE), RASER.baseX = CASTLE_OUR.x + STAGE_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].nose_x, RASER.baseY = CASTLE_OUR.y + STAGE_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].nose_y, RASER.target_start_x = STAGE_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].castle_our_w, RASER.target_end_x = Math.min(USER.missile_len, STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_BOSS.stage]), RASER.old_x = CASTLE_OUR.x, RASER.w = $("#Img_BOSS_missile").width(), RASER.h = $("#Img_BOSS_missile").height(), i = BOSS_STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_BOSS.stage], n = 1; n <= MAX_BOSS_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && (i = Math.min(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w / 2 - 10, i));
  for (t = i - CASTLE_OUR.baseX, t <= 60 ? (t = 60, RASER.HEIGHT = Math.floor(15 * 1.5)) : RASER.HEIGHT = Math.floor(t / 10 * 1.5), n = 0; n <= RASER_DELTA_X + 2; n++) RASER.x[n] = Math.round(RASER.baseX - RASER.w / 2 + t / (RASER_DELTA_X + 2) * n), RASER.y[n] = RASER.baseY - Math.round(RASER.HEIGHT / -25 * (n - 5) * (n - 5) + RASER.HEIGHT) - RASER.h;
  for (n = 0; n <= RASER_DELTA_X + 1; n++) r = RASER.x[n + 1] - RASER.x[n], u = RASER.y[n] - RASER.y[n + 1], RASER.deg[n] = 90 - Math.round(Math.atan2(u, r) * 360 / 6.283185);
  RASER.deg[RASER_DELTA_X + 2] = RASER.deg[RASER_DELTA_X + 1];
  RASER.flag = 1
};
S_BOSS.fireRaser_interval = function() {
  var n, i, r;
  if (RASER.flag != 0 && (RASER.dx++, $("#Img_BOSS_missile").css({
      display: "block",
      left: RASER.x[RASER.dx] + "px",
      top: RASER.y[RASER.dx] + "px",
      "-webkit-transform-origin": "50% 100%",
      "-webkit-transform": "rotate(" + RASER.deg[RASER.dx] + "deg)",
      position: "absolute"
    }), RASER.pole_x = RASER.x[RASER.dx] + RASER.w / 2 + RASER.h * Math.sin(RASER.deg[RASER.dx] * Math.PI / 180), RASER.pole_y = RASER.y[RASER.dx] + RASER.h - RASER.h * Math.cos(RASER.deg[RASER.dx] * Math.PI / 180), RASER.dx >= RASER_DELTA_X + 2 || RASER.pole_y >= GAME_BASE_Y - 30)) {
    RASER.dx = -1;
    RASER.flag = 0;
    QUEST.f6_missile();
    var t = RASER.x[RASER_DELTA_X + 2],
      u = t - RASER.damage_range,
      f = t + RASER.damage_range;
    for (n = 1; n <= MAX_BOSS_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && (i = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num, r = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + BOSS_DESIGN[i].beattack_margine);
    $("#Img_BOSS_missile").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    S_BOSS.fireRaser_attack();
    return
  }
};
S_BOSS.fireRaser_attack = function() {
  var i = RASER.x[RASER_DELTA_X],
    r = i - RASER.damage_range,
    u = i + RASER.damage_range,
    n = 1,
    f = 7,
    e = RASER.pole_x,
    o = RASER.pole_y,
    t;
  $("#Img_BOSS_raser_pung_effect").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  t = function() {
    var i, h, c, l, s;
    if (n <= f) {
      var a = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url_only_glo() + "image/ui/98_effect/missileEffect_" + n + ".png",
        v = e - 280,
        y = o - 200;
      utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_BOSS_raser_pung_effect", a, v, y);
      setTimeout(t, TIMER_INTERVAL);
      n++
    } else setTimeout(function() {
      utilDraw_image_1pixel("Img_BOSS_raser_pung_effect");
      $("#Img_BOSS_raser_pung_effect").css({
        display: "none"
      })
    }, 50);
    if (n == 5)
      for (i = 1; i <= MAX_BOSS_NUM_ON_SCREEN; i++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].alive == 1 && (h = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].x + BOSS_DESIGN[i].beattack_margine, r <= h && h <= u && (c = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp, s = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].unit_num == 3 ? Math.floor(USER.missile_power * .1) : USER.missile_power, glo.APP_FEATURE.BOSS_2026 && (S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() ? (l = typeof gAPP_RELEASE != "undefined" && gAPP_RELEASE == "TEST" ? 10 : .001, s = Math.floor(USER.missile_power * l), s > 0 && (s = S_BOSS.guild_boss_apply_damage_cap(s))) : s = Math.floor(USER.missile_power * .001)), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp = Math.floor(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp - s), console.log("%cRaser attack!  old hp:" + c + " new hp:" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp + " damage:" + s, "color:yellow"), S_BOSS.draw_damage(i, s), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].mode == MODE.WAIT && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_BOSS_your_unit" + i + "_img", (S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode() ? glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("GUILD_BOSS") : glo.img_url) + "image/char/" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].filename + "/" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].filename + "_beattack_11.png", YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].x, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].y), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp <= 0 && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp = 0, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].mode = MODE.DESTROY)))
  };
  t()
};
S_BOSS.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_BOSS.run_zoom();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.back:
    case KeyDefine.esc:
      S_BOSS.run_back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_BOSS.focus == S_GAME.bottom_ui.get_max_btn() ? (S_BOSS.focus--, S_BOSS.drawFocus()) : S_BOSS.focus >= 2 && (S_BOSS.focus--, S_BOSS.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_BOSS.focusRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_BOSS.focus < USER.socket_available_num + 2 ? (S_BOSS.focus++, S_BOSS.drawFocus()) : S_BOSS.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      3 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_BOSS.focus = 3, S_BOSS.drawFocus(), S_BOSS.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      4 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_BOSS.focus = 4, S_BOSS.drawFocus(), S_BOSS.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
      5 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_BOSS.focus = 5, S_BOSS.drawFocus(), S_BOSS.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM4:
      6 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_BOSS.focus = 6, S_BOSS.drawFocus(), S_BOSS.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM5:
      7 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_BOSS.focus = 7, S_BOSS.drawFocus(), S_BOSS.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.RED:
    case KeyDefine.A:
      S_BOSS.focus = 1;
      S_BOSS.drawFocus();
      S_BOSS.focusRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.BLUE:
      (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB) && (S_BOSS.focus = 2, S_BOSS.drawFocus(), S_BOSS.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.GREEN:
    case KeyDefine.S:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.KT && (S_BOSS.focus = 2, S_BOSS.drawFocus(), S_BOSS.focusRun())
  }
};
S_BOSS.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_BOSS.backKey()
};
S_BOSS.backKey = function() {
  S_BOSS.end();
  utilPush();
  S_POPUPYN.focus = 2;
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN) : ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
    display: "block"
  }), S_POPUPYN.init())
};
S_BOSS.run_zoom = function() {
  var i;
  if (S_BOSS.zoom_flag == 0) {
    if (S_BOSS.notice_flag == 0 && utilNotice(TXT.zoomout, 1.2), SCROLL.flag == 1) return;
    if (S_BOSS.view_mode != 1) return;
    S_BOSS.modeChange_m();
    S_GAME.top_ui.show_zoom_out();
    setTimeout(function() {
      S_BOSS.zoom_flag = 1
    }, 1e3)
  } else {
    if (S_BOSS.notice_flag == 0 && utilNotice(TXT.zoomin, 1.2), S_GAME.top_ui.show_zoom_in(), S_GAME.is_guild_boss_mode()) {
      var n = S_BOSS.guild_boss_ctx && S_BOSS.guild_boss_ctx.boss_no ? parseInt(S_BOSS.guild_boss_ctx.boss_no, 10) : 7,
        t = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("GUILD_BOSS"),
        r = t + "image/bg/mapBOSS" + n + "_bg1.jpg",
        u = t + "image/bg/mapBOSS" + n + "_bg2.png";
      $("#Img_BOSS_bg").css({
        display: "block",
        background: util_bg_url("url(" + r + ") no-repeat 0 0"),
        "background-repeat": "repeat-x"
      });
      $("#Img_BOSS_center_bg").css({
        top: GAME_BASE_Y - 774 + "px",
        background: util_bg_url("url(" + u + ") no-repeat 0 0"),
        "background-repeat": "repeat-x"
      })
    } else i = glo.img_url + "image/bg/mapBOSS_bg.jpg", $("#Img_BOSS_center_bg").css({
      top: GAME_BASE_Y - 774 + "px",
      background: util_bg_url("url(" + i + ")"),
      "background-repeat": "repeat-x"
    });
    S_BOSS.view_mode = 1;
    $("#S_BOSS_center").css({
      left: "0px",
      top: "0px",
      width: "1280px",
      height: "720px",
      position: "absolute"
    });
    utilConsoleLog("View mode 작동=====> " + S_BOSS.view_mode);
    utilScale_xy("S_BOSS_center", S_BOSS.view_mode, S_BOSS.view_mode);
    SCROLL.part_cur_num = 1;
    setTimeout(function() {
      S_BOSS.zoom_flag = 0
    }, 1e3)
  }
};
S_BOSS.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_BOSS.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_BOSS.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_BOSS.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } S_BOSS.board.flag == 0 && (t.id.search("zoom") >= 0 ? S_BOSS.run_zoom() : t.id.search("back") >= 0 ? S_BOSS.run_back() : S_BOSS.focusRun())
  }
};
S_BOSS.onMouseover = function(n) {
  for (var t = n.target, i; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
    if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
      t = null;
      return
    } S_BOSS.board.flag == 0 && (t.id.search(S_GAME.bottom_ui.get_missile_id()) >= 0 ? (S_BOSS.focus = 1, S_BOSS.drawFocus()) : t.id.search(S_GAME.bottom_ui.get_mineral_id()) >= 0 ? (S_BOSS.focus = 2, S_BOSS.drawFocus()) : t.id.search(S_GAME.bottom_ui.get_char_id()) >= 0 && (i = glo.fun.get_only_number_by_text(t.id), USER.socket_available_num >= i && (S_BOSS.focus = i + 2), S_BOSS.drawFocus()))
};
S_BOSS.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_BOSS.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_BOSS.onMouseover(n)
};
S_BOSS.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_BOSS.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_BOSS.onMouseover(n);
  S_BOSS.onClick(n)
};

S_RANKING_BOSS.checkDataReceiveFromServer = function() {
  if (console.log("월드보스 S_RANKING_BOSS.checkDataReceiveFromServer  gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey), S_RANKING_BOSS.server_flag == 1) {
    if (gEnableKey = 1, console.log("월드보스 S_RANKING_BOSS.checkDataReceiveFromServer  server_flag == 1 gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey), clearInterval(S_RANKING_BOSS.timer), S_RANKING_BOSS.timer = null, S_RANKING_BOSS.drawTicketInfo(), S_RANKING_BOSS.getRunOutTime(), S_RANKING_BOSS.drawRanks(), S_RANKING_BOSS.addMouseEvent(), USER.max_score_BOSS >= 0 && USER.ranking_BOSS >= 1) {
      $("#Txt_RB_mydata_text2").text(USER.ranking_BOSS);
      USER.ranking_BOSS <= MAX_GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS && $("#Txt_RB_mydata_text2").text(GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[USER.ranking_BOSS].rank);
      var n = USER.max_score_BOSS / BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].max_hp * 100;
      $("#Txt_RB_mydata_text4").text(n.toFixed(9) + "%")
    } else $("#RB_left_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Txt_RB_mydata_text2").text("-"), $("#Txt_RB_mydata_text4").text("-");
    S_RANKING_BOSS.server_flag = 0
  } else S_RANKING_BOSS.server_count++, S_RANKING_BOSS.server_count >= 5 ? (gEnableKey = 1, console.log("월드보스 S_RANKING_BOSS.checkDataReceiveFromServer  server_count gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey), clearInterval(S_RANKING_BOSS.timer), S_RANKING_BOSS.timer = null, utilNotice(TXT.server_error, 1), utilConsoleLog("Error in S_RANKING_BOSS.checkDataReceiveFromServer()"), S_RANKING_BOSS.addMouseEvent(), S_RANKING_BOSS.server_flag = 0) : (clearInterval(S_RANKING_BOSS.timer), S_RANKING_BOSS.timer = null, S_RANKING_BOSS.timer = setTimeout(S_RANKING_BOSS.checkDataReceiveFromServer, 500))
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.drawRanks = function() {
  var f = 4,
    o = Math.min(S_RANKING_BOSS.server_rank_num, MAX_GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS),
    s = S_RANKING_BOSS.ranking_page * 10,
    r, n, t, u, i, e, h, c;
  if (!glo.APP_FEATURE.BOSS_2026 && o >= 2)
    for (n = 1; n < s; n++) o >= n && GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[n].score == GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[n + 1].score && (GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[n + 1].rank = GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[n].rank);
  for ($("#RB_left_scroll_text2").text(S_RANKING_BOSS.max_ranking_page()), $("#RB_left_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), r = 1; r <= 5; r++) S_RANKING_BOSS.ranking_page == 1 ? utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Txt_RB_left_rank" + r + "_img", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/42_cloud_garden/cloud_toprankbox.png", 43, 114 + 35 * (r - 1)) : utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Txt_RB_left_rank" + r + "_img", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url_only_glo() + "image/ui/0_common/onepixel.png", 105, 208);
  for (n = 1; n <= 10; n++) {
    if (t = s - 10 + n, S_RANKING_BOSS.server_rank_num < t) {
      $("#Txt_RB_left_rank" + n).text("");

      utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("img_RB_left_team" + n + "_char5", "", 9999, 9999, "absolute");
      $("#Txt_RB_left_score" + n).text("");
      $("#Txt_RB_left_id" + n).text("");
      continue
    }
    for ($("#Txt_RB_left_rank" + n).text(GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[t].rank), $("#Txt_RB_left_rank" + n).css({
        left: "59px",
        top: 114 + (31 + f) * (n - 1) + "px",
        width: "29px",
        height: "31px",
        "line-height": "31px",
        "font-size": "18rem",

        position: "absolute"
      }), $("#div_img_RB_left_team" + n).css({
        left: "151px",
        top: 119 + (31 + f) * (n - 1) + "px",
        width: "200px",
        height: "22px",
        position: "absolute"
      }), u = glo.APP_FEATURE.BOSS_2026 ? GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[t].team : GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[t].team.split("||"), i = 0; i <= 4; i++) e = glo.fun.get_img_url_ally(u[i]) + "image/ui/4_game/char/ga_ally_" + u[i] + ".jpg", u[i] == 0 || typeof u[i] == "undefined" ?     glo.APP_FEATURE.BOSS_2026 ?     $("#Txt_RB_left_id" + n).css({

S_RANKING_BOSS.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  utilConsoleLog(" 월드보스 keyDown  keyCode: " + i + " gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey);
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      glo.APP_FEATURE.BOSS_2026 ? (S_RANKING_BOSS.focus--, S_RANKING_BOSS.focus < 1 && (S_RANKING_BOSS.focus = 1), S_RANKING_BOSS.drawFocus()) : gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && (S_RANKING_BOSS.focus = 1, S_RANKING_BOSS.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      glo.APP_FEATURE.BOSS_2026 ? (S_RANKING_BOSS.focus++, S_RANKING_BOSS.focus > S_RANKING_BOSS.max_btn && (S_RANKING_BOSS.focus = S_RANKING_BOSS.max_btn), S_RANKING_BOSS.drawFocus()) : gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && (S_RANKING_BOSS.focus = 2, S_RANKING_BOSS.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_RANKING_BOSS.ranking_page != 1 && S_RANKING_BOSS.make_screen_ranking_list("up");
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_RANKING_BOSS.ranking_page < S_RANKING_BOSS.max_ranking_page() && S_RANKING_BOSS.make_screen_ranking_list("down");
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_RANKING_BOSS.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_RANKING_BOSS.run_back()
  }
};

  S_RANKING_BOSS.removeMouseEvent();
  gEnableKey = 1;
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MODE_SELECT, S_MODE_SELECT);
  sound_bgm_play(BGM_SOUND.WAIT);
  S_MODE_SELECT.cur_boss_hp = BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp
};

S_RANKING_BOSS.max_ranking_page = function() {

};

S_RANKING_BOSS.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  switch (S_RANKING_BOSS.focus) {
    case 1:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && (gEnableKey = 1, S_RANKING_BOSS.run_back());
      break;
    case 2:
      if (!USER.can_I_enter_boss()) {
        utilNotice(TXT.world_boss_entry_available, 2);
        gEnableKey = 1;
        return
      }
      if (console.log("월드보스 S_RANKING_BOSS.menuRu  gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey), glo.APP_FEATURE.BOSS_2026) {
        if (BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp <= 0) {
          utilNotice(TXT.boss_timelimit_2026, 2.5, 16);
          gEnableKey = 1;
          return
        }
        if (S_RANKING_BOSS.tiket <= 0) {
          if (S_RANKING_BOSS.enter_count++, S_RANKING_BOSS.get_fee_gold(), get_cur_gold() >= S_RANKING_BOSS.need_gold) {
            S_RANKING_BOSS.removeMouseEvent();
            $("#Img_RB_start_focus").css({
              display: "none"
            });
            gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
              display: "block"
            }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN);
            return
          }
          S_RANKING_BOSS.enter_count--;
          utilNotice(TXT.pvp_not_enterance, 2);
          gEnableKey = 1;
          return
        }
        boss_mode = "ENTRY_TICKET";
        S_RANKING_BOSS.run_boss_game(boss_mode)
      } else ServerConnection.is_time_init_BOSS(S_RANKING_BOSS.check_init_time);
      break;
    case 3:
      utilPush();
      S_RANKING_BOSS.end();
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM);
      break;
    case 4:
      S_RANKING_BOSS.popup_help();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("error!! in S_RANKING_BOSS.menuRun()")
  }
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.run_boss_game = function(n) {
  loading_show("BOSS대전입장", 1);
  ServerConnection.enter_boss_game(n, function(n) {
    if (loading_hide("BOSS대전입장"), n.STATE === "ERROR") n.CODE == "-101" ? utilNotice(TXT.pvp_timelimit, 2.5, 16) : n.CODE == "-102" ? (utilNotice(TXT.cloud_garden_not_enter, 2.5), S_RANKING_BOSS.tiket = 0, S_RANKING_BOSS.drawTicketInfo()) : n.CODE == "-103" ? utilNotice(TXT.gold_lack, 2.5) : n.CODE == "-104" ? (utilNotice(TXT.boss_timelimit_2026, 2.5), $("#RB_boss_hp_text2").text("0%")) : glo.fun.show_s_error_network(n.ERROR_MESSAGE), gEnableKey = 1;
    else if (n.STATE === "SUCCESS") {
      BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp = parseInt(n.boss_cur_hp);
      var t = BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp / BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].max_hp * 100;
      $("#RB_boss_hp_text2").text(t.toFixed(5) + "%");
      S_RANKING_BOSS.enter_count = parseInt(n.ENTER_COUNT);
      n.MODE === "ENTRY_TICKET" ? (S_RANKING_BOSS.tiket = parseInt(n.cur_ticket), S_RANKING_BOSS.drawTicketInfo()) : n.MODE === "ENTRY_GOLD" && (USER.gold = parseInt(n.s_add_gold));
      S_RANKING_BOSS.removeMouseEvent();
      S_RANKING_BOSS.game_start()
    }
  })
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.check_init_time = function(n) {
  console.log("월드보스 S_RANKING_BOSS.check_init_time  gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey);
  switch (n) {
    case "play":
      BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp = -1;
      loading_show("BOSS대전입장", 1);
      ServerConnection.boss_cur_hp(S_BOSS.stage, function() {
        if (console.log("월드보스 S_RANKING_BOSS.check_init_time boss_cur_hp  gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey), loading_hide("BOSS대전입장"), BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp != -1) {
          var n = BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp / BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].max_hp * 100;
          if ($("#RB_boss_hp_text2").text(n.toFixed(5) + "%"), BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp == 0 && $("#RB_boss_hp_text2").text("0%"), BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp == 0) {
            utilNotice(TXT.boss_timelimit, 2.5, 16);
            gEnableKey = 1;
            return
          }
          S_RANKING_BOSS.tiket <= 0 ? (glo.package.get_month_entry_package_buy_status() == 1 && (S_RANKING_BOSS.need_gold = 0), get_cur_gold() >= S_RANKING_BOSS.need_gold ? (S_RANKING_BOSS.removeMouseEvent(), $("#Img_RB_start_focus").css({
            display: "none"
          }), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
            display: "block"
          }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN)) : (utilNotice(TXT.pvp_not_enterance, 2), gEnableKey = 1)) : (console.log("월드보스 S_RANKING_BOSS.check_init_time boss_cur_hp update_boss_tiket_to_server  gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey), S_RANKING_BOSS.removeMouseEvent(), S_RANKING_BOSS.tiket--, S_RANKING_BOSS.drawTicketInfo(), loading_show("BOSS대전입장", 1), ServerConnection.update_boss_tiket_to_server("월드 보스 ~입장~  티켓 소모 -1 현재 티켓 : " + S_RANKING_BOSS.tiket, function() {
            loading_hide("BOSS대전입장");
            S_RANKING_BOSS.game_start()
          }), update_user_to_server_acc("BOSS대전입장:입장권(" + S_RANKING_BOSS.tiket + "장 남음)"))
        }
      });
      break;
    case "noplay":
      utilNotice(TXT.boss_timelimit, 2.5, 16);
      gEnableKey = 1;
      return
  }
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.game_start = function() {
  if (BOSS_GOIN_FLAG <= 0) {
    USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("보스전에 입장할수 없습니다.", 2.5) : utilNotice("You can not enter World Boss.", 2.5);
    return
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    $("#S_RANKING_BOSS_div").empty()
  }, 1e3);
  document.getElementById("S_BOSS_div") == null ? $("#MM_top").after('<div id= "S_BOSS_div"><\/div>') : $("#S_BOSS_div").empty();
  S_GAME.ranking_mode = 4;
  MAX_BOSS_NUM_ON_SCREEN = BOSS_STAGE_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].boss_max_num;
  console.log("월드보스 S_RANKING_BOSS.game_start gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey);
  utilPush();
  S_SELECTMAP.removeMouseEvent();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_BOSS, S_BOSS)
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.getRunOutTime = function() {
  var n = parseInt(window.g.timestamp_start, 10) + parseInt(window.g.timestamp_due, 10),
    t = S_RANKING_BOSS.boss_run_out_time - n;
  S_RANKING_BOSS.drawRunOutTime(t)
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.drawRunOutTime = function(n) {
  var f, u = n,
    t = Math.floor(u / 36e5),
    i = Math.floor((u - t * 36e5) / 6e4),
    r = Math.floor((u - t * 36e5 - i * 6e4) / 1e3),
    e = t > 9 ? t : t == 0 ? "00" : "0" + t,
    o = i > 9 ? i : i == 0 ? "00" : "0" + i,
    s = r > 9 ? r : r == 0 ? "00" : "0" + r;
  f = e + ":" + o + ":" + s;
  BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp == 0 ? ($("#RB_boss_info_isFinished").text(TXT.boss_catch_success), $("#RB_boss_info_clock_icon").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#RB_boss_info_isFinished").css({
    position: "absolute",
    left: "15px",
    top: "42px",
    width: "234px",
    height: "34px",
    "font-size": USER.lang != LANG.KOREA ? "16rem" : "23rem",
    color: "#df0202",
    "text-align": "center"
  })) : BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp == -1 ? $("#RB_boss_info_isFinished").text("") : n > 0 ? $("#RB_boss_info_isFinished").text(f) : ($("#RB_boss_info_isFinished").text(TXT.boss_catch_fail), $("#RB_boss_info_clock_icon").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#RB_boss_info_isFinished").css({
    position: "absolute",
    left: "15px",
    top: "42px",
    width: "234px",
    height: "34px",
    "font-size": USER.lang != LANG.KOREA ? "16rem" : "23rem",
    color: "#181818",
    "text-align": "center"
  }));
  DEFINE.boss_goin_check();
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_RANKING_BOSS && setTimeout(S_RANKING_BOSS.getRunOutTime, 1e3)
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.tip_draw = function() {
  var n = 1,
    t;
  $("#Txt_RB_info").text(TXT["boss_init_guide" + n]);
  t = function() {
    g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_RANKING_BOSS && (n >= 6 ? n = 1 : n++, utilConsoleLog("~~~~~~보스 랭킹 화면에서 TIP 부분 롤링중 ~~~~~~"), $("#Txt_RB_info").text(TXT["boss_init_guide" + n]), setTimeout(t, 1e4))
  };
  t()
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.yes = function() {
  var n, t;
  if (BOSS_GOIN_FLAG <= 0 || BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp == 0) {
    USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("보스전에 입장할수 없습니다.", 2.5) : utilNotice("You can not enter World Boss.", 2.5);
    return
  }
  if (glo.APP_FEATURE.BOSS_2026) n = "ENTRY_GOLD", S_RANKING_BOSS.run_boss_game(n);
  else {
    if (BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].cur_hp == -1) {
      setTimeout(S_RANKING_BOSS.yes, 100);
      return
    }
    glo.package.get_month_entry_package_buy_status() == 1 && (S_RANKING_BOSS.need_gold = 0);
    USER.gold = USER.gold - S_RANKING_BOSS.need_gold;
    glo.APP_FEATURE.GOLD_CRYPT && encoding_add_gold(-S_RANKING_BOSS.need_gold);
    loading_show("BOSS게임현금입장", 1);
    t = "BOSS게임현금입장(" + S_RANKING_BOSS.need_gold + "골드소모)|GOLD|" + -S_RANKING_BOSS.need_gold + "|" + USER.gold;
    STORAGE.save_all_info_to_storage(t, 0, "gold", function() {
      loading_hide("BOSS게임현금입장", 1);
      S_RANKING_BOSS.game_start()
    });
    S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top()
  }
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.end = function() {
  S_RANKING_BOSS.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.parse_ranking_info = function(n) {
  var i, t;
  for (GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS = [], t = 1; t <= MAX_GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS + 1; t++) GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[t] = {}, GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[t].rank = 0, GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[t].user_name = "", GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[t].team = "", GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[t].score = 0, GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[t].platform = "";
  for (i = n.ranking_list, S_RANKING_BOSS.server_rank_num = i.length, t = 0; t < i.length; t++) GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[t + 1] = [], GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[t + 1].rank = parseInt(i[t].ranking), GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[t + 1].user_name = i[t].user_name, GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[t + 1].team = glo.char.extract_character_numbers(i[t].team), GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[t + 1].score = parseInt(i[t].tot_score), GLOBAL_RANK_BOSS[t + 1].platform = i[t].platform;
  n.hasOwnProperty("my_ranking") && (USER.ranking_BOSS = parseInt(n.my_ranking));
  USER.max_score_BOSS = parseInt(n.TOT_SCORE);
  S_RANKING_PVP.server_flag = 1
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.get_fee_gold = function() {
  var n = S_RANKING_BOSS.enter_count,
    t;
  return glo.package.get_month_entry_package_buy_status() == 1 ? (S_RANKING_BOSS.need_gold = 0, 0) : (t = 0, n >= 0 && n <= 10 ? t = 0 : n >= 11 && n <= 30 ? t = 3e3 : n >= 31 && n <= 50 ? t = 5e3 : n >= 51 && n <= 70 ? t = 7e3 : n >= 71 && (t = 1e4), S_RANKING_BOSS.need_gold = t, t)
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_RANKING_BOSS.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(S_RANKING_BOSS.onMouseover)))
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id == "RB_left_scroll_up" ? S_RANKING_BOSS.ranking_page != 1 && S_RANKING_BOSS.make_screen_ranking_list("up") : t.id == "RB_left_scroll_down" ? S_RANKING_BOSS.ranking_page < S_RANKING_BOSS.max_ranking_page() && S_RANKING_BOSS.make_screen_ranking_list("down") : S_RANKING_BOSS.menuRun()
  }
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    utilConsoleLog(" onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
    switch (n.target.id) {
      case "RB_back":
      case "RB_back_icon":
      case "Txt_RB_back":
      case "Img_RB_back_focus":
        gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && (S_RANKING_BOSS.focus = 1, S_RANKING_BOSS.drawFocus());
        return;
      case "RB_start_btn":
      case "RB_start":
      case "RB_start_icon":
      case "Img_RB_start_focus":
      case "Img_RB_start_chance":
      case "Txt_RB_start_chance":
      case "Txt_RB_start":
        S_RANKING_BOSS.focus = 2;
        S_RANKING_BOSS.drawFocus();
        return;
      case "RB_team_btn":
      case "RB_team":
      case "Txt_RB_team":
      case "Img_RB_team_focus":
        S_RANKING_BOSS.focus = 3;
        S_RANKING_BOSS.drawFocus();
        return;
      case "RB_help":
      case "RB_help_icon":
      case "Txt_RB_help":
      case "Img_RB_help_focus":
        S_RANKING_BOSS.focus = 4;
        S_RANKING_BOSS.drawFocus();
        return;
      default:
        utilConsoleLog("Please define this id in S_RANKING_BOSS.onMouseover():" + n.target.id)
    }
  }
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_RANKING_BOSS.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_RANKING_BOSS.onMouseover(n)
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_RANKING_BOSS.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_RANKING_BOSS.onMouseover(n);
  S_RANKING_BOSS.onClick(n)
};
S_RANKING_BOSS.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_RANKING_BOSS.backKey()
};

S_BOSSFAIL.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var r = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    i;
  switch (r) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_BOSSFAIL.focus > 1 && (S_BOSSFAIL.focus--, S_BOSSFAIL.guild_boss_mode && S_BOSSFAIL.focus === 4 && (S_BOSSFAIL.focus = 3), S_BOSSFAIL.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      i = REWARD_AD.is_shown("BF_ad_btn") ? 6 : 5;
      S_BOSSFAIL.focus < i && (S_BOSSFAIL.focus++, S_BOSSFAIL.guild_boss_mode && S_BOSSFAIL.focus === 4 && (S_BOSSFAIL.focus = 5), S_BOSSFAIL.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_BOSSFAIL.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      S_BOSSFAIL.focus = 1;
      S_BOSSFAIL.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      S_BOSSFAIL.focus = 2;
      S_BOSSFAIL.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
      S_BOSSFAIL.focus = 3;
      S_BOSSFAIL.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM4:
      S_BOSSFAIL.focus = S_BOSSFAIL.guild_boss_mode ? 5 : 4;
      S_BOSSFAIL.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM5:
      if (S_BOSSFAIL.guild_boss_mode) break;
      S_BOSSFAIL.focus = 5;
      S_BOSSFAIL.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_BOSSFAIL.focus = 5;
      S_BOSSFAIL.menuRun()
  }
};
S_BOSSFAIL.backKey = function() {
  S_BOSSFAIL.menuRun()
};

S_BOSSFAIL.make_screen_spawn_star = function(n, t, i, r, u, f) {
  u = typeof u == "number" ? u : 0;
  setTimeout(function() {
    var s = "BF_star_" + n + "_" + t,
      c = Math.floor(Math.random() * 41) + 26,
      l = Math.floor(Math.random() * 360),
      w = n === "L" ? 1 : -1,
      a = 40,
      b = n === "L" ? i - a : i + a,
      o = 1200,
      v = l + w * 270,
      h, u, e, y, p;
    utilDrawImage(s, f, i, r, c, c, "absolute");
    h = document.getElementById("Img_BF_title_effect") || document.getElementById("S_BOSSFAIL_div") || document.body;
    u = document.getElementById(s);
    u ? h && u.parentNode !== h && h.appendChild(u) : (u = document.createElement("div"), u.id = s, u.style.position = "absolute", u.style.left = i + "px", u.style.top = r + "px", u.style.width = c + "px", u.style.height = c + "px", u.style.backgroundImage = util_bg_url("url(" + f + ")"), u.style.backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat", u.style.backgroundPosition = "50% 50%", u.style.backgroundSize = "contain", h.appendChild(u));
    e = $("#" + s);
    e.css({
      "z-index": 103,
      "pointer-events": "none",
      opacity: 1,
      "transform-origin": "50% 50%",
      "-webkit-transform-origin": "50% 50%",
      transform: "translateZ(0) rotate(" + l + "deg) scale(1)",
      "-webkit-transform": "translateZ(0) rotate(" + l + "deg) scale(1)",
      transition: "none",
      "-webkit-transition": "none"
    });
    e[0] && e[0].offsetWidth;
    y = "transform " + o + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), left " + o + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), opacity " + o + "ms linear";
    p = "-webkit-transform " + o + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), left " + o + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), opacity " + o + "ms linear";
    e.css({
      transition: y,
      "-webkit-transition": p
    });
    e[0] && e[0].offsetWidth;
    e.css({
      left: b + "px",
      opacity: 0,
      transform: "translateZ(0) rotate(" + v + "deg) scale(0)",
      "-webkit-transform": "translateZ(0) rotate(" + v + "deg) scale(0)"
    });
    setTimeout(function() {
      var n = document.getElementById(s);
      n && n.parentNode && n.parentNode.removeChild(n)
    }, o + 120)
  }, u)
};

S_BOSSFAIL.drawFocus = function() {
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  $("#Img_BF_make_team_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_BF_upgrade_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_BF_main_menu_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_BF_select_mode_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_BF_retry_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_BF_ad_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_BOSSFAIL.focus == 1 ? $("#Img_BF_make_team_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_BOSSFAIL.focus == 2 ? $("#Img_BF_upgrade_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_BOSSFAIL.focus == 3 ? $("#Img_BF_main_menu_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_BOSSFAIL.focus == 4 ? $("#Img_BF_select_mode_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_BOSSFAIL.focus == 5 ? $("#Img_BF_retry_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_BOSSFAIL.focus == 6 && $("#Img_BF_ad_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  })
};
S_BOSSFAIL.menuRun = function() {
  if (util_key_number.clear_all(), S_BOSSFAIL.guild_boss_mode && S_BOSSFAIL.focus === 5) {
    S_BOSS.guild_boss_back_to_lobby();
    return
  }
  switch (S_BOSSFAIL.focus) {
    case 6:
      if (!REWARD_AD.is_enabled("BF_ad_btn")) {
        REWARD_AD.notice_state("BF_ad_btn");
        break
      }
      REWARD_AD.play(S_BOSSFAIL.get_ad_place(), "", null, S_BOSSFAIL.on_reward_ad);
      break;
    case 1:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM);
      break;
    case 2:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_UPGRADE, S_UPGRADE);
      break;
    case 3:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU);
      break;
    case 4:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MODE_SELECT, S_MODE_SELECT);
      break;
    case 5:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_RANKING_BOSS, S_RANKING_BOSS);
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("S_BOSSFAIL.menuRun(): Unknown focus value: " + S_BOSSFAIL.focus)
  }
};
S_BOSSFAIL.yes = function() {
  if (BOSS_GOIN_FLAG <= 0) {
    USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("보스전에 입장할수 없습니다.", 2.5) : utilNotice("You can not enter World Boss.", 2.5);
    return
  }
  USER.gold = USER.gold - S_RANKING_BOSS.need_gold;
  glo.APP_FEATURE.GOLD_CRYPT && encoding_add_gold(-S_RANKING_BOSS.need_gold);
  loading_show("BOSS입장", 1);
  STORAGE.save_all_info_to_storage("BOSS입장|GOLD|" + -S_RANKING_BOSS.need_gold + "|" + USER.gold, 0, "gold", function() {
    loading_hide("BOSS입장", 1);
    ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_BOSS, S_BOSS)
  })
};
S_BOSSFAIL.end = function() {
  S_BOSSFAIL.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_BOSSFAIL.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_BOSSFAIL.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_BOSSFAIL.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_BOSSFAIL.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } S_BOSSFAIL.menuRun()
  }
};
S_BOSSFAIL.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) switch (n.target.id) {
    case "make_team_button":
    case "Img_BF_make_team_bg":
    case "Txt_BF_make_team_text":
    case "Img_BF_make_team_focus":
      S_BOSSFAIL.focus = 1;
      S_BOSSFAIL.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "upgrade_button":
    case "Img_BF_upgrade_bg":
    case "Txt_BF_upgrade_text":
    case "Img_BF_upgrade_focus":
      S_BOSSFAIL.focus = 2;
      S_BOSSFAIL.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "main_menu_button":
    case "Img_BF_main_menu_bg":
    case "Txt_BF_main_menu_text":
    case "Img_BF_main_menu_focus":
      S_BOSSFAIL.focus = 3;
      S_BOSSFAIL.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "select_mode_button":
    case "Img_BF_select_mode_bg":
    case "Txt_BF_select_mode_text":
    case "Img_BF_select_mode_focus":
      S_BOSSFAIL.focus = 4;
      S_BOSSFAIL.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "retry_button":
    case "Img_BF_retry_bg":
    case "Txt_BF_retry_text":
    case "Img_BF_retry_focus":
      S_BOSSFAIL.focus = 5;
      S_BOSSFAIL.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "BF_ad_btn":
    case "Txt_BF_ad_btn_label":
    case "Txt_BF_ad_btn_sub":
    case "Img_BF_ad_btn_dim":
    case "Img_BF_ad_focus":
      S_BOSSFAIL.focus = 6;
      S_BOSSFAIL.drawFocus();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Please define this id in S_BOSSFAIL.onMouseover():" + n.target.id)
  }
};
S_BOSSFAIL.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_BOSSFAIL.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_BOSSFAIL.onMouseover(n)
};
S_BOSSFAIL.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_BOSSFAIL.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_BOSSFAIL.onMouseover(n);
  S_BOSSFAIL.onClick(n)
};
S_BOSSFAIL.on_reward_ad = function(n) {
  if (S_BOSSFAIL.guild_boss_mode === !0) n && typeof n.APPLIED != "undefined" && (typeof S_BOSS != "undefined" && typeof S_BOSS.guild_boss_tot_damage != "undefined" && (S_BOSS.guild_boss_tot_damage = parseInt(S_BOSS.guild_boss_tot_damage, 10) + parseInt(n.APPLIED, 10)), $("#BF_damage_value").text(utilGetNumber_withComma(n.APPLIED)));
  else if (n && typeof n.SCORE != "undefined" && typeof BOSS_DESIGN != "undefined" && BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage]) {
    var t = (parseInt(n.SCORE, 10) / BOSS_DESIGN[S_BOSS.stage].max_hp * 100).toFixed(10);
    $("#BF_damage_value").text(t + "%")
  }
  utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_boss_x2, 2);
  REWARD_AD.hide("BF_ad_btn")
};

  utilConsoleLog("S_BOSSCLEAR.init()");
  gEnableKey = 0;
  $("#S_BOSS_div").empty();
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && S_BOSSCLEAR.maketag();
  sound_bgm_play(BGM_SOUND.WAIT);
  bga("send", "event", "game", "BOSS" + S_BOSS.stage, "win");
  $("#S_BOSSCLEAR_div").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_BOSSCLEAR;
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_BOSSCLEAR.add_score = S_BOSS.start_boss_hp - S_BOSS.end_boss_hp;
  glo.APP_FEATURE.BOSS_2026 || S_BOSSCLEAR.guild_boss_mode || glo.TEST_MODE.BOSS_ENTER || S_BOSS.start_boss_hp != -1 && S_BOSS.end_boss_hp != -1 && (ServerConnection.update_boss_to_server(S_BOSS.stage, S_BOSSCLEAR.add_score, "월드 보스 ~성공~  데미지 : " + S_BOSSCLEAR.add_score + " 보스 HP " + S_BOSS.start_boss_hp + " -> " + S_BOSS.end_boss_hp), update_user_to_server_acc("월드 보스 ~성공~  데미지 : " + S_BOSSCLEAR.add_score + " 보스 HP " + S_BOSS.start_boss_hp + " -> " + S_BOSS.end_boss_hp));

S_BOSSCLEAR.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_BOSSCLEAR.focus > 1 && (S_BOSSCLEAR.focus--, S_BOSSCLEAR.guild_boss_mode && S_BOSSCLEAR.focus === 4 && (S_BOSSCLEAR.focus = 3), S_BOSSCLEAR.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_BOSSCLEAR.focus < 5 && (S_BOSSCLEAR.focus++, S_BOSSCLEAR.guild_boss_mode && S_BOSSCLEAR.focus === 4 && (S_BOSSCLEAR.focus = 5), S_BOSSCLEAR.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_BOSSCLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      S_BOSSCLEAR.focus = 1;
      S_BOSSCLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      S_BOSSCLEAR.focus = 2;
      S_BOSSCLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
      S_BOSSCLEAR.focus = 3;
      S_BOSSCLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM4:
      S_BOSSCLEAR.focus = S_BOSSCLEAR.guild_boss_mode ? 5 : 4;
      S_BOSSCLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM5:
      if (S_BOSSCLEAR.guild_boss_mode) break;
      S_BOSSCLEAR.focus = 5;
      S_BOSSCLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_BOSSCLEAR.focus = 5;
      S_BOSSCLEAR.menuRun()
  }
};

S_BOSSCLEAR.make_screen_spawn_star = function(n, t, i, r, u, f) {
  u = typeof u == "number" ? u : 0;
  setTimeout(function() {
    var s = "BC_star_" + n + "_" + t,
      c = Math.floor(Math.random() * 41) + 26,
      l = Math.floor(Math.random() * 360),
      w = n === "L" ? 1 : -1,
      a = 40,
      b = n === "L" ? i - a : i + a,
      o = 1200,
      v = l + w * 270,
      h, u, e, y, p;
    utilDrawImage(s, f, i, r, c, c, "absolute");
    h = document.getElementById("Img_BC_title_effect") || document.getElementById("S_BOSSCLEAR_div") || document.body;
    u = document.getElementById(s);
    u ? h && u.parentNode !== h && h.appendChild(u) : (u = document.createElement("div"), u.id = s, u.style.position = "absolute", u.style.left = i + "px", u.style.top = r + "px", u.style.width = c + "px", u.style.height = c + "px", u.style.backgroundImage = util_bg_url("url(" + f + ")"), u.style.backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat", u.style.backgroundPosition = "50% 50%", u.style.backgroundSize = "contain", h.appendChild(u));
    e = $("#" + s);
    e.css({
      "z-index": 103,
      "pointer-events": "none",
      opacity: 1,
      "transform-origin": "50% 50%",
      "-webkit-transform-origin": "50% 50%",
      transform: "translateZ(0) rotate(" + l + "deg) scale(1)",
      "-webkit-transform": "translateZ(0) rotate(" + l + "deg) scale(1)",
      transition: "none",
      "-webkit-transition": "none"
    });
    e[0] && e[0].offsetWidth;
    y = "transform " + o + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), left " + o + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), opacity " + o + "ms linear";
    p = "-webkit-transform " + o + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), left " + o + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), opacity " + o + "ms linear";
    e.css({
      transition: y,
      "-webkit-transition": p
    });
    e[0] && e[0].offsetWidth;
    e.css({
      left: b + "px",
      opacity: 0,
      transform: "translateZ(0) rotate(" + v + "deg) scale(0)",
      "-webkit-transform": "translateZ(0) rotate(" + v + "deg) scale(0)"
    });
    setTimeout(function() {
      var n = document.getElementById(s);
      n && n.parentNode && n.parentNode.removeChild(n)
    }, o + 120)
  }, u)
};

      display: "block"
    });

      e = 19 - Math.round(CHAR_OUR_TEAM[t].h * u),

  }

S_BOSSCLEAR.backKey = function() {
  S_BOSSCLEAR.focus = 5;
  S_BOSSCLEAR.menuRun()
};
S_BOSSCLEAR.menuRun = function() {
  if (util_key_number.clear_all(), S_BOSSCLEAR.guild_boss_mode && S_BOSSCLEAR.focus === 5) {
    S_BOSS.guild_boss_back_to_lobby();
    return
  }
  switch (S_BOSSCLEAR.focus) {
    case 1:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM);
      break;
    case 2:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_UPGRADE, S_UPGRADE);
      break;
    case 3:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU);
      break;
    case 4:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MODE_SELECT, S_MODE_SELECT);
      break;
    case 5:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_RANKING_BOSS, S_RANKING_BOSS);
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("S_BOSSCLEAR.menuRun(): Unknown focus value: " + S_BOSSCLEAR.focus)
  }
};
S_BOSSCLEAR.end = function() {
  S_BOSSCLEAR.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_BOSSCLEAR.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_BOSSCLEAR.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_BOSSCLEAR.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_BOSSCLEAR.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } S_BOSSCLEAR.menuRun()
  }
};
S_BOSSCLEAR.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) switch (n.target.id) {
    case "make_team_button":
    case "Img_BC_make_team_bg":
    case "Txt_BC_make_team_text":
    case "Img_BC_make_team_focus":
      S_BOSSCLEAR.focus = 1;
      S_BOSSCLEAR.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "upgrade_button":
    case "Img_BC_upgrade_bg":
    case "Txt_BC_upgrade_text":
    case "Img_BC_upgrade_focus":
      S_BOSSCLEAR.focus = 2;
      S_BOSSCLEAR.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "main_menu_button":
    case "Img_BC_main_menu_bg":
    case "Txt_BC_main_menu_text":
    case "Img_BC_main_menu_focus":
      S_BOSSCLEAR.focus = 3;
      S_BOSSCLEAR.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "select_mode_button":
    case "Img_BC_select_mode_bg":
    case "Txt_BC_select_mode_text":
    case "Img_BC_select_mode_focus":
      S_BOSSCLEAR.focus = 4;
      S_BOSSCLEAR.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "retry_button":
    case "Img_BC_retry_bg":
    case "Txt_BC_retry_text":
    case "Img_BC_retry_focus":
      S_BOSSCLEAR.focus = 5;
      S_BOSSCLEAR.drawFocus();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Please define this id in S_BOSSCLEAR.onMouseover():" + n.target.id)
  }
};
S_BOSSCLEAR.yes = function() {
  if (BOSS_GOIN_FLAG <= 0) {
    USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice("보스전에 입장할수 없습니다.", 2.5) : utilNotice("You can not enter World Boss.", 2.5);
    return
  }
  USER.gold = USER.gold - S_RANKING_BOSS.need_gold;
  glo.APP_FEATURE.GOLD_CRYPT && encoding_add_gold(-S_RANKING_BOSS.need_gold);
  loading_show("BOSS입장", 1);
  STORAGE.save_all_info_to_storage("BOSS입장|GOLD|" + -S_RANKING_BOSS.need_gold + "|" + USER.gold, 0, "gold", function() {
    loading_hide("BOSS입장", 1);
    ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_BOSS, S_BOSS)
  })
};
S_BOSSCLEAR.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_BOSSCLEAR.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_BOSSCLEAR.onMouseover(n)
};
S_BOSSCLEAR.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_BOSSCLEAR.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_BOSSCLEAR.onMouseover(n);
  S_BOSSCLEAR.onClick(n)
};

S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.focus >= 2 && (S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.focus--, S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.focus < 2 && (S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.focus++, S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : (S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.focus = 2, S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.menuRun_Run())
  }
};

S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR) && sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  utilScale_xy_center("APP_btn" + S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("APP_btn_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("APP_btn" + S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.focus, 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("APP_btn_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.focus == 2)
    if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) switch (g_sceneinfo.before_scene) {
      case gS_POPUPYN:
      case gS_MAINMENU:
        S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.back_mainmenu()
    } else switch (g_sceneinfo.before_scene) {
      case gS_POPUPYN:
      case gS_MAINMENU:
        S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.back_mainmenu()
    } else if (glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) try {
      if (S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.isConnected()) {
        utilNoticeUpper(TXT.payment_fail_mobile_connect, 2);
        return
      }
      if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB) {
        $("#S_AUTOPLAY_PAID_div").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.end();
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_PAYMENT_CNM, S_PAYMENT_CNM);
        return
      }
      Main.use_android_bridge() ? (android_bridge.show_progress_dialog(), android_bridge.request_payment("atv_eldorado_auto")) : S_PACKAGE_STORE.payment_cancel("1")
    } catch (n) {
      S_PACKAGE_STORE.payment_cancel("2")
    } else gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR ? (ServerConnection.payment_count("XSOLLA"), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV ? ($("#S_AUTOPLAY_PAID_div").css({
      display: "none"
    }), S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.end(), $("#S_INPUT_PAY_div").css({
      display: "block"
    }), S_INPUT_PAY.init()) : gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR ? ($("#S_AUTOPLAY_PAID_div").css({
      display: "none"
    }), S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.end(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_INPUT_PAY, S_INPUT_PAY)) : glo.fun.is_glo_platform() && ($("#S_AUTOPLAY_PAID_div").css({
      display: "none"
    }), S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.end(), $("#S_INPUT_PAY_div").css({
      display: "block"
    }), S_INPUT_PAY.init())) : USER.bonus_point >= AUTOPLAY.need_bp ? (S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.backKey(), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.HCN || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
      display: "block"
    }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN)) : (S_AUTOPLAY_PAID.back_mainmenu(), utilNotice(TXT.bonus_point_lack, 1.4))
};

S_MAILBOX = {
  MAX_NUM: 100,
  row_focus: 2,
  list_focus: 1,
  btn_focus: 1,
  view_flag: 0,
  is_partial_get: !1
};
S_MAILBOX.reward_init = function() {
  window.g.REWARD != null && (window.g.REWARD = null);
  window.g.REWARD = new Array(S_MAILBOX.MAX_NUM + 1);
  for (var n = 1; n <= S_MAILBOX.MAX_NUM; n++) window.g.REWARD[n] = {}, S_MAILBOX.reward_init_i(n);
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.ruby = 0;
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.gold = 0;
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.bp = 0;
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.char = "";
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.item = "";
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.cloud_piece = 0;
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.celestialbar = 0
};
S_MAILBOX.reward_init_i = function(n) {
  window.g.REWARD[n].sn = 0;
  window.g.REWARD[n].why = null;
  window.g.REWARD[n].what = null;
  window.g.REWARD[n].what_value = 0;
  window.g.REWARD[n].start_date = null;
  window.g.REWARD[n].end_date = null
};
S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num = function() {
  var t, n;
  if (window.g.REWARD == null) return 0;
  for (t = 0, n = 1; n <= S_MAILBOX.MAX_NUM; n++)
    if (window.g.REWARD[n].sn > 0) t++;
    else break;
  return t
};
S_MAILBOX.reward_del_i = function(n) {
  if (window.g.REWARD[n].sn == 0) {
    glo.fun.show_s_error_network("S_MAILBOX.reward_del_i() 에서 오류 :" + n);
    return
  }
  S_MAILBOX.reward_init_i(n);
  for (var t = n + 1; t <= S_MAILBOX.MAX_NUM; t++)
    if (window.g.REWARD[t].sn > 0) window.g.REWARD[t - 1].sn = window.g.REWARD[t].sn, window.g.REWARD[t - 1].why = window.g.REWARD[t].why, window.g.REWARD[t - 1].what = window.g.REWARD[t].what, window.g.REWARD[t - 1].what_value = window.g.REWARD[t].what_value, window.g.REWARD[t - 1].start_date = window.g.REWARD[t].start_date, window.g.REWARD[t - 1].end_date = window.g.REWARD[t].end_date, S_MAILBOX.reward_init_i(t);
    else break
};
S_MAILBOX.preload = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_POPUP_ORANGE_PAY.preload()!!");
  gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.KT && ChangeScene.end_loading()
};
S_MAILBOX.init = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_MAILBOX.init()");
  S_MAINMENU.unmount_mm_top();
  $("#S_MAILBOX_div").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MAILBOX;
  S_MAILBOX.make_tag();
  S_MAILBOX.addMouseEvent();
  S_MAILBOX.row_focus = 2;
  S_MAILBOX.btn_focus = 1;
  S_MAILBOX.list_focus = 1;
  S_MAILBOX.make_screen();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_MAILBOX.view_flag = 1
};

S_MAILBOX.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var f = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    u, i, r;
  switch (f) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_MAILBOX.row_focus == 1 ? (u = Math.floor((S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num() - 1) / 5) + 1, i = Math.floor((S_MAILBOX.list_focus - 1) / 5) + 1, i >= 2 && (S_MAILBOX.pressed_left(), gEnableKey = 0, setTimeout(function() {
        i--;
        S_MAILBOX.make_screen_list_page(i);
        S_MAILBOX.list_focus = (i - 1) * 5 + 1;
        S_MAILBOX.draw_focus();
        gEnableKey = 1
      }, 600))) : S_MAILBOX.btn_focus == 2 && (S_MAILBOX.btn_focus = 1, S_MAILBOX.draw_focus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_MAILBOX.row_focus == 1 ? (u = Math.floor((S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num() - 1) / 5) + 1, i = Math.floor((S_MAILBOX.list_focus - 1) / 5) + 1, i < u && (S_MAILBOX.pressed_right(), gEnableKey = 0, setTimeout(function() {
        i++;
        S_MAILBOX.make_screen_list_page(i);
        S_MAILBOX.list_focus = (i - 1) * 5 + 1;
        S_MAILBOX.draw_focus();
        gEnableKey = 1
      }, 600))) : S_MAILBOX.btn_focus == 1 && (S_MAILBOX.btn_focus = 2, S_MAILBOX.draw_focus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_MAILBOX.row_focus == 1 ? (r = S_MAILBOX.list_focus % 5, r == 0 && (r = 5), r >= 2 && (S_MAILBOX.list_focus--, S_MAILBOX.draw_focus())) : (S_MAILBOX.row_focus = 1, S_MAILBOX.draw_focus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_MAILBOX.row_focus == 1 && (r = S_MAILBOX.list_focus % 5, r == 0 && (r = 5), r == 5 ? (S_MAILBOX.row_focus = 2, S_MAILBOX.draw_focus()) : S_MAILBOX.list_focus < S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num() ? (S_MAILBOX.list_focus++, S_MAILBOX.draw_focus()) : (S_MAILBOX.row_focus = 2, S_MAILBOX.draw_focus()));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_MAILBOX.menu_run();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.back:
    case KeyDefine.esc:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_MAILBOX.back()
  }
};
S_MAILBOX.back = function() {
  S_MAILBOX.end();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU)
};

S_MAILBOX.draw_focus_list = function() {
  var n, t;
  if (S_MAILBOX.row_focus != 1) {
    console.error("Error in S_MAILBOX.draw_focus_list():호출되면 안됨.");
    return
  }
  for ($("#MBOX_btn1_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#MBOX_btn2_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), n = 1; n <= 5; n++) $("#MBOX_list" + n + "_btn_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  t = S_MAILBOX.list_focus % 5;
  t == 0 && (t = 5);
  $("#MBOX_list" + t + "_btn_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  })
};

S_MAILBOX.menu_run = function() {
  var r = gEnableKey,
    n, t, i;
  gEnableKey = 0;
  n = "";
  t = "";
  S_MAILBOX.row_focus == 1 ? (i = S_MAILBOX.list_focus % 5, i == 0 && (i = 5), n = "MBOX_list" + i + "_btn", t = n + "_focus") : (n = "MBOX_btn" + S_MAILBOX.btn_focus, t = "MBOX_btn" + S_MAILBOX.btn_focus + "_focus");
  utilScale_xy_center(n, window.g.KeyScale, window.g.KeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center(t, window.g.KeyScale, window.g.KeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center(n, 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center(t, 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = r;
      S_MAILBOX.menu_run_run()
    }, window.g.KeyUpTime)
  }, window.g.KeyPressTime)
};
S_MAILBOX.menu_run_run = function() {
  if (S_MAILBOX.row_focus == 1) {
    gEnableKey = 0;
    loading_show();
    var n = window.g.REWARD[S_MAILBOX.list_focus].sn;
    S_MAILBOX.reward_get_in_server(S_MAILBOX.list_focus)
  } else S_MAILBOX.btn_focus == 1 ? (gEnableKey = 0, loading_show(), $("#MBOX_btn1").css({
    display: "block"
  }), S_MAILBOX.reward_get_in_server()) : S_MAILBOX.back()
};
S_MAILBOX.reward_i_run1 = function() {
  var n = window.g.REWARD[S_MAILBOX.list_focus].sn;
  ServerConnection.check_reward_sn_i(n)
};
S_MAILBOX.reward_i_run2 = function() {
  var t, i, r, n, u;
  if (window.g.REWARD[S_MAILBOX.list_focus].what == "HERO_ITEM") {
    t = window.g.REWARD[S_MAILBOX.list_focus].sn;
    S_MAILBOX_HERO.reward_sn = t;
    S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value = window.g.REWARD[S_MAILBOX.list_focus].what_value;
    S_MAILBOX_HERO.init();
    loading_hide();
    gEnableKey = 1;
    return
  }
  if (i = 1, window.g.REWARD[S_MAILBOX.list_focus].what == "CHAR" && (n = STORAGE.get_my_char_tot_num(), n + i > STORAGE.data1.upgrade[8])) {
    utilNotice(TXT.space_lack, 3);
    loading_hide();
    gEnableKey = 1;
    return
  }
  if (r = 1, window.g.REWARD[S_MAILBOX.list_focus].what == "ITEM" && (n = STORAGE.get_my_item_tot_num(), n + r > DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX)) {
    utilNotice(TXT.item_space_lack, 3);
    loading_hide();
    gEnableKey = 1;
    return
  }
  u = S_MAILBOX.reward_get_i(S_MAILBOX.list_focus)
};
S_MAILBOX.reward_i_run3 = function() {
  if (utilNotice(TXT.do_get, 3), S_MAILBOX.reward_del_i(S_MAILBOX.list_focus), S_MAILBOX.list_focus > S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num() && (S_MAILBOX.list_focus = S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num()), S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num() == 0) {
    loading_hide();
    S_MAILBOX.back();
    return
  }
  var n = Math.floor((S_MAILBOX.list_focus - 1) / 5) + 1;
  S_MAILBOX.make_screen_list_page(n);
  loading_hide();
  gEnableKey = 1;
  S_MAILBOX.draw_focus()
};
