S_MAILBOX.reward_get_in_server = function(n) {
  var u = typeof n == "number" ? !1 : !0,
    g, i, l, t, d, s, st, ht, h, v, c, y;
  if (S_MAILBOX.is_fetch_all = u, !u && window.g.REWARD[n].what == "HERO_ITEM") {
    g = window.g.REWARD[n].sn;
    S_MAILBOX_HERO.reward_sn = g;
    S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value = window.g.REWARD[n].what_value;
    S_MAILBOX_HERO.init();
    loading_hide();
    gEnableKey = 1;
    return
  }
  if (u)
    for (i = "", l = S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num(), t = 1; t <= l; t++) window.g.REWARD[t].what != "HERO_ITEM" && (i = i == "" ? window.g.REWARD[t].sn : i + "," + window.g.REWARD[t].sn);
  else i = window.g.REWARD[n].sn, l = n;
  var ct = STORAGE.get_my_char_tot_num(),
    lt = STORAGE.get_my_item_tot_num(),
    p = 0,
    w = 0,
    nt = 0,
    tt = 0,
    it = 0,
    f = "",
    e = "",
    a = 0,
    r = 0,
    b = [],
    k = [],
    o = "",
    rt = 0,
    ut = 0,
    at = u ? 1 : n;
  for (t = at; t <= l; t++) switch (window.g.REWARD[t].what) {
    case "RUBY":
      nt += Number(window.g.REWARD[t].what_value);
      break;
    case "GOLD":
      tt += Number(window.g.REWARD[t].what_value);
      break;
    case "BP":
      it += Number(window.g.REWARD[t].what_value);
      break;
    case "CHAR":
      p++;
      a = window.g.REWARD[t].what_value;
      f = f == "" || f == null ? a + "" : f + "," + a;
      o = a + ":1:" + CHAR_OUR_TEAM[a].max_level + ":0:0";
      glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING && (o = o + ":0");
      b.push(o);
      break;
    case "ITEM":
      w++;
      r = window.g.REWARD[t].what_value;
      e = e == "" || e == null ? r + "" : e + "," + r;
      d = String(r).length;
      d == 3 ? s = Math.floor(Math.random() * (DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION.length - 1) + 1) : d == 4 && (s = String(r).charAt(3), r = Math.floor(r / 10));
      var ft = DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION[s].ran_option[S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade_return_num(r)][2],
        et = DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION[s].ran_option[S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade_return_num(r)][3],
        vt = et - ft,
        ot = ft + Math.floor(Math.random() * vt + 1);
      s == 7 && (ot = et);
      st = DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION[s].name;
      ht = ot;
      o = r + ":0:" + st + "-" + ht + ":0:0";
      k.push(o);
      break;
    case "CLOUD":
      rt += Number(window.g.REWARD[t].what_value);
      break;
    case "CEL_ESSN":
      ut += Number(window.g.REWARD[t].what_value)
  }
  if (h = p > 0 && ct + p > STORAGE.data1.upgrade[8], v = w > 0 && lt + w > DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX, S_MAILBOX.is_partial_get = !1, u) {
    if (h || v) {
      for (i = "", c = 1; c <= l; c++)(y = window.g.REWARD[c].what, y != "HERO_ITEM") && (y == "CHAR" && h || y == "ITEM" && v || (i = i == "" ? window.g.REWARD[c].sn : i + "," + window.g.REWARD[c].sn));
      if (h && (f = "", b = []), v && (e = "", k = []), i == "") {
        utilNotice(h ? TXT.space_lack : TXT.item_space_lack, 3);
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        return
      }
      S_MAILBOX.is_partial_get = !0
    }
  } else {
    if (h) {
      utilNotice(TXT.space_lack, 3);
      loading_hide();
      gEnableKey = 1;
      return
    }
    if (v) {
      utilNotice(TXT.item_space_lack, 3);
      loading_hide();
      gEnableKey = 1;
      return
    }
  }
  if (u && i == "") {
    utilNotice(TXT.select_choice_item, 3);
    loading_hide();
    gEnableKey = 1;
    return
  }
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.ruby = nt;
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.gold = tt;
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.bp = it;
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.char = f;
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.item = e;
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.cloud_piece = rt;
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.celestialbar = ut;
  var yt = k.join(","),
    pt = b.join(",");
  ServerConnection.del_reward_sn_all_n_save(i, yt, pt, "", S_MAILBOX.reward_get_in_server_callback_fn)
};
S_MAILBOX.on_reward_already_received = function(n) {
  (ServerConnection.put_error_log("S_MAILBOX.on_reward_already_received(): " + g_sceneinfo.cur_scene + ":" + n.CODE + ":" + n.DESCRIPTION), S_MAILBOX.is_partial_get = !1, g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_MAILBOX) && S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num() != 0 && (utilNotice(TXT.reward_already_received, 3), ServerConnection.get_reward2_mailbox(function() {
    if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_MAILBOX) {
      if (S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num() == 0) {
        loading_hide();
        S_MAILBOX.back();
        return
      }
      S_MAILBOX.row_focus = 2;
      S_MAILBOX.btn_focus = 1;
      S_MAILBOX.list_focus = 1;
      S_MAILBOX.make_screen_list_page(1);
      loading_hide();
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_MAILBOX.draw_focus()
    }
  }))
};
S_MAILBOX.reward_get_in_server_callback_fn = function(n) {
  var i, t, f;
  if (n.STATE == "ERROR") {
    if (n.CODE == "ALREADY_RECEIVED" || n.CODE == "NO_REWARD_NUM") {
      S_MAILBOX.on_reward_already_received(n);
      return
    }
    n.CODE == "mysql_error" ? glo.fun.show_s_error_network("reward_get_in 에서 ERROR:" + n.DESCRIPTION) : glo.fun.show_s_error_network("reward_get_in 에서 ERROR:" + n.DESCRIPTION)
  } else if (n.STATE == "SUCCESS") {
    if (utilConsoleLog("OK, 잘 지웠다."), window.g.REWARD_ALL.ruby > 0 && S_MAINMENU.make_screen_top_add_ruby(window.g.REWARD_ALL.ruby, !0), window.g.REWARD_ALL.gold > 0 && S_MAINMENU.make_screen_top_add_gold(window.g.REWARD_ALL.gold, "우편함수령", !0), window.g.REWARD_ALL.bp > 0 && (USER.bonus_point += Number(window.g.REWARD_ALL.bp)), window.g.REWARD_ALL.cloud_piece > 0 && (USER.cloud_piece += Number(window.g.REWARD_ALL.cloud_piece)), window.g.REWARD_ALL.celestialbar > 0 && (USER.celestial_essence += Number(window.g.REWARD_ALL.celestialbar)), window.g.REWARD_ALL.char != "")
      for (i = window.g.REWARD_ALL.char.split(","), t = 0; t < i.length; t++) STORAGE.add_char(Number(i[t]), !0);
    if (window.g.REWARD_ALL.item != "")
      for (i = n.ADD_ITEM.split(","), t = 0; t < i.length; t++) {
        var r = i[t].split(":"),
          e = Number(r[0]),
          u = r[2].split("-"),
          o = u[0],
          s = u[1];
        STORAGE.add_item(e, o, s)
      }
    window.g.REWARD_ALL.char != "" ? (loading_show("우편함", 1), f = S_MAILBOX.is_fetch_all ? "우편함모두받기|CHAR|" + window.g.REWARD_ALL.char + "|ITEM|" + window.g.REWARD_ALL.item : "우편함하나받기|CHAR|" + window.g.REWARD_ALL.char + "|ITEM|" + window.g.REWARD_ALL.item, ServerConnection.update_data2_item(f, "char_item", function() {
      loading_hide("우편함", 1);
      S_MAILBOX.is_fetch_all ? S_MAILBOX.reward_all_run3() : S_MAILBOX.reward_i_run3()
    })) : S_MAILBOX.is_fetch_all ? S_MAILBOX.reward_all_run3() : S_MAILBOX.reward_i_run3()
  }
};
S_MAILBOX.draw_arrow = function() {
  var i = Math.floor((S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num() - 1) / 5) + 1,
    n = Math.floor((S_MAILBOX.list_focus - 1) / 5) + 1,
    t = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/";
  n >= 2 ? ($("#MBOX_left").css({
    display: "block"
  }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("MBOX_left", t + "ui/23_mailbox/sm_leftbt.png", 112, 326)) : $("#MBOX_left").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  n < i ? ($("#MBOX_right").css({
    display: "block"
  }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("MBOX_right", t + "ui/23_mailbox/sm_rightbt.png", 1128, 326)) : $("#MBOX_right").css({
    display: "none"
  })
};
S_MAILBOX.pressed_left = function() {
  var n, t;
  for (gEnableKey = 0, $("#MBOX_btn1_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#MBOX_btn2_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), n = 1; n <= 5; n++) $("#MBOX_list" + n + "_btn_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  t = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/";
  $("#MBOX_left").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("MBOX_left", t + "ui/23_mailbox/sm_leftbt_focus.png", 112, 326);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("MBOX_left", t + "ui/23_mailbox/sm_leftbt.png", 112, 326);
    setTimeout(function() {
      S_MAILBOX.draw_focus()
    }, 100)
  }, 400)
};
S_MAILBOX.pressed_right = function() {
  var n, t;
  for (gEnableKey = 0, $("#MBOX_btn1_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#MBOX_btn2_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), n = 1; n <= 5; n++) $("#MBOX_list" + n + "_btn_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  t = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/";
  $("#MBOX_right").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("MBOX_right", t + "ui/23_mailbox/sm_rightbt_focus.png", 1128, 326);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("MBOX_right", t + "ui/23_mailbox/sm_rightbt.png", 1128, 326);
    setTimeout(function() {
      S_MAILBOX.draw_focus()
    }, 100)
  }, 400)
};
S_MAILBOX.end = function() {
  S_MAILBOX.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_MAILBOX.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (S_MAILBOX.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").click(this.on_mouse_up).mouseover(this.on_mouse_over).mouseout(this.on_mouse_out))
};
S_MAILBOX.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  $(".button").unbind("click").unbind("mouseover").unbind("mouseout")
};
S_MAILBOX.on_mouse_move = function() {};
S_MAILBOX.on_mouse_out = function() {
  S_MAILBOX.draw_arrow()
};
S_MAILBOX.on_mouse_down = function(n) {
  var i = document.getElementById(n.target.id) && document.getElementById(n.target.id).className,
    t;
  if (i != null && (i.includes("button") || i.includes("focus"))) switch (S_MAILBOX.row_focus) {
    case 1:
      t = S_MAILBOX.list_focus % 5;
      t == 0 && (t = 5);
      Main.mouse_pressed("MBOX_list" + t + "_btn", "MBOX_list" + t + "_btn_focus");
      break;
    case 2:
      Main.mouse_pressed("MBOX_btn" + S_MAILBOX.btn_focus)
  }
};
S_MAILBOX.on_mouse_up = function(n) {
  var r, t, i;
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    if (S_MAILBOX.draw_arrow(), n.target.className.search("button") >= 0) {
      if (n.target.id.search("right") >= 0) {
        r = Math.floor((S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num() - 1) / 5) + 1;
        t = Math.floor((S_MAILBOX.list_focus - 1) / 5) + 1;
        t < r && (S_MAILBOX.pressed_right(), gEnableKey = 0, setTimeout(function() {
          t++;
          S_MAILBOX.make_screen_list_page(t);
          S_MAILBOX.list_focus = (t - 1) * 5 + 1;
          S_MAILBOX.draw_focus();
          gEnableKey = 1
        }, 600));
        return
      }
      if (n.target.id.search("left") >= 0) {
        r = Math.floor((S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num() - 1) / 5) + 1;
        t = Math.floor((S_MAILBOX.list_focus - 1) / 5) + 1;
        t >= 2 && (S_MAILBOX.pressed_left(), gEnableKey = 0, setTimeout(function() {
          t--;
          S_MAILBOX.make_screen_list_page(t);
          S_MAILBOX.list_focus = (t - 1) * 5 + 1;
          S_MAILBOX.draw_focus();
          gEnableKey = 1
        }, 600));
        return
      }
    }
    i = document.getElementById(n.target.id) && document.getElementById(n.target.id).className;
    i != null && (i.includes("button") || i.includes("focus")) && S_MAILBOX.menu_run()
  }
};
S_MAILBOX.on_mouse_over = function(n) {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    var t = Math.floor((S_MAILBOX.list_focus - 1) / 5) + 1;
    switch (n.target.id) {
      case "MBOX_btn1_txt":
        S_MAILBOX.row_focus = 2;
        S_MAILBOX.btn_focus = 1;
        S_MAILBOX.draw_focus();
        break;
      case "MBOX_btn2_txt":
        S_MAILBOX.row_focus = 2;
        S_MAILBOX.btn_focus = 2;
        S_MAILBOX.draw_focus();
        break;
      case "MBOX_list1_btn":
        S_MAILBOX.row_focus = 1;
        S_MAILBOX.list_focus = (t - 1) * 5 + 1;
        S_MAILBOX.draw_focus();
        break;
      case "MBOX_list2_btn":
        S_MAILBOX.row_focus = 1;
        S_MAILBOX.list_focus = (t - 1) * 5 + 2;
        S_MAILBOX.draw_focus();
        break;
      case "MBOX_list3_btn":
        S_MAILBOX.row_focus = 1;
        S_MAILBOX.list_focus = (t - 1) * 5 + 3;
        S_MAILBOX.draw_focus();
        break;
      case "MBOX_list4_btn":
        S_MAILBOX.row_focus = 1;
        S_MAILBOX.list_focus = (t - 1) * 5 + 4;
        S_MAILBOX.draw_focus();
        break;
      case "MBOX_list5_btn":
        S_MAILBOX.row_focus = 1;
        S_MAILBOX.list_focus = (t - 1) * 5 + 5;
        S_MAILBOX.draw_focus()
    }
  }
};

S_ITEM.init = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_ITEM.init()");
  S_ITEM.maketag();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_ITEM;
  S_MAINMENU.remount_mm_top(this, TXT.item);
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  switch (S_ITEM.menu_focus) {
    case 2:
      S_ITEM.view_item_type(1);
      break;
    case 3:
      S_ITEM.view_item_type(2);
      break;
    case 4:
      S_ITEM.view_item_type(3);
      break;
    case 5:
      S_ITEM.view_item_type(4);
      break;
    default:
      S_ITEM.view_item_all()
  }
  S_ITEM.make_screen();
  setTimeout(function() {
    gEnableKey = 1
  }, 700);
  glo.event.apply_coupon_code()
};

S_ITEM.define = function() {};
S_ITEM.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      switch (S_ITEM.row_focus) {
        case 0:
          S_ITEM.arrow_focus == 2 && (S_ITEM.arrow_focus = 1);
          break;
        case 1:
          S_ITEM.menu_focus != 1 ? (S_ITEM.menu_focus--, S_ITEM.select_menu = S_ITEM.menu_focus) : (S_ITEM.row_focus = 0, S_ITEM.arrow_focus = 2);
          break;
        case 2:
        case 3:
          if (S_ITEM.option_reset_popup_mode == 1) {
            S_ITEM.option_reset_popup_focus = 1;
            S_ITEM.drawFocus_reset_popup();
            return
          }
          S_ITEM.item_focus != 1 ? S_ITEM.item_focus-- : S_ITEM.page_count == 1 ? (S_ITEM.row_focus = 0, S_ITEM.arrow_focus = 2) : (gEnableKey = 0, S_ITEM.page_count--, S_ITEM.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM.scroll_flag = 0), S_ITEM.scroll_target_x = S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x + (S_ITEM.list_w + S_ITEM.list_gap), S_ITEM.item_focus = 6, S_ITEM.scroll_left());
          break;
        case 4:
          gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO || S_ITEM.btn_focus == 2 && (S_ITEM.btn_focus = 1)
      }
      S_ITEM.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      switch (S_ITEM.row_focus) {
        case 0:
          S_ITEM.arrow_focus == 1 ? S_ITEM.arrow_focus = 2 : (S_ITEM.row_focus = 1, S_ITEM.menu_focus = 1, S_ITEM.select_menu = 1);
          break;
        case 1:
          S_ITEM.menu_focus < ITEM_TOPMENU_NUM && (S_ITEM.menu_focus++, S_ITEM.select_menu = S_ITEM.menu_focus);
          break;
        case 2:
        case 3:
          if (S_ITEM.option_reset_popup_mode == 1) {
            S_ITEM.option_reset_popup_focus = 2;
            S_ITEM.drawFocus_reset_popup();
            return
          }
          S_ITEM.item_focus < 6 ? S_ITEM.item_focus++ : S_ITEM.page_count < DEFINE.USER_ITEM_PAGE_MAX && (gEnableKey = 0, S_ITEM.page_count++, S_ITEM.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM.scroll_flag = 0), S_ITEM.scroll_target_x = S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x - (S_ITEM.list_w + S_ITEM.list_gap), S_ITEM.item_focus = 1, S_ITEM.scroll_right());
          break;
        case 4:
          gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO || S_ITEM.btn_focus == 1 && (S_ITEM.btn_focus = 2)
      }
      S_ITEM.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      if (S_ITEM.option_reset_popup_mode == 1) return;
      if (S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode == 1) S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus >= 2 ? (S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus--, S_ITEM.drawFocus_submenu()) : (S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = ITEM_SUBMENU_NUM, S_ITEM.drawFocus_submenu());
      else {
        if (S_ITEM.row_focus == 0) return;
        S_ITEM.row_focus != 1 && (S_ITEM.row_focus != 3 && (S_ITEM.item_focus = 1), S_ITEM.row_focus--, S_ITEM.btn_focus = 1, S_ITEM.drawFocus())
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      if (S_ITEM.option_reset_popup_mode == 1) return;
      if (S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode == 1) S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus < ITEM_SUBMENU_NUM ? (S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus++, S_ITEM.drawFocus_submenu()) : (S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 1, S_ITEM.drawFocus_submenu());
      else {
        if (S_ITEM.row_focus == 0) return;
        S_ITEM.row_focus < 4 && (S_ITEM.row_focus != 2 && (S_ITEM.item_focus = 1), S_ITEM.row_focus++, S_ITEM.btn_focus = 1, S_ITEM.drawFocus())
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_ITEM.menuRun_Run();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_ITEM.run_back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      S_ITEM.change_char_prev();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      S_ITEM.change_char_next()
  }
};
S_ITEM.backKey = function() {
  if (S_ITEM.option_reset_popup_mode == 1) {
    S_ITEM.option_reset_popup_mode = 0;
    S_ITEM.drawFocus_reset_popup();
    return
  }
  S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode == 1 ? (S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 1, $("#ITEM_right_submenu").css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode = 0) : (utilPush(), S_ITEM.end(), $("#S_ITEM_div").css({
    display: "none"
  }), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM))
};
S_ITEM.scroll_right = function() {
  S_ITEM.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_ITEM.scroll_right()!!");
  S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x - S_ITEM.scroll_speed * (S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x - S_ITEM.scroll_target_x);
  $("#ITEM_right_list_scroll").css({
    left: S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x > S_ITEM.scroll_target_x + 4 && S_ITEM.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_ITEM.scroll_right, 80) : (S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM.scroll_flag = 0, $("#ITEM_right_list_scroll").css({
    left: S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  }), gEnableKey = 1)
};
S_ITEM.scroll_left = function() {
  S_ITEM.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_ITEM.scroll_left()!!");
  S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x + S_ITEM.scroll_speed * (S_ITEM.scroll_target_x - S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x);
  $("#ITEM_right_list_scroll").css({
    left: S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x < S_ITEM.scroll_target_x - 4 && S_ITEM.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_ITEM.scroll_left, 80) : (S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM.scroll_flag = 0, $("#ITEM_right_list_scroll").css({
    left: S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  }), gEnableKey = 1)
};

S_ITEM.num_apply_item_type = function(n) {
  var t;
  return n >= 511 && n <= 543 ? Math.floor(n % 100 / 10) : n >= 611 && n <= 643 || n >= 711 && n <= 743 || n >= 811 && n <= 843 || n >= 911 && n <= 943 ? Math.floor(n % 100 / 10) : Math.floor(n / 100)
};
S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade = function(n) {
  if (glo.fun.is_exclusive_item_num(n)) return "a";
  var t = n % 100,
    i = Math.floor(t / 10);
  switch (i) {
    case 1:
      return "f";
    case 2:
      return "e";
    case 3:
      return "d";
    case 4:
      return "c";
    case 5:
      return "b";
    case 6:
      return "a";
    case 7:
      return "s"
  }
};
S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade_return_num = function(n) {
  if (glo.fun.is_exclusive_item_num(n)) return 6;
  var t = n % 100;
  return Math.floor(t / 10)
};

S_ITEM.draw_topmenu = function() {

  switch (S_ITEM.menu_focus) {
    case 1:
      S_ITEM.view_item_all();
      break;
    case 2:
      S_ITEM.view_item_type(1);
      break;
    case 3:
      S_ITEM.view_item_type(2);
      break;
    case 4:
      S_ITEM.view_item_type(3);
      break;
    case 5:
      S_ITEM.view_item_type(4)
  }
  S_ITEM.page_count = 1;
  S_ITEM.scroll_target_x = 0;
  S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x = 0;
  $("#ITEM_right_list_scroll").css({
    left: S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_ITEM.draw_itemlist()
};
S_ITEM.drawFocus = function() {
  var n, t;
  for (S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 1, $("#ITEM_right_submenu").css({
      display: "none"
    }), S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode = 0, utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_ITEM_btn_focus", "", 0, 0, "absolute"), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_ITEM_right_menu_focus", "", 0, 0, "absolute"), n = 1; n <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_PAGE_MAX; n++)
    for (t = 1; t <= 12; t++) utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_ITEM_right_list_scroll_" + n + "_div" + t + "_focus", "", 0, 0, "absolute");
  $("#Img_ITEM_left_btn_left_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_ITEM_left_btn_right_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  switch (S_ITEM.row_focus) {
    case 0:
      S_ITEM.arrow_focus == 1 ? $("#Img_ITEM_left_btn_left_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      }) : $("#Img_ITEM_left_btn_right_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      break;
    case 1:
      S_ITEM.drawFocus_topmenu();
      break;
    case 2:
    case 3:
      $("#Txt_ITEM_right_page").text(S_ITEM.page_count + " / " + DEFINE.USER_ITEM_PAGE_MAX);
      S_ITEM.drawFocus_item();
      break;
    case 4:
      S_ITEM.drawFocus_btnmenu()
  }
};

S_ITEM.drawFocus_item = function() {
  var i, n, f, e, t, o, r, u, s;
  if (S_ITEM.draw_arrow(), i = S_ITEM.get_item_stoage_index(S_ITEM.page_count, S_ITEM.item_focus + (S_ITEM.row_focus - 2) * 6), n = Number(STORAGE.view_item[i].item_num), n != 0) {
    for (f = "", e = "", t = 1; t < DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION.length; t++) DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION[t].name == DEFINE_ITEM[n].base_option && (f = TXT["item_option_reset_option_text" + t]), DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION[t].name == STORAGE.view_item[i].add_option && (e = TXT["item_option_reset_option_text" + t]);
    var h = TXT["item_name" + n],
      c = TXT.item_base_option + " : " + DEFINE_ITEM[n].base_option + "(" + f + ") +" + DEFINE_ITEM[n].base_option_num + "%",
      l = S_ITEM.option_str_text(STORAGE.view_item[i].add_option, STORAGE.view_item[i].add_option_num),
      a = TXT.item_add_option + " : " + STORAGE.view_item[i].add_option + "(" + e + ") " + l;
    $("#Txt_ITEM_right_top_name").text(h);
    S_ITEM.menu_focus == 1 ? (o = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_type(n), $("#Txt_ITEM_right_top_part").text(TXT.item_part_name + " : " + TXT["item_menu" + (o + 1)])) : $("#Txt_ITEM_right_top_part").text(TXT.item_part_name + " : " + TXT["item_menu" + S_ITEM.menu_focus]);
    $("#Txt_ITEM_right_top_base").text(c);
    $("#Txt_ITEM_right_top_add").text(a)
  } else $("#Txt_ITEM_right_top_name").text("-"), $("#Txt_ITEM_right_top_part").text(TXT.item_part_name + " : -"), $("#Txt_ITEM_right_top_base").text(TXT.item_base_option + " : -"), $("#Txt_ITEM_right_top_add").text(TXT.item_add_option + " : -");

    for (u = 1; u <= 12; u++) utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_ITEM_right_list_scroll_" + r + "_div" + u + "_focus", "", 0, 0, "absolute");

S_ITEM.menuRun_Run = function() {
  var r, u, n;
  switch (S_ITEM.row_focus) {
    case 0:
      S_ITEM.arrow_focus == 1 ? S_ITEM.change_char_prev() : S_ITEM.change_char_next();
      break;
    case 2:
    case 3:
      if (S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode == 0) {
        if (r = S_ITEM.get_item_stoage_index(S_ITEM.page_count, S_ITEM.item_focus + (S_ITEM.row_focus - 2) * 6), u = STORAGE.view_item[r].item_num, u != 0) {
          S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode = 1;
          var o = $("#ITEM_right_list_scroll_1_div" + S_ITEM.item_focus).css("left"),
            s = $("#ITEM_right_list_scroll_1_div" + S_ITEM.item_focus).css("top"),
            h = $("#ITEM_right").css("left"),
            c = $("#ITEM_right").css("top"),
            f = parseInt(o, 10),
            t = parseInt(s, 10),
            e = parseInt(h, 10),
            i = parseInt(c, 10);
          if (S_ITEM.item_focus == 6) {
            for (n = 1; n <= ITEM_SUBMENU_NUM; n++) $("#ITEM_right_submenu_" + n).css({
              left: "9px"
            });
            $("#ITEM_right_submenu").css({
              display: "block",
              left: e + f - 99 + "px",
              top: S_ITEM.row_focus == 3 ? i + t - -141 + "px" : i + t - 21 + "px",
              background: util_bg_url("url(" + glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_ITEM") + "image/ui/24_item/it_smpopup2_1.png) no-repeat 0 0"),
              position: "absolute"
            })
          } else {
            for (n = 1; n <= ITEM_SUBMENU_NUM; n++) $("#ITEM_right_submenu_" + n).css({
              left: "24px"
            });
            $("#ITEM_right_submenu").css({
              display: "block",
              left: e + f + 100 + "px",
              top: S_ITEM.row_focus == 3 ? i + t - -141 + "px" : i + t - 21 + "px",
              background: util_bg_url("url(" + glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_ITEM") + "image/ui/24_item/it_smpopup_1.png) no-repeat 0 0"),
              position: "absolute"
            })
          }
          document.getElementById("ITEM_right_submenu_4").innerHTML = STORAGE.view_item[S_ITEM.get_item_stoage_index(S_ITEM.page_count, S_ITEM.item_focus + (S_ITEM.row_focus - 2) * 6)].lock == 1 ? TXT.lock_cancel : TXT.lock;
          S_ITEM.drawFocus_submenu()
        }
      } else S_ITEM.menuRun_submenu();
      break;
    case 4:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? S_ITEM.btn_focus == 1 && (S_GACHA.entry_tab = 3, S_ITEM.end(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GACHA, S_GACHA)) : S_ITEM.btn_focus == 1 ? S_ITEM.backKey() : (S_GACHA.entry_tab = 3, S_ITEM.end(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GACHA, S_GACHA))
  }
};
S_ITEM.menuRun_submenu = function() {
  var n, u, v, y, p, w, b, k, d, r, o, t, i, s;
  switch (S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus) {
    case 1:
      S_ITEM.menuRun_submenu_run1();
      break;
    case 2:
      S_ITEM.sell_item();
      break;
    case 3:
      if (document.getElementById("S_ITEM_UPGRADE_div") == null ? $("#S_ITEM_div").after('<div id= "S_ITEM_UPGRADE_div"><\/div>') : $("#S_ITEM_UPGRADE_div").empty(), i = S_ITEM.get_item_stoage_index(S_ITEM.page_count, S_ITEM.item_focus + (S_ITEM.row_focus - 2) * 6), n = STORAGE.view_item[i].indexing, S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade(STORAGE.item[n].item_num) == "s") {
        utilNotice(TXT.item_not_updrade, 2);
        return
      }
      if (STORAGE.item[n].socket_index > 0 || STORAGE.item[n].lock == 1) {
        utilNotice(TXT.item_not_updrade1, 2);
        return
      }
      for (u = 0, t = 1; t <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX; t++) {
        var h = Math.floor(STORAGE.item[t].item_num / 100),
          c = Math.floor(STORAGE.item[n].item_num / 100),
          l = c >= 5,
          a = h >= 5,
          f = !1;
        l || a ? (v = l ? Math.floor(STORAGE.item[n].item_num / 10) % 10 : c, y = a ? Math.floor(STORAGE.item[t].item_num / 10) % 10 : h, f = v == y) : (p = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_type(STORAGE.item[t].item_num), w = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_type(STORAGE.item[n].item_num), f = p == w);
        f && (b = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade(STORAGE.item[t].item_num), k = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade(STORAGE.item[n].item_num), b == k && u++)
      }
      if (u <= 3) {
        utilNotice(TXT.item_not_updrade3, 2);
        return
      }
      loading_show("아이템등급업", 1);
      auto_event_system_init();
      auto_event_system_check(999, function() {
        loading_hide("아이템등급업", 1);
        S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_num = STORAGE.item[n].item_num;
        S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index = n;
        S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_grade = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade(S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_num);
        S_ITEM.end();
        $("#S_ITEM_div").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        $("#S_ITEM_UPGRADE_div").css({
          display: "block"
        });
        S_ITEM_UPGRADE.init()
      });
      break;
    case 4:
      var i = S_ITEM.get_item_stoage_index(S_ITEM.page_count, S_ITEM.item_focus + (S_ITEM.row_focus - 2) * 6),
        n = STORAGE.view_item[i].indexing,
        g = STORAGE.make_item_index(n),
        e = "";
      STORAGE.item[n].lock == 1 ? (STORAGE.item[n].lock = 0, e = "잠금해제") : (STORAGE.item[n].lock = 1, e = "잠금");
      d = STORAGE.make_item_index(n);
      r = "";
      switch (S_ITEM.num_apply_item_type(STORAGE.view_item[i].item_num)) {
        case 1:
          r = "투구";
          break;
        case 2:
          r = "무기";
          break;
        case 3:
          r = "갑옷";
          break;
        case 4:
          r = "신발"
      }
      o = "아이템(" + r + ") " + e + " == " + g + " -> " + d;
      loading_show("ITEM_LOCK", 1);
      ServerConnection.update_item_to_server(o, function() {
        loading_hide("ITEM_LOCK", 1)
      }, "ITEM_LOCK");
      utilConsoleLog("~~##~~" + o);
      S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 1;
      $("#ITEM_right_submenu").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode = 0;
      switch (S_ITEM.menu_focus) {
        case 1:
          S_ITEM.view_item_all();
          break;
        case 2:
          S_ITEM.view_item_type(1);
          break;
        case 3:
          S_ITEM.view_item_type(2);
          break;
        case 4:
          S_ITEM.view_item_type(3);
          break;
        case 5:
          S_ITEM.view_item_type(4)
      }
      for (t = 1; t <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_PAGE_MAX; t++) $("#ITEM_right_list_scroll_" + t + "_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      S_ITEM.make_screen_right();
      S_ITEM.drawFocus_item();
      break;
    case 5:
      i = S_ITEM.get_item_stoage_index(S_ITEM.page_count, S_ITEM.item_focus + (S_ITEM.row_focus - 2) * 6);
      s = Number(STORAGE.view_item[i].item_num);
      S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 1;
      $("#ITEM_right_submenu").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode = 0;
      glo.fun.is_exclusive_item_num(s) ? (document.getElementById("S_ITEM_SET_div") == null ? $("#S_ITEM_div").after('<div id="S_ITEM_SET_div"><\/div>') : $("#S_ITEM_SET_div").empty(), S_ITEM_SET.selected_item_num = s, S_ITEM_SET.init()) : (utilNotice(TXT.item_no_set_ability || "해당 아이템은 세트 능력이 없습니다.", 2), gEnableKey = 0, setTimeout(function() {
        gEnableKey = 1
      }, 100));
      break;
    case 6:
      S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 1;
      $("#ITEM_right_submenu").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode = 0
  }
};
S_ITEM.menuRun_submenu_run1 = function() {
  var h, f, t, u, r, i, c, o, n;
  switch (S_ITEM.item_focus_status()) {
    case 0:
      var r = S_ITEM.get_item_stoage_index(S_ITEM.page_count, S_ITEM.item_focus + (S_ITEM.row_focus - 2) * 6),
        i = STORAGE.view_item[r].indexing,
        s = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_type(STORAGE.view_item[r].item_num),
        e = "X";
      for (n = 1; n <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX; n++)
        if (STORAGE.item[n].socket_index == S_MAKETEAM.focus && (h = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_type(STORAGE.item[n].item_num), h == s)) {
          glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING ? glo.char.unequip_item_from_char(n) : STORAGE.item[n].socket_index = 0;
          e = STORAGE.make_item_index(n);
          continue
        } glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING ? glo.char.equip_item_to_char(i, S_MAKETEAM.focus) : STORAGE.item[i].socket_index = S_MAKETEAM.focus;
      utilNotice(TXT.item_Notice_status1, 2);
      f = STORAGE.make_item_index(i);
      t = "";
      switch (s) {
        case 1:
          t = "투구";
          break;
        case 2:
          t = "무기";
          break;
        case 3:
          t = "갑옷";
          break;
        case 4:
          t = "신발"
      }
      u = "아이템(" + t + ") 장착 결과 == " + e + " -> " + f;
      loading_show("ITEM_SOCKET", 1);
      ServerConnection.update_item_to_server(u, function() {
        loading_hide("ITEM_SOCKET", 1)
      }, "ITEM_SOCKET");
      utilConsoleLog("~~##~~" + u);
      S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode = 0;
      S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 1;
      S_ITEM.item_focus = 1;
      S_ITEM.row_focus = 2;
      S_ITEM.draw_topmenu();
      S_ITEM.make_screen_left();
      S_ITEM.make_screen_left_tot_option();
      S_ITEM.make_screen_right();
      S_ITEM.drawFocus_item();
      break;
    case 1:
      var r = S_ITEM.get_item_stoage_index(S_ITEM.page_count, S_ITEM.item_focus + (S_ITEM.row_focus - 2) * 6),
        i = STORAGE.view_item[r].indexing,
        e = STORAGE.make_item_index(i);
      glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING ? glo.char.unequip_item_from_char(i) : STORAGE.item[i].socket_index = 0;
      utilNotice(TXT.item_Notice_status2, 2);
      f = STORAGE.make_item_index(i);
      t = "";
      switch (S_ITEM.num_apply_item_type(STORAGE.view_item[r].item_num)) {
        case 1:
          t = "투구";
          break;
        case 2:
          t = "무기";
          break;
        case 3:
          t = "갑옷";
          break;
        case 4:
          t = "신발"
      }
      u = "아이템(" + t + ") 해제 결과 == " + e + " -> " + f;
      loading_show("ITEM_SOCKET", 1);
      ServerConnection.update_item_to_server(u, function() {
        loading_hide("ITEM_SOCKET", 1)
      }, "ITEM_SOCKET");
      utilConsoleLog("~~##~~" + u);
      S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode = 0;
      S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 1;
      S_ITEM.draw_topmenu();
      S_ITEM.make_screen_left();
      S_ITEM.make_screen_left_tot_option();
      S_ITEM.make_screen_right();
      S_ITEM.drawFocus_item();
      break;
    case 2:
      for (r = S_ITEM.get_item_stoage_index(S_ITEM.page_count, S_ITEM.item_focus + (S_ITEM.row_focus - 2) * 6), i = STORAGE.view_item[r].indexing, S_MAKETEAM.focus = STORAGE.item[i].socket_index, c = STORAGE.item[i].item_num, o = 0, n = 1; n <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX; n++)
        if (STORAGE.item[n].socket_index == S_MAKETEAM.focus && (o++, c == STORAGE.item[n].item_num)) {
          S_ITEM.item_focus = o;
          S_ITEM.row_focus = 2;
          continue
        } utilNotice(TXT.item_Notice_movechar, 2);
      S_ITEM.menu_focus = 1;
      S_ITEM.select_menu = 1;
      S_ITEM.page_count = 1;
      S_ITEM.row_focus = 1;
      S_ITEM.init();
      S_ITEM.row_focus = 2;
      S_ITEM.drawFocus()
  }
};
S_ITEM.is_new_item = function(n) {
  if (n = parseInt(n), !n || n <= 0 || !STORAGE.item || n >= STORAGE.item.length) return 0;
  return STORAGE.item[n].is_new || 0
};
S_ITEM.change_char_prev = function() {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    if (gEnableKey = 0, S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num <= 1) {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      return
    }
    var n = S_MAKETEAM.focus;
    if (S_MAKETEAM.focus > 1 ? S_MAKETEAM.focus-- : S_MAKETEAM.focus = S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num, n == S_MAKETEAM.focus) {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      return
    }
    $("#Img_ITEM_left_btn_left_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    $("#Img_ITEM_left_btn_right_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    S_ITEM.menu_focus = 1;
    S_ITEM.select_menu = 1;
    S_ITEM.row_focus = 2;
    S_ITEM.item_focus = 1;
    S_ITEM.view_item_all();
    S_ITEM.draw_topmenu();
    S_ITEM.make_screen_left();
    S_ITEM.make_screen_left_tot_option();
    S_ITEM.make_screen_right();
    S_ITEM.drawFocus_item();
    S_ITEM.row_focus = 0;
    S_ITEM.arrow_focus = 1;
    S_ITEM.drawFocus();
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1
    }, 300)
  }
};
S_ITEM.change_char_next = function() {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    if (gEnableKey = 0, S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num <= 1) {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      return
    }
    var n = S_MAKETEAM.focus;
    if (S_MAKETEAM.focus < S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num ? S_MAKETEAM.focus++ : S_MAKETEAM.focus = 1, n == S_MAKETEAM.focus) {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      return
    }
    $("#Img_ITEM_left_btn_left_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    $("#Img_ITEM_left_btn_right_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    S_ITEM.menu_focus = 1;
    S_ITEM.select_menu = 1;
    S_ITEM.row_focus = 2;
    S_ITEM.item_focus = 1;
    S_ITEM.view_item_all();
    S_ITEM.draw_topmenu();
    S_ITEM.make_screen_left();
    S_ITEM.make_screen_left_tot_option();
    S_ITEM.make_screen_right();
    S_ITEM.drawFocus_item();
    S_ITEM.row_focus = 0;
    S_ITEM.arrow_focus = 2;
    S_ITEM.drawFocus();
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1
    }, 300)
  }
};
S_ITEM.item_focus_status = function() {
  var n = S_ITEM.get_item_stoage_index(S_ITEM.page_count, S_ITEM.item_focus + (S_ITEM.row_focus - 2) * 6);
  return STORAGE.view_item[n].socket_index == S_MAKETEAM.focus ? 1 : STORAGE.view_item[n].socket_index != S_MAKETEAM.focus && STORAGE.view_item[n].socket_index > 0 ? 2 : 0
};
S_ITEM.view_item_all = function() {
  var t, n;
  for (STORAGE.check_item_socket_over(), S_ITEM.view_item_reset(), S_ITEM.item_list_sorting(), t = 1, n = 1; n <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX; n++) STORAGE.item[n].item_num > 0 && STORAGE.item[n].socket_index == S_MAKETEAM.focus && (STORAGE.view_item[t].item_num = STORAGE.item[n].item_num, STORAGE.view_item[t].socket_index = STORAGE.item[n].socket_index, STORAGE.view_item[t].add_option = STORAGE.item[n].add_option, STORAGE.view_item[t].add_option_num = STORAGE.item[n].add_option_num, STORAGE.view_item[t].add_option_reset_num = STORAGE.item[n].add_option_reset_num, STORAGE.view_item[t].lock = STORAGE.item[n].lock, STORAGE.view_item[t].is_new = STORAGE.item[n].is_new, STORAGE.view_item[t].indexing = n, t++);
  for (n = 1; n <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX; n++) STORAGE.item[n].item_num > 0 && STORAGE.item[n].socket_index == 0 && (STORAGE.view_item[t].item_num = STORAGE.item[n].item_num, STORAGE.view_item[t].socket_index = STORAGE.item[n].socket_index, STORAGE.view_item[t].add_option = STORAGE.item[n].add_option, STORAGE.view_item[t].add_option_num = STORAGE.item[n].add_option_num, STORAGE.view_item[t].add_option_reset_num = STORAGE.item[n].add_option_reset_num, STORAGE.view_item[t].lock = STORAGE.item[n].lock, STORAGE.view_item[t].is_new = STORAGE.item[n].is_new, STORAGE.view_item[t].indexing = n, t++);
  for (n = 1; n <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX; n++) STORAGE.item[n].item_num > 0 && STORAGE.item[n].socket_index != S_MAKETEAM.focus && STORAGE.item[n].socket_index > 0 && (STORAGE.view_item[t].item_num = STORAGE.item[n].item_num, STORAGE.view_item[t].socket_index = STORAGE.item[n].socket_index, STORAGE.view_item[t].add_option = STORAGE.item[n].add_option, STORAGE.view_item[t].add_option_num = STORAGE.item[n].add_option_num, STORAGE.view_item[t].add_option_reset_num = STORAGE.item[n].add_option_reset_num, STORAGE.view_item[t].lock = STORAGE.item[n].lock, STORAGE.view_item[t].is_new = STORAGE.item[n].is_new, STORAGE.view_item[t].indexing = n, t++)
};
S_ITEM.view_item_type = function(n) {
  var i, t, r;
  for (STORAGE.check_item_socket_over(), S_ITEM.view_item_reset(), S_ITEM.item_list_sorting(), i = 1, t = 1; t <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX; t++) r = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_type(STORAGE.item[t].item_num), r == n && STORAGE.item[t].item_num > 0 && STORAGE.item[t].socket_index == S_MAKETEAM.focus && (STORAGE.view_item[i].item_num = STORAGE.item[t].item_num, STORAGE.view_item[i].socket_index = STORAGE.item[t].socket_index, STORAGE.view_item[i].add_option = STORAGE.item[t].add_option, STORAGE.view_item[i].add_option_num = STORAGE.item[t].add_option_num, STORAGE.view_item[i].add_option_reset_num = STORAGE.item[t].add_option_reset_num, STORAGE.view_item[i].lock = STORAGE.item[t].lock, STORAGE.view_item[i].is_new = STORAGE.item[t].is_new, STORAGE.view_item[i].indexing = t, i++);
  for (t = 1; t <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX; t++) r = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_type(STORAGE.item[t].item_num), r == n && STORAGE.item[t].item_num > 0 && STORAGE.item[t].socket_index == 0 && (STORAGE.view_item[i].item_num = STORAGE.item[t].item_num, STORAGE.view_item[i].socket_index = STORAGE.item[t].socket_index, STORAGE.view_item[i].add_option = STORAGE.item[t].add_option, STORAGE.view_item[i].add_option_num = STORAGE.item[t].add_option_num, STORAGE.view_item[i].add_option_reset_num = STORAGE.item[t].add_option_reset_num, STORAGE.view_item[i].lock = STORAGE.item[t].lock, STORAGE.view_item[i].is_new = STORAGE.item[t].is_new, STORAGE.view_item[i].indexing = t, i++);
  for (t = 1; t <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX; t++) r = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_type(STORAGE.item[t].item_num), r == n && STORAGE.item[t].item_num > 0 && STORAGE.item[t].socket_index != S_MAKETEAM.focus && STORAGE.item[t].socket_index > 0 && (STORAGE.view_item[i].item_num = STORAGE.item[t].item_num, STORAGE.view_item[i].socket_index = STORAGE.item[t].socket_index, STORAGE.view_item[i].add_option = STORAGE.item[t].add_option, STORAGE.view_item[i].add_option_num = STORAGE.item[t].add_option_num, STORAGE.view_item[i].add_option_reset_num = STORAGE.item[t].add_option_reset_num, STORAGE.view_item[i].lock = STORAGE.item[t].lock, STORAGE.view_item[i].is_new = STORAGE.item[t].is_new, STORAGE.view_item[i].indexing = t, i++)
};
S_ITEM.item_list_sorting = function() {
  for (var r, u, i, f, e, t = new Array(DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX + 1), n = 1; n <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX + 1; n++) t[n] = {}, t[n].item_num = STORAGE.item[n].item_num, t[n].socket_index = STORAGE.item[n].socket_index > S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num && S_MAKETEAM.bottom_ch_num > 0 || STORAGE.item[n].socket_index < 0 ? 0 : STORAGE.item[n].socket_index, t[n].add_option = STORAGE.item[n].add_option, t[n].add_option_num = STORAGE.item[n].add_option_num, t[n].add_option_reset_num = STORAGE.item[n].add_option_reset_num, t[n].lock = STORAGE.item[n].lock, t[n].is_new = STORAGE.item[n].is_new || 0, STORAGE.item[n].item_num = 0, STORAGE.item[n].socket_index = 0, STORAGE.item[n].add_option = "", STORAGE.item[n].add_option_num = 0, STORAGE.item[n].add_option_reset_num = 0, STORAGE.item[n].lock = 0, STORAGE.item[n].is_new = 0;
  for (r = 1, n = 7; n >= 1; n--)
    for (u = 1; u <= 4; u++)
      for (i = 1; i <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX + 1; i++) f = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade_return_num(t[i].item_num), f == n && (e = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_type(t[i].item_num), e == u && (STORAGE.item[r].item_num = t[i].item_num, STORAGE.item[r].socket_index = t[i].socket_index, STORAGE.item[r].add_option = t[i].add_option, STORAGE.item[r].add_option_num = t[i].add_option_num, STORAGE.item[r].add_option_reset_num = t[i].add_option_reset_num, STORAGE.item[r].lock = t[i].lock, STORAGE.item[r].is_new = t[i].is_new || 0, r++))
};
S_ITEM.view_item_reset = function() {
  for (var n = 1; n <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_PAGE_MAX * 12; n++) STORAGE.view_item[n].item_num = 0, STORAGE.view_item[n].socket_index = 0, STORAGE.view_item[n].add_option = "", STORAGE.view_item[n].add_option_num = 0, STORAGE.view_item[n].add_option_reset_num = 0, STORAGE.view_item[n].lock = 0, STORAGE.view_item[n].indexing = 0, STORAGE.view_item[n].is_new = 0
};
S_ITEM.sell_item = function() {
  var t, i, n;
  if (S_ITEM.item_focus_status() >= 1) {
    utilNotice(TXT.item_no_sell_use, 1.2);
    return
  }
  if (t = S_ITEM.get_item_stoage_index(S_ITEM.page_count, S_ITEM.item_focus + (S_ITEM.row_focus - 2) * 6), i = STORAGE.view_item[t].indexing, STORAGE.item[i].lock == 1) {
    utilNotice(TXT.item_no_sell_lock, 1.2);
    return
  }
  for (S_ITEM.sell_gold = S_ITEM.get_how_much(), S_ITEM.removeMouseEvent(), $("#ITEM_right_submenu").css({
      display: "none"
    }), S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode = 0, S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 1, $("#MT_bottom_fo" + n).css({
      display: "none"
    }), n = 1; n <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_PAGE_MAX; n++) $("#ITEM_right_list_scroll_" + n + "_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  utilPush();
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
    display: "block"
  }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN)
};
S_ITEM.get_how_much = function() {
  var n = 5e3,
    t = S_ITEM.get_item_stoage_index(S_ITEM.page_count, S_ITEM.item_focus + (S_ITEM.row_focus - 2) * 6),
    i = STORAGE.view_item[t].indexing,
    r = STORAGE.item[i].item_num,
    u = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade(r);
  switch (u) {
    case "s":
      n = Math.floor(n * 20);
      break;
    case "a":
      n = Math.floor(n * 13);
      break;
    case "b":
      n = Math.floor(n * 8);
      break;
    case "c":
      n = Math.floor(n * 5);
      break;
    case "d":
      n = Math.floor(n * 3);
      break;
    case "e":
      n = Math.floor(n * 1.75);
      break;
    case "f":
      n = Math.floor(n)
  }
  return utilConsoleLog("아이템 판매 가격은 :" + n), n
};
S_ITEM.get_how_much_option_reset = function() {
  var n = 1e4,
    r = S_ITEM.get_item_stoage_index(S_ITEM.page_count, S_ITEM.item_focus + (S_ITEM.row_focus - 2) * 6),
    t = STORAGE.view_item[r].indexing,
    u = STORAGE.item[t].item_num,
    f = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade(u),
    i = STORAGE.item[t].add_option_reset_num;
  switch (f) {
    case "s":
      n = Math.floor(n * 20);
      break;
    case "a":
      n = Math.floor(n * 13);
      break;
    case "b":
      n = Math.floor(n * 8);
      break;
    case "c":
      n = Math.floor(n * 5);
      break;
    case "d":
      n = Math.floor(n * 3);
      break;
    case "e":
      n = Math.floor(n * 1.75);
      break;
    case "f":
      n = Math.floor(n)
  }
  return n = Math.floor(n + n * .4 * i * i), utilConsoleLog("아이템 리셋 가격은 :" + n), n
};
S_ITEM.sell_yes = function() {
  var u = S_ITEM.get_how_much(),
    f = S_ITEM.get_item_stoage_index(S_ITEM.page_count, S_ITEM.item_focus + (S_ITEM.row_focus - 2) * 6),
    i = STORAGE.view_item[f].indexing,
    e = STORAGE.make_item_index(i),
    n = "",
    r, t;
  switch (S_ITEM.num_apply_item_type(STORAGE.item[i].item_num)) {
    case 1:
      n = "투구";
      break;
    case 2:
      n = "무기";
      break;
    case 3:
      n = "갑옷";
      break;
    case 4:
      n = "신발"
  }
  STORAGE.del_item(i);
  r = "아이템(" + n + ") 판매  == " + e;
  loading_show("ITEM_SELL", 1);
  ServerConnection.update_item_to_server(r, function(n) {
    loading_hide("ITEM_SELL", 1);
    utilNotice2(TXT.sell_complete, 1.2);
    USER.gold = Number(n.after_gold);
    glo.APP_FEATURE.GOLD_CRYPT && (USER.gold_encoding = number_encoding(n.after_gold));
    S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top()
  }, "ITEM_SELL", u);
  utilConsoleLog("~~##~~" + r);
  switch (S_ITEM.menu_focus) {
    case 1:
      S_ITEM.view_item_all();
      break;
    case 2:
      S_ITEM.view_item_type(1);
      break;
    case 3:
      S_ITEM.view_item_type(2);
      break;
    case 4:
      S_ITEM.view_item_type(3);
      break;
    case 5:
      S_ITEM.view_item_type(4)
  }
  for (t = 1; t <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_PAGE_MAX; t++) $("#ITEM_right_list_scroll_" + t + "_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode = 0;
  S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 1;
  S_ITEM.make_screen_right();
  S_ITEM.drawFocus_item();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)
};
S_ITEM.option_str_text = function(n, t) {
  var i = "";
  switch (n) {
    case "AP":
    case "HP":
    case "AD":
    case "AS":
      i = " +" + utilGetNumber_withComma(t + "");
      break;
    case "PS":
    case "SP":
      i = " +" + utilGetNumber_withComma(t + "") + "%";
      break;
    case "MR":
      i = " -" + utilGetNumber_withComma(t + "")
  }
  return i
};

S_ITEM.end = function() {
  S_ITEM.stop_exclusive_item_effect_animation();
  for (var n = 1; n <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX; n++) STORAGE.item[n] && STORAGE.item[n].is_new && (STORAGE.item[n].is_new = 0);
  $("#ITEM_right_menu").empty();
  $("#ITEM_right_list").empty();
  S_ITEM.menu_focus = 1;
  S_ITEM.row_focus = 2;
  S_ITEM.item_focus = 1;
  S_ITEM.btn_focus = 1;
  S_ITEM.select_menu = 1;
  S_ITEM.page_count = 1;
  S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode = 0;
  S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 1;
  S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x = 0;
  S_ITEM.scroll_target_x = 0;
  S_ITEM.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_ITEM.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").click(this.onClick).mouseover(this.onMouseover)
};
S_ITEM.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("click").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_ITEM.onClick = function(n) {
  var f, t, e, i, u, o, r, s;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && (utilConsoleLog("S_ITEM.onClick  ~~~ e.target.id: " + n.target.id), gEnableKey != 0)) {
    for (f = n.target.id.indexOf("ITEM_right_submenu_") != -1 && n.target.id.indexOf("_cover") != -1, f || (S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 1, $("#ITEM_right_submenu").css({
        display: "none"
      }), S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode = 0), t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } switch (n.target.id) {
      case "Img_ITEM_left_btn_left_wrapper":
      case "Img_ITEM_left_btn_left":
      case "Img_ITEM_left_btn_left_focus":
        S_ITEM.change_char_prev();
        return;
      case "Img_ITEM_left_btn_right_wrapper":
      case "Img_ITEM_left_btn_right":
      case "Img_ITEM_left_btn_right_focus":
        S_ITEM.change_char_next();
        return;
      case "Img_ITEM_left_item1":
      case "Img_ITEM_left_item2":
      case "Img_ITEM_left_item3":
      case "Img_ITEM_left_item4":
        for (e = parseInt(n.target.id.replace("Img_ITEM_left_item", "")), i = 1; i <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX; i++)
          if (STORAGE.item[i].socket_index == S_MAKETEAM.focus && (u = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_type(STORAGE.item[i].item_num), u == e)) {
            o = STORAGE.make_item_index(i);
            r = "";
            switch (u) {
              case 1:
                r = "투구";
                break;
              case 2:
                r = "무기";
                break;
              case 3:
                r = "갑옷";
                break;
              case 4:
                r = "신발"
            }
            glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_CHAR_LINKING ? glo.char.unequip_item_from_char(i) : STORAGE.item[i].socket_index = 0;
            s = "아이템(" + r + ") 해제 == " + o;
            loading_show("ITEM_SOCKET", 1);
            ServerConnection.update_item_to_server(s, function() {
              loading_hide("ITEM_SOCKET", 1)
            }, "ITEM_SOCKET");
            utilNotice(TXT.item_Notice_status2, 2);
            S_ITEM.draw_topmenu();
            S_ITEM.make_screen_left();
            S_ITEM.make_screen_left_tot_option();
            S_ITEM.make_screen_right();
            S_ITEM.drawFocus();
            break
          } return;
      case "ITEM_right_submenu_1_cover":
      case "ITEM_right_submenu_2_cover":
      case "ITEM_right_submenu_3_cover":
      case "ITEM_right_submenu_4_cover":
      case "ITEM_right_submenu_5_cover":
      case "ITEM_right_submenu_6_cover":
        S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode == 1 && S_ITEM.menuRun_Run();
        return;
      case "Img_ITEM_right_arrow_left":
      case "Img_ITEM_under_arrow_left":
        S_ITEM.page_count != 1 && (gEnableKey = 0, S_ITEM.page_count--, S_ITEM.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM.scroll_flag = 0), S_ITEM.scroll_target_x = S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x + (S_ITEM.list_w + S_ITEM.list_gap), S_ITEM.row_focus = 2, S_ITEM.item_focus = 6, n.target.id == "Img_ITEM_under_arrow_left" && S_ITEM.pressed_left(), S_ITEM.scroll_left(), S_ITEM.drawFocus());
        return;
      case "Img_ITEM_right_arrow_right":
      case "Img_ITEM_under_arrow_right":
        S_ITEM.page_count < DEFINE.USER_ITEM_PAGE_MAX && (gEnableKey = 0, S_ITEM.page_count++, S_ITEM.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM.scroll_flag = 0), S_ITEM.scroll_target_x = S_ITEM.scroll_cur_x - (S_ITEM.list_w + S_ITEM.list_gap), S_ITEM.row_focus = 2, S_ITEM.item_focus = 1, n.target.id == "Img_ITEM_under_arrow_right" && S_ITEM.pressed_right(), S_ITEM.scroll_right(), S_ITEM.drawFocus());
        return;
      case "Img_ITEM_btn_focus":
        S_ITEM.drawFocus();
        S_ITEM.menuRun_Run();
        return
    }
    S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode != 1 && n.target.id.indexOf("ITEM_right_list_scroll_") != -1 && n.target.id.indexOf("_cover") != -1 && S_ITEM.menuRun_Run()
  }
};
S_ITEM.onMouseup = function(n) {
  this.onMouseover(n);
  this.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_ITEM.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    switch (n.target.id) {
      case "Img_ITEM_left_btn_left":
      case "Img_ITEM_left_btn_left_wrapper":
        S_ITEM.row_focus = 0;
        S_ITEM.arrow_focus = 1;
        S_ITEM.drawFocus();
        return;
      case "Img_ITEM_left_btn_right":
      case "Img_ITEM_left_btn_right_wrapper":
        S_ITEM.row_focus = 0;
        S_ITEM.arrow_focus = 2;
        S_ITEM.drawFocus();
        return;
      case "ITEM_right_menu1_cover":
        S_ITEM.row_focus = 1;
        S_ITEM.menu_focus = 1;
        S_ITEM.select_menu = S_ITEM.menu_focus;
        S_ITEM.drawFocus();
        return;
      case "ITEM_right_menu2_cover":
        S_ITEM.row_focus = 1;
        S_ITEM.menu_focus = 2;
        S_ITEM.select_menu = S_ITEM.menu_focus;
        S_ITEM.drawFocus();
        return;
      case "ITEM_right_menu3_cover":
        S_ITEM.row_focus = 1;
        S_ITEM.menu_focus = 3;
        S_ITEM.select_menu = S_ITEM.menu_focus;
        S_ITEM.drawFocus();
        return;
      case "ITEM_right_menu4_cover":
        S_ITEM.row_focus = 1;
        S_ITEM.menu_focus = 4;
        S_ITEM.select_menu = S_ITEM.menu_focus;
        S_ITEM.drawFocus();
        return;
      case "ITEM_right_menu5_cover":
        S_ITEM.row_focus = 1;
        S_ITEM.menu_focus = 5;
        S_ITEM.select_menu = S_ITEM.menu_focus;
        S_ITEM.drawFocus();
        return;
      case "ITEM_right_submenu_1_cover":
        S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode == 1 && (S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 1, S_ITEM.drawFocus_submenu());
        return;
      case "ITEM_right_submenu_2_cover":
        S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode == 1 && (S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 2, S_ITEM.drawFocus_submenu());
        return;
      case "ITEM_right_submenu_3_cover":
        S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode == 1 && (S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 3, S_ITEM.drawFocus_submenu());
        return;
      case "ITEM_right_submenu_4_cover":
        S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode == 1 && (S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 4, S_ITEM.drawFocus_submenu());
        return;
      case "ITEM_right_submenu_5_cover":
        S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode == 1 && (S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 5, S_ITEM.drawFocus_submenu());
        return;
      case "ITEM_right_submenu_6_cover":
        S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode == 1 && (S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 6, S_ITEM.drawFocus_submenu());
        return;
      case "back_button":
      case "Img_ITEM_back_bg":
      case "Txt_ITEM_back_text":
        S_ITEM.row_focus = 4;
        S_ITEM.btn_focus = 1;
        S_ITEM.drawFocus();
        return;
      case "gacha_button":
      case "Img_ITEM_gacha_bg":
      case "Img_ITEM_gacha_icon":
      case "Txt_ITEM_gacha_text":
        S_ITEM.row_focus = 4;
        S_ITEM.btn_focus = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? 1 : 2;
        S_ITEM.drawFocus();
        return
    }
    if (n.target.id.indexOf("ITEM_right_submenu_") == -1 && n.target.id.indexOf("ITEM_right_list_scroll_") != -1 && n.target.id.indexOf("_cover") != -1) {
      var i = Number(n.target.id.substring(23, 25)),
        t = Number(n.target.id.substring(29, 31));
      S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode == 1 && (S_ITEM.sub_menu_focus = 1, $("#ITEM_right_submenu").css({
        display: "none"
      }), S_ITEM.sub_menu_mode = 0);
      S_ITEM.page_count = i;
      t <= 6 ? (S_ITEM.row_focus = 2, S_ITEM.item_focus = t) : (S_ITEM.row_focus = 3, S_ITEM.item_focus = t - 6);
      S_ITEM.drawFocus()
    }
  }
};

S_ITEM.start_exclusive_item_effect_animation = function() {
  var t, n;
  for (S_ITEM.stop_exclusive_item_effect_animation(), t = !1, n = 1; n <= 4; n++)
    if (S_ITEM.effect_animation_slots[n]) {
      t = !0;
      break
    } if (!t) {
    for (n = 1; n <= 4; n++) $("#Img_ITEM_left_item_effect" + n).css({
      display: "none"
    });
    return
  }
  S_ITEM.effect_animation_frame = 1;
  S_ITEM.update_animation()
};
S_ITEM.update_animation = function() {
  for (var r = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_ITEM") + "image/ui/24_item/", t = S_ITEM.effect_animation_frame, u = t < 10 ? "0" + t : "" + t, f = r + "item_seteffect" + u + ".png", i = [null, {
      x: 1,
      y: 78
    }, {
      x: 283,
      y: 78
    }, {
      x: 1,
      y: 198
    }, {
      x: 283,
      y: 198
    }], n = 1; n <= 4; n++) S_ITEM.effect_animation_slots[n] ? (utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_ITEM_left_item_effect" + n, f, i[n].x, i[n].y, "absolute"), $("#Img_ITEM_left_item_effect" + n).css({
    display: "block",
    "pointer-events": "none"
  })) : $("#Img_ITEM_left_item_effect" + n).css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_ITEM.effect_animation_frame++;
  S_ITEM.effect_animation_frame > 12 && (S_ITEM.effect_animation_frame = 1);
  S_ITEM.effect_animation_interval = setTimeout(function() {
    S_ITEM.update_animation()
  }, 80)
};
S_ITEM.stop_exclusive_item_effect_animation = function() {
  S_ITEM.effect_animation_interval && (clearTimeout(S_ITEM.effect_animation_interval), S_ITEM.effect_animation_interval = null);
  for (var n = 1; n <= 4; n++) $("#Img_ITEM_left_item_effect" + n).css({
    display: "none"
  })
};

S_ITEM_UPGRADE.init = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_ITEM_UPGRADE.init()");

  utilPush();

  S_MAINMENU.remount_mm_top(this, TXT.item_upgrade_start);
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE.view_item_upgrade_type();
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE.view_max_item = 0;
  for (var n = 1; n <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX; n++) Number(STORAGE.view_item[n].item_num) != 0 && S_ITEM_UPGRADE.view_max_item++;
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE.need_gold = DEFINE_ITEM_UPGRADE.gold[S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade_return_num(S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_num)];
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE.need_gold = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.get_growth_reward(S_ITEM_UPGRADE.need_gold);
  utilNotice2(TXT.item_upgrade_tip, 3);
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE.make_screen()
};
S_ITEM_UPGRADE.get_growth_reward = function(n) {
  if (!glo.APP_FEATURE.PACKAGE_STORE) return n;
  var t = 1;
  return glo.package.get_is_growth() == "yes" && USER.level <= glo.package.get_growth_max_level() && (t = glo.package.get_growth_upgrade_cost()), Math.floor(n * t)
};

S_ITEM_UPGRADE.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE.row_focus == 1 ? S_ITEM_UPGRADE.focus > 1 && (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.focus--, S_ITEM_UPGRADE.abs_focus >= 2 ? S_ITEM_UPGRADE.abs_focus = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.abs_focus - 1 : (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_flag = 0), S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x + (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_w + S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_gap), S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_left())) : S_ITEM_UPGRADE.btn_focus = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? 1 : 1;
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE.row_focus == 1 ? S_ITEM_UPGRADE.focus < S_ITEM_UPGRADE.view_max_item && (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.focus++, S_ITEM_UPGRADE.abs_focus < ITEM_UPGRADE_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? S_ITEM_UPGRADE.abs_focus = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.abs_focus + 1 : (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_flag = 0), S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x - (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_w + S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_gap), S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_right())) : S_ITEM_UPGRADE.btn_focus = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? 1 : 2;
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE.row_focus = 1;
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE.row_focus = 2;
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE.menuRun_Run();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE.run_back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.space:
      if (gAPP_RELEASE != "TEST") return;
    case KeyDefine.RED:
      S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW.move_page = 3;
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_PERCENTAGE_SHOW, S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW) : S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW.init()
  }
};

S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_right = function() {
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_right()!!");
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x - S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_speed * (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x - S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x);
  $("#IUG_center_item_list_scroll").css({
    left: S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x > S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x + 4 && S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_right, 80) : (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_flag = 0, $("#IUG_center_item_list_scroll").css({
    left: S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  }), gEnableKey = 1)
};

S_ITEM_UPGRADE.menuRun_Run = function() {
  var t, n;
  switch (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.row_focus) {
    case 1:
      if (STORAGE.view_item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.focus].socket_index > 0 || STORAGE.view_item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.focus].lock == 1) {
        utilNotice(TXT.item_not_updrade1, 2);
        return
      }
      for (n = 1; n <= 3; n++) {
        if (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_array[n] == 0) {
          S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_array[n] = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.focus;
          S_ITEM_UPGRADE.item_checkbox_draw();
          n == 3 && (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.row_focus = 2, S_ITEM_UPGRADE.btn_focus = 2, S_ITEM_UPGRADE.drawFocus());
          return
        }
        if (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_array[n] == S_ITEM_UPGRADE.focus) {
          for (t = n; t <= 3; t++) S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_array[t] = t == 3 ? 0 : S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_array[t + 1];
          S_ITEM_UPGRADE.item_checkbox_draw();
          return
        }
        n == 3 && utilNotice(TXT.item_not_select_max, 2)
      }
      break;
    case 2:
      if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO) {
        for (n = 1; n <= 3; n++)
          if (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_array[n] == 0) {
            utilNotice(TXT.item_not_updrade2, 2);
            return
          } if (get_cur_gold() < S_ITEM_UPGRADE.need_gold) {
          utilNotice(TXT.gold_lack, 1.2);
          return
        }
        S_ITEM_UPGRADE.removeMouseEvent();
        gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
          display: "block"
        }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN)
      } else if (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.btn_focus == 1) S_ITEM_UPGRADE.backKey();
      else {
        for (n = 1; n <= 3; n++)
          if (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_array[n] == 0) {
            utilNotice(TXT.item_not_updrade2, 2);
            return
          } if (get_cur_gold() < S_ITEM_UPGRADE.need_gold) {
          utilNotice(TXT.gold_lack, 1.2);
          return
        }
        S_ITEM_UPGRADE.removeMouseEvent();
        gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
          display: "block"
        }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN)
      }
  }
};

S_ITEM_UPGRADE.view_item_upgrade_type = function() {
  var n, o, s, h, c;
  S_ITEM.view_item_reset();
  var l = DEFINE_ITEM[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_num].type,
    a = DEFINE_ITEM[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_num].filename,
    v = STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].add_option,
    y = utilGetNumber_withComma(STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].add_option_num + ""),
    p = Math.floor(S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_num / 100),
    t = 1;
  for (n = 1; n <= DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX; n++) {
    var i = Math.floor(STORAGE.item[n].item_num / 100),
      r = Math.floor(S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_num / 100),
      f = r >= 5,
      e = i >= 5,
      u = !1;
    f || e ? (o = f ? Math.floor(S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_num / 10) % 10 : r, s = e ? Math.floor(STORAGE.item[n].item_num / 10) % 10 : i, u = o == s) : u = i == r;
    u && (h = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade(STORAGE.item[n].item_num), c = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_grade, h == c && n != S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index && (STORAGE.view_item[t].item_num = STORAGE.item[n].item_num, STORAGE.view_item[t].socket_index = STORAGE.item[n].socket_index, STORAGE.view_item[t].add_option = STORAGE.item[n].add_option, STORAGE.view_item[t].add_option_num = STORAGE.item[n].add_option_num, STORAGE.view_item[t].add_option_reset_num = STORAGE.item[n].add_option_reset_num, STORAGE.view_item[t].lock = STORAGE.item[n].lock, STORAGE.view_item[t].indexing = n, t++))
  }
};
S_ITEM_UPGRADE.yes_callback = function() {
  var v, y, p, r, t, o, s, u, i;
  USER.gold = USER.gold - S_ITEM_UPGRADE.need_gold;
  glo.APP_FEATURE.GOLD_CRYPT && encoding_add_gold(-S_ITEM_UPGRADE.need_gold);
  S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top();
  var l = STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].item_num + ":0:" + STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].add_option + "-" + STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].add_option_num + ":0:0",
    h = "",
    k = Math.floor(S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_num / 100),
    n = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade_return_num(S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_num),
    d = Math.floor(Math.random() * DEFINE_ITEM_UPGRADE.probability[n][3] + 1),
    g = DEFINE_ITEM_UPGRADE.probability[n][1],
    nt = "",
    tt = 0;
  AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[17] == 1 && n == 2 || DEFINE_ITEM_UPGRADE.mileage[n].num >= DEFINE_ITEM_UPGRADE.mileage[n].success100_num && n <= 4 && (d = 100, g = 100, tt = 1);
  var a = n >= 5,
    ft = STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].add_option,
    et = STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].add_option_num;
  if (!a)
    if (d <= g) {
      utilConsoleLog("~~##~~[아이템 등급업 성공]");
      v = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 1);
      y = 0;
      y = v <= DEFINE_ITEM_UPGRADE.probability_sangjungha[1] ? 1 : v <= DEFINE_ITEM_UPGRADE.probability_sangjungha[1] + DEFINE_ITEM_UPGRADE.probability_sangjungha[2] ? 2 : 3;
      p = k;
      k >= 5 && (p = Math.floor(S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_num / 10) % 10);
      var ot = p + "" + (n + 1) + "" + y,
        st = Number(ot),
        f = Math.floor(Math.random() * (DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION.length - 1) + 1);
      n == 6 && (f == 2 ? f = 1 : f == 4 && (f = 2));
      var it = DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION[f].ran_option[n + 1][2],
        rt = DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION[f].ran_option[n + 1][3],
        ht = rt - it,
        ut = it + Math.floor(Math.random() * ht + 1);
      f == 7 && (ut = rt);
      STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].item_num = st;
      STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].add_option = DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION[f].name;
      STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].add_option_num = ut;
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_num = STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].item_num;
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_index = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index;
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_grade = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade(STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].item_num);
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_add_option = STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].add_option;
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_add_option_num = STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].add_option_num;
      nt = S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_num + ":" + S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_index + ":" + S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_add_option + "-" + S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_add_option_num + ":0:0";
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result = 1
    } else utilConsoleLog("~~##~~[아이템 등급업 실패]"), S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_num = STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].item_num, S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_index = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index, S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_grade = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade(STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].item_num), S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_add_option = STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].add_option, S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_add_option_num = STORAGE.item[S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_index].add_option_num, S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result = 2;

S_ITEM_UPGRADE.goto_next_scene = function() {
  document.getElementById("S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE_div") == null ? $("#S_ITEM_UPGRADE_div").after('<div id= "S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE_div"><\/div>') : $("#S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE_div").empty();
  gEnableKey = 0;
  $("#S_ITEM_UPGRADE_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE_div").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.init()
};
S_ITEM_UPGRADE.yes = function() {
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE.yes_callback()
};
S_ITEM_UPGRADE.end = function() {
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE.removeMouseEvent();
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE.focus = 1;
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE.row_focus = 1;
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE.abs_focus = 1;
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE.btn_focus = 1;
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x = 50;
  for (var n = 1; n <= 3; n++) S_ITEM_UPGRADE.select_item_array[n] = 0
};
S_ITEM_UPGRADE.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.removeMouseEvent(), $("#S_ITEM_UPGRADE_div").mouseover(this.onMouseover))
};
S_ITEM_UPGRADE.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_ITEM_UPGRADE_div").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_ITEM_UPGRADE.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && (utilConsoleLog("1-onClick  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), gEnableKey != 0)) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (t.id.search("leftarrow") >= 0)
      if (this.view_max_item >= 8) this.mousedrag_left_to_right(), S_ITEM_UPGRADE.pressed_left();
      else return;
    else if (t.id.search("rightarrow") >= 0)
      if (this.view_max_item >= 8) this.mousedrag_right_to_left(), S_ITEM_UPGRADE.pressed_right();
      else return;
    else t.id.search("percentage") >= 0 ? (S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW.move_page = 3, gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_PERCENTAGE_SHOW, S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW) : S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW.init()) : S_ITEM_UPGRADE.menuRun_Run()
  }
};
S_ITEM_UPGRADE.pressed_left = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  var n = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/";
  $("#IUG_leftarrow_drag").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("IUG_leftarrow_drag", n + "ui/0_common/drag_leftbt_focus.png", 40, 628);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("IUG_leftarrow_drag", n + "ui/0_common/drag_leftbt.png", 40, 628);
    setTimeout(function() {
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE.drawFocus();
      gEnableKey = 1
    }, 100)
  }, 400)
};
S_ITEM_UPGRADE.pressed_right = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  var n = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/";
  $("#IUG_rightarrow_drag").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("IUG_rightarrow_drag", n + "ui/0_common/drag_rightbt_focus.png", 1160, 628);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("IUG_rightarrow_drag", n + "ui/0_common/drag_rightbt.png", 1160, 628);
    setTimeout(function() {
      S_ITEM_UPGRADE.drawFocus();
      gEnableKey = 1
    }, 100)
  }, 400)
};
S_ITEM_UPGRADE.onMousedown = function(n) {
  this.onMouseover(n)
};
S_ITEM_UPGRADE.onMouseup = function(n) {
  this.onMouseover(n);
  this.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_ITEM_UPGRADE.onMouseover = function(n) {
  var t, i;
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    for (t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } console.log("S_ITEM_UPGRADE.onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
    switch (n.target.id) {
      case "IUG_back_btn":
      case "IUG_back":
      case "Txt_IUG_back":
      case "Img_IUG_back_focus":
        gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.row_focus = 2, S_ITEM_UPGRADE.btn_focus = 1, S_ITEM_UPGRADE.drawFocus());
        return;
      case "IUG_start_btn":
      case "IUG_start":
      case "Txt_IUG_start":
      case "Img_IUG_start_icon":
      case "Img_IUG_start_focus":
        S_ITEM_UPGRADE.row_focus = 2;
        S_ITEM_UPGRADE.btn_focus = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? 1 : 2;
        S_ITEM_UPGRADE.drawFocus();
        return
    }
    t.id.search("Img_IUG_center_item_list_scroll_item_cover") >= 0 && (i = Number(n.target.id.substring(42)), this.view_max_item >= i && (this.focus = i, this.row_focus = 1, S_ITEM_UPGRADE.drawFocus()))
  }
};
S_ITEM_UPGRADE.mousedrag_right_to_left = function() {
  if (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_flag != 1) {
    var t = 50 + (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_w + S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_gap) * (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.view_max_item - ITEM_UPGRADE_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1,
      i = Math.abs(Math.abs(S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x - 50) - Math.abs(t)) + 50,
      r = Math.abs(Math.floor(i / (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_w + S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_gap))),
      n = 3,
      u = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x - (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_w + S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_gap) * n;
    u < t && (n = r);
    S_ITEM_UPGRADE.focus < S_ITEM_UPGRADE.view_max_item && (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.focus = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.focus + n, S_ITEM_UPGRADE.drawFocus(), S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_flag = 0), S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x - (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_w + S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_gap) * n, S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_right())
  }
};
S_ITEM_UPGRADE.mousedrag_left_to_right = function() {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    var i = 50,
      n = 3,
      t = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x + (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_w + S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_gap) * n;
    t > i && (n = 2, t = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x + (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_w + S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 1, t = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x + (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_w + S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_gap) * n, t > i && (n = 0)));
    S_ITEM_UPGRADE.focus = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.focus - n;
    S_ITEM_UPGRADE.drawFocus();
    S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_flag = 0);
    S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_target_x = S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_cur_x + (S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_w + S_ITEM_UPGRADE.list_gap) * n;
    S_ITEM_UPGRADE.scroll_left()
  }
};
S_ITEM_UPGRADE.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_ITEM_UPGRADE.backKey()
};

S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.end = function() {
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.removeMouseEvent();
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result = 0;
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_num = 0;
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_index = 0;
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_grade = "";
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_add_option = "";
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.result_item_add_option_num = 0;
  clearInterval(S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.effect_center.timer);
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.effect_center.timer = null;
  clearInterval(S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.effect_result.timer);
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.effect_result.timer = null;
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.effect_center.cur_frame = 1;
  S_ITEM_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.effect_center.cur_loop = 1
};

};

};

};

  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene != gS_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE && S_ITEM_GACHA.define();

    gEnableKey = 1
