S_ITEM_GACHA.define = function() {
  S_ITEM_GACHA.focus = 1;
  S_ITEM_GACHA.row_focus = 1;
  S_ITEM_GACHA.card_num = ITEM_GACHA_NUM
};
S_ITEM_GACHA.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_ITEM_GACHA.row_focus == 2) {
        if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO) return;
        S_ITEM_GACHA.btn_focus >= 2 && S_ITEM_GACHA.btn_focus--;
        S_ITEM_GACHA.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        return
      }
      S_ITEM_GACHA.focus >= 2 && (S_ITEM_GACHA.focus = S_ITEM_GACHA.focus - 1, S_ITEM_GACHA.drawFocus(), S_ITEM_GACHA.abs_focus >= 2 ? S_ITEM_GACHA.abs_focus = S_ITEM_GACHA.abs_focus - 1 : (S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_flag = 0), S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_target_x = S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x + (S_ITEM_GACHA.card_w + S_ITEM_GACHA.card_gap), S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_left()));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_ITEM_GACHA.row_focus == 2) {
        if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO) return;
        S_ITEM_GACHA.btn_focus < 2 && S_ITEM_GACHA.btn_focus++;
        S_ITEM_GACHA.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        return
      }
      S_ITEM_GACHA.focus < S_ITEM_GACHA.card_num && (S_ITEM_GACHA.focus = S_ITEM_GACHA.focus + 1, S_ITEM_GACHA.drawFocus(), S_ITEM_GACHA.abs_focus < GACHA_NUM_ON_SCREEN ? S_ITEM_GACHA.abs_focus = S_ITEM_GACHA.abs_focus + 1 : (S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_flag = 0), S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_target_x = S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x - (S_ITEM_GACHA.card_w + S_ITEM_GACHA.card_gap), S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_right()));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_ITEM_GACHA.row_focus == 2 && (S_ITEM_GACHA.row_focus = 1, S_ITEM_GACHA.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_ITEM_GACHA.row_focus == 1 && (S_ITEM_GACHA.row_focus = 2, gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO && (S_ITEM_GACHA.btn_focus = 1), S_ITEM_GACHA.drawFocus_btnmenu());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_ITEM_GACHA.row_focus == 2 ? S_ITEM_GACHA.menuRun_btnmenu() : S_ITEM_GACHA.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_ITEM_GACHA.run_back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.space:
      if (gAPP_RELEASE != "TEST") return;
    case KeyDefine.RED:
      S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW.move_page = 2;
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_PERCENTAGE_SHOW, S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW) : S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW.init()
  }
};
S_ITEM_GACHA.backKey = function() {
  S_ITEM_GACHA.end();
  $("#S_ITEM_GACHA_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU)
};
S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_right = function() {
  S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_right()!!");
  S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x - S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_speed * (S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x - S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_target_x);
  $("#S_ITEM_GACHA_card").css({
    left: S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x > S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_target_x + 4 && S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_right, 80) : (S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_flag = 0)
};
S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_left = function() {
  S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_left()!!");
  S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x + S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_speed * (S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_target_x - S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x);
  $("#S_ITEM_GACHA_card").css({
    left: S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x < S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_target_x - 4 && S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_left, 80) : (S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_flag = 0)
};

S_ITEM_GACHA.make_screen_bottom_only_one = function(n) {

      break;
    case 2:
      t = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/12_gacha/cp_bt1.png";
      break;
    case 3:
      t = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/12_gacha/cp_bt1.png";
      break;
    case 4:
      t = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/12_gacha/cp_bt2.png";

    default:

S_ITEM_GACHA.drawFocus = function() {

  });

S_ITEM_GACHA.menuRun_btnmenu_Run = function() {
  var n;
  if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO) n = function(n) {
    for (var t = 0; t < n.event_arr.length; t++) AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[n.event_arr[t]] = 1;
    auto_event_value();
    loading_hide();
    gEnableKey = 1;
    S_ITEM_GACHA.end();
    ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GACHA, S_GACHA)
  }, loading_show(), gEnableKey = 0, auto_event_system_init(), auto_event_system_check(999, n);
  else switch (S_ITEM_GACHA.btn_focus) {
    case 1:
      S_ITEM_GACHA.backKey();
      break;
    case 2:
      n = function(n) {
        for (var t = 0; t < n.event_arr.length; t++) AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[n.event_arr[t]] = 1;
        auto_event_value();
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        S_ITEM_GACHA.end();
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GACHA, S_GACHA)
      };
      loading_show();
      gEnableKey = 0;
      auto_event_system_init();
      auto_event_system_check(999, n);
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_ITEM_GACHA.menuRun_btnmenu():" + S_ITEM_GACHA.btn_focus)
  }
};
S_ITEM_GACHA.gacha_run = function() {
  var n, i, t;
  if (n = S_ITEM_GACHA.data[S_ITEM_GACHA.focus].need_ruby, get_cur_ruby() > 0 && get_cur_ruby() >= n) {
    if ((glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && loading_hide(), S_ITEM_GACHA.need_ruby = n, i = STORAGE.get_my_item_tot_num(), t = S_ITEM_GACHA.focus <= 3 ? 1 : 6, AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[23] == 1 && (t = S_ITEM_GACHA.focus <= 3 ? 2 : 12), i + t > DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX) {
      utilNotice(TXT.item_space_lack, 1.2);
      return
    }
    utilPush();
    S_ITEM_GACHA.removeMouseEvent();
    $("#IG_card_focus_" + S_ITEM_GACHA.focus).css({
      display: "none"
    });
    gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN) : ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
      display: "block"
    }), S_POPUPYN.init());
    return
  }(glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && (loading_hide(), gEnableKey = 1);
  utilNotice(TXT.ruby_lack, 1.2);
  utilConsoleLog("ruby 가 부족합니다. 구매 하시겠습니까?");
  return
};
S_ITEM_GACHA.yes = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  S_ITEM_GACHA.flag_back_lock = 1;
  S_ITEM_GACHA.aniRun();
  glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_GACHA_PHP_REFACTORING && (S_ITEM_GACHA.call_num_by_gacha = 0, S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.init_ITEM_GACHARESULT(), S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.calculate(), S_ITEM_GACHA.gacha_etc = S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha_etc(), loading_show("ITEM_GACHA", 1), ServerConnection.update_item_to_server(S_ITEM_GACHA.gacha_etc, function(n) {
    loading_hide("ITEM_GACHA", 1);
    utilConsoleLog("~~##~~data:" + n);
    utilConsoleLog("~~##~~data typeof:" + typeof n);
    var t = n;
    if (t.STATUS == "ERROR") {
      S_ITEM_GACHA.is_error = 1;
      t.ERROR_CODE == "BLACK_LIST" || t.ERROR_CODE == "ITEM_USE_OVER" ? ((gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.SSBR) && (S_ERROR_NETWORK.black_list_check = 1), glo.fun.show_s_error_network("아이템 뽑기에서 실패:BLACK_LIST")) : (t.ERROR_CODE == "RUN_COUNT_ERROR" || t.ERROR_CODE == "HOST_ID_NONE") && glo.fun.show_s_error_network("아이템 뽑기에서 실패:" + t.ERROR_CODE);
      return
    }
    if (t.STATUS && t.STATUS.search("mysql_error") >= 0) {
      S_ITEM_GACHA.is_error = 1;
      glo.fun.show_s_error_network("아이템 뽑기에서 에서 실패:mysql_error:" + t.ERROR_MESSAGE);
      return
    }
    USER.ruby = Number(t.after_ruby);
    glo.APP_FEATURE.GOLD_CRYPT && (USER.ruby_encoding = number_encoding(t.after_ruby));
    console.log(" S_ITEM_GACHA.yes update_item_to_server  after_ruby:" + t.after_ruby + "  ruby:" + USER.ruby);
    S_ITEM_GACHA.is_error = 0;
    S_ITEM_GACHA.callback_update_item_to_server()
  }, "ITEM_GACHA", S_ITEM_GACHA.need_ruby * -1))
};

  }

  if (S_ITEM_GACHA.call_num_by_gacha++, S_ITEM_GACHA.call_num_by_gacha === 2) S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.add_item_refactoring(), save_UserInfo_after_pay_to_server(S_ITEM_GACHA.need_ruby * -1, S_ITEM_GACHA.get_gacha_type, S_ITEM_GACHA.gacha_etc), S_ITEM_GACHA.networkCheck();

    if (S_ITEM_GACHA.is_error === 1) {

    }

  }

S_ITEM_GACHA.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_ITEM_GACHA.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_ITEM_GACHA.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_ITEM_GACHA.onClick = function(n) {
  var t, i, r;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (n.target.id.search("percentage") >= 0) {
      S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW.move_page = 2;
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_PERCENTAGE_SHOW, S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW) : S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW.init();
      return
    }
    S_ITEM_GACHA.row_focus == 2 ? S_ITEM_GACHA.menuRun_btnmenu() : n.target.id.substring(0, 9) == "IG_cover_" && (i = n.target.id.substring(9), r = parseInt(i, 10), S_ITEM_GACHA.menuRun())
  }
};
S_ITEM_GACHA.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && !(n.target.id.search("percentage") >= 0)) {
    switch (n.target.id) {
      case "IG_back":
      case "IG_back_icon":
      case "Txt_IG_back":
      case "Img_IG_back_focus":
        if (gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO) {
          S_ITEM_GACHA.row_focus = 2;
          S_ITEM_GACHA.btn_focus = 1;
          S_ITEM_GACHA.drawFocus_btnmenu();
          S_ITEM_GACHA.onMouseover_pressed("IG_back_icon", "Txt_IG_back")
        }
        return;
      case "IG_start_btn":
      case "IG_start":
      case "IG_start_icon":
      case "Img_IG_start_focus":
      case "Txt_IG_start":
        S_ITEM_GACHA.row_focus = 2;
        S_ITEM_GACHA.btn_focus = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? 1 : 2;
        S_ITEM_GACHA.drawFocus_btnmenu();
        S_ITEM_GACHA.onMouseover_pressed("IG_start_btn", "IG_start", "IG_start_icon");
        return
    }
    if (n.target.id.substring(0, 9) != "IG_cover_") {
      utilConsoleLog("해당 id는 무시:" + n.target.id);
      return
    }
    S_ITEM_GACHA.row_focus = 1;
    var i = n.target.id.substring(9),
      t = parseInt(i, 10);
    isNaN(t) && utilConsoleLog("Error in S_ITEM_GACHA.onMouseover() : focus is NaN");
    S_ITEM_GACHA.abs_focus = S_ITEM_GACHA.abs_focus + (t - S_ITEM_GACHA.focus);
    S_ITEM_GACHA.focus = t;
    S_ITEM_GACHA.drawFocus()
  }
};
S_ITEM_GACHA.onMouseover_pressed = function() {};
S_ITEM_GACHA.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_ITEM_GACHA.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_ITEM_GACHA.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_ITEM_GACHA.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_ITEM_GACHA.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_ITEM_GACHA.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_ITEM_GACHA.mousedrag_right_to_left = function() {
  if (S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_flag != 1) {
    var t = (S_ITEM_GACHA.card_w + S_ITEM_GACHA.card_gap) * (S_ITEM_GACHA.card_num - ITEM_GACHA_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1,
      i = (S_ITEM_GACHA.card_w + S_ITEM_GACHA.card_gap) * (S_ITEM_GACHA.card_num - ITEM_GACHA_NUM_ON_SCREEN) * -1 - S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x,
      r = Math.abs(Math.floor(i / (S_ITEM_GACHA.card_w + S_ITEM_GACHA.card_gap))),
      n = ITEM_GACHA_NUM_ON_SCREEN - 1,
      u = S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x - (S_ITEM_GACHA.card_w + S_ITEM_GACHA.card_gap) * n;
    u < t && (n = r);
    S_ITEM_GACHA.focus < S_ITEM_GACHA.card_num && (S_ITEM_GACHA.focus = S_ITEM_GACHA.focus + n, S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_flag = 0), S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_target_x = S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x - (S_ITEM_GACHA.card_w + S_ITEM_GACHA.card_gap) * n, S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_right())
  }
};
S_ITEM_GACHA.mousedrag_left_to_right = function() {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    var i = 0,
      n = 3,

    S_ITEM_GACHA.focus = S_ITEM_GACHA.focus - n;
    S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x = S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_target_x, S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_flag = 0);
    S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_target_x = S_ITEM_GACHA.scroll_cur_x + (S_ITEM_GACHA.card_w + S_ITEM_GACHA.card_gap) * n;

  }

      i = REWARD_AD.exists(REWARD_AD.PLACE.GACHA_COMPLETE) && !S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.ad_redraw_used ? 4 : 3;
      S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus < i && (S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus++, S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.run_back()
  }

S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && sound_play(SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus) {
    case 1:
      utilScale_xy_center("GIG_redraw", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_GIG_redraw_icon", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_GIG_redraw_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 2:
      utilScale_xy_center("GIG_ok", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_GIG_ok_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      break;
    case 3:
      utilScale_xy_center("GIG_maketeam", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_GIG_maketeam_icon", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
      utilScale_xy_center("Img_GIG_maketeam_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    switch (S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus) {
      case 1:
        utilScale_xy_center("GIG_redraw", 1, 1);
        utilScale_xy_center("Img_GIG_redraw_icon", 1, 1);
        utilScale_xy_center("Img_GIG_redraw_focus", 1, 1);
        break;
      case 2:
        utilScale_xy_center("GIG_ok", 1, 1);
        utilScale_xy_center("Img_GIG_ok_focus", 1, 1);
        break;
      case 3:
        utilScale_xy_center("GIG_maketeam", 1, 1);
        utilScale_xy_center("Img_GIG_maketeam_icon", 1, 1);
        utilScale_xy_center("Img_GIG_maketeam_focus", 1, 1)
    }
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.menuRun_Run = function() {
  var i, n, r, t;
  switch (S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus) {
    case 4:
      if (!REWARD_AD.is_enabled("GIG_ad_btn")) {
        REWARD_AD.notice_state("GIG_ad_btn");
        gEnableKey = 1;
        break
      }
      REWARD_AD.play(REWARD_AD.PLACE.GACHA_COMPLETE, "", null, S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.on_reward_ad);
      break;
    case 1:
      if (typeof S_GACHA != "undefined" && (S_GACHA.item_ad_reroll_run = 0), i = S_ITEM_GACHA.data[S_ITEM_GACHA.focus].need_ruby, n = Math.floor(i * .9), get_cur_ruby() >= n) {
        if (S_ITEM_GACHA.need_ruby = n, r = STORAGE.get_my_item_tot_num(), t = S_ITEM_GACHA.focus <= 3 ? 1 : 6, AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[23] == 1 && (t = S_ITEM_GACHA.focus <= 3 ? 2 : 12), r + t > DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX) {
          utilNotice(TXT.item_space_lack, 1.2);
          return
        }
        S_GACHA.item_gacha_mode = !0;
        S_GACHA.item_gacha_need_ruby = n;
        utilPush();
        S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.removeMouseEvent();
        $("#Img_GIG_redraw_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        $("#Img_GIG_ok_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        $("#Img_GIG_maketeam_focus").css({
          display: "none"
        });
        gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
          display: "block"
        }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN);
        return
      }
      utilNotice(TXT.ruby_lack, 1.2);
      utilConsoleLog("ruby 가 부족합니다. 구매 하시겠습니까?");
      return;
    case 2:
      S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.run_back();
      break;
    case 3:
      S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.end();
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM);
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.menuRun_Run():" + S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus)
  }
};
S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.back = function() {
  var n, t;
  if (g_sceneinfo.before_scene == gS_GACHA) {
    n = function(n) {
      for (var t = 0; t < n.event_arr.length; t++) AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[n.event_arr[t]] = 1;
      auto_event_value();
      loading_hide();
      $("#S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE_div").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.end();
      S_GACHA.effect.timer !== null && (clearTimeout(S_GACHA.effect.timer), S_GACHA.effect.timer = null);
      S_GACHA.card_ani_complete_count = 0;
      S_GACHA.effect_complete = 0;
      S_GACHA.effect.cur_loop = 1;
      S_GACHA.effect.cur_frame = 1;
      g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
      g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_GACHA;
      S_MAINMENU.remount_mm_top(S_GACHA, TXT.gacha);
      $("#S_GACHA_div").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      S_GACHA.make_screen();
      S_GACHA.addMouseEvent();
      blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
      setTimeout(function() {
        gEnableKey = 1
      }, DEFINE.KEYLOCKTIME)
    };
    loading_show();
    gEnableKey = 0;
    auto_event_system_init();
    auto_event_system_check(999, n);
    return
  }
  t = function(n) {
    for (var t = 0; t < n.event_arr.length; t++) AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[n.event_arr[t]] = 1;
    auto_event_value();
    loading_hide();
    $("#S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE_div").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.end();
    $("#S_ITEM_GACHA_div").css({
      display: "block"
    });
    S_ITEM_GACHA.init()
  };
  loading_show();
  gEnableKey = 0;
  auto_event_system_init();
  auto_event_system_check(999, t)
};
S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.calculate = function() {
  switch (S_ITEM_GACHA.focus) {
    case 1:
      S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha1();
      break;
    case 2:
      S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha2();
      break;
    case 3:
      S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha3();
      break;
    case 4:
      S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha4();
      break;
    case 5:
      S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha5();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.calculate():" + S_ITEM_GACHA.focus)
  }
};
S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.get_gacha1 = function() {
  var s = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4 + 1),
    n = 0,
    r = 0,
    t = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 1),
    u;
  n = t <= ITEM_GACHA_PROBABILITY.gacha1[1] ? 1 : 2;
  t = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 1);
  r = t <= DEFINE_ITEM_UPGRADE.probability_sangjungha[1] ? 1 : t <= DEFINE_ITEM_UPGRADE.probability_sangjungha[1] + DEFINE_ITEM_UPGRADE.probability_sangjungha[2] ? 2 : 3;
  u = s + "" + n + "" + r;
  ITEM_GACHARESULT[1].item_num = Number(u);
  var i = Math.floor(Math.random() * (DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION.length - 1) + 1),
    f = DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION[i].ran_option[n][2],
    e = DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION[i].ran_option[n][3],
    h = e - f,
    o = f + Math.floor(Math.random() * h + 1);
  i == 7 && (o = e);
  ITEM_GACHARESULT[1].add_option = DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION[i].name;
  ITEM_GACHARESULT[1].add_option_num = o;
  glo.APP_FEATURE.ITEM_GACHA_PHP_REFACTORING || S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.add_item()
};

S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.add_item = function() {
  var i, t, n;
  switch (S_ITEM_GACHA.focus) {
    case 1:
    case 2:
    case 3:
      i = 1;
      break;
    case 4:
    case 5:
      i = 6;
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.add_item():" + S_ITEM_GACHA.focus)

S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.rad_find_item_from_end = function(n) {
  for (var t, i = DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX + 1; i >= 1; i--)
    if ((t = STORAGE.item[i], t && !(t.item_num <= 0)) && Number(t.item_num) == Number(n.item_num) && String(t.add_option) == String(n.add_option) && Number(t.add_option_num) == Number(n.add_option_num) && Number(t.socket_index) == 0 && Number(t.lock) == 0) return i;
  return 0
};

  gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0 && (utilConsoleLog(" S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.onMouseonClick  e.target.id: " + n.target.id), S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.menuRun())
};
S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    switch (n.target.id) {
      case "GIG_redraw_btn":
      case "GIG_redraw":
      case "Txt_GIG_redraw":
      case "Img_GIG_redraw_icon":
      case "Img_GIG_redraw_focus":
        S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus = 1;
        break;
      case "GIG_ok_btn":
      case "GIG_ok":
      case "Txt_GIG_ok":
      case "Img_GIG_ok_focus":
        S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus = 2;
        break;
      case "GIG_maketeam_btn":
      case "GIG_maketeam":
      case "Txt_GIG_maketeam":
      case "Img_GIG_maketeam_icon":
      case "Img_GIG_maketeam_focus":
        S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus = 3;
        break;
      default:
        REWARD_AD.hit(n.target.id, "GIG_ad_btn") && (S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.focus = 4)
    }
    S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.drawFocus()
  }
};

};

  }

  }

  S_GACHA.item_gacha_mode = !0;

  S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.removeMouseEvent();
  S_ITEM_GACHA_COMPLETE.rad_remove_new_items();
  S_GACHA.gacha_item_yes()
};

    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus >= 2 && S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus <= 10 && (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus = S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus - 1, S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus == 5 ? (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_cur_x = -1280, S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_target_x = 0, $("#Img_SMH_focus_6").css({

      }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_SMH_leftarrow", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/2_selectmap/sm_leftbt_f.png", 21, 387), gEnableKey = 0, setTimeout(function() {

      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus == S_SELECTMAP.JEWEL_BTN_NUM ? (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus--, S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawFocus()) : S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus == S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM && S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawFocus() : S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus == S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM || S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus == S_SELECTMAP.JEWEL_BTN_NUM ? (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus--, S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawFocus()) : S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus == S_SELECTMAP.PREV_BTN_NUM && S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus < S_SELECTMAP_HARD.maxfocus && (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus = S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus + 1, S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus == 6 ? (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_cur_x = 0, S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_target_x = -1280, $("#Img_SMH_focus_5").css({

      }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_SMH_rightarrow", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/2_selectmap/sm_rightbt_f.png", 1228, 387), gEnableKey = 0, setTimeout(function() {

      }, 300)) : S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawFocus());
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus == S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM ? (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus++, S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawFocus()) : S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus == S_SELECTMAP.JEWEL_BTN_NUM && S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawFocus() : S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus == S_SELECTMAP.PREV_BTN_NUM || S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus == S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM ? (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus++, S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawFocus()) : S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus == S_SELECTMAP.JEWEL_BTN_NUM && S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      switch (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus) {
        case S_SELECTMAP.PREV_BTN_NUM:
        case S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM:
        case S_SELECTMAP.JEWEL_BTN_NUM:
          S_SELECTMAP_HARD.backup_focus_down = S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus;
          S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus = S_SELECTMAP_HARD.backup_focus;

      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      switch (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus) {
        case 1:
        case 2:
        case 3:
        case 4:
        case 5:
        case 6:
        case 7:
        case 8:
        case 9:

          S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus = S_SELECTMAP_HARD.backup_focus_down;
          S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawFocus()

      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_SELECTMAP_HARD.run_back()
  }

S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawFocus = function() {
  if (!(S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus <= SELECTMAP_NUM) || !(S_SELECTMAP_HARD.maxfocus < S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus)) {
    utilConsoleLog("S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawFocus  focus:" + S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus);
    window.g.blink.value = 1;
    S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus_none_all();
    S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawArrow();
    for (var n = 1; n <= SELECTMAP_NUM; n++) $("#SM_map_" + n).css({
      "z-index": "0"
    }), S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus == n && ($("#SMH_map_" + n).css({
      "z-index": "2"
    }), $("#Img_SMH_focus_" + n).css({
      display: "block"
    }), n <= 5 ? utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_SMH_focus_" + n, glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/2_selectmap/sm_map" + n + "_focus.png", SELECTMAP[n].fx, SELECTMAP[n].fy) : n <= 10 ? utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_SMH_focus_" + n, glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/2_selectmap/sm_map" + n + "_focus.png", SELECTMAP[n].fx, SELECTMAP[n].fy) : n == 11 ? utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_SMH_focus_" + n, glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/0_common/co_leftbt_focus.png", SELECTMAP[n].fx, SELECTMAP[n].fy) : n == 12 ? utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_SMH_focus_" + n, glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/1_mainmenu/mm_mainbt_focus.png", SELECTMAP[n].fx, SELECTMAP[n].fy) : utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_SMH_focus_" + n, glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/0_common/co_rightbt_focus.png", SELECTMAP[n].fx, SELECTMAP[n].fy));
    try {
      $("#Img_SMH_bottom_bt" + S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus + "_focus").css({
        display: "block"
      })
    } catch (t) {
      utilConsoleLog("S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawFocus error:" + t)
    }
    S_SELECTMAP_HARD.update_story_package_img()
  }
};
S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus_none_all = function() {
  try {
    $("#Img_SMH_bottom_bt" + S_SELECTMAP.PREV_BTN_NUM + "_focus").length && $("#Img_SMH_bottom_bt" + S_SELECTMAP.PREV_BTN_NUM + "_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    $("#Img_SMH_bottom_bt" + S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM + "_focus").length && $("#Img_SMH_bottom_bt" + S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM + "_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    $("#Img_SMH_bottom_bt" + S_SELECTMAP.JEWEL_BTN_NUM + "_focus").length && $("#Img_SMH_bottom_bt" + S_SELECTMAP.JEWEL_BTN_NUM + "_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    for (var n = 1; n <= SELECTMAP_NUM; n++) $("#Img_SMH_focus_" + n).length && $("#Img_SMH_focus_" + n).css({
      display: "none"
    })
  } catch (t) {
    utilConsoleLog("S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus_none_all error:" + t)
  }
};
S_SELECTMAP_HARD.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  setTimeout(function() {
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_SELECTMAP_HARD.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_SELECTMAP_HARD.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_SELECTMAP_HARD) {
    utilConsoleLog("마우스가 두번 눌려져서 S_SELECTSTAGE.init()가 두번 불려지는 현상 제거!");
    return
  }
  if (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus >= 1 && S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus <= 6 && gVALIDATE == 0) {
    var n;
    switch (gAPP_INFO.APP_NAME) {
      case "ELDORADO_LG_TV_RnD":
        n = TXT.validate_over_lgrnd;
        break;
      case "ELDORADO_ENTRIX_test":
        n = TXT.validate_over_entrix;
        break;
      default:
        n = TXT.validate_over
    }
    utilNotice3(n, 5);
    return
  }
  switch (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus) {
    case 1:
    case 2:
    case 3:
    case 4:
    case 5:
    case 6:
    case 7:
    case 8:
    case 9:
    case 10:
      utilPush();
      S_SELECTMAP_HARD.removeMouseEvent();
      S_GAME.ranking_mode = 5;
      $("#S_SELECTMAP_HARD_div").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      document.getElementById("S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD_div") == null ? $("#S_SELECTSTAGE_div").after('<div id= "S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD_div"><\/div>') : $("#S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD_div").empty();
      $("#S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD_div").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.init();
      S_SELECTMAP.set_background_display("none");
      break;
    case S_SELECTMAP.PREV_BTN_NUM:
      S_SELECTMAP.run_back();
      break;
    case S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM:
      S_SELECTMAP.mode_change("normal");
      break;
    case S_SELECTMAP.JEWEL_BTN_NUM:
      utilPush();
      document.getElementById("S_HARDMODE_JEWEL_div") == null ? $("#S_SELECTSTAGE_div").after('<div id= "S_HARDMODE_JEWEL_div"><\/div>') : $("#S_HARDMODE_JEWEL_div").empty();
      utilPush();
      S_SELECTMAP_HARD.end();
      $("#S_HARDMODE_JEWEL_div").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      $("#S_SELECTMAP_HARD_div").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      S_HARDMODE_JEWEL.init();
      S_SELECTMAP.set_background_display("none");
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("error!! in S_SELECTMAP_HARD.menuRun()")
  }
};
S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_right = function() {
  S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_right()!!");
  S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_cur_x = S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_cur_x - S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_speed * (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_cur_x - S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_target_x);
  $("#SMH_map_section").css({
    left: S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_cur_x + 4 < S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_target_x && S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_right, 80) : (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_cur_x = S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_target_x, S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_flag = 0, S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawBg(1), S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawArrow(), gEnableKey = 1);
  S_SELECTMAP_HARD.opacity -= S_SELECTMAP_HARD.op_gap;
  $("#Img_SMH_background2").css({
    opacity: S_SELECTMAP_HARD.opacity
  })
};
S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_left = function() {
  S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_flag = 1;
  utilConsoleLog("S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_left()!!");
  S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_cur_x = S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_cur_x - S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_speed * (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_cur_x - S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_target_x);
  $("#SMH_map_section").css({
    left: S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_cur_x > S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_target_x + 4 && S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_left, 80) : (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_cur_x = S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_target_x, S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_flag = 0, S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawBg(2), S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawArrow(), gEnableKey = 1);
  S_SELECTMAP_HARD.opacity += S_SELECTMAP_HARD.op_gap;
  $("#Img_SMH_background2").css({
    opacity: S_SELECTMAP_HARD.opacity
  })
};

S_SELECTMAP_HARD.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    console.log(" onMouseonClick  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
    utilConsoleLog(" S_SELECTMAP_HARD.onMouseonClick  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (n.target.id == "Img_SMH_leftarrow") {
      S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_cur_x = -1280;
      S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_target_x = 0;
      $("#Img_SMH_focus_6").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_SMH_leftarrow", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/2_selectmap/sm_leftbt_f.png", 21, 387);
      gEnableKey = 0;
      setTimeout(function() {
        S_SELECTMAP_HARD.opacity = 1;
        S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_right();
        S_SELECTMAP_HARD.page = 1
      }, 300);
      return
    }
    if (n.target.id == "Img_SMH_rightarrow") {
      S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_cur_x = 0;
      S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_target_x = -1280;
      $("#Img_SMH_focus_5").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_SMH_rightarrow", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/2_selectmap/sm_rightbt_f.png", 1228, 387);
      gEnableKey = 0;
      setTimeout(function() {
        S_SELECTMAP_HARD.opacity = 0;
        S_SELECTMAP_HARD.scroll_left();
        S_SELECTMAP_HARD.page = 2
      }, 300);
      return
    }
    n.target.className.search("map_button") >= 0 && (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus = glo.fun.get_only_number_by_text(n.target.id));
    n.target.className.search("prev_button") >= 0 ? S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus = S_SELECTMAP.PREV_BTN_NUM : n.target.className.search("mode_button") >= 0 ? S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus = S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM : n.target.className.search("jewel_button") >= 0 && (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus = S_SELECTMAP.JEWEL_BTN_NUM);
    S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawFocus();
    S_SELECTMAP_HARD.menuRun();
    return
  }
};
S_SELECTMAP_HARD.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (utilConsoleLog(" S_SELECTMAP_HARD.onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id), gMOUSE_USE) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } n.target.className.search("map_button") >= 0 && (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus = glo.fun.get_only_number_by_text(n.target.id));
    n.target.className.search("prev_button") >= 0 ? S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus = S_SELECTMAP.PREV_BTN_NUM : n.target.className.search("mode_button") >= 0 ? S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus = S_SELECTMAP.MODE_BTN_NUM : n.target.className.search("jewel_button") >= 0 && (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus = S_SELECTMAP.JEWEL_BTN_NUM);
    S_SELECTMAP_HARD.drawFocus()
  }
};
S_SELECTMAP_HARD.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_SELECTMAP_HARD.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_SELECTMAP_HARD.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_SELECTMAP_HARD.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_SELECTMAP_HARD.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_SELECTMAP_HARD.onMouseover(n);
  S_SELECTMAP_HARD.onClick(n);
  return
};

};

  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_SELECTSTAGE_HARD;
  S_MAINMENU.remount_mm_top(this, TXT.selectstage);
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus = 1;
  S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.set_maxfocus();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene != gS_STAGECLEAR && (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus = S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.maxfocus);
  S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.make_screen();
  S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.addMouseEvent();
  S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.drawFocus();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  setTimeout(function() {
    gEnableKey = 1
  }, 700)
};

S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.define = function() {
  for (var t = 5, i = 113, r = 129, u = 0, n = 1; n <= SELECTSTAGE_NUM + 1; n++) SELECTSTAGE_HARD[n] = {}, u = 6 <= n && n <= 10 || 16 <= n && n <= 20 ? 64 : 0, SELECTSTAGE_HARD[n].title = (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus - 1) * 20 + n, SELECTSTAGE_HARD[n].x = 516 + (i + 15) * ((n - 1) % t) + u, SELECTSTAGE_HARD[n].y = 147 + (r + -18) * Math.floor((n - 1) / t) - 20, SELECTSTAGE_HARD[n].w = i, SELECTSTAGE_HARD[n].h = r
};
S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.set_maxfocus = function() {
  if (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus < S_SELECTMAP_HARD.maxfocus) {
    S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.maxfocus = 20;
    return
  }
  if (MAX_STAGE_NUM_HARD <= CUR_HARD_STAGE_NUM) {
    S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.maxfocus = 20;
    return
  }
  S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.maxfocus = CUR_HARD_STAGE_NUM % 20 == 0 ? 20 : CUR_HARD_STAGE_NUM % 20
};
S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var r = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    i;
  utilConsoleLog("S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.keyDown  keyCode:" + r);
  switch (r) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus == 2) {
        S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus--;
        S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus === 2 && (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus = 1);
        $("#SSH_map_concept").length && $("#SSH_map_concept").css("display") === "block" ? S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus < 0 && (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus = 0) : S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus < 1 && (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus = 1);
        S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus >= 2 && (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus = S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus - 1, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      if (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus == 2) {
        S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus = 1;
        S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.drawFocus();
        return
      }
      S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus - 5 >= 1 && (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus = S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus - 5, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus == 2 ? (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus++, i = REWARD_AD.exists(REWARD_AD.PLACE.STAGESELECT) ? 3 : 1, i === 3 && S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus === 2 && (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus = 3), S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus > i && (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus = i)) : S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus < S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.maxfocus && (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus = S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus + 1);
      S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      if (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus == 2) return;
      S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus + 5 <= S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.maxfocus ? (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus = S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus + 5, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.drawFocus()) : Math.floor((S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus - 1) / 5) < Math.floor((S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.maxfocus - 1) / 5) ? (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus = S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.maxfocus, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.drawFocus()) : (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.run_back()
  }
};
S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.backKey = function() {
  S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.end();
  S_SELECTMAP.set_background_display("block");
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR ? ($("#S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD_div").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#S_SELECTMAP_HARD_div").css({
    display: "block"
  }), S_SELECTMAP_HARD.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_SELECTMAP_HARD, S_SELECTMAP_HARD)
};

S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.drawFocus = function() {

  }))
};
S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && sound_play(SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus == 1 ? (utilScale_xy_center("SSH_ad_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale), utilScale_xy_center("Img_SSH_ad_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)) : (utilScale_xy_center("SSH_back", gKeyScale, gKeyScale), utilScale_xy_center("Img_SSH_back_img", gKeyScale, gKeyScale), utilScale_xy_center("Txt_SSH_back", gKeyScale, gKeyScale), utilScale_xy_center("Img_SSH_back_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale));

S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.menuRun_Run = function() {
  switch (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus) {
    case 1:
      S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.run_stage();
      break;
    case 2:
      S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.run_button()
  }
};
S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.run_stage = function() {
  var n = (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus - 1) * 20 + S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus;
  if (STORAGE.get_maxstage() - 1 < n) {
    utilNotice(TXT.not_hardmode_stage, 2);
    return
  }(gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && get_server_time_sec();
  S_GAME.stage = n;
  ServerConnection.stage_start_then(S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.game_start)
};
S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.run_button = function() {
  switch (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus) {
    case 3:
      if (!REWARD_AD.is_enabled("SSH_ad_btn")) {
        REWARD_AD.notice_state("SSH_ad_btn");
        gEnableKey = 1;
        break
      }
      REWARD_AD.play(REWARD_AD.PLACE.STAGESELECT, "", null, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.on_reward_ad);
      break;
    case 0:
      S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.show_map_guide();
      break;
    case 1:
      S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.run_back()
  }
};
S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.show_map_guide = function() {
  S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.removeMouseEvent();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAP_GUIDE, S_MAP_GUIDE)
};
S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.game_start = function() {
  if (S_GAME.stage_ability_time = window.g.timestamp_due, S_GAME.stage_ability_bensy_flag = 0, S_GAME.stage_ability_time_pause_start = 0, S_GAME.stage_ability_time_pause_end = 0, gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) {
    var n = parseInt(window.g.timestamp_start, 10) + parseInt(window.g.timestamp_due, 10);
    window.g.stage_time_start = getTimeStamp(n);
    utilConsoleLog("~스테이지 진입 시간 : " + window.g.stage_time_start)
  }
  utilPush();
  S_GAME.stage = (S_SELECTMAP_HARD.focus - 1) * 20 + S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus;
  S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.end();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_GAME, S_GAME)
};

S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.onClick = function(n) {
  var t, i;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } n.target.className.search("stage_btn") >= 0 ? (i = glo.fun.get_only_number_by_text(n.target.id), i == 1 ? (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus = 1, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.menuRun()) : S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.maxfocus >= i && (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus = i, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.menuRun())) : REWARD_AD.hit(n.target.id, "SSH_ad_btn") ? (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus = 3, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.menuRun()) : n.target.className.search("prev_button") >= 0 ? (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus = 1, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.menuRun()) : n.target.className.search("medal_button") >= 0 ? (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.menuRun()) : n.target.className.search("concept_button") >= 0 && (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus = 0, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.show_map_guide())
  }
};
S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.onMouseover = function(n) {
  var t, i;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } n.target.id.search("SSH_menu") >= 0 ? (i = glo.fun.get_only_number_by_text(n.target.id), i == 1 ? (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus = 1, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus = 1) : S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.maxfocus >= i && (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.focus = i, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus = 1)) : n.target.className.search("prev_button") >= 0 ? (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus = 1) : n.target.className.search("medal_button") >= 0 ? (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus = 2) : REWARD_AD.hit(n.target.id, "SSH_ad_btn") ? (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus = 3) : n.target.className.search("concept_button") >= 0 && (S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.row_focus = 2, S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.btn_focus = 0);
    S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.drawFocus()
  }
};
S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.onMouseover(n);
  S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.onClick(n);
  return
};

  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_SELECTSTAGE_HARD.backKey()
};

S_HARDMODE_JEWEL.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && (S_HARDMODE_JEWEL.focus = 1, S_HARDMODE_JEWEL.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && (S_HARDMODE_JEWEL.focus = 1, S_HARDMODE_JEWEL.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && S_HARDMODE_JEWEL.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_HARDMODE_JEWEL.run_back()
  }
};

          }

          break;
        case KeyDefine.down:
          S_PACKAGE_ITEM.row_focus == 1 && (S_PACKAGE_ITEM.row_focus = 2, S_PACKAGE_ITEM.drawFocus());
          break;

    S_PACKAGE_ITEM.drawBuyOutTime(t)
  }, S_PACKAGE_ITEM.drawBuyOutTime = function(n) {
    if (S_PACKAGE_ITEM.flag != 0) {
      var f, u = n,
        t = Math.floor(u / 36e5),
        i = Math.floor((u - t * 36e5) / 6e4),
        r = Math.floor((u - t * 36e5 - i * 6e4) / 1e3),
        e = t > 9 ? t : t == 0 ? "00" : "0" + t,
        o = i > 9 ? i : i == 0 ? "00" : "0" + i,
        s = r > 9 ? r : r == 0 ? "00" : "0" + r;
      if (f = e + ":" + o + ":" + s, n <= 0) {
        S_PACKAGE_ITEM.remain_timer != null && (clearInterval(S_PACKAGE_ITEM.remain_timer), S_PACKAGE_ITEM.remain_timer = null);
        S_PACKAGE_ITEM.buy_package_item();
        return
      }
      n > 0 && (t >= 24 ? $("#Txt_PI_remain_time").text(Math.floor(t / 24) + " " + TXT.package_remain_time) : $("#Txt_PI_remain_time").text(f));
      g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_PACKAGE_ITEM && (S_PACKAGE_ITEM.remain_timer != null && (clearInterval(S_PACKAGE_ITEM.remain_timer), S_PACKAGE_ITEM.remain_timer = null), S_PACKAGE_ITEM.remain_timer = setTimeout(S_PACKAGE_ITEM.getBuyOutTime, 1e3))
    }

  }, S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.keyDown = function(n, t) {
    var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
    switch (i) {
      case KeyDefine.left:
        if (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.row_focus == 1) S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus >= 2 && (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus--, S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.drawFocus());
        else if (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.row_focus == 2) {
          if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO) return;
          S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.btn_focus == 2 && (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.btn_focus = 1, S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.drawFocus())
        }
        break;
      case KeyDefine.right:
        if (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.row_focus == 1) S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus < DAY_DUNGEON_STEP && (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus++, S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.drawFocus());
        else if (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.row_focus == 2) {
          if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO) return;
          S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.btn_focus == 1 && (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.btn_focus = 2, S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.drawFocus())
        }
        break;
      case KeyDefine.up:
        S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.row_focus = 1;
        S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.drawFocus();
        break;
      case KeyDefine.down:
        gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO ? (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.row_focus = 2, S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.btn_focus = 1) : (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.row_focus = 2, S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.btn_focus = 2);
        S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.drawFocus();
        break;
      case KeyDefine.enter:
        S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.menuRun();
        break;
      case KeyDefine.esc:
      case KeyDefine.back:
        S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.run_back();
        break;
      case KeyDefine.space:
        if (gAPP_RELEASE != "TEST") return;
      case KeyDefine.RED:
        S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW.move_page = 6;
        gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_PERCENTAGE_SHOW, S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW) : S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW.init()
    }

S_DAYDUNGEON.pause = function() {
  var n, t;
  if (utilConsoleLog("S_DAYDUNGEON.resume()!!"), CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp <= 0) S_DAYDUNGEON.ourCastle_destroyAni();
  else if (CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp <= 0) S_DAYDUNGEON.yourCastle_destroyAni();
  else {
    if (sound_bgm_play(BGM_SOUND.INGAME), S_DAYDUNGEON.addMouseEvent(), S_DAYDUNGEON.notice_flag == 1) {
      $("#DD_board").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_DAYDUNGEON.notice_flag = 1;
      return
    }
    S_DAYDUNGEON.interval();
    S_DAYDUNGEON.start_render();
    n = S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_stop_time - S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_start_time;
    S_DAYDUNGEON.timer_autoYourTeamManager != null && (clearInterval(S_DAYDUNGEON.timer_autoYourTeamManager), S_DAYDUNGEON.timer_autoYourTeamManager = null);
    S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_remain_time = S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_remain_time - n;
    S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_remain_time < 0 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_remain_time = 0);
    S_DAYDUNGEON.timer_autoYourTeamManager = setTimeout(S_DAYDUNGEON.autoYourTeamManager_timeout, S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_remain_time);
    t = new Date;
    S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_start_time = t.getTime()
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.resume = function() {
  var n, t;
  if (utilConsoleLog("S_DAYDUNGEON.resume()!!"), CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp <= 0) S_DAYDUNGEON.ourCastle_destroyAni();
  else if (CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp <= 0) S_DAYDUNGEON.yourCastle_destroyAni();
  else {
    if (sound_bgm_play(BGM_SOUND.INGAME), S_DAYDUNGEON.addMouseEvent(), S_DAYDUNGEON.notice_flag == 1) {
      $("#DD_board").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_DAYDUNGEON.notice_flag = 1;
      return
    }
    S_DAYDUNGEON.interval();
    S_DAYDUNGEON.start_render();
    n = S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_stop_time - S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_start_time;
    S_DAYDUNGEON.timer_autoYourTeamManager != null && (clearInterval(S_DAYDUNGEON.timer_autoYourTeamManager), S_DAYDUNGEON.timer_autoYourTeamManager = null);
    S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_remain_time = S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_remain_time - n;
    S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_remain_time < 0 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_remain_time = 0);
    S_DAYDUNGEON.timer_autoYourTeamManager = setTimeout(S_DAYDUNGEON.autoYourTeamManager_timeout, S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_remain_time);
    t = new Date;
    S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_start_time = t.getTime()
  }
};

S_DAYDUNGEON.is_new_char_stage = function(n) {
  if (n < 160) return n != 1 && STAGE_DESIGN[n].char_end != STAGE_DESIGN[n - 1].char_end ? !0 : !1;
  switch (n) {
    case 161:
    case 166:
    case 169:
    case 174:
    case 176:
    case 178:
    case 181:
    case 183:
    case 186:
    case 189:
    case 192:
    case 195:
    case 198:
    case 201:
    case 202:
    case 203:
    case 205:
    case 208:
    case 210:
    case 213:
    case 214:
    case 215:
    case 220:
      return !0;
    default:
      return !1
  }
};

};

S_DAYDUNGEON.autoplay_count = 1;
S_DAYDUNGEON.autoplay_timer = null;
S_DAYDUNGEON.AutoPlay_auto = function() {
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_DAYDUNGEON) {
    switch (S_DAYDUNGEON.autoplay_count) {
      case 1:
        S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 1;
        break;
      case 2:
        S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 2;
        break;
      case 3:
        3 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 3);
        break;
      case 4:
        4 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 4);
        break;
      case 5:
        5 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 5);
        break;
      case 6:
        6 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 6);
        break;
      case 7:
        6 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 7)
    }
    S_DAYDUNGEON.focusRun();
    S_DAYDUNGEON.autoplay_count == 7 ? S_DAYDUNGEON.autoplay_count = 1 : S_DAYDUNGEON.autoplay_count++;
    S_DAYDUNGEON.autoplay_timer != null && (clearInterval(S_DAYDUNGEON.autoplay_timer), S_DAYDUNGEON.autoplay_timer = null);
    S_DAYDUNGEON.autoplay_timer = setTimeout(S_DAYDUNGEON.AutoPlay_auto, 100)
  } else S_DAYDUNGEON.autoplay_count = 1, clearInterval(S_DAYDUNGEON.autoplay_timer), S_DAYDUNGEON.autoplay_timer = null
};

S_DAYDUNGEON.focusRun = function() {
  switch (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus) {
    case 1:
      USER.missile_cur_tick >= USER.missile_full_tick && (S_GAME.effect_del("game_ui_missile"), USER.missile_cur_tick = 0, CASTLE_OUR.mode = MODE.ATTACK, S_GAME.bottom_ui.reder_missile_gage());
      break;
    case 2:
      if (USER.mineral_cur_level >= MINERAL_LEVEL_MAX) {
        utilConsoleLog("Your Mineral Level ... MAX...");
        return
      }
      USER.mineral_cur >= MINERAL_LEVEL_ARRAY[USER.mineral_cur_level].need_mineral ? (sound_play(EFF_SOUND.CHAR_CREATE), S_GAME.mineral_effect_f(), USER.mineral_cur = Math.round(USER.mineral_cur) - MINERAL_LEVEL_ARRAY[USER.mineral_cur_level].need_mineral, USER.mineral_cur_level++, S_GAME.bottom_ui.update_mineral_level(), S_GAME.bottom_ui.update_mineral_count(), S_GAME.effect_del("game_ui_mineral")) : utilConsoleLog("need more mineral.. please wait..");
      break;
    case 3:
    case 4:
    case 5:
    case 6:
    case 7:
      S_DAYDUNGEON.startUnit(S_DAYDUNGEON.focus - 2)
  }
};

S_DAYDUNGEON.autoYourTeamManager_timeout = function() {
  var n;
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_DAYDUNGEON) {
    utilConsoleLog("by pass----------");
    return
  }
  n = new Date;
  S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_start_time = n.getTime();
  var t = DAYDUNGEON_STAGE_DESIGN[DD_stage_design_index()].dd_enemy.length - 1,
    i = Math.floor(Math.random() * t + 1),
    r = DAYDUNGEON_STAGE_DESIGN[DD_stage_design_index()].dd_enemy[i];
  S_DAYDUNGEON.addYourUnit(r);
  S_DAYDUNGEON.acc_your_num++;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_DAYDUNGEON ? (S_DAYDUNGEON.timer_autoYourTeamManager != null && (clearInterval(S_DAYDUNGEON.timer_autoYourTeamManager), S_DAYDUNGEON.timer_autoYourTeamManager = null), S_DAYDUNGEON.timer_autoYourTeamManager = setTimeout(S_DAYDUNGEON.autoYourTeamManager_timeout, DAYDUNGEON_STAGE.char_interval[S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus] * TIMER_INTERVAL), S_DAYDUNGEON.your_team_remain_time = DAYDUNGEON_STAGE.char_interval[S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus] * TIMER_INTERVAL) : utilConsoleLog("Wave endded~")
};

S_DAYDUNGEON.render_raf = function() {
  if (S_GAME.render_paused && !S_GAME.done_render_raf) {
    console.log(" render_raf  S_DAYDUNGEON.start_render_num: " + S_GAME.start_render_num);
    window.requestAFrame(S_DAYDUNGEON.render_raf);
    return
  }
  S_GAME.done_render_raf || window.requestAFrame(S_DAYDUNGEON.render_raf)
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.interval = function() {
  var r = (new Date).getTime(),
    t, n, i;
  if (S_DAYDUNGEON.end_flag == 1) {
    utilConsoleLog("S_DAYDUNGEON.end_flag가 1이라서 S_DAYDUNGEON.interval() 건너뜀.");
    return
  }
  for (++S_DAYDUNGEON.count >= 1e6 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.count = 1), context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, 570), t = 1; t <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; t++) OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1 && S_DAYDUNGEON.interval_set_our_div(t);
  for (n = 1; n <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && S_DAYDUNGEON.interval_set_your_div(n);
  for (n = 1; n <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; n++) OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACK && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACKEND && (S_DAYDUNGEON.isCanIattack(n) == !1 ? (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].before_x = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + CAL.p_get_move_speed_your(n), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.MOVE, $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + n + "_fire").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + n + "_fire_pung").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + n + "_fire_img").css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_DAYDUNGEON.del_check_area_our_char(n), $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + n + "_fire_pung_img").css({
    display: "none"
  }), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur = 1, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur = 1) : OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode == MODE.MOVE ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.ATTACK : OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode == MODE.WAIT && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_speed_tick_count++ > OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_speed && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.ATTACK, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_speed_tick_count = 1, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur = 1, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur = 1));
  for (n = 1; n <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACK && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACKEND && (S_DAYDUNGEON.isCanYouattack(n) == !1 ? (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_speed == 0 || (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x - CAL.get_move_speed_your(n), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.MOVE), $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_fire").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_fire_pung").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_fire_img").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_fire_pung_img").css({
    display: "none"
  }), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur = 1, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur = 1) : YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode == MODE.MOVE ? YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.ATTACK : YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode == MODE.WAIT && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_speed_tick_count++ > YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_speed && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.ATTACK, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_speed_tick_count = 1));
  if (S_GAME.render_fever_breath_of_blue_dragon_our(), S_GAME.render_fever_breath_of_white_tiger_our(), S_GAME.render_fever_breath_of_black_tortoise_our(), S_GAME.render_fever_breath_of_vermilion_bird_our(), S_GAME.ogong_unit && (S_GAME.ogong_unit.render_fever_attack("our"), S_GAME.ogong_unit.render_fever_attack("your")), S_GAME.spirit_serpent_unit && (S_GAME.spirit_serpent_unit.render_fever_attack("our"), S_GAME.spirit_serpent_unit.render_fever_attack("your")), S_GAME.hyeono_unit && (S_GAME.hyeono_unit.render_fever_attack("our"), S_GAME.hyeono_unit.render_fever_attack("your")), S_GAME.animate_shield_102_effect(null, "our"), S_GAME.animate_reflection_effect("your"), MINERAL_LEVEL_ARRAY[USER.mineral_cur_level].max > USER.mineral_cur ? (USER.mineral_cur += CAL.get_user_mineral_gap(), S_GAME.bottom_ui.update_current_mineral(), MINERAL_LEVEL_ARRAY[USER.mineral_cur_level].need_mineral <= USER.mineral_cur && USER.mineral_cur_level != MINERAL_LEVEL_MAX && S_GAME.effect_add("game_ui_mineral")) : (USER.mineral_cur = MINERAL_LEVEL_ARRAY[USER.mineral_cur_level].max, S_GAME.bottom_ui.update_current_mineral()), S_DAYDUNGEON.count % COUNT_BOTTOM_EFFECT == 0 && S_GAME.bottom_effect_interval(), S_DAYDUNGEON.count % COUNT_CHARGE == 0)
    for (n = 1; n <= USER.socket_available_num; n++) OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].ch_time >= OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].need_ch_time ? OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].ch_time = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].need_ch_time : (OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].ch_time++, OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].ch_time == OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].need_ch_time && sound_play(EFF_SOUND.MINERAL_FULL), S_GAME.bottom_ui.draw_one_char_gage(n));
  S_DAYDUNGEON.count % COUNT_SCROLL == 0 && (i = S_GAME.where_scroll(), i > 0 && S_GAME.scroll_part(i), S_DAYDUNGEON.enemy_flag.enemy_49_51_53 = 0);
  RASER.flag == 1 && S_DAYDUNGEON.fireRaser_interval();
  RASER_STAGE.flag == 1 && S_DAYDUNGEON.fireRaser_interval_stage();
  S_DAYDUNGEON.count % COUNT_MISSILE_STAGE == 0 && (USER.missile_cur_tick_stage = USER.missile_cur_tick_stage + USER.missile_full_tick_stage / 10, USER.missile_cur_tick_stage >= USER.missile_full_tick_stage && (sound_play(EFF_SOUND.MINERAL_FULL), USER.missile_cur_tick_stage = 0, CASTLE_YOUR.mode = MODE.ATTACK));
  S_DAYDUNGEON.count % COUNT_MISSILE == 0 && (USER.missile_cur_tick = USER.missile_cur_tick + USER.missile_full_tick / 10, S_GAME.bottom_ui.reder_missile_gage(), USER.missile_cur_tick >= USER.missile_full_tick && (S_GAME.effect_add("game_ui_missile"), USER.missile_cur_tick == USER.missile_full_tick && sound_play(EFF_SOUND.MINERAL_FULL)));
  S_DAYDUNGEON.count % COUNT_CASTLE == 0 && (CASTLE_OUR.mode == MODE.WAIT && CASTLE_OUR.mode_before == MODE.WAIT || S_DAYDUNGEON.drawCastle_our(), CASTLE_YOUR.mode == MODE.WAIT && CASTLE_YOUR.mode_before == MODE.WAIT || S_DAYDUNGEON.drawCastle_your());
  S_DAYDUNGEON.count % 40 == 0 && check_currentTime();
  S_DAYDUNGEON.drawMission();
  S_DAYDUNGEON.timer_interval != null && (clearInterval(S_DAYDUNGEON.timer_interval), S_DAYDUNGEON.timer_interval = null);
  S_DAYDUNGEON.timer_interval = setTimeout(S_DAYDUNGEON.interval, TIMER_INTERVAL)
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.mineral_effect_f = function() {
  S_DAYDUNGEON.mineral_effect.flag == 1 && (clearInterval(S_DAYDUNGEON.mineral_effect.timer), S_DAYDUNGEON.mineral_effect.cur_frame = 1);
  S_DAYDUNGEON.mineral_effect.flag = 1;
  var n = function() {
    S_DAYDUNGEON.mineral_effect.cur_frame <= S_DAYDUNGEON.mineral_effect.max_frame ? (S_GAME.bottom_ui.reder_mineral_effect(), S_DAYDUNGEON.mineral_effect.cur_frame++, S_DAYDUNGEON.mineral_effect.timer != null && (clearInterval(S_DAYDUNGEON.mineral_effect.timer), S_DAYDUNGEON.mineral_effect.timer = null), S_DAYDUNGEON.mineral_effect.timer = setTimeout(n, TIMER_INTERVAL)) : (S_DAYDUNGEON.mineral_effect.cur_frame = 1, S_DAYDUNGEON.mineral_effect.flag = 0, S_GAME.bottom_ui.hide_mineral_effect())
  };
  n()
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.isCanIattack = function(n) {
  var r = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num,
    o = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power,
    t = S_DAYDUNGEON.getYou_firt_one(),
    a, s, h, f, i, c, u, l, e;
  if (S_GAME.is_koo_char(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num) && (t = 0), t != 0 && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1 && (a = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num, s = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x - (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w), s <= OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len)) {
    if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_num = t, S_DAYDUNGEON.isCanIattack_fireAni(n, t), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur == OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_num && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACK && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACKEND)
      if (h = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp, f = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num].hp / 2, CHAR_OUR_TEAM[r].attack_type == ATTACK_TYPE.WIDE || CHAR_OUR_TEAM[r].attack_type == ATTACK_TYPE.HIT_WIDE || CHAR_OUR_TEAM[r].attack_type == ATTACK_TYPE.FULL_WIDE) S_DAYDUNGEON.featureWideOur(n);
      else if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - o, h >= f && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp < f && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].flag_hp_half = 1), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp <= 0)
      for (S_DAYDUNGEON.die_by_our_attack(t, n), i = 1; i <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; i++) OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].attack_num == t && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].attack_num = 0, $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + i + "_fire").css({
        display: "none"
      }), $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + i + "_fire_pung").css({
        display: "none"
      }), $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + i + "_fire_img").css({
        display: "none"
      }), S_DAYDUNGEON.del_check_area_our_char(t), $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + i + "_fire_pung_img").css({
        display: "none"
      }));
    return OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur == OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_num && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1 && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].flag_hp_half == 1 && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode == MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACK || YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode == MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACKEND || (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED, $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + t + "_fire").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + t + "_fire_pung").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + n + "_fire").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + n + "_fire_pung").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + n + "_fire_img").css({
      display: "none"
    }), S_DAYDUNGEON.del_check_area_our_char(n), $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + n + "_fire_pung_img").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + t + "_fire_img").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + t + "_fire_pung_img").css({
      display: "none"
    })), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].flag_hp_half = 0), !0
  }
  return (c = CASTLE_YOUR.baseX - (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w), c <= OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len) ? (S_DAYDUNGEON.isCanIattack_fireAni(n, -1), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur == OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_num ? (u = o, (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day == 2 || S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day === 7) && (u = 0), S_GAME.has_innate_ability("our", r, INNATE_ABILITY.MULTI_HIT) && (l = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].socket_index, e = S_GAME.special_ability.get_index_value(r, l, "our", "multi_hit_count"), e > 1 && (u = u * e)), CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp = Math.floor(CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp - u), CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp <= 0) ? (CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp = 0, document.getElementById("Txt_DD_your_castle").innerHTML = Math.floor(CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp) + " / " + CASTLE_YOUR.max_hp, CASTLE_YOUR.mode = MODE.DESTROY, S_DAYDUNGEON.drawCastle_your(), S_DAYDUNGEON.yourCastle_destroyAni(), !1) : (CASTLE_YOUR.mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED, document.getElementById("Txt_DD_your_castle").innerHTML = Math.floor(CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp) + " / " + CASTLE_YOUR.max_hp, !0) : !0) : !1
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.die_by_our_attack = function(n, t) {
  S_DAYDUNGEON.sunday_mission_check();
  S_DAYDUNGEON.acc_your_num--;
  YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED;
  YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].bluedragon_dot_damage_ms = 0;
  S_DAYDUNGEON.yourunit_display_none(n);
  t > 0 && ($("#Img_DD_our_unit" + t + "_fire").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + t + "_fire_pung").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + t + "_fire_img").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + t + "_fire_pung_img").css({
    display: "none"
  }))
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.die_by_your_attack = function(n, t) {
  USER.bekilled++;
  S_DAYDUNGEON.del_check_area_our_char(n);
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.CHAR_DIE);
  OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED;
  OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].shield_102_time = 0;
  S_DAYDUNGEON.ourunit_display_none(n);
  t > 0 && ($("#Img_DD_your_unit" + t + "_fire").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + t + "_fire_pung").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + t + "_fire_img").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + t + "_fire_pung_img").css({
    display: "none"
  }));
  S_DAYDUNGEON.drawOurTeamNumber()
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.featureWideOur = function(n) {
  for (var a, f, e, v, r, y, o, d = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 1), i = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num, s = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power, t = 1; t <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; t++)
    if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1) {
      var p = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x - (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w),
        w = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp,
        h = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num].hp / 2,
        u = !1;
      if (CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_type == ATTACK_TYPE.HIT_WIDE) {
        var c = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_center_x,
          l = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_half_width,
          b = c - l,
          k = c + l;
        YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x >= b && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x <= k && (u = !0)
      } else p <= OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len + 100 && (u = !0);
      if (u) {
        if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - s, S_GAME.has_innate_ability("our", i, INNATE_ABILITY.MULTI_HIT) && (a = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].socket_index, f = S_GAME.special_ability.get_index_value(i, a, "our", "multi_hit_count"), f > 1))
          for (e = 1; e < f; e++) {
            if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive != 1 || YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp <= 0) break;
            YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - s
          }
        w >= h && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp < h && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].flag_hp_half = 1);
        YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp <= 0 && S_DAYDUNGEON.die_by_our_attack(t, n)
      }
    } if (v = CASTLE_YOUR.baseX - (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w), v <= OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len + 50) {
    if (S_GAME.is_sky_garden_mode() || (r = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power, (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day == 2 || S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day === 7) && (r = 0), S_GAME.has_innate_ability("our", i, INNATE_ABILITY.MULTI_HIT) && (y = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].socket_index, o = S_GAME.special_ability.get_index_value(i, y, "our", "multi_hit_count"), o > 1 && (r = r * o)), CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp = Math.floor(CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp - r)), CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp <= 0) {
      CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp = 0;
      document.getElementById("Txt_DD_your_castle").innerHTML = Math.floor(CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp) + " / " + CASTLE_YOUR.max_hp;
      CASTLE_YOUR.mode = MODE.DESTROY;
      S_DAYDUNGEON.drawCastle_your();
      S_DAYDUNGEON.yourCastle_destroyAni();
      return
    }
    CASTLE_YOUR.mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED;
    document.getElementById("Txt_DD_your_castle").innerHTML = Math.floor(CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp) + " / " + CASTLE_YOUR.max_hp
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.getYou_firt_one = function() {
  for (var t = 0, i = 2e3, n = 1; n <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && i > YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x && (i = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, t = n);
  return t
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.featureWideYour = function(n) {
  for (var i, r, h = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 1), t = 1; t <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; t++)
    if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1) {
      var f = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x - (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].w),
        e = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp,
        o = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].socket_index,
        s = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[o].hp,
        u = s / 2;
      if (f <= YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len + 100) {
        if (i = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num, S_GAME.is_koo_char(i)) continue;
        S_GAME.has_special_ability("our", i, SPECIAL_ABILITY.ARMOR) ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].shield_102_time == 0 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - 1) : S_GAME.has_innate_ability("our", i, INNATE_ABILITY.ARMOR) ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].shield_102_time == 0 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - 1) : (r = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].shield_102_time == 0 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - r));
        S_GAME.apply_reflection_buff(t, n, r, "your");
        e >= u && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp < u && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].flag_hp_half = 1);
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp <= 0 && S_DAYDUNGEON.die_by_your_attack(t, n)
      }
    }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.win = function() {};

OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].shield_102_time == 0 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - 1) : (f = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].shield_102_time == 0 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - f)), S_GAME.apply_reflection_buff(t, n, f, "your"), h >= s && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp < s && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].flag_hp_half = 1), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp <= 0)

          display: "none"
        }), $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + t + "_fire_pung").css({
          display: "none"
        }), $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + t + "_fire_img").css({
          display: "none"
        }), S_DAYDUNGEON.del_check_area_our_char(t), $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + t + "_fire_pung_img").css({
          display: "none"
        }), $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_fire").css({
          display: "none"
        }), $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_fire_pung").css({
          display: "none"
        }), $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_fire_img").css({
          display: "none"
        }), $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_fire_pung_img").css({
          display: "none"
        }), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].flag_hp_half = 0) : $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + t).css({
          opacity: "1.0",
          "-webkit-transform": "rotate(0deg) scale(1.0,1.0)"
        }), !0
      }
    } if (e = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x - CASTLE_OUR.baseX, e <= YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len || YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode == MODE.ATTACK) {
    if (S_DAYDUNGEON.isCanYouattack_fireAni(n), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur == YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_num && e <= Math.abs(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len)) {
      if (CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp = Math.floor(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp - YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power), CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp <= 0) {
        CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp = 0;
        document.getElementById("Txt_DD_our_castle").innerHTML = Math.floor(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp) + " / " + CASTLE_OUR.max_hp;
        S_DAYDUNGEON.ourCastle_destroyAni();
        return
      }
      return CASTLE_OUR.mode == MODE.ATTACK ? utilConsoleLog("==미사일 계속 발사하게 내 버려 두라~~") : CASTLE_OUR.mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED, document.getElementById("Txt_DD_our_castle").innerHTML = Math.floor(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp) + " / " + CASTLE_OUR.max_hp, !0
    }
    return !0
  }
  return !1
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.drawCastle_our = function() {
  var n = null,
    i, r, t;
  CASTLE_OUR.mode_before = CASTLE_OUR.mode;
  switch (CASTLE_OUR.mode) {
    case MODE.DESTROY:
      n = "_destroy";
      break;
    case MODE.WAIT:
      n = "_wait";
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:
      i = CAL.get_our_castle_level();
      r = i <= 3 ? 4 : 6;
      n = "_attack_" + CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_attack;
      CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_attack >= r ? (CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_attack = 1, S_DAYDUNGEON.fireRaser(), CASTLE_OUR.mode = MODE.WAIT) : CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_attack++;
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED:
      switch (CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_beattack) {
        case 1:
          n = "_beattack_1";
          CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_beattack = 2;
          break;
        case 2:
          n = "_beattack_2";
          CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_beattack = 1;
          CASTLE_OUR.mode = MODE.WAIT
      }
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_DAYDUNGEON.drawCastle_our()");
      return
  }
  S_GAME.is_sky_garden_mode() ? (t = RANKING_STAGE_DESIGN.castle_our_filename + n + ".png", utilDrawImage_no_wh("Img_DD_our_castle", t, CASTLE_OUR.x, CASTLE_OUR.y, "absolute")) : (t = STAGE_DESIGN[S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day].castle_our_filename + n + ".png", utilDrawImage_no_wh("Img_DD_our_castle", t, CASTLE_OUR.x, CASTLE_OUR.y, "absolute"))
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.drawCastle_your = function() {
  var n = null,
    t, i;
  CASTLE_YOUR.mode_before = CASTLE_YOUR.mode;
  switch (CASTLE_YOUR.mode) {
    case MODE.DESTROY:
      n = "_destroy";
      break;
    case MODE.WAIT:
      n = "_wait";
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:
      n = "_attack_";
      t = 4;
      n = "_attack_" + CASTLE_YOUR.cur_frame_attack;
      CASTLE_YOUR.cur_frame_attack >= t ? (CASTLE_YOUR.cur_frame_attack = 1, S_DAYDUNGEON.fireRaser_stage(), CASTLE_YOUR.mode = MODE.WAIT) : CASTLE_YOUR.cur_frame_attack++;
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED:
      n = "_beattack_";
      switch (CASTLE_YOUR.cur_frame_beattack) {
        case 1:
          n = "_beattack_1";
          CASTLE_YOUR.cur_frame_beattack = 2;
          break;
        case 2:
          n = "_beattack_2";
          CASTLE_YOUR.cur_frame_beattack = 1;
          CASTLE_YOUR.mode = MODE.WAIT
      }
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_DAYDUNGEON.drawCastle_our()");
      return
  }
  i = glo.img_url + "image/castle/" + STAGE_DESIGN[S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day].castle_your_filename + n + ".png";
  utilDrawImage_no_wh("Img_DD_your_castle", i, CASTLE_YOUR.x, CASTLE_YOUR.y, "absolute")
};
