S_DAYDUNGEON.get_your_socket_index = function(n) {
  for (var i = DAYDUNGEON_STAGE_DESIGN[DD_stage_design_index()].dd_enemy.length - 1, t = 1; t <= i; t++)
    if (LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].unit_num == n) return t;
  return utilConsoleLog("Error in S_DAYDUNGEON.get_your_socket_index():" + n), 0
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.addYourUnit = function(n) {
  for (var i = 0, t = 1; t <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; t++)
    if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 0) {
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num = n;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].index = t;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive = 1;
      utilConsoleLog("---->unit_num=" + n);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].socket_index = S_DAYDUNGEON.get_your_socket_index(n);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x = CASTLE_YOUR.x - DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].w + DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].beattack_margine;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].y = GAME_BASE_Y - DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].h;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].name = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].name;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].filename = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].filename;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].feature = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].feature;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].star = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].star;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].need_mineral = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].need_mineral;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].attack_speed = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].attack_speed;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].attack_power = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].attack_power;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].hp;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].full_hp = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].hp;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].attack_len = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].attack_len == ATTACK_LEN.VL ? DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].attack_len + Math.round(Math.random() * 2) - 4 : DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].attack_len + Math.round(Math.random() * 5) * 8 - 20;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_speed = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].move_speed;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].w = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].w;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].h = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].h;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_frame_num = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].move_frame_num;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].attack_frame_num = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].attack_frame_num;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].beattack_frame_num = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].beattack_frame_num;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].attack_fire_frame = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].attack_fire_frame;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].fire_frame_num = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].fire_frame_num;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].missile_gap_x = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].missile_gap_x;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].missile_gap_y = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].missile_gap_y;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].max_level = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[n].max_level;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode = MODE.MOVE;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_frame_cur = 1;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].attack_frame_cur = 1;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].beattack_frame_cur = 1;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].fire_frame_cur = 1;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].wait_frame_cur = 1;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].bluedragon_dot_damage_ms = 0;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].dot_damage_cur_frame = 1;
      i = 1;
      break
    } i == 0 && utilConsoleLog("Full.. please upgrade your  MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN value")
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.get_dd_enemy_castle_hp = function() {
  var n = 0;
  switch (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day) {
    case 1:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 1 ? n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(10) : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 2 ? n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(30) : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 3 && (n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(100));
      break;
    case 2:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 1 ? n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(30) : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 2 ? n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(100) : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 3 && (n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(220));
      break;
    case 3:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 1 ? n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(30) : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 2 ? n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(100) : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 3 && (n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(200));
      break;
    case 4:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 1 ? n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(30) : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 2 ? n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(70) : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 3 && (n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(150));
      break;
    case 5:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 1 ? n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(30) : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 2 ? n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(100) : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 3 && (n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(220));
      break;
    case 6:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 1 ? n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(30) : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 2 ? n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(100) : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 3 && (n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(180));
      break;
    case 7:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 1 ? n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(30) : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 2 ? n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(100) : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 3 && (n = CAL.get_enemy_castle_hp(180))
  }
  return n
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.sunday_mission_check = function() {
  if (S_DAYDUNGEON.end_flag == 1) {
    utilConsoleLog("게임이 종료되어 성이 터지고 있다 .");
    return
  }
  S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day == 7 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.sunday_mission_num--, S_DAYDUNGEON.sunday_mission_num <= 0 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.sunday_mission_num = 0), USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? $("#Txt_DD_mission_num").text(S_DAYDUNGEON.sunday_mission_num + "마리") : $("#Txt_DD_mission_num").text("Kill " + S_DAYDUNGEON.sunday_mission_num), S_DAYDUNGEON.sunday_mission_num <= 0 && (CASTLE_YOUR.mode = MODE.DESTROY, S_DAYDUNGEON.drawCastle_your(), S_DAYDUNGEON.yourCastle_destroyAni()))
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.drawMission = function() {
  if (S_DAYDUNGEON.end_flag == 1) {
    utilConsoleLog("게임이 끝났으니 더이상 그리지 말자");
    return
  }
  S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day == 2 || S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day == 7 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.mission_img_count <= 2 ? utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("DD_mission_img", glo.img_url + "image/ui/26_daydungeon/mission/dd_game_monster_icon_1.png", 569, 6) : S_DAYDUNGEON.mission_img_count <= 4 && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("DD_mission_img", glo.img_url + "image/ui/26_daydungeon/mission/dd_game_monster_icon_2.png", 569, 6), S_DAYDUNGEON.mission_img_count == 4 ? S_DAYDUNGEON.mission_img_count = 1 : S_DAYDUNGEON.mission_img_count++)
};

        setTimeout(t, 500)
      }
    };
  t()
};

S_DAYDUNGEON.interval_set_our_div = function(n) {
  var i = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num,
    f, u, r, t;
  switch (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode) {
    case MODE.WAIT:
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur++;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur > CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].wait_frame_num && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur = 1);
      break;
    case MODE.MOVE:
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur++;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur > CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].move_frame_num && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur = 1);
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:
      if (i == 106 && S_DAYDUNGEON.end_flag == 1) {
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1;
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.WAIT;
        break
      }
      if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur++, S_GAME.is_koo_char(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num) && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur > CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_fire_frame && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_frame_num, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x += DEFINE.COW_MOVE_SPEED), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur > CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_frame_num && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.WAIT, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1), S_GAME.set_normal_attcak_count_of_four_gods(i, n, "our"), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur == OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_fire_frame) switch (i) {
        case 27:
        case 28:
        case 43:
        case 44:
        case 45:
        case 46:
          var e = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w - 10,
            o = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].h / 2,
            s = e - 52,
            h = o - 52;
          S_GAME.our_char_pung(n, s, h)
      }
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED:
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur++;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur > CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].beattack_frame_num && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1);
      switch (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur) {
        case 1:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 10;
          break;
        case 2:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 10;
          break;
        case 3:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 8;
          break;
        case 4:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 8;
          break;
        case 5:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 3;
          break;
        case 6:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 1
      }
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 114 ? (f = CASTLE_OUR.baseX + CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].game_gap_x, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x < f && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = f)) : OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x < CASTLE_OUR.baseX && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].game_gap_x !== undefined ? CASTLE_OUR.baseX + CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].game_gap_x : CASTLE_OUR.baseX)
  }
  r = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].socket_index;
  switch (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode) {
    case MODE.MOVE:
      u = LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[r].MOVE[OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur];
      break;
    case MODE.WAIT:
      u = LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[r].WAIT[OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur];
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:
      u = LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[r].ATTACK[OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur];
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACKEND:
      u = S_GAME.is_koo_char(i) ? LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[r].BEATTACK[1] : LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[r].BEATTACK[CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].beattack_frame_num];
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED:
      u = S_GAME.is_koo_char(i) ? LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[r].BEATTACK[1] : LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[r].BEATTACK[OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur];
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error!! in S_DAYDUNGEON.interval_set_our_div 34523423 :" + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode)
  }
  if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode == MODE.ATTACK && i == 50) {
    if (t = 0, gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT) switch (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur) {

        t = 87;
        break;

        t = 0
    } else switch (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur) {
      case 1:
        t = 0;
        break;
      case 2:
        t = -10;
        break;
      case 3:

  } else context.drawImage(u, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].h);

S_DAYDUNGEON.interval_set_your_div = function(n) {
  var l, a, h = null,
    r = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num,
    e, u, t, i, c, o, s, f;
  h = glo.img_url + "image/char/" + DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[r].dirname + "/";
  e = DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN;
  l = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w + "px";
  a = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].h + "px";
  u = null;
  switch (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode) {
    case MODE.WAIT:
      u = "wait_" + (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur + 10);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur++;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur > e[r].wait_frame_num && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur = 1);
      break;
    case MODE.MOVE:
      u = "move_" + (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur + 10);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur++;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur > e[r].move_frame_num && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur = 1);
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:
      u = "attack_" + (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur + 10);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur++;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur > e[r].attack_frame_num && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.WAIT, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1);
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED:
      u = "beattack_" + (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur + 10);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur++;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur > e[r].beattack_frame_num && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1);
      switch (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur) {
        case 1:
          YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x += 6;
          break;
        case 2:
          YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x += 6;
          break;
        case 3:
          YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x += 6;
          break;
        case 4:
          YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x += 3;
          break;
        case 5:
          YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x += 3;
          break;
        case 6:
          YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x += 1
      }
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w / 2 > CASTLE_YOUR.baseX && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = CASTLE_YOUR.baseX - YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w / 2)
  }
  i = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].socket_index;
  switch (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode) {
    case MODE.MOVE:
      c = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur;
      t = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[i].MOVE[c];
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error! in S_DAYDUNGEON.interval_set_your_div() 08990348 :" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode);
    case MODE.WAIT:
      t = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[i].WAIT[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur];
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:
      t = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[i].ATTACK[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur];
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED:
      t = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[i].BEATTACK[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur];
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACK:
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACKEND:
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur > YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_num ? (o = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_num - YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur, o = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur % 3, t = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[i].BEATTACK[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_num - o]) : t = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[i].BEATTACK[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur]
  }
  switch (r) {
    case 16:
    case 17:
    case 18:
      document.getElementById("Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_img") == null && (s = document.getElementById("S_daydungeon_center"), f = document.createElement("img"), f.id = "Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_img", s.appendChild(f), f = document.createElement("img"), f.id = "Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_reflection", s.appendChild(f));
      $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_img").css({
        display: "block"
      });
      utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_img", h + u + ".png", YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y + 15);
      break;
    default:
      context.drawImage(t, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].h)
  }
  YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode == MODE.BE_ATTACKED && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur == 1 && ($("#Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_fire").css({
    display: "none"
  }), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.MOVE, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur = 1, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp <= 0 && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive = 0, $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_fire").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_fire_pung").css({
    display: "none"
  }), document.getElementById("Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_img") != null && $("#Img_DD_your_unit" + n + "_img").css({
    display: "none"
  })));
  S_GAME.animate_blue_dragon_dot_damage("your", n);
  YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp > 0 && S_DAYDUNGEON.hp_bar_update_your(n)
};

S_DAYDUNGEON.add_check_area = function(n, t) {
  if (CHECK_AREA_count + 1 > MAX_OUR_TEAM_UNIT) {
    utilConsoleLog("Error in S_DAYDUNGEON.add_check_area():" + CHECK_AREA_count + 1 + "--이게 full찰리가 없는데..");
    return
  }
  CHECK_AREA[CHECK_AREA_count + 1].x1 = n;
  CHECK_AREA[CHECK_AREA_count + 1].x2 = t;
  CHECK_AREA_count++
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.del_check_area = function() {
  if (CHECK_AREA_count <= 0) {
    utilConsoleLog("S_DAYDUNGEON.del_check_area() : 여기서 0 이 될리가 없는데..." + CHECK_AREA_count);
    return
  }
  for (var n = 1; n <= CHECK_AREA_count - 1; n++) CHECK_AREA[n].x1 = CHECK_AREA[n + 1].x1, CHECK_AREA[n].x2 = CHECK_AREA[n + 1].x2;
  CHECK_AREA[CHECK_AREA_count].x1 = CHECK_AREA[CHECK_AREA_count].x2 = 0;
  CHECK_AREA_count--;
  return
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.del_check_area_our_char = function(n) {
  if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 40) {
    var t = $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + n + "_fire_pung_img").css("display");
    t == "block" && S_DAYDUNGEON.del_check_area()
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.is_check_area = function(n) {
  if (check_ability_stage()) {
    for (var t = 1; t <= CHECK_AREA_count; t++)
      if (CHECK_AREA[t].x1 <= n && n <= CHECK_AREA[t].x2) return !0;
    return !1
  }
  return !1
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.char49_heal_run = function(n, t) {
  var i = 10,
    r;
  if (n == 49 || n == 87) switch (t) {
    case 80:
      i = 10;
      break;
    case 85:
      i = 20;
      break;
    case 90:
      i = 30;
      break;
    case 95:
      i = 40;
      break;
    case 100:
      i = 50;
      break;
    case 105:
      i = 55;
      break;
    case 110:
      i = 60;
      break;
    default:
      i = 10
  } else if (n == 109) switch (t) {
    case 100:
      i = 30;
      break;
    case 105:
      i = 45;
      break;
    case 110:
      i = 50;
      break;
    case 115:
      i = 55;
      break;
    case 120:
      i = 60;
      break;
    default:
      i = 30
  }
  for (r = 1; r <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; r++)
    if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[r].alive == 1) {
      if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[r].unit_num == 49 || OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[r].unit_num == 87) continue;
      var f = S_DAYDUNGEON.get_index_using_unit_num(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[r].unit_num),
        u = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[f].hp,
        e = Math.floor(u * i / 100);
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[r].hp = Math.min(u, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[r].hp + e)
    }
};

      break;
    case 115:
      i = 55;
      break;
    case 120:
      i = 60;
      break;
    default:
      i = 30
  }
  for (r = 1; r <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; r++)
    if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[r].alive == 1) {
      if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[r].unit_num == 49 || YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[r].unit_num == 87) continue;
      var u = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[r].socket_index,
        f = CAL.get_char_hp_NPC(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[r].unit_num, USER_NPC.char[u].cur_level, u),
        e = Math.floor(f * i / 100);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[r].hp = Math.min(f, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[r].hp + e)
    }
};

          h = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y - bi,
          w = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].socket_index,
          ti = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur,
          v = LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[w].FIRE[ti],
          c;
        ti <= cr ? (tr = ti / cr, c = ni + (ht - ni) * tr - i / 2) : c = ht - i / 2;
        context.drawImage(v, 0, 0, i, u, c, h, i, u);
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur++;
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur > tt.fire_img_frame_num && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur = 1);
        return;
      default:
        utilConsoleLog("Error in S_DAYDUNGEON.isCanIattack() .. undefined unit num:" + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num)
    }
  } else S_DAYDUNGEON.$el.our_unit && S_DAYDUNGEON.$el.our_unit[n] && S_DAYDUNGEON.$el.our_unit[n].fire_pung.css({
    display: "none"
  })
};

S_DAYDUNGEON.ourCastle_destroyAni = function() {
  if (S_DAYDUNGEON.end_flag == 1) {
    utilConsoleLog("폭파중에 연속공격 받아 또 폭파 되는 것이다. 그래서 폭파 건너뜀.");
    return
  }
  S_DAYDUNGEON.end_flag = 1;
  for (var n = 1; n <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.end_DD_hp = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].hp, n = MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + 1);
  gEnableKey = 0;
  CASTLE_OUR.destroy = {
    cur: 0,
    end: 10
  };
  S_DAYDUNGEON.end();
  S_DAYDUNGEON.ourCastle_destroyAni_1()
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.ourCastle_destroyAni_1 = function() {
  var n, t;
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_EXITPOPUP) {
    switch (CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_beattack) {
      case 1:
        n = "_beattack_1";
        CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_beattack = 2;
        break;
      case 2:
      default:
        n = "_beattack_2";
        CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_beattack = 1;
        CASTLE_OUR.destroy.cur++
    }
    if (t = STAGE_DESIGN[S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day].castle_our_filename + n + ".png", utilDrawImage_no_wh$(S_DAYDUNGEON.$el.our_castle, t, CASTLE_OUR.x, CASTLE_OUR.y, "absolute"), CASTLE_OUR.destroy.cur < CASTLE_OUR.destroy.end) setTimeout(S_DAYDUNGEON.ourCastle_destroyAni_1, TIMER_INTERVAL);
    else {
      CASTLE_OUR.mode = MODE.DESTROY;
      S_DAYDUNGEON.drawCastle_our();
      S_DAYDUNGEON.ourCastle_destroyAni_effect();
      return
    }
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.ourCastle_destroyAni_effect = function() {
  var n = 1,
    u = 8,
    t = null,
    i = null,
    r;
  $("#Img_DD_castle_destroy_effect").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  r = function() {
    if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_EXITPOPUP)
      if (n <= u) {
        var f = "./image/ui/98_effect/homedestroyEffect_" + n + ".png";
        utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_DD_castle_destroy_effect", f, CASTLE_OUR.x - 58, CASTLE_OUR.y - 56);
        $("#Img_DD_castle_destroy_effect").css({
          opacity: (u - n + 3) / 10
        });
        i != null && (clearInterval(i), i = null);
        i = setTimeout(r, TIMER_INTERVAL);
        n++
      } else t != null && (clearInterval(t), t = null), t = setTimeout(function() {
        (S_DAYDUNGEON.end(), S_DAYDUNGEON.end_memory_free(), g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_EXITPOPUP) && ($("#Img_DD_castle_destroy_effect").css({
          display: "none"
        }), gEnableKey = 1, ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL, S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL))
      }, 300)
  };
  r()
};

S_DAYDUNGEON.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  if (S_DAYDUNGEON.board.flag == 1) switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_DAYDUNGEON.focusRun_board();
      $("#S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT_div").hide()
  } else switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_DAYDUNGEON.run_zoom();
      return;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_DAYDUNGEON.run_metor();
      return;
    case KeyDefine.back:
    case KeyDefine.esc:
      S_DAYDUNGEON.run_back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_DAYDUNGEON.focus == S_GAME.bottom_ui.get_max_btn() ? (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus--, S_DAYDUNGEON.drawFocus()) : S_DAYDUNGEON.focus >= 2 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus--, S_DAYDUNGEON.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_DAYDUNGEON.focusRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_DAYDUNGEON.focus < USER.socket_available_num + 2 ? (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus++, S_DAYDUNGEON.drawFocus()) : S_DAYDUNGEON.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      3 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 3, S_DAYDUNGEON.drawFocus(), S_DAYDUNGEON.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      4 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 4, S_DAYDUNGEON.drawFocus(), S_DAYDUNGEON.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
      5 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 5, S_DAYDUNGEON.drawFocus(), S_DAYDUNGEON.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM4:
      6 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 6, S_DAYDUNGEON.drawFocus(), S_DAYDUNGEON.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM5:
      7 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 7, S_DAYDUNGEON.drawFocus(), S_DAYDUNGEON.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.RED:
    case KeyDefine.A:
      S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 1;
      S_DAYDUNGEON.drawFocus();
      S_DAYDUNGEON.focusRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.GREEN:
    case KeyDefine.S:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.KT && (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 2, S_DAYDUNGEON.drawFocus(), S_DAYDUNGEON.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.BLUE:
      (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB) && (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 2, S_DAYDUNGEON.drawFocus(), S_DAYDUNGEON.focusRun())
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_DAYDUNGEON.backKey()
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.backKey = function() {
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || S_DAYDUNGEON.board.flag != 1) && (S_DAYDUNGEON.end(), utilPush(), S_POPUPYN.focus = 2, gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").css({
    display: "block"
  }), S_POPUPYN.init()) : (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) && ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN))
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.run_metor = function() {
  S_DAYDUNGEON.metor_num > 0 ? (gEnableKey = 0, sound_play(EFF_SOUND.METOR), S_GAME.effect_meteor(), S_DAYDUNGEON.metor_num--, S_GAME.top_ui.update_metor_num(S_DAYDUNGEON.metor_num)) : utilNotice(TXT.metor_only_one, 1.5)
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.run_zoom = function() {
  if (!(DAYDUNGEON_STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day][S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus] <= 1280))
    if (S_DAYDUNGEON.zoom_flag == 0) {
      if (utilNotice(TXT.zoomout, 1.2), SCROLL.flag == 1) return;
      if (S_DAYDUNGEON.view_mode != 1) return;
      S_DAYDUNGEON.modeChange_m();
      S_GAME.top_ui.show_zoom_out();
      setTimeout(function() {
        S_DAYDUNGEON.zoom_flag = 1
      }, 1e3)
    } else utilNotice(TXT.zoomin, 1.2), S_GAME.top_ui.show_zoom_in(), S_DAYDUNGEON.view_mode = 1, $("#S_daydungeon_center").css({
      left: "0px",
      top: "0px",
      width: "1280px",
      height: "720px",
      position: "absolute"
    }), utilConsoleLog("View mode 작동=====> " + S_DAYDUNGEON.view_mode), utilScale_xy("S_daydungeon_center", S_DAYDUNGEON.view_mode, S_DAYDUNGEON.view_mode), SCROLL.part_cur_num = 1, setTimeout(function() {
      S_DAYDUNGEON.zoom_flag = 0
    }, 1e3)
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_DAYDUNGEON.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    if (S_DAYDUNGEON.board.flag == 1) {
      S_DAYDUNGEON.focusRun_board();
      return
    }
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("metor") >= 0 ? S_DAYDUNGEON.run_metor() : t.id.search("zoom") >= 0 ? S_DAYDUNGEON.run_zoom() : t.id.search("back") >= 0 ? S_DAYDUNGEON.run_back() : S_DAYDUNGEON.focusRun()
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.onMouseover = function(n) {
  var r, t, i;
  if (gMOUSE_USE) {
    for (r = null, t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search(S_GAME.bottom_ui.get_missile_id()) >= 0 ? (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 1, S_DAYDUNGEON.drawFocus()) : t.id.search(S_GAME.bottom_ui.get_mineral_id()) >= 0 ? (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = 2, S_DAYDUNGEON.drawFocus()) : t.id.search(S_GAME.bottom_ui.get_char_id()) >= 0 && (i = glo.fun.get_only_number_by_text(t.id), USER.socket_available_num >= i && (S_DAYDUNGEON.focus = i + 2), S_DAYDUNGEON.drawFocus())
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_DAYDUNGEON.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_DAYDUNGEON.onMouseover(n)
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_DAYDUNGEON.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_DAYDUNGEON.onMouseover(n);
  S_DAYDUNGEON.onClick(n)
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.get_missile_level = function() {
  return S_GAME.get_missile_level()
};
your_raser_beattacked = [];
S_DAYDUNGEON.fireRaser = function() {
  var i, t, n, r, u;
  if (RASER.flag == 1) {
    utilConsoleLog("Can not fire because firing....");
    return
  }
  for (RASER.baseX = CASTLE_OUR.x + STAGE_DESIGN[S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day].nose_x, RASER.baseY = CASTLE_OUR.y + STAGE_DESIGN[S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day].nose_y, RASER.target_start_x = STAGE_DESIGN[S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day].castle_our_w, RASER.target_end_x = Math.min(USER.missile_len, STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day]), RASER.old_x = CASTLE_OUR.x, RASER.w = $("#Img_DD_missile").width(), RASER.h = $("#Img_DD_missile").height(), i = DAYDUNGEON_STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day][S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus], n = 1; n <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && (i = Math.min(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w / 2 - 10, i));
  for (t = i - CASTLE_OUR.baseX, t <= 60 ? (t = 60, RASER.HEIGHT = Math.floor(15 * 1.5)) : RASER.HEIGHT = Math.floor(t / 10 * 1.5), n = 0; n <= RASER_DELTA_X + 2; n++) RASER.x[n] = Math.round(RASER.baseX - RASER.w / 2 + t / (RASER_DELTA_X + 2) * n), RASER.y[n] = RASER.baseY - Math.round(RASER.HEIGHT / -25 * (n - 5) * (n - 5) + RASER.HEIGHT) - RASER.h;
  for (n = 0; n <= RASER_DELTA_X + 1; n++) r = RASER.x[n + 1] - RASER.x[n], u = RASER.y[n] - RASER.y[n + 1], RASER.deg[n] = 90 - Math.round(Math.atan2(u, r) * 360 / 6.283185);
  RASER.deg[RASER_DELTA_X + 2] = RASER.deg[RASER_DELTA_X + 1];
  RASER.flag = 1
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.fireRaser_interval = function() {
  var n, i, r;
  if (RASER.flag != 0 && (RASER.dx++, $("#Img_DD_missile").css({
      display: "block",
      left: RASER.x[RASER.dx] + "px",
      top: RASER.y[RASER.dx] + "px",
      "-webkit-transform-origin": "50% 100%",
      "-webkit-transform": "rotate(" + RASER.deg[RASER.dx] + "deg)",
      position: "absolute"
    }), RASER.pole_x = RASER.x[RASER.dx] + RASER.w / 2 + RASER.h * Math.sin(RASER.deg[RASER.dx] * Math.PI / 180), RASER.pole_y = RASER.y[RASER.dx] + RASER.h - RASER.h * Math.cos(RASER.deg[RASER.dx] * Math.PI / 180), RASER.dx >= RASER_DELTA_X + 2 || RASER.pole_y >= GAME_BASE_Y - 30)) {
    RASER.dx = -1;
    RASER.flag = 0;
    QUEST.f6_missile();
    var t = RASER.x[RASER_DELTA_X + 2],
      u = t - RASER.damage_range,
      f = t + RASER.damage_range;
    for (n = 1; n <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && (i = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num, r = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[i].beattack_margine);
    $("#Img_DD_missile").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    S_DAYDUNGEON.fireRaser_attack();
    return
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.fireRaser_attack = function() {
  var i = RASER.x[RASER_DELTA_X],
    r = i - RASER.damage_range,
    u = i + RASER.damage_range,
    n = 1,
    f = 7,
    e = RASER.pole_x,
    o = RASER.pole_y,
    t;
  $("#Img_DD_raser_pung_effect").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  t = function() {
    var i, s, a;
    if (n <= f) {
      var h = "./image/ui/98_effect/missileEffect_" + n + ".png",
        c = e - 280,
        l = o - 200;
      utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_DD_raser_pung_effect", h, c, l);
      setTimeout(t, TIMER_INTERVAL);
      n++
    } else setTimeout(function() {
      utilDraw_image_1pixel("Img_DD_raser_pung_effect");
      $("#Img_DD_raser_pung_effect").css({
        display: "none"
      })
    }, 50);
    if (n == 5) {
      for (i = 1; i <= MAX_YOUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN; i++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].alive == 1 && (s = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].x + DAYDUNGEON_DESIGN[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].unit_num].beattack_margine, r <= s && s <= u && (a = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp = Math.floor(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp - USER.missile_power), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp <= 0 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.sunday_mission_check(), S_DAYDUNGEON.acc_your_num--, S_DAYDUNGEON.yourunit_display_none(i))));
      r <= CASTLE_YOUR.baseX && CASTLE_YOUR.baseX <= u && (CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp > 1 && S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day != 2 && (CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp = CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp - USER.missile_power), CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp <= 1 && (CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp = 1), CASTLE_YOUR.mode != MODE.ATTACK && (CASTLE_YOUR.mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED), document.getElementById("Txt_DD_your_castle").innerHTML = Math.floor(CASTLE_YOUR.cur_hp) + " / " + CASTLE_YOUR.max_hp)
    }
  };
  t()
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.fireRaser_stage = function() {
  var t, i, u, r, n, f, e;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.RASER_FIRE);
  t = 0;
  i = 0;
  switch (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day) {
    case 1:
      t = -66;
      i = 31;
      break;
    case 2:
      t = -84;
      i = 92;
      break;
    case 3:
      t = -80;
      i = 0;
      break;
    case 4:
      t = -50;
      i = 117;
      break;
    case 5:
      t = -78;
      i = 81;
      break;
    case 6:
      t = -74;
      i = -24;
      break;
    case 7:
      t = -70;
      i = 60
  }
  for (RASER_STAGE.baseX = CASTLE_YOUR.x + CASTLE_YOUR.w - 134 + t, RASER_STAGE.baseY = CASTLE_YOUR.y + 105 + i, RASER_STAGE.w = $("#Img_DD_missile_stage").width(), RASER_STAGE.h = $("#Img_DD_missile_stage").height(), u = CASTLE_OUR.baseX, n = 1; n <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; n++) OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 95 && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && (u = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w / 5);
  for (r = CASTLE_YOUR.baseX + CASTLE_YOUR.w / 2 - u, r <= 60 ? (r = 60, RASER_STAGE.HEIGHT = Math.floor(15 * 1.5)) : RASER_STAGE.HEIGHT = Math.floor(r / 10 * 1.5), utilConsoleLog("RASER_STAGE.HEIGHT= " + RASER_STAGE.HEIGHT), n = 0; n <= RASER_STAGE_DELTA_X + 2; n++) RASER_STAGE.x[n] = Math.round(RASER_STAGE.baseX + RASER_STAGE.w / 2 - r / (RASER_STAGE_DELTA_X + 2) * n), RASER_STAGE.y[n] = RASER_STAGE.baseY - Math.round(RASER_STAGE.HEIGHT / -25 * (n - 5) * (n - 5) + RASER_STAGE.HEIGHT) - RASER_STAGE.h;
  for (n = 0; n <= RASER_STAGE_DELTA_X + 1; n++) f = RASER_STAGE.x[n + 1] - RASER_STAGE.x[n], e = RASER_STAGE.y[n] - RASER_STAGE.y[n + 1], RASER_STAGE.deg[n] = 90 - Math.round(Math.atan2(e, f) * 360 / 6.283185);
  RASER_STAGE.deg[RASER_STAGE_DELTA_X + 2] = RASER_STAGE.deg[RASER_STAGE_DELTA_X + 1];
  RASER_STAGE.flag = 1
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.fireRaser_interval_stage = function() {
  var n, r, u;
  if (RASER_STAGE.flag != 0) {
    for (RASER_STAGE.dx++, $("#Img_DD_missile_stage").css({
        display: "block",
        left: RASER_STAGE.x[RASER_STAGE.dx] + "px",
        top: RASER_STAGE.y[RASER_STAGE.dx] + "px",
        "-webkit-transform-origin": "50% 100%",
        "-webkit-transform": "rotate(" + RASER_STAGE.deg[RASER_STAGE.dx] + "deg)",
        position: "absolute"
      }), RASER_STAGE.pole_x = RASER_STAGE.x[RASER_STAGE.dx] - RASER_STAGE.w / 2 - RASER_STAGE.h * Math.sin(RASER_STAGE.deg[RASER_STAGE.dx] * Math.PI / 180), RASER_STAGE.pole_y = RASER_STAGE.y[RASER_STAGE.dx] + RASER_STAGE.h - RASER_STAGE.h * Math.cos(RASER_STAGE.deg[RASER_STAGE.dx] * Math.PI / 180), n = 1; n <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; n++)
      if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && S_GAME.is_koo_char(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num)) {
        var f = RASER_STAGE.pole_x,
          e = RASER_STAGE.pole_x + RASER_STAGE.w,
          t = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w,
          o = RASER_STAGE.pole_y,
          s = RASER_STAGE.pole_x + RASER_STAGE.w,
          i = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].h;
        if (f <= t && t <= e && o <= i && i <= s && (r = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e3) + 1, u = 1e3 - DEFINE.RASER_DESTROY_PERCENT["COW" + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num], r <= u)) {
          RASER_STAGE.dx = -1;
          RASER_STAGE.flag = 0;
          S_DAYDUNGEON.fireRaser_i_cow(n, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y);
          return
        }
      } if (RASER_STAGE.dx >= RASER_STAGE_DELTA_X + 2 || RASER_STAGE.pole_y >= GAME_BASE_Y - 30) {
      RASER_STAGE.dx = -1;
      RASER_STAGE.flag = 0;
      $("#Img_DD_missile_stage").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      S_DAYDUNGEON.fireRaser_attack_stage();
      return
    }
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.fireRaser_attack_stage = function() {
  var i = RASER_STAGE.x[RASER_STAGE_DELTA_X],
    r = i - RASER_STAGE.damage_range,
    u = i + RASER_STAGE.damage_range,
    n = 1,
    f = 10,
    e = RASER_STAGE.pole_x,
    o = RASER_STAGE.pole_y,
    t;
  $("#Img_DD_raser_pung_effect_stage").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  t = function() {
    var i, h, s, v;
    if (n <= f) {
      var c = "./image/ui/98_effect/missileEffect_" + n + ".png",
        l = e - 206,
        a = o - 200;
      $("#Img_DD_raser_pung_effect_stage").css({
        "-webkit-transform": "rotateY(180deg)",
        "-webkittransform-origin": "50% 50%",
        transform: "scaleX(1.0) scaleY(1.0) rotateY(180deg)",
        "transform-origin": "50% 50%"
      });
      utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_DD_raser_pung_effect_stage", c, l, a);
      setTimeout(t, TIMER_INTERVAL);
      n++
    } else setTimeout(function() {
      utilDraw_image_1pixel("Img_DD_raser_pung_effect_stage");
      $("#Img_DD_raser_pung_effect_stage").css({
        display: "none"
      })
    }, 50);
    if (n == 5) {
      for (i = 1; i <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; i++)
        if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].alive == 1 && (h = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].x, r <= h && h <= u)) {
          if (s = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].unit_num, S_GAME.is_koo_char(s)) continue;
          v = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp;
          S_GAME.has_special_ability("our", s, SPECIAL_ABILITY.ARMOR) ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].shield_102_time == 0 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp - 1) : S_GAME.has_innate_ability("our", s, INNATE_ABILITY.ARMOR) ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].shield_102_time == 0 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp - 1) : OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].shield_102_time == 0 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp - USER.get_missile_power_daydungeon());
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED;
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].hp <= 0 && (S_DAYDUNGEON.ourunit_display_none(i), S_DAYDUNGEON.drawOurTeamNumber())
        } r <= CASTLE_OUR.baseX && CASTLE_OUR.baseX <= u && (CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp > 1 && (CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp = Math.floor(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp - USER.get_missile_power_daydungeon())), CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp <= 1 && (CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp = 0, S_DAYDUNGEON.ourCastle_destroyAni()), CASTLE_OUR.mode != MODE.ATTACK && (CASTLE_OUR.mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED), document.getElementById("Txt_DD_our_castle").innerHTML = Math.floor(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp) + " / " + CASTLE_OUR.max_hp)
    }
  };
  t()
};
S_DAYDUNGEON.fireRaser_i_cow = function(n, t, i, r) {

  OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive = 0;
  S_DAYDUNGEON.ourunit_display_none(n);
  S_DAYDUNGEON.drawOurTeamNumber();
  $("#Img_DD_missile_stage").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  f = function() {
    u <= o ? (e = glo.fun.get_img_url(t) + "image/char/ally_" + t + "/ally_" + t + "_effect_" + (10 + u) + ".png", $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + n + "_fire_pung_img").css({
      display: "block"
    }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_DD_our_unit" + n + "_fire_pung_img", e, s, h), setTimeout(f, TIMER_INTERVAL), u++) : $("#Img_DD_our_unit" + n + "_fire_pung_img").css({
      display: "none"
    })
  };
  f()
};

S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.init = function() {
  sound_bgm_play(BGM_SOUND.WAIT);
  S_MAINMENU.unmount_mm_top();
  S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus = 5;
  utilConsoleLog("S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.init()");
  gEnableKey = 0;
  S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.maketag();
  $("#S_DAYDUNGEON_div").empty();
  $("#S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR_div").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR;
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.win_cal();
  S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.ch_num = S_GAME.socket_getAvailable_num();
  S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.scale.cur = 0;
  S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.make_screen();
  S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.addMouseEvent();
  var n = "(요일던전)난이도[" + TXT["daydungeon_btn" + S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus + "_text"] + "] 클리어";
  ServerConnection.update_daydungeon_cur_ticket(0, n, function() {});
  STORAGE.save_quest_to_server();
  glo.fun.is_glo_platform() && (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 1 ? ServerConnection.put_eldorado_score("DAYDUNGEON_EASY", "요일던전 쉬움 클리어") : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 2 ? ServerConnection.put_eldorado_score("DAYDUNGEON_NORMAL", "요일던전 보통 클리어") : S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus == 3 && ServerConnection.put_eldorado_score("DAYDUNGEON_HARD", "요일던전 어려움 클리어"))
};

S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.maketag = function() {

S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.win_cal = function() {
  var u, f;
  S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top();
  var i = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4 + 1),
    n = 0,
    r = 0,
    t = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 1);
  if (t <= DAYDUNGEON_REWARD_PROBABILITY["level" + S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus][1]) switch (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus) {
    case 1:
      n = 1;
      break;
    case 2:
      n = 2;
      break;
    case 3:
      n = 3
  } else switch (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus) {
    case 1:
      n = 1;
      break;
    case 2:
      n = 3;
      break;
    case 3:
      n = 4
  }
  t = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 1);
  r = t <= DEFINE_ITEM_UPGRADE.probability_sangjungha[1] ? 1 : t <= DEFINE_ITEM_UPGRADE.probability_sangjungha[1] + DEFINE_ITEM_UPGRADE.probability_sangjungha[2] ? 2 : 3;
  u = i + "" + n + "" + r;
  f = i + "" + n;
  S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.reward_item = Number(u);
  S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.reward_item_img = Number(f);
  var e = "",
    s = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade(S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.reward_item),
    h = s.toUpperCase() + TXT.daydungeon_clear_gread,
    o = TXT["daydungeon_btn" + S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.focus + "_text"];
  e = USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? TXT.map_day_text + "[" + o + "] 클리어 보상(" + h + ")" : TXT.map_day_text + "[" + o + "] Clear Reward";
  ServerConnection.put_reward_char("ITEM", e, S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.reward_item);
  utilNotice(TXT.reward_mailbox_check, 2)
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus > 1 && (S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus--, S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus < 5 && (S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus++, S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus = 1;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus = 2;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus = 3;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM4:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus = 4;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM5:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus = 5;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.menuRun()
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.backKey = function() {
  S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.menuRun()
};

S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.make_screen_spawn_star = function(n, t, i, r, u, f) {
  u = typeof u == "number" ? u : 0;
  setTimeout(function() {
    var s = "DDC_star_" + n + "_" + t,
      c = Math.floor(Math.random() * 41) + 26,
      l = Math.floor(Math.random() * 360),
      w = n === "L" ? 1 : -1,
      a = 40,
      b = n === "L" ? i - a : i + a,
      o = 1200,
      v = l + w * 270,
      h, u, e, y, p;
    utilDrawImage(s, f, i, r, c, c, "absolute");
    h = document.getElementById("Img_DDC_title_effect") || document.getElementById("S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR_div") || document.body;
    u = document.getElementById(s);
    u ? h && u.parentNode !== h && h.appendChild(u) : (u = document.createElement("div"), u.id = s, u.style.position = "absolute", u.style.left = i + "px", u.style.top = r + "px", u.style.width = c + "px", u.style.height = c + "px", u.style.backgroundImage = util_bg_url("url(" + f + ")"), u.style.backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat", u.style.backgroundPosition = "50% 50%", u.style.backgroundSize = "contain", h.appendChild(u));
    e = $("#" + s);
    e.css({
      "z-index": 103,
      "pointer-events": "none",
      opacity: 1,
      "transform-origin": "50% 50%",
      "-webkit-transform-origin": "50% 50%",
      transform: "translateZ(0) rotate(" + l + "deg) scale(1)",
      "-webkit-transform": "translateZ(0) rotate(" + l + "deg) scale(1)",
      transition: "none",
      "-webkit-transition": "none"
    });
    e[0] && e[0].offsetWidth;
    y = "transform " + o + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), left " + o + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), opacity " + o + "ms linear";
    p = "-webkit-transform " + o + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), left " + o + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), opacity " + o + "ms linear";
    e.css({
      transition: y,
      "-webkit-transition": p
    });
    e[0] && e[0].offsetWidth;
    e.css({
      left: b + "px",
      opacity: 0,
      transform: "translateZ(0) rotate(" + v + "deg) scale(0)",
      "-webkit-transform": "translateZ(0) rotate(" + v + "deg) scale(0)"
    });
    setTimeout(function() {
      var n = document.getElementById(s);
      n && n.parentNode && n.parentNode.removeChild(n)
    }, o + 120)
  }, u)
};

S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.easeOutCubic = function(n) {
  return 1 - Math.pow(1 - n, 3)
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.createFadeUpAnimation = function(n, t) {
  var i = {
    opacity: {
      start: 0,
      end: 1
    },
    translateY: {
      start: -10,
      end: 0
    },
    duration: 500,
    delay: 0,
    onComplete: null
  };
  t && (t.opacity && (i.opacity = t.opacity), t.translateY && (i.translateY = t.translateY), t.duration !== undefined && (i.duration = t.duration), t.delay !== undefined && (i.delay = t.delay), t.onComplete && (i.onComplete = t.onComplete));
  n.css({
    opacity: i.opacity.start,
    transform: "translateY(" + i.translateY.start + "px)",
    "-webkit-transform": "translateY(" + i.translateY.start + "px)"
  });
  setTimeout(function() {
    S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.startFadeUpAnimation(n, i)
  }, i.delay)
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.startFadeUpAnimation = function(n, t) {
  function i() {
    var o = (new Date).getTime() - r,
      u = Math.min(o / t.duration, 1),
      e, f;
    if (u = S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.easeOutCubic(u), e = t.opacity.start + (t.opacity.end - t.opacity.start) * u, f = t.translateY.start + (t.translateY.end - t.translateY.start) * u, n.css({
        opacity: e,
        transform: "translateY(" + f + "px)",
        "-webkit-transform": "translateY(" + f + "px)"
      }), u >= 1) {
      if (n.css({
          opacity: t.opacity.end,
          transform: "translateY(" + t.translateY.end + "px)",
          "-webkit-transform": "translateY(" + t.translateY.end + "px)"
        }), t.onComplete) t.onComplete(n)
    } else setTimeout(i, TIMER_INTERVAL)
  }
  var r = (new Date).getTime();
  i()
};

  });

    });

      u = 19 - Math.round(CHAR_OUR_TEAM[t].h * i),

S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.drawFocus = function() {
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  $("#Img_DDC_make_team_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_DDC_upgrade_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_DDC_main_menu_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_DDC_select_mode_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_DDC_retry_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus == 1 ? $("#Img_DDC_make_team_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus == 2 ? $("#Img_DDC_upgrade_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus == 3 ? $("#Img_DDC_main_menu_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus == 4 ? $("#Img_DDC_select_mode_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus == 5 && $("#Img_DDC_retry_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  })
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.menuRun = function() {
  switch (S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus) {
    case 1:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM);
      break;
    case 2:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_UPGRADE, S_UPGRADE);
      break;
    case 3:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU);
      break;
    case 4:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MODE_SELECT, S_MODE_SELECT);
      break;
    case 5:
      ServerConnection.get_cur_day(function() {
        ServerConnection.get_daydungeon_cur_ticket(function() {
          if (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day < 0 || S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.free_ticket < 0) {
            console.error(" 요일던전 정보가 잘못되었습니다.");
            glo.fun.show_s_error_network("S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.menuRun():요일던전 정보오류");
            return
          }
          var n = function(n) {
            for (var t = 0; t < n.event_arr.length; t++) AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[n.event_arr[t]] = 1;
            auto_event_value();
            loading_hide();
            gEnableKey = 1;
            S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.end();
            $("#S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR_div").css({
              display: "none"
            });
            $("#S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR_div").empty();
            $("#S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT_div").css({
              display: "block"
            });
            S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.init()
          };
          loading_show();
          gEnableKey = 0;
          auto_event_system_init();
          auto_event_system_check(999, n)
        })
      });
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.menuRun(): Unknown focus value: " + S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus)
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.end = function() {
  S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.removeMouseEvent();
  util_key_number.clear_all()
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.menuRun()
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) switch (n.target.id) {
    case "make_team_button":
    case "Img_DDC_make_team_bg":
    case "Txt_DDC_make_team_text":
    case "Img_DDC_make_team_focus":
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus = 1;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "upgrade_button":
    case "Img_DDC_upgrade_bg":
    case "Txt_DDC_upgrade_text":
    case "Img_DDC_upgrade_focus":
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus = 2;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "main_menu_button":
    case "Img_DDC_main_menu_bg":
    case "Txt_DDC_main_menu_text":
    case "Img_DDC_main_menu_focus":
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus = 3;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "select_mode_button":
    case "Img_DDC_select_mode_bg":
    case "Txt_DDC_select_mode_text":
    case "Img_DDC_select_mode_focus":
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus = 4;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "retry_button":
    case "Img_DDC_retry_bg":
    case "Txt_DDC_retry_text":
    case "Img_DDC_retry_focus":
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.focus = 5;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.drawFocus();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Please define this id in S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.onMouseover():" + n.target.id)
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.onMouseover(n)
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.onMouseover(n);
  S_DAYDUNGEON_CLEAR.onClick(n)
};

S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.focus > 1 && (S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.focus--, S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.focus < 5 && (S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.focus++, S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.focus = 1;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.focus = 2;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.focus = 3;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM4:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.focus = 4;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM5:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.focus = 5;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.menuRun()
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.backKey = function() {
  S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.menuRun()
};

S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.display_char = function() {
  for (var n = 1; n <= MAX_SOCKET_NUMBER; n++) $("#DDF_ch" + n).css({
    display: "none"
  });
  for (n = 1; n <= S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.ch_num; n++) {
    var t = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].unit_num,
      e = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[t].filename,
      o = glo.fun.get_img_url_ally(t) + "image/char/ally_" + t + "/",
      s = e + "_beattack_11.png";
    $("#DDF_ch" + n).css({
      display: "block"
    });
    var i = char_ratio(t),
      r = -50 + 193 / 2 - Math.round(CHAR_OUR_TEAM[t].w * i) / 2 + CHAR_OUR_TEAM[t].center_gap_x,
      u = 19 - Math.round(CHAR_OUR_TEAM[t].h * i),
      f = S_GAME.get_xy_display_char(t, r, u);
    r = f.cx;
    u = f.cy;
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_DDF_ch" + n, o + s, r, u);
    utilScale("Img_DDF_ch" + n, i)
  }

S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.menuRun = function() {
  switch (S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.focus) {
    case 1:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM);
      break;
    case 2:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_UPGRADE, S_UPGRADE);
      break;
    case 3:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU);
      break;
    case 4:
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MODE_SELECT, S_MODE_SELECT);
      break;
    case 5:
      ServerConnection.get_cur_day(function() {
        ServerConnection.get_daydungeon_cur_ticket(function() {
          if (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day < 0 || S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.free_ticket < 0) {
            console.error(" 요일던전 정보가 잘못되었습니다.");
            glo.fun.show_s_error_network("S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.menuRun():요일던전 정보오류");
            return
          }
          var n = function(n) {
            for (var t = 0; t < n.event_arr.length; t++) AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[n.event_arr[t]] = 1;
            auto_event_value();
            loading_hide();
            gEnableKey = 1;
            S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.end();
            $("#S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL_div").css({
              display: "none"
            });
            $("#S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL_div").empty();
            $("#S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT_div").css({
              display: "block"
            });
            S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.init()
          };
          loading_show();
          gEnableKey = 0;
          auto_event_system_init();
          auto_event_system_check(999, n)
        })
      });
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.menuRun(): Unknown focus value: " + S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.focus)
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.end = function() {
  S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.removeMouseEvent();
  util_key_number.clear_all()
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.menuRun()
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE) switch (n.target.id) {
    case "make_team_button":
    case "Img_DDF_make_team_bg":
    case "Txt_DDF_make_team_text":
    case "Img_DDF_make_team_focus":
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.focus = 1;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "upgrade_button":
    case "Img_DDF_upgrade_bg":
    case "Txt_DDF_upgrade_text":
    case "Img_DDF_upgrade_focus":
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.focus = 2;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "main_menu_button":
    case "Img_DDF_main_menu_bg":
    case "Txt_DDF_main_menu_text":
    case "Img_DDF_main_menu_focus":
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.focus = 3;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "select_mode_button":
    case "Img_DDF_select_mode_bg":
    case "Txt_DDF_select_mode_text":
    case "Img_DDF_select_mode_focus":
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.focus = 4;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "retry_button":
    case "Img_DDF_retry_bg":
    case "Txt_DDF_retry_text":
    case "Img_DDF_retry_focus":
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.focus = 5;
      S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.drawFocus();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Please define this id in S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.onMouseover():" + n.target.id)
  }
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.onMouseover(n)
};
S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.onMouseover(n);
  S_DAYDUNGEON_FAIL.onClick(n)
}

function getCountry_usingIP() {
  if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT) {
    USER.country = STORAGE.data1.country = "KR";
    STORAGE.save_all_info_to_storage("나라정보뭐야:" + USER.country);
    return
  }
  $.get("http://ipinfo.io", function(n) {
    console.log(n.country);
    USER.country = n.country == "undefined" ? STORAGE.data1.country = "KR" : STORAGE.data1.country = n.country;
    STORAGE.save_all_info_to_storage("나라정보저장:" + USER.country)
  }, "jsonp")
}

function run_count_to_server() {
  var t = SERVER_URL + "Counter/daily_run_count.php",
    n = {
      ID: glo.fun.get_uniq_id(),
      APPS_NAME: gAPP_INFO.APP_NAME,
      VERSION: gAPP_INFO.VERSION,
      COUNTRY: USER.country,
      DATA1: STORAGE.make_data1(),
      DATA2: STORAGE.make_data2(),
      DATA3: STORAGE.make_data3()
    };
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.HCN && (n.SMART_CARD_ID = gEntrix.SMART_CARD_ID, n.SOCode = gEntrix.SOCode);
  $.post(t, n, function(n) {
    if (n == null || n == "") window.g.daily_run_count > 0 || (window.g.daily_run_count = 0);
    else {
      var t = parseInt(n, 10);
      t > 0 ? window.g.daily_run_count = t : window.g.daily_run_count > 0 || (window.g.daily_run_count = 0)
    }
    glo.APP_FEATURE.MOBILE_LINK ? (glo.APP_FEATURE.RUN_COUNT_CHECK_ALL || S_MOBILE_LINK.GOOGLE_ID != "none") && ServerConnection.get_cur_run_count() : (glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) && ServerConnection.get_cur_run_count();
    utilConsoleLog("###g.daily_run_count = " + window.g.daily_run_count)
  })
}

function check_deployed_char_level_hack() {
  var u, n;
  if (!(glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS)) return !0;
  for (u = glo.char.get_deck_count(), n = 1; n <= u; n++)
    if (OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].unit_num != 0) {
      var f = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].index,
        i = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].unit_num,
        r = STORAGE.data2[f].cur_level,
        e = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].max_level,
        o = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].star,
        h = function(n) {
          switch (n) {
            case 1:
              return 40;
            case 2:
              return 50;
            case 3:
              return 60;
            case 4:
              return 70;
            case 5:
              return 80;
            case 6:
              return 90;
            case 7:
              return 100;
            case 8:
              return 110;
            case 9:
              return 120
          }
        },
        t = h(o),
        s = "index:" + f + " cur_num:" + i + " cur_level:" + r + " star:" + o + " max_lv:" + t + " team:" + glo.char.get_decks() + " socket:" + JSON.stringify(OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n]);
      if (Number(r) > Number(t)) return ServerConnection.put_black_list_myid("[앱] " + n + "번 캐릭(" + i + ") CUR 레벨 조정 [ MAX Lv : " + t + " 현재 Lv : " + r + " ] debug_log:" + s), !1;
      if (Number(e) > Number(t)) return ServerConnection.put_black_list_myid("[앱] " + n + "번 캐릭(" + i + ") MAX 레벨 조정 [ 정상 MAX Lv : " + t + " 현재 MAX Lv : " + e + " ] debug_log:" + s), !1
    } return !0
}

function save_UserInfo_after_pay_to_server(n, t, i, r) {
  var u, e, f;
  if (glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS) {
    if (!check_deployed_char_level_hack()) return;
    if ((t == "업적보상" || t == "업적보상(2배)") && (u = 101, (glo.package.get_is_subscribe() === "yes" || glo.package.get_month_cloud_package_buy_status() == 1) && (u = 201), Number(n) >= u)) {
      ServerConnection.put_black_list_myid("업적보상으로 " + n + " 받을려고 함. 최대 100개. 구독자이면 100*2개");
      return
    }
    if ((t == "업적보상모두받기(루비)" || t == "업적보상모두받기(2배지급됨 루비)") && (u = 321, (glo.package.get_is_subscribe() === "yes" || glo.package.get_month_cloud_package_buy_status() == 1) && (u = 641), Number(n) >= u)) {
      ServerConnection.put_black_list_myid("업적보상모두받기(루비)으로 " + n + " 받을려고 함. 최대 320개. 구독자이면 320*2개");
      return
    }
    if (typeof n == "string" && n.indexOf("--") != -1) {
      ServerConnection.put_black_list_myid(t + " 받을려고 하였으나 --로 값이 들어옴 들어온 값 " + n);
      S_EXITPOPUP.start(1);
      return
    }
    if (t == "아이템 뽑기") switch (S_ITEM_GACHA.focus) {
      case 1:
        if (Math.abs(Number(n)) < 4) {
          ServerConnection.put_black_list_myid("아이템 뽑기[F등급]하기 위한 정해진 루비 수보다 적게 루비가 소모됨 루비 : " + n);
          return
        }
        break;
      case 2:
        if (Math.abs(Number(n)) < 67) {
          ServerConnection.put_black_list_myid("아이템 뽑기[E~C등급(150루비)]하기 위한 정해진 루비 수보다 적게 루비가 소모됨 루비 : " + n);
          return
        }
        break;
      case 3:
        if (Math.abs(Number(n)) < 67) {
          ServerConnection.put_black_list_myid("아이템 뽑기[E~C등급(150루비)]하기 위한 정해진 루비 수보다 적게 루비가 소모됨 루비 : " + n);
          return
        }
        break;
      case 4:
        if (Math.abs(Number(n)) < 360) {
          ServerConnection.put_black_list_myid("아이템 뽑기[E~C등급(800루비)]하기 위한 정해진 루비 수보다 적게 루비가 소모됨 루비 : " + n);
          return
        }
        break;
      case 5:
        if (Math.abs(Number(n)) < 360) {
          ServerConnection.put_black_list_myid("아이템 뽑기[E~C등급(800루비)]하기 위한 정해진 루비 수보다 적게 루비가 소모됨 루비 : " + n);
          return
        }
    }
  }
  e = SERVER_URL + "save_UserInfo_after_PAY.php";
  typeof i != "string" && (i = "");
  f = {
    HOST_ID: glo.fun.get_uniq_id(),
    USER_NAME: gEntrix.user_name,
    RUBY: n,
    TYPE: t,
    APPS_NAME: gAPP_INFO.APP_NAME,
    VERSION: gAPP_INFO.VERSION,
    COUNTRY: USER.country,
    DATA1: STORAGE.make_data1(),
    DATA2: STORAGE.make_data2(),
    DATA3: STORAGE.make_data3(),
    ETC: i
  };
  (gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CNM || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.ENTRIX_CJH || gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.HCN) && (f.COUNTRY = gEntrix.SOCode);
  $.post(e, f, function() {
    r && r()
  })
}

function utilPush() {
  var r;
  if (gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV) {
    utilConsoleLog("Not Web OS in utilPush();");
    return
  }
  var u = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene,
    n = {
      scene: u
    },
    t = "",
    i = "";
  try {
    history.pushState(n, t, i)
  } catch (f) {
    utilConsoleLog("Error in utilPush():" + f)
  }
  r = {
    data: n,
    title: t,
    url: i
  };
  gHISTORY.push(r)
}

function utilPushString(n, t, i, r) {
  STR[p_str] = {};
  STR[p_str].id = n;
  STR[p_str].or34 = t;
  STR[p_str].leafnum = i;
  STR[p_str].index = r;
  p_str++
}

}

}

  }

        width: "500px",
        height: "650px",
        background: "white",

  }

function utilGetNumber_withComma(n) {
  var f = 1,
    u, i;
  Number(n) < 0 && (f = -1);
  f == -1 && (n = n * -1);
  typeof n != "string" && (n = n + "");
  var t = "",
    e = n.length,
    r = e % 3;
  for (r > 0 && (t = n.slice(0, r), e > r && (t += ",")), u = n.slice(r), i = 0; i < u.length; i += 3) t += u.slice(i, i + 3), i + 3 < u.length && (t += ",");
  return f == -1 && (t = "-" + t), t
}

function utilGetFontSize(n, t, i) {
  var f = 30,
    e = 5,
    u, r;
  for ($("#dummy_text").css({
      width: t + "px",
      "font-size": f + "rem"
    }), $("#dummy_text").text(TXT.start[gUSER.lang]), u = $("#dummy_text").outerHeight(), r = f; r >= e; r--) {
    if (u = $("#dummy_text").outerHeight(), u < i) return r;
    $("#dummy_text").css({
      "font-size": r + "rem"
    })
  }
  return e
}

function utilGetFileName(n) {

function getDate() {
  var n = new Date,
    r = n.getFullYear(),
    t = n.getMonth() + 1,
    i = n.getDate(),
    u = t < 10 ? "0" + t : t,
    f = i < 10 ? "0" + i : i;
  return r + "/" + u + "/" + f
}

function getDate2() {
  var n = new Date,
    r = n.getFullYear(),
    t = n.getMonth() + 1,
    i = n.getDate(),
    u = t < 10 ? "0" + t : "" + t,
    f = i < 10 ? "0" + i : "" + i;
  return r + "" + u + "" + f
}

function getTime() {
  var i = new Date,
    n = i.getHours(),
    t = i.getMinutes(),
    r = n < 10 ? "0" + n : n,
    u = t < 10 ? "0" + t : t;
  return r + ":" + u
}

  for (var t = 1; t <= n; t++) LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t] = {}, LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].MOVE = [], LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].WAIT = [], LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].ATTACK = [], LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].BEATTACK = [], LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].FIRE = [], LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].DESTROY = [], LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].VALKYRIE = [], LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].SHIELD = null, LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].SHIELD_102 = [], LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].REFLECT = [], LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].HEAL = [], LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].FEVER = [], LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].ATTACK_2 = [], LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].FEVER_GREEN = [], LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[t].EFFECT = []
}

function interval_test_our() {
  if (LOIMG_CHAR_OUR_NUM.MOVE.tot <= LOIMG_CHAR_OUR_NUM.MOVE.cur && LOIMG_CHAR_OUR_NUM.WAIT.tot <= LOIMG_CHAR_OUR_NUM.WAIT.cur && LOIMG_CHAR_OUR_NUM.ATTACK.tot <= LOIMG_CHAR_OUR_NUM.ATTACK.cur && LOIMG_CHAR_OUR_NUM.BEATTACK.tot <= LOIMG_CHAR_OUR_NUM.BEATTACK.cur && LOIMG_CHAR_OUR_NUM.FIRE.tot <= LOIMG_CHAR_OUR_NUM.FIRE.cur && LOIMG_ETC_OUR.tot <= LOIMG_ETC_OUR.cur) {
    utilConsoleLog("---------------------------------------------All image Loaded!!");
    flag_LOIMG_CHAR_OUR = 1;
    return
  }
  setTimeout(interval_test_our, 100)
}

function interval_test_your() {
  if (utilConsoleLog(" your MOVE:tot=" + LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.MOVE.tot + "   cur=" + LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.MOVE.cur), utilConsoleLog(" your WAIT:tot=" + LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.WAIT.tot + "   cur=" + LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.WAIT.cur), utilConsoleLog(" your ATTACKT:tot=" + LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.ATTACK.tot + "   cur=" + LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.ATTACK.cur), utilConsoleLog(" your BEATTACKT:tot=" + LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.BEATTACK.tot + "   cur=" + LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.BEATTACK.cur), utilConsoleLog(" your FIRE:tot=" + LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.FIRE.tot + "   cur=" + LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.FIRE.cur), LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.MOVE.tot <= LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.MOVE.cur && LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.WAIT.tot <= LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.WAIT.cur && LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.ATTACK.tot <= LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.ATTACK.cur && LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.BEATTACK.tot <= LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.BEATTACK.cur && LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.FIRE.tot <= LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR_NUM.FIRE.cur) {
    utilConsoleLog("All enemy image Loaded!!");
    flag_LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR = 1;
    return
  }
  setTimeout(interval_test_your, 100)
}

function over1time_sound_off() {
  window.g.flag_over1time = 1;
  USER.sound_bgm == 2 && USER.sound_effect == 2 || utilNotice3(TXT.over1time, 4);
  sound_bgm_stop();
  $("#Txt_2_ST_card_1").text(TXT.off);
  $("#Txt_2_ST_card_2").text(TXT.off)
}

function uncomma(n) {
  for (var i = n.split(","), r = "", t = 0; t < i.length; t++) r += i[t];
  return r
}

function loading_show(n, t) {
  t === 1 && (gEnableKey = 0);
  $("#LO_loading")[0] ? $("#LO_loading").css({
    display: "block",
    left: "632px",
    top: "248px",
    position: "absolute"
  }) : typeof util_fun == "object" && typeof util_fun.loadingSpinner == "object" && util_fun.loadingSpinner.show()
}

function unblink() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.KT && window.g.blink.timer != null && (clearInterval(window.g.blink.timer), window.g.blink.timer = null)
}

function blink_focus_start(n) {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.KT && (window.g.blink.timer != null && (clearInterval(window.g.blink.timer), window.g.blink.timer = null), window.g.blink.scene = n, blink_focus_interval())
}

function blink_focus_interval() {
  if (gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.KT) {
    if ($(".focus").css({
        opacity: window.g.blink.value
      }), g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != window.g.blink.scene) {
      $(".focus").css({
        opacity: "1.0"
      });
      return
    }
    switch (window.g.blink.value) {
      case 0:
        window.g.blink.value = 1;
        window.g.blink.timer != null && (clearInterval(window.g.blink.timer), window.g.blink.timer = null);
        window.g.blink.timer = setTimeout(blink_focus_interval, window.g.blink.HIDE_TIMER);
        break;
      case 1:
        window.g.blink.value = 0;
        window.g.blink.timer != null && (clearInterval(window.g.blink.timer), window.g.blink.timer = null);
        window.g.blink.timer = setTimeout(blink_focus_interval, window.g.blink.SHOW_TIMER)
    }
  }
}

function util_getSystemSettings() {
  if (gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV) {
    utilConsoleLog("Not Web OS");
    return
  }
  webos_response = 0;
  var n = webOS.service.request("luna://com.webos.settingsservice", {
    method: "getSystemSettings",
    parameters: {
      category: "option",
      keys: ["country", "smartServiceCountryCode2"]
    },
    onComplete: util_getSystemSettings_onComplete
  });
  return n.send(), !0
}

function util_getSystemSettings_onComplete(n) {
  var t = n.returnValue;
  USER.lang = t ? n.settings.smartServiceCountryCode2 == "KR" ? STORAGE.data1.lang = LANG.KOREA : STORAGE.data1.lang = LANG.ENGLISH : STORAGE.data1.lang = LANG.ENGLISH;
  webos_response = 1;
  STORAGE.save_all_info_to_storage("시스템정보읽어오기완료")
}

function getTimeStamp(n) {
  var t = new Date(n);
  return leadingZeros(t.getFullYear(), 4) + "-" + leadingZeros(t.getMonth() + 1, 2) + "-" + leadingZeros(t.getDate(), 2) + " " + leadingZeros(t.getHours(), 2) + ":" + leadingZeros(t.getMinutes(), 2) + ":" + leadingZeros(t.getSeconds(), 2)
}

function leadingZeros(n, t) {
  var r = "";
  if (n = n.toString(), n.length < t)
    for (i = 0; i < t - n.length; i++) r += "0";
  return r + n
}

  }

function ally_charbook_reward_add_check() {
  for (var t, i = USER.charbook_ally_list.split(","), r = USER.charbook_ally_reward.split(","), n = 1; n < window.g.CHAR_NUM.length; n++)
    if (t = 0, t = ally_get_decx_char_number(n), t === window.g.CHAR_NUM[n].length - 1) return ally_get_decx_reward(n)
}

function ally_get_decx_num(n) {
  for (var i, t = 1; t <= window.g.CHAR_NUM.length; t++)
    for (i = 0; i < window.g.CHAR_NUM[t].length; i++)
      if (n == window.g.CHAR_NUM[t][i]) return t
}

function ally_get_decx_char_number(n) {
  for (var t, i = USER.charbook_ally_list.split(","), u = 0, r = 1; r <= window.g.CHAR_NUM[n].length; r++)
    for (t = 0; t < i.length; t++) parseInt(i[t]) === window.g.CHAR_NUM[n][r] && (u++, t = i.length);
  return u
}

function ally_get_decx_reward(n) {
  var i = USER.charbook_ally_reward.split(","),
    t, r;
  if (USER.charbook_ally_reward === null || USER.charbook_ally_reward === "") return 1;
  for (t = 0; t < i.length; t++) {
    if (r = "A" + n, i[t] === r) return t = i.length, 0;
    if (t == i.length - 1) return 1
  }
}

function ally_is_new() {
  for (var t, n = 1; n < window.g.CHAR_NUM.length; n++)
    if (t = 0, t = ally_get_decx_char_number(n), t === window.g.CHAR_NUM[n].length - 1) {
      if (ally_get_decx_reward(n) == 1) return 1
    } else if (n == window.g.CHAR_NUM.length - 1) return 0
}

function check_ability_stage() {
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_MAKETEAM) return !0;
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_BOSS || g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_DAYDUNGEON || g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_CLOUD_GARDEN) return !1;
  if (S_GAME.is_sky_garden_mode() || S_GAME.is_pvp_mode()) return !0;
  if (S_SELECTSTAGE.is_sealling_debuff_stage()) return !1;
  if (S_GAME.stage >= 221 && S_GAME.stage <= 240) return S_GAME.stone_skill_flag == 0 ? !1 : !0;
  if (S_GAME.stage >= 201) return !0;
  if (S_GAME.stage >= 198) return !1;
  var t = stage_progress_time(),
    n = stage_ability_limit_time();
  return n == 0 ? !0 : t <= n ? !1 : !0
}

function stage_ability_limit_time() {
  return S_GAME.stage < 181 ? 0 : S_GAME.stage >= 198 ? 9999 : (S_GAME.stage - 181) * 5 + 10
}

function stage_progress_time() {
  var n = 0,
    t, i;
  return S_GAME.stage_ability_time_pause_flag == 1 && (n = S_GAME.stage_ability_time_pause_end - S_GAME.stage_ability_time_pause_start, n == 0 && (utilConsoleLog("~~~##~~멈춘 시간이 0초입니다 그러므로 1초를 강제로 줍니다 "), n = 1e3), S_GAME.stage_ability_time = S_GAME.stage_ability_time + n, S_GAME.stage_ability_time_pause_flag = 0, S_GAME.stage_ability_time_pause_start = 0, S_GAME.stage_ability_time_pause_end = 0), t = window.g.timestamp_due - S_GAME.stage_ability_time, i = t / 1e3, i
}

function stage_ability_draw() {
  if (S_GAME.ranking_mode == 0 || S_GAME.ranking_mode == 5) {
    S_GAME.bensi_buff_movespeed();
    for (var n = 1; n <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; n++)
      if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && S_GAME.stage_ability_bensy_flag == 0) {
        S_GAME.stage_ability_bensy_flag = 1;
        switch (S_GAME.bensi_buff_charnum(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num)) {
          case 92:
            OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_speed = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_speed * 5;
            break;
          case 62:
            OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_speed = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_speed * 4;
            break;
          case 61:
            OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_speed = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_speed * 3;
            break;
          case 60:
            OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_speed = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_speed * 2
        }
      }
  }
}

function number_encoding(n) {
  for (var r = String(n), t = "", i = 0; i < r.length; i++) switch (r.charAt(i)) {
    case "0":
      t += "J";
      break;
    case "1":
      t += "I";
      break;
    case "2":
      t += "H";
      break;
    case "3":
      t += "G";
      break;
    case "4":
      t += "F";
      break;
    case "5":
      t += "E";
      break;
    case "6":
      t += "D";
      break;
    case "7":
      t += "C";
      break;
    case "8":
      t += "B";
      break;
    case "9":
      t += "A"
  }
  return t
}

function str_decoding(n) {
  for (var r = String(n), t = "", i = 0; i < r.length; i++) switch (r.charAt(i)) {
    case "J":
      t += "0";
      break;
    case "I":
      t += "1";
      break;
    case "H":
      t += "2";
      break;
    case "G":
      t += "3";
      break;
    case "F":
      t += "4";
      break;
    case "E":
      t += "5";
      break;
    case "D":
      t += "6";
      break;
    case "C":
      t += "7";
      break;
    case "B":
      t += "8";
      break;
    case "A":
      t += "9"
  }
  return Number(t)
}

function encoding_add_ruby(n) {
  if (glo.APP_FEATURE.RUBY_CRYPT) {
    utilConsoleLog("~~encoding_add_ruby~~" + n);
    var i = str_decoding(USER.ruby_encoding),
      t = i + n;
    if (t < USER.ruby && update_user_to_server("해킹:[엔진사용] 정상루비 : " + t + " 변환루비 : " + USER.ruby, USER.ruby), t < 0) {
      S_EXITPOPUP.start(1);
      return
    }
    USER.ruby_encoding = number_encoding(t);
    USER.ruby = Number(t);
    S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top()
  }
}

function onYouTubeIframeAPIReady() {
  $("#player1").css({
    "z-index": 98,
    position: "absolute",
    left: "0px",
    top: "0px",
    display: "none"
  });
  youtubePlayer = new YT.Player("player1", {
    height: "720",
    width: "1280",
    videoId: sYoutubeId,
    playerVars: {
      rel: "0",
      showinfo: "0",
      loop: "1",
      controls: "0",
      disablekb: "1"
    },
    events: {
      onReady: onPlayerReady,
      onError: onError,
      onPlaybackQualityChange: onPlaybackQualityChange,
      onStateChange: onPlayerStateChange
    }
  })
}

function onCurTime() {
  $("#player1").hide()
}

function onPlayerReady(n) {
  stopYoutube = !1;
  youtubePlayer.setPlaybackQuality("hd720");
  n.target.playVideo();
  nDuration = (youtubePlayer.getDuration() - 1) * 1e3;
  setTimeout(onCurTime.bind(this), nDuration);
  youtubePlayer.mute()
}

function onPlayerStateChange(n) {
  n.data == YT.PlayerState.ENDED ? (youtubePlayer.playVideo(), stopYoutube = !1) : n.data == YT.PlayerState.PLAYING && (stopYoutube = !1, gEnableKey = 1, util_fun.loadingSpinner.hide(), $("#player1").show(), $("body").trigger("onShow"), $("#player1_next_btn").show(), setTimeout(function() {
    youtubePlayer.unMute()
  }, 500))
}

    left: "0px",
