  util_key_number.clear_all()
};
S_JACKPOT_GACHA.onClick = function(n) {
  var t, i;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (t) {
      if (t.id == "JG_back_btn") S_JACKPOT_GACHA.area_focus = 1;
      else if (t.id == "JG_reward_btn") S_JACKPOT_GACHA.area_focus = 3;
      else if (REWARD_AD.hit(t.id, "JG_ad_btn")) S_JACKPOT_GACHA.area_focus = 4;
      else if (t.id.indexOf("JG_board") === 0 && (i = parseInt(t.id.replace("JG_board", ""), 10), i >= 1 && i <= 100)) {
        if (S_JACKPOT_GACHA.is_drawn(i)) return;
        S_JACKPOT_GACHA.area_focus = 2;
        S_JACKPOT_GACHA.board_focus = i
      }
      S_JACKPOT_GACHA.drawFocus();
      S_JACKPOT_GACHA.menuRun()
    }
  }
};
S_JACKPOT_GACHA.onMouseOver = function(n) {
  var t, i;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t && (t.id == "JG_back_btn" ? S_JACKPOT_GACHA.area_focus = 1 : t.id == "JG_reward_btn" ? S_JACKPOT_GACHA.area_focus = 3 : t.id.indexOf("JG_board") === 0 && (i = parseInt(t.id.replace("JG_board", ""), 10), i >= 1 && i <= 100 && !S_JACKPOT_GACHA.is_drawn(i) && (S_JACKPOT_GACHA.area_focus = 2, S_JACKPOT_GACHA.board_focus = i)), S_JACKPOT_GACHA.drawFocus())
  }
};
S_JACKPOT_GACHA.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog("S_JACKPOT_GACHA.onMousedown e.target.id :" + n.target.id);
  S_JACKPOT_GACHA.onMouseOver(n)
};
S_JACKPOT_GACHA.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog("S_JACKPOT_GACHA.onMouseup e.target.id :" + n.target.id);
  S_JACKPOT_GACHA.onMouseOver(n);
  S_JACKPOT_GACHA.onClick(n)
};
S_JACKPOT_GACHA.run_reward_ad = function() {
  if (!REWARD_AD.is_enabled("JG_ad_btn")) {
    REWARD_AD.notice_state("JG_ad_btn");
    return
  }
  REWARD_AD.play(REWARD_AD.PLACE.JACKPOT, "", null, S_JACKPOT_GACHA.on_reward_ad)
};

};

  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MARBLE;
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_MARBLE.define();
  S_MARBLE.call_preload == !1 && S_MARBLE.preload();
  S_MARBLE.maketag();
  S_MARBLE.call_preload = !1;
  S_MARBLE.make_screen();

  S_MARBLE.addMouseEvent();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);

    gEnableKey = 1
  }, 300)
};

S_MARBLE.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  console.log("Key pressed: " + i + " in S_MARBLE.keyDown()");
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_MARBLE.focus = 1;
      S_MARBLE.menuRun_Run();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_MARBLE.focus--;
      S_MARBLE.focus < 1 && (S_MARBLE.focus = 1);
      S_MARBLE.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_MARBLE.focus++;
      S_MARBLE.focus > S_MARBLE.max_btn && (S_MARBLE.focus = S_MARBLE.max_btn);
      S_MARBLE.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_MARBLE.menuRun()
  }
};
S_MARBLE.drawFocus = function() {
  $(".focus").hide();
  $("#Img_EM_btn" + S_MARBLE.focus + "_f").show()
};
S_MARBLE.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  utilScale_xy_center("EM_btn" + S_MARBLE.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("EM_btn" + S_MARBLE.focus, 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_MARBLE.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_MARBLE.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (S_MARBLE.focus === 1) gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_MARBLE.back();
  else if (S_MARBLE.focus === 2) S_MARBLE.check_roll_dice();
  else if (S_MARBLE.focus === 3) {
    if (!REWARD_AD.is_enabled("EM_btn3")) {
      REWARD_AD.notice_state("EM_btn3");
      return
    }
    REWARD_AD.play(REWARD_AD.PLACE.MARBLE, "", null, S_MARBLE.on_reward_ad)
  }
};
S_MARBLE.end = function() {
  $("#S_MARBLE_div").remove();
  S_MARBLE.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_MARBLE.back = function() {
  clearInterval(S_MARBLE.roll_timer);
  clearInterval(S_MARBLE.effect_timer);
  clearInterval(S_MARBLE.reward_effect);
  clearInterval(S_MARBLE.remain_timeout);
  S_MARBLE.roll_timer = null;
  S_MARBLE.effect_timer = null;
  S_MARBLE.reward_effect = null;
  S_MARBLE.remain_timeout = null;
  S_MARBLE.my_char.stop();
  S_MARBLE.my_char = null;
  S_MARBLE.end();
  S_SELECTEVENT.init_focus = 2;
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_SELECTEVENT, S_SELECTEVENT)
};
S_MARBLE.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_MARBLE_div").mouseover(S_MARBLE.onMouseover)
};
S_MARBLE.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_MARBLE_div").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_MARBLE.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("EM_btn1") >= 0 ? (S_MARBLE.focus = 1, S_MARBLE.menuRun()) : t.id.search("EM_btn2") >= 0 ? (S_MARBLE.focus = 2, S_MARBLE.menuRun()) : t.id.search("EM_btn3") >= 0 && (S_MARBLE.focus = 3, S_MARBLE.menuRun())
  }
};
S_MARBLE.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("EM_btn1") >= 0 ? (S_MARBLE.focus = 1, S_MARBLE.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("EM_btn2") >= 0 ? (S_MARBLE.focus = 2, S_MARBLE.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("EM_btn3") >= 0 && (S_MARBLE.focus = 3, S_MARBLE.drawFocus())
  }
};
S_MARBLE.onMousedown = function(n) {
  S_MARBLE.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_MARBLE.onMouseup = function(n) {
  S_MARBLE.onMouseover(n);
  S_MARBLE.onClick(n);
  return
};

S_MARBLE.start_char_pos = function() {

    t = S_MARBLE.char_pos_arr[S_MARBLE.cur_pos].y;
  $("#EM_char_ani").css({
    left: n,
    top: t
  });
  S_MARBLE.cur_pos >= 8 && S_MARBLE.cur_pos <= 13 ? S_MARBLE.my_char.set_flip(!0) : S_MARBLE.my_char.set_flip(!1)
};

S_MARBLE.update_daily_mission = function() {
  $(".box1_dim").hide();
  S_MARBLE.daily_mission_count_1 >= 1 && $("#Img_EM_box1_dim1").show();
  S_MARBLE.daily_mission_count_2 >= 3 && $("#Img_EM_box1_dim2").show();
  S_MARBLE.daily_mission_count_3 >= 1 && $("#Img_EM_box1_dim3").show();
  S_MARBLE.daily_mission_count_4 >= 3 && $("#Img_EM_box1_dim4").show();
  S_MARBLE.daily_mission_count_5 >= 1 && $("#Img_EM_box1_dim5").show()
};
S_MARBLE.update_completion_reward = function() {
  var n, t;
  $(".box2_dim").hide();
  n = S_MARBLE.completion_count;
  n >= 1 && $("#Img_EM_box2_dim1").show();
  n >= 5 && $("#Img_EM_box2_dim2").show();
  n >= 10 && $("#Img_EM_box2_dim3").show();
  n >= 15 && $("#Img_EM_box2_dim4").show();
  n >= 20 && $("#Img_EM_box2_dim5").show();
  t = LANG.replace_value(TXT.current_n_completions, [S_MARBLE.completion_count]);
  $("#Txt_EM_box2_cur").html(t)
};
S_MARBLE.get_random_dices = function() {
  var n, t;
  for (S_MARBLE.dice_nums = [], n = 0; n < 11; n++) t = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1, S_MARBLE.dice_nums.push(t);
  S_MARBLE.dice_roll_result = S_MARBLE.dice_nums[10];
  console.log(" S_MARBLE.dice_nums :" + S_MARBLE.dice_nums.toString());
  console.log(" S_MARBLE.dice_roll_result :" + S_MARBLE.dice_roll_result)
};
S_MARBLE.check_roll_dice = function() {
  S_MARBLE.ani_play_count > 0 || (USER.dice <= 0 ? S_MARBLE.popup_ruby() : S_MARBLE.roll_dice("DICE"))
};
S_MARBLE.roll_dice = function(n) {
  S_MARBLE.ani_play_count > 0 || (S_MARBLE.ani_play_count++, console.log(" roll_dice S_MARBLE.ani_play_count:" + S_MARBLE.ani_play_count), S_MARBLE.get_random_dices(), S_MARBLE.update_dice_info(), loading_show("rolling_dice", 1), ServerConnection.update_eldo_marble(n, function() {
    S_MARBLE.cur_pos = S_MARBLE.target_pos;
    S_MARBLE.ani_dice();
    S_MARBLE.update_ui_info()
  }))
};
S_MARBLE.test_roll_dice = function(n) {
  S_MARBLE.ani_play_count > 0 || (S_MARBLE.ani_play_count++, S_MARBLE.get_random_dices(), S_MARBLE.dice_roll_result = n, S_MARBLE.update_dice_info(), S_MARBLE.cur_pos = S_MARBLE.target_pos, S_MARBLE.ani_dice())
};
S_MARBLE.update_dice_info = function(n) {
  var t = n || S_MARBLE.dice_roll_result;
  S_MARBLE.target_pos = (S_MARBLE.cur_pos + t) % 16;
  S_MARBLE.reward_value = S_MARBLE.reward_tables[S_MARBLE.target_pos];
  S_MARBLE.run_commands = S_MARBLE.get_movement_path(S_MARBLE.cur_pos, S_MARBLE.target_pos).full_path;
  S_MARBLE.final_reward_value = S_MARBLE.get_final_reward();
  console.log(" S_MARBLE.cur_pos :" + S_MARBLE.cur_pos);
  console.log(" target_pos :" + S_MARBLE.target_pos);
  console.log(" S_MARBLE.run_commands :" + S_MARBLE.run_commands.toString())
};
S_MARBLE.get_final_reward = function() {
  return S_MARBLE.reward_value == -1 ? "ruby" : S_MARBLE.reward_value == 1 ? "gold" : S_MARBLE.reward_value == 3 ? "gold" : S_MARBLE.reward_value == 0 ? "start" : S_MARBLE.reward_value
};
S_MARBLE.get_reward_text = function() {
  return S_MARBLE.reward_value == "gold" ? TXT.marble_reward1 : S_MARBLE.reward_value == "ruby" ? TXT.marble_reward2 : S_MARBLE.reward_value == "bp" ? TXT.marble_reward3 : S_MARBLE.reward_value == "cloud" ? TXT.marble_reward4 : ""
};

S_MARBLE.get_movement_path = function(n, t) {
  for (var i = [], r = n, s, u, f, e, o; r !== t;) s = (r + 1) % 16, u = s === t, r >= 0 && r <= 4 ? u ? i.push("jump_right") : i.push("move_right") : r >= 5 && r <= 7 ? u ? i.push("jump_up") : i.push("move_up") : r >= 8 && r <= 12 ? u ? i.push("jump_left") : i.push("move_left") : r >= 13 && r <= 15 && (u ? i.push("jump_down") : i.push("move_down")), r = s;
  for (f = {}, e = 0; e < i.length; e++) o = i[e], f[o] || (f[o] = 0), f[o]++;
  return {
    full_path: i,
    summary: f
  }
};
S_MARBLE.run_character_sequence = function(n, t, i, r) {
  function u() {
    if (f.length === 0) {
      console.log("모든 동작 완료");
      typeof r == "function" && r();
      return
    }
    var t = f.shift();
    typeof n[t] == "function" ? (console.log("실행 중: " + t), t.indexOf("jump") !== -1 ? n[t](e, function() {
      u()
    }) : n[t](e, n.move_speed, function() {
      u()
    }), S_MARBLE.delay_n_update_char_num()) : (console.warn("존재하지 않는 함수입니다: " + t), u())
  }
  var f = t.slice(),
    e = i;
  u()
};

CharAnimator = function() {
  function n(n) {
    this.el = document.getElementById(n.container_id);
    this.states = {
      wait: {
        group: document.getElementById(n.wait_group_id),
        images: document.getElementById(n.wait_group_id).getElementsByTagName("img")
      },
      move: {
        group: document.getElementById(n.move_group_id),
        images: document.getElementById(n.move_group_id).getElementsByTagName("img")
      }
    };
    this.current_state = "wait";
    this.current_index = 0;
    this.duration = n.duration || 150;
    this.move_speed = n.move_speed || 3;
    this.ani_timer = null;
    this.action_timer = null;
    this.base_y = parseInt(this.el.style.top) || 0
  }
  return n.prototype.update_frame = function() {
    var n = this.states[this.current_state].images,
      t;
    if (n && n.length) {
      for (t = 0; t < n.length; t++) n[t].style.display = "none";
      this.current_index = (this.current_index + 1) % n.length;
      n[this.current_index].style.display = "block"
    }
  }, n.prototype.hide_all_images = function(n) {
    for (var i = this.states[n].images, t = 0; t < i.length; t++) i[t].style.display = "none"
  }, n.prototype.move_linear = function(n, t, i, r) {
    if (Math.abs(t - n) <= r) return this.el.style[i] = t + "px", !0;
    var u = t > n ? 1 : -1;
    return this.el.style[i] = n + u * r + "px", !1
  }, n.prototype.change_state = function(n) {
    this.current_state !== n && (this.hide_all_images(this.current_state), this.states[this.current_state].group.style.display = "none", this.current_state = n, this.current_index = 0, this.states[this.current_state].group.style.display = "block", this.states[this.current_state].images[0].style.display = "block")
  }, n.prototype.play = function() {
    if (!this.ani_timer) {
      var n = this;
      this.ani_timer = setInterval(function() {
        n.update_frame()
      }, this.duration)
    }
  }, n.prototype.stop = function() {
    this.ani_timer && (clearInterval(this.ani_timer), this.ani_timer = null);
    this.action_timer && (clearInterval(this.action_timer), this.action_timer = null)
  }, n.prototype.jump_right = function(n, t) {
    this.set_flip(!1);
    var i = this,
      f = n || 109,
      e = parseInt(this.el.style.left) || 0,
      o = e + f,
      r = e + 60,
      h = this.move_speed;
    console.log(" jump_right total_x :" + f);
    var c = 41,
      s = !1,
      u = 0;
    this.change_state("move");
    this.play();
    this.action_timer && clearInterval(this.action_timer);
    this.base_y = parseInt(this.el.style.top);
    S_MARBLE.ani_play_count++;
    console.log(" jump_right S_MARBLE.ani_play_count:" + S_MARBLE.ani_play_count);
    this.action_timer = setInterval(function() {
      var n = parseInt(i.el.style.left) || 0,
        f = parseInt(i.el.style.top) || i.base_y,
        a = i.move_linear(n, o, "left", h),
        e, l;
      if (n < r) i.el.style.top = i.base_y + "px";
      else if (s) switch (u) {
        case 0:
          i.move_linear(f, i.base_y - 5, "top", 1) && (S_MARBLE.ani_reward_effect(S_MARBLE.get_char_effect_id()), u = 1);
          break;
        case 1:
          i.move_linear(f, i.base_y - 10, "top", 1) && (u = 2);
          break;
        case 2:
          i.move_linear(f, i.base_y, "top", 1) && (i.stop_action(), typeof t == "function" && t())
      } else e = (n - r) / (o - r), l = 4 * c * e * (1 - e), i.el.style.top = i.base_y - l + "px", a && (s = !0)
    }, 20)
  }, n.prototype.jump_left = function(n, t) {
    var i = this,
      r = n || 109,
      u = parseInt(this.el.style.left) || 0,
      o = u - r,
      s = u - 60,
      h = this.move_speed;
    console.log(" jump_left total_x :" + r);
    var c = 41,
      e = !1,
      f = 0;
    this.set_flip(!0);
    this.change_state("move");
    this.play();
    this.action_timer && clearInterval(this.action_timer);
    this.base_y = parseInt(this.el.style.top);
    S_MARBLE.ani_play_count++;
    console.log(" jump_left S_MARBLE.ani_play_count:" + S_MARBLE.ani_play_count);
    this.action_timer = setInterval(function() {
      var l = parseInt(i.el.style.left) || 0,
        a = parseInt(i.el.style.top) || i.base_y,
        y = i.move_linear(l, o, "left", h),
        n, v;
      if (l > s) i.el.style.top = i.base_y + "px";
      else if (e) switch (f) {
        case 0:
          i.move_linear(a, i.base_y - 5, "top", 1) && (S_MARBLE.ani_reward_effect(S_MARBLE.get_char_effect_id()), f = 1);
          break;
        case 1:
          i.move_linear(a, i.base_y - 10, "top", 1) && (f = 2);
          break;
        case 2:
          i.move_linear(a, i.base_y, "top", 1) && (i.stop_action(), typeof t == "function" && t())
      } else n = (u - 60 - l) / (r - 60), n < 0 && (n = 0), n > 1 && (n = 1), v = 4 * c * n * (1 - n), i.el.style.top = i.base_y - v + "px", y && (e = !0)
    }, 20)
  }, n.prototype.jump_up = function(n, t) {
    this.set_flip(!1);
    this.base_y = parseInt(this.el.style.top) || 0;
    var i = this,
      u = n || 121,
      f = this.move_speed;
    console.log(" jump_up distance :" + u);
    var r = this.base_y - u,
      s = this.base_y - u * (70 / u),
      e = 1,
      o = 0;
    this.change_state("move");
    this.play();
    this.action_timer && clearInterval(this.action_timer);
    S_MARBLE.ani_play_count++;
    console.log(" jump_up S_MARBLE.ani_play_count:" + S_MARBLE.ani_play_count);
    this.action_timer = setInterval(function() {
      var n = parseInt(i.el.style.top) || i.base_y;
      switch (e) {
        case 1:
          i.move_linear(n, s, "top", f) && (e = 2);
          break;
        case 2:
          i.move_linear(n, r, "top", f) && (e = 3);
          break;
        case 3:
          switch (o) {
            case 0:
              i.move_linear(n, r - 5, "top", f) && (S_MARBLE.ani_reward_effect(S_MARBLE.get_char_effect_id()), o = 1);
              break;
            case 1:
              i.move_linear(n, r - 10, "top", 1) && (o = 2);
              break;
            case 2:
              i.move_linear(n, r, "top", 1) && (i.stop_action(), i.base_y = r, typeof t == "function" && t())
          }
      }
    }, 20)
  }, n.prototype.jump_down = function(n, t) {
    this.set_flip(!1);
    var f = parseInt(this.el.style.top) || 0,
      i = this,
      u = n || 121,
      e = this.move_speed;
    console.log(" jump_down distance :" + u);
    var r = f + u,
      h = f + u * (70 / u),
      o = 1,
      s = 0;
    this.change_state("move");
    this.play();
    this.action_timer && clearInterval(this.action_timer);
    S_MARBLE.ani_play_count++;
    console.log(" jump_down S_MARBLE.ani_play_count:" + S_MARBLE.ani_play_count);
    this.action_timer = setInterval(function() {
      var n = parseInt(i.el.style.top) || f;
      switch (o) {
        case 1:
          i.move_linear(n, h, "top", e) && (o = 2);
          break;
        case 2:
          i.move_linear(n, r, "top", e) && (o = 3);
          break;
        case 3:
          switch (s) {
            case 0:
              i.move_linear(n, r + 5, "top", e) && (S_MARBLE.ani_reward_effect(S_MARBLE.get_char_effect_id()), s = 1);
              break;
            case 1:
              i.move_linear(n, r - 5, "top", 1) && (s = 2);
              break;
            case 2:
              i.move_linear(n, r, "top", 1) && (i.stop_action(), i.base_y = r, typeof t == "function" && t())
          }
      }
    }, 20)
  }, n.prototype.set_flip = function(n) {
    n ? ($("#Img_EM_pin").css({
      left: "38px"
    }), $("#Txt_EM_char").css({
      left: "33px"
    }), this.states.wait.group.style.transform = "scaleX(-1)", this.states.move.group.style.transform = "scaleX(-1)") : ($("#Img_EM_pin").css({
      left: "22px"
    }), $("#Txt_EM_char").css({
      left: "17px"
    }), this.states.wait.group.style.transform = "scaleX(1)", this.states.move.group.style.transform = "scaleX(1)")
  }, n.prototype.stop_action = function() {
    this.action_timer && (clearInterval(this.action_timer), this.action_timer = null);
    this.change_state("wait");
    S_MARBLE.ani_play_count--;
    console.log(" stop_action S_MARBLE.ani_play_count:" + S_MARBLE.ani_play_count)
  }, n.prototype.move_left = function(n, t, i) {
    var r = this,
      u = n || 109,
      f = t || this.move_speed,
      e = (parseInt(this.el.style.left) || 0) - u;
    console.log(" move_left distance :" + u);
    this.set_flip(!0);
    this.change_state("move");
    this.play();
    this.action_timer && clearInterval(this.action_timer);
    S_MARBLE.ani_play_count++;
    console.log(" move_left S_MARBLE.ani_play_count:" + S_MARBLE.ani_play_count);
    this.action_timer = setInterval(function() {
      var n = parseInt(r.el.style.left) || 0;
      r.move_linear(n, e, "left", f) && (r.stop_action(), typeof i == "function" && i())
    }, 20)
  }, n.prototype.move_right = function(n, t, i) {
    var f, e;
    this.set_flip(!1);
    var r = this,
      u = n || 109,
      o = t || this.move_speed;
    console.log(" move_right distance :" + u);
    f = parseInt(this.el.style.left) || 0;
    e = f + u;
    this.change_state("move");
    this.play();
    this.action_timer && clearInterval(this.action_timer);
    S_MARBLE.ani_play_count++;
    console.log(" move_right S_MARBLE.ani_play_count:" + S_MARBLE.ani_play_count);
    this.action_timer = setInterval(function() {
      var n = parseInt(r.el.style.left) || 0;
      r.move_linear(n, e, "left", o) && (r.stop_action(), typeof i == "function" && i())
    }, 20)
  }, n.prototype.move_down = function(n, t, i) {
    var r = this,
      u = n || 121,
      f = t || this.move_speed,
      e = (parseInt(this.el.style.top) || 0) + u;
    console.log(" move_down distance :" + u);
    this.set_flip(!1);
    this.change_state("move");
    this.play();
    this.action_timer && clearInterval(this.action_timer);
    S_MARBLE.ani_play_count++;
    console.log(" move_down S_MARBLE.ani_play_count:" + S_MARBLE.ani_play_count);
    this.action_timer = setInterval(function() {
      var n = parseInt(r.el.style.top) || 0;
      r.move_linear(n, e, "top", f) && (r.stop_action(), typeof i == "function" && i())
    }, 20)
  }, n.prototype.move_up = function(n, t, i) {
    var r = this,
      u = n || 121,
      f = t || this.move_speed,
      e = (parseInt(this.el.style.top) || 0) - u;
    console.log(" move_up distance :" + u);
    this.set_flip(!1);
    this.change_state("move");
    this.play();
    this.action_timer && clearInterval(this.action_timer);
    S_MARBLE.ani_play_count++;
    console.log(" move_up S_MARBLE.ani_play_count:" + S_MARBLE.ani_play_count);
    this.action_timer = setInterval(function() {
      var n = parseInt(r.el.style.top) || 0;
      r.move_linear(n, e, "top", f) && (r.stop_action(), typeof i == "function" && i())
    }, 20)
  }, n
}();

S_MOREGAMES.preload = function() {
  var n = S_MOREGAMES.img_base(),
    t = [n + "atv_pagebg.jpg", n + "atv_title_rewards.png", n + "atv_leftbt.png", n + "atv_rightbt.png", n + "atv_backbt.png", n + "atv_backbt_f.png", n + "atv_bt_f.png", n + "atv_bt_rewardbox.png", n + "atv_bt_rewardbox_ruby.png", n + "atv_bt_download.png", n + "atv_bt_download_complete.png", n + "atv_bt_gtd.png", n + "atv_bt_aqua.png", n + "atv_bt_tank.png", n + "atv_bt_tank_lg.png", n + "atv_bt_airforce.png", n + "gtd.png", n + "aqua.png", n + "tank.png", n + "airforce.png"];
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO && (t.push(n + "amo_bt_airforce_shooter.png"), t.push(n + "airforce_shooter.png"), t.push(n + "amo_bt_eldo_goldenpath.png"), t.push(n + "eldo_goldenpath.png"), t.push(n + "amo_bt_orderupcafe.png"), t.push(n + "orderupcafe.png"), t.push(n + "amo_bt_bgwm.png"), t.push(n + "bgwm.png"));
  ChangeScene.preloadImage(t);
  S_MOREGAMES.maketag_base()
};
S_MOREGAMES.maketag_base = function() {
  document.getElementById("S_MOREGAMES_div") == null && $("#S_MAINMENU_div").after('<div id="S_MOREGAMES_div"><\/div>');
  util_draw_div("S_MOREGAMES_div", 0, 0, 1280, 720)
};
S_MOREGAMES.init = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_MOREGAMES.init()");
  S_MOREGAMES.maketag_base();
  $("#S_MOREGAMES_div").empty();
  $("#S_MOREGAMES_div").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  S_MAINMENU.unmount_mm_top();
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MOREGAMES;
  sound_bgm_play(BGM_SOUND.INTRO);
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  utilNotice(TXT.please_wait, .5);
  ServerConnection.getput_moregames_info("get", function() {
    S_MOREGAMES.after_load()
  })
};
S_MOREGAMES.after_load = function() {
  for (var i = S_MOREGAMES.games.length - 1, t = [null], n = 1; n <= i; n++) t.push("MG_card" + n);
  S_MOREGAMES.focus_array = [null, t, [null, "MG_back"]];
  S_MOREGAMES.page = 0;
  S_MOREGAMES.focus_row = 1;
  S_MOREGAMES.focus_col = 1;
  S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_open = !1;
  S_MOREGAMES.maketag_cards();
  S_MOREGAMES.make_screen();
  S_MOREGAMES.addMouseEvent();
  S_MOREGAMES.detect_installed(function() {
    S_MOREGAMES.render_cards()
  });
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_MOREGAMES.drawFocus()
};
S_MOREGAMES.maketag_cards = function() {
  for (var i = document.getElementById("S_MOREGAMES_div"), r = S_MOREGAMES.games.length - 1, t = "", n = 1; n <= r; n++) t += '<div id="MG_card' + n + '" class="button"><img id="MG_card' + n + '_bg"><div id="MG_card' + n + '_title"><\/div><div id="MG_card' + n + '_dscr"><\/div><img id="MG_card' + n + '_reward_bg"><img id="MG_card' + n + '_reward_icon"><div id="MG_card' + n + '_reward_txt"><\/div><img id="MG_card' + n + '_btn_bg"><div id="MG_card' + n + '_btn_txt"><\/div><img id="MG_card' + n + '_focus" class="focus"><\/div>';
  i.innerHTML = '<img id="MG_bg"><div id="MG_title"><img id="MG_title_icon"><div id="MG_title_txt1"><\/div><div id="MG_title_txt2"><\/div><div id="MG_title_txt3"><\/div><\/div><div id="MG_card_row">' + t + '<\/div><img id="MG_arrow_l" class="button"><img id="MG_arrow_r" class="button"><div id="MG_page_ind"><div id="MG_page_text"><\/div><\/div><div id="MG_bottom_tip"><\/div><div id="MG_back" class="button"><img id="MG_back_img"><div id="MG_back_txt"><\/div><img id="MG_back_focus" class="focus"><\/div>'
};

S_MOREGAMES.render_cards = function() {
  var i = S_MOREGAMES.img_base(),
    o = S_MOREGAMES.games.length - 1,
    s = 292,
    u = Math.min(S_MOREGAMES.per_page, o - S_MOREGAMES.page * S_MOREGAMES.per_page),
    h, t, c, f, e;
  for (u < 1 && (u = 1), h = Math.round((1280 - ((u - 1) * s + 276)) / 2), t = 1; t <= o; t++) {
    var n = S_MOREGAMES.games[t],
      a = Math.floor((t - 1) / S_MOREGAMES.per_page),
      v = (t - 1) % S_MOREGAMES.per_page;
    switch (n.app) {
      case "gtd":
        n.fname = "atv_bt_gtd";
        n.icon_fname = "gtd";
        n.name = TXT.gold_tower_defence;
        n.name_en = "Gold Tower Defence";
        n.description = TXT.gold_tower_defence_description;
        break;
      case "aqua":
        n.fname = "atv_bt_aqua";
        n.icon_fname = "aqua";
        n.name = TXT.digital_aqua;
        n.name_en = "Digital Aqua";
        n.description = TXT.digital_aqua_description;
        break;
      case "tank":
        n.fname = "atv_bt_tank";
        n.icon_fname = "tank";
        n.name = TXT.intank;
        n.name_en = "Incredible Tank";
        n.description = TXT.intank_description;
        break;
      case "airforce":
        n.fname = "atv_bt_airforce";
        n.icon_fname = "airforce";
        n.name = TXT.airforce;
        n.name_en = "Air Force";
        n.description = TXT.airforce_description;
        break;
      case "airforce_m":
        n.fname = "amo_bt_airforce_shooter";
        n.icon_fname = "airforce_shooter";
        n.name = TXT.airforce_shooter;
        n.description = TXT.airforce_shooter_description;
        break;
      case "goldenpath":
        n.fname = "amo_bt_eldo_goldenpath";
        n.icon_fname = "eldo_goldenpath";
        n.name = TXT.golden_path;
        n.description = TXT.golden_path_description;
        break;
      case "orderupcafe":
        n.fname = "amo_bt_orderupcafe";
        n.icon_fname = "orderupcafe";
        n.name = TXT.order_up_cafe;
        n.description = TXT.order_up_cafe_description;
        break;
      case "bgwm":
        n.fname = "amo_bt_bgwm";
        n.icon_fname = "bgwm";
        n.name = TXT.busidol_game_world;
        n.description = TXT.busidol_game_world_description
    }
    if (a != S_MOREGAMES.page) {
      $("#MG_card" + t).css({
        display: "none"
      });
      continue
    }
    c = h + v * s;
    $("#MG_card" + t).css({
      left: c + "px",
      top: "195px",
      width: "276px",
      height: "383px",
      position: "absolute",
      display: "block"
    });
    f = n.fname;
    n.fname == "atv_bt_tank" && (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR) && (f = n.fname + "_lg");
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("MG_card" + t + "_bg", i + f + ".png", 0, 0);
    for (var l = n.name || "", r = USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? 30 : 26, y = /[가-힣]/.test(l) ? 1 : .55; r > 14 && l.length * r * y > 276;) r -= 2;
    util_draw_text_html(n.name, "MG_card" + t + "_title", 0, 180, 276, 40, 30, r, "center", "#ffd24a");
    util_draw_textshadow("MG_card" + t + "_title", "#000000", 2);
    util_draw_text_html(n.description, "MG_card" + t + "_dscr", 0, 219, 276, 24, 16, USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? 16 : 14, "center", "#ffffff");
    util_draw_textshadow("MG_card" + t + "_dscr", "#000000", 2);
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("MG_card" + t + "_reward_bg", i + "atv_bt_rewardbox.png", 35, 252);
    n.status == 1 ? ($("#MG_card" + t + "_reward_icon").css({
      display: "none"
    }), util_draw_text_html(TXT.reward_claimed, "MG_card" + t + "_reward_txt", 35, 268, 206, 26, 22, 18, "center", "#7fe0a0")) : (utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("MG_card" + t + "_reward_icon", i + "atv_bt_rewardbox_ruby.png", 53, 262), $("#MG_card" + t + "_reward_icon").css({
      display: "block"
    }), util_draw_text_html(n.reward, "MG_card" + t + "_reward_txt", 79, 268, 146, 26, 22, 22, "center", "#ffd24a"));
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("MG_card" + t + "_btn_bg", i + (n.is_installed ? "atv_bt_download_complete.png" : "atv_bt_download.png"), 35, 310);
    util_draw_text_html(n.is_installed ? TXT.play : TXT.download, "MG_card" + t + "_btn_txt", 79, 328, 146, 24, 18, 18, "center", "#ffffff");
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("MG_card" + t + "_focus", i + "atv_bt_f.png", -7, -7);
    $("#MG_card" + t + "_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    })
  }
  e = S_MOREGAMES.last_page();
  $("#MG_page_text").html(S_MOREGAMES.page + 1 + "/" + Math.max(1, e + 1));
  $("#MG_arrow_l").css({
    display: S_MOREGAMES.page > 0 ? "block" : "none"
  });
  $("#MG_arrow_r").css({
    display: S_MOREGAMES.page < e ? "block" : "none"
  });
  S_MOREGAMES.drawFocus()
};
S_MOREGAMES.last_page = function() {
  return Math.ceil((S_MOREGAMES.games.length - 1) / S_MOREGAMES.per_page) - 1
};
S_MOREGAMES.flip = function(n) {
  var t = S_MOREGAMES.page + n,
    i, r;
  t < 0 || t > S_MOREGAMES.last_page() || (S_MOREGAMES.page = t, i = t * S_MOREGAMES.per_page + 1, r = Math.min(i + S_MOREGAMES.per_page - 1, S_MOREGAMES.games.length - 1), S_MOREGAMES.focus_row = 1, S_MOREGAMES.focus_col = n > 0 ? i : r, S_MOREGAMES.render_cards(), sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT))
};
S_MOREGAMES.cur_card_index = function() {
  var n = S_MOREGAMES.focus_array[S_MOREGAMES.focus_row][S_MOREGAMES.focus_col];
  return n && n.indexOf("MG_card") == 0 ? parseInt(n.substring(7), 10) : 0
};
S_MOREGAMES.move = function(n) {
  var t = S_MOREGAMES.focus_row,
    i = S_MOREGAMES.focus_col,
    r = S_MOREGAMES.focus_array,
    u, f;
  n == "left" ? i = Math.max(1, i - 1) : n == "right" ? i = Math.min(r[t].length - 1, i + 1) : n == "up" ? t = Math.max(1, t - 1) : n == "down" && (t = Math.min(r.length - 1, t + 1));
  r[t] && r[t][i] != null || (r[t] && (i = Math.min(i, r[t].length - 1)), r[t] && r[t][i] != null || (i = r[t] ? r[t].length - 1 : 1));
  i < 1 && (i = 1);
  S_MOREGAMES.focus_row = t;
  S_MOREGAMES.focus_col = i;
  u = S_MOREGAMES.cur_card_index();
  u > 0 && (f = Math.floor((u - 1) / S_MOREGAMES.per_page), f != S_MOREGAMES.page && (S_MOREGAMES.page = f, S_MOREGAMES.render_cards()));
  S_MOREGAMES.drawFocus();
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT)
};
S_MOREGAMES.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  if (S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_open) {
    S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_key(i);
    return
  }
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_MOREGAMES.move("left");
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_MOREGAMES.move("right");
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_MOREGAMES.move("up");
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_MOREGAMES.move("down");
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_MOREGAMES.menu_run();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.back:
    case KeyDefine.esc:
      S_MOREGAMES.go_back()
  }
};
S_MOREGAMES.go_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_MOREGAMES.back()
};
S_MOREGAMES.backKey = function() {
  if (S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_open) {
    S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_close();
    return
  }
  S_MOREGAMES.back()
};
S_MOREGAMES.drawFocus = function() {
  $(".focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_MOREGAMES.btn_id = S_MOREGAMES.focus_array[S_MOREGAMES.focus_row][S_MOREGAMES.focus_col];
  $("#" + S_MOREGAMES.btn_id + "_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  })
};
S_MOREGAMES.is_back = function() {
  return S_MOREGAMES.focus_array[S_MOREGAMES.focus_row][S_MOREGAMES.focus_col] == "MG_back"
};
S_MOREGAMES.menu_run = function() {
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  utilScale_xy_center(S_MOREGAMES.btn_id, 1.1, 1.1);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center(S_MOREGAMES.btn_id, 1, 1);
    S_MOREGAMES.menu_run_run()
  }, 100)
};
S_MOREGAMES.menu_run_run = function() {
  if (S_MOREGAMES.btn_id == "MG_back") {
    S_MOREGAMES.go_back();
    return
  }
  S_MOREGAMES.btn_id && S_MOREGAMES.btn_id.indexOf("MG_card") == 0 && S_MOREGAMES.select_game(parseInt(S_MOREGAMES.btn_id.substring(7), 10))
};
S_MOREGAMES.select_game = function(n) {
  var t = S_MOREGAMES.games[n];
  if (t) {
    if (t.is_installed && t.status == 0) {
      ServerConnection.getput_moregames_info("보상지급:" + t.app, function() {
        S_MOREGAMES.detect_installed(function() {
          S_MOREGAMES.render_cards();
          S_MOREGAMES.open_link(S_MOREGAMES.games[n])
        })
      });
      return
    }
    S_MOREGAMES.open_link(t);
    S_MOREGAMES.render_cards()
  }
};
S_MOREGAMES.back = function() {
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  S_MOREGAMES.removeMouseEvent();
  $("#S_MOREGAMES_div").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU)
};
S_MOREGAMES.WEBOS_STORE_KEYS = ["lg_store", "lgtv_store", "lgsw_store", "lgwebos_store", "lgauto_store", "lgs_store", "lgw_store"];
S_MOREGAMES.webos_appid = function(n) {
  return String(n && n.lg_store || "")
};
S_MOREGAMES.webos_candidates = function(n) {
  if (!n) return [];
  for (var r = S_MOREGAMES.WEBOS_STORE_KEYS, u = [], f = {}, t, i = 0; i < r.length; i++) t = n[r[i]], t && !f[t] && (f[t] = 1, u.push(t));
  return u
};
S_MOREGAMES.webos_installed_pkg = function(n) {
  for (var t = S_MOREGAMES.webos_candidates(n), r = S_MOREGAMES.webos_installed || {}, i = 0; i < t.length; i++)
    if (r[t[i]]) return t[i];
  return t.length ? t[0] : S_MOREGAMES.webos_appid(n)
};
S_MOREGAMES.webos_inst = function(n) {
  var r = S_MOREGAMES.webos_installed,
    i, t;
  if (!r) return !1;
  for (i = S_MOREGAMES.webos_candidates(n), t = 0; t < i.length; t++)
    if (r[i[t]]) return !0;
  return !1
};
S_MOREGAMES.webos_installed = null;
S_MOREGAMES.webos_detect = function(n) {
  var u, e;
  if (!(typeof webOS != "undefined" && webOS.service && webOS.service.request)) {
    S_MOREGAMES.webos_installed = {};
    n && n();
    return
  }
  u = S_MOREGAMES.games;
  e = {};
  S_MOREGAMES.webos_installed = e;
  for (var f = 0, s = !1, o = function() {
      f--;
      s && f <= 0 && n && n()
    }, c = function(n) {
      try {
        webOS.service.request("luna://com.webos.applicationManager", {
          method: "getAppLoadStatus",
          parameters: {
            appId: n
          },
          onSuccess: function(t) {
            t && t.exist && (e[n] = 1);
            o()
          },
          onFailure: function() {
            o()
          }
        })
      } catch (t) {
        o()
      }
    }, h = {}, t, i, r = 1; r < u.length; r++)
    if (u[r])
      for (i = S_MOREGAMES.webos_candidates(u[r]), t = 0; t < i.length; t++) i[t] && !h[i[t]] && (h[i[t]] = 1, f++, c(i[t]));
  s = !0;
  f == 0 && n && n()
};
S_MOREGAMES.get_device_platform = function() {
  return gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? "M" : glo.fun.get_dbname_by_patform()
};
S_MOREGAMES.play_url = function(n) {
  return n ? String(n.amo_store || n.atv_store || "") : ""
};
S_MOREGAMES.android_pkg = function(n) {
  var t = String(S_MOREGAMES.play_url(n)).match(/[?&]id=([^&]+)/);
  return t ? decodeURIComponent(t[1]) : ""
};
S_MOREGAMES.detect_installed = function(n) {
  var t = S_MOREGAMES.games,
    i, r;
  if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV) {
    S_MOREGAMES.webos_detect(function() {
      for (var i = 1; i < t.length; i++) t[i] && (t[i].is_installed = S_MOREGAMES.webos_inst(t[i]), t[i]._installed_pkg = S_MOREGAMES.webos_installed_pkg(t[i]));
      n && n()
    });
    return
  }
  if (glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) {
    for (i = 1; i < t.length; i++)
      if (t[i]) {
        t[i].is_installed = !1;
        try {
          r = S_MOREGAMES.android_pkg(t[i]);
          r && typeof AndroidBridge != "undefined" && AndroidBridge.isInstalled && AndroidBridge.isInstalled(r) && (t[i].is_installed = !0)
        } catch (u) {}
      } n && n();
    return
  }
  if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR) {
    for (i = 1; i < t.length; i++) t[i] && (t[i].is_installed = S_MOREGAMES.tizen_inst(t[i]));
    n && n();
    return
  }
  n && n()
};
S_MOREGAMES.open_link = function(n) {
  if (n) {
    if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV) {
      n.is_installed ? S_MOREGAMES.open_webos(n) : S_MOREGAMES.make_down_pop(n);
      return
    }
    if (glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE) {
      S_MOREGAMES.open_android(n);
      return
    }
    if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR) {
      n.is_installed ? S_MOREGAMES.open_tizen(n) : S_MOREGAMES.make_down_pop(n);
      return
    }
    S_MOREGAMES.open_url(S_MOREGAMES.play_url(n))
  }
};
S_MOREGAMES.open_webos = function(n) {
  try {
    if (typeof webOS == "undefined" || !webOS.service || !webOS.service.request) return;
    if (n.is_installed) {
      var t = S_MOREGAMES.webos_installed_pkg(n);
      webOS.service.request("luna://com.webos.applicationManager", {
        method: "launch",
        parameters: {
          id: t
        },
        onSuccess: function() {},
        onFailure: function() {
          S_MOREGAMES.webos_store(n)
        }
      })
    } else S_MOREGAMES.webos_store(n)
  } catch (i) {
    utilConsoleLog("S_MOREGAMES.open_webos error: " + i)
  }
};
S_MOREGAMES.webos_store = function() {
  try {
    webOS.service.request("luna://com.webos.service.applicationmanager", {
      method: "launch",
      parameters: {
        id: "com.webos.app.discovery"
      }
    })
  } catch (n) {
    utilConsoleLog("S_MOREGAMES.webos_store error: " + n)
  }
};
S_MOREGAMES.open_android = function(n) {
  try {
    var i = S_MOREGAMES.android_pkg(n),
      t = S_MOREGAMES.play_url(n);
    if (!t) {
      utilConsoleLog("S_MOREGAMES.open_android: store url is empty. app=" + (n && n.app));
      return
    }
    if (n.is_installed && i && typeof AndroidBridge != "undefined" && AndroidBridge.launchApp) {
      AndroidBridge.launchApp(i, t);
      return
    }
    if (typeof AndroidBridge != "undefined" && AndroidBridge.openUrl) {
      AndroidBridge.openUrl(t);
      return
    }
  } catch (r) {}
  S_MOREGAMES.open_url(S_MOREGAMES.play_url(n))
};
S_MOREGAMES.open_url = function(n) {
  if (n) try {
    window.open(n, "_blank")
  } catch (t) {
    try {
      location.href = n
    } catch (i) {}
  }
};
S_MOREGAMES.tizen_appid = function(n) {
  return String(n && n.ss_store || "")
};
S_MOREGAMES.tizen_inst = function(n) {
  var t = S_MOREGAMES.tizen_appid(n);
  if (!t || typeof tizen == "undefined" || !tizen.application) return !1;
  try {
    return !!tizen.application.getAppInfo(t)
  } catch (i) {
    return !1
  }
};
S_MOREGAMES.open_tizen = function(n) {
  try {
    var t = S_MOREGAMES.tizen_appid(n);
    if (n.is_installed && t && typeof tizen != "undefined" && tizen.application) {
      tizen.application.launch(t, function() {}, function() {
        S_MOREGAMES.make_down_pop(n)
      });
      return
    }
  } catch (i) {
    utilConsoleLog("S_MOREGAMES.open_tizen error: " + i)
  }
  S_MOREGAMES.make_down_pop(n)
};
S_MOREGAMES.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_MOREGAMES_div").mouseover(S_MOREGAMES.onMouseover)
};
S_MOREGAMES.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_MOREGAMES_div").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_MOREGAMES.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0 && !S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_open) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      }(t.id.search("MG_card") >= 0 || t.id.search("MG_back") >= 0) && S_MOREGAMES.focus_to(t.id)
  }
};
S_MOREGAMES.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0 && !S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_open) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (t.id.search("MG_arrow_l") >= 0) {
      S_MOREGAMES.flip(-1);
      return
    }
    if (t.id.search("MG_arrow_r") >= 0) {
      S_MOREGAMES.flip(1);
      return
    }(t.id.search("MG_card") >= 0 || t.id.search("MG_back") >= 0) && (S_MOREGAMES.focus_to(t.id), S_MOREGAMES.menu_run())
  }
};
S_MOREGAMES.onMousedown = function(n) {
  S_MOREGAMES.onMouseover(n)
};
S_MOREGAMES.onMouseup = function(n) {
  S_MOREGAMES.onMouseover(n);
  S_MOREGAMES.onClick(n)
};
S_MOREGAMES.focus_to = function(n) {
  for (var i, r, t = 1; t < S_MOREGAMES.focus_array.length; t++)
    if (r = S_MOREGAMES.focus_array[t], r)
      for (i = 1; i < r.length; i++)
        if (r[i] == n) {
          S_MOREGAMES.focus_row = t;
          S_MOREGAMES.focus_col = i;
          S_MOREGAMES.drawFocus();
          return
        }
};
S_MOREGAMES.make_down_pop = function(n) {
  var t, s, r, i, h, u, f;
  if (n) {
    S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_inject_css();
    t = n.name || "";
    s = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && USER.lang == LANG.KOREA && n.name_en && n.name_en != t && TXT.how_to_down_tip_lg ? TXT.how_to_down_tip_lg.replace(/%n/g, t).replace(/%e/g, n.name_en) : TXT.how_to_down_tip.replace(/%n/g, t);
    var c = S_MOREGAMES.img_base() + (n.icon_fname || n.fname || "atv_bt_aqua") + ".png",
      e = !(gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR),
      o = "";
    e && (o += '<div class="mg_guide_btn mg_guide_go" id="mg_guide_go">' + TXT.move_apps + "<\/div>");

    r && r.parentNode.removeChild(r);

    S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_game = n;
    S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_has_go = e;
    S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_sel = e ? 0 : 1;
    $(".focus").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    u = document.getElementById("mg_guide_go");
    f = document.getElementById("mg_guide_cancel");
    u && (u.onmouseover = function() {
      S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_sel = 0;
      S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_paint()
    }, u.onclick = function() {
      S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_go()
    });
    f && (f.onmouseover = function() {
      S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_sel = 1;
      S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_paint()
    }, f.onclick = function() {
      S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_close()
    });

  }
};

    t = document.getElementById("mg_guide_cancel");

  S_MOREGAMES.drawFocus()

S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_go = function() {
  var n = S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_game;
  (S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_close(), n) && gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && S_MOREGAMES.webos_store(n)
};
S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_key = function(n) {
  switch (n) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (!S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_has_go) break;
      S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_sel = n == KeyDefine.left ? 0 : 1;
      S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_paint();
      sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_has_go && S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_sel == 0 ? S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_go() : S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_close();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.back:
    case KeyDefine.esc:
      S_MOREGAMES.down_pop_close()
  }
};

S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + i + " in S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.keyDown()");
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      $("#AE_popup").css("display") == "block" ? $("#AE_popup").hide() : gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      $("#AE_popup").css("display") == "none" && (S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus == 2 && REWARD_AD.is_shown("AE_ad_btn") ? (S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus = 3, S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.drawFocus()) : S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus == 3 ? (S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus = 1, S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.drawFocus()) : S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus == 2 && (S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus = 1, S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.drawFocus()));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      $("#AE_popup").css("display") == "none" && (S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus == 1 && REWARD_AD.is_shown("AE_ad_btn") ? (S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus = 3, S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.drawFocus()) : S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus == 3 ? (S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus = 2, S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.drawFocus()) : S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus == 1 && (S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus = 2, S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.drawFocus()));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      $("#AE_popup").css("display") == "block" ? $("#AE_popup").hide() : S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus == 2 ? (S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.show_popup_check_stamp(), $("#AE_popup").show()) : S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus == 3 ? S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.run_reward_ad() : gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      $("#AE_popup").css("display") == "none" && (S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.show_popup_check_stamp(), $("#AE_popup").show())
  }
};

S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.end = function() {
  clearTimeout(S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render_timer_num);
  S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render_timer_num = null;
  $("#S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT_div").remove();
  S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.back = function() {
  S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.end();
  S_SELECTEVENT.init()
};
S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.start_render = function() {
  clearTimeout(S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render_timer_num);
  S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render_timer_num = null;
  S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render_count = 1;
  S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render_timer_num = setTimeout(S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render, S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render_time)
};
S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render = function() {
  if (!$("#S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT_div").html()) {
    console.log(" S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render  clearTimeout ");
    clearTimeout(S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render_timer_num);
    S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render_timer_num = null;
    return
  }
  $("#AE_time_txt").text(util.get_remain_time(S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.end_time));
  console.log(" S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render ");
  S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render_count++;
  S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render_timer_num = setTimeout(S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render, S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.render_time)
};
S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT_div").click(S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.onClick).mouseover(S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.onMouseover).mouseout(S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.onMouseout)
};
S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT_div").unbind("click").unbind("mouseover").unbind("mouseout")
};

};

S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.onMouseover = function(n) {
  switch (n.target.id) {
    case "Img_AE_button_left":
    case "Img_AE_button_left_f":
      S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus = 1;
      break;
    case "Img_AE_button_right":
    case "Img_AE_button_right_f":
      S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus = 2;
      break;
    case "AE_back":
    case "AE_back_focus":
      S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus = 1;
      S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "AE_how":
    case "AE_how_focus":
    case "AE_how_num":
      S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus = 2;
      S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.drawFocus();
      break;
    case "AE_ad_btn":
    case "Txt_AE_ad_btn_label":
    case "Txt_AE_ad_btn_sub":
    case "Img_AE_ad_btn_dim":
    case "AE_ad_focus":
      S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.focus = 3;
      S_ATTENDANCE_EVENT.drawFocus()
  }
};

S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focusRun = function() {
  switch (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus) {
    case 1:
      USER.missile_cur_tick >= USER.missile_full_tick && (S_GAME.effect_del("game_ui_missile"), USER.missile_cur_tick = 0, CASTLE_OUR.mode = MODE.ATTACK, S_GAME.bottom_ui.reder_missile_gage());
      break;
    case 2:
      if (USER.mineral_cur_level >= MINERAL_LEVEL_MAX) {
        utilConsoleLog("Your Mineral Level ... MAX...");
        return
      }
      USER.mineral_cur >= MINERAL_LEVEL_ARRAY[USER.mineral_cur_level].need_mineral ? (sound_play(EFF_SOUND.CHAR_CREATE), S_GAME.mineral_effect_f(), USER.mineral_cur = Math.round(USER.mineral_cur) - MINERAL_LEVEL_ARRAY[USER.mineral_cur_level].need_mineral, USER.mineral_cur_level++, S_GAME.bottom_ui.update_mineral_level(), S_GAME.bottom_ui.update_mineral_count(), S_GAME.effect_del("game_ui_mineral")) : utilConsoleLog("need more mineral.. please wait..");
      break;
    case 3:
    case 4:
    case 5:
    case 6:
    case 7:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN.startUnit(S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus - 2);
      break;
    case 8:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV ? glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_CLOUD_GARDEN.backKey() : (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.pause(), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.end(), S_POPUPYN.focus = 2, ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN));
      return
  }
};

S_CLOUD_GARDEN.autoYourTeamManager_timeout = function() {
  if (g_sceneinfo.cur_scene != gS_CLOUD_GARDEN) {
    utilConsoleLog("by pass----------");
    return
  }
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene + "- CLOUD_GARDEN : " + S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage);
  var n = new Date;
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.your_team_start_time = n.getTime();
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.acc_your_num >= CLOUD_GARDEN_STAGE_DESIGN[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage].cloud_garden_max_num ? (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.acc_your_num = 0, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.timer_autoYourTeamManager != null && (clearInterval(S_CLOUD_GARDEN.timer_autoYourTeamManager), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.timer_autoYourTeamManager = null), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.timer_autoYourTeamManager = setTimeout(function() {
    g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_CLOUD_GARDEN ? (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.timer_autoYourTeamManager != null && (clearInterval(S_CLOUD_GARDEN.timer_autoYourTeamManager), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.timer_autoYourTeamManager = null), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.autoYourTeamManager_timeout()) : utilConsoleLog("Wave ended!--")
  }, CLOUD_GARDEN_STAGE.char_interval[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage] * CLOUD_GARDEN_TIMER_INTERVAL * 1.5), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.your_team_remain_time = CLOUD_GARDEN_STAGE.char_interval[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage] * CLOUD_GARDEN_TIMER_INTERVAL * 1.5) : (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.addYourUnit(CLOUD_GARDEN_STAGE_DESIGN[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage].cloud_garden_num[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.acc_your_num + 1]), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.acc_your_num++, g_sceneinfo.cur_scene == gS_CLOUD_GARDEN ? (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.timer_autoYourTeamManager != null && (clearInterval(S_CLOUD_GARDEN.timer_autoYourTeamManager), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.timer_autoYourTeamManager = null), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.timer_autoYourTeamManager = setTimeout(S_CLOUD_GARDEN.autoYourTeamManager_timeout, CLOUD_GARDEN_STAGE.char_interval[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage] * CLOUD_GARDEN_TIMER_INTERVAL), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.your_team_remain_time = CLOUD_GARDEN_STAGE.char_interval[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage] * CLOUD_GARDEN_TIMER_INTERVAL) : utilConsoleLog("Wave endded~"))
};

S_CLOUD_GARDEN.render_raf = function() {
  if (S_GAME.render_paused && !S_GAME.done_render_raf) {
    console.log(" render_raf  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.start_render_num: " + S_GAME.start_render_num);
    window.requestAFrame(S_CLOUD_GARDEN.render_raf);
    return
  }
  S_GAME.done_render_raf || window.requestAFrame(S_CLOUD_GARDEN.render_raf)
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.interval = function() {
  var r = (new Date).getTime(),
    t, n, i;
  if ($("#S_CLOUD_GARDEN_div")[0] && g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === gS_CLOUD_GARDEN) {
    if (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.end_flag == 1) {
      utilConsoleLog("S_CLOUD_GARDEN.end_flag가 1이라서 S_CLOUD_GARDEN.interval() 건너뜀.");
      return
    }
    for (++S_CLOUD_GARDEN.count >= 1e6 && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.count = 1), context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, 576), t = 1; t <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; t++) OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1 && S_CLOUD_GARDEN.interval_set_our_div(t);
    for (n = 1; n <= MAX_CLOUD_GARDEN_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && S_CLOUD_GARDEN.count % 3 == 0 && S_CLOUD_GARDEN.interval_set_your_div(n);
    for (n = 1; n <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; n++) OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACK && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACKEND && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.isCanIattack(n) == !1 ? (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].before_x = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + CAL.p_get_move_speed_your(n), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.MOVE, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.our_unit[n].fire_pung.css({
      display: "none"
    }), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.our_unit[n].fire_img.css({
      display: "none"
    }), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.del_check_area_our_char(n), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.our_unit[n].fire_pung_img.css({
      display: "none"
    }), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur = 1, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur = 1) : OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode == MODE.MOVE ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.ATTACK : OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode == MODE.WAIT && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_speed_tick_count++ > OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_speed && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.ATTACK, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_speed_tick_count = 1, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur = 1, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur = 1));
    for (n = 1; n <= MAX_CLOUD_GARDEN_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACK && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACKEND && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode != MODE.DESTROY && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.isCanBossattack(n) == !1 ? (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.WAIT, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.your_unit[n].fire.css({
      display: "none"
    }), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.your_unit[n].fire_pung.css({
      display: "none"
    }), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.your_unit[n].fire_img.css({
      display: "none"
    }), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.your_unit[n].fire_pung_img.css({
      display: "none"
    }), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur = 1, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].destroy_frame_num = 1) : YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode == MODE.WAIT && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_speed_tick_count++);
    S_GAME.render_fever_breath_of_blue_dragon_our();
    S_GAME.render_fever_breath_of_white_tiger_our();
    S_GAME.render_fever_breath_of_black_tortoise_our();
    S_GAME.render_fever_breath_of_vermilion_bird_our();
    S_GAME.ogong_unit && (S_GAME.ogong_unit.render_fever_attack("our"), S_GAME.ogong_unit.render_fever_attack("your"));
    S_GAME.spirit_serpent_unit && (S_GAME.spirit_serpent_unit.render_fever_attack("our"), S_GAME.spirit_serpent_unit.render_fever_attack("your"));
    S_GAME.hyeono_unit && (S_GAME.hyeono_unit.render_fever_attack("our"), S_GAME.hyeono_unit.render_fever_attack("your"));
    S_GAME.animate_shield_102_effect(null, "our");
    S_GAME.animate_reflection_effect("your");
    MINERAL_LEVEL_ARRAY[USER.mineral_cur_level].max > USER.mineral_cur ? (USER.mineral_cur += CAL.get_user_mineral_gap(), S_GAME.bottom_ui.update_current_mineral(), MINERAL_LEVEL_ARRAY[USER.mineral_cur_level].need_mineral <= USER.mineral_cur && USER.mineral_cur_level != MINERAL_LEVEL_MAX && S_GAME.effect_add("game_ui_mineral")) : S_GAME.bottom_ui.update_current_mineral();
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.count % COUNT_BOTTOM_EFFECT == 0 && S_GAME.bottom_effect_interval();
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.count % COUNT_CHARGE == 0 && setTimeout(function() {
      for (var n = 1; n <= USER.socket_available_num; n++) OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].ch_time >= OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].need_ch_time ? OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].ch_time = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].need_ch_time : (OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].ch_time++, OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].ch_time == OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[n].need_ch_time && sound_play(EFF_SOUND.MINERAL_FULL), S_GAME.bottom_ui.draw_one_char_gage(n))
    }, 0);
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.count % COUNT_SCROLL == 0 && (i = S_GAME.where_scroll(), i > 0 && S_GAME.scroll_part(i));
    RASER.flag == 1 && S_CLOUD_GARDEN.fireRaser_interval();
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.count % COUNT_MISSILE == 0 && (USER.missile_cur_tick = USER.missile_cur_tick + USER.missile_full_tick / 10, S_GAME.bottom_ui.reder_missile_gage(), USER.missile_cur_tick >= USER.missile_full_tick && (S_GAME.effect_add("game_ui_missile"), USER.missile_cur_tick == USER.missile_full_tick && sound_play(EFF_SOUND.MINERAL_FULL)));
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.count % COUNT_CASTLE == 0 && (CASTLE_OUR.mode == MODE.WAIT && CASTLE_OUR.mode_before == MODE.WAIT || S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawCastle_our());
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.count % 40 == 0 && check_currentTime();
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.GOLDMAN_STOP_count > 0 && S_CLOUD_GARDEN.GOLDMAN_STOP_count--;
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.p_GOLDMAN_STOP_count > 0 && S_CLOUD_GARDEN.p_GOLDMAN_STOP_count--;
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.timer_interval != null && (clearTimeout(S_CLOUD_GARDEN.timer_interval), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.timer_interval = null);
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.timer_interval = setTimeout(S_CLOUD_GARDEN.interval, CLOUD_GARDEN_TIMER_INTERVAL)
  }
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.mineral_effect_f = function() {
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.mineral_effect.flag == 1 && (clearInterval(S_CLOUD_GARDEN.mineral_effect.timer), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.mineral_effect.cur_frame = 1);
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.mineral_effect.flag = 1;
  var n = function() {
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.mineral_effect.cur_frame <= S_CLOUD_GARDEN.mineral_effect.max_frame ? (S_GAME.bottom_ui.reder_mineral_effect(), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.mineral_effect.cur_frame++, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.mineral_effect.timer != null && (clearInterval(S_CLOUD_GARDEN.mineral_effect.timer), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.mineral_effect.timer = null), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.mineral_effect.timer = setTimeout(n, CLOUD_GARDEN_TIMER_INTERVAL)) : (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.mineral_effect.cur_frame = 1, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.mineral_effect.flag = 0, S_GAME.bottom_ui.hide_mineral_effect())
  };
  n()
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.isCanIattack = function(n) {
  var i = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num,
    f = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power,
    t = S_CLOUD_GARDEN.getYou_firt_one(),
    r, u, e, o;
  return t != 0 && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1 && (r = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num, u = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x + CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[r].beattack_margine - (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w), u <= OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len) ? (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_num = t, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.isCanIattack_fireAni(n, t), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur == OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_num && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACK && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACKEND && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.DESTROY && (e = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp, o = CHAR_YOUR_TEAM[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num].hp / 2, CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_type == ATTACK_TYPE.WIDE || CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_type == ATTACK_TYPE.HIT_WIDE || CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_type == ATTACK_TYPE.FULL_WIDE ? S_CLOUD_GARDEN.featureWideOur(n) : (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.score += Math.floor(f * S_CLOUD_GARDEN.score_correction), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.draw_damage(), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode == MODE.WAIT && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_CLOUD_GARDEN_your_unit" + t + "_img", glo.ser_img_url + "image/char/" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].filename + "/" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].filename + "_beattack_11.png", YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].y))), !0) : !1
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.featureWideOur = function(n) {
  for (var h, u, f, v = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 1), i = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num, e = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power, t = 1; t <= MAX_CLOUD_GARDEN_NUM_ON_SCREEN; t++)
    if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1) {
      var c = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x - (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w),
        y = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp,
        r = !1;
      if (CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_type == ATTACK_TYPE.HIT_WIDE) {
        var o = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_center_x,
          s = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_half_width,
          l = o - s,
          a = o + s;
        YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x + 300 >= l && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x <= a && (r = !0)
      } else CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_type == ATTACK_TYPE.FULL_WIDE ? r = !0 : c <= OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len + 100 && (r = !0);
      if (r) {
        if (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.score += Math.floor(e * S_CLOUD_GARDEN.score_correction), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.draw_damage(), S_GAME.has_innate_ability("our", i, INNATE_ABILITY.MULTI_HIT) && (h = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].socket_index, u = S_GAME.special_ability.get_index_value(i, h, "our", "multi_hit_count"), u > 1))
          for (f = 1; f < u; f++) S_CLOUD_GARDEN.score += Math.floor(e * S_CLOUD_GARDEN.score_correction), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.draw_damage();
        YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode == MODE.WAIT && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_CLOUD_GARDEN_your_unit" + t + "_img", glo.ser_img_url + "image/char/" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].filename + "/" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].filename + "_beattack_11.png", YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].y)
      }
    }
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.getYou_firt_one = function() {
  for (var t = 0, i = 2e3, n = 1; n <= MAX_CLOUD_GARDEN_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && i > YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x && (i = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, t = n);
  return t
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.die_by_your_attack = function(n, t) {
  USER.bekilled++;
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.del_check_area_our_char(n);
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.CHAR_DIE);
  OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.BE_ATTACKED;
  OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].shield_102_time = 0;
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.ourunit_display_none(n);
  t > 0 && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.your_unit[t].fire.css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.your_unit[t].fire_pung.css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.your_unit[t].fire_img.css({
    display: "none"
  }), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.your_unit[t].fire_pung_img.css({
    display: "none"
  }));
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawOurTeamNumber()
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.featureWideYour = function(n) {
  for (var i, r, h = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 1), t = 1; t <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; t++)
    if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1) {
      var f = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x - (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].w),
        e = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp,
        o = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].socket_index,
        s = OUR_TEAM_SOCKET[o].hp,
        u = s / 2;
      if (f <= YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len + 100) {
        if (i = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num, S_GAME.is_koo_char(i)) continue;
        S_GAME.has_special_ability("our", i, SPECIAL_ABILITY.ARMOR) ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].shield_102_time == 0 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - 1) : S_GAME.has_innate_ability("our", i, INNATE_ABILITY.ARMOR) ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].shield_102_time == 0 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - 1) : (r = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].shield_102_time == 0 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp - r));
        S_GAME.apply_reflection_buff(t, n, r, "your");
        console.log(" 구름정원 아군데미지: " + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power + "  남은 HP:" + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp);
        e >= u && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp < u && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].flag_hp_half = 1);
        OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp <= 0 && S_CLOUD_GARDEN.die_by_your_attack(t, n)
      }
    } if (CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp <= 0) {
    CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp = 0;
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.txt_our_castle.text(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp + " / " + CASTLE_OUR.max_hp);
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.ourCastle_destroyAni();
    return
  }
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.txt_our_castle.text(Math.floor(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp) + " / " + CASTLE_OUR.max_hp)
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.win = function() {};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.isCanBossattack = function(n) {
  for (var i, t = 1; t <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_NUM_ON_SCREEN + S_GAME.FOR_GUARDIANS_MAX; t++)
    if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1) return i = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_num = t, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.isCanYouattack_fireAni(n), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur == YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_num && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACK && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode != MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACKEND && S_CLOUD_GARDEN.featureWideYour(n), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur == YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_num && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1 && OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].flag_hp_half == 1 ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].flag_hp_half = 0 : $("#Img_CLOUD_GARDEN_our_unit" + t).css({
      opacity: "1.0",
      "-webkit-transform": "rotate(0deg) scale(1.0,1.0)"
    }), !0;
  if (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.isCanYouattack_fireAni(n), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur == YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_num) {
    if (CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp <= 0) {
      CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp = 0;
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.txt_our_castle.text(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp + " / " + CASTLE_OUR.max_hp);
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN.ourCastle_destroyAni();
      return
    }
    return S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.txt_our_castle.text(Math.floor(CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp) + " / " + CASTLE_OUR.max_hp), !0
  }
  return !0
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawCastle_our = function() {
  var n = null,
    t, i, r;
  CASTLE_OUR.mode_before = CASTLE_OUR.mode;
  switch (CASTLE_OUR.mode) {
    case MODE.DESTROY:
      n = "_destroy";
      break;
    case MODE.WAIT:
      n = "_wait";
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:
      t = CAL.get_our_castle_level();
      i = t <= 3 ? 4 : 6;
      n = "_attack_" + CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_attack;
      CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_attack >= i ? (CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_attack = 1, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.fireRaser(), CASTLE_OUR.mode = MODE.WAIT) : CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_attack++;
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED:
      switch (CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_beattack) {
        case 1:
          n = "_beattack_1";
          CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_beattack = 2;
          break;
        case 2:
          n = "_beattack_2";
          CASTLE_OUR.cur_frame_beattack = 1;
          CASTLE_OUR.mode = MODE.WAIT
      }
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawCastle_our()");
      return
  }
  r = STAGE_DESIGN[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage].castle_our_filename + n + ".png";
  utilDrawImage_no_wh$(S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.our_castle, r, CASTLE_OUR.x, CASTLE_OUR.y, "absolute")
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.startUnit = function(n) {
  S_GAME.startUnit(n)
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.parse_char_ap_info = function() {
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.char_down_arr = [];
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.CHAR_AP_INFO.down != "" && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.char_down_arr = S_CLOUD_GARDEN.CHAR_AP_INFO.down.split(","));
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.char_up_arr = [];
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.CHAR_AP_INFO.up != "" && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.char_up_arr = S_CLOUD_GARDEN.CHAR_AP_INFO.up.split(","))
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.is_char_ap_up = function(n) {
  for (var i = !1, t = 0; t < S_CLOUD_GARDEN.char_up_arr.length; t++)
    if (n == S_CLOUD_GARDEN.char_up_arr[t]) {
      i = !0;
      break
    } return i
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.is_char_ap_down = function(n) {
  for (var i = !1, t = 0; t < S_CLOUD_GARDEN.char_down_arr.length; t++)
    if (n == S_CLOUD_GARDEN.char_down_arr[t]) {
      i = !0;
      break
    } return i
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.addOurUnit = function(n) {
  S_GAME.addOurUnit(n)
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.addYourUnit = function(n) {
  for (var i = 0, t = 1; t <= MAX_CLOUD_GARDEN_NUM_ON_SCREEN; t++)
    if (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 0) {
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num = n;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].index = t;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive = 1;
      utilConsoleLog("S_CLOUD_GARDEN.addYourUnit---->unit_num=" + n);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].socket_index = S_GAME.get_your_socket_index(n);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x = CLOUD_GARDEN_STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage] < 1280 ? 1280 - CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].w + CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].center_gap_x : CLOUD_GARDEN_STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage] - CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].w + CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].center_gap_x;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].y = GAME_BASE_Y - CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].h + CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].center_gap_y;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].name = CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].name;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].filename = CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].filename;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].feature = CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].feature;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].attack_power = CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].ap;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].attack_len = CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].attack_len;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].attack_speed = CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].attack_speed;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].hp = CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].cur_hp;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].full_hp = CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].max_hp;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].w = CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].w;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].h = CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].h;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_frame_num = CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].move_frame_num;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].attack_frame_num = CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].attack_frame_num;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].beattack_frame_num = CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].beattack_frame_num;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].attack_fire_frame = CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].attack_fire_frame;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].fire_frame_num = CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[n].fire_frame_num;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].mode = MODE.WAIT;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].move_frame_cur = 1;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].attack_frame_cur = 1;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].beattack_frame_cur = 1;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].fire_frame_cur = 1;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].wait_frame_cur = 1;
      utilConsoleLog("~~ 보스 생성 완료 ~~");
      i = 1;
      break
    } i == 0 && utilConsoleLog("Full.. please upgrade your  MAX_CLOUD_GARDEN_NUM_ON_SCREEN value")
};

S_CLOUD_GARDEN.interval_set_our_div = function(n) {
  var i = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num,
    f, e, o, u, r, t;
  switch (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode) {
    case MODE.WAIT:
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur++;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur > CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].wait_frame_num && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur = 1);
      break;
    case MODE.MOVE:
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur++;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur > CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].move_frame_num && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur = 1);
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:
      if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur++, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur > CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_frame_num && (S_GAME.is_koo_char(OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num) ? (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].attack_frame_num, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x += DEFINE.COW_MOVE_SPEED, console.log(" 쿠 캐릭터 사라짐  unit_num:" + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num)) : (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.WAIT, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1)), S_GAME.set_normal_attcak_count_of_four_gods(i, n, "our"), OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur == OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_fire_frame) switch (i) {
        case 27:
        case 28:
        case 43:
        case 44:
        case 45:
        case 46:
          var s = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w - 10,
            h = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].h / 2,
            c = s - 52,
            l = h - 52;
          S_GAME.our_char_pung(n, c, l)
      }
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED:
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur++;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur > CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].beattack_frame_num && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1);
      switch (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur) {
        case 1:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 10;
          break;
        case 2:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 10;
          break;
        case 3:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 8;
          break;
        case 4:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 8;
          break;
        case 5:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 3;
          break;
        case 6:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 1
      }
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 114 ? (f = CASTLE_OUR.baseX + CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].game_gap_x, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x < f && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = f)) : OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x < CASTLE_OUR.baseX && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].game_gap_x !== undefined ? CASTLE_OUR.baseX + CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].game_gap_x : CASTLE_OUR.baseX);
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACK:
      if (S_GAME.ranking_mode != 2 || S_GAME.ranking_mode != 3) {
        utilConsoleLog("Error in S_CLOUD_GARDEN.interval_set_our_div()  case MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACK");
        return
      }
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur++;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur > CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].beattack_frame_num && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.WAIT);
      switch (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur) {
        case 1:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 48;
          break;
        case 2:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 42;
          break;
        case 3:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 36;
          break;
        case 4:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 15;
          break;
        case 5:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 12;
          break;
        case 6:
          OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x -= 3
      }
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x < CASTLE_OUR.baseX && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = CASTLE_OUR.baseX);
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACKEND:
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur++;
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur > 15 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.WAIT, OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1);
      e = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x - CASTLE_OUR.baseX;
      o = .1;

      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x < CASTLE_OUR.baseX && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = CASTLE_OUR.baseX);
      OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur == 14 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x = CASTLE_OUR.baseX)
  }
  r = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].socket_index;
  switch (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode) {
    case MODE.MOVE:
      u = LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[r].MOVE[OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur];
      break;
    case MODE.WAIT:
      u = LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[r].WAIT[OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur];
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:

      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED_BACKEND:
      u = S_GAME.is_koo_char(i) ? LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[r].BEATTACK[1] : LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[r].BEATTACK[CHAR_OUR_TEAM[i].beattack_frame_num];

      break;

      utilConsoleLog("Error!! in S_CLOUD_GARDEN.interval_set_our_div 34523423 :" + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode)
  }
  if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode == MODE.ATTACK && i == 50) {

        break;
      case 8:
        t = 87;
        break;
      case 9:
        t = 0
    } else switch (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur) {
      case 1:
        t = 0;
        break;
      case 2:
        t = -10;
        break;
      case 3:
        t = -25;
        break;
      case 4:
        t = -40;
        break;
      case 5:
        t = -55;
        break;
      case 6:
        t = -75;
        break;
      case 7:
        t = -95;
        break;
      case 8:
        t = -100;
        break;
      case 9:
        t = -90;
        break;
      case 10:
        t = -80;
        break;
      case 11:
        t = -60;
        break;
      case 12:
        t = -35;
        break;
      case 13:
        t = 5;

      case 14:

      case 15:

S_CLOUD_GARDEN.interval_set_your_div = function(n) {

    u = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num,
