  s = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].h + "px";
  t = null;
  switch (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode) {
    case MODE.WAIT:
      t = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].filename + "_wait_" + (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur + 10);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur++;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur > CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[u].wait_frame_num && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur = 1);
      break;
    case MODE.MOVE:
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.WAIT;
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:
      t = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].filename + "_attack_" + (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur + 10);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur++;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur > CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[u].attack_frame_num && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1);
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED:
      t = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].filename + "_beattack_" + (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur + 10);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur++;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur > CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[u].beattack_frame_num && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur = 1);
      break;
    case MODE.DESTROY:
      t = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].filename + "_destroy_" + (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].destroy_frame_cur + 10);
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].destroy_frame_cur++;
      YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].destroy_frame_cur > CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[u].destroy_frame_num && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].destroy_frame_cur = 1)
  }
  i = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].socket_index;
  switch (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode) {
    case MODE.MOVE:
      e = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur;
      r = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[i].MOVE[e];
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error! in S_CLOUD_GARDEN.interval_set_your_div() 08990348 :" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode);
    case MODE.WAIT:
      r = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[i].WAIT[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].wait_frame_cur];
      break;
    case MODE.ATTACK:
      r = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[i].ATTACK[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur];
      break;
    case MODE.BE_ATTACKED:
      r = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[i].BEATTACK[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur];
      break;
    case MODE.DESTROY:
      r = LOIMG_CHAR_YOUR[i].DESTROY[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].destroy_frame_cur]
  }
  YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode == MODE.ATTACK ? (h = 0, c = 0, utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_CLOUD_GARDEN_your_unit" + n + "_img", f + t + ".png", YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur == CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num].attack_frame_num && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.WAIT)) : ($("#S_CLOUD_GARDEN_center_shake_div").css({
    top: "0px",
    position: "absolute"
  }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_CLOUD_GARDEN_your_unit" + n + "_img", f + t + ".png", YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y));
  YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode == MODE.BE_ATTACKED && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].beattack_frame_cur == 1 && ($("#Img_CLOUD_GARDEN_your_unit" + n + "_fire").css({
    display: "none"
  }), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.WAIT, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].move_frame_cur = 1, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur = 1)
};
CHECK_AREA = new Array(MAX_OUR_TEAM_UNIT + 1);
CHECK_AREA_count = 0;
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.init_check_area = function() {
  CHECK_AREA_count = 0;
  for (var n = 1; n <= MAX_OUR_TEAM_UNIT; n++) CHECK_AREA[n] = {}, CHECK_AREA[n].x1 = CHECK_AREA[n].x2 = 0
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.add_check_area = function(n, t) {
  if (CHECK_AREA_count + 1 > MAX_OUR_TEAM_UNIT) {
    utilConsoleLog("Error in S_CLOUD_GARDEN.add_check_area():" + CHECK_AREA_count + 1 + "--이게 full찰리가 없는데..");
    return
  }
  CHECK_AREA[CHECK_AREA_count + 1].x1 = n;
  CHECK_AREA[CHECK_AREA_count + 1].x2 = t;
  CHECK_AREA_count++
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.del_check_area = function() {
  if (CHECK_AREA_count <= 0) {
    utilConsoleLog("S_CLOUD_GARDEN.del_check_area() : 여기서 0 이 될리가 없는데..." + CHECK_AREA_count);
    return
  }
  for (var n = 1; n <= CHECK_AREA_count - 1; n++) CHECK_AREA[n].x1 = CHECK_AREA[n + 1].x1, CHECK_AREA[n].x2 = CHECK_AREA[n + 1].x2;
  CHECK_AREA[CHECK_AREA_count].x1 = CHECK_AREA[CHECK_AREA_count].x2 = 0;
  CHECK_AREA_count--;
  return
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.del_check_area_our_char = function(n) {
  if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num == 40) {
    var t = S_CLOUD_GARDEN.$el.our_unit[n].fire_pung_img.css("display");
    t == "block" && S_CLOUD_GARDEN.del_check_area()
  }
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.is_check_area = function(n) {
  for (var t = 1; t <= CHECK_AREA_count; t++)
    if (CHECK_AREA[t].x1 <= n && n <= CHECK_AREA[t].x2) return !0;
  return !1
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.cloud_garden_attack_count_power = function(n) {
  CASTLE_OUR.cur_hp != CASTLE_OUR.max_hp && (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power = Math.floor(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_power * 10))
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.cloud_garden_attack_count_attackspeed = function(n) {
  YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_speed <= 10 || (YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_speed = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_speed - 10)
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.get_missile_level = function() {
  return S_GAME.get_missile_level()
};
your_raser_beattacked = [];
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.fireRaser = function() {
  var i, t, n, r, u;
  if (RASER.flag == 1) {
    utilConsoleLog("Can not fire because firing....");
    return
  }
  for (sound_play(EFF_SOUND.RASER_FIRE), RASER.baseX = CASTLE_OUR.x + STAGE_DESIGN[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage].nose_x, RASER.baseY = CASTLE_OUR.y + STAGE_DESIGN[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage].nose_y, RASER.target_start_x = STAGE_DESIGN[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage].castle_our_w, RASER.target_end_x = Math.min(USER.missile_len, STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage]), RASER.old_x = CASTLE_OUR.x, RASER.w = $("#Img_CLOUD_GARDEN_missile").width(), RASER.h = $("#Img_CLOUD_GARDEN_missile").height(), i = CLOUD_GARDEN_STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage], n = 1; n <= MAX_CLOUD_GARDEN_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && (i = Math.min(YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w / 2 - 10, i));
  for (t = i - CASTLE_OUR.baseX, t <= 60 ? (t = 60, RASER.HEIGHT = Math.floor(15 * 1.5)) : RASER.HEIGHT = Math.floor(t / 10 * 1.5), n = 0; n <= RASER_DELTA_X + 2; n++) RASER.x[n] = Math.round(RASER.baseX - RASER.w / 2 + t / (RASER_DELTA_X + 2) * n), RASER.y[n] = RASER.baseY - Math.round(RASER.HEIGHT / -25 * (n - 5) * (n - 5) + RASER.HEIGHT) - RASER.h;
  for (n = 0; n <= RASER_DELTA_X + 1; n++) r = RASER.x[n + 1] - RASER.x[n], u = RASER.y[n] - RASER.y[n + 1], RASER.deg[n] = 90 - Math.round(Math.atan2(u, r) * 360 / 6.283185);
  RASER.deg[RASER_DELTA_X + 2] = RASER.deg[RASER_DELTA_X + 1];
  RASER.flag = 1
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.fireRaser_interval = function() {
  var n, i, r;
  if (RASER.flag != 0 && (RASER.dx++, $("#Img_CLOUD_GARDEN_missile").css({
      display: "block",
      left: RASER.x[RASER.dx] + "px",
      top: RASER.y[RASER.dx] + "px",
      "-webkit-transform-origin": "50% 100%",
      "-webkit-transform": "rotate(" + RASER.deg[RASER.dx] + "deg)",
      position: "absolute"
    }), RASER.pole_x = RASER.x[RASER.dx] + RASER.w / 2 + RASER.h * Math.sin(RASER.deg[RASER.dx] * Math.PI / 180), RASER.pole_y = RASER.y[RASER.dx] + RASER.h - RASER.h * Math.cos(RASER.deg[RASER.dx] * Math.PI / 180), RASER.dx >= RASER_DELTA_X + 2 || RASER.pole_y >= GAME_BASE_Y - 30)) {
    RASER.dx = -1;
    RASER.flag = 0;
    QUEST.f6_missile();
    var t = RASER.x[RASER_DELTA_X + 2],
      u = t - RASER.damage_range,
      f = t + RASER.damage_range;
    for (n = 1; n <= MAX_CLOUD_GARDEN_NUM_ON_SCREEN; n++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].alive == 1 && (i = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num, r = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[i].beattack_margine);
    $("#Img_CLOUD_GARDEN_missile").css({
      display: "none"
    });
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.fireRaser_attack();
    return
  }
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.fireRaser_attack = function() {
  var i = RASER.x[RASER_DELTA_X],
    r = i - RASER.damage_range,
    u = i + RASER.damage_range,
    n = 1,
    f = 7,
    e = RASER.pole_x,
    o = RASER.pole_y,
    t;
  $("#Img_CLOUD_GARDEN_raser_pung_effect").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  t = function() {
    var i, s;
    if (n <= f) {
      var h = "./image/ui/98_effect/missileEffect_" + n + ".png",
        c = e - 280,
        l = o - 200;
      utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_CLOUD_GARDEN_raser_pung_effect", h, c, l);
      setTimeout(t, TIMER_INTERVAL);
      n++
    } else setTimeout(function() {
      utilDraw_image_1pixel("Img_CLOUD_GARDEN_raser_pung_effect");
      $("#Img_CLOUD_GARDEN_raser_pung_effect").css({
        display: "none"
      })
    }, 50);
    if (n == 5)
      for (i = 1; i <= MAX_CLOUD_GARDEN_NUM_ON_SCREEN; i++) YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].alive == 1 && (s = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].x + CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[i].beattack_margine, r <= s && s <= u && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.score += Math.floor(USER.missile_power * S_CLOUD_GARDEN.score_correction), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.draw_damage(), YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].mode == MODE.WAIT && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_CLOUD_GARDEN_your_unit" + i + "_img", glo.ser_img_url + "image/char/" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].filename + "/" + YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].filename + "_beattack_11.png", YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].x, YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[i].y)))
  };
  t()
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN.run_metor();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.back:
    case KeyDefine.esc:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN.run_back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus == S_GAME.bottom_ui.get_max_btn() ? (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus--, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus()) : S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus >= 2 && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus--, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focusRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus < USER.socket_available_num + 2 ? (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus++, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus()) : S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      3 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus = 3, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus(), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      4 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus = 4, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus(), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
      5 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus = 5, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus(), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM4:
      6 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus = 6, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus(), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM5:
      7 <= USER.socket_available_num + 2 && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus = 7, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus(), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM6:
      gAPP_RELEASE == "TEST";
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM7:
      gAPP_RELEASE == "TEST";
      break;
    case KeyDefine.RED:
    case KeyDefine.A:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus = 1;
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus();
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focusRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.BLUE:
      (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SKB) && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus = 2, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus(), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focusRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.GREEN:
    case KeyDefine.S:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM !== gPLATFORM.KT && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus = 2, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus(), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focusRun())
  }
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_CLOUD_GARDEN.backKey()
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.backKey = function() {
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.pause();
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.end();
  utilPush();
  S_POPUPYN.focus = 2;
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN)
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.run_metor = function() {
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.metor_num > 0 ? (gEnableKey = 0, sound_play(EFF_SOUND.METOR), S_GAME.effect_meteor(), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.metor_num--, S_GAME.top_ui.update_metor_num(S_CLOUD_GARDEN.metor_num)) : utilNotice(TXT.metor_only_one, 1.5)
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.run_zoom = function() {
  if (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.zoom_flag == 0) {
    if (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.notice_flag == 0 && utilNotice(TXT.zoomout, 1.2), SCROLL.flag == 1) return;
    if (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.view_mode != 1) return;
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.modeChange_m();
    S_GAME.top_ui.show_zoom_out();
    setTimeout(function() {
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN.zoom_flag = 1
    }, 1e3)
  } else {
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.notice_flag == 0 && utilNotice(TXT.zoomin, 1.2);
    S_GAME.top_ui.show_zoom_in();
    var n = glo.ser_img_url + "image/bg/mapCLOUD_GARDEN_bg.jpg";
    $("#Img_CLOUD_GARDEN_center_bg").css({
      top: GAME_BASE_Y - 774 + "px",
      background: util_bg_url("url(" + n + ")"),
      "background-repeat": "repeat-x"
    });
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.view_mode = 1;
    $("#S_CLOUD_GARDEN_center").css({
      left: "0px",
      top: "0px",
      width: "1280px",
      height: "720px",
      position: "absolute"
    });
    utilConsoleLog("View mode 작동=====> " + S_CLOUD_GARDEN.view_mode);
    utilScale_xy("S_CLOUD_GARDEN_center", S_CLOUD_GARDEN.view_mode, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.view_mode);
    SCROLL.part_cur_num = 1;
    setTimeout(function() {
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN.zoom_flag = 0
    }, 1e3)
  }
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } S_CLOUD_GARDEN.board.flag == 0 ? t.id.search("metor") >= 0 ? S_CLOUD_GARDEN.run_metor() : t.id.search("zoom") >= 0 ? S_CLOUD_GARDEN.run_zoom() : t.id.search("back") >= 0 ? S_CLOUD_GARDEN.run_back() : S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focusRun() : S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focusRun_board();
    return
  }
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.onMouseover = function(n) {
  for (var t = n.target, i; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
    if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
      t = null;
      return
    } S_CLOUD_GARDEN.board.flag == 0 ? t.id.search(S_GAME.bottom_ui.get_missile_id()) >= 0 ? (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus = 1, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus()) : t.id.search(S_GAME.bottom_ui.get_mineral_id()) >= 0 ? (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus = 2, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus()) : t.id.search(S_GAME.bottom_ui.get_char_id()) >= 0 && (i = glo.fun.get_only_number_by_text(t.id), USER.socket_available_num >= i && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus = i + 2), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus()) : (t.id.search("btn1") >= 0 ? S_CLOUD_GARDEN.board.focus = 1 : t.id.search("btn2") >= 0 ? S_CLOUD_GARDEN.board.focus = 2 : t.id.search("btn3") >= 0 ? S_CLOUD_GARDEN.board.focus = 3 : t.id.search("btn4") >= 0 && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN.board.focus = 4), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus_board())
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_CLOUD_GARDEN.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.onMouseover(n)
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_CLOUD_GARDEN.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.onMouseover(n);
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN.onClick(n)
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN.isCanIattack_fireAni = function(n, t) {
  var ai, si, a, r, wi, bi, lt, at, vt, f, s, lr, it, d, c, h, ui, rr, ur, ii, i, u, fr, fi, b, st, tt, ut, g, k, rt, oi, hi, bt, ot, o, gt, pi, ni, e, sr, tr;
  if (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_frame_cur == OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_fire_frame || OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur != 1) {
    a = CLOUD_GARDEN_STAGE.len_from_our_to_your[S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage];
    t >= 0 && YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].alive == 1 && (r = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].unit_num, wi = YOUR_TEAM_ARRAY[t].x + CLOUD_GARDEN_DESIGN[r].beattack_margine, a > wi && (a = wi));
    var r = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].unit_num,
      ot = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[r].filename + "_fire.png",
      nt = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[r];
    switch (r) {
      case 1:
      case 5:
        var f = 0,
          i = 82,
          u = 87,
          s = 100;
        switch (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur) {
          case 1:
            f = 0;
            OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur = 2;
            OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_remain_len = a - (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w) + s - i;
            OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_remain_len + i > OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len + s && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_remain_len = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].attack_len + s - i);
            OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_remain_len <= 0 && (OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_remain_len = 1);
            break;
          case 2:
            f = 0;
            OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur = 3;
            break;
          case 3:
            f = 0;
            OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur = 4;
            break;
          case 4:
            f = 0;
            OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur = 5;
            break;
          case 5:
            f = 0;
            OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur = 6;
            break;
          case 6:
            f = 83;
            OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur = 1;
            OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].mode = MODE.WAIT;
            break;
          default:
            utilConsoleLog("Error in S_CLOUD_GARDEN.isCanIattack ;case 1")
        }
        var o = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].x + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].w - 50,
          lr = i,
          e = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_remain_len,
          g = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur == 1 ? OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_num : OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_cur - 1,
          k = o + e / OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].fire_frame_num * g,
          w = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].socket_index,
          v = LOIMG_CHAR_OUR[w].FIRE[1],
          c = k,
          h = OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].y + OUR_TEAM_ARRAY[n].h / 2 - 30;

S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var r = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    i;
  switch (r) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus--;
      S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus < 1 && (S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus = 1);
      S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus++;
      i = REWARD_AD.exists(REWARD_AD.PLACE.CLOUD_GARDEN) ? 4 : 3;
      S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus > i && (S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus = i);
      S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.ranking_page != 1 && S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.make_screen_ranking_list("up");
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.ranking_page < S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.max_ranking_page() && S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.make_screen_ranking_list("down");
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.run_back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.RED:
      S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW.move_page = 8;
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_PERCENTAGE_SHOW, S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW)
  }
};
S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.backKey = function() {
  S_SELECTMAP.focus = 22;
  S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.end();
  S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.end_memory_free();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MODE_SELECT, S_MODE_SELECT);
  sound_bgm_play(BGM_SOUND.WAIT)
};

S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawRanks = function() {
  var r = 0,
    h = "_kr",
    s, e, n, t, u, i, f, o;
  for (USER.lang != LANG.KOREA && (h = "_en"), s = S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.ranking_page * 10, S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.ranking_page == 1 ? $("#RCG_left_rank12345").css({
      display: "block"
    }) : $("#RCG_left_rank12345").css({
      display: "none"
    }), $("#RCG_left_focus").css({
      display: "none"
    }), e = 10, S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.rank_arr.length < 11 && (e = S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.rank_arr.length - 1), n = 1; n <= e; n++) {
    if (t = s - 10 + n, t >= S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.rank_arr.length) {
      $("#Txt_RCG_left_rank" + n).empty();
      $("#Txt_RCG_left_platform" + n).empty().css({

      });
      $("#Txt_RCG_left_team" + n).empty();
      $("#Txt_RCG_left_id" + n).empty();
      $("#Txt_RCG_left_score" + n).empty();
      t < 6 && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("RCG_left_rank" + n, "./image/ui/0_common/onepixel.png", 440, 199 + 35 * (n - 1));
      continue
    }
    for ($("#Txt_RCG_left_rank" + n).css({
        left: "456px",
        top: 198 + (35 + r) * (n - 1) + "px",
        width: "29px",

        "font-size": "20rem",
        "text-align": "center",
        color: n <= 5 ? "#ffffff" : "#672b0e",

      }).text(S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.rank_arr[t].RANKING), t < 6 && n < 6 && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("RCG_left_rank" + n, glo.ser_img_url + "image/ui/42_cloud_garden/cloud_toprankbox.png", 440, 199 + 35 * (n - 1)), S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.ranking_page > 1 && $("#Txt_RCG_left_rank" + n).css({

S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.max_ranking_page = function() {
  var n = 1,
    t = S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.rank_arr.length - 1,
    i = t % 10;
  return n = Math.floor(t / 10), t > 0 && i != 0 && (n = n + 1), n == 0 && (n = 1), n
};
S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus = function() {
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  $("#Img_RCG_back_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_RCG_start_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_RCG_team_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_RCG_ad_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus == 1 ? $("#Img_RCG_back_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus == 2 ? $("#Img_RCG_start_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus == 3 ? $("#Img_RCG_team_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus == 4 && $("#Img_RCG_ad_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  })
};
S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.menuRun = function() {
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus) {
    case 4:
      if (!REWARD_AD.is_enabled("RCG_ad_btn")) {
        REWARD_AD.notice_state("RCG_ad_btn");
        break
      }
      REWARD_AD.play(REWARD_AD.PLACE.CLOUD_GARDEN, "", null, S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.on_reward_ad);
      break;
    case 1:
      S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.run_back();
      break;
    case 2:
      S_GAME.stage = 1;
      S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.get_cur_ms() >= S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.get_init_start_date_ms() && S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.get_cur_ms() < S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.get_init_end_date_ms() ? utilNotice(TXT.cloud_garden_time_out, 3) : S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.cur_ticket > 0 ? (loading_show(), gEnableKey = 0, ServerConnection.ranking_cloud_garden({
        MODE: "GAME_TICKET",
        SCORE: 0
      }, function(n) {
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        n.TYPE == "GAME_START_ERROR" ? USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice(n.DESCRIPTION, 3) : utilNotice(n.DESCRIPTION_EN, 3) : (S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.cur_ticket = parseInt(n.after_ticket), S_CLOUD_GARDEN.game_nonce = n.GAME_NONCE ? n.GAME_NONCE : "", utilNotice(TXT.cloud_garden_use_free_ticket, 3), utilPush(), gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TIZEN_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE ? (S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.end(), S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.end_memory_free(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_CLOUD_GARDEN, S_CLOUD_GARDEN)) : (S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.end(), S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.end_memory_free(), S_GAME.ranking_mode = 7, S_CLOUD_GARDEN.init()))
      })) : USER.ruby >= S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.ENTER_RUBY ? ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN) : utilNotice(TXT.cloud_garden_not_enter, 3);
      break;
    case 3:
      utilPush();
      S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.end();

  }

ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_PERCENTAGE_SHOW, S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW) : S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW.init()) : REWARD_AD.hit(n.target.id, "RCG_ad_btn") ? (S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus = 4, S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.menuRun()) : n.target.id.search("scroll_up") >= 0 ? S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.ranking_page != 1 && S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.make_screen_ranking_list("up") : n.target.id.search("scroll_down") >= 0 ? S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.ranking_page < S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.max_ranking_page() && S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.make_screen_ranking_list("down") : S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.menuRun())
};

(S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus = 4, S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus()) : n.target.id.search("team") >= 0 ? (S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.focus = 3, S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.drawFocus()) : n.target.id.search("scroll_up") >= 0 ? utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("RCG_left_scroll_focus", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/42_cloud_garden/cloud_scrolltop_f.png", 1194, 204) : n.target.id.search("scroll_down") >= 0 && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("RCG_left_scroll_focus", glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/42_cloud_garden/cloud_scrolldown_f.png", 1194, 518), n.target.id.search("soft") >= 0 && $("#RCG_soft_txt").css({

  })))
};

S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.init = function() {
  S_MAINMENU.unmount_mm_top();
  utilPush();
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus = 5;
  utilConsoleLog("S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.init()");
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_bgm_play(BGM_SOUND.WAIT);
  bga("send", "event", "game", "CLOUD_GARDEN" + S_CLOUD_GARDEN.stage, "win");
  $("#MM_top").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR_div").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR;
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.call_preload == !1 && S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.preload();
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.maketag();
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.call_preload = !1;
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.add_score = Math.floor(S_CLOUD_GARDEN.score / 1e3);
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.ch_num = S_GAME.socket_getAvailable_num();
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.scale.cur = 0;
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.make_screen();
  loading_show();
  gEnableKey = 0;
  ServerConnection.ranking_cloud_garden({
    MODE: "GAME_END",
    SCORE: S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.add_score
  }, function(n) {
    gEnableKey = 1;
    loading_hide();
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN.game_nonce = "";
    glo.fun.is_glo_platform() && n.IS_SCORE_REFRESH == 1 && ServerConnection.put_eldorado_score("CLOUD_GARDEN", "구름정원클리어");
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.best_score = parseInt(n.MY_SCORE);
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.best_score < 0 && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.best_score = 0);
    n.TYPE == "GAME_END_ERROR" ? S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.bonus_piece = 0 : (S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.bonus_piece = parseInt(n.win_piece), USER.cloud_piece = parseInt(n.tot_piece));
    $("#Txt_CGC_board_text1_num").text(utilGetNumber_withComma(S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.add_score));
    (S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.best_score === 0 || S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.add_score < S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.best_score) && $("#Img_CGC_popup_best").hide();
    $("#Txt_CGC_title2").hide();
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.addMouseEvent();
    S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.bonus_piece > 0 && S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.clear_bonus();
    S_MAINMENU.update_screen_top();
    (n.TYPE == "TODAY_LIMIT_PIECE_OVER" || n.TYPE == "TODAY_LIMIT_PIECE_OVER_AFTER" || n.TYPE == "GAME_END_ERROR") && (USER.lang == LANG.KOREA ? utilNotice(n.DESCRIPTION, 3) : utilNotice(n.DESCRIPTION_EN, 3))
  });
  STORAGE.save_quest_to_server();
  glo.event.apply_coupon_code();
  S_GUILD_MAIN.update_guild_mission(3, 1)
};

S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus--;
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus < 1 && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus = 1);
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus++;
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus > 5 && (S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus = 5);
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus = 1;
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.drawFocus();
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus = 2;
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.drawFocus();
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus = 3;
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.drawFocus();
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM4:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus = 4;
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.drawFocus();
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM5:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus = 5;
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.drawFocus();
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.back:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.backKey()
  }
};

S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  utilScale_xy_center("CGC_btn" + S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("CGC_btn" + S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus + "_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("CGC_btn" + S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus, 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("CGC_btn" + S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus + "_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.menuRun_Run = function() {
  switch (S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus) {
    case 1:
      utilPush();
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.end();
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM);
      break;
    case 2:
      var n = function(n) {
        for (var t = 0; t < n.event_arr.length; t++) AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[n.event_arr[t]] = 1;
        auto_event_value();
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "upgrade(업그레이드)", "ok");
        utilPush();
        S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.end();
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_UPGRADE, S_UPGRADE)
      };
      loading_show();
      gEnableKey = 0;
      auto_event_system_init();
      auto_event_system_check(999, n);
      break;
    case 3:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.end();
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU);
      break;
    case 4:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.end();
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MODE_SELECT, S_MODE_SELECT);
      break;
    case 5:
      S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.backKey()
  }
  $("#MM_top").show()
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.backKey = function() {
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.end();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN, S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN)
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.end = function() {
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.removeMouseEvent();
  util_key_number.clear_all()
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.fx_drop = function(n, t) {
  t = t || {};
  var e = typeof t.dy == "number" ? t.dy : 60,
    f = typeof t.ms == "number" ? t.ms : 520,
    o = typeof t.opacity == "number" ? t.opacity : 0,
    s = typeof t.delay == "number" ? t.delay : 0,
    i = document.getElementById(n);
  if (i) {
    var r = i.style.transform || "",
      u = i.style.WebkitTransform || "",
      h = i.style.transition || "",
      c = i.style.WebkitTransition || "",
      l = (r && r !== "none" ? r + " " : "") + "translate3d(0," + -e + "px,0)",
      a = (u && u !== "none" ? u + " " : "") + "translate3d(0," + -e + "px,0)";
    i.style.transition = "none";
    i.style.WebkitTransition = "none";
    i.style.opacity = o;
    i.style.transform = l;
    i.style.WebkitTransform = a;
    i.style.willChange = "transform, opacity";
    setTimeout(function() {
      function y() {
        t || (t = !0, i.style.transform = r, i.style.WebkitTransform = u, i.style.transition = h, i.style.WebkitTransition = c, i.style.willChange = "", i.removeEventListener("transitionend", n), i.removeEventListener("webkitTransitionEnd", n))
      }
      var s, l, a, v, t, n;
      i.style.transition = "none";
      i.style.WebkitTransition = "none";
      i.style.opacity = o;
      s = (r && r !== "none" ? r + " " : "") + "translate3d(0," + -e + "px,0)";
      l = (u && u !== "none" ? u + " " : "") + "translate3d(0," + -e + "px,0)";
      i.style.transform = s;
      i.style.WebkitTransform = l;
      i.style.willChange = "transform, opacity";
      i.offsetWidth;
      i.style.transition = "transform " + f + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), opacity " + f + "ms ease-out";
      i.style.WebkitTransition = "-webkit-transform " + f + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), opacity " + f + "ms ease-out";
      i.style.opacity = 1;
      a = (r && r !== "none" ? r + " " : "") + "translate3d(0,0,0)";
      v = (u && u !== "none" ? u + " " : "") + "translate3d(0,0,0)";
      i.style.transform = a;
      i.style.WebkitTransform = v;
      t = !1;
      n = function(n) {
        var t = n && n.propertyName ? n.propertyName.toLowerCase() : "";
        (t.indexOf("transform") !== -1 || t.indexOf("opacity") !== -1 || t.indexOf("webkit-transform") !== -1) && y()
      };
      i.addEventListener("transitionend", n);
      i.addEventListener("webkitTransitionEnd", n);
      setTimeout(y, f + 200)
    }, s)
  }
};

S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.spawn_star = function(n, t, i, r, u, f) {
  u = typeof u == "number" ? u : 0;
  setTimeout(function() {
    var s = "CGC_star_" + n + "_" + t,
      c = Math.floor(Math.random() * 41) + 26,
      l = Math.floor(Math.random() * 360),
      w = n === "L" ? 1 : -1,
      a = 40,
      b = n === "L" ? i - a : i + a,
      o = 1200,
      v = l + w * 270,
      h, u, e, y, p;
    utilDrawImage(s, f, i, r, c, c, "absolute");
    h = document.getElementById("Img_CGC_title_effect") || document.getElementById("S_CLUD_GARDEN_CLEAR_div") || document.body;
    u = document.getElementById(s);
    u ? h && u.parentNode !== h && h.appendChild(u) : (u = document.createElement("div"), u.id = s, u.style.position = "absolute", u.style.left = i + "px", u.style.top = r + "px", u.style.width = c + "px", u.style.height = c + "px", u.style.backgroundImage = util_bg_url("url(" + f + ")"), u.style.backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat", u.style.backgroundPosition = "50% 50%", u.style.backgroundSize = "contain", h.appendChild(u));
    e = $("#" + s);
    e.css({
      "pointer-events": "none",
      opacity: 1,
      "transform-origin": "50% 50%",
      "-webkit-transform-origin": "50% 50%",
      transform: "translateZ(0) rotate(" + l + "deg) scale(1)",
      "-webkit-transform": "translateZ(0) rotate(" + l + "deg) scale(1)",
      transition: "none",
      "-webkit-transition": "none"
    });
    e[0] && e[0].offsetWidth;
    y = "transform " + o + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), left " + o + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), opacity " + o + "ms linear";
    p = "-webkit-transform " + o + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), left " + o + "ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), opacity " + o + "ms linear";
    e.css({
      transition: y,
      "-webkit-transition": p
    });
    e[0] && e[0].offsetWidth;
    e.css({
      left: b + "px",
      opacity: 0,
      transform: "translateZ(0) rotate(" + v + "deg) scale(0)",
      "-webkit-transform": "translateZ(0) rotate(" + v + "deg) scale(0)"
    });
    setTimeout(function() {
      var n = document.getElementById(s);
      n && n.parentNode && n.parentNode.removeChild(n)
    }, o + 120)
  }, u)
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover)))
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.menuRun()
  }
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.onMouseover = function(n) {
  for (var t = n.target, i = 0, r; t;) {
    if (t.id && (r = t.id.match(/CGC_btn([1-5])/), r)) {
      i = parseInt(r[1], 10);
      break
    }
    if (t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") break;
    t = t.parentNode
  }
  if (i == 0) {
    utilConsoleLog("Please define this id in S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.onMouseover():" + n.target.id);
    return
  }
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.focus = i;
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.drawFocus()
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.onMouseover(n)
};
S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_CLOUD_GARDEN_CLEAR.onMouseover(n);

S_GACHA_SELECTION.draw_page = function() {
  for (var t, i = S_GACHA_SELECTION.get_valid_tot(), n = 1; n <= S_GACHA_SELECTION.char_tot; n++) t = S_GACHA_SELECTION.get_char_num(n), n <= i ? $("#GS_box_char_" + n).css({
    "background-image": util_bg_url("url(" + S_GACHA_SELECTION.get_char_img_url(t) + ")")
  }).show() : $("#GS_box_char_" + n).hide(), n <= i && t === S_GACHA_SELECTION.checkbox_focus ? ($("#GS_box_bg_sel_" + n).show(), $("#GS_box_check_" + n).show()) : ($("#GS_box_bg_sel_" + n).hide(), $("#GS_box_check_" + n).hide()), $("#GS_box_focus_" + n).hide()
};
S_GACHA_SELECTION.change_page = function(n, t) {
  S_GACHA_SELECTION.page_tot <= 1 || (S_GACHA_SELECTION.cur_page = S_GACHA_SELECTION.cur_page + n, S_GACHA_SELECTION.cur_page < 1 && (S_GACHA_SELECTION.cur_page = S_GACHA_SELECTION.page_tot), S_GACHA_SELECTION.cur_page > S_GACHA_SELECTION.page_tot && (S_GACHA_SELECTION.cur_page = 1), S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus !== 3 && (S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus = 1, S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus = t ? S_GACHA_SELECTION.get_valid_tot() : 1, S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus < 1 && (S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus = 1)), S_GACHA_SELECTION.draw_page(), S_GACHA_SELECTION.drawFocus())
};
S_GACHA_SELECTION.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var f = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    i = parseInt(S_GACHA_SELECTION.char_tot / 2),
    r = S_GACHA_SELECTION.get_valid_tot(),
    u = S_GACHA_SELECTION.page_tot > 1;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + f + " in S_GACHA_SELECTION.keyDown()");
  switch (f) {
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus = 2;
      S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_focus = 2;
      S_GACHA_SELECTION.menuRun_Run();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus === 2) S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_focus--, S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_focus < 1 && (S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_focus = 1);
      else if (S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus === 3) S_GACHA_SELECTION.page_focus = 1;
      else {
        if (u && S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus === 1) {
          S_GACHA_SELECTION.change_page(-1, !0);
          break
        }
        S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus--;
        S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus < 1 && (S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus = r)
      }
      S_GACHA_SELECTION.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus === 2) S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_focus++, S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_focus > S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_tot && (S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_focus = S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_tot);
      else if (S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus === 3) S_GACHA_SELECTION.page_focus = 2;
      else {
        if (u && S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus >= r) {
          S_GACHA_SELECTION.change_page(1, !1);
          break
        }
        S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus++;
        S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus > r && (S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus = 1)
      }
      S_GACHA_SELECTION.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus === 1 ? (S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus + i <= r ? S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus = S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus + i : S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus = u ? 3 : 2, S_GACHA_SELECTION.drawFocus()) : S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus === 3 && (S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus = 2, S_GACHA_SELECTION.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus === 2 ? S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus = u ? 3 : 1 : S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus === 3 ? S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus = 1 : S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus > i && (S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus = S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus - i);
      S_GACHA_SELECTION.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      if (S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus === 3) {
        S_GACHA_SELECTION.change_page(S_GACHA_SELECTION.page_focus === 1 ? -1 : 1, !1);
        break
      }
      S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus === 2 ? S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_focus == 1 ? S_GACHA_SELECTION.menuRun_Run() : (S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus = 2, S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_focus = 2, S_GACHA_SELECTION.menuRun_Run()) : S_GACHA_SELECTION.check_checkbox()
  }
};
S_GACHA_SELECTION.pause = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_GACHA_SELECTION.pause()!!")
};
S_GACHA_SELECTION.resume = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_GACHA_SELECTION.resume()!!");
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  gEnableKey = 1
};
S_GACHA_SELECTION.end = function() {
  $("#S_GACHA_SELECTION_div").remove();
  S_GACHA_SELECTION.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_GACHA_SELECTION.back = function() {
  S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus = 1;
  S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus = 1;
  S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_focus = 1;
  S_GACHA_SELECTION.end();
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = g_sceneinfo.before_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = gS_GACHA_SELECTION;
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  $("#MM_top").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  S_GACHA.addMouseEvent();
  S_GACHA.drawFocus()
};
S_GACHA_SELECTION.drawFocus = function() {
  var n, t;
  for ($("#GS_btn1_focus").hide(), $("#GS_btn2_focus").hide(), $("#GS_page_focus_1").hide(), $("#GS_page_focus_2").hide(), n = 1; n <= S_GACHA_SELECTION.char_tot; n++) $("#GS_box_focus_" + n).hide();
  S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus === 2 ? $("#GS_btn" + S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_focus + "_focus").show() : S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus === 3 ? $("#GS_page_focus_" + S_GACHA_SELECTION.page_focus).show() : (t = S_GACHA_SELECTION.get_valid_tot(), S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus > t && (S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus = t >= 1 ? t : 1), $("#GS_box_focus_" + S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus).show())
};
S_GACHA_SELECTION.check_checkbox = function() {
  if (S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus === 1) {
    if (S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus > S_GACHA_SELECTION.get_valid_tot()) return;
    for (var n = 1; n <= S_GACHA_SELECTION.char_tot; n++) $("#GS_box_bg_sel_" + n).hide(), $("#GS_box_check_" + n).hide();
    $("#GS_box_bg_sel_" + S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus).show();
    $("#GS_box_check_" + S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus).show();
    S_GACHA_SELECTION.checkbox_focus = S_GACHA_SELECTION.get_char_num(S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus)
  }
};
S_GACHA_SELECTION.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus === 3) {
    S_GACHA_SELECTION.change_page(S_GACHA_SELECTION.page_focus === 1 ? -1 : 1, !1);
    return
  }
  S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus === 2 ? S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_focus == 2 ? gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_GACHA_SELECTION.back() : S_GACHA_SELECTION.checkbox_focus >= 1 && S_GACHA_SELECTION.checkbox_focus <= S_GACHA_SELECTION.char_line_tot ? ($("#MM_top").css({
    display: "block"
  }), S_GACHA_SELECTION.end(), g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_GACHA, S_GACHA.yes()) : utilNotice(TXT.selecet_a_character, 1.5) : S_GACHA_SELECTION.check_checkbox()
};
S_GACHA_SELECTION.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || $("#S_GACHA_SELECTION_div").mouseover(S_GACHA_SELECTION.onMouseover))
};
S_GACHA_SELECTION.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_GACHA_SELECTION_div").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_GACHA_SELECTION.onClick = function(n) {
  var t, i;
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("c_button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } if (t.id.search("GS_box_") >= 0) {
      if (i = Number(t.id.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "")), i > S_GACHA_SELECTION.get_valid_tot()) return;
      S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus = 1;
      S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus = i;
      utilConsoleLog(" S_GACHA_SELECTION.onMouseonClick  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "  focus:" + S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus);
      S_GACHA_SELECTION.check_checkbox()
    } else t.id.search("GS_page_") >= 0 ? (S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus = 3, S_GACHA_SELECTION.page_focus = Number(t.id.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "")), S_GACHA_SELECTION.change_page(S_GACHA_SELECTION.page_focus === 1 ? -1 : 1, !1)) : t.id.search("GS_btn1") >= 0 ? (S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus = 2, S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_focus = 1, S_GACHA_SELECTION.menuRun_Run()) : t.id.search("GS_btn2") >= 0 && (S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus = 2, S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_focus = 2, S_GACHA_SELECTION.menuRun_Run())
  }
};
S_GACHA_SELECTION.onMouseover = function(n) {
  for (var t = n.target, i; !(t.className && t.className.search("c_button") >= 0);)
    if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
      t = null;
      return
    } if (t.id.search("GS_box_") >= 0) {
    if (i = Number(t.id.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "")), i > S_GACHA_SELECTION.get_valid_tot()) return;
    S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus = 1;
    S_GACHA_SELECTION.focus = i;
    S_GACHA_SELECTION.drawFocus()
  } else t.id.search("GS_page_") >= 0 ? (S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus = 3, S_GACHA_SELECTION.page_focus = Number(t.id.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "")), S_GACHA_SELECTION.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("GS_btn1") >= 0 ? (S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus = 2, S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_focus = 1, S_GACHA_SELECTION.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("GS_btn2") >= 0 && (S_GACHA_SELECTION.row_focus = 2, S_GACHA_SELECTION.btn_focus = 2, S_GACHA_SELECTION.drawFocus())
};
S_GACHA_SELECTION.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GACHA_SELECTION.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_GACHA_SELECTION.onMouseover(n)
};
S_GACHA_SELECTION.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_GACHA_SELECTION.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_GACHA_SELECTION.onClick(n)
};

S_AGREE.maketag = function() {
  if (!$("#S_AGREE_div").html()) {
    $("#S_MAINMENU_div").after('<div id= "S_AGREE_div"><\/div>');
    $("#S_AGREE_div").append('<img id="AGREE_bg"><div id="AGREE_contents_left"><\/div><div id="AGREE_contents_right"><\/div><div id="AGREE_contents_left_cover"><\/div><div id="AGREE_contents_right_cover"><\/div><img id="AGREE_contents_left_focus"><img id="AGREE_contents_right_focus"><img id="AGREE_check_left"><img id="AGREE_check_left_focus"><img id="AGREE_check_right"><img id="AGREE_check_right_focus"><div id="AGREE_check_left_cover"><\/div><div id="AGREE_check_right_cover"><\/div><div id="AGREE_btn1" class="button">\t<img id="AGREE_btn1_bg">\t<div id="AGREE_btn1_txt"> <\/div>\t<img id="AGREE_btn1_focus" class="focus"><\/div><div id="AGREE_RED" class="button"><\/div>')
  }
};
S_AGREE.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_AGREE.row_focus == 1 && (S_AGREE.contents_focus = 1);
      S_AGREE.row_focus == 2 && (S_AGREE.check_focus = 1);
      S_AGREE.draw_focus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_AGREE.row_focus == 1 && (S_AGREE.contents_focus = 2);
      S_AGREE.row_focus == 2 && (S_AGREE.check_focus = 2);
      S_AGREE.draw_focus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_AGREE.row_focus >= 2 && (S_AGREE.row_focus--, S_AGREE.draw_focus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_AGREE.row_focus <= 2 && (S_AGREE.row_focus++, S_AGREE.draw_focus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.RED:
    case KeyDefine.space:
      USER.lang = USER.lang == LANG.ENGLISH ? LANG.KOREA : LANG.ENGLISH;
      S_AGREE.personal_info_policy = null;
      S_AGREE.terms_n_condition = null;
      LANG.init();
      S_AGREE.make_screen();
      S_AGREE.load_n_display();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      switch (S_AGREE.row_focus) {
        case 1:
          S_AGREE_DETAIL.what = S_AGREE.contents_focus;
          ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_AGREE_DETAIL, S_AGREE_DETAIL);
          break;
        case 2:
          S_AGREE.check_focus == 1 ? S_AGREE.value_check1 = S_AGREE.value_check1 == 0 ? 1 : 0 : S_AGREE.value_check2 = S_AGREE.value_check2 == 0 ? 1 : 0;
          S_AGREE.draw_check();
          break;
        case 3:
          if (S_AGREE.value_check1 == 1 && S_AGREE.value_check2 == 1) S_AGREE.end(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_SYNOPSIS, S_SYNOPSIS);
          else {
            utilNotice(TXT.need_all_agree, 2);
            return
          }
      }
      break;
    case KeyDefine.back:
    case KeyDefine.esc:
      S_EXITPOPUP.start("동의화면에서 이전버턴 누름")
  }
};

S_AGREE.onClick = function(n) {
  switch (n.target.id) {
    case "AGREE_RED":
      USER.lang = USER.lang == LANG.ENGLISH ? LANG.KOREA : LANG.ENGLISH;
      S_AGREE.personal_info_policy = null;
      S_AGREE.terms_n_condition = null;
      LANG.init();
      S_AGREE.make_screen();
      S_AGREE.load_n_display();
      return;
    case "AGREE_contents_left_cover":
    case "AGREE_contents_right_cover":
    case "AGREE_check_left_cover":
    case "AGREE_check_right_cover":
    case "AGREE_contents_left_focus":
    case "AGREE_contents_right_focus":
    case "AGREE_check_left_focus":
    case "AGREE_check_right_focus":
      S_AGREE.keyDown({
        keyCode: KeyDefine.enter
      });
      return
  }
  if (n.target.parentElement) switch (n.target.parentElement.id) {
    case "AGREE_btn1":
      S_AGREE.keyDown({
        keyCode: KeyDefine.enter
      });
      return
  }
};
S_AGREE.onMouseover = function(n) {
  switch (n.target.id) {
    case "AGREE_contents_left_cover":
      S_AGREE.row_focus = 1;
      S_AGREE.contents_focus = 1;
      S_AGREE.draw_focus();
      return;
    case "AGREE_contents_right_cover":
      S_AGREE.row_focus = 1;
      S_AGREE.contents_focus = 2;
      S_AGREE.draw_focus();
      return;
    case "AGREE_check_left_cover":
      S_AGREE.row_focus = 2;
      S_AGREE.check_focus = 1;
      S_AGREE.draw_focus();
      return;
    case "AGREE_check_right_cover":
      S_AGREE.row_focus = 2;
      S_AGREE.check_focus = 2;
      S_AGREE.draw_focus();
      return
  }
  if (n.target.parentElement) switch (n.target.parentElement.id) {
    case "AGREE_btn1":
      S_AGREE.row_focus = 3;
      S_AGREE.draw_focus()
  }
};
S_AGREE.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_AGREE.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);

};

S_AGREE_DETAIL.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  console.log("Key pressed: " + i + " in S_AGREE_DETAIL.keyDown()");
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.up:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ATV ? S_AGREE_DETAIL.scroll_agd_contents("AGD_contents", -1) : $("#AGD_contents").attr("tabindex", -1).focus();

      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.ATV ? S_AGREE_DETAIL.scroll_agd_contents("AGD_contents", 1) : $("#AGD_contents").attr("tabindex", -1).focus();

    case KeyDefine.enter:
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_AGREE_DETAIL.back()
  }

    $("#AGD_contents").css({

      cursor: "default"
    });
    $("#AGD_contents").on("mousedown.agd_scroll touchstart.agd_scroll", S_AGREE_DETAIL.on_scroll_down).on("mousemove.agd_scroll touchmove.agd_scroll", S_AGREE_DETAIL.on_scroll_move).on("mouseup.agd_scroll mouseleave.agd_scroll touchend.agd_scroll touchcancel.agd_scroll", S_AGREE_DETAIL.on_scroll_up)
  }
};
S_AGREE_DETAIL.remove_scroll_event = function() {
  $("#AGD_contents").off(".agd_scroll")
};
S_AGREE_DETAIL.get_scroll_event_y = function(n) {
  var t = n.originalEvent ? n.originalEvent : n;
  return t.touches && t.touches.length > 0 ? t.touches[0].pageY : t.changedTouches && t.changedTouches.length > 0 ? t.changedTouches[0].pageY : n.pageY
};
S_AGREE_DETAIL.on_scroll_down = function(n) {
  var t = document.getElementById("AGD_contents");
  t && (S_AGREE_DETAIL.drag_scroll.pressed = 1, S_AGREE_DETAIL.drag_scroll.start_y = S_AGREE_DETAIL.get_scroll_event_y(n), S_AGREE_DETAIL.drag_scroll.start_top = t.scrollTop, n.stopPropagation(), n.type == "mousedown" && n.preventDefault())
};
S_AGREE_DETAIL.on_scroll_move = function(n) {
  var t, i, r, u;
  S_AGREE_DETAIL.drag_scroll.pressed != 0 && (t = document.getElementById("AGD_contents"), t) && (i = t.scrollHeight - t.clientHeight, i < 0 && (i = 0), r = S_AGREE_DETAIL.drag_scroll.start_y - S_AGREE_DETAIL.get_scroll_event_y(n), u = S_AGREE_DETAIL.drag_scroll.start_top + r, t.scrollTop = Math.max(0, Math.min(i, u)), n.stopPropagation(), n.preventDefault())
};
S_AGREE_DETAIL.on_scroll_up = function(n) {
  S_AGREE_DETAIL.drag_scroll.pressed != 0 && (S_AGREE_DETAIL.drag_scroll.pressed = 0, n.stopPropagation())
};

      }) : $("#AGREE_check_right_focus").css({

        display: "block"
      })
  }

S_BLUE_DRAGON.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var r = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    i;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + r + " in S_BLUE_DRAGON.keyDown()");
  switch (r) {
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status === "idle" ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus = 1, S_BLUE_DRAGON.menuRun_Run()) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status === "result" && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus = 1, S_BLUE_DRAGON.menuRun_Run());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status === "idle" ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus--, S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus < 1 && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus = 1)) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status === "result" && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus--, S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus < 1 && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus = 1));
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status === "idle" ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus++, i = REWARD_AD.exists(REWARD_AD.PLACE.FOUR_GODS) ? 4 : 3, S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus > i && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus = i)) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status === "result" && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus++, S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus > 2 && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus = 2));
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.menuRun()
  }
};

S_BLUE_DRAGON.drawFocus = function(n) {
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.ad_hide || S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status !== "idle" ? REWARD_AD.hide("BD_ad_box") : REWARD_AD.show("BD_ad_box");
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status === "idle" ? ($("#BD_back_f").hide(), $("#BD_persuade_f").hide(), $("#BD_help_f").hide(), $("#BD_ad_f").hide(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus == 1 ? $("#BD_back_f").show() : S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus == 2 ? $("#BD_persuade_f").show() : S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus == 3 ? $("#BD_help_f").show() : $("#BD_ad_f").show()) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status === "result" && ($("#BD_result_btn1_f").hide(), $("#BD_result_btn2_f").hide(), $("#BD_result_btn" + S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus + "_f").show());
  n === "hide" && ($("#BD_back_f").hide(), $("#BD_persuade_f").hide(), $("#BD_help_f").hide(), $("#BD_ad_f").hide(), $("#BD_result_btn1_f").hide(), $("#BD_result_btn2_f").hide())
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status === "idle" ? S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("BD_back_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus === 2 ? (loading_show(), utilScale_xy_center("BD_persuade_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus === 3 ? utilScale_xy_center("BD_help_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus === 4 && utilScale_xy_center("BD_ad_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status === "result" && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("BD_result_btn1_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus === 2 && utilScale_xy_center("BD_result_btn2_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale));
  setTimeout(function() {
    S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status === "idle" ? S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("BD_back_box", 1, 1) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus === 2 ? utilScale_xy_center("BD_persuade_box", 1, 1) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus === 3 ? utilScale_xy_center("BD_help_box", 1, 1) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus === 4 && utilScale_xy_center("BD_ad_box", 1, 1) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status === "result" && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("BD_result_btn1_box", 1, 1) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus === 2 && utilScale_xy_center("BD_result_btn2_box", 1, 1));
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status === "idle") {
    if (S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus === 4) {
      if (S_BLUE_DRAGON.cur_gauge >= S_BLUE_DRAGON.GAUGE_MAX) {
        utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_gauge_full, 2);
        gEnableKey = 1;
        return
      }
      if (!REWARD_AD.is_enabled("BD_ad_box")) {
        REWARD_AD.notice_state("BD_ad_box");
        gEnableKey = 1;
        return
      }
      REWARD_AD.play(REWARD_AD.PLACE.FOUR_GODS, "95", null, S_BLUE_DRAGON.on_reward_ad);
      return
    }
    if (S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus === 1) gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_BLUE_DRAGON.back();
    else if (S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus === 2) {
      if (USER.cloud_piece < S_BLUE_DRAGON.cost_num || isNaN(USER.cloud_piece)) {
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        utilNotice(TXT.cloud_pieces_lack, 2);
        return
      }
      if (!S_GACHA.is_char_storage_space_available("FOUR_GODS")) {
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        return
      }
      utilPush();
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.removeMouseEvent();
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.ad_hide = !0;
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.drawFocus("hide");
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP, S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP)
    } else S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus === 3 && (utilPush(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.removeMouseEvent(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.drawFocus("hide"), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP, S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP))
  }
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status === "result" && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus === 1 ? S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_ok() : S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus === 2 && (utilPush(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.end(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM)))
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.end = function() {
  clearTimeout(S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_timer_num);
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_timer_num = null;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.done_render_raf = !0;
  $("#S_BLUE_DRAGON_div").remove();
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.back = function() {
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.end();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_FOUR_GODS, S_FOUR_GODS)
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.yes = function() {
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.ad_hide = !0;
  REWARD_AD.hide("BD_ad_box");
  loading_show("", 1);
  var n = {
    MODE: "UPDATE",
    GAGE: S_BLUE_DRAGON.cur_gauge,
    EVENT: S_BLUE_DRAGON.is_event,
    CLOUD: USER.cloud_piece,
    TYPE: 1
  };
  ServerConnection.update_dragon_info(n, function(n) {
    if (loading_hide(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.is_event = n.EVENT, n.STATE === "NOTICE") gEnableKey = 1, utilNotice(TXT.dragon_event_end, 2), S_BLUE_DRAGON.update_event_icon(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.ad_hide = !1, S_BLUE_DRAGON.drawFocus();
    else {
      gEnableKey = 0;
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.update_event_icon();
      n.STATE === "SUCCESS" ? (STORAGE.add_char(95, !0), S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result = "ok") : n.STATE === "FAIL" && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result = "no");
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.add_gauge = parseInt(n.MULTI);
      var t = S_BLUE_DRAGON.cur_gauge + S_BLUE_DRAGON.add_gauge;
      t > S_BLUE_DRAGON.GAUGE_MAX && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.add_gauge = S_BLUE_DRAGON.GAUGE_MAX - S_BLUE_DRAGON.cur_gauge);
      USER.cloud_piece = parseInt(n.CLOUD);
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_bg_scale_up();
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_dragon_name_left();
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_button_1_down();
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_top_1_up();
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_gauge_box_right();
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_char_move_right();
      S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_tip_hide();
      $("#BD_speech_balloon_box").hide();
      $("#MM_top_cloud_piece_txt").text(utilGetNumber_withComma(USER.cloud_piece + ""))
    }
  })
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.update_cur_gauge = function() {
  var n = 414 - 2.8 * S_BLUE_DRAGON.cur_gauge;
  $("#BD_gauge_white").css({
    top: n + "px"
  });
  $("#BD_gauge_top").css({
    top: -5 + n + "px"
  });
  $("#BD_gauge_addnum").css({
    top: -68 + n + "px"
  })
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_ok = function() {
  if (gEnableKey = 0, $("#BD_result_title").hide(), $("#BD_result_minich_box").hide(), $("#BD_result_pop_box").hide(), $("#BD_result_btn1_box").hide(), $("#BD_result_btn2_box").hide(), $("#BD_result_chmood").css({
      opacity: 0
    }), $("#BD_result_bg").css({
      opacity: 0
    }), S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status = "animate", S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_bg_scale_down(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_char("wait"), S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_char_move_left(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result === "ok") {
    S_BLUE_DRAGON.count_tip_show = 1;
    S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_tip_hide();
    S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_particle = !1;
    for (var n in S_BLUE_DRAGON.particle_info) $("#" + n).remove();
    S_BLUE_DRAGON.particle_info = {}
  }
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.callback_idle = function() {
  console.log(" ========= S_BLUE_DRAGON.callback_idle   called");
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_show_callback_fn = null;
  gEnableKey = 1;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status = "idle";
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.ad_hide = !1;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.drawFocus()
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.callback_result = function() {
  console.log(" ========= S_BLUE_DRAGON.callback_result   called");
  gEnableKey = 1;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.scene_status = "result";
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.drawFocus()
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_idle_return = function() {
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_idle_return = !1;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_dragon_name_right();
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_button_1_up();
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_top_1_down();
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_gauge_box_left();
  $("#BD_speech_balloon_box").show();
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result === "no" && S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_tip_show("add")
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.start_render = function() {
  clearTimeout(S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_timer_num);
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_timer_num = null;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_count = 1;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_timer_num = setTimeout(S_BLUE_DRAGON.render, S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_time);
  window.requestAFrame(S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_raf)
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.render = function() {
  if (!$("#S_BLUE_DRAGON_div").html()) {
    console.log(" S_BLUE_DRAGON.render  clearTimeout ");
    clearTimeout(S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_timer_num);
    S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_timer_num = null;
    return
  }
  if (S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_tip_show ? S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_tip_show() : S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_tip_hide && S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_tip_hide(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_char(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_char_ef_circle(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_char_ef_light(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_progress_particle && S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_progress_particle(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_particle && S_BLUE_DRAGON.cur_gauge > 5) {
    var n = 7 + parseInt(14 - S_BLUE_DRAGON.cur_gauge / 10);
    S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_count % n == 1 && S_BLUE_DRAGON.create_particle()
  }
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.is_event === "yes" && S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_count % 3 == 1 && S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_event_icon();
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_count++;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_timer_num = setTimeout(S_BLUE_DRAGON.render, S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_time)
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_raf = function(n) {
  (S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_scale_up || S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_scale_down) && S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_bg_scale_up_down(n);
  (S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_dragon_name_left || S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_dragon_name_right) && S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_dragon_name_left_right(n);
  (S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_button_1_up || S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_button_1_down) && S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_button_1_up_down(n);
  (S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_top_1_up || S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_top_1_down) && S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_top_1_up_down(n);
  (S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_gauge_box_left_left || S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_gauge_box_left_right) && S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_gauge_box_left_right(n);
  (S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_char_move_left || S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_char_move_right) && S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_char_move_left_right(n);
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_result_pop_up && S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_result_pop_up(n);
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_result_minichar_right && S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_result_minichar_right(n);
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_idle_return && S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_idle_return();
  (S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_gauge_up || S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_gauge_down) && S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_gauge_up_down(n);
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_particle(n);
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.done_render_raf || window.requestAFrame(S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_raf)
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.update_event_icon = function() {
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.is_event === "yes" ? $("#BD_gauge_evnt_icon").show() : $("#BD_gauge_evnt_icon").hide()
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_event_icon = function() {
  var t = S_BLUE_DRAGON.img_url,
    n = "";
  USER.lang != LANG.KOREA && (n = "_en");
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.event_num++;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.event_num > 2 && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.event_num = 1);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("BD_gauge_evnt_icon", t + "event_4gauge_guaranteed_icon" + S_BLUE_DRAGON.event_num + n + "_0.png", -12, -66)
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_tip_show = function(n, t) {
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_img_num = 0;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_show_callback_fn = t;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_tip_show = !0;
  n === "add" ? ($("#BD_tip_box").css({
    left: "395px"
  }), $("#BD_tip_txt").css({
    "line-height": "68px",
    color: "#ffffff"
  }), S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_txt = LANG.replace_value(TXT.gage_increase_text, [S_BLUE_DRAGON.add_gauge]), S_BLUE_DRAGON.count_tip_show = 2) : n === "complete" ? ($("#BD_tip_box").css({
    left: "361px"
  }), $("#BD_tip_txt").css({
    "line-height": "35px",
    color: "#fff595"
  }), S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_txt = TXT.persuade_success_center_des, S_BLUE_DRAGON.count_tip_show = 1) : ($("#BD_tip_box").css({
    left: "395px"
  }), $("#BD_tip_txt").css({
    "line-height": "35px",
    color: "#ffffff"
  }), S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_txt = TXT.dragon_des_text, S_BLUE_DRAGON.count_tip_show = 1)
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_tip_hide = function() {
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_img_num = 5;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_tip_hide = !0
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_tip_show = function() {
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_img_num++;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_img_num <= 5 && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("BD_tip_bg", S_BLUE_DRAGON.img_url + "bdtemple_txtbox" + S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_img_num + ".png", 0, 0);
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_img_num === 5 && ($("#BD_tip_txt").html(S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_txt).show(), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("BD_tip_arrow", S_BLUE_DRAGON.img_url + "bdtemple_txtbox_arrow.png", 265, 108), S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_tip_show = !1, S_BLUE_DRAGON.count_tip_show--, S_BLUE_DRAGON.count_tip_show === 1 ? setTimeout(function() {
    S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_tip_hide()
  }, 1500) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_show_callback_fn && S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_show_callback_fn())
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_tip_hide = function() {
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_img_num === 5 && ($("#BD_tip_txt").hide(), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("BD_tip_arrow", "", 265, 108));
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_img_num--;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_img_num > 0 && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("BD_tip_bg", S_BLUE_DRAGON.img_url + "bdtemple_txtbox" + S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_img_num + ".png", 0, 0);
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.tip_img_num === 0 && (utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("BD_tip_bg", "", 0, 0), S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_tip_hide = !1, S_BLUE_DRAGON.count_tip_show === 1 && ($("#BD_gauge_addnum").hide(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_tip_show("", S_BLUE_DRAGON.callback_idle)))
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_char = function(n, t) {
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_status = "wait";
  typeof n == "string" && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_status = n);
  typeof t == "string" && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result = t);
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_wait_num = 1;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_progress_num = 1;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result_num = 1;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.progress_particle_num = 1
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_char = function() {
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_status === "wait" ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_wait_num++, S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_wait_num > 14 && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_wait_num = 1), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("BD_char", S_BLUE_DRAGON.img_url + "bdragon_wait" + S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_wait_num + ".png", 0, 0)) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_status === "progress" ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_progress_num == 15 && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_progress_particle = !0, $("#BD_result_title").show(), $("#BD_result_btn1_box").show(), $("#BD_result_btn2_box").show(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.drawFocus("hide"), S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_result_pop_up(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_result_minichar_right(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result === "ok" && S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_tip_show("complete")), $("#BD_ef_circle").hide(), $("#BD_ef_light").hide(), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("BD_char", S_BLUE_DRAGON.img_url + "bdragon_progress" + S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_progress_num + ".png", 0, 0), S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_progress_num++, S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_progress_num > 16 && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_progress_num = 16, S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_status = S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result, $("#BD_ef_circle").show(), $("#BD_ef_light").show())) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_status === "no" ? (utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("BD_char", S_BLUE_DRAGON.img_url + "bdragon_no" + S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result_num + ".png", 0, 0), S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result_num++, S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result_num > 10 && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result_num = 10)) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_status === "ok" && (utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("BD_char", S_BLUE_DRAGON.img_url + "bdragon_ok" + S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result_num + ".png", 0, 0), S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result_num++, S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result_num > 14 && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result_num = 1))

S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_bg_scale_up_down = function(n) {
  var i, u, r, t;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.bg_scale_start === null && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.bg_scale_start = n);
  i = n - S_BLUE_DRAGON.bg_scale_start;
  u = .3 / S_BLUE_DRAGON.bg_scale_duration;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.bg_scale_previous !== n && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_scale_up ? (r = Math.min(u * i, .3), t = 1 + r, utilScale_xy_center("BD_bg", t, t), t === 1.3 && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_scale_up = !1)) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_scale_down && (r = Math.min(u * i, .3), t = 1.3 - r, utilScale_xy_center("BD_bg", t, t), t === 1 && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_scale_down = !1)));
  i < S_BLUE_DRAGON.bg_scale_duration && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.bg_scale_previous = n)
};

  }), console.log(" enable_gauge_box_left count: " + t), t === 1038 && (console.log(" enable_gauge_box_left end "), $("#BD_gauge_box").css({
    left: "1038px"
  }), S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_gauge_box_left = !1, S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result === "no" ? S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_gauge_up() : S_BLUE_DRAGON.char_result === "ok" && S_BLUE_DRAGON.animate_gauge_down())) : S_BLUE_DRAGON.enable_gauge_box_right && (t = 1038 + Math.min(u * r, i), $("#BD_gauge_box").css({

S_BLUE_DRAGON.create_particle = function() {
  var u, t, f, i, e;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.particle_count++;
  var t = Math.random(),
    r = t + .5,
    n = document.createElement("img");
  n.id = "particle" + S_BLUE_DRAGON.particle_count;
  n.src = S_BLUE_DRAGON.img_url + "bdtemple_gbox_particle.png";
  n.width = Math.floor(13 * r);
  n.height = Math.floor(13 * r);
  n.style.position = "absolute";
  t = Math.random();
  u = t * 40;
  n.style.left = Math.floor(39 + u) + "px";
  t = Math.random();
  f = 1 + Math.floor(t * 2);
  n.style.top = "414px";
  i = 2.8 * S_BLUE_DRAGON.cur_gauge;
  e = i / (S_BLUE_DRAGON.cur_gauge * 100);
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.particle_info[n.id] = {
    y_value: f,
    move_y: i,
    start_time: null,
    gauge_min: e,
    previous: null
  };
  $("#BD_gauge_top").after(n)
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_particle_one = function(n, t) {
  var i = S_BLUE_DRAGON.particle_info[n],
    u, r, f;
  i.start_time === null && (i.start_time = t);
  u = t - i.start_time;
  i.previous !== t && (r = Math.min(i.gauge_min * u * i.y_value, i.move_y), f = 414 - r, $("#" + n).css({
    top: f + "px"
  }), i.move_y <= r && ($("#" + n).remove(), delete S_BLUE_DRAGON.particle_info[n]));
  i.previous = t
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_particle = function(n) {
  for (var t in S_BLUE_DRAGON.particle_info) S_BLUE_DRAGON.render_particle_one(t, n)
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_BLUE_DRAGON_div").mouseover(S_BLUE_DRAGON.onMouseover)
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_BLUE_DRAGON_div").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("c_button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } REWARD_AD.hit(t.id, "BD_ad_box") ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus = 4, S_BLUE_DRAGON.menuRun()) : t.id.search("BD_back") >= 0 ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus = 1, S_BLUE_DRAGON.menuRun()) : t.id.search("BD_persuade") >= 0 ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus = 2, S_BLUE_DRAGON.menuRun()) : t.id.search("BD_help") >= 0 ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus = 3, S_BLUE_DRAGON.menuRun()) : t.id.search("BD_result_btn1") >= 0 ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus = 1, S_BLUE_DRAGON.menuRun()) : t.id.search("BD_result_btn2") >= 0 && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus = 2, S_BLUE_DRAGON.menuRun())
  }
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("c_button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } REWARD_AD.hit(t.id, "BD_ad_box") ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus = 4, S_BLUE_DRAGON.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("BD_back") >= 0 ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus = 1, S_BLUE_DRAGON.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("BD_persuade") >= 0 ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus = 2, S_BLUE_DRAGON.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("BD_help") >= 0 ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON.focus = 3, S_BLUE_DRAGON.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("BD_result_btn1") >= 0 ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus = 1, S_BLUE_DRAGON.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("BD_result_btn2") >= 0 && (S_BLUE_DRAGON.result_focus = 2, S_BLUE_DRAGON.drawFocus())
  }
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.onMousedown = function(n) {
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON.onMouseup = function(n) {
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.onMouseover(n);
  S_BLUE_DRAGON.onClick(n);
  return
};

S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.init = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  utilConsoleLog("S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.init");
  $("#S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP_div").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  utilPush();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP;
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.focus = 1;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.call_preload == !1 && S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.preload();
  S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.maketag();
  S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.call_preload = !1;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.make_screen();
  S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.drawFocus();
  S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.addMouseEvent();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  setTimeout(function() {
    gEnableKey = 1
  }, 700)
};

    n += "<\/div>";

S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + i + " in S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.keyDown()");
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.RED:
      S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.show_percentage()
  }
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.make_screen = function() {

    background: "black",
    opacity: "0.9"
  });
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("BDH_bg", n + "bdtemple_help" + i + ".png", 0, 0);
  util_draw_div("BDH_back_box", 550, 623, 180, 80);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("BDH_back_bg", n + "bdtemple_okbt.png", 0, 0);
  util_draw_text_html(TXT.cancel, "BDH_back_txt", 0, 0, 180, 80, 80, 35, "center", "#fff595").css({
    "text-shadow": "#5d261a -2px -2px 2px,#5d261a 0px -2px 2px,#5d261a 2px -2px 2px,#5d261a -2px 0px 2px,#5d261a 2px 0px 2px,#5d261a -2px 2px 2px,#5d261a 0px 2px 2px,#5d261a 2px 2px 2px"
  });
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("BDH_back_f", n + "bdtemple_okbt_f.png", -5, -5);
  util_draw_div("BDH_red_box", 1095, 657, 135, 32);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("BDH_red_bg", S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.red_img, 0, 0);

S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.focus === 1 && utilScale_xy_center("BDH_back_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.focus === 1 && utilScale_xy_center("BDH_back_box", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.menuRun_Run = function() {

  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP_div").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("c_button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("BDH_back") >= 0 ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.focus = 1, S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.menuRun()) : t.id.search("BDH_red") >= 0 && S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.show_percentage()
  }
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if ((utilConsoleLog(" onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), gMOUSE_USE) && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("c_button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("BDH_back") >= 0 && (S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.focus = 1, S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.drawFocus())
  }
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.onMouseover(n);
  S_BLUE_DRAGON_HELP.onClick(n);
  return
};

S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + i + " in S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.keyDown()");
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.focus = 1;
      S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.focus = 2;
      S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.menuRun()
  }
};
