S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.drawFocus = function() {
  S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.focus == 1 ? ($("#BDP_yes_f").show(), $("#BDP_no_f").hide()) : S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.focus == 2 && ($("#BDP_yes_f").hide(), $("#BDP_no_f").show())
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("BDP_yes_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.focus === 2 && utilScale_xy_center("BDP_no_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("BDP_yes_box", 1, 1) : S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.focus === 2 && utilScale_xy_center("BDP_no_box", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.menuRun_Run = function() {
  $("#MM_top").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.focus === 1 ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.back(), S_BLUE_DRAGON.yes()) : S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.focus === 2 && (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_BLUE_DRAGON_POPUP.back())
};

S_FOUR_GODS.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + i + " in S_FOUR_GODS.keyDown()");
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.NUM0:
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_FOUR_GODS.back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_FOUR_GODS.row_focus == 1 && (S_FOUR_GODS.focus--, S_FOUR_GODS.focus < 1 && (S_FOUR_GODS.focus = 1), S_FOUR_GODS.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_FOUR_GODS.row_focus == 1 && (S_FOUR_GODS.focus++, S_FOUR_GODS.focus > 4 && (S_FOUR_GODS.focus = 4), S_FOUR_GODS.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_FOUR_GODS.row_focus == 1 && (S_FOUR_GODS.row_focus = 2, S_FOUR_GODS.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_FOUR_GODS.row_focus == 2 && (S_FOUR_GODS.row_focus = 1, S_FOUR_GODS.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_FOUR_GODS.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      S_FOUR_GODS.row_focus = 1;
      S_FOUR_GODS.focus = 1;
      S_FOUR_GODS.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      S_FOUR_GODS.row_focus = 1;
      S_FOUR_GODS.focus = 2;
      S_FOUR_GODS.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
      S_FOUR_GODS.row_focus = 1;
      S_FOUR_GODS.focus = 3;
      S_FOUR_GODS.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM4:
      S_FOUR_GODS.row_focus = 1;
      S_FOUR_GODS.focus = 4;
      S_FOUR_GODS.menuRun()
  }
};
S_FOUR_GODS.make_screen = function() {
  var t, i, r, f, u, n;
  for (util_draw_div("S_FOUR_GODS_div", 0, 0, 1280, 720), t = S_FOUR_GODS.img_url, i = "", USER.lang != LANG.KOREA && (i = "_en"), r = {
      "text-shadow": "#000000 -2px -2px 2px,#000000 0px -2px 2px,#000000 2px -2px 2px,#000000 -2px 0px 2px,#000000 2px 0px 2px,#000000 -2px 2px 2px,#000000 0px 2px 2px,#000000 2px 2px 2px"

S_FOUR_GODS.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  S_FOUR_GODS.focus === 1 && utilScale_xy_center("FG_back_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    S_FOUR_GODS.focus === 1 && utilScale_xy_center("FG_back_box", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_FOUR_GODS.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_FOUR_GODS.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (S_FOUR_GODS.row_focus === 2) gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_FOUR_GODS.back();
  else if (S_FOUR_GODS.row_focus === 1) {
    loading_show("", 1);
    var n = {
      MODE: "GET",
      GAGE: 0,
      EVENT: "no",
      CLOUD: USER.cloud_piece,
      TYPE: S_FOUR_GODS.focus
    };
    ServerConnection.update_dragon_info(n, function(n) {
      loading_hide();
      bga("send", "event", "mainmenu", "blur dragon(청룡신전)", "ok");
      utilPush();
      S_FOUR_GODS.end();
      S_FOUR_GODS.focus == 1 ? (S_BLUE_DRAGON.is_event = n.EVENT, S_BLUE_DRAGON.cur_gauge = parseInt(n.GAGE), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_BLUE_DRAGON, S_BLUE_DRAGON)) : S_FOUR_GODS.focus == 2 ? (S_FOUR_TIGER.is_event = n.EVENT, S_FOUR_TIGER.cur_gauge = parseInt(n.GAGE), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_FOUR_TIGER, S_FOUR_TIGER)) : S_FOUR_GODS.focus == 3 ? (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.is_event = n.EVENT, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.cur_gauge = parseInt(n.GAGE), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_FOUR_TORTOISE, S_FOUR_TORTOISE)) : S_FOUR_GODS.focus == 4 && (S_FOUR_BIRD.is_event = n.EVENT, S_FOUR_BIRD.cur_gauge = parseInt(n.GAGE), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_FOUR_BIRD, S_FOUR_BIRD))
    })
  }
};

S_FOUR_GODS.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_FOUR_GODS_div").mouseover(S_FOUR_GODS.onMouseover)
};
S_FOUR_GODS.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_FOUR_GODS_div").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_FOUR_GODS.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("c_button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("FG_back") >= 0 ? (S_FOUR_GODS.row_focus = 2, S_FOUR_GODS.menuRun()) : t.id.search("FG_select") >= 0 && (S_FOUR_GODS.row_focus = 1, S_FOUR_GODS.focus = Number(t.id.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "")), S_FOUR_GODS.menuRun())
  }
};
S_FOUR_GODS.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if ((utilConsoleLog(" onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), gMOUSE_USE) && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("c_button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("FG_back") >= 0 ? (S_FOUR_GODS.row_focus = 2, S_FOUR_GODS.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("FG_select") >= 0 && (S_FOUR_GODS.row_focus = 1, S_FOUR_GODS.focus = Number(t.id.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "")), S_FOUR_GODS.drawFocus())
  }
};
S_FOUR_GODS.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_FOUR_GODS.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_FOUR_GODS.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_FOUR_GODS.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_FOUR_GODS.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_FOUR_GODS.onMouseover(n);
  S_FOUR_GODS.onClick(n);
  return
};

S_FOUR_TIGER.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var r = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    i;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + r + " in S_FOUR_TIGER.keyDown()");
  switch (r) {
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status === "idle" ? (S_FOUR_TIGER.focus = 1, S_FOUR_TIGER.menuRun_Run()) : S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_TIGER.result_focus = 1, S_FOUR_TIGER.menuRun_Run());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status === "idle" ? (S_FOUR_TIGER.focus--, S_FOUR_TIGER.focus < 1 && (S_FOUR_TIGER.focus = 1)) : S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_TIGER.result_focus--, S_FOUR_TIGER.result_focus < 1 && (S_FOUR_TIGER.result_focus = 1));
      S_FOUR_TIGER.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status === "idle" ? (S_FOUR_TIGER.focus++, i = REWARD_AD.exists(REWARD_AD.PLACE.FOUR_GODS) ? 4 : 3, S_FOUR_TIGER.focus > i && (S_FOUR_TIGER.focus = i)) : S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_TIGER.result_focus++, S_FOUR_TIGER.result_focus > 2 && (S_FOUR_TIGER.result_focus = 2));
      S_FOUR_TIGER.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_FOUR_TIGER.menuRun()
  }
};

S_FOUR_TIGER.drawFocus = function(n) {
  S_FOUR_TIGER.ad_hide || S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status !== "idle" ? REWARD_AD.hide("FT_ad_box") : REWARD_AD.show("FT_ad_box");
  S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status === "idle" ? ($("#FT_back_f").hide(), $("#FT_persuade_f").hide(), $("#FT_help_f").hide(), $("#FT_ad_f").hide(), S_FOUR_TIGER.focus == 1 ? $("#FT_back_f").show() : S_FOUR_TIGER.focus == 2 ? $("#FT_persuade_f").show() : S_FOUR_TIGER.focus == 3 ? $("#FT_help_f").show() : $("#FT_ad_f").show()) : S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status === "result" && ($("#FT_result_btn1_f").hide(), $("#FT_result_btn2_f").hide(), $("#FT_result_btn" + S_FOUR_TIGER.result_focus + "_f").show());
  n === "hide" && ($("#FT_back_f").hide(), $("#FT_persuade_f").hide(), $("#FT_help_f").hide(), $("#FT_ad_f").hide(), $("#FT_result_btn1_f").hide(), $("#FT_result_btn2_f").hide())
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status === "idle" ? S_FOUR_TIGER.focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("FT_back_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_FOUR_TIGER.focus === 2 ? (loading_show(), utilScale_xy_center("FT_persuade_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)) : S_FOUR_TIGER.focus === 3 ? utilScale_xy_center("FT_help_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_FOUR_TIGER.focus === 4 && utilScale_xy_center("FT_ad_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_TIGER.result_focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("FT_result_btn1_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_FOUR_TIGER.result_focus === 2 && utilScale_xy_center("FT_result_btn2_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale));
  setTimeout(function() {
    S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status === "idle" ? S_FOUR_TIGER.focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("FT_back_box", 1, 1) : S_FOUR_TIGER.focus === 2 ? utilScale_xy_center("FT_persuade_box", 1, 1) : S_FOUR_TIGER.focus === 3 ? utilScale_xy_center("FT_help_box", 1, 1) : S_FOUR_TIGER.focus === 4 && utilScale_xy_center("FT_ad_box", 1, 1) : S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_TIGER.result_focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("FT_result_btn1_box", 1, 1) : S_FOUR_TIGER.result_focus === 2 && utilScale_xy_center("FT_result_btn2_box", 1, 1));
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_FOUR_TIGER.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status === "idle") {
    if (S_FOUR_TIGER.focus === 4) {
      if (S_FOUR_TIGER.cur_gauge >= S_FOUR_TIGER.GAUGE_MAX) {
        utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_gauge_full, 2);
        gEnableKey = 1;
        return
      }
      if (!REWARD_AD.is_enabled("FT_ad_box")) {
        REWARD_AD.notice_state("FT_ad_box");
        gEnableKey = 1;
        return
      }
      REWARD_AD.play(REWARD_AD.PLACE.FOUR_GODS, "101", null, S_FOUR_TIGER.on_reward_ad);
      return
    }
    if (S_FOUR_TIGER.focus === 1) gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_FOUR_TIGER.back();
    else if (S_FOUR_TIGER.focus === 2) {
      if (USER.cloud_piece < S_FOUR_TIGER.cost_num || isNaN(USER.cloud_piece)) {
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        utilNotice(TXT.cloud_pieces_lack, 2);
        return
      }
      if (!S_GACHA.is_char_storage_space_available("FOUR_GODS")) {
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        return
      }
      utilPush();
      S_FOUR_TIGER.removeMouseEvent();
      S_FOUR_TIGER.ad_hide = !0;
      S_FOUR_TIGER.drawFocus("hide");
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_FOUR_TIGER_POPUP, S_FOUR_TIGER_POPUP)
    } else S_FOUR_TIGER.focus === 3 && (utilPush(), S_FOUR_TIGER.removeMouseEvent(), S_FOUR_TIGER.drawFocus("hide"), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_FOUR_TIGER_HELP, S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP))
  }
  S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_TIGER.result_focus === 1 ? S_FOUR_TIGER.result_ok() : S_FOUR_TIGER.result_focus === 2 && (utilPush(), S_FOUR_TIGER.end(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM)))
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.end = function() {
  clearTimeout(S_FOUR_TIGER.render_timer_num);
  S_FOUR_TIGER.render_timer_num = null;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.done_render_raf = !0;
  $("#S_FOUR_TIGER_div").remove();
  S_FOUR_TIGER.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.back = function() {
  S_FOUR_TIGER.end();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_FOUR_GODS, S_FOUR_GODS)
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.yes = function() {
  S_FOUR_TIGER.ad_hide = !0;
  REWARD_AD.hide("FT_ad_box");
  loading_show("", 1);
  var n = {
    MODE: "UPDATE",
    GAGE: S_FOUR_TIGER.cur_gauge,
    EVENT: S_FOUR_TIGER.is_event,
    CLOUD: USER.cloud_piece,
    TYPE: 2
  };
  ServerConnection.update_dragon_info(n, function(n) {
    if (loading_hide(), S_FOUR_TIGER.is_event = n.EVENT, n.STATE === "NOTICE") gEnableKey = 1, utilNotice(TXT.tiger_event_end, 2), S_FOUR_TIGER.update_event_icon(), S_FOUR_TIGER.ad_hide = !1, S_FOUR_TIGER.drawFocus();
    else {
      gEnableKey = 0;
      S_FOUR_TIGER.update_event_icon();
      n.STATE === "SUCCESS" ? (STORAGE.add_char(101, !0), S_FOUR_TIGER.char_result = "ok") : n.STATE === "FAIL" && (S_FOUR_TIGER.char_result = "no");
      S_FOUR_TIGER.add_gauge = parseInt(n.MULTI);
      var t = S_FOUR_TIGER.cur_gauge + S_FOUR_TIGER.add_gauge;
      t > S_FOUR_TIGER.GAUGE_MAX && (S_FOUR_TIGER.add_gauge = S_FOUR_TIGER.GAUGE_MAX - S_FOUR_TIGER.cur_gauge);
      USER.cloud_piece = parseInt(n.CLOUD);
      S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_bg_scale_up();
      S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_dragon_name_left();
      S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_button_1_down();
      S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_top_1_up();
      S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_gauge_box_right();
      S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_char_move_right();
      S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_tip_hide();
      $("#FT_speech_balloon_box").hide();
      $("#MM_top_cloud_piece_txt").text(utilGetNumber_withComma(USER.cloud_piece + ""))
    }
  })
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.update_cur_gauge = function() {
  var n = 414 - 2.8 * S_FOUR_TIGER.cur_gauge;
  $("#FT_gauge_white").css({
    top: n + "px"
  });
  $("#FT_gauge_top").css({
    top: -5 + n + "px"
  });
  $("#FT_gauge_addnum").css({
    top: -68 + n + "px"
  })
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.result_ok = function() {
  if (gEnableKey = 0, $("#FT_result_title").hide(), $("#FT_result_minich_box").hide(), $("#FT_result_pop_box").hide(), $("#FT_result_btn1_box").hide(), $("#FT_result_btn2_box").hide(), $("#FT_result_chmood").css({
      opacity: 0
    }), $("#FT_result_bg").css({
      opacity: 0
    }), S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status = "animate", S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_bg_scale_down(), S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_char("wait"), S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_char_move_left(), S_FOUR_TIGER.char_result === "ok") {
    S_FOUR_TIGER.count_tip_show = 1;
    S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_tip_hide();
    S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_particle = !1;
    for (var n in S_FOUR_TIGER.particle_info) $("#" + n).remove();
    S_FOUR_TIGER.particle_info = {}
  }
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.callback_idle = function() {
  console.log(" ========= S_FOUR_TIGER.callback_idle   called");
  S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_show_callback_fn = null;
  gEnableKey = 1;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status = "idle";
  S_FOUR_TIGER.ad_hide = !1;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.drawFocus()
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.callback_result = function() {
  console.log(" ========= S_FOUR_TIGER.callback_result   called");
  gEnableKey = 1;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.scene_status = "result";
  S_FOUR_TIGER.drawFocus()
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_idle_return = function() {
  S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_idle_return = !1;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_dragon_name_right();
  S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_button_1_up();
  S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_top_1_down();
  S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_gauge_box_left();
  $("#FT_speech_balloon_box").show();
  S_FOUR_TIGER.char_result === "no" && S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_tip_show("add")
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.start_render = function() {
  clearTimeout(S_FOUR_TIGER.render_timer_num);
  S_FOUR_TIGER.render_timer_num = null;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.render_count = 1;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.render_timer_num = setTimeout(S_FOUR_TIGER.render, S_FOUR_TIGER.render_time);
  window.requestAFrame(S_FOUR_TIGER.render_raf)
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.render = function() {
  if (!$("#S_FOUR_TIGER_div").html()) {
    console.log(" S_FOUR_TIGER.render  clearTimeout ");
    clearTimeout(S_FOUR_TIGER.render_timer_num);
    S_FOUR_TIGER.render_timer_num = null;
    return
  }
  if (S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_tip_show ? S_FOUR_TIGER.render_tip_show() : S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_tip_hide && S_FOUR_TIGER.render_tip_hide(), S_FOUR_TIGER.render_char(), S_FOUR_TIGER.render_char_ef_circle(), S_FOUR_TIGER.render_char_ef_light(), S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_progress_particle && S_FOUR_TIGER.render_progress_particle(), S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_particle && S_FOUR_TIGER.cur_gauge > 5) {
    var n = 7 + parseInt(14 - S_FOUR_TIGER.cur_gauge / 10);
    S_FOUR_TIGER.render_count % n == 1 && S_FOUR_TIGER.create_particle()
  }
  S_FOUR_TIGER.is_event === "yes" && S_FOUR_TIGER.render_count % 3 == 1 && S_FOUR_TIGER.render_event_icon();
  S_FOUR_TIGER.render_count++;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.render_timer_num = setTimeout(S_FOUR_TIGER.render, S_FOUR_TIGER.render_time)
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.render_raf = function(n) {
  (S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_scale_up || S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_scale_down) && S_FOUR_TIGER.render_bg_scale_up_down(n);
  (S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_dragon_name_left || S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_dragon_name_right) && S_FOUR_TIGER.render_dragon_name_left_right(n);
  (S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_button_1_up || S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_button_1_down) && S_FOUR_TIGER.render_button_1_up_down(n);
  (S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_top_1_up || S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_top_1_down) && S_FOUR_TIGER.render_top_1_up_down(n);
  (S_FOUR_TIGER.render_gauge_box_left_left || S_FOUR_TIGER.render_gauge_box_left_right) && S_FOUR_TIGER.render_gauge_box_left_right(n);
  (S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_char_move_left || S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_char_move_right) && S_FOUR_TIGER.render_char_move_left_right(n);
  S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_result_pop_up && S_FOUR_TIGER.render_result_pop_up(n);
  S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_result_minichar_right && S_FOUR_TIGER.render_result_minichar_right(n);
  S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_idle_return && S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_idle_return();
  (S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_gauge_up || S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_gauge_down) && S_FOUR_TIGER.render_gauge_up_down(n);
  S_FOUR_TIGER.render_particle(n);
  S_FOUR_TIGER.done_render_raf || window.requestAFrame(S_FOUR_TIGER.render_raf)
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.update_event_icon = function() {
  S_FOUR_TIGER.is_event === "yes" ? $("#FT_gauge_evnt_icon").show() : $("#FT_gauge_evnt_icon").hide()
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.render_event_icon = function() {
  var t = S_FOUR_TIGER.img_url,
    n = "";
  USER.lang != LANG.KOREA && (n = "_en");
  S_FOUR_TIGER.event_num++;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.event_num > 2 && (S_FOUR_TIGER.event_num = 1);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FT_gauge_evnt_icon", t + "event_4gauge_guaranteed_icon" + S_FOUR_TIGER.event_num + n + "_0.png", -12, -66)
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_tip_show = function(n, t) {
  S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_img_num = 0;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_show_callback_fn = t;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_tip_show = !0;
  n === "add" ? ($("#FT_tip_box").css({
    left: "395px"
  }), $("#FT_tip_txt").css({
    "line-height": "68px",
    color: "#ffffff"
  }), S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_txt = LANG.replace_value(TXT.gage_increase_text, [S_FOUR_TIGER.add_gauge]), S_FOUR_TIGER.count_tip_show = 2) : n === "complete" ? ($("#FT_tip_box").css({
    left: "361px"
  }), $("#FT_tip_txt").css({
    "line-height": "35px",
    color: "#fff595"
  }), S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_txt = TXT.persuade_success_center_des, S_FOUR_TIGER.count_tip_show = 1) : ($("#FT_tip_box").css({
    left: "395px"
  }), $("#FT_tip_txt").css({
    "line-height": "35px",
    color: "#ffffff"
  }), S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_txt = TXT.tiger_des_text, S_FOUR_TIGER.count_tip_show = 1)
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_tip_hide = function() {
  S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_img_num = 5;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_tip_hide = !0
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.render_tip_show = function() {
  S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_img_num++;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_img_num <= 5 && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FT_tip_bg", S_FOUR_TIGER.img_url + "wttemple_txtbox" + S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_img_num + ".png", 0, 0);
  S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_img_num === 5 && ($("#FT_tip_txt").html(S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_txt).show(), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FT_tip_arrow", S_FOUR_TIGER.img_url + "bdtemple_txtbox_arrow.png", 265, 108), S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_tip_show = !1, S_FOUR_TIGER.count_tip_show--, S_FOUR_TIGER.count_tip_show === 1 ? setTimeout(function() {
    S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_tip_hide()
  }, 1500) : S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_show_callback_fn && S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_show_callback_fn())
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.render_tip_hide = function() {
  S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_img_num === 5 && ($("#FT_tip_txt").hide(), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FT_tip_arrow", "", 265, 108));
  S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_img_num--;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_img_num > 0 && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FT_tip_bg", S_FOUR_TIGER.img_url + "wttemple_txtbox" + S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_img_num + ".png", 0, 0);
  S_FOUR_TIGER.tip_img_num === 0 && (utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FT_tip_bg", "", 0, 0), S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_tip_hide = !1, S_FOUR_TIGER.count_tip_show === 1 && ($("#FT_gauge_addnum").hide(), S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_tip_show("", S_FOUR_TIGER.callback_idle)))
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_char = function(n, t) {
  S_FOUR_TIGER.char_status = "wait";
  typeof n == "string" && (S_FOUR_TIGER.char_status = n);
  typeof t == "string" && (S_FOUR_TIGER.char_result = t);
  S_FOUR_TIGER.char_wait_num = 1;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.char_progress_num = 1;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.char_result_num = 1;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.progress_particle_num = 1
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.render_char = function() {
  S_FOUR_TIGER.char_status === "wait" ? (S_FOUR_TIGER.char_wait_num++, S_FOUR_TIGER.char_wait_num > 14 && (S_FOUR_TIGER.char_wait_num = 1), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FT_char", S_FOUR_TIGER.img_url + "wtiger_wait" + S_FOUR_TIGER.char_wait_num + ".png", S_FOUR_TIGER.char_left, S_FOUR_TIGER.char_top)) : S_FOUR_TIGER.char_status === "progress" ? (S_FOUR_TIGER.char_progress_num == 15 && (S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_progress_particle = !0, $("#FT_result_title").show(), $("#FT_result_btn1_box").show(), $("#FT_result_btn2_box").show(), S_FOUR_TIGER.drawFocus("hide"), S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_result_pop_up(), S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_result_minichar_right(), S_FOUR_TIGER.char_result === "ok" && S_FOUR_TIGER.animate_tip_show("complete")), $("#FT_ef_circle").hide(), $("#FT_ef_light").hide(), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FT_char", S_FOUR_TIGER.img_url + "wtiger_progress" + S_FOUR_TIGER.char_progress_num + ".png", S_FOUR_TIGER.char_left, S_FOUR_TIGER.char_top), S_FOUR_TIGER.char_progress_num++, S_FOUR_TIGER.char_progress_num > 16 && (S_FOUR_TIGER.char_progress_num = 16, S_FOUR_TIGER.char_status = S_FOUR_TIGER.char_result, $("#FT_ef_circle").show(), $("#FT_ef_light").show())) : S_FOUR_TIGER.char_status === "no" ? (utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FT_char", S_FOUR_TIGER.img_url + "wtiger_fail" + S_FOUR_TIGER.char_result_num + ".png", S_FOUR_TIGER.char_left, S_FOUR_TIGER.char_top), S_FOUR_TIGER.char_result_num++, S_FOUR_TIGER.char_result_num > 10 && (S_FOUR_TIGER.char_result_num = 10)) : S_FOUR_TIGER.char_status === "ok" && (utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FT_char", S_FOUR_TIGER.img_url + "wtiger_success" + S_FOUR_TIGER.char_result_num + ".png", S_FOUR_TIGER.char_left, S_FOUR_TIGER.char_top), S_FOUR_TIGER.char_result_num++, S_FOUR_TIGER.char_result_num > 14 && (S_FOUR_TIGER.char_result_num = 1))
};

  }), console.log(" enable_gauge_up  gauge_white:" + t), t === 414 - S_FOUR_TIGER.cur_gauge_y - i && (S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_gauge_up = !1)) : S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_gauge_down && (t = 414 - S_FOUR_TIGER.cur_gauge_y + Math.min(u * r, i), $("#FT_gauge_white").css({
    top: t + "px"
  }), $("#FT_gauge_top").css({
    top: -5 + t + "px"
  }), $("#FT_gauge_addnum").css({
    top: -68 + t + "px"
  }), console.log(" enable_gauge_down  gauge_white:" + t), t === 414 && (S_FOUR_TIGER.enable_gauge_down = !1)));
  r < S_FOUR_TIGER.gauge_duration && (S_FOUR_TIGER.gauge_previous = n)
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.create_particle = function() {
  var u, t, f, i, e;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.particle_count++;
  var t = Math.random(),
    r = t + .5,
    n = document.createElement("img");
  n.id = "particle" + S_FOUR_TIGER.particle_count;
  n.src = S_FOUR_TIGER.img_url + "wttemple_gbox_particle.png";
  n.width = Math.floor(13 * r);
  n.height = Math.floor(13 * r);
  n.style.position = "absolute";
  t = Math.random();
  u = t * 40;
  n.style.left = Math.floor(39 + u) + "px";
  t = Math.random();
  f = 1 + Math.floor(t * 2);
  n.style.top = "414px";
  i = 2.8 * S_FOUR_TIGER.cur_gauge;
  e = i / (S_FOUR_TIGER.cur_gauge * 100);
  S_FOUR_TIGER.particle_info[n.id] = {
    y_value: f,
    move_y: i,
    start_time: null,
    gauge_min: e,
    previous: null
  };
  $("#FT_gauge_top").after(n)
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.render_particle_one = function(n, t) {
  var i = S_FOUR_TIGER.particle_info[n],
    u, r, f;
  i.start_time === null && (i.start_time = t);
  u = t - i.start_time;
  i.previous !== t && (r = Math.min(i.gauge_min * u * i.y_value, i.move_y), f = 414 - r, $("#" + n).css({
    top: f + "px"
  }), i.move_y <= r && ($("#" + n).remove(), delete S_FOUR_TIGER.particle_info[n]));
  i.previous = t
};
S_FOUR_TIGER.render_particle = function(n) {
  for (var t in S_FOUR_TIGER.particle_info) S_FOUR_TIGER.render_particle_one(t, n)
};

S_FOUR_TORTOISE.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var r = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    i;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + r + " in S_FOUR_TORTOISE.keyDown()");
  switch (r) {
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status === "idle" ? (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus = 1, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.menuRun_Run()) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.result_focus = 1, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.menuRun_Run());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status === "idle" ? (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus--, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus < 1 && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus = 1)) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.result_focus--, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.result_focus < 1 && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.result_focus = 1));
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status === "idle" ? (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus++, i = REWARD_AD.exists(REWARD_AD.PLACE.FOUR_GODS) ? 4 : 3, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus > i && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus = i)) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.result_focus++, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.result_focus > 2 && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.result_focus = 2));
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.menuRun()
  }
};

S_FOUR_TORTOISE.show_user_level_info = function() {
  $("#MM_top").css({
    top: "0px"
  });
  $("#MM_top_profile").show()
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.hide_user_level_info = function() {
  $("#MM_top_profile").hide()
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.drawFocus = function(n) {
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.ad_hide || S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status !== "idle" ? REWARD_AD.hide("FBT_ad_box") : REWARD_AD.show("FBT_ad_box");
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status === "idle" ? ($("#FBT_back_f").hide(), $("#FBT_persuade_f").hide(), $("#FBT_help_f").hide(), $("#FBT_ad_f").hide(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus == 1 ? $("#FBT_back_f").show() : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus == 2 ? $("#FBT_persuade_f").show() : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus == 3 ? $("#FBT_help_f").show() : $("#FBT_ad_f").show()) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status === "result" && ($("#FBT_result_btn1_f").hide(), $("#FBT_result_btn2_f").hide(), $("#FBT_result_btn" + S_FOUR_TORTOISE.result_focus + "_f").show());
  n === "hide" && ($("#FBT_back_f").hide(), $("#FBT_persuade_f").hide(), $("#FBT_help_f").hide(), $("#FBT_ad_f").hide(), $("#FBT_result_btn1_f").hide(), $("#FBT_result_btn2_f").hide())
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status === "idle" ? S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("FBT_back_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus === 2 ? utilScale_xy_center("FBT_persuade_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus === 3 ? utilScale_xy_center("FBT_help_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus === 4 && utilScale_xy_center("FBT_ad_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.result_focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("FBT_result_btn1_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.result_focus === 2 && utilScale_xy_center("FBT_result_btn2_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale));
  setTimeout(function() {
    S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status === "idle" ? S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("FBT_back_box", 1, 1) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus === 2 ? (loading_show(), utilScale_xy_center("FBT_persuade_box", 1, 1)) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus === 3 ? utilScale_xy_center("FBT_help_box", 1, 1) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus === 4 && utilScale_xy_center("FBT_ad_box", 1, 1) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.result_focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("FBT_result_btn1_box", 1, 1) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.result_focus === 2 && utilScale_xy_center("FBT_result_btn2_box", 1, 1));
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status === "idle") {
    if (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus === 4) {
      if (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.cur_gauge >= S_FOUR_TORTOISE.GAUGE_MAX) {
        utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_gauge_full, 2);
        gEnableKey = 1;
        return
      }
      if (!REWARD_AD.is_enabled("FBT_ad_box")) {
        REWARD_AD.notice_state("FBT_ad_box");
        gEnableKey = 1;
        return
      }
      REWARD_AD.play(REWARD_AD.PLACE.FOUR_GODS, "102", null, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.on_reward_ad);
      return
    }
    if (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus === 1) gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.back();
    else if (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus === 2) {
      if (USER.cloud_piece < S_FOUR_TORTOISE.cost_num || isNaN(USER.cloud_piece)) {
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        utilNotice(TXT.cloud_pieces_lack, 2);
        return
      }
      if (!S_GACHA.is_char_storage_space_available("FOUR_GODS")) {
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        return
      }
      utilPush();
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.removeMouseEvent();
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.ad_hide = !0;
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.drawFocus("hide");
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP, S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP)
    } else S_FOUR_TORTOISE.focus === 3 && (utilPush(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.removeMouseEvent(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.drawFocus("hide"), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_FOUR_TORTOISE_HELP, S_FOUR_TORTOISE_HELP))
  }
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.result_focus === 1 ? S_FOUR_TORTOISE.result_ok() : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.result_focus === 2 && (utilPush(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.end(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM)))
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.end = function() {
  clearTimeout(S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_timer_num);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_timer_num = null;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.done_render_raf = !0;
  $("#S_FOUR_TORTOISE_div").remove();
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.back = function() {
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.end();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_FOUR_GODS, S_FOUR_GODS)
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.yes = function() {
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.ad_hide = !0;
  REWARD_AD.hide("FBT_ad_box");
  loading_show("", 1);
  var n = {
    MODE: "UPDATE",
    GAGE: S_FOUR_TORTOISE.cur_gauge,
    EVENT: S_FOUR_TORTOISE.is_event,
    CLOUD: USER.cloud_piece,
    TYPE: 3
  };
  ServerConnection.update_dragon_info(n, function(n) {
    if (loading_hide(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.is_event = n.EVENT, n.STATE === "NOTICE") gEnableKey = 1, utilNotice(TXT.tortoise_event_end, 2), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.update_event_icon(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.ad_hide = !1, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.drawFocus();
    else {
      gEnableKey = 0;
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.update_event_icon();
      n.STATE === "SUCCESS" ? (STORAGE.add_char(102, !0), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_result = "ok") : n.STATE === "FAIL" && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_result = "no");
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.add_gauge = parseInt(n.MULTI);
      var t = S_FOUR_TORTOISE.cur_gauge + S_FOUR_TORTOISE.add_gauge;
      t > S_FOUR_TORTOISE.GAUGE_MAX && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.add_gauge = S_FOUR_TORTOISE.GAUGE_MAX - S_FOUR_TORTOISE.cur_gauge);
      USER.cloud_piece = parseInt(n.CLOUD);
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_bg_scale_up();
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_dragon_name_left();
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_button_1_down();
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_top_1_up();
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_gauge_box_right();
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_char_move_right();
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_tip_hide();
      $("#FBT_speech_balloon_box").hide();
      $("#MM_top_cloud_piece_txt").text(utilGetNumber_withComma(USER.cloud_piece + ""))
    }
  })
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.update_cur_gauge = function() {
  var n = 414 - 2.8 * S_FOUR_TORTOISE.cur_gauge;
  $("#FBT_gauge_white").css({
    top: n + "px"
  });
  $("#FBT_gauge_top").css({
    top: -5 + n + "px"
  });
  $("#FBT_gauge_addnum").css({
    top: -68 + n + "px"
  })
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.result_ok = function() {
  if (gEnableKey = 0, $("#FBT_result_title").hide(), $("#FBT_result_minich_box").hide(), $("#FBT_result_pop_box").hide(), $("#FBT_result_btn1_box").hide(), $("#FBT_result_btn2_box").hide(), $("#FBT_result_chmood").css({
      opacity: 0
    }), $("#FBT_result_bg").css({
      opacity: 0
    }), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status = "animate", S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_bg_scale_down(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_char("wait"), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_char_move_left(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_result === "ok") {
    S_FOUR_TORTOISE.count_tip_show = 1;
    S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_tip_hide();
    S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_particle = !1;
    for (var n in S_FOUR_TORTOISE.particle_info) $("#" + n).remove();
    S_FOUR_TORTOISE.particle_info = {}
  }
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.callback_idle = function() {
  console.log(" ========= S_FOUR_TORTOISE.callback_idle   called");
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_show_callback_fn = null;
  gEnableKey = 1;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status = "idle";
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.ad_hide = !1;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.drawFocus()
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.callback_result = function() {
  console.log(" ========= S_FOUR_TORTOISE.callback_result   called");
  gEnableKey = 1;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.scene_status = "result";
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.drawFocus()
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_idle_return = function() {
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_idle_return = !1;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_dragon_name_right();
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_button_1_up();
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_top_1_down();
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_gauge_box_left();
  $("#FBT_speech_balloon_box").show();
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_result === "no" && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_tip_show("add")
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.start_render = function() {
  clearTimeout(S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_timer_num);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_timer_num = null;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_count = 1;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_timer_num = setTimeout(S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_time);
  window.requestAFrame(S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_raf)
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render = function() {
  if (!$("#S_FOUR_TORTOISE_div").html()) {
    console.log(" S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render  clearTimeout ");
    clearTimeout(S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_timer_num);
    S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_timer_num = null;
    return
  }
  if (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_tip_show ? S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_tip_show() : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_tip_hide && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_tip_hide(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_char(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_char_ef_circle(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_char_ef_light(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_progress_particle && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_progress_particle(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_particle && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.cur_gauge > 5) {
    var n = 7 + parseInt(14 - S_FOUR_TORTOISE.cur_gauge / 10);
    S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_count % n == 1 && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.create_particle()
  }
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.is_event === "yes" && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_count % 3 == 1 && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_event_icon();
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_count++;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_timer_num = setTimeout(S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_time)
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_raf = function(n) {
  (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_scale_up || S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_scale_down) && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_bg_scale_up_down(n);
  (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_dragon_name_left || S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_dragon_name_right) && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_dragon_name_left_right(n);
  (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_button_1_up || S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_button_1_down) && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_button_1_up_down(n);
  (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_top_1_up || S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_top_1_down) && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_top_1_up_down(n);
  (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_gauge_box_left_left || S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_gauge_box_left_right) && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_gauge_box_left_right(n);
  (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_char_move_left || S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_char_move_right) && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_char_move_left_right(n);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_result_pop_up && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_result_pop_up(n);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_result_minichar_right && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_result_minichar_right(n);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_idle_return && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_idle_return();
  (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_gauge_up || S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_gauge_down) && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_gauge_up_down(n);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_particle(n);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.done_render_raf || window.requestAFrame(S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_raf)
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.update_event_icon = function() {
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.is_event === "yes" ? $("#FBT_gauge_evnt_icon").show() : $("#FBT_gauge_evnt_icon").hide()
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_event_icon = function() {
  var t = S_FOUR_TORTOISE.img_url,
    n = "";
  USER.lang != LANG.KOREA && (n = "_en");
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.event_num++;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.event_num > 2 && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.event_num = 1);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FBT_gauge_evnt_icon", t + "event_4gauge_guaranteed_icon" + S_FOUR_TORTOISE.event_num + n + "_0.png", -12, -66)
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_tip_show = function(n, t) {
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_img_num = 0;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_show_callback_fn = t;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_tip_show = !0;
  n === "add" ? ($("#FBT_tip_box").css({
    left: "395px"
  }), $("#FBT_tip_txt").css({
    "line-height": "68px",
    color: "#ffffff"
  }), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_txt = LANG.replace_value(TXT.gage_increase_text, [S_FOUR_TORTOISE.add_gauge]), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.count_tip_show = 2) : n === "complete" ? ($("#FBT_tip_box").css({
    left: "361px"
  }), $("#FBT_tip_txt").css({
    "line-height": "35px",
    color: "#fff595"
  }), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_txt = TXT.persuade_success_center_des, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.count_tip_show = 1) : ($("#FBT_tip_box").css({
    left: "395px"
  }), $("#FBT_tip_txt").css({
    "line-height": "35px",
    color: "#ffffff"
  }), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_txt = TXT.tortoise_des_text, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.count_tip_show = 1)
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_tip_hide = function() {
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_img_num = 5;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_tip_hide = !0
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_tip_show = function() {
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_img_num++;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_img_num <= 5 && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FBT_tip_bg", S_FOUR_TORTOISE.img_url + "bttemple_txtbox" + S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_img_num + ".png", 0, 0);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_img_num === 5 && ($("#FBT_tip_txt").html(S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_txt).show(), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FBT_tip_arrow", S_FOUR_TORTOISE.img_url + "bdtemple_txtbox_arrow.png", 265, 108), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_tip_show = !1, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.count_tip_show--, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.count_tip_show === 1 ? setTimeout(function() {
    S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_tip_hide()
  }, 1500) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_show_callback_fn && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_show_callback_fn())
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_tip_hide = function() {
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_img_num === 5 && ($("#FBT_tip_txt").hide(), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FBT_tip_arrow", "", 265, 108));
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_img_num--;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_img_num > 0 && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FBT_tip_bg", S_FOUR_TORTOISE.img_url + "bttemple_txtbox" + S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_img_num + ".png", 0, 0);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.tip_img_num === 0 && (utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FBT_tip_bg", "", 0, 0), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_tip_hide = !1, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.count_tip_show === 1 && ($("#FBT_gauge_addnum").hide(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_tip_show("", S_FOUR_TORTOISE.callback_idle)))
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_char = function(n, t) {
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_status = "wait";
  typeof n == "string" && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_status = n);
  typeof t == "string" && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_result = t);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_wait_num = 1;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_progress_num = 1;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_result_num = 1;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.progress_particle_num = 1
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_char = function() {
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_status === "wait" ? (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_wait_num++, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_wait_num > 14 && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_wait_num = 1), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FBT_char", S_FOUR_TORTOISE.img_url + "btortoise_wait" + S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_wait_num + ".png", S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_left, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_top)) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_status === "progress" ? (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_progress_num == 15 && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.enable_progress_particle = !0, $("#FBT_result_title").show(), $("#FBT_result_btn1_box").show(), $("#FBT_result_btn2_box").show(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.drawFocus("hide"), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_result_pop_up(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_result_minichar_right(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_result === "ok" && S_FOUR_TORTOISE.animate_tip_show("complete")), $("#FBT_ef_circle").hide(), $("#FBT_ef_light").hide(), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FBT_char", S_FOUR_TORTOISE.img_url + "btortoise_progress" + S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_progress_num + ".png", S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_left, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_top), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_progress_num++, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_progress_num > 16 && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_progress_num = 16, S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_status = S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_result, $("#FBT_ef_circle").show(), $("#FBT_ef_light").show())) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE.char_status === "no" ?   r < S_FOUR_TORTOISE.gauge_duration && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.gauge_previous = n)
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.create_particle = function() {
  var u, t, f, i, e;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.particle_count++;
  var t = Math.random(),
    r = t + .5,
    n = document.createElement("img");
  n.id = "particle" + S_FOUR_TORTOISE.particle_count;
  n.src = S_FOUR_TORTOISE.img_url + "bttemple_gbox_particle.png";
  n.width = Math.floor(13 * r);
  n.height = Math.floor(13 * r);
  n.style.position = "absolute";
  t = Math.random();
  u = t * 40;
  n.style.left = Math.floor(39 + u) + "px";
  t = Math.random();
  f = 1 + Math.floor(t * 2);
  n.style.top = "414px";
  i = 2.8 * S_FOUR_TORTOISE.cur_gauge;
  e = i / (S_FOUR_TORTOISE.cur_gauge * 100);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.particle_info[n.id] = {
    y_value: f,
    move_y: i,
    start_time: null,
    gauge_min: e,
    previous: null
  };
  $("#FBT_gauge_top").after(n)
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_particle_one = function(n, t) {
  var i = S_FOUR_TORTOISE.particle_info[n],
    u, r, f;
  i.start_time === null && (i.start_time = t);
  u = t - i.start_time;
  i.previous !== t && (r = Math.min(i.gauge_min * u * i.y_value, i.move_y), f = 414 - r, $("#" + n).css({
    top: f + "px"
  }), i.move_y <= r && ($("#" + n).remove(), delete S_FOUR_TORTOISE.particle_info[n]));
  i.previous = t
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_particle = function(n) {
  for (var t in S_FOUR_TORTOISE.particle_info) S_FOUR_TORTOISE.render_particle_one(t, n)
};

S_FOUR_BIRD.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var r = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    i;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + r + " in S_FOUR_BIRD.keyDown()");
  switch (r) {
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status === "idle" ? (S_FOUR_BIRD.focus = 1, S_FOUR_BIRD.menuRun_Run()) : S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus = 1, S_FOUR_BIRD.menuRun_Run());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status === "idle" ? (S_FOUR_BIRD.focus--, S_FOUR_BIRD.focus < 1 && (S_FOUR_BIRD.focus = 1)) : S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus--, S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus < 1 && (S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus = 1));
      S_FOUR_BIRD.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status === "idle" ? (S_FOUR_BIRD.focus++, i = REWARD_AD.exists(REWARD_AD.PLACE.FOUR_GODS) ? 4 : 3, S_FOUR_BIRD.focus > i && (S_FOUR_BIRD.focus = i)) : S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus++, S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus > 2 && (S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus = 2));
      S_FOUR_BIRD.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_FOUR_BIRD.menuRun()
  }
};

S_FOUR_BIRD.drawFocus = function(n) {
  S_FOUR_BIRD.ad_hide || S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status !== "idle" ? REWARD_AD.hide("FVB_ad_box") : REWARD_AD.show("FVB_ad_box");
  S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status === "idle" ? ($("#FVB_back_f").hide(), $("#FVB_persuade_f").hide(), $("#FVB_help_f").hide(), $("#FVB_ad_f").hide(), S_FOUR_BIRD.focus == 1 ? $("#FVB_back_f").show() : S_FOUR_BIRD.focus == 2 ? $("#FVB_persuade_f").show() : S_FOUR_BIRD.focus == 3 ? $("#FVB_help_f").show() : $("#FVB_ad_f").show()) : S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status === "result" && ($("#FVB_result_btn1_f").hide(), $("#FVB_result_btn2_f").hide(), $("#FVB_result_btn" + S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus + "_f").show());
  n === "hide" && ($("#FVB_back_f").hide(), $("#FVB_persuade_f").hide(), $("#FVB_help_f").hide(), $("#FVB_ad_f").hide(), $("#FVB_result_btn1_f").hide(), $("#FVB_result_btn2_f").hide())
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status === "idle" ? S_FOUR_BIRD.focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("FVB_back_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_FOUR_BIRD.focus === 2 ? (loading_show(), utilScale_xy_center("FVB_persuade_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)) : S_FOUR_BIRD.focus === 3 ? utilScale_xy_center("FVB_help_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_FOUR_BIRD.focus === 4 && utilScale_xy_center("FVB_ad_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("FVB_result_btn1_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus === 2 && utilScale_xy_center("FVB_result_btn2_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale));
  setTimeout(function() {
    S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status === "idle" ? S_FOUR_BIRD.focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("FVB_back_box", 1, 1) : S_FOUR_BIRD.focus === 2 ? utilScale_xy_center("FVB_persuade_box", 1, 1) : S_FOUR_BIRD.focus === 3 ? utilScale_xy_center("FVB_help_box", 1, 1) : S_FOUR_BIRD.focus === 4 && utilScale_xy_center("FVB_ad_box", 1, 1) : S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("FVB_result_btn1_box", 1, 1) : S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus === 2 && utilScale_xy_center("FVB_result_btn2_box", 1, 1));
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_FOUR_BIRD.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.menuRun_Run = function() {
  if (S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status === "idle") {
    if (S_FOUR_BIRD.focus === 4) {
      if (S_FOUR_BIRD.cur_gauge >= S_FOUR_BIRD.GAUGE_MAX) {
        utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_gauge_full, 2);
        gEnableKey = 1;
        return
      }
      if (!REWARD_AD.is_enabled("FVB_ad_box")) {
        REWARD_AD.notice_state("FVB_ad_box");
        gEnableKey = 1;
        return
      }
      REWARD_AD.play(REWARD_AD.PLACE.FOUR_GODS, "103", null, S_FOUR_BIRD.on_reward_ad);
      return
    }
    if (S_FOUR_BIRD.focus === 1) gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_FOUR_BIRD.back();
    else if (S_FOUR_BIRD.focus === 2) {
      if (USER.cloud_piece < S_FOUR_BIRD.cost_num || isNaN(USER.cloud_piece)) {
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        utilNotice(TXT.cloud_pieces_lack, 2);
        return
      }
      if (!S_GACHA.is_char_storage_space_available("FOUR_GODS")) {
        loading_hide();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        return
      }
      utilPush();
      S_FOUR_BIRD.removeMouseEvent();
      S_FOUR_BIRD.ad_hide = !0;
      S_FOUR_BIRD.drawFocus("hide");
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_FOUR_BIRD_POPUP, S_FOUR_BIRD_POPUP)
    } else S_FOUR_BIRD.focus === 3 && (utilPush(), S_FOUR_BIRD.removeMouseEvent(), S_FOUR_BIRD.drawFocus("hide"), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_FOUR_BIRD_HELP, S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP))
  }
  S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status === "result" && (S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus === 1 ? S_FOUR_BIRD.result_ok() : S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus === 2 && (utilPush(), S_FOUR_BIRD.end(), ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAKETEAM, S_MAKETEAM)))
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.end = function() {
  clearTimeout(S_FOUR_BIRD.render_timer_num);
  S_FOUR_BIRD.render_timer_num = null;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.done_render_raf = !0;
  $("#S_FOUR_BIRD_div").remove();
  S_FOUR_BIRD.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.back = function() {
  S_FOUR_BIRD.end();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_FOUR_GODS, S_FOUR_GODS)
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.yes = function() {
  S_FOUR_BIRD.ad_hide = !0;
  REWARD_AD.hide("FVB_ad_box");
  loading_show("", 1);
  var n = {
    MODE: "UPDATE",
    GAGE: S_FOUR_BIRD.cur_gauge,
    EVENT: S_FOUR_BIRD.is_event,
    CLOUD: USER.cloud_piece,
    TYPE: 4
  };
  ServerConnection.update_dragon_info(n, function(n) {
    if (loading_hide(), S_FOUR_BIRD.is_event = n.EVENT, n.STATE === "NOTICE") gEnableKey = 1, utilNotice(TXT.bird_event_end, 2), S_FOUR_BIRD.update_event_icon(), S_FOUR_BIRD.ad_hide = !1, S_FOUR_BIRD.drawFocus();
    else {
      gEnableKey = 0;
      S_FOUR_BIRD.update_event_icon();
      n.STATE === "SUCCESS" ? (STORAGE.add_char(103, !0), S_FOUR_BIRD.char_result = "ok") : n.STATE === "FAIL" && (S_FOUR_BIRD.char_result = "no");
      S_FOUR_BIRD.add_gauge = parseInt(n.MULTI);
      var t = S_FOUR_BIRD.cur_gauge + S_FOUR_BIRD.add_gauge;
      t > S_FOUR_BIRD.GAUGE_MAX && (S_FOUR_BIRD.add_gauge = S_FOUR_BIRD.GAUGE_MAX - S_FOUR_BIRD.cur_gauge);
      USER.cloud_piece = parseInt(n.CLOUD);
      S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_bg_scale_up();
      S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_dragon_name_left();
      S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_button_1_down();
      S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_top_1_up();
      S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_gauge_box_right();
      S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_char_move_right();
      S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_tip_hide();
      $("#FVB_speech_balloon_box").hide();
      $("#MM_top_cloud_piece_txt").text(utilGetNumber_withComma(USER.cloud_piece + ""))
    }
  })
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.update_cur_gauge = function() {
  var n = 414 - 2.8 * S_FOUR_BIRD.cur_gauge;
  $("#FVB_gauge_white").css({
    top: n + "px"
  });
  $("#FVB_gauge_top").css({
    top: -5 + n + "px"
  });
  $("#FVB_gauge_addnum").css({
    top: -68 + n + "px"
  })
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.result_ok = function() {
  if (gEnableKey = 0, $("#FVB_result_title").hide(), $("#FVB_result_minich_box").hide(), $("#FVB_result_pop_box").hide(), $("#FVB_result_btn1_box").hide(), $("#FVB_result_btn2_box").hide(), $("#FVB_result_chmood").css({
      opacity: 0
    }), $("#FVB_result_bg").css({
      opacity: 0
    }), S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status = "animate", S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_bg_scale_down(), S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_char("wait"), S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_char_move_left(), S_FOUR_BIRD.char_result === "ok") {
    S_FOUR_BIRD.count_tip_show = 1;
    S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_tip_hide();
    S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_particle = !1;
    for (var n in S_FOUR_BIRD.particle_info) $("#" + n).remove();
    S_FOUR_BIRD.particle_info = {}
  }
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.callback_idle = function() {
  console.log(" ========= S_FOUR_BIRD.callback_idle   called");
  S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_show_callback_fn = null;
  gEnableKey = 1;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status = "idle";
  S_FOUR_BIRD.ad_hide = !1;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.drawFocus()
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.callback_result = function() {
  console.log(" ========= S_FOUR_BIRD.callback_result   called");
  gEnableKey = 1;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.scene_status = "result";
  S_FOUR_BIRD.drawFocus()
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_idle_return = function() {
  S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_idle_return = !1;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_dragon_name_right();
  S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_button_1_up();
  S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_top_1_down();
  S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_gauge_box_left();
  $("#FVB_speech_balloon_box").show();
  S_FOUR_BIRD.char_result === "no" && S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_tip_show("add")
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.start_render = function() {
  clearTimeout(S_FOUR_BIRD.render_timer_num);
  S_FOUR_BIRD.render_timer_num = null;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.render_count = 1;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.render_timer_num = setTimeout(S_FOUR_BIRD.render, S_FOUR_BIRD.render_time);
  window.requestAFrame(S_FOUR_BIRD.render_raf)
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.render = function() {
  if (!$("#S_FOUR_BIRD_div").html()) {
    console.log(" S_FOUR_BIRD.render  clearTimeout ");
    clearTimeout(S_FOUR_BIRD.render_timer_num);
    S_FOUR_BIRD.render_timer_num = null;
    return
  }
  if (S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_tip_show ? S_FOUR_BIRD.render_tip_show() : S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_tip_hide && S_FOUR_BIRD.render_tip_hide(), S_FOUR_BIRD.render_char(), S_FOUR_BIRD.render_char_ef_circle(), S_FOUR_BIRD.render_char_ef_light(), S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_progress_particle && S_FOUR_BIRD.render_progress_particle(), S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_particle && S_FOUR_BIRD.cur_gauge > 5) {
    var n = 7 + parseInt(14 - S_FOUR_BIRD.cur_gauge / 10);
    S_FOUR_BIRD.render_count % n == 1 && S_FOUR_BIRD.create_particle()
  }
  S_FOUR_BIRD.is_event === "yes" && S_FOUR_BIRD.render_count % 3 == 1 && S_FOUR_BIRD.render_event_icon();
  S_FOUR_BIRD.render_count++;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.render_timer_num = setTimeout(S_FOUR_BIRD.render, S_FOUR_BIRD.render_time)
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.render_raf = function(n) {
  (S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_scale_up || S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_scale_down) && S_FOUR_BIRD.render_bg_scale_up_down(n);
  (S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_dragon_name_left || S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_dragon_name_right) && S_FOUR_BIRD.render_dragon_name_left_right(n);
  (S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_button_1_up || S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_button_1_down) && S_FOUR_BIRD.render_button_1_up_down(n);
  (S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_top_1_up || S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_top_1_down) && S_FOUR_BIRD.render_top_1_up_down(n);
  (S_FOUR_BIRD.render_gauge_box_left_left || S_FOUR_BIRD.render_gauge_box_left_right) && S_FOUR_BIRD.render_gauge_box_left_right(n);
  (S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_char_move_left || S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_char_move_right) && S_FOUR_BIRD.render_char_move_left_right(n);
  S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_result_pop_up && S_FOUR_BIRD.render_result_pop_up(n);
  S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_result_minichar_right && S_FOUR_BIRD.render_result_minichar_right(n);
  S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_idle_return && S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_idle_return();
  (S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_gauge_up || S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_gauge_down) && S_FOUR_BIRD.render_gauge_up_down(n);
  S_FOUR_BIRD.render_particle(n);
  S_FOUR_BIRD.done_render_raf || window.requestAFrame(S_FOUR_BIRD.render_raf)
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.update_event_icon = function() {
  S_FOUR_BIRD.is_event === "yes" ? $("#FVB_gauge_evnt_icon").show() : $("#FVB_gauge_evnt_icon").hide()
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.render_event_icon = function() {
  var t = S_FOUR_BIRD.img_url,
    n = "";
  USER.lang != LANG.KOREA && (n = "_en");
  S_FOUR_BIRD.event_num++;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.event_num > 2 && (S_FOUR_BIRD.event_num = 1);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FVB_gauge_evnt_icon", t + "event_4gauge_guaranteed_icon" + S_FOUR_BIRD.event_num + n + "_0.png", -12, -66)
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_tip_show = function(n, t) {
  S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_img_num = 0;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_show_callback_fn = t;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_tip_show = !0;
  n === "add" ? ($("#FVB_tip_box").css({
    left: "395px"
  }), $("#FVB_tip_txt").css({
    "line-height": "68px",
    color: "#ffffff"
  }), S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_txt = LANG.replace_value(TXT.gage_increase_text, [S_FOUR_BIRD.add_gauge]), S_FOUR_BIRD.count_tip_show = 2) : n === "complete" ? ($("#FVB_tip_box").css({
    left: "361px"
  }), $("#FVB_tip_txt").css({
    "line-height": "35px",
    color: "#fff595"
  }), S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_txt = TXT.persuade_success_center_des, S_FOUR_BIRD.count_tip_show = 1) : ($("#FVB_tip_box").css({
    left: "395px"
  }), $("#FVB_tip_txt").css({
    "line-height": "35px",
    color: "#ffffff"
  }), S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_txt = TXT.bird_des_text, S_FOUR_BIRD.count_tip_show = 1)
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_tip_hide = function() {
  S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_img_num = 5;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_tip_hide = !0
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.render_tip_show = function() {
  S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_img_num++;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_img_num <= 5 && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FVB_tip_bg", S_FOUR_BIRD.img_url + "vbtemple_txtbox" + S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_img_num + ".png", 0, 0);
  S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_img_num === 5 && ($("#FVB_tip_txt").html(S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_txt).show(), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FVB_tip_arrow", S_FOUR_BIRD.img_url + "bdtemple_txtbox_arrow.png", 265, 108), S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_tip_show = !1, S_FOUR_BIRD.count_tip_show--, S_FOUR_BIRD.count_tip_show === 1 ? setTimeout(function() {
    S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_tip_hide()
  }, 1500) : S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_show_callback_fn && S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_show_callback_fn())
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.render_tip_hide = function() {
  S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_img_num === 5 && ($("#FVB_tip_txt").hide(), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FVB_tip_arrow", "", 265, 108));
  S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_img_num--;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_img_num > 0 && utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FVB_tip_bg", S_FOUR_BIRD.img_url + "vbtemple_txtbox" + S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_img_num + ".png", 0, 0);
  S_FOUR_BIRD.tip_img_num === 0 && (utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FVB_tip_bg", "", 0, 0), S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_tip_hide = !1, S_FOUR_BIRD.count_tip_show === 1 && ($("#FVB_gauge_addnum").hide(), S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_tip_show("", S_FOUR_BIRD.callback_idle)))
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_char = function(n, t) {
  S_FOUR_BIRD.char_status = "wait";
  typeof n == "string" && (S_FOUR_BIRD.char_status = n);
  typeof t == "string" && (S_FOUR_BIRD.char_result = t);
  S_FOUR_BIRD.char_wait_num = 1;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.char_progress_num = 1;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.char_result_num = 1;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.progress_particle_num = 1
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.render_char = function() {
  S_FOUR_BIRD.char_status === "wait" ? (S_FOUR_BIRD.char_wait_num++, S_FOUR_BIRD.char_wait_num > 14 && (S_FOUR_BIRD.char_wait_num = 1), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FVB_char", S_FOUR_BIRD.img_url + "vbird_wait" + S_FOUR_BIRD.char_wait_num + ".png", S_FOUR_BIRD.char_left, S_FOUR_BIRD.char_top)) : S_FOUR_BIRD.char_status === "progress" ? (S_FOUR_BIRD.char_progress_num == 15 && (S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_progress_particle = !0, $("#FVB_result_title").show(), $("#FVB_result_btn1_box").show(), $("#FVB_result_btn2_box").show(), S_FOUR_BIRD.drawFocus("hide"), S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_result_pop_up(), S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_result_minichar_right(), S_FOUR_BIRD.char_result === "ok" && S_FOUR_BIRD.animate_tip_show("complete")), $("#FVB_ef_circle").hide(), $("#FVB_ef_light").hide(), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FVB_char", S_FOUR_BIRD.img_url + "vbird_progress" + S_FOUR_BIRD.char_progress_num + ".png", S_FOUR_BIRD.char_left, S_FOUR_BIRD.char_top), S_FOUR_BIRD.char_progress_num++, S_FOUR_BIRD.char_progress_num > 16 && (S_FOUR_BIRD.char_progress_num = 16, S_FOUR_BIRD.char_status = S_FOUR_BIRD.char_result, $("#FVB_ef_circle").show(), $("#FVB_ef_light").show())) : S_FOUR_BIRD.char_status === "no" ? (utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FVB_char", S_FOUR_BIRD.img_url + "vbird_fail" + S_FOUR_BIRD.char_result_num + ".png", S_FOUR_BIRD.char_left, S_FOUR_BIRD.char_top), S_FOUR_BIRD.char_result_num++, S_FOUR_BIRD.char_result_num > 10 && (S_FOUR_BIRD.char_result_num = 10)) : S_FOUR_BIRD.char_status === "ok" && (utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FVB_char", S_FOUR_BIRD.img_url + "vbird_success" + S_FOUR_BIRD.char_result_num + ".png", S_FOUR_BIRD.char_left, S_FOUR_BIRD.char_top), S_FOUR_BIRD.char_result_num++, S_FOUR_BIRD.char_result_num > 14 && (S_FOUR_BIRD.char_result_num = 1))
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.render_progress_particle = function() {
  console.log("render_progress_particle progress_particle_num:" + S_FOUR_BIRD.progress_particle_num);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FVB_progress_particle", S_FOUR_BIRD.img_url + "vbird_progress_particle" + S_FOUR_BIRD.progress_particle_num + ".png", 135, 0).show();
  S_FOUR_BIRD.progress_particle_num++;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.progress_particle_num > 15 && (S_FOUR_BIRD.progress_particle_num = 15, $("#FVB_progress_particle").hide(), S_FOUR_BIRD.enable_progress_particle = !1, S_FOUR_BIRD.drawFocus())
};

S_FOUR_BIRD.create_particle = function() {
  var u, t, f, i, e;
  S_FOUR_BIRD.particle_count++;
  var t = Math.random(),
    r = t + .5,
    n = document.createElement("img");
  n.id = "particle" + S_FOUR_BIRD.particle_count;
  n.src = S_FOUR_BIRD.img_url + "vbtemple_gbox_particle.png";
  n.width = Math.floor(13 * r);
  n.height = Math.floor(13 * r);
  n.style.position = "absolute";
  t = Math.random();
  u = t * 40;
  n.style.left = Math.floor(39 + u) + "px";
  t = Math.random();
  f = 1 + Math.floor(t * 2);
  n.style.top = "414px";
  i = 2.8 * S_FOUR_BIRD.cur_gauge;
  e = i / (S_FOUR_BIRD.cur_gauge * 100);
  S_FOUR_BIRD.particle_info[n.id] = {
    y_value: f,
    move_y: i,
    start_time: null,
    gauge_min: e,
    previous: null
  };
  $("#FVB_gauge_top").after(n)
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.render_particle_one = function(n, t) {
  var i = S_FOUR_BIRD.particle_info[n],
    u, r, f;
  i.start_time === null && (i.start_time = t);
  u = t - i.start_time;
  i.previous !== t && (r = Math.min(i.gauge_min * u * i.y_value, i.move_y), f = 414 - r, $("#" + n).css({
    top: f + "px"
  }), i.move_y <= r && ($("#" + n).remove(), delete S_FOUR_BIRD.particle_info[n]));
  i.previous = t
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.render_particle = function(n) {
  for (var t in S_FOUR_BIRD.particle_info) S_FOUR_BIRD.render_particle_one(t, n)
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_FOUR_BIRD_div").mouseover(S_FOUR_BIRD.onMouseover)
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_FOUR_BIRD_div").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("c_button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } REWARD_AD.hit(t.id, "FVB_ad_box") ? (S_FOUR_BIRD.focus = 4, S_FOUR_BIRD.menuRun()) : t.id.search("FVB_back") >= 0 ? (S_FOUR_BIRD.focus = 1, S_FOUR_BIRD.menuRun()) : t.id.search("FVB_persuade") >= 0 ? (S_FOUR_BIRD.focus = 2, S_FOUR_BIRD.menuRun()) : t.id.search("FVB_help") >= 0 ? (S_FOUR_BIRD.focus = 3, S_FOUR_BIRD.menuRun()) : t.id.search("FVB_result_btn1") >= 0 ? (S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus = 1, S_FOUR_BIRD.menuRun()) : t.id.search("FVB_result_btn2") >= 0 && (S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus = 2, S_FOUR_BIRD.menuRun())
  }
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("c_button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } REWARD_AD.hit(t.id, "FVB_ad_box") ? (S_FOUR_BIRD.focus = 4, S_FOUR_BIRD.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("FVB_back") >= 0 ? (S_FOUR_BIRD.focus = 1, S_FOUR_BIRD.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("FVB_persuade") >= 0 ? (S_FOUR_BIRD.focus = 2, S_FOUR_BIRD.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("FVB_help") >= 0 ? (S_FOUR_BIRD.focus = 3, S_FOUR_BIRD.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("FVB_result_btn1") >= 0 ? (S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus = 1, S_FOUR_BIRD.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("FVB_result_btn2") >= 0 && (S_FOUR_BIRD.result_focus = 2, S_FOUR_BIRD.drawFocus())
  }
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.onMousedown = function(n) {
  S_FOUR_BIRD.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.onMouseup = function(n) {
  S_FOUR_BIRD.onMouseover(n);
  S_FOUR_BIRD.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_FOUR_BIRD.on_reward_ad = function(n) {
  n && typeof n.AFTER_GAGE != "undefined" && (S_FOUR_BIRD.cur_gauge = parseInt(n.AFTER_GAGE, 10), $("#FVB_gauge_txt").html(S_FOUR_BIRD.cur_gauge + "/" + S_FOUR_BIRD.GAUGE_MAX));
  utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_get_gauge, 2)
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP = {
  sceneType: 1,
  call_preload: !1,
  focus: 1,
  img_url: "",
  end: ""
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.init_img_url = function() {
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.img_url === "" && (S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.img_url = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("BLUE_DRAGON") + "image/ui/44_blue_dragon/")
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.preload = function() {
  console.log(" S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.preload called ");
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.init_img_url();
  var t = S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.img_url,
    i = [t + "wttemple_help.png", t + "bdtemple_okbt.png", t + "bdtemple_okbt_f.png", t + "wttemple_help_en.png"],
    n = "edo_probability_keyguide_basic.png";
  glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? n = "edo_probability_keyguide_glo.png" : gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.KT && (n = "edo_probability_keyguide_kt.png");
  n = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDROID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? "./image/ui/30_percentage/" + n : glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("BLUE_DRAGON") + "image/ui/30_percentage/" + n;
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.red_img = n;
  i.push(n);
  ChangeScene.preloadImage(i);
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.call_preload = !0
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.init = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  utilConsoleLog("S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.init");
  $("#S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP_div").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  utilPush();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_FOUR_TIGER_HELP;
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.focus = 1;
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.call_preload == !1 && S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.preload();
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.maketag();
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.call_preload = !1;
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.make_screen();
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.drawFocus();
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.addMouseEvent();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  setTimeout(function() {
    gEnableKey = 1
  }, 700)
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.pause = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.pause()!!");
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.resume = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.resume()!!");
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.addMouseEvent();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_FOUR_TIGER_HELP;
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.drawFocus();
  gEnableKey = 1
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.maketag = function() {
  if (!$("#S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP_div").html()) {
    $("#S_FOUR_TIGER_div").after('<div id= "S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP_div"><\/div>');
    var n = '<div id="FTH_bg_dim_div"><\/div>';
    n += '<img id="FTH_bg">';
    n += '<div id="FTH_back_box" class="c_button">';
    n += '<img id="FTH_back_bg">';
    n += '<div id="FTH_back_txt"><\/div>';
    n += '<img id="FTH_back_f" class="c_button focus">';
    n += "<\/div>";
    n += '<div id="FTH_red_box" class="c_button">';
    n += '<img id="FTH_red_bg">';
    n += '<div id="FTH_red_txt"><\/div>';
    n += "<\/div>";
    $("#S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP_div").append(n)
  }
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + i + " in S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.keyDown()");
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.RED:
      S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.show_percentage()
  }
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.make_screen = function() {
  var n = S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.img_url,
    i = "",
    t;
  USER.lang != LANG.KOREA && (i = "_en");
  $("#MM_top").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  util_draw_div("S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP_div", 0, 0, 1280, 720);
  util_draw_div("FTH_bg_dim_div", 0, 0, 1280, 720).css({
    background: "black",
    opacity: "0.9"
  });
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FTH_bg", n + "wttemple_help" + i + ".png", 0, 0);
  util_draw_div("FTH_back_box", 550, 623, 180, 80);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FTH_back_bg", n + "bdtemple_okbt.png", 0, 0);
  util_draw_text_html(TXT.cancel, "FTH_back_txt", 0, 0, 180, 80, 80, 35, "center", "#fff595").css({
    "text-shadow": "#5d261a -2px -2px 2px,#5d261a 0px -2px 2px,#5d261a 2px -2px 2px,#5d261a -2px 0px 2px,#5d261a 2px 0px 2px,#5d261a -2px 2px 2px,#5d261a 0px 2px 2px,#5d261a 2px 2px 2px"
  });
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FTH_back_f", n + "bdtemple_okbt_f.png", -5, -5);
  util_draw_div("FTH_red_box", 1095, 657, 135, 32);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FTH_red_bg", S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.red_img, 0, 0);
  t = USER.lang == LANG.PORTUGAL ? 14 : 16;
  glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? util_draw_text_html(TXT.view_probabilities, "FTH_red_txt", 0, 3, 135, 25, 25, t, "center", "#ffffff") : util_draw_text_html(TXT.view_probabilities, "FTH_red_txt", 39, 3, 89, 25, 25, t, "center", "#ffffff")
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.show_percentage = function() {
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.removeMouseEvent();
  S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW.move_page = 10;
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_PERCENTAGE_SHOW, S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW)
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.drawFocus = function() {};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.focus === 1 && utilScale_xy_center("FTH_back_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.focus === 1 && utilScale_xy_center("FTH_back_box", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.menuRun_Run = function() {
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.focus === 1 && (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.back())
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.end = function() {
  $("#S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP_div").remove();
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.back = function() {
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.end();
  $("#MM_top").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_FOUR_TIGER;
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = gS_FOUR_TIGER_HELP;
  S_FOUR_TIGER.addMouseEvent();
  S_FOUR_TIGER.resume();
  S_MAINMENU.remount_mm_top(S_FOUR_TIGER, "", {
    show_top_button: !1,
    show_profile: !1,
    show_back_button: !1
  })
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP_div").mouseover(S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.onMouseover)
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP_div").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("c_button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("FTH_back") >= 0 ? (S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.focus = 1, S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.menuRun()) : t.id.search("FTH_red") >= 0 && S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.show_percentage()
  }
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if ((utilConsoleLog(" onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), gMOUSE_USE) && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("c_button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("FTH_back") >= 0 && (S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.focus = 1, S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.drawFocus())
  }
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.onMouseover(n);
  S_FOUR_TIGER_HELP.onClick(n);
  return
};

};
S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.preload = function() {

  S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.init_img_url();
  var t = S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.img_url,
    i = [t + "vbtemple_help.png", t + "bdtemple_okbt.png", t + "bdtemple_okbt_f.png", t + "vbtemple_help_en.png"],
    n = "edo_probability_keyguide_basic.png";
  glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? n = "edo_probability_keyguide_glo.png" : gTARGET_PLATFORM === gPLATFORM.KT && (n = "edo_probability_keyguide_kt.png");
  n = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.KT || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.SSBR || glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || glo.APP_FEATURE.ANDORID_BASE || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? "./image/ui/30_percentage/" + n : glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("BLUE_DRAGON") + "image/ui/30_percentage/" + n;
  S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.red_img = n;
  i.push(n);
  ChangeScene.preloadImage(i);
  S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.call_preload = !0
};
S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.init = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  utilConsoleLog("S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.init");
  $("#S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP_div").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  utilPush();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_FOUR_BIRD_HELP;
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.focus = 1;
  S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.call_preload == !1 && S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.preload();
  S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.maketag();
  S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.call_preload = !1;
  S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.make_screen();
  S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.drawFocus();
  S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.addMouseEvent();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  setTimeout(function() {
    gEnableKey = 1
  }, 700)
};
S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.pause = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.pause()!!");
  S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.resume = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.resume()!!");
  S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.addMouseEvent();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_FOUR_BIRD_HELP;
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.drawFocus();
  gEnableKey = 1
};
S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.maketag = function() {
  if (!$("#S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP_div").html()) {
    $("#S_FOUR_BIRD_div").after('<div id= "S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP_div"><\/div>');
    var n = '<div id="FVBH_bg_dim_div"><\/div>';
    n += '<img id="FVBH_bg">';
    n += '<div id="FVBH_back_box" class="c_button">';
    n += '<img id="FVBH_back_bg">';
    n += '<div id="FVBH_back_txt"><\/div>';
    n += '<img id="FVBH_back_f" class="c_button focus">';
    n += "<\/div>";
    n += '<div id="FVBH_red_box" class="c_button">';
    n += '<img id="FVBH_red_bg">';
    n += '<div id="FVBH_red_txt"><\/div>';
    n += "<\/div>";
    $("#S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP_div").append(n)
  }
};
S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + i + " in S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.keyDown()");
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.RED:
      S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.show_percentage()
  }
};
S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.make_screen = function() {
  var n = S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.img_url,
    i = "",
    t;
  USER.lang != LANG.KOREA && (i = "_en");
  $("#MM_top").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  util_draw_div("S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP_div", 0, 0, 1280, 720);
  util_draw_div("FVBH_bg_dim_div", 0, 0, 1280, 720).css({
    background: "black",
    opacity: "0.9"
  });
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FVBH_bg", n + "vbtemple_help" + i + ".png", 0, 0);
  util_draw_div("FVBH_back_box", 550, 623, 180, 80);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FVBH_back_bg", n + "bdtemple_okbt.png", 0, 0);
  util_draw_text_html(TXT.cancel, "FVBH_back_txt", 0, 0, 180, 80, 80, 35, "center", "#fff595").css({
    "text-shadow": "#5d261a -2px -2px 2px,#5d261a 0px -2px 2px,#5d261a 2px -2px 2px,#5d261a -2px 0px 2px,#5d261a 2px 0px 2px,#5d261a -2px 2px 2px,#5d261a 0px 2px 2px,#5d261a 2px 2px 2px"
  });
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FVBH_back_f", n + "bdtemple_okbt_f.png", -5, -5);
  util_draw_div("FVBH_red_box", 1095, 657, 135, 32);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FVBH_red_bg", S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.red_img, 0, 0);
  t = USER.lang == LANG.PORTUGAL ? 14 : 16;
  glo.fun.is_glo_platform() || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO || gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.TOSS ? util_draw_text_html(TXT.view_probabilities, "FVBH_red_txt", 0, 3, 135, 25, 25, t, "center", "#ffffff") : util_draw_text_html(TXT.view_probabilities, "FVBH_red_txt", 39, 3, 89, 25, 25, t, "center", "#ffffff")
};
S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.show_percentage = function() {
  S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.removeMouseEvent();
  S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW.move_page = 10;
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_PERCENTAGE_SHOW, S_PERCENTAGE_SHOW)
};
S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.drawFocus = function() {};
S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.focus === 1 && utilScale_xy_center("FVBH_back_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.focus === 1 && utilScale_xy_center("FVBH_back_box", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_FOUR_BIRD_HELP.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
