S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP = {
  sceneType: 1,
  call_preload: !1,
  focus: 1,
  img_url: "",
  end: ""
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.init_img_url = function() {
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.img_url === "" && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.img_url = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("BLUE_DRAGON") + "image/ui/44_blue_dragon/")
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.preload = function() {
  console.log(" S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.preload called ");
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.init_img_url();
  var n = S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.img_url,
    t = [n + "bdtemple_pop_cloudbar.png", n + "bdtemple_okbt.png", n + "bdtemple_okbt_f.png", n + "bdtemple_pop_bg.png"];
  ChangeScene.preloadImage(t);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.call_preload = !0
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.init = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  utilConsoleLog("S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.init");
  $("#S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP_div").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  utilPush();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP;
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.focus = 1;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.call_preload == !1 && S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.preload();
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.maketag();
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.call_preload = !1;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.make_screen();
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.drawFocus();
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.addMouseEvent();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  setTimeout(function() {
    gEnableKey = 1
  }, 700)
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.pause = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.pause()!!");
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.resume = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.resume()!!");
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.addMouseEvent();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP;
  send_analytics(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.drawFocus();
  gEnableKey = 1
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.maketag = function() {
  if (!$("#S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP_div").html()) {
    $("#S_FOUR_TORTOISE_div").after('<div id= "S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP_div"><\/div>');
    var n = '<div id="FBTP_bg_dim_div"><\/div>';
    n += '<div id="FBTP_box">';
    n += '<img id="FBTP_bg">';
    n += '<div id="FBTP_title_txt"><\/div>';
    n += '<div id="FBTP_body_txt"><\/div>';
    n += '<img id="FBTP_cost_bg">';
    n += '<div id="FBTP_cost_txt"><\/div>';
    n += '<div id="FBTP_yes_box" class="c_button">';
    n += '<img id="FBTP_yes_bg">';
    n += '<div id="FBTP_yes_txt"><\/div>';
    n += '<img id="FBTP_yes_f" class="c_button focus">';
    n += "<\/div>";
    n += '<div id="FBTP_no_box" class="c_button">';
    n += '<img id="FBTP_no_bg">';
    n += '<div id="FBTP_no_txt"><\/div>';
    n += '<img id="FBTP_no_f" class="c_button focus">';
    n += "<\/div>";
    n += "<\/div>";
    $("#S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP_div").append(n)
  }
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + i + " in S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.keyDown()");
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.focus = 1;
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.focus = 2;
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.menuRun()
  }
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.make_screen = function() {
  var n = S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.img_url,
    i = "",
    t;
  USER.lang != LANG.KOREA && (i = "_en");
  t = {
    "text-shadow": "#5d261a -2px -2px 2px,#5d261a 0px -2px 2px,#5d261a 2px -2px 2px,#5d261a -2px 0px 2px,#5d261a 2px 0px 2px,#5d261a -2px 2px 2px,#5d261a 0px 2px 2px,#5d261a 2px 2px 2px"
  };
  $("#MM_top").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  util_draw_div("S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP_div", 0, 0, 1280, 720);
  util_draw_div("FBTP_bg_dim_div", 0, 0, 1280, 720).css({
    background: "black",
    opacity: "0.9"
  });
  util_draw_div("FBTP_box", 339, 141, 602, 438);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FBTP_bg", n + "bdtemple_pop_bg.png", 0, 0);
  util_draw_text_html(TXT.persuade_text, "FBTP_title_txt", 17, 28, 568, 61, 61, 40, "center", "#fff595").css(t);
  util_draw_text_html(TXT.spend_cloud_pop_des, "FBTP_body_txt", 17, 88, 568, 102, 61, 33, "center", "#272727");
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FBTP_cost_bg", n + "bdtemple_pop_cloudbar.png", 156, 215);
  util_draw_text_html(S_FOUR_TORTOISE.cost_num, "FBTP_cost_txt", 232, 221, 189, 57, 57, 35, "center", "#fee92b");
  util_draw_div("FBTP_yes_box", 104, 320, 180, 80);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FBTP_yes_bg", n + "bdtemple_okbt.png", 0, 0);
  util_draw_text_html(TXT.yes, "FBTP_yes_txt", 0, 0, 180, 80, 80, 35, "center", "#fff595").css(t);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FBTP_yes_f", n + "bdtemple_okbt_f.png", -5, -5);
  util_draw_div("FBTP_no_box", 318, 320, 180, 80);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FBTP_no_bg", n + "bdtemple_okbt.png", 0, 0);
  util_draw_text_html(TXT.no, "FBTP_no_txt", 0, 0, 180, 80, 80, 35, "center", "#fff595").css(t);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("FBTP_no_f", n + "bdtemple_okbt_f.png", -5, -5)
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.drawFocus = function() {
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.focus == 1 ? ($("#FBTP_yes_f").show(), $("#FBTP_no_f").hide()) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.focus == 2 && ($("#FBTP_yes_f").hide(), $("#FBTP_no_f").show())
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("FBTP_yes_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.focus === 2 && utilScale_xy_center("FBTP_no_box", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("FBTP_yes_box", 1, 1) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.focus === 2 && utilScale_xy_center("FBTP_no_box", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.menuRun_Run = function() {
  $("#MM_top").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.focus === 1 ? (S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.back(), S_FOUR_TORTOISE.yes()) : S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.focus === 2 && (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.back())
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.end = function() {
  $("#S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP_div").remove();
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.back = function() {
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.end();
  $("#MM_top").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_FOUR_TORTOISE;
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = gS_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP;
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.addMouseEvent();
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE.resume()
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP_div").mouseover(S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.onMouseover)
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP_div").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("c_button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("FBTP_yes") >= 0 ? (S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.focus = 1, S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.menuRun()) : t.id.search("FBTP_no") >= 0 && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.focus = 2, S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.menuRun())
  }
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if ((utilConsoleLog(" onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), gMOUSE_USE) && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("c_button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("FBTP_yes") >= 0 ? (S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.focus = 1, S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.drawFocus()) : t.id.search("FBTP_no") >= 0 && (S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.focus = 2, S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.drawFocus())
  }
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.onMouseover(n);
  S_FOUR_TORTOISE_POPUP.onClick(n);
  return
};

S_COUPON.maketag = function() {
  var t, n;
  if (!$("#S_COUPON_div").html()) {
    for ($("#S_POPUPYN_div").after('<div id= "S_COUPON_div"><\/div>'), t = '<img id="CP_bg">', t += '<div id="CP_title"><\/div>', t += '<div id="CP_number"><\/div>', n = 1; n <= 13; n++) t += '<div id="CP_btn' + n + '" class="button">\t<img id="CP_btn' + n + '_bg">\t<div id="CP_btn' + n + '_txt"> <\/div>\t<img id="CP_btn' + n + '_focus" class="focus"><\/div>';
    $("#S_COUPON_div").append(t)
  }
};
S_COUPON.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + i + " in S_COUPON.keyDown()");
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_COUPON.back();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.left:
      S_COUPON.focus >= 2 && (S_COUPON.focus--, S_COUPON.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      S_COUPON.focus < 13 && (S_COUPON.focus++, S_COUPON.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_COUPON.focus <= 7 ? (S_COUPON.focus += 5, S_COUPON.drawFocus()) : (S_COUPON.focus == 8 || S_COUPON.focus == 9 || S_COUPON.focus == 10) && (S_COUPON.focus = 13, S_COUPON.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      6 <= S_COUPON.focus && (S_COUPON.focus -= 5, S_COUPON.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_COUPON.menuRun()
  }
};
S_COUPON.back = function() {
  S_COUPON.end();
  g_sceneinfo.before_scene = g_sceneinfo.cur_scene;
  g_sceneinfo.cur_scene = gS_MAINMENU;
  $("#S_MAINMENU_div").css("display", "block");
  S_MAINMENU.resume();
  blink_focus_start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene)
};

S_COUPON.drawFocus = function() {
  for (var n = 1; n <= 13; n++) $("#CP_btn" + n + "_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#CP_btn" + S_COUPON.focus + "_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  })
};
S_COUPON.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  utilScale_xy_center("CP_btn" + S_COUPON.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  utilScale_xy_center("CP_btn" + S_COUPON.focus + "_focus", gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("CP_btn" + S_COUPON.focus, 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("CP_btn" + S_COUPON.focus + "_focus", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_COUPON.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_COUPON.menuRun_Run = function() {
  switch (S_COUPON.focus) {
    case 1:
    case 2:
    case 3:
    case 4:
    case 5:
    case 6:
    case 7:
    case 8:
    case 9:
    case 10:
      switch (S_COUPON.number_add_i(S_COUPON.focus)) {
        case "모두입력되어 입력불가함":
          S_COUPON.focus = 13;
          S_COUPON.drawFocus();
          break;
        case "모두입력됨":
          S_COUPON.make_screen_number();
          S_COUPON.focus = 13;
          S_COUPON.drawFocus();
          break;
        case "정상입력":
          S_COUPON.make_screen_number()
      }
      break;
    case 11:
      S_COUPON.back();
      break;
    case 12:
      S_COUPON.number_del_i();
      S_COUPON.make_screen_number();
      break;
    case 13:
      S_COUPON.menu_run_run_enter()
  }
};
S_COUPON.menu_run_run_enter = function() {
  if (S_COUPON.input.length != 14) {
    utilNotice(TXT.enter_12_num, 2);
    return
  }
  gEnableKey = 0;
  ServerConnection.input_coupon_after(S_COUPON.input, function(n) {
    n == "OK" ? setTimeout(function() {
      S_COUPON.back()
    }, 2e3) : setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1
    }, 2e3)
  })
};
S_COUPON.number_add_i = function(n) {
  return (n == 10 && (n = 0), S_COUPON.input.length >= 14) ? "모두입력되어 입력불가함" : ((S_COUPON.input.length == 4 || S_COUPON.input.length == 9) && (S_COUPON.input += "-"), S_COUPON.input += "" + n, S_COUPON.input.length >= 14) ? "모두입력됨" : "정상입력"
};
S_COUPON.number_del_i = function() {
  var t = S_COUPON.input.length,
    n;
  t != 0 && (n = S_COUPON.input.substr(0, t - 1), (n.length == 5 || n.length == 10) && (n = n.substr(0, n.length - 1)), S_COUPON.input = n)
};
S_COUPON.end = function() {
  $("#S_COUPON_div").remove();
  S_COUPON.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_COUPON.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_COUPON_div").mouseover(S_COUPON.onMouseover)
};
S_COUPON.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#S_COUPON_div").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_COUPON.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("CP_btn") >= 0 && (S_COUPON.focus = parseInt(glo.fun.get_only_number_by_text(t.id)), S_COUPON.menuRun())
  }
};
S_COUPON.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if ((utilConsoleLog(" onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), gMOUSE_USE) && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("CP_btn") >= 0 && (S_COUPON.focus = parseInt(glo.fun.get_only_number_by_text(t.id)), S_COUPON.drawFocus())
  }
};
S_COUPON.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_COUPON.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_COUPON.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_COUPON.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_COUPON.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_COUPON.onMouseover(n);
  S_COUPON.onClick(n);
  return
};

  util_draw_div("S_MODE_SELECT_div", 0, 0, 1280, 720);
  utilDrawImage("MOS_background", mode_seelect.image.mode_bg, 0, 0, 1280, 720, "absolute");

};
S_MODE_SELECT.make_screen_card = function() {
  var n;
  S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x > 0 && (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = 0);
  S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x < S_MODE_SELECT.get_scroll_min() && (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = S_MODE_SELECT.get_scroll_min());
  $("#s_mode_select_card").css({
    left: S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x + "px",
    top: "0px",
    position: "absolute"
  });
  var t = gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO ? 123 : 80;
  for (n = 1; n <= S_MODE_SELECT.card_num; n++) $("#MOS_card_div_" + n).css({
    width: "266px",
    height: "530px",
    left: 69 + (n - 1) * 292 + "px",
    top: t + "px",
    position: "absolute"
  });
  for (n = 1; n <= S_MODE_SELECT.card_num; n++) $("#MOS_cover_" + n).css({
    display: "block",
    left: "0px",
    top: "0px",
    width: "100%",
    height: "100%",
    position: "absolute",
    "z-index": "10"
  }), util_key_number.is_enabled() && util_key_number.create(n, -5, -5, "MOS_card_div_" + n);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("MOS_card_" + S_MODE_SELECT.STORY_MODE + "_bg", mode_seelect.image.mode_bt1, 0, 0);
  utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("MOS_card_" + S_MODE_SELECT.CLOUD_GARDEN_MODE + "_bg", mode_seelect.image.mode_bt2, 0, 0);

S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus = function() {
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  for (var n = 1; n <= S_MODE_SELECT.card_num; n++) n == S_MODE_SELECT.focus ? ($("#MOS_card_" + n + "_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("MOS_card_" + n + "_focus", mode_seelect.image.mode_bt1_f, -6, -6)) : $("#MOS_card_" + n + "_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_MOS_back_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Txt_MOS_back").css({
    color: "white"
  })
};
S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus_btnmenu = function() {
  for (var n = 1; n <= S_MODE_SELECT.card_num; n++) $("#MOS_card_" + n + "_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_MODE_SELECT.btn_focus == 1 && ($("#Img_MOS_back_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }), utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos("Img_MOS_back_focus", mode_seelect.image.co_bt_f, -8, -9))
};
S_MODE_SELECT.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  if (gEnableKey != 0) switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus == 2) break;
      S_MODE_SELECT.focus >= 2 && (S_MODE_SELECT.focus = S_MODE_SELECT.focus - 1, S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus(), S_MODE_SELECT.abs_focus >= 2 ? S_MODE_SELECT.abs_focus = S_MODE_SELECT.abs_focus - 1 : (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x, S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_flag = 0), S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x = S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x + (S_MODE_SELECT.card_w + S_MODE_SELECT.card_gap), S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_left()));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus == 2) break;
      S_MODE_SELECT.focus < S_MODE_SELECT.card_num && (S_MODE_SELECT.focus = S_MODE_SELECT.focus + 1, S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus(), S_MODE_SELECT.abs_focus < S_MODE_SELECT.card_num_on_screen ? S_MODE_SELECT.abs_focus = S_MODE_SELECT.abs_focus + 1 : (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x, S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_flag = 0), S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x = S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x - (S_MODE_SELECT.card_w + S_MODE_SELECT.card_gap), S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_right()));
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus == 2 && (S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus = 1, S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO && S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus == 1 && (S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus = 2, S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus_btnmenu());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus == 2 ? S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun_btnmenu() : S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM1:
      S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus = 1;
      S_MODE_SELECT.focus = 1;
      S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus();
      S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM2:
      S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus = 1;
      S_MODE_SELECT.focus = 2;
      S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus();
      S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM3:
      S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus = 1;
      S_MODE_SELECT.focus = 3;
      S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus();
      S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM4:
      S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus = 1;
      S_MODE_SELECT.focus = 4;
      S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus();
      S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM5:
      S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus = 1;
      S_MODE_SELECT.focus = 5;
      S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus();
      S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM6:
      S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus = 1;
      S_MODE_SELECT.focus = 6;
      S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus();
      S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM7:
      S_MODE_SELECT.card_num >= 7 && (S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus = 1, S_MODE_SELECT.focus = 7, S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus(), S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun());
      break;
    case KeyDefine.NUM0:
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_MODE_SELECT.backKey()
  }
};
S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  utilScale_xy_center("MOS_card_div_" + S_MODE_SELECT.focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale);
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("MOS_card_div_" + S_MODE_SELECT.focus, 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun_Run = function() {
  S_MODE_SELECT.focus >= 1 && S_MODE_SELECT.focus <= S_MODE_SELECT.card_num && (utilConsoleLog("Selected mode: " + S_MODE_SELECT.focus), S_MODE_SELECT.enter_mode())
};
S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun_btnmenu = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  switch (S_MODE_SELECT.btn_focus) {
    case 1:
      utilScale_xy_center("MOS_back_btn", gKeyScale, gKeyScale)
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("MOS_back_btn", 1, 1);
    setTimeout(function() {
      gEnableKey = 1;
      S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun_btnmenu_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};
S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun_btnmenu_Run = function() {
  switch (S_MODE_SELECT.btn_focus) {
    case 1:
      S_MODE_SELECT.run_back();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun_btnmenu():" + S_MODE_SELECT.btn_focus)
  }
};
S_MODE_SELECT.backKey = function() {
  S_MODE_SELECT.removeMouseEvent();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAINMENU, S_MAINMENU);
  util_key_number.clear_all()
};
S_MODE_SELECT.end = function() {
  S_MODE_SELECT.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_right = function() {
  S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_flag = 1;
  S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x - S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_speed * (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x - S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x);
  S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x > 0 && (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = 0);
  S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x < S_MODE_SELECT.get_scroll_min() && (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = S_MODE_SELECT.get_scroll_min());
  $("#s_mode_select_card").css({
    left: S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x > S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x + 2 && S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_right, 16) : (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x, S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x > 0 && (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = 0), S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x < S_MODE_SELECT.get_scroll_min() && (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = S_MODE_SELECT.get_scroll_min()), $("#s_mode_select_card").css({
    left: S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  }), S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_flag = 0)
};
S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_left = function() {
  S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_flag = 1;
  S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x + S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_speed * (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x - S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x);
  S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x > 0 && (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = 0);
  S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x < S_MODE_SELECT.get_scroll_min() && (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = S_MODE_SELECT.get_scroll_min());
  $("#s_mode_select_card").css({
    left: S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  });
  S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x < S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x - 2 && S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_flag == 1 ? setTimeout(S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_left, 16) : (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x, S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x > 0 && (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = 0), S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x < S_MODE_SELECT.get_scroll_min() && (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = S_MODE_SELECT.get_scroll_min()), $("#s_mode_select_card").css({
    left: S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x + "px"
  }), S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_flag = 0)
};
S_MODE_SELECT.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (ENABLE_TOUCH_EVENT || (S_MODE_SELECT.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").mouseover(this.onMouseover).mouseout(this.onMouseout)))
};
S_MODE_SELECT.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover").unbind("mouseout")
};
S_MODE_SELECT.is_valid_pvp_classic_entry = function() {
  var h = glo.char.get_decks(),
    r, n, u, e, o, f, t, s, i;
  if (!h) return !1;
  for (r = h.split(","), n = 0; n < r.length; n++)
    if (r[n] !== "" && ((u = parseInt(r[n].split(":")[0], 10), !(u > 0) || !CHAR_OUR_TEAM[u]) || (e = CHAR_OUR_TEAM[u].star, !(e >= 1 && e <= 7)))) return !1;
  if (o = glo.char.get_deck_items(), o)
    for (f = o.split(","), t = 0; t < f.length; t++)
      if (f[t] !== "" && ((s = parseInt(f[t].split(":")[0], 10), !(s > 0)) || (i = S_ITEM.num_apply_item_grade(s), i !== "f" && i !== "e" && i !== "d" && i !== "c"))) return !1;
  return !0
};
S_MODE_SELECT.onMouseover = function(n) {
  var t, i, r;
  if (gTARGET_PLATFORM != gPLATFORM.AMO) switch (n.target.id) {
    case "MOS_back_btn":
    case "Txt_MOS_back":
    case "Img_MOS_back_focus":
      S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus = 2;
      S_MODE_SELECT.btn_focus = 1;
      S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus_btnmenu();
      return
  }
  if (t = 0, n.target.id.substring(0, 10) == "MOS_cover_") r = n.target.id.substring(10), t = parseInt(r, 10);
  else {
    for (i = n.target; i && i.id;) {
      if (i.id.substring(0, 13) == "MOS_card_div_") {
        r = i.id.substring(13);
        t = parseInt(r, 10);
        break
      }
      i = i.parentNode
    }
    if (t == 0) {
      utilConsoleLog("해당 id는 무시:" + n.target.id);
      return
    }
  }
  if (isNaN(t)) {
    utilConsoleLog("Error in S_MODE_SELECT.onMouseover() : focus is NaN");
    return
  }
  S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus = 1;
  S_MODE_SELECT.abs_focus = S_MODE_SELECT.abs_focus + (t - S_MODE_SELECT.focus);
  S_MODE_SELECT.focus = t;
  S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus()
};
S_MODE_SELECT.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } S_MODE_SELECT.row_focus == 2 ? S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun_btnmenu() : S_MODE_SELECT.menuRun()
  }
};
S_MODE_SELECT.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_MODE_SELECT.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_MODE_SELECT.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_MODE_SELECT.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_MODE_SELECT.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id);
  S_MODE_SELECT.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_MODE_SELECT.mousedrag_right_to_left = function() {
  var i;
  if (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_flag != 1) {
    var n = S_MODE_SELECT.get_scroll_min(),
      t = S_MODE_SELECT.card_num_on_screen - 1,
      r = S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x - (S_MODE_SELECT.card_w + S_MODE_SELECT.card_gap) * t;
    r < n && (i = Math.abs(Math.floor((n - S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x) / (S_MODE_SELECT.card_w + S_MODE_SELECT.card_gap))), t = i);
    S_MODE_SELECT.focus < S_MODE_SELECT.card_num && (S_MODE_SELECT.focus = S_MODE_SELECT.focus + t, S_MODE_SELECT.focus > S_MODE_SELECT.card_num && (S_MODE_SELECT.focus = S_MODE_SELECT.card_num), S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x, S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_flag = 0), S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x = S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x - (S_MODE_SELECT.card_w + S_MODE_SELECT.card_gap) * t, S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x < n && (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x = n), S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_right(), S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus())
  }
};
S_MODE_SELECT.mousedrag_left_to_right = function() {
  var i;
  if (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_flag != 1) {
    var n = 0,
      t = S_MODE_SELECT.card_num_on_screen - 1,
      r = S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x + (S_MODE_SELECT.card_w + S_MODE_SELECT.card_gap) * t;
    r > n && (i = Math.abs(Math.floor((n - S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x) / (S_MODE_SELECT.card_w + S_MODE_SELECT.card_gap))), t = i);
    S_MODE_SELECT.focus > 1 && (S_MODE_SELECT.focus = S_MODE_SELECT.focus - t, S_MODE_SELECT.focus < 1 && (S_MODE_SELECT.focus = 1), S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_flag == 1 && (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x = S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x, S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_flag = 0), S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x = S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_cur_x + (S_MODE_SELECT.card_w + S_MODE_SELECT.card_gap) * t, S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x > n && (S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_target_x = n), S_MODE_SELECT.scroll_left(), S_MODE_SELECT.drawFocus())
  }
};
S_MODE_SELECT.enter_mode = function() {
  util_key_number.clear_all();
  switch (S_MODE_SELECT.focus) {
    case S_MODE_SELECT.STORY_MODE:
      loading_show();
      gEnableKey = 0;
      auto_event_system_init();
      auto_event_system_check(999, function() {
        bga("send", "event", "mode_select", "story mode(스토리 모드)", "ok");
        utilPush();
        S_MODE_SELECT.removeMouseEvent();
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_SELECTMAP, S_SELECTMAP)
      });
      break;
    case S_MODE_SELECT.CLOUD_GARDEN_MODE:
      if (!glo.APP_FEATURE.CLOUD_GARDEN) return;
      if (!S_CLOUD_GARDEN.can_I_enter_cloud_garden()) {
        utilNotice(TXT.cloud_garden_entry_available, 2);
        return
      }
      utilPush();
      S_MODE_SELECT.removeMouseEvent();
      ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN, S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN);
      break;
    case S_MODE_SELECT.BOSS_MODE:
      if (glo.APP_FEATURE.BOSS_2026) {
        if (!USER.can_I_enter_boss()) {
          utilNotice(TXT.world_boss_entry_available, 2);
          return
        }
        utilPush();
        S_MODE_SELECT.removeMouseEvent();
        loading_show("", 1);
        get_rankboss_info(S_BOSS.stage, function() {
          loading_hide("", 1);
          ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_RANKING_BOSS, S_RANKING_BOSS)
        })
      } else {
        if (gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.AMO && S_MOBILE_CONNECT_AMO.isConnected()) {
          utilNotice(TXT.no_inter_content_mobile_connect, 2);
          return
        }
        if (!USER.can_I_enter_boss()) {
          utilNotice(TXT.world_boss_entry_available, 2);
          return
        }
        utilPush();
        S_MODE_SELECT.removeMouseEvent();
        console.log("월드보스 S_SELECTMAP.menuRun_Run gEnableKey:" + gEnableKey);
        ServerConnection.is_time_init_boss_ranking_screen(S_SELECTMAP.boss_start)
      }
      break;
    case S_MODE_SELECT.PVP_MODE:
      if (utilConsoleLog("NPC게임 진입"), !USER.can_I_enter_PvP()) {
        utilNotice(TXT.not_enter_ranking_game, 1.2);
        return
      }
      ServerConnection.get_pvp_ranking(function() {
        utilPush();
        S_GAME.ranking_mode = 2;
        bga("send", "event", "select_map", "PVP대전입장", "ok");
        S_MODE_SELECT.removeMouseEvent();
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_RANKING_PVP, S_RANKING_PVP)
      });
      break;
    case S_MODE_SELECT.PVP_CLASSIC_MODE:
      if (utilConsoleLog("PVP 클래식 진입"), !USER.can_I_enter_PvP()) {
        utilNotice(TXT.not_enter_ranking_game, 1.2);
        return
      }
      if (!S_MODE_SELECT.is_valid_pvp_classic_entry()) {
        S_MODE_SELECT.removeMouseEvent();
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_POPUPYN, S_POPUPYN);
        return
      }
      ServerConnection.get_pvp_cls_ranking(function() {
        utilPush();
        S_GAME.ranking_mode = 10;
        S_MODE_SELECT.removeMouseEvent();
        ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_RANKING_PVP, S_RANKING_PVP)
      });
      break;
    case S_MODE_SELECT.DUNGEON_MODE:
      ServerConnection.get_cur_day(function() {
        ServerConnection.get_daydungeon_cur_ticket(function() {
          if (S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day < 0 || S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.free_ticket < 0) {
            console.error(" 요일던전 정보가 잘못되었습니다.");
            glo.fun.show_s_error_network("S_SELECTMAP.menuRun_Run():요일던전 정보오류,cur_day=" + S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.cur_day + " free_ticket=" + free_ticket);
            return
          }
          utilPush();
          var n = function(n) {
            for (var t = 0; t < n.event_arr.length; t++) AUTO_EVENT_FLAG[n.event_arr[t]] = 1;
            auto_event_value();
            S_MODE_SELECT.removeMouseEvent();
            $("#S_MODE_SELECT_div").css({
              display: "none"
            });
            $("#S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT_div").css({
              display: "block"
            });
            S_DAYDUNGEON_SELECT.init()
          };
          loading_show();
          gEnableKey = 0;
          auto_event_system_init();
          auto_event_system_check(999, n)
        })
      });
      loading_show();
      gEnableKey = 0;
      break;
    case S_MODE_SELECT.SKY_GARDEN_MODE:
      if (!1 && glo.APP_FEATURE.COUPON_EVENT) {
        var n = glo.APP_FEATURE.COUPON_EVENT ? glo.event.apply_coupon_code("MOS_card_div_" + S_MODE_SELECT.SKY_GARDEN_MODE) : "";
        utilNotice(TXT.sky_garden_update_popup + " " + n, 2.5)
      } else {
        if (glo.APP_FEATURE.SKY_GARDEN != 1) {
          utilNotice(TXT.tobe_ready, 2.5);
          return
        }
        utilConsoleLog("하늘정원 진입");
        loading_show("", 1);
        S_RANKING.load_sky_ranking(function() {
          bga("send", "event", "select_map", "하늘정원입장", "ok");
          utilPush();
          S_GAME.ranking_mode = 1;
          S_MODE_SELECT.removeMouseEvent();
          ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_RANKING, S_RANKING)
        })
      }
      gEnableKey = 1
  }
};
S_MODE_SELECT.get_clear_stage_num = function() {
  for (var t = 0, n = 1; n <= MAX_STAGE_NUM; n++) switch (STORAGE.data3[n]) {
    case "A":
    case "B":
    case "C":
    case "D":
      t++
  }
  return t + 1
};
S_MODE_SELECT.get_time_until_cloud_garden = function() {
  var n = S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.get_init_start_date_ms() - S_RANKING_CLOUD_GARDEN.get_cur_ms();
  if (n <= 0) return {
    hours: 0,
    minutes: 0
  };
  var t = Math.floor(n / 36e5),
    i = Math.floor(n % 36e5 / 6e4),
    r = t < 10 ? "0" + t : t,
    u = i < 10 ? "0" + i : i;
  return {
    hours: r,
    minutes: u
  }
};
S_MODE_SELECT.get_time_until_midnight = function() {
  var r = new Date,
    e = r.getTime() + r.getTimezoneOffset() * 6e4,
    u = new Date(e + 324e5),
    f = new Date(u),
    n;
  if (f.setHours(24, 0, 0, 0), n = f.getTime() - u.getTime(), n <= 0) return {
    hours: 0,
    minutes: 0
  };
  var t = Math.floor(n / 36e5),
    i = Math.floor(n % 36e5 / 6e4),
    o = t < 10 ? "0" + t : t,
    s = i < 10 ? "0" + i : i;
  return {
    hours: o,
    minutes: s
  }
};

  S_MODE_SELECT.backKey()
};

S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.draw_team = function(n, t, i, r, u) {
  for (var y, c, h, p = glo.pvp.get_fame_ranking_list(), l = p[i].team, a = l.length, w = 5 - a, v = [
      [0, 37, 74, 111, 148],
      [0, 27, 54, 81, 108],
      [0, 21, 42, 63, 84]
    ][i][w], e = 0; e < a; e++) {
    var f = l[e],
      o = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/4_game/",
      s = o + "ga_unitsbt.png";
    glo.fun.is_ally_four_guardians_num(f) ? (s = o + "ga_unitsbtblue.png", f == 101 ? s = o + "ga_unitsbtgold.png" : f == 102 ? s = o + "ga_unitsbtgreen.png" : f == 103 && (s = o + "ga_unitsbtred.png")) : glo.fun.is_ally_8_char_num(f) ? s = glo.fun.is_hero_char_num(f) ? glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_PVP") + "image/ui/4_game/ga_unitsbthero.png" : o + "ga_unitsbt8.png" : glo.fun.is_ally_9_star(f) && (s = o + "ga_unitsbt9.png");
    y = glo.fun.get_img_url_ally(f) + "image/ui/4_game/char/ga_ally_" + f + ".jpg";
    c = n + "_bg" + e;
    $("#" + n).append('<img id="' + c + '">');
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos(c, s, v + e * u, 0, "absolute");
    utilScale_xy(c, r, r);
    h = t + "_char" + (e + 1);
    $("#" + t).append('<img id="' + h + '">');
    f == 0 ? utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos(h, "", 9999, 9999, "absolute") : utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos(h, y, v + e * u, 0, "absolute");
    utilScale_xy(h, r, r)
  }
  return l
};
S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.draw_first_ally = function(n) {
  for (var c, e, r, o, l, h, f, i, a, t = 0, u = 0, s = 1; s < window.g.CHAR_NUM.length; s++) {
    for (c = window.g.CHAR_NUM[s], e = 1; e < c.length; e++)
      if (c[e] == n) {
        t = s;
        u = e;
        break
      } if (t && u) break
  }
  for (r = 0, o = 1; o < window.g.STAR.length; o++) {
    for (l = window.g.STAR[o], h = 1; h < l.length; h++)
      if (l[h] == n) {
        r = o;
        break
      } if (r) break
  }
  return n == 49 || n == 86 ? (i = n == 86 ? 8 : u, f = glo.fun.get_img_url(n) + "image/ui/19_charbook/char/cb_ally_ch" + t + "_" + i + "_1.png") : n == 50 || n == 87 ? (i = n == 87 ? 8 : u, f = glo.fun.get_img_url(n) + "image/ui/19_charbook/char/cb_ally_ch" + t + "_" + i + "_2.png") : n == 108 ? (i = 9, f = glo.fun.get_img_url(n) + "image/ui/19_charbook/char/cb_ally_ch" + t + "_" + i + "_1.png") : n == 109 ? (i = 9, f = glo.fun.get_img_url(n) + "image/ui/19_charbook/char/cb_ally_ch" + t + "_" + i + "_2.png") : f = glo.fun.get_ally_charbook_image_url(n) + "image/ui/19_charbook/char/cb_ally_ch" + t + "_" + u + ".png", a = r === 8 ? glo.ser_img_url + "image/ui/19_charbook/cb_ally_chstar8.png" : r === 9 ? glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("LUCY_9STAR") + "image/ui/19_charbook/cb_ally_chstar9.png" : glo.img_url + "image/ui/19_charbook/cb_ally_chstar" + r + ".png", {
    i: t,
    j: u,
    k: r,
    img: f,
    star_img: a
  }
};
S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.drawFocus = function() {};
S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  switch (S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.focus) {
    case 1:
      S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.run_back();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("error!! in S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.menuRun()")
  }
};
S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.run_back()
  }
};
S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.backKey = function() {
  S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.removeMouseEvent();
  S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.end();
  $("#S_RANKING_PVP_div").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_RANKING_PVP, S_RANKING_PVP)
};
S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.end = function() {
  $("#S_RANKING_PVP_HOF_div").remove();
  S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").click(this.onClick).mouseover(this.onMouseOver))
};
S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("click").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } switch (t.id) {
      case "RPH_back_btn":
      case "RPH_back":
      case "Img_RPH_back_focus":
        S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.run_back()
    }
  }
};
S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.onMouseOver = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && (utilConsoleLog(" onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), gEnableKey != 0)) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } switch (t.id) {
      case "RPH_back_btn":
      case "RPH_back":
      case "Img_RPH_back_focus":
        S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.focus = 1;
        S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.drawFocus()
    }
  }
};
S_RANKING_PVP.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.onMouseOver(n);
  return
};
S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.onMouseUp = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.onMouseOver(n);
  S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_RANKING_PVP_HOF.backKey()
};

};

S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.drawFocus = function() {
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  $("#Img_RPR_back_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.focus == 1 && $("#Img_RPR_back_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  })
};
S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  switch (S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.focus) {
    case 1:
      S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.run_back();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("error!! in S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.menuRun()")
  }
};
S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.run_back()
  }
};
S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.backKey = function() {
  S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.removeMouseEvent();
  S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.end();
  $("#S_RANKING_PVP_div").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_RANKING_PVP, S_RANKING_PVP)
};
S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.end = function() {
  $("#S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD_div").remove();
  S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").click(this.onClick).mouseover(this.onMouseOver))
};
S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("click").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } switch (t.id) {
      case "RPR_back_btn":
      case "RPR_back":
      case "Img_RPR_back_focus":
        S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.run_back()
    }
  }
};
S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.onMouseOver = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && (utilConsoleLog(" onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), gEnableKey != 0)) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } switch (t.id) {
      case "RPR_back_btn":
      case "RPR_back":
      case "Img_RPR_back_focus":
        S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.focus = 1;
        S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.drawFocus()
    }
  }
};
S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.onMouseOver(n);
  return
};
S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.onMouseUp = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.onMouseOver(n);
  S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.onClick(n);
  return
};
S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_RANKING_PVP_REWARD.backKey()
};

S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.draw_team = function(n, t, i, r, u) {
  for (var y, c, h, p = glo.pvp.get_season_ranking_list(), l = p[i].team, w = l.length, b = [52, 41, 35][i], k = [-(u / 2), -28.5, -24.5][i], f = 0; f < w; f++) {
    var e = l[f],
      d = f < 2 ? f : f - 2,
      a = f < 2 ? 0 : b,
      g = f < 2 ? 0 : k,
      v = g + d * u,
      o = glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_UI_2025") + "image/ui/4_game/",
      s = o + "ga_unitsbt.png";
    glo.fun.is_ally_four_guardians_num(e) ? (s = o + "ga_unitsbtblue.png", e == 101 ? s = o + "ga_unitsbtgold.png" : e == 102 ? s = o + "ga_unitsbtgreen.png" : e == 103 && (s = o + "ga_unitsbtred.png")) : glo.fun.is_ally_8_char_num(e) ? s = glo.fun.is_hero_char_num(e) ? glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_PVP") + "image/ui/4_game/ga_unitsbthero.png" : o + "ga_unitsbt8.png" : glo.fun.is_ally_9_star(e) && (s = o + "ga_unitsbt9.png");
    y = glo.fun.get_img_url_ally(e) + "image/ui/4_game/char/ga_ally_" + e + ".jpg";
    c = n + "_bg" + f;
    $("#" + n).append('<img id="' + c + '">');
    utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos(c, s, v, a, "absolute");
    utilScale_xy(c, r, r);
    h = t + "_char" + (f + 1);
    $("#" + t).append('<img id="' + h + '">');
    e == 0 ? utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos(h, "", 9999, 9999, "absolute") : utilDrawImage_no_wh_pos(h, y, v, a, "absolute");
    utilScale_xy(h, r, r)
  }
};

S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  switch (S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.focus) {
    case 1:
      S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.run_back();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("error!! in S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.menuRun()")
  }
};

  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.run_back()
  }
};

      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {

    }
  }
};
S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.onMouseOver = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && (utilConsoleLog(" onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), gEnableKey != 0)) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } switch (t.id) {
      case "RPS_back_btn":
      case "RPS_back":
      case "Img_RPS_back_focus":
        S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.focus = 1;
        S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.drawFocus()
    }
  }
};
S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.onMouseOver(n);
  return
};
S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.onMouseup = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.onMouseOver(n);
  S_RANKING_PVP_SEASONRANK.onClick(n);
  return
};

};

};

S_PROFILE.find_first_owned_in_page = function() {
  for (var n = 1; n <= 32; n++)
    if (S_PROFILE.is_focus_owned(n)) return n;
  return 0
};
S_PROFILE.find_last_owned_in_page = function() {
  for (var n = 32; n >= 1; n--)
    if (S_PROFILE.is_focus_owned(n)) return n;
  return 0
};
S_PROFILE.is_focus_owned = function(n) {
  var i = S_PROFILE.tab_focus === 2 ? S_PROFILE.all_list_hero : S_PROFILE.all_list,
    t = (S_PROFILE.page - 1) * 32 + n - 1;
  return t < 0 || t >= i.length ? !1 : S_PROFILE.owned_set[i[t]] ? !0 : !1
};
S_PROFILE.drawFocus = function() {
  window.g.blink.value = 1;
  $("#Img_SP_tab1_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_SP_tab2_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $(".focus").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_PROFILE.row_focus === 1 ? S_PROFILE.tab_focus === 1 ? $("#Img_SP_tab1_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : $("#Img_SP_tab2_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_PROFILE.row_focus === 2 ? $("#Img_SP_profile_focus_" + S_PROFILE.profile_focus).css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_PROFILE.row_focus === 3 ? S_PROFILE.focus === 1 ? $("#Img_SP_arrow_left_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : $("#Img_SP_arrow_right_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_PROFILE.row_focus === 4 && (S_PROFILE.btn_focus === 1 ? $("#Img_SP_btn1_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : $("#Img_SP_btn2_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }))
};
S_PROFILE.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var k = t == null ? n.keyCode : t,
    h, c, b, w, l, r, i, o, f, s;
  switch (k) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_PROFILE.row_focus === 1) S_PROFILE.tab_focus > 1 && (S_PROFILE.tab_focus--, S_PROFILE.page = 1, S_PROFILE.profile_focus = 1, h = S_PROFILE.tab_focus === 2 ? S_PROFILE.all_list_hero : S_PROFILE.all_list, S_PROFILE.max_page = Math.ceil(h.length / 32), S_PROFILE.max_page < 1 && (S_PROFILE.max_page = 1), S_PROFILE.make_screen_tabs(), S_PROFILE.make_screen_profile_list());
      else if (S_PROFILE.row_focus === 2) {
        for (var a = (S_PROFILE.profile_focus - 1) % 8, e = S_PROFILE.profile_focus - 1, v = a - 1, y = !1; v >= 0;) {
          if (S_PROFILE.is_focus_owned(e)) {
            S_PROFILE.profile_focus = e;
            y = !0;
            break
          }
          e--;
          v--
        }
        y || S_PROFILE.page > 1 && (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 3, S_PROFILE.focus = 1)
      } else S_PROFILE.row_focus === 3 ? S_PROFILE.focus === 2 && (r = S_PROFILE.find_first_owned_in_page(), r > 0 ? (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 2, S_PROFILE.profile_focus = r) : S_PROFILE.focus = 1) : S_PROFILE.row_focus === 4 && S_PROFILE.btn_focus > 1 && S_PROFILE.btn_focus--;
      S_PROFILE.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_PROFILE.row_focus === 1) S_PROFILE.tab_focus < 2 && (S_PROFILE.tab_focus++, S_PROFILE.page = 1, S_PROFILE.profile_focus = 1, h = S_PROFILE.tab_focus === 2 ? S_PROFILE.all_list_hero : S_PROFILE.all_list, S_PROFILE.max_page = Math.ceil(h.length / 32), S_PROFILE.max_page < 1 && (S_PROFILE.max_page = 1), S_PROFILE.make_screen_tabs(), S_PROFILE.make_screen_profile_list());
      else if (S_PROFILE.row_focus === 2) {
        for (var a = (S_PROFILE.profile_focus - 1) % 8, p = Math.floor((S_PROFILE.profile_focus - 1) / 8), h = S_PROFILE.tab_focus === 2 ? S_PROFILE.all_list_hero : S_PROFILE.all_list, d = Math.min(8, h.length - p * 8 - (S_PROFILE.page - 1) * 32), e = S_PROFILE.profile_focus + 1, v = a + 1, y = !1; v < d;) {
          if (S_PROFILE.is_focus_owned(e)) {
            S_PROFILE.profile_focus = e;
            y = !0;
            break
          }
          e++;
          v++
        }
        y || S_PROFILE.page < S_PROFILE.max_page && (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 3, S_PROFILE.focus = 2)
      } else S_PROFILE.row_focus === 3 ? S_PROFILE.focus === 1 && (r = S_PROFILE.find_first_owned_in_page(), r > 0 ? (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 2, S_PROFILE.profile_focus = r) : S_PROFILE.page < S_PROFILE.max_page && (S_PROFILE.focus = 2)) : S_PROFILE.row_focus === 4 && S_PROFILE.btn_focus < 2 && S_PROFILE.btn_focus++;
      S_PROFILE.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      if (S_PROFILE.row_focus === 2) {
        var p = Math.floor((S_PROFILE.profile_focus - 1) / 8),
          a = (S_PROFILE.profile_focus - 1) % 8,
          u = !1;
        for (i = p - 1; i >= 0 && !u; i--) {
          if (o = i * 8 + a + 1, S_PROFILE.is_focus_owned(o)) {
            S_PROFILE.profile_focus = o;
            u = !0;
            break
          }
          for (f = 0; f < 8; f++)
            if (s = i * 8 + f + 1, S_PROFILE.is_focus_owned(s)) {
              S_PROFILE.profile_focus = s;
              u = !0;
              break
            }
        }
        u || (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 1)
      } else if (S_PROFILE.row_focus === 3) S_PROFILE.row_focus = 1;
      else if (S_PROFILE.row_focus === 4)
        if (c = S_PROFILE.find_last_owned_in_page(), c > 0) {
          for (b = Math.floor((c - 1) / 8), w = c, l = b * 8 + 1; l <= c; l++)
            if (S_PROFILE.is_focus_owned(l)) {
              w = l;
              break
            } S_PROFILE.row_focus = 2;
          S_PROFILE.profile_focus = w
        } else S_PROFILE.page > 1 ? (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 3, S_PROFILE.focus = 1) : S_PROFILE.page < S_PROFILE.max_page ? (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 3, S_PROFILE.focus = 2) : S_PROFILE.row_focus = 1;
      S_PROFILE.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      if (S_PROFILE.row_focus === 1) r = S_PROFILE.find_first_owned_in_page(), r > 0 ? (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 2, S_PROFILE.profile_focus = r) : S_PROFILE.page > 1 ? (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 3, S_PROFILE.focus = 1) : S_PROFILE.page < S_PROFILE.max_page ? (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 3, S_PROFILE.focus = 2) : (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 4, S_PROFILE.btn_focus = 1);
      else if (S_PROFILE.row_focus === 2) {
        var p = Math.floor((S_PROFILE.profile_focus - 1) / 8),
          a = (S_PROFILE.profile_focus - 1) % 8,
          u = !1;
        for (i = p + 1; i <= 3 && !u; i++) {
          if (o = i * 8 + a + 1, S_PROFILE.is_focus_owned(o)) {
            S_PROFILE.profile_focus = o;
            u = !0;
            break
          }
          for (f = 0; f < 8; f++)
            if (s = i * 8 + f + 1, S_PROFILE.is_focus_owned(s)) {
              S_PROFILE.profile_focus = s;
              u = !0;
              break
            }
        }
        u || (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 4, S_PROFILE.btn_focus = 1)
      } else S_PROFILE.row_focus === 3 && (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 4, S_PROFILE.btn_focus = 1);
      S_PROFILE.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_PROFILE.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_PROFILE.run_back()
  }
};
S_PROFILE.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  sound_play(EFF_SOUND.BTN_SELECT);
  S_PROFILE.row_focus === 1 ? S_PROFILE.tab_focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("SP_tab1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : utilScale_xy_center("SP_tab2", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_PROFILE.row_focus === 2 ? utilScale_xy_center("SP_profile_item_" + S_PROFILE.profile_focus, gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_PROFILE.row_focus === 3 ? S_PROFILE.focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("SP_arrow_left", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : utilScale_xy_center("SP_arrow_right", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : S_PROFILE.row_focus === 4 && (S_PROFILE.btn_focus === 1 ? utilScale_xy_center("SP_btn1", gKeyScale, gKeyScale) : utilScale_xy_center("SP_btn2", gKeyScale, gKeyScale));
  setTimeout(function() {
    utilScale_xy_center("SP_tab1", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("SP_tab2", 1, 1);

    utilScale_xy_center("SP_arrow_right", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("SP_btn1", 1, 1);
    utilScale_xy_center("SP_btn2", 1, 1);

      S_PROFILE.menuRun_Run()
    }, gKeyUpTime)
  }, gKeyPressTime)
};

    for (t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } t.id.search("SP_tab1") >= 0 ? (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 1, S_PROFILE.tab_focus = 1, S_PROFILE.drawFocus(), S_PROFILE.menuRun()) : t.id.search("SP_tab2") >= 0 ? (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 1, S_PROFILE.tab_focus = 2, S_PROFILE.drawFocus(), S_PROFILE.menuRun()) : t.id.search("SP_profile_item_") >= 0 ? (i = parseInt(t.id.replace("SP_profile_item_", "").replace(/[^0-9]/g, "")), S_PROFILE.row_focus = 2, S_PROFILE.profile_focus = i, S_PROFILE.drawFocus(), S_PROFILE.menuRun()) : t.id.search("SP_arrow_left") >= 0 ? (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 3, S_PROFILE.focus = 1, S_PROFILE.drawFocus(), S_PROFILE.menuRun()) : t.id.search("SP_arrow_right") >= 0 ? (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 3, S_PROFILE.focus = 2, S_PROFILE.drawFocus(), S_PROFILE.menuRun()) : t.id.search("SP_btn1") >= 0 ? (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 4, S_PROFILE.btn_focus = 1, S_PROFILE.drawFocus(), S_PROFILE.menuRun()) : t.id.search("SP_btn2") >= 0 && (S_PROFILE.row_focus = 4, S_PROFILE.btn_focus = 2, S_PROFILE.drawFocus(), S_PROFILE.menuRun())
  }
};

S_LANG_SELECT.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  if (gEnableKey != 0) switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_LANG_SELECT.focus--;
      S_LANG_SELECT.focus < 1 && (S_LANG_SELECT.focus = S_LANG_SELECT.LANG_COUNT);
      S_LANG_SELECT.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_LANG_SELECT.focus++;
      S_LANG_SELECT.focus > S_LANG_SELECT.LANG_COUNT && (S_LANG_SELECT.focus = 1);
      S_LANG_SELECT.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_LANG_SELECT.select_language()
  }
};

S_ITEM_SET.drawFocus = function() {
  S_ITEM_SET.focus == 1 ? $("#Img_IS_back_btn_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : $("#Img_IS_back_btn_focus").css({
    display: "none"
  })
};
S_ITEM_SET.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var i = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + i + " in S_ITEM_SET.keyDown()");
  switch (i) {
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_ITEM_SET.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_ITEM_SET.run_back()
  }
};
S_ITEM_SET.menuRun = function() {
  gEnableKey = 0;
  switch (S_ITEM_SET.focus) {
    case 1:
      S_ITEM_SET.run_back();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("error!! in S_ITEM_SET.menuRun()")
  }
};
S_ITEM_SET.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_ITEM_SET.backKey()
};
S_ITEM_SET.backKey = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_ITEM_SET.backKey()");
  S_ITEM_SET.removeMouseEvent();
  S_ITEM_SET.end();
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_ITEM, S_ITEM)
};
S_ITEM_SET.end = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_ITEM_SET.end()");
  $("#S_ITEM_SET_div").remove();
  S_ITEM_SET.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_ITEM_SET.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $("#Img_IS_back_btn").unbind("click").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_ITEM_SET.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (S_ITEM_SET.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").click(this.onClick).mouseover(this.onMouseover))
};
S_ITEM_SET.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") return;
    switch (t.id) {
      case "Img_IS_back_btn":
      case "Txt_IS_back_btn":
      case "Img_IS_back_btn_focus":
        S_ITEM_SET.run_back()
    }
  }
};
S_ITEM_SET.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && (utilConsoleLog(" onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), gEnableKey != 0)) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } switch (t.id) {
      case "Img_IS_back_btn":
      case "Txt_IS_back_btn":
      case "Img_IS_back_btn_focus":
        S_ITEM_SET.focus = 1;
        S_ITEM_SET.drawFocus()
    }
  }
};
S_ITEM_SET.onMousedown = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_ITEM_SET.onMousedown  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_ITEM_SET.onMouseover(n);
  return
};
S_ITEM_SET.onMouseUp = function(n) {
  utilConsoleLog(" S_ITEM_SET.onMouseup  e.target.id: " + n.target.id);
  S_ITEM_SET.onMouseover(n);
  S_ITEM_SET.onClick(n);
  return
};

  }), $("#Txt_MH_wukong_box_title").text(TXT.char_name_106), $("#Img_MH_mukhyang_box").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Txt_MH_select_item_detail").text(LANG.replace_value(TXT.select_item_detail, [TXT.char_name_106])), $("#Txt_MH_set_detail").html(TXT.serpent_set_1 + "<br>" + TXT.serpent_set_2 + "<br>" + TXT.serpent_set_3 + "<br>" + TXT.serpent_set_4)) : S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 2 ? ($("#Img_MH_wukong_box").css({

    "background-image": util_bg_url("url(" + glo.fun.get_ser_img_url("NEW_ITEM") + "image/ui/23_mailbox/mail_heroitem_flamecavalierbox.png)")

  }), $("#Img_MH_wukong_box").css({

  });

    display: "none"
  });

    display: "none"
  });

(t = S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus - 4, $("#Img_MH_mukhyang_box_item" + t + "_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }), $("#Txt_MH_select_item_detail").text(LANG.replace_value(TXT.select_item_detail, [TXT.char_name_105])), $("#Txt_MH_set_detail").html(TXT.mukhyang_set_1 + "<br>" + TXT.mukhyang_set_2 + "<br>" + TXT.mukhyang_set_3 + "<br>" + TXT.mukhyang_set_4)) : S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 1 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus >= 1 && S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus <= 4 && ($("#Img_MH_wukong_box_item" + S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus + "_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }), $("#Txt_MH_select_item_detail").text(LANG.replace_value(TXT.select_item_detail, [TXT.char_name_106])), $("#Txt_MH_set_detail").html(TXT.serpent_set_1 + "<br>" + TXT.serpent_set_2 + "<br>" + TXT.serpent_set_3 + "<br>" + TXT.serpent_set_4)) : S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 2 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus >= 1 && S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus <= 4 && ($("#Img_MH_wukong_box_item" + S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus + "_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }), $("#Txt_MH_select_item_detail").text(LANG.replace_value(TXT.select_item_detail, [TXT.char_name_107])), $("#Txt_MH_set_detail").html(TXT.flame_set_1 + "<br>" + TXT.flame_set_2 + "<br>" + TXT.flame_set_3 + "<br>" + TXT.flame_set_4)) : S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 3 && S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus >= 1 && S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus <= 4 && ($("#Img_MH_wukong_box_item" + S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus + "_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }), $("#Txt_MH_select_item_detail").text(LANG.replace_value(TXT.select_item_detail, [TXT.char_name_112])), $("#Txt_MH_set_detail").html(TXT.raven_set_1 + "<br>" + TXT.raven_set_2 + "<br>" + TXT.raven_set_3 + "<br>" + TXT.raven_set_4)) : S_MAILBOX_HERO.row_focus == 1 && (S_MAILBOX_HERO.btn_focus == 1 ? $("#Img_MH_back_btn_focus").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : $("#Img_MH_select_btn_focus").css({

S_MAILBOX_HERO.draw_check = function() {
  for (var t, n = 1; n <= 4; n++) $("#Img_MH_wukong_box_item" + n + "_check").css({
    display: "none"
  }), $("#Img_MH_mukhyang_box_item" + n + "_check").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  S_MAILBOX_HERO.selected_item > 0 && (S_MAILBOX_HERO.selected_item >= 1 && S_MAILBOX_HERO.selected_item <= 4 ? $("#Img_MH_wukong_box_item" + S_MAILBOX_HERO.selected_item + "_check").css({
    display: "block"
  }) : S_MAILBOX_HERO.selected_item >= 5 && S_MAILBOX_HERO.selected_item <= 8 && (t = S_MAILBOX_HERO.selected_item - 4, $("#Img_MH_mukhyang_box_item" + t + "_check").css({
    display: "block"
  })))
};
S_MAILBOX_HERO.select_item = function() {
  S_MAILBOX_HERO.row_focus == 0 && (S_MAILBOX_HERO.selected_item = S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus, S_MAILBOX_HERO.draw_check())
};
S_MAILBOX_HERO.confirm_selection = function() {
  var c, l;
  if (S_MAILBOX_HERO.selected_item == 0) {
    utilNotice(TXT.select_choice_item, 2);
    gEnableKey = 1;
    return
  }
  var u = S_MAILBOX_HERO.get_item_type_by_focus(S_MAILBOX_HERO.selected_item),
    t = u.char_num,
    n = u.item_type,
    a = t == 104 ? 50 + n : t == 105 ? 60 + n : t == 106 ? 70 + n : t == 107 ? 80 + n : t == 112 ? 90 + n : 50 + n;
  var f = Math.random() * 100,
    v = f < 60 ? 1 : f < 90 ? 2 : 3,
    e = a * 10 + v,
    i = Math.floor(Math.random() * (DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION.length - 1) + 1),
    o = DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION[i].ran_option[6][2],
    s = DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION[i].ran_option[6][3],
    y = s - o,
    h = o + Math.floor(Math.random() * y + 1);
  i == 7 && (h = s);
  var p = DEFINE_ITEM_SUB_OPTION[i].name,
    w = h,
    r = e + ":0:" + p + "-" + w + ":0:0";
  if (S_MAILBOX_HERO.pending_item_data = r, utilConsoleLog("S_MAILBOX_HERO.confirm_selection() - char_num:" + t + " item_type:" + n + " item_data:" + r), c = STORAGE.get_my_item_tot_num(), c + 1 > DEFINE.USER_ITEM_MAX) {
    utilNotice(TXT.item_space_lack, 3);
    gEnableKey = 1;
    return
  }
  loading_show("우편함", 1);
  l = window.g.REWARD[S_MAILBOX.list_focus].sn;
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.ruby = 0;
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.gold = 0;
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.bp = 0;
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.char = "";
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.item = String(e);
  window.g.REWARD_ALL.cloud_piece = 0;
  ServerConnection.del_reward_sn_all_n_save(l, r, "", "영웅 아이템 선택권", S_MAILBOX_HERO.on_reward_complete)
};
S_MAILBOX_HERO.on_reward_complete = function(n) {
  var r;
  if (n.STATE == "SUCCESS") {
    if (S_MAILBOX_HERO.pending_item_data) {
      var t = S_MAILBOX_HERO.pending_item_data.split(":"),
        u = Number(t[0]),
        i = t[2].split("-"),
        f = i[0],
        e = Number(i[1]);
      STORAGE.add_item(u, f, e);
      S_MAILBOX_HERO.pending_item_data = null
    }
    S_MAILBOX.reward_del_i(S_MAILBOX.list_focus);
    S_MAILBOX.list_focus > S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num() && (S_MAILBOX.list_focus = S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num());
    utilNotice(TXT.do_get, 3);
    S_MAILBOX.reward_get_num() == 0 ? (loading_hide(), S_MAILBOX_HERO.removeMouseEvent(), S_MAILBOX_HERO.end(), $("#S_MAILBOX_div").css({
      display: "none"
    }), S_MAILBOX.back()) : (S_MAILBOX_HERO.backKey(), r = Math.floor((S_MAILBOX.list_focus - 1) / 5) + 1, S_MAILBOX.make_screen_list_page(r), S_MAILBOX.draw_focus(), loading_hide(), gEnableKey = 1)
  } else glo.fun.show_s_error_network("영웅 아이템 획득 실패: " + n.DESCRIPTION), loading_hide(), gEnableKey = 1
};
S_MAILBOX_HERO.get_item_type_by_focus = function(n) {
  var t, i;
  return S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 0 ? (t = n <= 4 ? 104 : 105, i = (n - 1) % 4 + 1, {
    char_num: t,
    item_type: i
  }) : S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 1 ? (t = 106, i = n, {
    char_num: t,
    item_type: i
  }) : S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 2 ? (t = 107, i = n, {
    char_num: t,
    item_type: i
  }) : S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 3 ? (t = 112, i = n, {
    char_num: t,
    item_type: i
  }) : {
    char_num: 0,
    item_type: 0
  }
};
S_MAILBOX_HERO.keyDown = function(n, t) {
  var t = t == null ? n.keyCode : t;
  utilConsoleLog("Key pressed: " + t + " in S_MAILBOX_HERO.keyDown()");
  switch (t) {
    case KeyDefine.left:
      if (S_MAILBOX_HERO.row_focus == 0) {
        if (S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 0) S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 2 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 1 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 4 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 3 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 5 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 2 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 6 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 5 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 7 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 4 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 8 && (S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 7);
        else if (S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 1 || S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 2 || S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 3)
          if (S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 2) S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 1;
          else if (S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 4) S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 3;
        else return
      } else if (S_MAILBOX_HERO.btn_focus == 2) S_MAILBOX_HERO.btn_focus = 1;
      else return;
      S_MAILBOX_HERO.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.right:
      if (S_MAILBOX_HERO.row_focus == 0) {
        if (S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 0) S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 1 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 2 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 2 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 5 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 3 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 4 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 4 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 7 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 5 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 6 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 7 && (S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 8);
        else if (S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 1 || S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 2 || S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 3)
          if (S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 1) S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 2;
          else if (S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 3) S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 4;
        else return
      } else if (S_MAILBOX_HERO.btn_focus == 1) S_MAILBOX_HERO.btn_focus = 2;
      else return;
      S_MAILBOX_HERO.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.up:
      S_MAILBOX_HERO.row_focus == 0 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 0 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 3 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 1 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 4 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 2 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 7 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 5 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 8 && (S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 6) : (S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 1 || S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 2 || S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 3) && (S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 3 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 1 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 4 && (S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 2)) : S_MAILBOX_HERO.row_focus = 0;
      S_MAILBOX_HERO.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.down:
      S_MAILBOX_HERO.row_focus == 0 && (S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 0 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 1 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 3 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 2 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 4 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 5 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 7 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 6 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 8 : (S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 3 || S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 4 || S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 7 || S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 8) && (S_MAILBOX_HERO.row_focus = 1, S_MAILBOX_HERO.btn_focus = 1) : (S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 1 || S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 2 || S_MAILBOX_HERO.hero_what_value == 3) && (S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 1 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 3 : S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 2 ? S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 4 : (S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 3 || S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus == 4) && (S_MAILBOX_HERO.row_focus = 1, S_MAILBOX_HERO.btn_focus = 1)));
      S_MAILBOX_HERO.drawFocus();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.enter:
      S_MAILBOX_HERO.menuRun();
      break;
    case KeyDefine.esc:
    case KeyDefine.back:
      S_MAILBOX_HERO.run_back()
  }
};
S_MAILBOX_HERO.menuRun = function() {
  if (gEnableKey = 0, S_MAILBOX_HERO.row_focus == 0) S_MAILBOX_HERO.select_item(), gEnableKey = 1;
  else if (S_MAILBOX_HERO.row_focus == 1) switch (S_MAILBOX_HERO.btn_focus) {
    case 1:
      S_MAILBOX_HERO.run_back();
      break;
    case 2:
      S_MAILBOX_HERO.confirm_selection();
      break;
    default:
      utilConsoleLog("Error in S_MAILBOX_HERO.menuRun()");
      gEnableKey = 1
  } else utilConsoleLog("Error in S_MAILBOX_HERO.menuRun() - invalid row_focus"), gEnableKey = 1
};
S_MAILBOX_HERO.run_back = function() {
  gTARGET_PLATFORM == gPLATFORM.LGWEBOS_TV && glo.APP_FEATURE.HISTORY_BACK ? history.back() : S_MAILBOX_HERO.backKey()
};
S_MAILBOX_HERO.backKey = function() {
  S_MAILBOX_HERO.removeMouseEvent();
  S_MAILBOX_HERO.end();
  $("#S_MAILBOX_div").css({
    display: "block"
  });
  ServerConnection.get_reward2_mailbox(S_MAILBOX_HERO.after_reload_mailbox)
};
S_MAILBOX_HERO.after_reload_mailbox = function() {
  S_MAILBOX.init();
  gEnableKey = 1;
  ChangeScene.start(g_sceneinfo.cur_scene, gS_MAILBOX, S_MAILBOX)
};
S_MAILBOX_HERO.end = function() {
  utilConsoleLog("S_MAILBOX_HERO.end()");
  $("#S_MAILBOX_HERO_div").remove();
  S_MAILBOX_HERO.removeMouseEvent()
};
S_MAILBOX_HERO.removeMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && $(".button").unbind("mouseover")
};
S_MAILBOX_HERO.addMouseEvent = function() {
  gMOUSE_USE && (S_MAILBOX_HERO.removeMouseEvent(), $(".button").click(this.onClick).mouseover(this.onMouseover))
};
S_MAILBOX_HERO.onClick = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && gEnableKey != 0) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") return;
    switch (t.id) {
      case "MH_wukong_box_item1_area":
      case "Img_MH_wukong_box_item1_focus":
      case "MH_wukong_box_item2_area":
      case "Img_MH_wukong_box_item2_focus":
      case "MH_wukong_box_item3_area":
      case "Img_MH_wukong_box_item3_focus":
      case "MH_wukong_box_item4_area":
      case "Img_MH_wukong_box_item4_focus":
      case "MH_mukhyang_box_item1_area":
      case "Img_MH_mukhyang_box_item1_focus":
      case "MH_mukhyang_box_item2_area":
      case "Img_MH_mukhyang_box_item2_focus":
      case "MH_mukhyang_box_item3_area":
      case "Img_MH_mukhyang_box_item3_focus":
      case "MH_mukhyang_box_item4_area":
      case "Img_MH_mukhyang_box_item4_focus":
        S_MAILBOX_HERO.select_item();
        break;
      case "Img_MH_back_btn":
      case "Txt_MH_back_btn":
      case "Img_MH_back_btn_focus":
        S_MAILBOX_HERO.run_back();
        break;
      case "Img_MH_select_btn":
      case "Txt_MH_select_btn":
      case "Img_MH_select_btn_focus":
        S_MAILBOX_HERO.confirm_selection()
    }
  }
};
S_MAILBOX_HERO.onMouseover = function(n) {
  if (gMOUSE_USE && (utilConsoleLog(" onMouseover  e.target.id: " + n.target.id + "   currentTarget:" + n.currentTarget.id), gEnableKey != 0)) {
    for (var t = n.target; !(t.className && t.className.search("button") >= 0);)
      if (t = t.parentNode, t == null || t.nodeName == "BODY" || t.nodeName == "HTML") {
        t = null;
        return
      } switch (t.id) {
      case "MH_wukong_box_item1_area":
      case "Img_MH_wukong_box_item1_focus":
        S_MAILBOX_HERO.row_focus = 0;
        S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 1;
        S_MAILBOX_HERO.drawFocus();
        break;
      case "MH_wukong_box_item2_area":
      case "Img_MH_wukong_box_item2_focus":
        S_MAILBOX_HERO.row_focus = 0;
        S_MAILBOX_HERO.item_focus = 2;
        S_MAILBOX_HERO.drawFocus();
        break;
      case "MH_wukong_box_item3_area":
      case "Img_MH_wukong_box_item3_focus":
        S_MAILBOX_HERO.row_focus = 0;

util.get_remain_time = function(n) {
  var f = parseInt(window.g.timestamp_start, 10) + parseInt(window.g.timestamp_due, 10),
    i = n - f,
    r;
  if (i <= 0) r = TXT.event_end;
  else if (i > 0 && i <= 59e3) r = "[" + TXT.daydungeon_remain_time + "] " + TXT.less_than_1_minute;
  else {
    var t = Math.floor(i / 36e5),
      u = Math.floor((i - t * 36e5) / 6e4),
      e = t > 9 ? t : t == 0 ? "00" : "0" + t,
      o = u > 9 ? u : u == 0 ? "00" : "0" + u;
    r = t >= 24 ? "[" + TXT.daydungeon_remain_time + "] " + Math.floor(t / 24) + " " + TXT.package_remain_time : "[" + TXT.daydungeon_remain_time + "] " + e + ":" + o
  }
  return r
};
