    if (r = REWARD_AD.get_state(t.place, t.sub), r === "OFF") {
      $("#" + n).css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $("#Img_" + n + "_aura").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $("#Img_" + n + "_subpop").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $("#Img_" + n + "_subpop_dim").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      $("#Txt_" + n + "_subpop").css({
        display: "none"
      });
      return
    }
    $("#" + n).css({
      display: "block"
    });
    t.aura && $("#Img_" + n + "_aura").css({
      display: "block"
    });
    t.subpop && ($("#Img_" + n + "_subpop").css({
      display: "block"
    }), $("#Txt_" + n + "_subpop").css({
      display: "block"
    }));
    var h = typeof t.label_txt != "undefined" ? t.label_txt : TXT.reward_ad_watch,
      s = "",
      i = !1,
      u = "";
    r === "COOL" ? (u = REWARD_AD.format_mmss(REWARD_AD.get_cool_remain_sec()), i = !0) : r === "LIMIT" ? (f = REWARD_AD.get_midnight_remain_sec(), u = t.cool_hm ? REWARD_AD.format_hmm(f) : REWARD_AD.format_hmmss(f), i = !0) : r === "BUFF" && (u = REWARD_AD.format_mmss(REWARD_AD.get_buff_remain_sec()), i = !0);
    t.locked && !i && (e = REWARD_AD.get_midnight_remain_sec(), u = t.cool_hm ? REWARD_AD.format_hmm(e) : REWARD_AD.format_hmmss(e), i = !0);
    t.no_daily || (o = REWARD_AD.get_max(t.place, t.sub), o > 0 && (s = REWARD_AD.get_used(t.place, t.sub) + " / " + o));
    $("#Txt_" + n + "_label").html(h);
    $("#Txt_" + n + "_sub").html(s);
    $("#Txt_" + n + "_cool").html(i ? u : "").css({
      display: i ? "block" : "none"
    });
    $("#Img_" + n + "_dim").css({
      display: i ? "block" : "none"
    });
    t.subpop && t.subpop.dim_img && $("#Img_" + n + "_subpop_dim").css({
      display: i ? "block" : "none"
    })
  }
};
REWARD_AD.refresh_all = function() {
  for (var n in REWARD_AD.btn_list) REWARD_AD.btn_list.hasOwnProperty(n) && REWARD_AD.refresh_btn(n)
};
REWARD_AD.hide = function(n) {
  $("#" + n).css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_" + n + "_aura").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_" + n + "_subpop").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Img_" + n + "_subpop_dim").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  $("#Txt_" + n + "_subpop").css({
    display: "none"
  });
  REWARD_AD.btn_list[n] && (REWARD_AD.btn_list[n].hidden = 1)
};
REWARD_AD.show = function(n) {
  REWARD_AD.btn_list[n] && (REWARD_AD.btn_list[n].hidden = 0);
  REWARD_AD.refresh_btn(n)
};
REWARD_AD.set_lock = function(n, t) {
  var i = REWARD_AD.btn_list[n];
  i && (i.locked = t ? 1 : 0, REWARD_AD.refresh_btn(n))
};
REWARD_AD.is_shown = function(n) {
  var t = REWARD_AD.btn_list[n];
  return t ? t.hidden ? !1 : REWARD_AD.get_state(t.place, t.sub) !== "OFF" : !1
};
REWARD_AD.is_enabled = function(n) {
  var t = REWARD_AD.btn_list[n];
  return t ? t.hidden ? !1 : t.locked ? !1 : REWARD_AD.get_state(t.place, t.sub) === "READY" : !1
};
REWARD_AD.hit = function(n, t) {
  if (!n) return !1;
  if (n === t || n.indexOf(t) >= 0) return !0;
  var i = REWARD_AD.btn_list[t];
  return i && i.focus_id && n === i.focus_id ? !0 : !1
};
REWARD_AD.notice_state = function(n) {
  var i = REWARD_AD.btn_list[n],
    t;
  i && (t = REWARD_AD.get_state(i.place, i.sub), t === "LIMIT" ? utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_limit, 1.5) : t === "COOL" ? utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_cool, 1.5) : t === "BUFF" && utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_buff_on, 2))
};
REWARD_AD.tick_start = function() {
  REWARD_AD.tick_timer || (REWARD_AD.tick_timer = setInterval(function() {
    REWARD_AD.refresh_all()
  }, 1e3))
};
REWARD_AD.tick_stop = function() {
  REWARD_AD.tick_timer && (clearInterval(REWARD_AD.tick_timer), REWARD_AD.tick_timer = null);
  REWARD_AD.btn_list = {}
};
REWARD_AD.play = function(n, t, i, r) {
  if (!REWARD_AD.busy_flag) {
    var u = REWARD_AD.get_state(n, t);
    if (u !== "READY") {
      u === "COOL" ? utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_cool, 1.5) : u === "LIMIT" && utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_limit, 1.5);
      return
    }
    REWARD_AD.busy_flag = 1;
    gEnableKey = 0;
    ServerConnection.reward_ad("begin", n, t, "", function(u) {
      if (!u || u.STATE !== "SUCCESS") {
        REWARD_AD.busy_flag = 0;
        gEnableKey = 1;
        REWARD_AD.notice_fail_code(u ? u.CODE : "");
        REWARD_AD.refresh();
        return
      }
      REWARD_AD.pending_ad = {
        place: n,
        sub: t,
        ticket: u.TICKET,
        extra: i,
        on_grant: r,
        scene: g_sceneinfo.cur_scene,
        t0: Date.now(),
        timed_out: 0
      };
      REWARD_AD.arm_watchdog(2e4);
      REWARD_AD.is_web_platform() ? REWARD_AD.web.show(n) : android_bridge.show_reward_ad_ex(n, "REWARD_AD.on_ad_result")
    })
  }
};
REWARD_AD.on_ad_result = function(n) {
  REWARD_AD.clear_watchdog();
  var t = REWARD_AD.pending_ad;
  if (t) {
    if (REWARD_AD.pending_ad = null, REWARD_AD.busy_flag = 0, n !== "true") {
      ServerConnection.reward_ad("cancel", t.place, t.sub, t.ticket, null);
      gEnableKey = 1;
      REWARD_AD.notice_auto(t.timed_out ? TXT.reward_ad_no_fill : TXT.reward_ad_aborted, 2);
      REWARD_AD.refresh_all();
      return
    }
    REWARD_AD.save_pending_grant(t);
    REWARD_AD.run_grant(t, 0)
  }
};
REWARD_AD.run_grant = function(n, t) {
  REWARD_AD.grant_ticket = n.ticket;
  ServerConnection.reward_ad("grant", n.place, n.sub, n.ticket, function(i) {
    if (!i || i.STATE !== "SUCCESS") {
      if (REWARD_AD.is_fatal_fail(i)) {
        REWARD_AD.grant_ticket = "";
        REWARD_AD.clear_pending_grant();
        gEnableKey = 1;
        REWARD_AD.notice_grant_fail(i.CODE);
        REWARD_AD.refresh_all();
        return
      }
      if (t < 3) {
        var r = [2e3, 5e3, 1e4][t];
        setTimeout(function() {
          REWARD_AD.run_grant(n, t + 1)
        }, r);
        return
      }
      REWARD_AD.grant_ticket = "";
      gEnableKey = 1;
      REWARD_AD.notice_auto(TXT.reward_ad_reward_fail, 2);
      return
    }
    REWARD_AD.grant_ticket = "";
    REWARD_AD.grant_done[n.ticket] = 1;
    REWARD_AD.clear_pending_grant();
    gEnableKey = 1;
    i && !i.TICKET && (i.TICKET = n.ticket);
    g_sceneinfo.cur_scene === n.scene && n.on_grant && n.on_grant(i);
    REWARD_AD.refresh_all()
  })
};
REWARD_AD.FATAL_CODE = {
  ALREADY_DONE: 1,
  ALREADY_ADDED: 1,
  ALREADY_CLEAR: 1,
  NOT_FINISHED: 1,
  NO_SCORE: 1,
  EXPIRED: 1,
  BAD_TICKET: 1,
  BAD_PLACE: 1,
  BAD_SUB: 1,
  BAD_MODE: 1,
  NOT_TARGET_PLATFORM: 1,
  AD_OFF: 1,
  OLD_VERSION: 1,
  NOT_EVENT_PERIOD: 1,
  REPLAY_NO_RESULT: 1,
  SUB_DENY: 1,
  BAD_MULTI: 1,
  DD_FAIL: 1
};
REWARD_AD.is_fatal_fail = function(n) {
  return !n || !n.CODE ? !1 : REWARD_AD.FATAL_CODE[n.CODE] === 1
};
REWARD_AD.notice_auto = function(n, t) {
  n && (String(n).indexOf("<br>") >= 0 ? utilNotice_line2_html(n, t) : utilNotice(n, t))
};
REWARD_AD.notice_grant_fail = function(n) {
  n === "ALREADY_DONE" || n === "ALREADY_ADDED" || n === "ALREADY_CLEAR" ? utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_already_done, 2) : n === "LIMIT" ? utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_limit, 2) : n === "COOL" ? utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_cool, 2) : utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_reward_gone, 2)
};
REWARD_AD.notice_fail_code = function(n) {
  n === "COOL" ? utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_cool, 1.5) : n === "LIMIT" ? utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_limit, 1.5) : n === "GAGE_FULL" ? utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_gauge_full, 2) : n === "BUFF_ON" ? utilNotice(TXT.reward_ad_buff_on, 2) : n === "AD_OFF" || REWARD_AD.notice_auto(TXT.reward_ad_no_fill, 2)
};
REWARD_AD.arm_watchdog = function(n) {
  REWARD_AD.clear_watchdog();
  REWARD_AD.watchdog_timer = setTimeout(function() {
    REWARD_AD.pending_ad && (REWARD_AD.pending_ad.timed_out = 1);
    REWARD_AD.busy_flag = 0;
    gEnableKey = 1;
    REWARD_AD.is_web_platform() && REWARD_AD.web.close_frame()
  }, n)
};
REWARD_AD.clear_watchdog = function() {
  REWARD_AD.watchdog_timer && (clearTimeout(REWARD_AD.watchdog_timer), REWARD_AD.watchdog_timer = null)
};
REWARD_AD.drop_pending = function(n) {
  REWARD_AD.pending_ad && REWARD_AD.pending_ad.place === n && (REWARD_AD.pending_ad = null, REWARD_AD.busy_flag = 0)
};
REWARD_AD.PENDING_MAX_TRY = 5;
REWARD_AD.save_pending_grant = function(n) {
  try {
    var t = {
      place: n.place,
      sub: n.sub,
      ticket: n.ticket,
      ts: Date.now(),
      try_n: 0
    };
    localStorage.setItem(REWARD_AD.PENDING_KEY, JSON.stringify(t))
  } catch (i) {}
};
REWARD_AD.bump_pending_try = function(n) {
  try {
    n.try_n = (n.try_n || 0) + 1;
    localStorage.setItem(REWARD_AD.PENDING_KEY, JSON.stringify(n))
  } catch (t) {}
};
REWARD_AD.clear_pending_grant = function() {
  try {
    localStorage.removeItem(REWARD_AD.PENDING_KEY)
  } catch (n) {}
};
REWARD_AD.flush_pending_grant = function() {
  var n, t;
  if (REWARD_AD.is_supported()) {
    n = null;
    try {
      if (t = localStorage.getItem(REWARD_AD.PENDING_KEY), !t) return;
      n = JSON.parse(t)
    } catch (i) {
      return
    }
    if (!n || !n.ticket) {
      REWARD_AD.clear_pending_grant();
      return
    }
    if (REWARD_AD.grant_ticket !== n.ticket) {
      if (REWARD_AD.grant_done[n.ticket]) {
        REWARD_AD.clear_pending_grant();
        return
      }
      if (Date.now() - n.ts > 864e5) {
        REWARD_AD.clear_pending_grant();
        return
      }
      if ((n.try_n || 0) >= REWARD_AD.PENDING_MAX_TRY) {
        REWARD_AD.clear_pending_grant();
        return
      }
      REWARD_AD.bump_pending_try(n);
      REWARD_AD.grant_ticket = n.ticket;
      ServerConnection.reward_ad("grant", n.place, n.sub, n.ticket, function(t) {
        if (REWARD_AD.grant_ticket = "", t && t.STATE === "SUCCESS") {
          REWARD_AD.grant_done[n.ticket] = 1;
          REWARD_AD.clear_pending_grant();
          REWARD_AD.refresh_all();
          return
        }
        REWARD_AD.is_fatal_fail(t) && REWARD_AD.clear_pending_grant()
      })
    }
  }
};
REWARD_AD.web.load_sdk = function() {
  if (REWARD_AD.web.load_state === 0 && REWARD_AD.web.cfg && REWARD_AD.web.cfg.app_key) {
    REWARD_AD.web.load_state = 1;
    window.AdPopcornSSPWebSDK = window.AdPopcornSSPWebSDK || {
      cmd: []
    };
    window.AdPopcornSSPWebSDK.cmd.push(function() {
      try {
        AdPopcornSSPWebSDK.init({
          app_key: String(REWARD_AD.web.cfg.app_key),
          placement_id: String(REWARD_AD.web.cfg.placement)
        });
        AdPopcornSSPWebSDK.setConfig({
          adid: REWARD_AD.web.ZERO_ADID
        });
        REWARD_AD.web.load_state = 2
      } catch (n) {
        utilConsoleLog("REWARD_AD.web init fail: " + n);
        REWARD_AD.web.load_state = 3
      }
      REWARD_AD.refresh_all()
    });
    var n = document.createElement("script");
    n.async = !0;
    n.src = REWARD_AD.web.SDK_URL;
    n.onerror = function() {
      REWARD_AD.web.load_state = 3;
      REWARD_AD.refresh_all()
    };
    (document.head || document.getElementsByTagName("head")[0]).appendChild(n)
  }
};
REWARD_AD.web.get_user_id = function() {
  var i = String(glo.fun.get_uniq_id() || ""),
    n, t;
  try {
    if (typeof CryptoJS != "undefined" && CryptoJS.MD5) return CryptoJS.MD5(i).toString()
  } catch (r) {}
  for (n = 0, t = 0; t < i.length; t++) n = (n << 5) - n + i.charCodeAt(t) | 0;
  return "eldo_" + (n >>> 0).toString(16)
};
REWARD_AD.web.make_frame = function() {
  var n, t;
  return REWARD_AD.web.remove_frame(), n = document.createElement("div"), n.id = REWARD_AD.web.FRAME_ID, n.style.cssText = "position:absolute;left:0px;top:0px;width:1280px;height:720px;background:#000;z-index:99999;overflow:hidden;", t = document.getElementById("div_body") || document.body, t.appendChild(n), n
};
REWARD_AD.web.remove_frame = function() {
  var n = document.getElementById(REWARD_AD.web.FRAME_ID);
  n && n.parentNode && n.parentNode.removeChild(n)
};
REWARD_AD.web.close_frame = function() {
  var n = REWARD_AD.web.rv;
  if (REWARD_AD.web.rv = null, n) try {
    n.terminateAd(REWARD_AD.web.FRAME_ID)
  } catch (t) {}
  REWARD_AD.web.remove_frame()
};
REWARD_AD.web.show = function() {
  var t = window.AdPopcornSSPWebSDK,
    n;
  if (REWARD_AD.web.load_state !== 2 || !t || typeof t.createRewardVideo != "function") {
    REWARD_AD.web.finish(!1, 1);
    return
  }
  REWARD_AD.web.completed = 0;
  REWARD_AD.web.make_frame();
  try {
    n = t.createRewardVideo({
      user_landing_enabled: !1
    });
    n.setUserId(REWARD_AD.web.get_user_id())
  } catch (i) {
    utilConsoleLog("REWARD_AD.web create fail: " + i);
    REWARD_AD.web.finish(!1, 1);
    return
  }
  REWARD_AD.web.rv = n;
  n.addEventListener("sdkError", function(t) {
    REWARD_AD.web.rv === n && (utilConsoleLog("REWARD_AD.web sdkError " + (t ? t.code + " " + t.message : "")), REWARD_AD.web.finish(!1, 1))
  });
  n.addEventListener("adInventoryRendered", function(t) {
    if (REWARD_AD.web.rv === n) {
      if (t && t.isNoAd) {
        REWARD_AD.web.finish(!1, 1);
        return
      }
      REWARD_AD.clear_watchdog()
    }
  });
  n.addEventListener("adPlaybackCompleted", function() {
    REWARD_AD.web.rv === n && (REWARD_AD.web.completed = 1, REWARD_AD.pending_ad && REWARD_AD.save_pending_grant(REWARD_AD.pending_ad))
  });
  n.addEventListener("adClickthrough", function(n) {
    if (n && n.clickthroughURL) try {
      window.open(n.clickthroughURL, "_blank")
    } catch (t) {}
  });
  n.addEventListener("adClosed", function() {
    REWARD_AD.web.rv === n && REWARD_AD.web.finish(REWARD_AD.web.completed === 1, 0)
  });
  try {
    n.display(REWARD_AD.web.FRAME_ID)
  } catch (i) {
    utilConsoleLog("REWARD_AD.web display fail: " + i);
    REWARD_AD.web.finish(!1, 1)
  }
};
REWARD_AD.web.finish = function(n, t) {
  REWARD_AD.web.close_frame();
  t && REWARD_AD.pending_ad && (REWARD_AD.pending_ad.timed_out = 1);
  REWARD_AD.on_ad_result(n ? "true" : "false")
};
REWARD_AD.init_visibility = function() {
  document.addEventListener && document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", function() {
    document.hidden || (REWARD_AD.refresh_all(), REWARD_AD.pending_ad && Date.now() - REWARD_AD.pending_ad.t0 > 3e4 && (REWARD_AD.busy_flag = 0, gEnableKey = 1))
  }, !1)
};
try {
  REWARD_AD.init_visibility()
} catch (e) {}
